m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum reception distribution bill to make the provincial allocation final by 1 February, extend the voluntary phase to 1 November, and postpone ministerial distribution decisions to 31 December.
By extending the phase in which reception facilities can be offered voluntarily, the chance that interadministrative supervision is needed is reduced.

Door de fase waarin op vrijwillige basis opvangfaciliteiten kunnen worden aangeboden te verlengen, wordt de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten verminderd.
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum shelter distribution law: earlier dates for provincial and municipal figures, a longer voluntary phase to 1 November, and postponing the minister's distribution decisions to 31 December, reducing use of interbestuurlijk toezicht.
This amendment enables the Minister to announce the distribution across all provinces and the indicative distribution per municipality before 1 February.
Dit amendement stelt de Minister in staat om de verdeling over alle provincies en de indicatieve verdeling per gemeente vóór 1 februari bekend te maken
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid
Changes the asylum reception distribution timetable so the minister's distribution decisions are postponed to 31 December and interbestuurlijk toezicht is less likely to be needed.

Moreover, the taking of distribution decisions by the Minister after insufficient places are offered is postponed, thereby reducing the chance that interadministrative supervision is used to realise reception facilities.

Bovendien wordt het nemen van verdeelbesluiten na het uitblijven van voldoende plekken door de Minister uitgesteld, waardoor de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten wordt verminderd.
Motie van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over het oprichten van een samenwerkingsverband voor werkgevers en werknemers van beroepsgroepen die onder druk staan

Asks the government to set up, modelled on PersVeilig, a collaboration for professional groups under pressure to offer collective support against aggression, working with the Public Prosecution Service and police.
requests the government, modelled on PersVeilig, to set up a collaboration for employers and employees in these professional groups
verzoekt de regering om, naar voorbeeld van PersVeilig, een samenwerkingsverband op te richten voor werkgevers en werknemers in deze beroepsgroepen
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over toetsing van de Grondwet aan institutioneel-organisatorische bepalingen en beslechting van bestuursgeschillen bij de rechter mogelijk maken
Asks the government to make it possible for the constitution to be tested against institutional provisions and for administrative disputes to be settled by the courts.
requests the government to enable review of the Constitution against institutional-organisational provisions, and the settlement of administrative disputes by the courts.
verzoekt de regering om toetsing van de Grondwet aan institutioneel-organisatorische bepalingen, alsook de beslechting van bestuursgeschillen bij de rechter mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over de aanpassing van de beperkingssystematiek van de Grondwet meenemen bij de consultatie over wijziging van artikel 120 van de Grondwet
Asks the government to include revising the Constitution's system for limiting fundamental rights in the consultation on amending article 120, which bars courts from reviewing statutes.
requests the government to include the adjustment of the Constitution's limitation system in the consultation on amending article 120 of the Constitution
verzoekt de regering de aanpassing van de beperkingssystematiek van de Grondwet mee te nemen in de consultatie over wijziging van artikel 120 van de Grondwet
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over oprichting van een grondwettelijk hof meenemen in de consultatieversie van de voorstellen
Asks the government to include the creation of a constitutional court in the consultation version of the parliamentary system proposals.
include the establishment of a constitutional court in the consultation version of the proposals
in de consultatieversie van de voorstellen oprichting van een grondwettelijk hof mee te nemen
Motie van de leden Gündoğan en Valstar over het stimuleren van precisiefermentatie in Nederland in kaart brengen
Asks the government to map how far and how it promotes precision fermentation in the Netherlands and inform the House by Q1 2023.
requests the government to map the extent and manner in which the development of precision fermentation in the Netherlands is being promoted
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen in welke mate en op welke wijze de ontwikkeling van precisiefermentatie in Nederland wordt gestimuleerd
Motie van het lid Van Campen c.s. over de landsadvocaat binnen twee weken vragen om een spoedadvies vragen over de situatie rond PAS-melders
Asks the government to have the state's legal adviser urgently advise on whether provinces may refrain from enforcing against PAS-melders and whether an enforcement moratorium is possible.

Requests the government, with the province of Overijssel, to ask the state advocate for an urgent advice within two weeks on the grounds on which provinces may refrain from enforcing against PAS-melders.
verzoekt de regering, met de provincie Overijssel, de landsadvocaat binnen twee weken om een spoedadvies te vragen: – op welke gronden provincies kunnen afzien van handhaving van PAS-melders
Motie van het lid Gündoğan over een onafhankelijke appreciatie en vergelijking van het Europese landbouw- en landschapsbeleid met het Costa Ricaanse PES-model
Asks the government to put an independent appraisal comparing EU agricultural and landscape policy with Costa Rica's PES model on the agenda of the next Council of Ministers.
requests the government to put an independent appraisal and comparison of EU agricultural and landscape policy with Costa Rica's PES model on the agenda
verzoekt de regering om de uitvoering van een onafhankelijke appreciatie en vergelijking van het Europese landbouw- en landschapsbeleid met het Costa Ricaanse model van Payment for Ecosystem Services
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over middelen voor biomedisch onderzoek naar Long COVID
Shifts 10 million euro within the 2023 health budget from the corona access pass reserve to biomedical research on Long COVID.
The funding for the released amount is taken from the funds reserved for the corona access pass.
De dekking voor het vrijgemaakte bedrag wordt gehaald uit de middelen die gereserveerd zijn voor het coronatoegangsbewijs.
Motie van het lid Bromet c.s. over inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel nog voor de aankomende waterschapsverkiezingen
Asks the government to ensure the water board seat law takes effect before the upcoming water board elections and is published in the Staatsblad by 18 December 2022.
requests the government to ensure that the bill takes effect before the upcoming water board elections
verzoekt de regering zorg te dragen dat het wetsvoorstel nog voor de aankomende waterschapsverkiezingen in werking treedt
Motie van het lid Wassenberg c.s. over een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om het aantal proeven op niet-humane primaten verder te verlagen
Asks the government to commission independent experts in 2023 to study how animal testing on non-human primates can be reduced further without harming necessary research.
requests the government to commission during 2023 a study into the possibility of further reducing the number of tests on non-human primates
verzoekt de regering om in de loop van 2023 de opdracht te geven tot een onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om het aantal proeven op niet-humane primaten verder te verlagen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 86 over vliegbelasting voor (privé-)vliegtuigen
Lowers the weight threshold for the aviation tax from 8,616 kg to 4,000 kg so small private jets are also taxed.
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over middelen voor biomedisch onderzoek naar Long COVID
Moves 10 million euros for 2023 from the COVID entry-pass budget to biomedical research on Long COVID within the health budget.
This amendment provides that 10 million euros is made available for 2023 for more biomedical research into Long COVID.
Dit amendement regelt dat er voor 2023 € 10 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor meer biomedisch onderzoek naar Long COVID.
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over bevorderen dat de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed een inspectie doet op het hele ministerie van Algemene Zaken

Asks the government to ensure the Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed inspects the entire Prime Minister's ministry, including the corona hotspot archive, after archiving violations of the Archives Act.
requests the government to promote that the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage inspects the entire Ministry of General Affairs
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed een inspectie doet op het hele Ministerie van Algemene Zaken
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over uitwonende studenten meenemen in de plannen voor energiecompensatie
Asks the government to extend the energy cost allowance to students living away from home, for example via a €250 amount for municipalities or DUO.
requests the government to also include students in the plans
verzoekt de regering ook studenten mee te nemen in de plannen
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over een langjarige strategie voor voedselzekerheid en energiezekerheid van Nederlandse huishoudens
Asks the government to present within six months a long-term strategy for food and energy security of Dutch households.
requests the government to formulate and present within half a year a long-term strategy for food and energy security of Dutch households
verzoekt de regering binnen een halfjaar een langjarige strategie te formuleren en te presenteren voor de voedselzekerheid en energiezekerheid van Nederlandse huishoudens
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over de regeling aanpassen en uitbreiden ten behoeve van mensen die er nu buiten vallen
Asks the government to add a second benefit tier of 400 euro for a higher income band and to give municipalities generous funds for energy allowances for people outside the scheme.
requests the government to adjust and extend the scheme along the following lines
verzoekt de regering de regeling langs de volgende lijnen aan te passen en uit te breiden
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over geen volledige uitkering voor gemeentes die een bovengrens hanteren van minder dan 120% van het sociaal minimum
Asks the government not to transfer the full energy allowance to municipalities that set a ceiling below 120% of the social minimum or impose extra restrictions.
not to transfer the full allowance
niet de volledige uitkering over te maken
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over steun aan de culturele en creatieve sector
Adds funding of 150 million euros to the culture budget to support the cultural and creative sector, including a safety-net scheme for freelancers and makers hit by the coronavirus crisis.
In article 14 Culture, the commitment appropriation and the expenditure appropriation are increased by 150,000 euros (x 1,000 euros).
In artikel 14 Cultuur worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 150.000 (x € 1.000).
Motie van het lid Van der Laan c.s. over de aanbeveling van GREVIO over de digitale dimensie van geweld tegen vrouwen
Asks the government to map what is needed to implement the GREVIO recommendation on the digital dimension of violence against women and inform the House.
requests the government to map what is needed to implement the GREVIO recommendation on the digital dimension of violence against women and to inform the House
verzoekt de regering in beeld te brengen wat er nodig is om de GREVIO-aanbeveling omtrent de digitale dimensie van geweld tegen vrouwen te implementeren en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van de leden De Hoop en Gündoğan over de wenselijkheid van een meerouderschapswet
Calls for a law allowing more than two legal parents, which the government has not yet delivered despite coalition agreements.
declares that a multi-parent law is necessary and desirable
spreekt uit dat een meerouderschapswet nodig en gewenst is
Motie van de leden Gündoğan en De Hoop over evenveel vrouwelijke als mannelijke bewindspersonen in het nieuwe kabinet
Asks that the new cabinet have equal numbers of female and male ministers and state secretaries.
states that the new cabinet should have equal numbers of female and male ministers and state secretaries
spreekt uit dat in het nieuwe kabinet evenveel vrouwelijke als mannelijke bewindspersonen plaats dienen te nemen
Motie van het lid Van der Laan c.s. over gelijke vergoedingen voor mannen en vrouwen in de topsport
Asks the government to map gender differences in top-sport fees paid indirectly by the state and, where they exist, to equalise them with NOC*NSF.
requests the government to map in which sports the fees paid to top athletes indirectly through the state differ between men and women
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen bij welke sporten de vergoedingen aan topsporters die indirect via rijkswege worden betaald, verschillen tussen mannen en vrouwen
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het bereiken van evenwichtig koopkrachtbeleid per 1 januari 2022
Asks the government to submit an amendment note achieving balanced purchasing-power policy with overall purchasing-power retention from 1 January 2022.
requests the government to submit an amendment note that achieves the earlier stated balanced purchasing-power policy
verzoekt de regering een nota van wijziging in te dienen die het eerder aangegeven evenwichtige koopkrachtbeleid
Motie van het lid Simons c.s. over het onderbrengen van het onderwerp "sekswerk" bij het ministerie van SZW
Asks the cabinet to prepare moving sex work to the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment to protect workers' labour rights.
requests the caretaker cabinet to take preparatory steps to place sex work under the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment
verzoekt het demissionair kabinet voorbereidende stappen te zetten om sekswerk onder te brengen bij het Ministerie van SZW
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het minimumloon met 4% extra verhogen per 1 januari
Asks the government to raise the statutory minimum wage by an extra 4% from 1 January as an advance on the coalition agreement, to preserve purchasing power.
requests the government, as an advance on the coalition agreement, to raise the minimum wage by an extra 4% per 1 January
verzoekt de regering als voorschot op het regeerakkoord het minimumloon met 4% extra te verhogen per 1 januari
Motie van het lid Ploumen c.s. over een Nationaal Cultuurplan voor een breed aanbod in alle provincies
Asks the government to develop a National Culture Plan with funding for a broad cultural offer in all provinces.
requests the government to develop a National Culture Plan to achieve a broad and varied offer
verzoekt de regering een Nationaal Cultuurplan te ontwikkelen om te komen tot een breed en gevarieerd aanbod
Motie van het lid Gündoğan c.s. over de Nederlandse culturele en creatieve sector onderdeel maken van programma's in Europees verband aangaande de digitale transformatie
Asks the government to gather existing EU knowledge on digital transformation of the cultural sector and to make the Dutch sector an active part of relevant EU programmes.
requests the government to gather the knowledge on digital transformation already available at European level
verzoekt de regering de kennis die aangaande de digitale transformatie reeds beschikbaar is in Europees verband te vergaren
Motie van het lid Gündoğan c.s. over verlaging van het aantal te werken uren voor internationale studenten om in aanmerking te komen voor studiefinanciering
Asks the government to lower the required monthly working hours for international students to qualify for study finance from 56 to 32.
requests the government to reduce the number of hours international students must work to qualify for study finance from 56 to a maximum of 32 hours per month
verzoekt de regering het aantal te werken uren voor internationale studenten om in aanmerking te komen voor studiefinanciering van 56 uur per maand te verlagen naar maximaal 32 uur per maand
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over de stagevergoeding voor alle mbo'ers aan laten sluiten bij die van de rijksstagiairs
Asks the cabinet to align the internship allowance for all mbo students with the national civil service intern allowance, with a support scheme for employers who cannot afford it.
requests the cabinet to align the internship allowance for all mbo students with that of national government interns
verzoekt het kabinet de stagevergoeding voor alle mbo'ers aan te laten sluiten bij die van de rijksstagiairs
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over advies vragen over het inrichten van een operationeel publiek-privaat expertisecentrum voor geneesmiddelenontwikkeling
Asks the government to request advice from the KNAW and FAST on setting up an operational public-private expertise centre for medicine development.
requests the government to ask the KNAW, together with FAST and others, for follow-up advice on how an operational public-private expertise centre can be set up
verzoekt de regering om de KNAW, samen met FAST en andere betrokkenen, om een vervolgadvies te vragen over de wijze waarop een operationeel publiek-privaat expertisecentrum ingericht kan worden
Motie van het lid Wassenberg c.s. over concrete voorbereidingen voor het verbeteren van het studentenwelzijn
Asks the government to prepare concrete measures so a next cabinet can quickly improve student wellbeing and mental health.
requests the government to make as many concrete preparations as possible that a next cabinet can use
verzoekt de regering om zo veel mogelijk concrete voorbereidingen te treffen die een volgend kabinet kunnen helpen
Motie van het lid Van der Woude c.s. over een onderzoek of zelfcensuur en beperking van diversiteit van perspectieven een rol spelen in wetenschap en hoger onderwijs
Asks the government to commission research into whether self-censorship and limited diversity of perspectives play a role in science and higher education.
requests the government to have it investigated whether self-censorship and limited diversity of perspectives play a role in science and higher education
verzoekt de regering om te laten onderzoeken of zelfcensuur en beperking van diversiteit van perspectieven in de wetenschap en het hoger onderwijs een rol spelen
Motie van de leden Gündoğan en De Hoop over een concreet langeretermijnactieplan om hoger te scoren op het algemene basisvaardighedenniveau
Asks the government for a long-term, cross-cabinet action plan to raise basic skills performance within ten years.
requests the government to draw up a concrete long-term action plan with clear ambitions, across cabinet periods
verzoekt de regering een concreet langeretermijnactieplan met heldere ambities op te stellen, over kabinetsperiodes heen
Motie van het lid Gündoğan over het bevorderen van onderwijsvernieuwing door middel van het Europese Universiteiten Initiatief
Asks the government to map how the European Universities Initiative can be promoted and to draw up an action plan.
requests the government to map how education innovation can be promoted through the European Universities Initiative
verzoekt de regering om in kaart te brengen hoe onderwijsvernieuwing door middel van het Europese Universiteiten Initiatief bevorderd kan worden
Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over het schrappen van de toekomstige bezuinigingen in het hoger onderwijs
Asks the government to scrap planned future budget cuts to higher education.
requests the government to scrap the future cuts in higher education
verzoekt de regering om de toekomstige bezuinigingen in het hoger onderwijs te schrappen
Motie van de leden Simons en Gündoğan over een landelijk dekkend systeem in de aanpak van laaggeletterdheid
Asks the government for a nationwide system against functional illiteracy, structural funding and information to the House before the education budget debate.
to inform the House as soon as possible, and in any case before the OCW budget debate for 2023
de Kamer hier op zo kort mogelijke termijn, maar in ieder geval voor de begrotingsbehandeling van OCW voor het begrotingsjaar 2023, over te informeren
Motie van de leden Simons en Gündoğan over streven naar 100% acceptatie van lhbtiqa+ mensen in het onderwijs
Asks the government to aim for 100% acceptance of LGBTQIA+ people in education and to adjust government communication accordingly.
requests the government to strive for 100% acceptance of LGBTQIA+ people in education among others
verzoekt de regering te streven naar 100% acceptatie van lhbtiqa+ mensen in onder andere het onderwijs
Amendement van het lid Gündoğan over middelen voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling
Increases the commitment and spending appropriations for research and science policy by 380,000 thousand euro, financed by additional public debt.
the commitment amount and the expenditure amount increased by € 380,000 (x € 1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 380.000 (x € 1.000)
Amendement van de leden Gündoğan en Maatoug ter vervanging nr. 49 over het verhogen van de accijns op tabak.
Raises tobacco excise rates from April 2022 so that a standard cigarette pack costs about 10 euros, to reduce smoking.
The excise duty on cigarettes is raised so that the price of a standard pack comes to 10 euros.
De accijns op sigaretten wordt zodanig verhoogd dat de prijs van een standaard pakje op 10 euro uitkomt.
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de uithuisplaatsingen in het toeslagenschandaal
Asks the government to commission independent research into the child-benefit scandal's out-of-home placements, set up a reporting point for parents, and propose family reunification and redress.
requests the government to have independent research carried out into the scale of the problem and how this could have happened for years
verzoekt de regering: – onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de omvang van het probleem en hoe dit jarenlang heeft kunnen gebeuren
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het aantal geanonimiseerde rechterlijke uitspraken verhogen tot ten minste 50%
Asks the government to raise the share of court rulings published in anonymised form to at least 50%, starting with appeal courts and the Council of State.
requests the government in the coming years to increase the number of rulings published anonymised to at least 50%
verzoekt de regering de komende jaren het aantal uitspraken dat geanonimiseerd gepubliceerd wordt te verhogen tot ten minste 50%
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 39 over het zekerstellen van belastingheffing van buitenlandse beleggers in vastgoed
Makes dividend tax apply to capital-gain distributions from a real estate investment fund's reinvestment reserve, closing a tax loophole on foreign investors.
With this amendment the submitters ensure that the above-mentioned tax loophole in the dividend tax is closed.
Met dit amendement zorgen de indieners ervoor dat bovengenoemd heffingslek in de dividendbelasting wordt gedicht
Amendement van de leden Gündoğan en Maatoug over het verhogen van de accijns op tabak.
Raises excise duties on cigarettes and rolling tobacco from April 2022 so a standard pack costs about 10 euro, to reduce smoking.
Scientific research has shown that raising the excise duty on tobacco is the most effective instrument for reducing tobacco use.
Uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek is gebleken dat verhoging van de accijns op tabak het meest effectieve instrument vormt om het gebruik van tabak terug te dringen
Amendement van het lid Maatoug ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het dichten van een gat in de wetgeving rond fusie en splitsing
Amendment clarifying the Corporate Income Tax act so that asset acquisitions under general title in mergers or demergers count as comparable legal acts for an anti-hybrid measure.
This amendment ensures that acquisition of an asset under general title in a merger or demerger is treated as a comparable legal act for the anti-avoidance measure
Dit amendement stelt zeker dat de verkrijging van een vermogensbestanddeel onder algemene titel in het kader van een fusie of een splitsing voor de toepassing van de flankerende maatregel
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het niet door laten gaan van de wijziging van de schijflengte per 1 januari 2022
Amends the corporate tax bracket so the low rate stays at the 2021 threshold of 245,000 euro instead of rising to 395,000 euro, raising revenue.
It is unclear what problem is solved by this annual revenue loss of 721 million euro
Het is onduidelijk welk probleem er wordt opgelost met deze jaarlijkse derving van € 721 miljoen
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het tegengaan van het opknippen van bedrijfsactiviteiten over meer vennootschappen

Proposes a group-wide rule so that the €1 million earnings-stripping threshold and the lower 15% corporate tax rate can be applied only once within a concern, to stop splitting business activities across companies.
With this amendment the submitters make this form of tax avoidance impossible.
Met dit amendement maken de indieners deze vorm van belastingontwijking onmogelijk.
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het zekerstellen van belastingheffing van buitenlandse beleggers in vastgoed
Removes the exemption from dividend tax for reinvestment reserves tied to gains on Dutch real estate, so foreign investors in funds pay tax on those gains.
With this amendment the submitters ensure that the above-mentioned gap in the dividend tax is closed.
Met dit amendement zorgen de indieners ervoor dat bovengenoemd gat in de dividendbelasting wordt gedicht
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het laten vervallen van vrijstellingen in de dividendbelasting
Abolishes several dividend tax exemptions, including the share buyback facility and the temporary investment exception.
The submitters do not see the added value of this exemption in the dividend tax.
De indieners van dit amendement zien niet in wat de toegevoegde waarde is van deze vrijstelling in de dividendbelasting.
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het afschaffen van de schenkingsvrijstelling eigen woning
Amends the Successiewet to abolish the enhanced gift tax exemption for a own home for recipients aged 18 to 40 from 2024.
The evaluation of the gift exemption for the own home shows that this tax exemption mainly amounts to help for homeowners with wealthy parents.
Uit de evaluatie van de schenkingsvrijstelling eigen woning blijkt dat deze belastingvrijstelling vooral neerkomt op hulp voor huiseigenaren met vermogende ouders.
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het dichten van een gat in de wetgeving rond fusie en splitsing
Treats asset acquisitions under general title in mergers and demergers as comparable transactions for a tax anti-hybrid rule, with exceptions for facilitated reorganisations.
This amendment provides that the acquisition of an asset in a merger or demerger under general title is deemed a comparable transaction under the cited article 8bd.

Dit amendement regelt dat de verkrijging van een vermogensbestanddeel in het kader van een fusie of splitsing waarbij vermogen onder algemene titel wordt verkregen, geacht wordt een met de in genoemd artikel 8bd
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over beperken van het overgangsrecht

Moves the start date of the transitional rule for the depreciation restriction on assets acquired from affiliated companies back to 1 January 2017, so that fewer companies get long transitional relief.
The bill contains a depreciation restriction for certain assets that taxpayers acquired from an affiliated body.
In het wetsvoorstel is een afschrijvingsbeperking opgenomen voor bepaalde bedrijfsmiddelen die belastingplichtigen hebben verkregen van een gelieerd lichaam
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het opnemen van een antimisbruikbepaling
Adds a specific anti-abuse rule to the transfer pricing mismatch provisions to block artificial intermediary-company constructions.
The bill lacks a provision preventing the proposed measures from being avoided through a non-arm's-length transaction with an intermediate affiliated entity
In het wetsvoorstel ontbreekt een bepaling die voorkomt dat de voorgestelde maatregelen worden ontgaan door de onzakelijke transactie aan te gaan met een tussengeschakeld gelieerd lichaam
Amendement van het lid Maatoug c.s. over het niet kwalificeren van een nultarief als een naar winst of inkomen geheven belasting
Clarifies in the tax law definitions that only taxes on profit or income with a nominal rate above zero count as such, so a zero-rate tax does not qualify.
a tax on profit or income at a nominal rate of 0% does not qualify
een naar de winst of het inkomen geheven belasting tegen een nominaal tarief van 0% niet kwalificeert
Amendement van de leden Simons en Gündoğan over middelen voor genderzorg
Shifts 2.5 million euros within the health budget to fund a triage pilot for gender care waiting lists.
The funding for this amendment is found in the non-legally mandatory expenditure of article 2 Curative care.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in de niet-juridisch verplichte uitgaven van artikel 2 Curatieve zorg.
Motie van het lid Gündoğan over een pilot om domeinoverstijgend te werken aan effectieve armoedebestrijding
Asks the government to explore a multi-domain pilot on effective poverty reduction for families near the poverty line and monitor health effects.
asks the government to start an exploration for a pilot in which work is done across domains
verzoekt de regering om een verkenning te starten voor een pilot waarin op een domeinoverstijgende manier gewerkt wordt
Motie van het lid Gündoğan over inzetten op brede gezondheid en preventie
Asks the government to pursue broad health and prevention policy across policy areas in a more binding way, in line with a WRR report.
expresses that, in line with the WRR report, broad health and prevention should be pursued in a more binding way across policy areas

MPs Rajkowski, Gündoğan and Brekelmans asked whether Dutch customs should stop using Chinese Nuctech scanners after Belgium's Council of State upheld exclusion of Nuctech from a tender, and whether this and EU and intelligence warnings should prompt a rethink. The state secretary answered that about 70 of roughly 100 customs scanners are Nuctech, that national security is not currently endangered under a TNO study, that procurement law limits exclusion of EU suppliers, and that stricter security requirements, a supplier-diversification effort and further research are underway.

The first part of the study indicated that national security is currently not endangered if the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the customs scan and detection processes is not compromised.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about lead contamination in Amsterdam's Oosterpark, including whether the park should be treated as a children's play area and whether warning signs should be placed. The municipality of Amsterdam is the competent authority to assess soil quality and possibly take measures, including issuing usage advice.

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports of Chinese police targeting suspects and dissidents abroad, including the detention of the mother and sister-in-law of a Dutch air force officer, and whether the government will act on the surveillance, intimidation, and his security clearance. The minister says unwanted foreign interference is unacceptable, that the Chinese 'overseas police stations' have been closed, that individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy and security reasons, and that the government will not intervene in Chinese legal proceedings or offer the family refugee status, while pointing to EU coordination and efforts to raise awareness.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the government's alternative to the planned real-return wealth tax, including the Tax Authority's IT burden, information gaps, complexity and precedent in other OECD countries. The State Secretary answered that a real-return system is still being prepared, that a refined flat-rate alternative is less complex to implement but shifts workload to service and oversight, and that a detailed implementation assessment and a letter on box 3 are still pending.
An implementation assessment quantifying the effects has not yet taken place and is planned for when the draft bill is published for internet consultation.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het grote tekort aan betaalbare huurwoningen op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked whether the government will provide the guarantee needed for the Bonaire housing association FCB's plan to build 500 social rental homes, and whether a national mortgage guarantee will be introduced for Bonaire. Minister Plasterk answered that FCB lacks the financing for a viable project, that his ministry is still exploring options including with NIA before deciding on any state guarantee, and that the Waarborgfonds Eigen Woningen is preparing a temporary mortgage guarantee for Caribbean Netherlands with an operational scheme targeted for mid-2017.
Before the (im)possibility of a guarantee from the central government is on the table, I want to complete that exploration.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over de dood van een agent op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Interior Affairs about the 2016 shooting death of a police officer on Bonaire, its impact on the force, and whether insurance and employer benefits differ between locally recruited and seconded officers. The Minister acknowledged the death and its effects, confirmed that terms of employment and employer arrangements differ for Caribbean Netherlands civil servants, and said a suitable employer provision for death in service is being examined.
Currently it is being examined how a suitable employer provision in case of death from a service accident can be created for (all) civil servants in the Caribbean part of the Netherlands.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Laar en Kerstens over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about planned pension cuts at the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, including a 3.5% cut in April 2017 and possible further cuts in 2018 under DNB supervision rules, and the reduced recovery period. The government confirmed the 3.5% cut and that further cuts depend on funding levels, explained the different recovery rules for Caribbean Netherlands, said it will work on targeted support measures, and declined to answer the question on PCN's 2010 capitalisation because the matter is before the court.
The cabinet, as an employer, is one of the social partners and is involved in talks about PCN's financial situation in that role.
Het kabinet is als werkgever één van de sociale partners, en is vanuit die rol betrokken bij de gesprekken over de financiële situatie van PCN.

The minister agreed with the concerns, described existing gender analysis requirements, water strategy commitments, CSR and due diligence efforts, and measures on women human rights defenders.
A condition for approval of all programmes the Netherlands supports, including water, food security and climate, is carrying out a gender analysis.

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Branded Childhood report linking clothing brands' low wages and excessive overtime to child labour and school dropout in Bangladesh, and what the government would do about living wages, rising living costs, transparency and wage benchmarks. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to existing actions such as the textile covenant, round tables, a Bangladesh conference and ISEAL benchmark work, and declined to commit to new binding legislation.
Government policy is aimed at voluntarily concluding IMVO covenants.
Het kabinetsbeleid is gericht op het vrijwillig afsluiten van IMVO-convenanten.

MPs asked the minister about forced and child labour in South Indian spinning mills supplying Western garment brands, referring to a 2016 NGO report, and what the government would do with companies and international bodies. The minister agreed that forced labour is widespread, pointed to OECD due diligence and the Textile Covenant, and described raising the issue with the Indian government and the ILO without committing to a specific new step.
I share the conclusion that forms of slavery occur in many spinning mills.
Ik deel de conclusie dat vormen van slavernij in veel spinnerijen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vervuilende afvalstort op Sint Eustatius

MP Van Laar asked whether a storm on Sint Eustatius washed a large part of the landfill into the sea, whether the landfill still sits on the coast, and why the new waste installation is not yet operational. Minister Plasterk answered that only a small part slid onto Zeelandia beach with limited environmental damage, that the Island Government is responsible for operating the new installation and is working on a budget solution, and that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger will keep discussing the timeline with the island.
The Island Government is currently looking for a solution.
Het OL is op dit moment bezig met het zoeken naar een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Laar over de duizenden kinderen die als kindsoldaten worden gebruikt in de Centraal Afrikaanse Republiek

The MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the thousands of child soldiers in the Central African Republic, including estimates, the 2015 peace accord, Dutch support for released children, and funding. The Minister answers that the number is unclear, outlines Dutch financing through EU, VN and humanitarian channels, and states no extra contribution is currently foreseen.
The cabinet currently does not foresee any additional contribution.
Het kabinet voorziet momenteel geen extra bijdrage.

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister whether certified palm oil plantations in Indonesia using child labour can be called sustainable, how RSPO and due diligence failures should be addressed, and what steps Unilever and Indonesia should take. The minister acknowledged the Amnesty report, said child labour makes palm oil unsustainable, pointed to RSPO complaint mechanisms and OECD contact point options, and committed to talks with Unilever and to working through multi-stakeholder forums and the Indonesian government.
The cabinet is of the view that products made with child labour are not sustainable.
Het kabinet is van mening dat producten die met kinderarbeid tot stand zijn gekomen niet duurzaam zijn.

Van Laar (PvdA) asked the minister whether the government knew of alleged poisoning, exploitation and sexual harassment of workers at Royal Van Zanten in Uganda, and what it would do. Minister Ploumen answered that Ugandan authorities are investigating, the embassy is facilitating dialogue, the Dutch state is not involved in the company's activities, and consequences depend on the outcome of that investigation.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of this investigation.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het ontbreken van schoolboeken op een school in Bonaire

An MP asked whether the VWO school Liseo Bonairiano on Bonaire still lacked textbooks for several subjects, what caused it, whether other schools were affected, and how equal education standards are guaranteed across the Dutch Caribbean. The Staatssecretaris answered that late sea delivery of books caused shortages, teachers used self-made materials so no lesson time was lost, all books are now present, no other schools report problems, and a second education agenda for Caribbean Netherlands is being signed.
The board of the Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is responsible for ordering and keeping the books in stock.
Het bestuur van de Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is verantwoordelijk voor het bestellen en op voorraad hebben van de boeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Kerstens over het recht op een werkloosheidsuitkering voor Nederlanders die in Caribisch Nederland werkzaam zijn geweest

Two MPs asked whether Dutch nationals whose last job was on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba can claim unemployment benefit under the Werkloosheidswet, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirmed that such workers are excluded from the European-Dutch unemployment insurance, pointed to the one-off Cessentiawet BES benefit on the islands, and refused to change the rules.

No. Employees whose last work was in Caribbean Netherlands can claim a one-off benefit under the Cessentiawet BES, if they become unemployed through no fault of their own and meet the other conditions.
Nee. Werknemers die laatstelijk werkzaam zijn geweest in Caribisch Nederland kunnen aanspraak maken op een eenmalige uitkering op grond van de Cessentiawet BES
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vragen van het lid Van Laar over vermeende invloed van president Assad bij de verstrekking van VN-hulp aan Syriërs

An MP asked the government whether President Assad's influence over UN aid distribution in Syria is acceptable, and whether an exception to the rule of cooperating with host governments should apply. The government answered that the UN must work with the Syrian regime to reach millions in need, acknowledges the dilemmas, supports the UN approach, and will keep parliament informed.
The cabinet will keep you informed of further developments through the usual channels.
Het kabinet zal u via de gebruikelijke wegen op de hoogte houden van verdere ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over fraude met hulpgoederen voor Syrische vluchtelingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about suspected fraud with aid goods for Syrian refugees, including how Dutch NGOs responded, whether ministry protocols exist, and whether the Chamber will be informed proactively. The minister said investigations are ongoing, the affected NGOs informed the ministry and tightened procedures, no own investigation is planned, and the Chamber will be informed of conclusions and of fraud involving Dutch funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het rapport Uitgekleed-Aangekleed

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report documenting exploitation of Indian garment workers supplying Dutch brands, including the companies' responses, complaint options under the textile covenant, the BSCI label, and India's role in living-wage efforts. The Minister acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, pointed to the covenant's due diligence and complaint mechanisms, and said government will raise the matter with companies, BSCI and ILO-linked actors, while stating that factory names were not shared with companies.
The cabinet wants to discuss the report 'Uitgekleed-Aangekleed' within the framework of the IMVO covenant for the clothing and textile sector concluded in July.
Het kabinet wil de discussie over het rapport «Uitgekleed-Aangekleed» voeren in het kader van het in juli afgesloten IMVO-convenant voor de kleding- en textielsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het sluiten van een school op Curaçao als gevolg van uitstoot van gevaarlijke stoffen van de ISLA raffinaderij

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a Curaçao school was again evacuated due to emissions from the ISLA refinery, and what steps were taken to implement a motion to cut emissions within three months. The minister declined to answer the facts and causes questions, saying the matter is Curaçao's responsibility, but said an inspection of the refinery is being assisted and results are expected by year-end.
These questions relate to a matter that falls under the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Onderhavige vragen hebben betrekking op een onderwerp dat tot de verantwoordelijkheid behoort van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de onmogelijkheid om in het Caribisch deel van Nederland de Nederlandse televisiezenders te ontvangen

An MP asked why Dutch TV channels were not receivable in Caribbean Netherlands and what the government would do about it. The government answered that the NPO adjusted geo-IP filtering so the islands can access its services, that sports rights are sold by geographic zone, and that commercial broadcasters set their own distribution policy.
For the distribution of media services by commercial broadcasters, this is not a matter for the Dutch government.
Voor de doorgifte van mediadiensten van commerciële omroepen geldt dat dit geen zaak is van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over “Wageningse geurval kan malaria uitroeien”

An MP asked the ministers whether a scent-trap method for malaria mosquitoes could be applied in the Caribbean Netherlands to combat chikungunya and Zika, and whether a pilot would be started. The minister answered that such research is important but results do not transfer directly to other settings, and committed to a joint plan with Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius, with a pilot only if research supports it.
With these islands it has been agreed that they will jointly work out a plan with the RIVM.
Met deze eilanden is afgesproken dat zij met het RIVM gezamenlijk tot een plan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over toegenomen ongelijkheid tussen kinderen in ontwikkelingslanden en roep om stevigere inzet t.b.v. de Werelddoelen over ondervoeding en onderwijs

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising inequality among children in developing countries, malnutrition, education gaps and the Sustainable Development Goals. The minister replied that the Netherlands supports nutrition and education programmes and points to results, but gives no new commitments beyond existing initiatives.
Carrying out specific context analyses and setting targets on malnutrition is first and foremost the responsibility of the national governments concerned.
Het uitvoeren van specifieke context analyses en het stellen van doelen op gebied van ondervoeding is op de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende nationale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het willen weren van seksuele voorlichting op scholen door het Oegandese parlement

Van Laar (PvdA) asked the minister about a reported Ugandan parliamentary resolution to ban sexuality education in schools and publicly burn materials, and about the Dutch response. Minister Ploumen replied that no such resolution was adopted, that Uganda had committed to comprehensive sexuality education, and that quiet diplomacy rather than a public statement is preferred.
The Ugandan parliament did not adopt a resolution calling for sexuality education to be banned from schools and for sexuality education materials to be publicly burned.
Het Oegandese parlement heeft geen resolutie aangenomen waarin wordt opgeroepen seksuele voorlichting op scholen te weren en schoolmateriaal voor seksuele voorlichting publiekelijk te verbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid in de textielsector van Myanmar

An MP asked the minister whether H&M's Myanmar suppliers employing 14-year-olds, working until 22:00, breach ILO norms and Myanmar law, and what the Netherlands is doing about child labour and the 'waterbed effect' in textiles. The minister answered that ILO norms on hours and schooling are breached if structural overtime occurs, that the ILO and EU programmes are the main tools, and that Dutch companies are expected to apply due diligence, though no Dutch textile firms currently operate in Myanmar.
If structural overtime and working hours until 22:00 were actually occurring, that would contradict ILO norms.
Mocht er daadwerkelijk sprake zijn van structureel overwerk en werktijden tot 22.00 uur, dan is dat in tegenspraak met de ILO-normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het uitblijven van internationale veiligheidsinterventies in Burundi

An MP asked the ministers about the Burundian government's rejection of a UN police force and African Union experts, the options to get them into the country, available UN/AU sanctions, the outcome of an EU visit and the Western position on the stalled dialogue, and measures against food, education and malaria shortages. The ministers answered that the UN force needs Burundi's consent and is for the UN secretariat to negotiate, listed existing sanctions tools while calling suspension of UN membership exceptional, said the EU visit was postponed to September, and described Dutch aid programmes on food, education and malaria.
It is up to the UN secretariat to reach agreement with the Burundian government on a possible solution.
Het is aan het VN-secretariaat om met de Burundese overheid tot overeenstemming te komen over een mogelijke oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het stoppen van kindhuwelijken in Tanzania

An MP asked the minister about the Tanzanian government's appeal against a High Court ruling that child marriage under 18 is unconstitutional, whether the Netherlands had responded, and how it could promote an end to child marriage. The minister said no formal appeal had yet been lodged and the Netherlands would monitor developments with EU partners and consider further support depending on the grounds of appeal.
Formally, there is not yet an appeal.
Formeel is er nog geen sprake van een hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Smaling over de kwetsbare positie van vrouwen bij landregistratieprojecten in onder andere Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Smaling asked whether a Dutch-supported land registration pilot in Ngozi, Burundi, left women with fewer land claims, whether gender analysis should precede such projects, and how gender inequality features in land registration projects. The minister acknowledged Dutch support, said about 95% of registered parcels in Ngozi are in men's names and that some customary women's rights risk erosion, and argued that gender analysis must be integral to such projects and that Nederland continues to support land registration where women's inheritance rights are not legally codified.
It is estimated that before the registration process, about 10% of parcels in the area were subject to such a right exercised by a woman.
Naar schatting werd voorafgaand aan het registratieproces op ongeveer 10% van de percelen in het betreffende gebied een dergelijk recht uitgeoefend door een vrouw.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het rapport 'Beauty and a Beast, Child labour in India for sparkling cars and cosmetics’ van SOMO en Terre des Hommes over kinderarbeid in mica-mijnen in India

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the SOMO and Terre des Hommes report on child labour in Indian mica mines, including rising child labour numbers, due diligence by Dutch companies, monitoring and support for local organisations. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Dutch firms must apply OECD due diligence, pointed to IMVO covenant talks and Dutch-supported child labour projects in India, but gave no clear explanation for the rise in child workers and no binding monitoring or sanctions commitment.

The cabinet is of the view that child labour in this kind of sector belongs to the worst forms of child labour and that Dutch companies must carry out due diligence to ensure they do not contribute to it.

Het kabinet is van mening dat kinderarbeid in dit soort sectoren tot de ergste vormen van kinderarbeid behoort en dat Nederlandse bedrijven hun due diligence moeten uitvoeren om te zorgen dat ze hieraan niet bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en van Laar over de discrepantie tussen het door banken gestelde beleid met betrekking tot arbeidsrechten en de misstanden in de kleding- en elektronicasector

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a gap between banks' stated policies on labour rights and abuses in the garment and electronics sectors, and what the government will do about it. The minister said the banks' policies are largely adequate but their practice (engagement with clients) needs improvement, and that a responsible-business covenant with the banking sector, which the government supports, is expected to be signed after the summer.
It is expected that the covenant will be signed after the summer.
Het is de verwachting dat het convenant na de zomer ondertekend zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over het bericht dat de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties (VN) is gechanteerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Saudi Arabia pressured the UN Secretary-General into removing its coalition from the children and armed conflict blacklist, and whether the Netherlands would press the UN to restore it. The minister called the findings on child casualties in Yemen very concerning, said the listing was removed pending further fact-finding, condemned any political pressure as unacceptable, and said the Netherlands is coordinating with the EU and the Group of Friends on a joint response supporting the independence of the Special Representative.

The cabinet is consulting within the EU and with partners in the Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict on how to respond jointly to this situation and to publicly express support for the independent mandate of the UN Special Representative.

Het kabinet overlegt binnen de EU en met partners binnen de Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict op welke wijze gezamenlijk op deze situatie te reageren en publiekelijk steun uit te spreken voor het onafhankelijke mandaat van de Speciaal Vertegenwoordiger van de SGVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over de moord en inbraak bij een Oegandese mensenrechtenorganisatie

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister about the murder and break-in at a Ugandan human rights organisation, the status of the NGO Bill, and support for the LGBT community in Uganda. The minister said the perpetrators are not yet arrested, that the EU will raise the break-in in a political dialogue and seek better protection for human rights groups, and that the NGO Bill is not yet applied, with no current grounds for further measures.
During this dialogue the EU will raise the violent break-in and press for measures to better protect human rights organisations against such break-ins.
Tijdens deze dialoog zal de EU de gewelddadige inbraak aan de orde stellen en aandringen op maatregelen om mensenrechtenorganisaties beter te beschermen tegen dergelijke inbraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over beperkte toegankelijkheid van de websites van Nederlandse ambassades voor het maatschappelijk middenveld in Senegal, Mozambique en Burundi

An MP asked why embassy websites in Senegal, Mozambique and Burundi offer funding information for local organisations only in Dutch, and whether they would add English, French or local-language versions and track application language. The minister replied that Dakar and Bujumbura sites already have French versions and Maputo has English, that embassies do not systematically track applications, that no applications have yet come via the websites, and that no pilot for local languages is planned.
Applications for funds are submitted by email, by post or in person.
Aanvragen voor fondsen worden per email, per post of in persoon ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jasper van Dijk over het geweld rondom het Agua Zarca project in Honduras en de vermeende betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs Van Laar and Jasper van Dijk asked about violence around the Agua Zarca project in Honduras, alleged FMO involvement, and the investigation into the murder of activist Berta Cáceres. The minister said the government was shocked, FMO was withdrawing from the project, and it had urged Honduran authorities to accept IACHR involvement, while the fact-finding and broader accountability questions remain under review.
The government considers it crucial to have the facts clearly established and has therefore given relevant stakeholders the opportunity to share their views on the project.
Het kabinet vindt het cruciaal de feiten goed op een rij te hebben en heeft daarom betrokken stakeholders de mogelijkheid gegeven om hun visie op het project te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over Burundese vluchtelingen en het voortdurend vermoorden van (vermeende) tegenstanders van president Nkurunziza in en buiten Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about escalating violence in Burundi, refugees being attacked in camps abroad, shortages in refugee camps, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers answered that Dutch and EU pressure, sanctions, suspended direct budget aid and support for a regional dialogue continue, and that Dutch humanitarian funding and a 1 million euro contribution for the Mahama camp were provided, while the AU observer deployment is delayed.
Because of the violence and the poorly conducted elections, the Netherlands suspended direct aid to Burundi in 2015.
Vanwege het geweld en de slecht verlopen verkiezingen heeft Nederland in 2015 de directe hulp aan Burundi opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over (onder)voeding

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the UN Decade of Action on Nutrition, a new investment framework, the investment needed to end global undernutrition, the balance between people, planet and profit in food security policy, and Dutch representation at the WHA and Nutrition for Growth summit. The minister answered each question, committing to letters to the House on the investment results and policy balance, while noting the Nutrition for Growth summit's date is uncertain and no invitation has been received.
Your House will be informed further about this in the letter promised during the Food Security committee meeting of 27 January.
Uw Kamer zal daarover nader worden geïnformeerd in de brief die is toegezegd tijdens het AO Voedselzekerheid van 27 januari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het schrijnende gebrek aan goede psychologische zorg in Indonesië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Indonesia's failure to provide adequate psychological care, the abuses (including chaining) documented by Human Rights Watch, and whether Netherlands should help Indonesia through training, twinning or EU initiatives. The minister said the findings are worrying, that Indonesia has not requested Dutch assistance, and that the Dutch embassy is exploring support for initiatives strengthening people with mental health conditions.
It is the responsibility of the Indonesian government to protect people with a psychological condition and to meet its international obligations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Indonesische overheid om bescherming te bieden aan mensen met een psychologische aandoening en aan haar internationale verplichtingen te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Koser Kaya en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Politicus Bonaire werd onterecht bespioneerd’

MPs Pechtold, Koşer Kaya and Van Laar asked whether the AIVD unlawfully collected data on former Bonaire minister Jopie Abraham and other Bonairean politicians, and how access refusals were tested. The Minister declined to discuss the CTIVD's non-public ruling or operational matters, stated that access refusals are tested under the Wiv 2002 on knowledge-protection grounds, and saw no reason to request further investigation.
The CTIVD's assessment of the complaint by Mr Jopie Abraham is not public.
Het oordeel van de CTIVD inzake de klacht van de heer Jopie Abraham is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactiviste Berta Cáceres is vermoord in Honduras

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers how the government would respond to the murder of Honduran activist Berta Cáceres, how it would monitor Honduras's human rights efforts, what steps it had taken regarding FMO's involvement in a dam project, and how it would address the protection of human rights defenders. The ministers answered that the government condemned the killing, had the ambassador raise investigation demands with Honduran authorities, pressed FMO on land rights and transparency, and outlined existing human rights defender protection programmes.
The government regularly speaks with FMO about its investment policy.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met FMO over haar investeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over hulp aan vrouwelijke en minderjarige slachtoffers van ontvoeringen door Boko Haram

MP Van Laar asked the minister about aid to female and underage victims of Boko Haram abductions in Nigeria, their stigmatisation, and the embassy's role. The minister said the findings are known, listed existing Dutch-funded and multilateral psychosocial programmes, and said the problem is that aid does not always reach the group rather than a lack of aid.
Where possible we draw attention to this problem, for example via the Dutch embassy in Abuja, our contacts with international aid organisations and our input into the policy process in Brussels.

Waar mogelijk vestigen we de aandacht op dit probleem, bijvoorbeeld via de Nederlandse ambassade in Abuja, onze contacten met de internationale hulporganisaties en onze inbreng in het beleidsproces in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de oplopende tekorten aan voedselhulp in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about looming food aid shortfalls in Ethiopia, including Dutch steps, EU coordination, donor conferences, refugee migration and lessons from the delayed Ethiopian appeal. The Minister answered in detail, describing Dutch contributions of EUR 5m to the CHF, EUR 8.6m via the DRA, EUR 8m to WFP and FAO, EU and UN funding, and a refugee programme, while declining to convene a donor conference for now.
However, the Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and calls on other countries to also contribute substantially.
Nederland blijft echter de situatie nauwlettend volgen en roept andere landen op ook substantieel bij te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht Syrian refugees in Turkish garment supply chains: An analysis of company action to address serious exploitation

MP Van Laar asked the minister whether companies are doing enough to prevent exploitation of Syrian refugees, including children, in Turkish garment supply chains, and what the government will do about it. The minister said the government expects buyers to investigate their Turkish supply chains, noted new Turkish work-permit rules and planned EU-funded education, and said a sector IMVO covenant and an anti-child-labour fund are being prepared, while declining to launch its own survey of Dutch textile firms.
The government sees little value in conducting such a survey itself.
Het kabinet ziet weinig in het zelf uitvoeren van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderen en vrouwen die het slachtoffer zijn van seksueel geweld ten tijde van de ebola-epidemieën

MP Van Laar asks the minister about reports of rising sexual violence against women and girls during the Ebola epidemics, including teenage pregnancies and a Liberian ban on pregnant girls attending school, and what the Netherlands will do. The minister acknowledges the increase, describes NGO-funded prevention work and Dutch agenda-setting on sexual and reproductive rights, and calls the school ban unwise without announcing a concrete new measure.
The absolute figures are not known to the cabinet, but the increase in sexual violence underlying them is very regrettable.
De absolute cijfers zijn bij het kabinet niet bekend, maar de toename van seksueel geweld dat hier aan ten grondslag ligt is zeer te betreuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht ‘Kinderarbeid achter batterijen voor smartphones en elektrische auto’s’

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of child labour in cobalt mining for smartphone and electric car batteries, asking whether large brands could be held to account and whether cobalt could be added to EU conflict-minerals rules. The minister said the government will engage industry through due diligence guidance and an IMVO covenant, raise the issue with Congo and China, but will not push to add cobalt to the EU regulation since Parliament, Council and Commission did not propose it.
The government is willing to raise this situation with the Chinese government.
Het kabinet is bereid deze situatie aan te kaarten bij de Chinese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over over de bosbranden in Indonesië en het streven naar duurzame palmolie

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the minister about a Friends of the Earth report alleging that palm oil producers Wilmar and Bumitama Agri fail their no-burning commitments and Indonesian law, and about implications for RSPO credibility and the 2020 sustainable palm oil ambition. The minister replied that the companies have reaffirmed no-burning policies, that RSPO has monitoring and sanctions mechanisms though not waterproof, and that Indonesian enforcement is difficult but the government supports capacity building and partnerships.
Possible breaches of the agreements must be taken seriously, but do not undermine the ambitions and concrete actions in this area.
Eventuele schendingen van de afspraken moeten serieus worden genomen, maar ondermijnen niet de ambities en concrete acties op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het niet bereiken van vrouwen en meisjes in noodsituaties met specifieke hulp

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNFPA findings that women and girls in crises and emergencies are not reached with reproductive health aid, and about gaps such as sanitary products in refugee camps. The Minister acknowledged the gaps, described Dutch efforts through EU and World Humanitarian Summit agendas, UN partners and NGOs, and committed to continued advocacy without specifying new funding.
The Netherlands supports the UNFPA call to focus the (humanitarian) agenda more on women and girls, as well as on sexual and reproductive health and rights.
Nederland ondersteunt de oproep van UNFPA om de (humanitaire) agenda meer op vrouwen en meisjes, alsook op seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jan Vos over de vernieling van drie Nederlandse bedrijven in Ethiopië

MPs Van Laar and Jan Vos asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the destruction of three Dutch companies in Ethiopia, including the causes, land-grab concerns, government response and safety of Dutch entrepreneurs. The minister answered that two Dutch firms were affected, that the embassy is in close contact with them, that the attacks likely stemmed from fears over land rights linked to Addis Ababa's expansion, and that the Ethiopian government will prosecute perpetrators and facilitate compensation talks.
The Dutch embassy is in almost daily contact with the two affected Dutch companies, Solagrow and Grazeland.
De Nederlandse ambassade staat in bijna dagelijks contact met de twee getroffen Nederlandse bedrijven, Solagrow en Grazeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Voordewind over kinderarbeid en lage lonen bij Nederlandse en in Nederland actieve zaadbedrijven die in India actief zijn

MPs Van Laar and Voordewind asked the minister about child labour and underpayment of women in Dutch-linked vegetable seed companies operating in India, citing a 2015 NGO report and asking about industry follow-up, a convenant, complaint mechanisms and raising the issue bilaterally. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to Plantum's engagement with members, a planned IMVO risk analysis, a new child-labour fund, and openness to a sector convenant and bilateral raising of the issue, without committing to a specific sanction or binding measure.
I consider a sector convenant with the seed sector and directly involved parties a suitable means to deal properly with the issues the report draws attention to.
Een sectorconvenant met de zadensector en direct betrokkenen acht ik een geschikt middel om goed om te gaan met kwesties waar het rapport aandacht voor vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de schrijnende situatie in Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about Burundi's suspension of ten civil society organisations, its prosecution of them, Dutch links to those groups, conditions for resuming aid, the recall of Burundian EALA members, US sanctions, and support for refugees in neighbouring countries. The government answered that it had raised its concern about the measures with Burundian ministers, that three of the ten organisations receive Dutch funding, that aid resumes only after conditions such as a peaceful climate and media independence are met, and that it added funds for refugee relief.
Naturally, the Netherlands also expects the Burundian government to give civil society sufficient room to function, without fear of persecution.
Uiteraard verwacht Nederland eveneens dat de Burundese regering het maatschappelijk middenveld voldoende ruimte geeft om te kunnen functioneren, zonder angst voor vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over meer dan 1 miljoen kinderen in nood in de Centraal Afrikaanse Republiek

Van Laar (PvdA) asks the minister how the government responds to the UN finding that over one million children in the Central African Republic need urgent aid, why aid is not reaching them, and whether the Bekou Fund and its EUR 64 million capitalisation are adequate. Minister Ploumen answers that insecurity and attacks on aid workers hamper delivery, that the fund now has sufficient financing for 2016, and that further Dutch aid will be assessed after the electoral process in 2016.
In 2016, once the electoral process is completed, it will be examined in which areas additional Dutch aid is needed and possible.
In 2016, wanneer het verkiezingsproces is afgerond, zal worden bezien op welke terreinen extra Nederlandse hulp nodig en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Laar over de blokkade die goederen van India naar Nepal tegenhoudt

An MP asked the minister about an Indian-imposed blockade on goods to Nepal, its impact on earthquake relief and medicine shortages, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirmed the blockade, described intervention in a stranded aid shipment, said the government would raise the issue in the EU and with like-minded countries, and noted the UN Secretary-General's call to lift the blockade.
The Netherlands will raise this issue where possible, within the EU and in consultation with like-minded countries.
Nederland zal waar mogelijk deze kwestie aan de orde stellen, in EU-verband en in samenspraak met gelijkgezinde landen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kinderarbeid bij goudwinning voor de elektronicasector

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the government about child labour in gold mining supplying the electronics sector, including responsibility of electronics firms, EU and OECD action, development programmes in Mali, and due diligence convenants. Minister Ploumen answered that the government will raise the issue with the Conflict Free Smelters Program, pursue a sector IMVO covenant for gold by summer 2016, seek EU Council conclusions during the Dutch presidency, and support child labour programmes in Mali.
In the process towards an IMVO covenant for the gold sector, the ministry is in close consultation with, among others, several companies from the electronics sector.
In het traject om te komen tot een IMVO-convenant voor de goudsector is het ministerie in nauw overleg met onder meer enkele bedrijven uit de elektronicasector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het tekort aan voedsel in Noord-Irak

An MP asked the minister about the imminent end of food aid in northern Iraq due to funding shortfalls, the EU and member state contributions, and whether northern Iraq and Syria receive adequate attention. The minister acknowledged serious concern, listed Dutch and EU humanitarian contributions to Iraq, and denied that northern regions are neglected relative to Turkey, Jordan and Lebanon.
The Netherlands supports both organisations and calls on other donors to also contribute.
Nederland ondersteunt beide organisaties en roept andere donoren op ook bij te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de reis van de voltallige directie Koninkrijksrelaties naar Curaçao

An MP asked why the entire 28-member directorate for Kingdom Relations travelled to Curaçao for its annual meeting, what justified full attendance, and what the trip cost and achieved. The minister answered that the meeting enabled strategic consultation and site visits, that full attendance was needed for network maintenance across the Kingdom, that the total cost was €56,326.75 for 54 participants, and that the minister will continue to monitor sober travel policy.
Also in the future I will continue to monitor a sober implementation of the policy on business travel.
Ook in de toekomst blijf ik toezien op een sobere uitvoering van het beleid inzake dienstreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over burgerslachtoffers, oorlogsmisdaden en dreigende hongersnood in Jemen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the government about civilian casualties, alleged war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, and famine risk, including whether the Netherlands would raise these at the UN Human Rights Council and General Assembly and support an international inquiry. The ministers answered that the Netherlands will raise violations with all parties, intends to include an inquiry in its Yemen resolution, and has granted 10 million euro in additional humanitarian aid on top of earlier contributions.
The cabinet is very concerned about allegations of violations of international humanitarian law in Yemen and is committed to investigating them.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over beschuldigingen van schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht in Jemen en maakt zich sterk voor onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid in Syrië

An MP asked the minister about child labour and lost schooling among Syrian children, and what the Netherlands is doing internationally on education, livelihoods and child marriage. The minister confirmed the UNICEF/Save the Children findings, listed Dutch funding for education and child protection programmes, and said the Netherlands will pursue these issues in UN and EU fora.
The Netherlands will play an active role in the Champions Group on Education in Emergencies and Protracted Crisis set up by UN Special Envoy for Global Education Gordon Brown.

Antwoord 4 Nederland gaat een actieve rol vervullen in de door de VN Speciaal Gezant voor Wereldwijd Onderwijs, Gordon Brown, in het leven geroepen Champions» Group on Education in Emergencies and Protracted Crisis .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over een half miljoen kinderen die in de katoenzaadproductie werken

An MP asked the minister about a report estimating nearly half a million children work in Indian cottonseed production, and what Dutch firms and government are doing to stop child labour and secure living wages. The minister agreed the estimate is realistic, pointed to voluntary due diligence, sector covenants, Plantum surveys, and dialogue with India, but committed to no binding measures.
Together with colleague Kamp, I aim to conclude IMVO covenants with Dutch business sectors and civil society.
Samen met collega Kamp streef ik naar het afsluiten van IMVO-convenanten met Nederlandse bedrijfssectoren en maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Eijsink over de samenwerking met milities die kindsoldaten inzetten

MPs Van Laar and Eijsink asked the ministers about Dutch cooperation with militias that deploy child soldiers in the fight against IS, including whether Dutch forces work with Iraqi militias and what can be done to end child deployment. The government answered that it does not cooperate with parties using child soldiers, that its Iraq training targets Iraqi Special Operations Forces and Peshmerga rather than militias, and that it will keep raising human rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and support education for children.
The Netherlands does not cooperate with parties that deploy child soldiers.
Nederland werkt niet samen met partijen die kindsoldaten inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Van Laar en Rebel over het bericht 'Afrikaanse voetballers verhandeld in Azië'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about a BBC report on African footballers trafficked to Asia, including estimates of victims, Dutch signals, and EU/FIFA enforcement. Minister Schippers answered that the report alone gives no basis for judgment, that FIFA is already acting, that FIFA transfer rules and KNVB policy are in place, and that no Dutch intervention is warranted.
Additional research into the numbers is therefore, in my judgment, not necessary.
Aanvullend onderzoek naar aantallen is naar mijn oordeel dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over twee omstreden wetsvoorstellen in Oeganda
