MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the government about Ugandan bills restricting NGOs and anti-homosexuality legislation, including Dutch aid resumption. The ministers answered that the NGO bill threatens NGO freedom if adopted unamended, that the anti-homosexuality bill has not been formally submitted, and that the EU is handling the dialogue.
If the law is adopted without substantial changes, its application could significantly restrict the freedom of NGOs.
Wordt de wet zonder substantiële wijzigingen aangenomen, dan zal de toepassing ervan de vrijheid van ngo's flink kunnen inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over kinderarbeid

MP Van Laar asked the minister about child labour in Thai shrimp processing and Ghanaian gold mines, including supply-chain transparency, living wages, and corporate duties. The minister answered that the government is pursuing living-wage initiatives, sector covenants and SDG targets, but that options to ban Thai shrimp from the EU market are very limited.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat de inwoners van Curaçao bezorgd zijn over de rookgassen uit de raffinaderij in Willemstad

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about residents of Curaçao worried about emissions from the Isla refinery and asked for research, openness and protection measures. The minister answered that the matter is an autonomous responsibility of the Curaçao government, that independent research is underway with results expected in August, and that the Defence Ministry will measure air quality in Julianadorp from January 2016.
However, this is an autonomous matter of the Curaçao government; on behalf of the Dutch cabinet I have regular contact with the Curaçao government about it.
Het betreft echter een autonome aangelegenheid van de Curaçaose regering, namens het Nederlandse kabinet heb ik hierover regelmatig contact met de Curaçaose regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over Kindermisbruik door militairen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the foreign and development ministers about child sexual abuse by French troops in the Central African Republic, the suspension of UN official Anders Kompass for leaking a report, UN protection of whistleblowers, and measures against sexual abuse by UN-mandated soldiers. The minister said the government lacks the facts to judge the Kompass case, supports an independent UN inquiry, and noted the UN Secretary-General announced an external independent investigation.
The cabinet considers it important that an independent investigation be carried out covering all relevant aspects, and will therefore follow this case closely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd waarin alle relevante aspecten aan de orde komen en zal deze zaak daarom op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over slavernij en kinderarbeid in steengroeves

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked about child labour and slavery in South Indian granite quarries, due diligence by Dutch firms, the government's own procurement of granite, and whether municipalities and other public bodies are engaged. Minister Ploumen answers that she will engage sector federations on IMVO agreements, raise the issue during her India visit, pilot and implement evaluation recommendations on international social procurement conditions, and that PIANOo has worked with local authorities on procurement tools.
I am in discussion with the relevant trade organisations about the support the government can offer the sectors to reach IMVO agreements.
Ik ben in gesprek met de desbetreffende brancheorganisaties over de ondersteuning die de overheid kan bieden aan de sectoren om te komen tot IMVO afspraken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Van Laar over het stoppen van de financiering van het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Ypma and Van Laar asked the State Secretary of Education about ending state funding for new pupils at the deaf boarding school in Haren, and the consequences for bilingual secondary education for deaf pupils. The State Secretary confirmed that boarding subsidy for new pupils will be phased out since passend onderwijs was introduced, argued that a havo diploma is achievable without boarding, admitted no specific study was done on effects, and committed to further talks with Kentalis, Fodok and Dovenschap.
Question 3: What research was done into the effects of closing the boarding school and the available alternatives?
Vraag 3 Wat voor onderzoek is gedaan naar de effecten van de sluiting van het internaat en de beschikbare alternatieven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de Burundezen die uit vrees voor mogelijk verkiezingsgeweld naar Rwanda vluchten

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about reports of Burundians fleeing to Rwanda over fear of election-related violence, the role of the Imbonerakure, threats to journalists and activists, police and military involvement, the Cibitoke investigation, a possible third term for President Nkurunziza, and possible suspension of cooperation programmes. The government answers that the questions were already answered in a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer is given here.

The written questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes (both PvdA), question number 2015Z07291, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary Paper 29 237, no. 163).

Antwoord 1 t/m 7 De schriftelijke vragen van leden Van Laar en Servaes (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2015Z07291 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Segers over het bericht ‘Gezamenlijke ketenactie tegen arbeidsuitbuiting en mensenhandel’

MPs Van Laar and Segers asked about a joint enforcement action against labour exploitation and trafficking on Bonaire, including how few addresses were checked, why action came only now, victim shelter, and prostitution policy. The minister reported no arrests and no finding of underpayment or exploitation, promised recurring joint checks at least four times a year, and said a revised MoU is expected in June 2015.
Agreements have been made to act jointly at least four times a year, with prostitution being one of the sectors that will regularly be checked.
Er zijn afspraken gemaakt om ten minste vier keer per jaar gezamenlijk op te treden waarbij prostitutie een van de sectoren is die regelmatig zullen worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Laar over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in de kledingindustrie in India

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Van Laar asked the government about modern slavery and child labour in the South Indian textile industry, including reported deaths and abuse of girls under the Sumangali scheme, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that the embassy and industry are engaged in multi-stakeholder initiatives, the MVO conference will explore EU-level supply chain measures, and the ILO and OECD frameworks are used to press India on forced and child labour standards.
Once the initiative takes firm shape, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will consider how this initiative can be supported.
Zodra het initiatief vaste vormen aanneemt, zal het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bezien op welke manier dit initiatief ondersteund kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over slechte werkomstandigheden en kinderarbeid in textielfabrieken in Bangladesh en Turkse katoenproductie

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and poor working conditions in Bangladeshi garment factories and in Turkish cotton production, including subcontracting under the Bangladesh Accord and forged identity documents. The Minister acknowledges the problems, says child labour has declined in BGMEA-affiliated factories, and promises to raise the issues with the Bangladeshi government and the Accord management during a June visit.
I will discuss this with the Bangladeshi government during my visit to Bangladesh in June.
Ik zal dit tijdens mijn bezoek aan Bangladesh in juni met de overheid van Bangladesh bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de vulkaanuitbarsting op Fogo, Kaapverdië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Fogo volcano eruption in Cape Verde, including the situation on the island, EU and member state assistance, and whether the Netherlands would contribute. The minister described evacuations and EU in-kind aid, and said the Netherlands was not for now considering a contribution to the IFRC appeal, while monitoring the situation.
The Cabinet is not currently considering making a contribution.
Het Kabinet overweegt vooralsnog niet een bijdrage te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over gaten in de huidige ebola-hulpverlening

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about gaps in Ebola aid in West Africa, including delayed deployment of pledged UK hospital beds and whether a more flexible approach is needed. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps, points to labs, flexible NGO funding and a new NGO financing facility, but rejects the claim that aid is misaligned with needs and says there is no EU biological disaster team.
I do not share that view. WHO and UNMEER continuously analyse needs on the ground.
Ik deel die visie niet. WHO en UNMEER maken een doorlopende analyse van de noden ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de effecten van spaargroepen

An MP asked the minister about a randomized evaluation finding only small effects of savings groups in Mali and whether Dutch funding supports such groups. The minister acknowledged the study, said savings groups are not a specific focus of Dutch policy, and pointed to broader financial sector programmes instead.
I do not specifically focus on savings groups, so the findings of this report have no direct effect on my policy.
Ik zet niet specifiek in op spaargroepen, daarom hebben de uitkomsten van dit rapport geen direct effect op mijn beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over ‘voluntoerisme’ en internationaal vrijwilligerswerk in weeshuizen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch subsidies under the MillenniumDoen! programme funded volunteering in orphanages abroad, whether those placements were checked, and what role the ministry and embassies should play in warning volunteers. The minister answered that the ministry does not hold a primary controlling role over youth volunteering organisations, that SBOS subsidies were checked on 'do no harm' criteria and are now discontinued, and that awareness-raising and embassy signalling are the main tools.
The cabinet does not see a primary or controlling role for itself in the field of youth travel and international volunteer work.
Het kabinet ziet in het veld van jongerenreizen en internationaal vrijwilligerswerk voor zichzelf geen primaire of controlerende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over het verbod voor studenten van de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) om voor stage of studie af te reizen naar Afrika

MPs Van Laar and Mohandis asked the ministers whether they know of the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences ban on student internships and study trips to Africa, and whether they agree that Africa should not be treated as one region. The minister acknowledged the ban is not absolute, agreed that per-country risk assessment is better, and said institutions set their own policy while the government advises following the Foreign Affairs travel advice without issuing binding national guidelines.
It is up to the institutions themselves to determine their policy in this matter; I will not draw up national guidelines on this.
Het is aan de instellingen zelf om in hierin hun beleid te bepalen, ik zal daarover geen landelijke richtlijnen opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over eerste ebola-besmetting in Mali

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the first Ebola case in Mali, its risk of a large outbreak, Dutch partner organisations' role and whether Mali lacks funds. The minister confirmed the case, said Mali has prepared since March with contact tracing and quarantine, and that Dutch funding supports the national plan while priority remains in the three worst-affected countries.
To date, no local Ebola infection in Mali has been reported.
Tot op heden is er nog geen melding gemaakt van lokale ebola-besmetting in Mali.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de dreigende hongersnood in Zuid-Sudan

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam Novib's report on looming famine in South Sudan, including whether the Netherlands would increase its efforts, provide logistical support, protect women better through UNMISS, and push diplomacy. The Minister confirmed the seriousness, cited suspended direct aid to the central government, humanitarian funding of about 18 million euro plus 3 million for UNHCR, said Defence assets were not requested, and stressed that IGAD-led peace talks are the key channel.
On the deployment of the available humanitarian funds for 2015 I will decide early next year, based on global needs.
Over de inzet van de beschikbare humanitaire fondsen voor 2015 zal ik begin volgend jaar beslissen, op basis van wereldwijde noden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de verlaging van de huwbare leeftijd in Bangladesh

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Bangladesh's proposal to lower the marriage age for girls from 18 to 16, and whether the Netherlands would act on it. The minister fully agreed that child marriage is harmful, called the proposal contrary to international human rights treaties, said embassy and partners would raise concerns with Bangladeshi authorities, and listed existing Dutch-funded NGO projects against child marriage.

The Bengali proposal to lower the marriageable age for girls from 18 to 16 is, among other things, contrary to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) and the Convention on the Rights of the Child.

Het Bengaalse voorstel om de huwbare leeftijd voor meisjes te verlagen van 18 jaar naar 16 jaar is onder andere in strijd met de Universele Verklaring voor de Rechten van de Mens, de Conventie voor uitbanning van alle vormen van discriminatie van vrouwen (CEDAW) en het Kinderrechtenverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het eenzijdig aanpassen van de procedure met betrekking tot het strategisch partnerschap

Labour MP Van Laar asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the ministry unilaterally changed the procedure for strategic partnerships, including a delay in the eligibility assessment, a tight pitch schedule disadvantaging southern applicants, and risks to timely start-up. The minister denied unilateral changes, said the process follows previously communicated rules with a final outcome by 31 October and partner selection by 31 January 2015, and offered flexibility on pitch dates.
That the rules would be changed unilaterally is, incidentally, not correct.
Dat eenzijdig de spelregels zouden worden veranderd klopt overigens niet.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Laar over de invloed van de humanitaire crisis op de ontwikkelingssamenwerking van Nederland met Jemen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the humanitarian crisis in Yemen affects Dutch development cooperation there, including the multi-year strategic plan, water, SRGR and rule-of-law programmes, and the NICHE higher-education programme. The Minister answered that no results have been reversed so far, that it is too early to judge effects on the strategic plan, and that monitoring projects has become difficult because travel is restricted.
It is too early to determine whether the current crisis has consequences for the Netherlands' multi-year strategic plan for Yemen.
Het is te vroeg om te kunnen bepalen of de huidige crisis gevolgen heeft voor het strategisch meerjarenplan van Nederland voor Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over duurzame energie in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands, including reported postponement of geothermal energy on Saba and the Sint Maarten green energy strategy. The government answered that it supports renewable investment, funds Saba and Sint Eustatius utilities for wind or solar, consulted Saba's government on geothermal, and says it does not block geothermal exploration but has no budget for multi-year losses.
Furthermore, it must be noted that the cabinet does not place any obstacle in the way of any party setting up geothermal energy in the Caribbean.
Voorts moet opgemerkt worden dat het kabinet geen enkele partij iets in de weg legt om geothermie in de Caribben op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over hulp aan Syrische vluchtelingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam and UNICEF reports that international aid to Syria is insufficient, including whether Dutch pledges were paid, whether Dutch contributions are fair, and how to protect Syrian children. The Minister confirmed the funding gap, said all Dutch pledges were transferred, argued Dutch contributions exceed a fair share, and announced an extra 30 million euros for humanitarian aid, including 7 million for UNICEF psychosocial work.
For that reason I have decided to contribute an additional 30 million euros to humanitarian aid.
Om die reden heb ik besloten 30 miljoen euro extra bij te dragen aan de humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over de strijd tegen Ebola

MPs Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the international Ebola response, the WHO's budget cuts and alleged poor choices, and what the Netherlands would contribute. The minister rejected the claim that the international community failed, described the logistical challenges, and announced 15 million euros from the emergency fund plus 1 million for practical support.
I do not share the view that the international community, including the WHO, has failed in its handling of the Ebola epidemic.
Ik deel de mening niet dat de internationale gemeenschap, inclusief de WHO, steken heeft laten vallen in de aanpak van de Ebola-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de Ebola-ziekte in West-Afrika

An MP asked the ministers about the Ebola epidemic in West Africa, including vaccine availability, international coordination, Dutch funding, travel advice and information for Dutch nationals. The minister answered that no vaccine or licensed treatment exists yet, listed WHO-led coordination and Dutch contributions of about 722,600 euro, and said travel advice was updated to refer to the outbreak.
It is correct that there is still no vaccine or effective treatment for Ebola.
Het klopt dat er nog geen vaccin of effectieve behandeling van Ebola is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat in navolging van het IMF nu ook de Wereldbank begrotingsondersteuning aan Mali heeft opgeschort

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will follow the IMF and World Bank in suspending budget support to Mali over unexplained spending such as a presidential aircraft and an army equipment guarantee. The minister answered that the Netherlands gives no general budget support to Mali since the 2012 coup, that the IMF expects a temporary suspension with verification in September 2014, and that the Dutch aid will be reviewed then.
The cabinet will carefully weigh the findings of the IMF mission in September and, if necessary, take appropriate measures.
Het kabinet zal de bevindingen van de IMF-missie in september a.s. zorgvuldig wegen en, indien noodzakelijk, alsnog passende maatregelen treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen en Van Laar over kinderarbeid en schending van andere arbeidsrechten

MPs Voordewind, Gesthuizen and Van Laar asked the minister about a Fair Labor Association study on child labour and long hours in Turkish hazelnut harvesting, and what the government, ILO, Turkish authorities and Dutch retailers and firms would do about it. The minister acknowledged the findings, said Turkey is primarily responsible, pointed to Dutch support for an ILO project and a 90,000 euro contribution, and said she raised the issue with Turkish officials and FNLI, which committed to a meeting with industry.
I have committed a contribution of 90,000 euros to the above-mentioned follow-up project of the ILO.
Ik heb hier een bijdrage van 90.000 euro toegezegd aan het hierboven genoemde vervolgproject van de ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over het rapport van Oxfam Novib over belastingontwijking door bedrijven

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an Oxfam Novib report on corporate tax avoidance and its effect on developing countries' revenues, and about Dutch efforts on the OECD BEPS project and country-by-country reporting. The government answered that the 100% revenue claim anticipates a forthcoming study, pointed to Dutch treaty and technical assistance efforts, said developing countries are being involved in BEPS, and described EU country-by-country reporting rules with an evaluation due in 2018.
Without knowledge of that report, the question posed cannot be answered.
Zonder kennis van dat rapport is de gestelde vraag niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht “Nepdokteren in Kenia wordt beloond met ridderorde in Nederland”

MPs Van Laar and Kuzu asked ministers about a Dutch homeopath whose non-profit distributes the homeopathic remedy Iquilai as a substitute for antiretrovirals in Kenya, and about his knighthood. The minister says such substitution is harmful, will ask the Dutch embassy to inform Kenyan authorities and asks the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine options, but states she has no power to revoke the honour and no action is possible abroad.
I have therefore asked the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine what options there are to investigate this matter further.
Ik heb daarom de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg gevraagd om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze zaak nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het hardhandig neerslaan van vredige protesten in Ethiopië

An MP asks the government about reports of excessive force against peaceful protesters in Ethiopia's Oromia region, arbitrary detention and possible torture, and what Dutch diplomatic and rule-of-law programme action follows. The minister says the security response appears disproportionate and concerning, that concerns were raised with Ethiopian officials and in UN review, and that dialogue continues, but offers no concrete new measures beyond existing programmes.
Although detailed information is not available, there is an impression that the response of the Ethiopian security forces was disproportionate.
Hoewel gedetailleerde informatie niet voorhanden is, bestaat de indruk dat de reactie van de Ethiopische veiligheidstroepen disproportioneel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over de instructietaal in het onderwijs op Sint Eustatius

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about a reported plan to replace Dutch with English as the language of instruction on Sint Eustatius, the feasibility study behind it, who decides the language, and the next steps after the island council's motion. The Secretary of State referred to a letter and attached reports, said the statutory language regime is set by legislation, and noted the council motion did not disrupt the ministry's decision-making, though the ministry said it would follow up with the council.
The legislator therefore ultimately determines what the language of instruction in education on this island is.
De wetgever bepaalt dus uiteindelijk wat de instructietaal in het onderwijs op dit eiland is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk, Van Laar en Sjoerdsma over het Moederdagrapport

MPs Van Dijk, Van Laar and Sjoerdsma asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Save the Children Mothers Day report on maternal and child mortality in fragile states, education in conflict countries, reproductive health, and the effects of reduced aid to transition countries. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports SRGR and education programmes in conflict settings, backs the Lucens Guidelines, and will shift some public health investment to the private sector in transition countries without a clear picture yet of who will fund it.
In the medium term, Dutch public investments in SRGR in the named countries will decrease.
Op middellange termijn zullen de Nederlandse publieke investeringen in SRGR in genoemde landen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Laar, Thieme en Voordewind over misstanden bij de productie van handgeknoopte tapijten in India

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdD and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour and forced labour in India's hand-knotted carpet industry, and whether Dutch importers are involved. The minister acknowledges the severe abuses, reports that the Dutch import market is small and that voluntary initiatives such as Goodweave and Care & Fair have limited reach, and lists development projects and dialogue with India as follow-up.
Statistics Netherlands publishes only aggregated data and provides no overview of individual companies importing carpets from India.
Het CBS publiceert alleen geaggregeerde data en geeft geen overzicht van individuele bedrijven die tapijten uit India importeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over concurrentie tussen verschillende VN-instanties

An MP asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about overlapping mandates and competition between UN agencies in humanitarian response, prompted by a press article. The minister acknowledged overlapping mandates and coordination difficulties, stated that existing agreements and OCHA coordination are adequate, and described reforms and Dutch funding for the Central African Republic without committing to new concrete measures.
I am of the view that the UN has an adequately organised system for humanitarian aid.
Ik ben van mening dat de VN een adequaat ingericht systeem heeft voor humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Taalbarrière stremt Sabaanse Studenten’

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about reports that Saban students struggle with language barriers in Dutch higher education and about barriers to studying in the United States. The minister said the data do not show most Saban students failing in the Netherlands, acknowledged language and cultural difficulties, pointed to extra Dutch lessons, a preparatory programme and an inventory of study options due to be completed in August 2014.
From the DUO data above it cannot be concluded that the majority of Saban students run into problems when studying in the Netherlands.
Uit de hierboven weergegeven gegevens van de DUO kan niet worden opgemaakt dat het merendeel van de Sabaanse studenten bij studie in Nederland in de problemen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over de toekomst van het Openbaar Ministerie en de landsrecherche op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about Dutch responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten, the temporary reinforcement of the Landsrecherche, mediation with the Rijksrecherche, the Aruba/Curaçao cooperation convenant, and whether prosecution capacity is sufficient. The government answered that law enforcement is an autonomous competence of the countries, that the temporary capacity boost has ended, that Sint Maarten's request for extra capacity is under review, and that capacity is considered adequate.
The Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten falls under the consensus national ordinance on the public prosecution services of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Sint Maarten valt onder de consensus-Rijkswet «Rijkswet openbare Ministeries van Curaçao, van Sint Maarten en van Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de rapportage van Brandpunt over de weeshuis-industrie in Cambodja

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a Brandpunt report on the orphanage industry in Cambodia, including what the government knew, how it informs tourists and volunteers, whether it funds anti-orphanage-tourism actors, and oversight of online volunteer intermediaries. The Minister answered that the problem was known, that Dutch support went to Unicef's alternative-care framework, that travel advice and the Better Care Network guidelines are the main information tools, and that the government has no primary controlling role over private volunteer intermediaries.
The network, with organisations such as Unicef and Cordaid, works to improve international volunteer work with children, including through guidelines.
Het netwerk, met organisaties als Unicef en Cordaid, zet zich in om het internationale vrijwilligerswerk met kinderen te verbeteren, onder meer met richtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Dove zaalvoetballers geplaatst voor Europese Kampioenschappen maar toch thuis blijven door geldgebrek”

MPs Van Dekken and Van Laar asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport why the deaf futsal team qualified for the European Championship could not attend due to lack of funding, and whether the ministry would support it and act structurally. The minister replied that sport bodies decide which programmes get top-sport funding under the 2013-2016 sport agenda, that deaf futsal falls outside this, and that the ministry is in talks with the KNDSB and NOC*NSF.
I regard this as a responsibility of sport, which makes its own decisions, and which I then support.
Ik beschouw dit als een verantwoordelijkheid van de sport, die zelf besluiten neemt en die ik vervolgens ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Nibud bevestigt dat Bonaire ver onder de armoedegrens leeft’

MPs Kuzu and Van Laar asked about a report by the Nibud finding that Bonaire lives well below the poverty line, and whether the government has the report and how it compares to the CBS study and the social minimum in the European Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that Bonaire commissioned the report for its own poverty policy, that the Nibud figures are reference amounts not norms, that the CBS study is a separate economic study, and that the government will engage with the island's executive but will not base national minimum wage or benefit levels on the Nibud report.
The Nibud study cannot be the basis for national policy on the levels of the statutory minimum wage and benefits.
Het Nibud-onderzoek kan niet de basis zijn voor het rijksbeleid ten aanzien van de niveaus van het wettelijk minimumloon en de uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de Humanitarian Action for Children van UNICEF

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNICEF's Humanitarian Action for Children appeal, the Dutch contributions to UNICEF and Syrian refugee children, and related policy. The minister answered in detail on funding amounts and programmes but gave no commitment to change the budget or launch new scrutiny-related steps.
No, the allocation of financial resources has been arrived at in a balanced way.
Nee, de verdeling van financiële middelen is op een evenwichtige wijze tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Groeiende kritiek op medische uitzendingen ZVK’

MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked about criticism of the medical referral system (ZVK) for patients from Caribbean Netherlands, including an open letter from Han de Bruijne that the minister says never reached her ministry. The minister partly accepts the criticism, citing complexity and bureaucracy, notes satisfaction survey results, and lists improvements under way, with a Coomeva study expected by year end.
The ZVK is currently undertaking a major improvement effort, which should be completed during 2014.
Het ZVK is momenteel met een flinke verbeterslag bezig, die in de loop van 2014 zijn beslag moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked ministers about postal delivery in the Caribbean Netherlands, including e-commerce access, postcodes, whether the ACM supervises the islands, and the change of ownership of concession holder Flamingo Communications. Minister Kamp answered that e-commerce is a market matter outside the postal concession, that postcode costs are unknown, that the ACM's tasks are set by the Wet post BES with no general competition oversight on the islands, and that the ownership change did not affect Flamingo's assessment.
In the Caribbean Netherlands the ACM has no tasks in general competition supervision, as laid down in the Mededingingswet in the European Netherlands.
In Caribisch Nederland heeft de ACM geen taken in het kader van generiek mededingingstoezicht, zoals dat in Europees Nederland is neergelegd in de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Groot over de uitzending ‘Caribisch Nederland, Drie jaar later, Bonaire’

Two MPs asked the government about a broadcast on Bonaire's high prices, falling real incomes, electricity and produce costs, and competition, and whether the 2010 tax reform and the switch to the US dollar caused price rises. The minister answered at length, acknowledging strong price rises and partly attributing them to global factors and dollarisation, citing indexation, tax relief and planned electricity and price regulation, while admitting gaps in data.
The Statistics Netherlands has started a study into, among other things, income developments on the islands.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek is een onderzoek gestart naar, onder andere, (bewegingen in) de inkomenssfeer op de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over het advies van de SER van Sint Maarten om de Antilliaanse Gulden in te ruilen voor de US Dollar

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about the Sint Maarten SER advice to dollarize the Antillean guilder, including the Curaçao-Sint Maarten current account deficit, devaluation risks, and effects on BES islands. The government replied that dollarization is not currently planned, that the matter is for the countries themselves, and that it will share Dutch experience with Sint Maarten.
The peg between the Antillean guilder and the US dollar is a matter for the countries themselves.
De koppeling tussen de Antilliaanse gulden en de US Dollar is een aangelegenheid van de landen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked about the new postal concession for Caribbean Netherlands, including the tender outcome, service changes, the 10-year term, enforcement tools, price rise and street addressing. The minister answered that Flamingo Communications was designated concessionaire, that the government can enforce via ACM orders, fines or withdrawal, and that addressing and postcode plans are progressing, without promising new oversight mechanisms.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises whether the concession holder complies with its obligations.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) ziet er op toe dat de concessiehouder zijn verplichtingen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het bericht dat de AIVD politici op Bonaire heeft bespioneerd

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD secretly spied on Bonaire politicians between 2005 and 2010, whether the operation was legal, who ordered it and whether it influenced constitutional negotiations and led to criminal investigation. The minister's supplementary answer refers the MPs to a separate letter on the NRC reporting, so the substance is not given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Recourt and Van Laar (both PvdA), question number 2013Z22947, have been answered by way of the letter 'Response to the reporting in NRC on AIVD investigation on Bonaire'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van leden Recourt en Van Laar (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2013Z22947 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op de berichtgeving in het NRC over onderzoek van de AIVD op Bonaire» (Kamerstuk 30 977, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de het lid Bouwmeester over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen

Opposition MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked Minister Schippers whether the hearing aid reimbursement system, which covers only certain categories, excludes cheaper devices and cochlear implants may be chosen as a perverse incentive, and how to optimise the system. The minister defended the current system as offering enough choice, said she would report on monitoring by the end of 2013 but needed to wait for CVZ findings, pushing the promised report to spring 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin Van Dijk over de nieuwe telefoonbemiddelingsdienst voor doven

MPs Van Laar, Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether the new relay service for deaf users, which requires Total Conversation software from a single provider, leaves analogue text-phone users without access and whether insurers cover the costs. The minister answered that TC is an open standard, insurers cover the software licence and equipment, and access is adequate, while acknowledging a small group may briefly lose service.
All insured persons known to have received a text phone in the past have received a letter from their health insurer.
Alle verzekerden van wie bekend is dat men in het verleden een teksttelefoon heeft gekregen, hebben van hun zorgverzekeraar een brief ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de knikkebolziekte in Afrika

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the nodding syndrome in East Africa, including death and case numbers, affected countries, causes and treatment, Ugandan and South Sudanese government responses, and possible Dutch contributions. The minister answered that about ten thousand children are affected, that causes are unknown with no cure, and that the Netherlands will make EUR 1 million available for research.
The Netherlands is willing to make EUR 1 million available for the fight against nodding syndrome.
Nederland is bereid tot EUR 1 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen voor de strijd tegen de knikkebolziekte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Laar over Wit-Rusland

MPs Maij and Van Laar asked whether EU development funds, via an integrated border management programme, trained and equipped Belarusian police and border forces who detain opposition activists, and whether the Minister would press the Commission to prevent such misuse. The Minister replied that the aid went to patrol boats, vehicles, night-vision equipment and customs/border training, not the police, that the practices against activists are worrying but not attributable to EU support, and that the Dutch embassy shared the report with the EU delegation, which said the aid cannot be linked to how authorities treat opponents.
The money the EU has spent in Belarus under integrated border management went to patrol boats, jeeps and night-vision equipment.
Het geld dat de EU in Wit-Rusland heeft besteed in het kader van geïntegreerd grensbeheer is ten goede gekomen aan patrouilleboten, jeeps en nachtkijkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over misbruik van Syrische minderjarige vluchtelingen

Two MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about reports of child abuse and child marriage among Syrian refugee girls, whether the trend is confirmed, what international measures exist, and whether Dutch funding addresses it. The ministers confirmed that child marriage is a known and possibly rising problem but lacks reliable figures, described Dutch-backed UN initiatives and funding for UNHCR and UNICEF, and did not commit to new concrete action beyond existing policy.
The trend of child abuse, and in particular child marriage, is known.
De trend van kindermisbruik en met name kindhuwelijken is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over de mogelijke sluiting van de Saint James School of Medicine op Bonaire

Two MPs asked whether the Saint James School of Medicine on Bonaire must close by 2015 because it fails Dutch inspection requirements, and what efforts and options exist to prevent closure. The minister answered that the school never received Dutch accreditation, withdrew its higher-education procedure, and therefore lost ECFMG recognition, while acknowledging some economic impact and noting that the government had already extended the deadline.
The medical school chose, after the investigation under the new programme assessment, to withdraw its application for that assessment.
De medical school heeft ervoor gekozen na het onderzoek in het kader van de toets nieuwe opleiding, de aanvraag voor die toets in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Van Laar over het niet doorgaan van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

MPs Yücel and Van Laar asked about the cancelled first Gay Pride on Curaçao, whether the government imposed last-minute conditions, whether police deemed flags and demonstration items dangerous, and whether Raveneau's letter to church leaders influenced this, and asked the government to press Curaçao on LHBT rights. The minister replied that public order and emancipation policy on Curaçao are autonomous matters, the reasons behind the police conditions are not known to him, and he has received no signals that LHBT rights are not respected, while pointing to the Curaçao government's stated support and the Pink Orange Akkoord funding.
It is up to the government of Curaçao to weigh to what extent additional requirements are needed for organising the Gay Pride in order to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van Laar over de boekhouding van het Rijk

MPs Nijboer and Van Laar asked the Finance Minister about press reports that ministries spent 472 million euros unlawfully and about the accountability of central government spending. The minister answered that 0.20% of 2012 spending (about 470 million euros, of which roughly 60% was uncertain rather than wrong) was unlawful, within the 1% tolerance, and pointed to Court of Audit reports, the 2013 accountability debate and ministers' commitments.
The unlawfulness rate of central government spending in 2012 (0.20%: about 470 million euros) remained well within the 1% tolerance limit.
Het onrechtmatigheidspercentage van de rijksuitgaven in 2012 (0,20%: circa € 470 miljoen) bleef daarmee ruim binnen de tolerantiegrens van 1%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Maij over het besluit van Artsen zonder Grenzen om Somalië te verlaten

Two MPs (Van Laar and Maij, PvdA) asked the ministers how the government views Artsen zonder Grenzen' withdrawal from Somalia over security concerns, its consequences for humanitarian aid, attacks on aid workers and how the Somali authorities respond, and whether the Netherlands will raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that the government regrets the decision, that other organisations continue aid, that the Somali government has pledged to protect aid workers and that the security situation remains fragile without changing asylum policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a robust dialogue by the international community with the SFG on this subject.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op een stevige dialoog van de internationale gemeenschap met de SFG over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat met subsidie Sapph-lingerie in Afrika zal worden verkocht

An MP asked whether a subsidy had been granted for selling Sapph lingerie in African countries and why such trade would be subsidised. The minister answered that no subsidy was granted to Mr Heilbron and no application was submitted, and that the 'subsidy-sensitive' remark was misquoted.
No subsidy was granted to Mr Heilbron, nor did he submit an application.
Er is aan Dhr. Heilbron geen subsidie verstrekt, noch heeft hij een aanvraag ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over berichten over de jeugdreclassering op Curaçao

An MP asks whether the Dutch government cooperates with Curaçao to improve youth probation after a Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report, and whether it will offer cooperation. The minister answers that there is no structural cooperation, only incidental case-level contacts, that Curaçao has not requested it, and that youth probation will be considered for the March 2014 Koninkrijksconferentie.

No. On behalf of the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice, I inform you that the government in European Netherlands does not cooperate structurally with Curaçao in the area of youth probation.

Nee. Mede namens de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie, bericht ik u dat de overheid in Europees Nederland niet in structurele zin samenwerkt met het land Curaçao op het gebied van jeugdreclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Laar over de participatie van doven en slechthorenden binnen de samenleving

MPs Bergkamp and Van Laar asked about participation of deaf and hard-of-hearing people in education, the labour market and sheltered workshops over ten years. The state secretary provided enrolment figures, noted missing data on start qualifications, sheltered workshop disability types and CI status, and gave older OSA labour-market estimates.
I cannot answer the question of how the ratio is among deaf pupils with and without a cochlear implant.
Ik kan geen antwoord geven op de vraag hoe de verhouding is onder dove leerlingen met en zonder cochleair implantaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het nieuws dat het gehoor van de Nederlandse jeugd nog verder is verslechterd

MPs Wolbert and Van Laar asked the state secretary about reported further hearing deterioration among Dutch youth and what measures would be taken. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, promised a RIVM study, a prevention programme item and a convenant with the music sector, but deferred a statutory noise limit and declined to answer some questions in time.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into this, so that we can have recent figures.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om hier onderzoek naar te doen, zodat we over recente cijfers kunnen beschikken.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Veldman en Fokke ter vervanging van nr. 9 over terugbrengen van de overgangstermijn
Shortens the transition period for abolishing the precario levy on works of general interest from 2027 to 2022 in three articles of the bill.
This amendment provides that the precario levy on works of general interest may be levied until 1 January 2022.
Dit amendement regelt dat de precariobelasting op werken van algemeen nut kan worden geheven tot 1 januari 2022.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Veldman en Fokke, ter vervanging van nr. 8  over terugbrengen van de overgangstermijn
Shortens the transition period for abolishing the precario tax on works of general benefit from ten to five years.
With this amendment the transition period is reduced from ten to five years.
Met dit amendement wordt de overgangstermijn teruggebracht van tien tot vijf jaar.
Amendement van het lid Veldman c.s. over terugbrengen van de overgangstermijn
Shortens the transitional period for abolishing the precario tax on public-benefit works from ten to six years, changing the date from 2027 to 2023.
With this amendment the transition period is reduced from ten to six years.
Met dit amendement wordt de overgangstermijn teruggebracht van tien tot zes jaar.
Motie van de leden Veldman en Fokke over een plan van aanpak voor herziening van de grondslagen van het Provinciefonds
Motion asking the government to present within two years a plan to revise the basis of the Provinciefonds distribution model.
within two years to come up with a plan to revise the basis of the Provinciefonds within three years
binnen twee jaar met een plan van aanpak te komen gericht op het binnen drie jaar herzien van de grondslagen van het Provinciefonds
Motie van de leden De Caluwé en Fokke over een nadere afweging over het subcluster VHROSV
Asks the government to further weigh the remaining questions on the Gemeentefonds housing and spatial planning subcluster before the full recalibration.
requests the government to make a further assessment of the remaining issues in the housing, spatial planning and urban renewal subcluster
verzoekt de regering, een nadere afweging over de resterende vraagstukken van het subcluster Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijk Ordening en Stedelijke Vernieuwing te maken
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over een inventarisatie van de wensen in de lokale democratie voor experimenten met democratische vernieuwing
Asks the government to inventory local democracy wishes for experiments with democratic renewal and examine removing obstacles to them.
requests the government to inventory which wishes exist in local democracy regarding experiments with democratic renewal
verzoekt de regering, te inventariseren welke wensen er vanuit de lokale democratie leven ten aanzien van experimenten met democratische vernieuwing
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over een actieplan om jongeren meer bij de politiek te betrekken
Asks the government to produce an action plan to involve young people more in politics, building on existing initiatives.
requests the government to come up with an action plan to involve young people even more in politics
verzoekt de regering, met een actieplan te komen om jongeren nog meer bij de politiek te betrekken
Amendement van de leden Fokke en Voortman over in stand houden subsidiëring LSA
Amendment shifts 50 thousand euros within the budget of the Openbaar bestuur en democratie article, keeping subsidy for the LSA citizen participation intermediary at 2015 levels.
This amendment aims to maintain subsidy for the LSA for 2017 at the 2015 level.
Dit amendement beoogt de subsidiëring van het Landelijk Samenwerkingsverband Actieve bewoners (LSA) voor het begrotingsjaar 2017 op het peil van het begrotingsjaar 2015 in stand te houden.
Motie van het lid Neppérus c.s. over spoedige uitvoering van de aanbevelingen in het ABD-rapport
Calls for swift implementation of the ABD report recommendations on reorganising the Tweede Kamer's civil service, with concrete results by 1 January 2017.
states that the reorganisation should be carried out swiftly
spreekt uit dat de reorganisatie spoedig dient te worden uitgevoerd
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over een actieplan om de informatiehuishouding van overheden op orde te brengen
Asks the government to draw up with other administrations an action plan to put public authorities' information management in order so that freedom-of-information requests are handled on time.
accountability of public administration, and with it the timely handling of freedom-of-information requests, requires a well-organised information management
verantwoording van het openbaar bestuur en daarmee ook het tijdig afhandelen van WOB-verzoeken vraagt om een goed georganiseerde informatiehuishouding
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Fokke ter vervanging van nr. 9 dat de bezwaarprocedure tegen het niet tijdig nemen van een Wob-besluit weer invoert
Reintroduces a pre-appeal objection procedure against failure to decide on Wob (access to information) requests in time, and adds an evaluation clause.
The reason for reintroducing the possibility to object to the failure to take a Wob decision in time is that direct appeal to the court may be too high a threshold.
De reden voor het weer invoeren van de mogelijkheid om bezwaar te maken tegen het niet tijdig nemen van een Wob-besluit, is dat rechtstreeks beroep een te hoge drempel kan zijn.

Amendement van het lid Voortman c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 waarmee wordt geëxpliciteerd dat bij nieuwe stembiljetten moet worden gestreefd naar het faciliteren van volledige toegankelijkheid voor k
Amendment specifying that new ballot papers should facilitate independent voting for voters with disabilities as far as reasonably possible.
independent voting as far as reasonably possible is facilitated
het zelfstandig stemmen zoveel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk is, wordt gefaciliteerd
Amendement van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke dat de bezwaarprocedure tegen het niet tijdig nemen van een besluit op grond van deze wet opnieuw invoert
Amendment reintroduces an objection procedure, alongside direct appeal to the court, against failure to decide on time under the Open Government Act, with limits on cost reimbursement.
direct appeal may be too high a threshold, and therefore a low-threshold alternative is considered desirable
rechtstreeks beroep een te hoge drempel kan zijn, en derhalve een laagdrempelig alternatief wenselijk wordt geacht
Motie van het lid Slob c.s. over spoedig hervatten van de onderhandelingen met de bonden
Asks the cabinet to resume collective bargaining with unions promptly without a wage freeze and to inform the Chamber by 1 September 2015.
Amendement van het lid Fokke dat de bezwaarprocedure tegen het niet tijdig nemen van een Wob-besluit weer invoert
Reinstates an objection procedure for citizens against authorities failing to decide on Wob transparency requests in time, alongside direct appeal to court.
direct appeal may be too high a threshold, and a low-threshold alternative is therefore considered desirable
rechtstreeks beroep een te hoge drempel kan zijn, en derhalve een laagdrempelig alternatief wenselijk wordt geacht
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over afdekken van het renterisico
Asks the government, with Muiden, Bussum, Naarden and the province, to cover the interest-rate risk of the municipality of Muiden under its article 12 status.
calls on the government, in consultation with Muiden, Bussum, Naarden and the province of Noord-Holland, to cover this interest rate risk
roept de regering op, in overleg met Muiden, Bussum, Naarden en de provincie Noord-Holland dit renterisico af te dekken
Motie van de leden Schouw en Fokke over terugdringen van bestuurlijke drukte
Asks the government to help spread good practices by decentralised governments for reducing administrative burden and making joint arrangements more democratic.
to organise joint arrangements more democratically
gemeenschappelijke regelingen meer democratisch in te richten
Motie van het lid Van Raak c.s. over de Expertgroep Klokkenluiders
Asks the government to extend financial support of 62,500 euro per year for the Expertgroep Klokkenluiders by up to one year while a House for whistleblowers is pending.
requests the government to consult with this expert group to extend this support by (at most) one year
verzoekt de regering, met deze expertgroep in overleg te treden om deze ondersteuning met (maximaal) een jaar te verlengen
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over meer gemeenschappelijke rekenkamers
Asks the minister, with NVRR and VNG, to produce an action plan for substantially more joint municipal audit offices (gemeenschappelijke rekenkamers), especially for small municipalities.
requests the Minister, together with the NVRR and VNG, to come up with an action plan to realise substantially more joint audit offices
verzoekt de Minister om, samen met de NVRR en de VNG met een actieplan te komen om substantieel meer gemeenschappelijke rekenkamers te realiseren
Motie van de leden Ouwehand en Fokke over bankieren bij een bank met een hoge score in de Eerlijke Bankwijzer
Asks the Presidium to prepare criteria for an ethical bank and to move the House's banking business to a bank with a high Eerlijke Bankwijzer score.
requests the Presidium to submit to the House before the next Raming a worked-out proposal with criteria
verzoekt het Presidium, de Kamer voor de volgende Raming een uitgewerkt voorstel te doen toekomen met criteria
Motie van het lid Neppérus c.s. over het uitwerken van voorstellen voor het vragenuur en het aanvragen van debatten
Asks the Presidium to develop proposals strengthening the question hour and making debate requests subject to a 40-member threshold for plenary debates.
requests the Presidium to work this out and come up with a worked-out proposal by September at the latest
verzoekt het Presidium, dit uit te werken en uiterlijk in september met een uitgewerkt voorstel te komen
Motie van het lid Schouw c.s. over overleg met het kabinet over betere handhaving op verschillende onderwerpen

Asks the Speaker to agree with the cabinet on better enforcement of rules for timely information to the House, press release timing, ministers' speaking time and restraint in bringing support to debates.
considering that it is important for the proper functioning of the House to be well and timely informed
overwegende dat het voor het goed functioneren van de Kamer van belang is goed en tijdig geïnformeerd te zijn
Motie van het lid Ouwehand c.s. over per trein reizen voor werkbezoeken tot 750 kilometer
Asks the Presidium to arrange that MPs travel by train for international study visits up to 750 km.
requests the Presidium to ensure that the House travels by (fast) train in principle for international working visits up to 750 km
verzoekt het Presidium, te bewerkstelligen dat de Kamer voor internationale werkbezoeken tot 750 kilometer in principe met de (snelle) trein reist
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over het in vaste dienst nemen van de schoonmakers
Asks the Presidium to rehire cleaners in permanent service when the external cleaning contracts end.
requests the Presidium to rehire the cleaners in permanent employment as soon as the opportunity arises and at the latest when the contract with the external cleaning companies ends
verzoekt het Presidium om, zodra zich de mogelijkheid voordoet en uiterlijk bij afloop van het contract met de externe schoonmaakbedrijven, de schoonmakers weer in vaste dienst te nemen
Amendement van het lid Litjens c.s. over het uitgangspunt dat de burgermeester ingezetene is van de gemeente waarvan hij burgemeester is.
Lets the Commissaris van de Koning, as a national organ, extend a council-granted exemption from the residence requirement for mayors twice by up to one year, after hearing the council.
The Commissioner of the King may extend the exemption in special cases twice, each time for a maximum of one year.
De Commissaris van de Koning kan de ontheffing in bijzondere gevallen tweemaal, telkens voor de duur van maximaal een jaar, verlengen.
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over een voorstel om zelden tot nooit aanwezige lokale en provinciale volksvertegenwoordigers te korten op hun vergoeding
Asks the government to examine a legally sound way to dock the allowances of rarely attending local and provincial councillors and report before Budget Day.
requests the government to examine a legally sound proposal to dock the allowances of rarely or never present local and provincial representatives
verzoekt de regering, een juridisch houdbaar voorstel te onderzoeken om de zelden tot nooit aanwezige lokale en provinciale volksvertegenwoordigers
Amendement van het lid Schouw c.s. over de betrokkenheid van burgemeester, CvdK of gezaghebber bij de formatie van decentrale vertegenwoordigingen.
Deletes provisions giving the mayor, commissioner of the King or gezaghebber a role in informing or advising the formation of local representative bodies, leaving it to local factions.
That concerns a matter of local autonomy that should not be overridden by law.
Dat betreft een kwestie van lokale autonomie die niet bij wet doorkruist moet worden.
Motie van het lid Litjens c.s. over onderzoek naar het woonplaatsvereiste voor wethouders
Asks the government to investigate and prepare legislation transferring the decision on the residence requirement for aldermen to the municipal council.
requests the government to investigate the various modalities of such a scheme and then prepare a bill
verzoekt de regering, de diverse modaliteiten van een dergelijke regeling te onderzoeken en vervolgens een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Amendement van het lid Schouw c.s. over het in autonomie beslissen door de gemeenteraad en PS over samenwerking met wethouders onderscheidenlijk gedeputeerden.
Lets municipal councils and provincial states decide freely whether to add aldermen or deputies to the confidential committee that advises on appointing the mayor or Queen's Commissioner.
The municipal council and provincial states must be able to decide autonomously how they wish to arrange cooperation with aldermen and deputies.
De gemeenteraad en provinciale staten moeten in autonomie kunnen beslissen hoe ze de samenwerking met de wethouders en gedeputeerden willen regelen

Amendement van de leden Fokke en Litjens over het wijzigen van de wijze van benoeming voor burgemeesters, wethouders, (eiland)gedeputeerden, commissarissen van de Koning, het dagelijks bestuur en de v
Requires that votes on appointing mayors, aldermen, provincial officials and water board executives be held in secret written ballot rather than by roll call.
If a vote takes place in the making of the appointment, that vote shall be secret.
Indien bij de totstandkoming van de benoeming wordt gestemd, geschiedt deze stemming geheim.
Motie van de leden Segers en Fokke over mogelijk maken dat decentrale overheden bezoldigingsnormen stellen
Asks the government to consult decentralised authorities and propose amending the General Administrative Law Act so they can set their own pay maximums for institutions they fund.
requests the government to consult decentralised authorities and quickly propose making it possible for them to set their own norms
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met de decentrale overheden en spoedig met een voorstel te komen dat het mogelijk maakt dat decentrale overheden eigen normen stellen
Motie van de leden Fokke en Taverne over tegengaan van misbruik van de dwangsomregeling
Asks the government to propose measures against misuse of the penalty payment scheme for late administrative decisions, including limiting it to cases of proven harm or excluding certain laws.
requests the government to make concrete proposals to counter misuse of the penalty payment scheme
verzoekt de regering, concrete voorstellen te doen om misbruik van de dwangsomregeling tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. over het uitbreiden van de bevoegdheden van rekenkamers
Asks the government to propose widening the powers of municipal audit offices over joint arrangements, so they can audit the joint interest of participating municipalities.
requests the government to make proposals to expand the powers of audit offices and audit committees for joint arrangements
verzoekt de regering, voorstellen te doen om de bevoegdheden van rekenkamers en rekenkamercommissies voor samenwerkingsverbanden

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Heijnen en Fokke ter vervanging van nr. 5 over de mogelijkheid tot korting van de financiele vergoeding voor volksvertegenwoordigers die (vrijwel) geheel niet meer fu
Lets councils and provincial states cut the allowance of members who are almost always absent, by a two-thirds vote, down to zero.
The decision to reduce must be taken by a qualified two-thirds majority of the council or states.
Het besluit tot korting dient door een gekwalificeerde meerderheid 2/3 van de raad of staten te worden genomen.
Amendement van de leden Heijnen en Fokke over de mogelijkheid tot korting van de financiele vergoeding voor volksvertegenwoordigers die (vrijwel) geheel niet meer functioneren.
Lets councils and provincial states cut the allowance of members who miss over half of meetings without good reason, to zero for up to a year, by a two-thirds vote.
Confidence in politics is in no way served by representatives receiving their financial allowances while delivering no performance in return.
Het vertrouwen in de politiek is er immers op geen enkele wijze mee gediend dat volksvertegenwoordigers wel hun financiële vergoedingen krijgen, maar daar geen prestatie meer tegenover stellen.
Motie van het lid Fokke over het gebruik van microplastics in cosmetica
Asks the government to talk with the cosmetics industry about avoiding microplastics and to push for an EU-wide ban on microplastics in cosmetics.
also requests the government to work at EU level for a ban on microplastics in cosmetics
verzoekt de regering tevens, zich in Europees verband in te zetten voor een verbod op microplastics in cosmetica
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Fokke over het bericht ‘Subsidie tram in gevaar’

MPs Hoogland and Fokke asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether she had threatened to withdraw the subsidy for the Hasselt-Maastricht tram after a newspaper report. The State Secretary denied threatening withdrawal, said she had called the province of Limburg to account for missed agreed deadlines on the BDU grant, and agreed to consult with the province on a solution.
I called the province of Limburg to account in my letter of 26 January 2017 for failing to meet agreements on the BDU grant
Ik heb de provincie Limburg met mijn brief van 26 januari 2017 aangesproken op het niet nakomen van afspraken over de BDU-uitkering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jan Vos over de berichtgeving over het langer openhouden van Belgische kerncentrales Tihange en Doel

MPs Fokke and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about Belgian plans to extend the Tihange and Doel nuclear reactors beyond 2025, the Belgian response, and whether the Dutch government had pressed Belgium to close them. The minister answered that the lifetime decision is a Belgian national matter for the FANC regulator, that he had relayed parliament's wish for closure to Belgian minister Jambon, and that he would monitor the process.
I have conveyed the wish of your House to Minister Jambon and informed your House of this.
Ik heb de wens van uw Kamer overgebracht aan Minister Jambon en uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie filmpjes van een arrestatie liet wissen (ingezonden 27 december 2016).

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police had its witnesses delete phone footage of a fatal arrest in Maastricht, and on what authority. The minister said a Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, that police have no power to order deletion of citizens' footage but may ask bystanders to delete it voluntarily in medical emergencies, and declined to report on complaints or the investigation's findings.
The police have no power to delete footage from citizens.
De politie heeft geen bevoegdheid om beelden van burgers te wissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Fokke over afgelaste operaties in de Zuyderland-ziekenhuizen in Geleen en Heerlen

MPs Volp and Fokke asked the minister whether cancelled operations at Zuyderland hospitals in Geleen and Heerlen, caused by full wards and a norovirus outbreak, could be prevented and how patients could be moved to appropriate care. The minister confirmed the five cancelled operations, said operations resumed the next day, pointed to the insurer's duty of care and NZa oversight, and promised a quickscan of the emergency care chain with results before the Christmas recess.
I am having a quickscan carried out of the emergency care chain in our country because there are signals that more is going on than an incident.
Ik laat een quickscan uitvoeren ten aanzien van de spoedeisende keten in ons land omdat er signalen zijn dat er meer aan de hand is dan een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Hoogland over het bericht ‘België geeft het op met spoor Maastricht-Lanaken

MPs Fokke and Hoogland asked about reports that Belgium was abandoning the Maastricht-Lanaken freight rail line, its unused state, the public money spent and the lessons learned. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the Rijk paid about 5.6 million euro for revitalisation, that the line lacked freight after Sappi switched to road transport, and that future reactivations must be funded by the initiator.
In future, when reactivating disused railways, the costs of planning, reactivation, and management and maintenance will fall entirely on the initiator.
In het vervolg zullen bij reactivering van in onbruik geraakte spoorwegen de kosten voor planvorming, reactivering en beheer en onderhoud geheel bij de initiatiefnemer komen te liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Fokke over veiligheidsrisico’s van de Belgische kerncentrales

MPs Jan Vos and Fokke asked the minister about safety risks at the Belgian Doel and Tihange nuclear plants, including reports of lax conduct by the operator and the government's response to a parliamentary motion urging Belgium to close them. The minister said the Netherlands would press Belgium for measures and, in the extreme case, closure if risks to Dutch residents are shown, while noting the Belgian regulator found no direct safety problem and that joint inspections were carried out.
I implemented your motions by contacting my Belgian counterpart Jambon by telephone at the time.
Ik heb uw moties uitgevoerd door hierover destijds telefonisch contact op te nemen met mijn Belgische ambtsgenoot Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over het bericht ‘Chemelot loost opnieuw een omstreden stof in de Maas’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about reports that Chemelot discharged melamine into the Maas again, and whether Sitech broke rules and what action can be taken. The minister confirmed elevated melamine levels from Sitech's treatment plant, said it is for the water board and courts to judge rule breaches, and declined to change the division of responsibilities while promising a risk assessment and possible review of the permit.
Ultimately it is for the court to judge to what extent an appeal against permits or against a decision whether or not to enforce is well-founded.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te oordelen in hoeverre een beroep tegen vergunningen of tegen een besluit om al dan niet te handhaven, gegrond of niet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de gemeenten de WOZ-inzage op orde heeft

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why only about a quarter of municipalities publish WOZ property values via the national WOZ portal, and when all will comply with the legal duty. The minister attributes delays to technical and capacity problems in connecting to the national facility, points to an appointed facilitator and a March 2017 deadline, and says municipalities must communicate interim ways for residents to access values.
Responsibility for connecting to the national WOZ facility lies with the municipalities in this matter.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de aansluiting op de Landelijke Voorziening WOZ ligt in dezen bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke over het bericht dat de politie in Maastricht een incident met drie drag queens niet serieus genomen zou hebben

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Maastricht failed to act seriously when three drag queens were harassed by youths, and how such incidents are handled. The minister replied that questions about the local case belong with the mayor, noted that police are willing to discuss perceived bias, and said a meeting took place between police and COC Maastricht.
Specific questions about the incident in Maastricht can therefore be put to the local authority.
Specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval in Maastricht kunnen dan ook worden gesteld aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “Gemeenten boos om tariefstijging Vicrea”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior about reports that municipalities face steep price increases from software vendor Vicrea, and whether the vendor's justification and municipalities' ability to switch providers are acceptable. The minister answered that about 195 municipalities use Vicrea software with increases of 40 to 1,150 percent in a sample, left the vendor's claim to the vendor, and pointed to open-standards agreements, guidance tools and existing monitoring as the means of preventing vendor lock-in.
I consider it a matter for the supplier and the customer to determine whether there is a business risk or whether the costs should be passed on.
Ik acht het een zaak van leverancier en afnemer om te bepalen of er sprake is van een ondernemersrisico of dat de kosten moeten worden doorbelast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kuiken over de vestiging van een asielzoekerscentrum in Maastricht

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the sale and lease of a Maastricht property for an asylum centre, reportedly linked to a suspect owner, showed integrity risks and whether the COA should have checked the buyer's integrity under the Bibob Act. The minister acknowledged factual inaccuracies in the press report, said the government should be restrained in such deals and that integrity checks are warranted, explained that the COA ran a notarial check finding no link to the owner, and noted the COA lacks Bibob powers but a change is being prepared.
The Minister of Justice and Security is currently examining how the Bibob authority for the COA can be realised in the short term by amending the Bibob Decree.
Momenteel beziet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie hoe de Bibob-bevoegdheid voor het COA, door middel van een aanpassing van het Besluit Bibob, op korte termijn kan worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over mijnwaterschade in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about delays in the study of mine-water damage in Limburg, its deadline, the reasons for delay, responsibility for damage and limitation periods. The minister answered that the study results will be published by end 2016 due to a peer review, that the Rijk is not responsible for mining damage (operators are liable), and that claims for coal-mining damage are time-barred since the mines closed in 1974.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over de uitbuiting van Filipijnse truckers door een Limburgs transportbedrijf

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of Filipino truck drivers by a Limburg transport company, including whether Dutch firms rely on them due to a driver shortage, the use of a foreign-based subcontracting construction, and possible exclusion from public tenders. The minister said the sector is recruiting young Dutch drivers, pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and a bill extending chain liability to road transport, declined to comment on the inspection investigation, and stated no current plans to change public procurement rules.
I do not make statements about individual investigations by the Inspectorate SZW, in line with the normal procedure.
Over individuele onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW doe ik conform de normale werkwijze geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ronnes en Fokke over de verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum Defensie van Limburg naar Utrecht

MPs Knops, Ronnes and Fokke asked the Defence Minister why the Financieel Service Centrum (FSC) in Eygelshoven is being moved to Utrecht despite earlier promises to keep work in Limburg, and how this fits with union and works-council opposition, job losses in Limburg, and the motion on fair treatment of peripheral provinces. The Minister answered that a 2015 evaluation showed the split was not natural, that US forces returning to Eygelshoven make the site unsuitable for offices, and that the decision is based primarily on operational grounds with the works council involved in implementation.
These developments were decisive in revising the earlier decision.
Deze ontwikkelingen zijn doorslaggevend geweest om het eerder genomen besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de regels ten aanzien van deeltijdwethouders

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about part-time alderman arrangements that may be used to avoid offsetting side income, including the Reusel case, minimum time-allocation norms, and appeal timelines.
