The Minister answers that such arrangements are not prohibited by law, that the council is responsible for setting time norms, and that the ministry checks offset figures against tax data, while declining to set a statutory minimum.
Appointing aldermen is pre-eminently a local, autonomous matter and a power and responsibility of the council.
Het benoemen van wethouders is bij uitstek een lokale, autonome aangelegenheid, en wel een bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “Gemeentelijke e-mail slecht beveiligd”

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the Interior Minister about a report that municipal email is poorly secured, asking about compliance with mandatory email security standards, enforcement, and a proposed privacy baseline for municipalities. The minister replied that standards are mandatory only for new purchases, that municipalities are responsible for their own supervision with national intervention possible but not yet used, and that a privacy baseline is a matter for the VNG to decide.
Nevertheless, the national government can, under the Municipalities Act and within interadministrative supervision, supervise the municipal executive.
Desalniettemin kan het Rijk op grond van de Gemeentewet – in het kader van interbestuurlijk toezicht – toezicht houden op het gemeentebestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Fokke over het bericht ‘gesjoemel met gevaarlijke stoffen tussen Eindhoven en Venlo’

MPs Cegerek and Fokke asked whether hazardous goods were transported on the Eindhoven–Venlo route in breach of Basisnet rules, and what the consequences are for residents and the government's measures. The State Secretary denied that any category is banned, acknowledged risk-ceiling exceedances without homes being within the contour, said causes are being analysed with results expected in early July, and affirmed the Basisnet commitments still apply.
Before further concrete measures are taken, it is important that the causes are properly identified. I expect the outcome of this analysis at the beginning of July.
Voordat verdere concrete maatregelen worden genomen is het van belang dat de oorzaken goed in beeld zijn gebracht. Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van deze analyse begin juli.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “beveiliging tientallen gemeentesites lek: persoonsgegevens niet veilig”

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked whether municipalities can securely handle citizens' confidential data via websites, after reports that some did not use https; the minister said the BIG is being implemented, that 10 of 390 municipalities were fixed, and that municipalities are responsible for security and accountable to councils. The minister rejected a separate audit, declined a single national website for now, and said privacy-BIG talks are ongoing with no firm commitment.

An investigation such as you describe would, in my view, as a snapshot of the application of a single technical measure, offer insufficient added value compared with the current accountability system.

Een onderzoek zoals u dat schetst zou als momentopname van de toepassing van een enkele technische maatregel mijns inziens onvoldoende meerwaarde bieden ten opzichte van het huidige verantwoordingsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Fokke en Yücel over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenis De Karelskamp te Almelo

Three PvdA MPs asked whether prison De Karelskamp in Almelo might be closed, what the status of the reported closure plans is, and whether this would cost jobs in a shrinkage region. The Staatssecretaris answered that DJI is drafting a plan in response to falling capacity needs, that no definitive closure decision has been taken, that shrinkage regions are one weighted factor, and that a political decision will follow after new WODC research and a second opinion.
I have instructed the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI) to develop a plan on how to deal with the declining capacity requirement.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) de opdracht gegeven een plan te ontwikkelen hoe om te gaan met de dalende capaciteitsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de Belastingdienst die in publiekscontacten in Friesland niet in het Fries communiceert

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the Tax Authority refuses to speak Frisian on its public phone line in Friesland and whether it must comply with the Frisian Language Use Act. The government answered that Leeuwarden tax office can communicate in Frisian in person and in writing, that the national Tax Telephone Service is not obliged to offer Frisian, and that it will discuss the DINGtiid advice on a language officer before deciding on follow-up.
It is true that taxpayers are not spoken to in Frisian on the Tax Telephone Service.
Het klopt dat belastingplichtigen bij de Belastingtelefoon niet in het Fries te woord worden gestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het privacybeleid bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the ministers about a report finding that privacy of Amsterdam citizens was not adequately protected, including unauthorised staff access, unsecured email and non-anonymised data use. The minister answered that such access is unacceptable, that municipalities are themselves responsible for privacy compliance, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens rather than the ministries supervises, and that support and campaigns are ongoing.
Information on this is not systematically collected by the ministries of Justice and Security or of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Informatie hierover wordt niet systematisch verzameld door de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Fokke en Oosenbrug over de situatie dat niet elke gemeente een overlijdensakte van een doodgeboren baby aan de ouders verstrekt

MPs Wolbert, Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether it is acceptable that some municipalities, unlike Amsterdam, do not issue a death certificate for stillborn babies, and how the law's wording (a stillborn child is deemed never to have existed) can be reconciled with parents' recognition needs. The minister said Amsterdam's practice fits existing rules and a 2006 official communication, promised to examine additional forms of registration and wording changes, and to inform parliament before summer.
The Minister of the Interior is willing to examine the possibilities of registration both within and outside the BRP.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken van registratie zowel binnen als buiten de BRP
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht dat het slecht gesteld is met de online vindbaarheid van beleidsstukken van de gemeente Maastricht

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked ministers about reports that online findability of Maastricht municipal policy documents was poor, and whether this affects other municipalities, what municipalities and the government are doing to improve access, and how the Open Government bill and archive programme relate. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own web presentation, no monitoring of this specific issue takes place, and he supports open government but does not favour the information register proposed in the initiative bill.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for the way they present themselves on the internet.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de wijze waarop zij zich op internet presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over de belemmeringen voor personen met een visuele beperking om als raadslid te kunnen functioneren

MPs Oosenbrug, Van Dijk and Fokke asked whether visually impaired councillors are forced to resign because of inadequate support, and what support exists and whether digital democracy is accessible. The Minister says the government is reviewing barriers via a stakeholder inventory and the Dijkstal law evaluation, notes existing financial support for structural impairments, and says digitalisation can help while accessibility is an ongoing process.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many political office holders have a visual or other impairment or have had to resign for that reason.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel politieke ambtsdragers een visuele of andersoortige beperking hebben dan wel om die reden hebben moeten aftreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de leegloop bij het ministerie van BZK als gevolg van de reorganisatie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about staff departures at the Interior Ministry after its reorganisation, including effects on the Democracy and Citizenship directorate and the capacity plan. The minister answered that 110 staff left over nine months, vacancies are being filled, the reorganisation strengthens external orientation, and the Agenda Lokale Democratie continues on schedule.
In December your House received a progress report on the Agenda Lokale Democratie.
In december heeft uw Kamer een voortgangsbericht van de Agenda Lokale Democratie ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over bedreigingen van raadsleden

An MP asked the ministers about threats against municipal councillors, the reporting rate to police, and whether police take such complaints seriously. The minister answered that survey figures are not directly comparable, that police treat these complaints seriously under national agreements, and that most recommendations of the Periklesinstituut are already being implemented or will be pursued with associations.
The police take these reports extremely seriously.
De politie neemt deze aangiften uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Fokke over Eurochild

MPs Maij and Fokke asked the Foreign Minister about child rights organisation Eurochild's recommendations to the Dutch EU Presidency on children's interests, including child poverty, unaccompanied minors and youth involvement. The government answered that it will address radicalisation of youth, involve young people through EU and school programmes, treat poverty mainly as a member state responsibility, and promise a general report on the Presidency afterwards.
After the EU Presidency a general report will follow to inform the House about the activities and outcomes of the Presidency.
Na afloop van het EU voorzitterschap volgt een algemene rapportage om de Kamer te informeren over activiteiten en uitkomsten van het voorzitterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over bedreigingen van raadsleden

An MP asked whether threats against local councillors, which may lead some to quit, are concerning and what protection and reporting measures exist. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to a Veilig bestuur toolkit with new security and psychosocial support, said councillors should report threats, and admitted police and prosecution do not register such cases separately.
Numbers of reports and complaints by councillors are not known to the police.
Aantallen van meldingen en aangiften door raadsleden zijn bij de politie niet bekend
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht 'Falende topambtenaren snel weer aan topbaan geholpen'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Civil Service whether senior civil servants who failed are rarely dismissed and instead quickly reappointed, and how this is treated differently from other staff. The minister replied that performance assessment applies to all civil servants, that top officials' 7-year terms and departures reflect various circumstances, and that no forced dismissals occurred at top level in 2011 to date, with 24 top-level departures reported.
The exact circumstances of each individual case are confidential personnel matters.
De exacte toedracht per individuele casus is personeelsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over het bericht dat bestuurders in de buurt meetellen bij de planning van asielzoekerscentra

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked whether officials at the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf were right to check which local administrators live near a possible asylum site, and why. The minister answered that COA, not the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, is responsible for finding locations, that the wording in the email suggests such considerations can and may not matter, and that COA does not use a social map and no sites were rejected on this basis; the answers to earlier questions were referred to.
The wording of the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the suggestion that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over het afschaffen van de kwijtschelding van de heffing voor de zuivering van afvalwater door het waterschap Delfland

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked about Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission of its wastewater treatment levy, its consistency with the Unie van Waterschappen advice and interbestuurlijke cooperation, and effects on low incomes and municipal debt and poverty policy. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards decide on remission democratically, that the Waterwet cooperation is unaffected by levy remission, and that the Staatssecretaris will invite the Unie van Waterschappen for a discussion.
The starting point is the freedom of each water board to shape and determine its remission policy in a democratic deliberative process.
Voorop staat de vrijheid van elk waterschap om zijn kwijtscheldingsbeleid in een democratisch afwegingsproces vorm en inhoud te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Fokke over het sluiten van de rechtbank in Almelo

MPs Recourt and Fokke asked whether the court in Almelo would be closed, whether this threatens local jobs, and how it fits with the motion on accessible justice. The minister replied that no closure is planned, that the judiciary's own multi-year plan (not a ministerial decision) moves workplaces to Zwolle without job losses in Overijssel, and that any zoning change is the judiciary's responsibility under board and Raad oversight.
The MJP is a document of the judiciary and is not approved by the Minister of Security and Justice.
Het MJP is een document van de rechtspraak en wordt niet door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bekrachtigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Fokke over het sluiten van een rechtbank in Limburg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether a court in Limburg (Roermond or Maastricht) would close, with consequences for jobs, and how this fits the motion on keeping small-claims justice accessible. The Minister answered that neither location is being closed, that planned relocation of workplaces within the district means no job losses in Limburg, and that the Rechtspraak retains responsibility for its locations under ministerial oversight.
There is no intention to close either of the two locations of the Limburg district court, namely the sitting places Maastricht or Roermond.
Er is geen sprake van een voornemen om een van de twee locaties van de rechtbank Limburg, namelijk de zittingsplaatsen Maastricht of Roermond, te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de vennootschapsbelasting

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about corporate tax (VpB) treatment of municipal land development companies, including whether each project is taxed separately, how land positions are valued, and when land should be written down to agricultural value. The government answered that taxation depends on case facts and that projects may be netted only where activities are interwoven, that separate valuation follows BBV rules, and that talks with the VNG resumed, with a planned BBV change from 1 January 2016.
The consultation was already ongoing again at the time the article appeared.
Het overleg was al weer gaande ten tijde van het verschijnen van het artikel

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over het voorkomen van onevenredig banenverlies in de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg door de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked whether the Tax Authority reorganisation has been instructed to prevent disproportionate job losses in Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and whether the De Vries motion will be honoured. The State Secretary answered that a detailed plan follows in autumn, that unions and the works council are consulted but municipalities are not initiated, and that regional employment effects will be reported later by the Minister for Housing and Government Employment, with the De Vries and Groot-Schouten motions taken into account.
I can commit that the De Vries motion will be taken into account in the picture the Minister intends to present to you.
Ik kan toezeggen dat de motie De Vries (Kamerstuk 31 490, nr. 126 ) wordt meegenomen in het beeld dat de Minister u wil schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Van Dekken over het in vaste dienst nemen van payrollers door DUO

Two MPs asked the ministers whether DUO's decision to end payroll contracts for 19 workers, who will remain employed by Randstad Payroll Solutions, was reasonable and consistent with the Wwz, and how it fits the motion on regional employment. The ministers confirmed the contracts are ended, cited DUO's digitisation and budget cuts, said DUO will help with redeployment, and promised a regional employment overview in the autumn.
Randstad Payroll Solutions will ensure new work for these employees.
Randstad Payroll Solutions zal zorgen voor nieuw werk voor deze medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht dat een oud-directeur van een belastingkantoor voor waterschappen bijna 9 ton als afkoopsom heeft gekregen

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked whether a former director of the Hefpunt tax office for water boards could keep receiving large annual payments and a 9 million euro severance, and about the timing, contract basis, job-search obligation, and transparency under the WNT pay-cap law. Minister Plasterk replied that negotiations took place in early 2014, that the legality of the severance is still under investigation by the WNT supervision unit which has access to the contract, and that he will report back on the outcome without yet giving a verdict.
If the investigation shows that the severance arrangement is wholly or partly in breach of the WNT, it is - for the non-compliant part - void by operation of law.
Als het onderzoek uitwijst dat de vertrekregeling geheel of gedeeltelijk in strijd is met WNT, is deze – voor het niet-conforme deel – van rechtswege nietig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert de Vries over de gevolgen van de reorganisatie bij de Belastingdienst voor de provincies Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland en Limburg

MPs Fokke and Albert de Vries asked whether the Belastingdienst reorganisation would disproportionately hit Friesland, Groningen, Drenthe, Zeeland and Limburg, and how the parliamentary motion on regional fairness would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the effects are not yet clear and that the Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform the House later, taking the motion into account.
The Minister for Housing and Civil Service will inform you at a later stage about the regional employment effects within central government
De Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst zal u in een later stadium informeren over de regionale werkgelegenheidseffecten bij de rijksoverheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Verhuur sloopwoningen lonend voor Avenue2’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that a subcontractor charged excessive rent for housing to underpaid workers, and whether the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would stop such deductions. The minister said the deductions are too high and he dislikes employers profiting from worker housing, but explained the law only requires payment of the statutory minimum wage in full and does not prohibit deductions above it, relying on enforcement and social partners.
Legislation alone, however, is not enough to tackle abuses.
Wetgeving alleen is echter niet genoeg om misstanden aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that few municipal websites meet the accessibility guidelines, and about the effectiveness of the new compliance model. The minister disputes the report's 7% figure as not reflecting his registers, notes progress with 166 municipal sites verified, admits too many bodies remain insufficiently accountable, and commits to new monitoring, supplier convenants and legislation expected mid-2016.
I published this application framework for the web guidelines and the accountability model for governments in 2013.
Ik heb dit toepassingskader voor de webrichtlijnen en het verantwoordingsmodel voor overheden in 2013 gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over extra administratiekosten door decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether the decentralisations in the social domain cause extra administrative costs of around 100-150 million euros, and what the government will do about standardising information flows. The minister says the figure is a VNG estimate without a substantiated calculation, that a temporary rise was partly foreseen, and points to ongoing work on standards and funding models with gemeenten and care providers.
The figure cited is an estimate by the VNG, based on signals from municipalities and care providers.
Het genoemde bedrag betreft een inschatting van de VNG, op basis van signalen vanuit gemeenten en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over het bericht dat Gemeentewiet rendabel kan worden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether Heerlen's municipal cannabis cultivation plan, which projects 26 million euros in revenue, is realistic and whether such municipal cultivation could be profitable and studied for other municipalities. The minister answered that regulation of cultivation is not permitted under international treaties and is not the solution, and declined to speculate on the plan's revenue, while pointing to continued integrated enforcement.
As indicated under question 2, regulation is not permitted and is not a solution to the problem outlined.
Zoals aangegeven onder vraag 2 is regulering niet toegestaan en geen oplossing voor de geschetste problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over minderjarigen die werken in wietplantages

Two MPs (Rebel and Fokke, PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about minors working in cannabis plantations after a TV report, including whether such cases are known, how parents are approached, and whether legalising cannabis cultivation would help. The minister said no cases involving minors in plantations were reported to the Public Prosecution Service in 2014 or 2015, one case in 2013, that police make a child-protection referral, and that legalisation would not solve the problem given export and international law constraints.
I refer to answers 2 and 3 to the parliamentary questions from MPs Oskam and Knops
Ik verwijs naar antwoord 2 en 3 op de Kamervragen van de leden Oskam en Knops
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Fokke over nieuw onderzoek naar de IJzeren Rijn

PvdA MPs Hoogland and Fokke asked the State Secretary about a new Flemish-led study into reactivating the IJzeren Rijn rail line, including which routes are examined, whether Dutch government funds the study, and whether outcomes are agreed in advance. The State Secretary answered that three routes will be studied, Dutch co-funding is conditional and not fixed, no agreements on outcomes exist yet, and Limburg has now been informed.
Further agreements on the study have not yet been made; Flanders intends to organise a high level meeting with the five involved governments
Verdere afspraken over de studie zijn nog niet gemaakt; Vlaanderen is voornemens een «high level meeting» met de vijf betrokken overheden te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over werken over de grens

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about provinces and municipalities planning pilots to place unemployed Dutch workers in jobs across the German border, and whether obligations to take such work should be enforced before obstacles are removed. The minister confirmed the initiatives, said cross-border work is possible and that the Participatiewet allows sollicitatieplicht across the border, promised to work with border regions via the GROS network under a motion, and said no one can be forced to accept work abroad though benefits can be sanctioned for refusing to apply.
No one in the Netherlands can be forced to accept work.
Niemand in Nederland kan gedwongen worden werk te aanvaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht “Dualisme in Vianen in het geding”

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior whether a Vianen party lacking an alderman may have its faction leader structurally attend college meetings, and what tools exist if municipalities deviate from the dualist model. The Minister said the Gemeentewet reserves such attendance mainly for officials and experts, that council members attending would undermine dualism, that he would first address the mayor, and that inter-governmental supervision is the last resort.
If council members were to attend college meetings, whether structurally or not, this would fundamentally undermine the dualist system.
Indien raadsleden al dan niet structureel zouden deelnemen aan de vergaderingen van het college, zou dit op een principieel punt afbreuk doen aan het dualistisch stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over gebrekkige controle door gemeentelijke rekenkamers

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior about municipal audit offices (rekenkamers) being under-resourced or dormant, and whether this undermines council oversight amid decentralisation. The Minister confirmed the concern, said 26 municipalities have dormant audit offices, promised an enquiry into budget cuts and a proposal to improve the position of audit offices, and committed to report before the summer recess.
As I reported in answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Fokke, I intend to come forward with proposals on how the position and functioning of audit offices can be improved.
Zoals ik in antwoord op Kamervragen van het lid-Fokke heb gemeld, ben ik voornemens om met voorstellen te komen over hoe de positie en het functioneren van rekenkamers kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Pestcultuur onder ambtenaren komt door gouden kooi’

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked about a report attributing bullying among civil servants to job security and a 'golden cage', and about mobility, top-down anti-bullying measures and financial sanctions for bullies. Minister Plasterk answered that bullying is a workplace matter for individual employers, cited survey figures, outlined mobility initiatives and existing disciplinary options, but declined a top-down approach.
It is primarily up to employers to ensure the safety and health of employees.
Het is primair aan de werkgevers om zorg te dragen voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over een lek in DigiD

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported security flaw in DigiD, including which municipalities were affected, how it arose, when it was discovered and fixed, whether citizens were informed, and whether certificates were outdated. The minister answered that no DigiD security breach occurred, that 12 municipalities had a potential risk patched without any evidence of compromise, that informing citizens is up to the organisations themselves, and that the certificate used is modern (SHA256).
Logius did not disclose the names of the municipalities and other organisations concerned, because it is up to those organisations themselves whether to make any statements about it.
Logius heeft de namen van de betrokken gemeenten en andere organisaties niet bekend gemaakt omdat het aan de betrokken organisaties zelf is om daar wel of geen mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over digitale dienstverlening bij decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipal digital service delivery for the 2015 social-domain decentralisations is lagging and whether residents risk inadequate service. The minister answered that digital information provision is not essential to the transition, pointed to VNG support programmes, a national information point and planned digital-government agreements, and said access arrangements are up to municipalities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Rebel en Fokke over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Recourt, Rebel and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising organised crime in southern Netherlands, including threats against mayors, drug-related crime, police funding and coordination. The minister answered that threats are handled under the prosecution service's protection directive, that police capacity in the south will be intensified within existing staffing from 1 October 2014 via regional structures, and that no national crime coordinator is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it makes no statements about possible threats against public administrators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over "gemeente mag subsidie niet korten om topinkomens"

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities should be able to weigh executive pay norms when contracting providers, given a Council of State ruling that municipalities may not use subsidy cuts to enforce income limits. The minister said such norms are desirable and can be weighed at the front end of subsidy decisions, but he will not amend the legislation and will send the VNG and IPO a letter with conclusions.
I therefore do not intend to amend the legislation.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens de wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Woede om gouden handdruk manager'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers about a reported €294,476 severance payment to a unit manager of the Amersfoort sheltered-work body, whether municipal aldermen knew, and whether it breaches the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the manager was not a top official under the WNT so the cap did not apply, the payment was reported and explained, the board was only informed afterwards and is discussing it with management, and no action to reclaim the payment was announced.
Strictly speaking, this question should not be directed at the ministers of BZK and SZW.
Deze vraag hoort strikt genomen niet te worden gericht aan de bewindspersonen van BZK en SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Rebel over de sponsoring van provincies en gemeenten door de tabaksindustrie

MPs Fokke and Rebel asked whether municipalities and provinces sponsored by the tobacco industry breach FCTC Article 5.3 and its guidelines, and what the government will do to stop it. The State Secretary answered that the convention binds local authorities but leaves implementation open, that the guidelines are non-binding, that the two campaigns do not stem from tobacco control policy, and that a letter reminding municipalities and provinces of their obligations has been sent.
That said, I consider it important that municipalities and provinces become better acquainted with the obligations arising from the FCTC convention and the Tobacco Act.
Dit neemt niet weg dat ik het belangrijk vind dat gemeenten en provincies beter bekend worden met de verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het FCTC-verdrag en de Tabakswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Fokke over het betaalgedrag van gemeenten

Opposition MPs Öztürk and Fokke asked ministers about municipalities paying invoices late, despite the 30-day statutory term, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the Ombudsman's findings, said a public monitor on municipal payment terms will be set up with the VNG and KING, and declined to send a circular or to suspend Municipality Fund payments.
You will be informed about this by the end of October at the latest, as promised in the aforementioned letter.
U wordt hierover uiterlijk eind oktober geïnformeerd, zoals toegezegd in voornoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over het bericht «Venlo eist salarisverlaging top Zorggroep»

MPs Kerstens, Van Dijk and Fokke asked about a 5% salary increase for the chair of the Zorggroep Noord- en Midden-Limburg board, its link to the Venlo council's demand for a salary cut, and whether the government would back the executive's stance and coordinate with VNG and IPO on local pay norms. Minister Plasterk answered that the increase was lawful under the WNT transitional rules, that voluntary pay cuts are encouraged, and that the case will be raised with VNG and IPO, which are still in talks.
I will include the case in the consultation with VNG and IPO.
Ik zal de casus betrekken bij het overleg met VNG en IPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het aanhoudende misbruik van de Wet openbaarheid bestuur

An MP asked the Interior Minister about recurring abuse of the Freedom of Information Act (Wob), where requests are filed mainly to extract penalty payments under the Dwangsom law, and whether excluding the Wob from that regime should be pushed through faster. The minister confirmed the abuse is not incidental, said the initiative bill Open overheid's articles 8.3 and 8.4 are an adequate remedy, and announced a narrower bill this autumn to stop the abuse sooner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht «Gefuseerde gemeente niet efficiënter»

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a study finding that merged municipalities are not more efficient, and whether it would be sent to parliament with a government response. The minister replied that the study is being examined, that efficiency is broader than costs alone, and cited other studies and Danish evidence suggesting service and governance gains and some administrative cost savings after mergers.
I will study it further and provide Parliament with a response.
Ik zal het nader bestuderen en voorzien van een reactie aan Uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over de dreiging van een artikel 12-status voor de gemeenten Oldambt, Pekela en Bellingwedde

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether Oldambt, Pekela and Bellingwedde risk an article 12 financial-supervision status, what causes it, and what the new municipal fund and participation budget models mean for them. The minister answered that the province sees no current basis for the concern, pointed to efficiency cuts and the new participation budget, and listed existing support measures for weak labour-market regions.
Once there is insight into the effects of the objective models in the social domain, the need for a possible transitional arrangement will be considered.
Als er zicht is op de effecten van de objectieve modellen binnen het sociaal domein, wordt de noodzaak van een eventuele overgangsregeling bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over integriteitsschendingen door ambtenaren

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked the Minister of Interior about a survey finding that about a quarter of civil servants perceived a misconduct, and about the actual extent and trend of integrity violations. The Minister said the survey is perception-based and a useful signal, that Rijk registrations (around 500 to 650 confirmed violations a year since 2010) show no significant rise, and pointed to existing integrity policy and the Ambtenarenwet obligations, promising continued encouragement of integrity efforts.
Organisations in the public administration are themselves responsible for registering integrity violations.
Organisaties in het openbaar bestuur zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het registreren van integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘NVRR wil normbedrag voor rekenkamers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that the NVRR wants a standard minimum budget for municipal audit committees, and about budget cuts, small-scale organisation, and inactive audit bodies. The minister acknowledged the risk that cuts impair audit functions, said he opposes a fixed norm amount because budgeting is a municipal prerogative, and promised to monitor developments and ask inactive municipalities for progress reports.

It is of great importance that every municipal council in the Netherlands has an active audit committee sufficiently equipped to examine the effectiveness, efficiency and lawfulness of the administration conducted.

Het is van groot belang dat elke gemeenteraad in Nederland beschikt over een actieve rekenkamer die voldoende is geëquipeerd om onderzoek te doen naar de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en rechtmatigheid van het gevoerde bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de berichten ‘Stadsbestuur let onvoldoende op de centen’ en ‘We zijn geen applausmachine van het college’

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior about reports that municipal boards pay insufficient attention to finances and that councils are not a rubber stamp for the executive, including how many municipalities lack a sound annual account and how responsibilities are divided among municipal board, auditor and audit office. The Minister answered that most municipalities receive unqualified auditor opinions, that councils take their oversight role seriously, that a follow-up survey will report in autumn, and that legislation strengthening audit offices is pending in the Senate.
Because of the expansion of municipal tasks in the social domain from budget year 2015, I will again map in the coming years the nature of the auditor statements issued.

Vanwege de uitbreiding van de gemeentelijke taken voor het sociaal domein per begrotingsjaar 2015 zal ik de komende jaren opnieuw in kaart laten brengen wat de aard van de afgegeven accountantsverklaringen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘Minister Plasterk kort noordelijke provincies ten gunste van Randstad’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that the planned 2015-2016 municipal fund revision cuts northern provinces in favour of the Randstad, including the Rfv's criticism and the use of 2010 cost data. The minister answered that the redistribution is cost-based, that only one municipality faces a 6% cut, that the 2010 patterns were checked and found comparable, and that a transition arrangement applies.
The distribution of the municipal fund is based on the costs municipalities incur and their opportunities to generate own revenue.
De verdeling van het gemeentefonds is gebaseerd op de kosten die gemeenten maken en de mogelijkheden om eigen inkomsten te verwerven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over strafbare feiten begaan door ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether reported cases of possible criminal offences by civil servants are rarely reported to police or prosecutors, and how reporting obligations and integrity enforcement work. The Minister answered that 53 criminal complaints were filed in 2011-2012 in the central government sector, that internal disciplinary enforcement is primary, that existing law already covers reporting duties, and that no additional regulation is considered necessary.
The data concern the central government sector, excluding the Ministry of Defence and zbo's (independent administrative bodies).
Het betreft de registratie in de sector Rijk, exclusief het Ministerie van Defensie en zbo's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Adviespunt Klokkenluiders: de ambtenaar is niet goed beschermd’

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether many Dutch municipalities lack public whistleblower schemes, whether weak scheme visibility reflects poor integrity, and what happened to around a hundred whistleblowers who contacted the Expert Group. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities must have a procedure by law, that public visibility is desirable though not tracked, and that the government has no insight into the individual cases while pointing to existing support bodies and an evaluation planned for 2014.
The cabinet has no insight into the fate of the hundred whistleblowers who reported to the Expert Group Whistleblowers over the past two years.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de lotgevallen van de honderd klokkenluiders die zich de afgelopen twee jaar bij de Expertgroep Klokkenluiders hebben gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘Rekenkamer vreest slechte controle geld gemeentetaken’

Fokke (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior whether local audit committees (rekenkamers) are strong enough to oversee decentralisation funds and whether they should get stronger investigative powers over joint arrangements. The minister answered that well-functioning audit bodies are essential, that 15 inactive committees were contacted, and that rekenkamercommissies will receive the same investigative powers as rekenkamers, with a further review of private-law partnerships pending.
The intention is that these powers also fully apply to a municipal audit committee.
Het voornemen is dat deze bevoegdheden ook onverkort toekomen aan een gemeentelijke rekenkamercommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Fokke over uitbuiting van werknemers die werken aan de A2-tunnel in Maastricht

MPs from the PvdA asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about exploitation of foreign workers on the A2 tunnel project in Maastricht, and about whether public bodies should screen contractors and prevent unfair competition. The minister says the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, an expert committee found likely violations of the Bouw cao, and he points to planned chain liability and a study on displacement, while rejecting a change to selection criteria and the Rijkswaterstaat procurement role.
Now that there is a report from the expert committee, it is becoming clearer what is going on.
Nu er een rapport ligt van de expertcommissie wordt inzichtelijker wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert De Vries over de financiële gevolgen van gemeenten met hun grondpositie

MPs Albert de Vries and Fokke asked ministers whether the financial crisis hitting municipal land companies is worse than the 2012 study showed, whether the minister will allow longer write-downs, support provinces' plans to help municipalities, and agree to renegotiate Rijk-subsidised building contracts to cut building capacity. The minister replied that current rules suffice, longer write-down periods are possible only under enhanced provincial supervision, and that the Rijk no longer has partner status in the remaining housing subsidies, with a further report promised in December.
As I already reported in my letter of 14 October and as promised in the VAO of 12 November, this report will be sent to your House in December on behalf of my colleague of the Interior Ministry.

Zoals ik al in mijn brief van 14 oktober heb gemeld en zoals ook in het VAO van 12 november heb toegezegd, zal dit rapport in december mede namens mijn collega van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het efficiënt omgaan met Wob-verzoeken door gemeenten

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipalities can refuse Wob requests by pointing to already public information, whether requesters must first search themselves, and how the Hoogeveen request for all permits since 1988 (apparently aimed at collecting a dwangsom) will be addressed. Minister Plasterk answered that public information falls outside the Wob and can be referred to, that requesters should first search for it, and that the misuse of the Wob will be tackled on a short timeframe based on a study of recent administrative law instruments.
Based partly on the results of this study, I am considering how to curb, in the short term, improper use (also called abuse or manifestly unreasonable use) of the Wob.

Mede op basis van de resultaten van dit onderzoek bezie ik op welke wijze op korte termijn paal en perk kan worden gesteld aan oneigenlijk gebruik (ook wel misbruik of kennelijk onredelijk gebruik) van de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de gestegen tarieven voor bouwleges

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a reported 5% rise in building permit fees and large variation between municipalities, and whether the government will impose a uniform cost model or cap on increases. The minister answers that municipalities set their own fees subject to courts' 100% cost-recovery test, that transparency should improve through VNG appeals and an updated guidance, but that no national maximum or mandatory model will be imposed.
The rights of citizens and businesses are guaranteed because objection and appeal are open against the levying of fees.
De rechten van de burger en het bedrijfsleven zijn gewaarborgd doordat er bezwaar en beroep open staat tegen de legesheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het wachtgeld van de burgemeester van Groningen, de heer Rehwinkel

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the transition allowance (wachtgeld) of Groningen mayor Rehwinkel under the Appa, including the job-search obligation, how it is enforced, sanctions, and whether it applies to those living abroad. The Minister confirmed the job-search obligation applies, explained the individual reintegration plan and withholding-based sanctions up to 100%, and said no cases of non-compliance had arisen in the Minister's remit.
The administrative body responsible for paying the Appa benefit is also responsible for reintegration.
Het bestuursorgaan dat verantwoordelijk is voor de uitvoering van de Appa-uitkering is ook verantwoordelijk voor de re-integratie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Rebel and Fokke asked the minister of Security and Justice about enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops in Maastricht, including whether the mayor may waive it in daily enforcement. The minister replied that the criterion is part of the national Opium Act guideline, that the local triangle sets enforcement priorities but cannot differentiate buyers by residency, and that he sent the mayor a letter of 30 August 2013.

As I indicated in my letter to the mayor of Maastricht of 30 August 2013, differentiation within the municipality regarding sales to residents, non-residents or certain non-residents does not fit the national framework and the objectives of the coffeeshop policy.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de burgemeester van Maastricht van 30 augustus 2013 heb aangegeven past differentiatie binnen de gemeente met betrekking tot de verkoop aan ingezetenen, niet-ingezetenen of bepaalde niet-ingezetenen niet in het landelijk kader en de doelstellingen van het coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het  misbruiken van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob)

Two MPs asked the Interior Minister about abuse of the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) to claim penalty payments for late decisions, and whether the Wet dwangsom or the Wob itself should be changed. The minister acknowledged the abuse, said research on the 'versnellingsinstrumenten' is underway with results expected soon, and said the Wob itself needs no full revision, while promising to consider measures after that research.
I am of the view that something must be done quickly about the improper use of the Wob.
Ik ben van oordeel dat er snel iets moet gebeuren aan het oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Fokke over jurisprudentie ten aanzien van de handhaving van het ingezetenencriterium voor coffeeshops

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about case law on enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops, following a Maastricht ruling declaring the prosecution inadmissible. The minister summarised criminal, civil and administrative rulings (mostly upholding the criterion, with some appeals pending) and said the case law is consistent enough that no legislation is needed.
Case law so far shows that the residency criterion passes scrutiny before the criminal, civil and administrative courts alike.
Uit de jurisprudentie tot nu toe blijkt dat het ingezetenencriterium zowel bij de strafrechter als de civiele rechter als de bestuursrechter de toets der kritiek doorstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Fokke over de toekomst van het European Institute of Public Administration

MPs Verheijen and Fokke asked whether EIPA may leave Maastricht after the Dutch government cuts its subsidy, who will be responsible for its support, and whether the government will consult Limburg and Maastricht. The minister answered that the government is considering an additional regional contribution, that responsibility is still open, and that letters requesting a regional contribution were sent on 2 July, with the Chamber to be informed once EIPA's financial position is clear.
Once there is clarity about EIPA's financial position, the cabinet will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is rondom de financiële positie van EIPA zal het kabinet de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Maastricht local triangle (mayor, police, prosecutor) is divided over raids on coffeeshops and whether local policy on the residency criterion is unclear. The minister replied that the partners operate in a unified way, that local tailoring within the national framework is preserved, and referred to an earlier letter to parliament.
I in fact observe that in Maastricht the partners in the triangle operate unambiguously and that sales to drug tourists are vigorously tackled both under criminal and administrative law.
Ik constateer juist dat in Maastricht de partners in de driehoek eenduidig opereren en dat de verkoop aan drugstoeristen zowel strafrechtelijk als bestuursrechtelijk voortvarend wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Jacobi over “overtredingen door veehouderijen met luchtwassers”

MPs Van Dekken, Fokke and Jacobi asked about violations by livestock farms with air scrubbers, including 58% of inspected cases with breaches and 16% serious ones, and their effect on fine-particle and nitrogen calculations, enforcement in Brabant versus other provinces, and sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the non-compliance, pointed to mandatory electronic monitoring from 2016, said enforcement is delegated to municipalities and provinces without a national register, and promised to take further measures if compliance does not improve.

There is no national system in which the competent authorities under the Wabo record inspections, so no overview of the results of inspections of intensive livestock farms with air scrubbers can be given.

Er is geen landelijk systeem waarin de bevoegde gezagen voor de Wabo de controles registreren, waardoor geen overzicht van de resultaten van controles op intensieve veehouderijen met luchtwassers gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Hilkens and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice how nuisance around Maastricht coffeeshops should be tackled, including whether the mayor may relax enforcement of the residents-only criterion, whether extra police are needed, and whether illegal street dealers are run by coffeeshop owners. Minister Opstelten answered that local authorities set coffeeshop policy within the national framework, that police capacity will be made available on request, and that he has no evidence for the claim about coffeeshop owners sending runners onto the street.
I told the mayor of Maastricht that I wish to provide support where needed and I will do so.
Ik heb de burgemeester van Maastricht gezegd mijn steun te willen verlenen waar dat nodig is en dit zal ik ook doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht «Gemeenten vrezen toename verloedering door bezuinigingen Rijk»

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior whether the planned end to municipal reimbursement for enforcing nuisance fines (bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast, such as littering and illegal parking) would weaken local enforcement, and whether they had consulted the VNG. Minister Opstelten answered that consultations with the VNG on the reimbursement scheme are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed once more is known.
I am still in consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) about the reimbursement scheme for municipalities concerning the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Kuiken over het niet vernietigen van een bouwvergunning voor een geitenstal in Landerd (Noord-Brabant)

Three PvdA MPs asked why the Crown did not annul the municipality of Landerd's building permit for a goat barn despite the province of Noord-Brabant's request, and whether the expansion should be allowed on public health grounds. The minister replied that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, so annulment under the Constitution's Article 132 could not be applied, and that the decision takes no position on the desirability of the expansion or the provincial building freeze.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over gemeenten zonder rekenkamer(functie)

An MP asked the Interior Minister about municipalities without an active audit committee (rekenkamer), citing an NVRR study, and whether such non-compliance with the Gemeentewet should have consequences and how to activate them. The minister answered that municipalities must have a rekenkamer, will discuss the study with VNG and IPO, but rejects coercive or sanction measures and is not in favour of amending the Arhi law to mandate audit functions during municipal mergers.
Municipalities must have a rekenkamer. Not only because it is in the law, but because it is important.
Gemeenten moeten een rekenkamer hebben. Niet alleen omdat dit in de wet staat, maar omdat het belangrijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de verkiezingen voor het fusiewaterschap Vechtstromen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the planned autumn 2013 elections for the merged water board Vechtstromen are lawful given the postponement of water board elections to 2015 and the transitional rules for mergers. The minister answered that the Water Board Act requires elections before a merger, that the board's term is extended to January 2019 by skipping the November 2014 elections, and that differing provincial decisions on guaranteed seats require a joint provincial decision under article 6.
Under article 29, fourth paragraph, the Vechtstromen board skips these elections and its term ends together with the end of the following term (January 2019).

Op grond van het bepaalde in artikel 29, vierde lid, slaat het bestuur van Vechtstromen deze verkiezingen over en eindigt de zittingsperiode gelijk met het einde van de hierop volgende zittingsperiode (januari 2019).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de gestegen waterschapsbelastingen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked the Minister whether rising water board charges in 2012 were consistent with the efficiency gains agreed in the Bestuursakkoord Water, and about regional differences. The Minister replied that charges rose about 2% on average, that the efficiency targets moderate rather than reduce charges, and that the rise is expected to fit the agreements, attributing regional differences to area characteristics and local policy choices.

As the answers to questions 3, 4 and 5 show, contrary to what the Vereniging Eigen Huis appears to assume, the Bestuursakkoord Water did not agree that the efficiency gains would lead to lower charges, but to a moderation of the increase in charges.

Zoals uit de beantwoording van de vragen 3, 4 en 5 blijkt is, anders dan de Vereniging Eigen Huis lijkt te veronderstellen, in het Bestuursakkoord Water niet afgesproken dat de te realiseren doelmatigheidswinsten gaan leiden tot lagere lasten, maar dat ze leiden tot een matiging van de lastenstijging.
Antwoord vragen Fokke en Jan Vos over het bericht 'niet ondertekenen verdrag export onbegrijpelijk'

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Netherlands is not ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemical safety, and whether this endangers workers abroad and imposes low administrative costs on firms. The minister answered that the government will consult the social partners and the SER on ratification, pointed to alternative chemical information sources, and noted that five of 27 EU states have ratified.
Following the consultation between the Cabinet and the Labour Foundation on 19 December, I informed the House by letter.
Naar aanleiding van het overleg tussen Kabinet en de Stichting van de Arbeid op 19 december heb ik de Kamer per brief geïnformeerd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fokke over controle op uitgaven door gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about weak oversight of municipal spending of decentralisation grants and whether the legal obligation for local audit committees (rekenkamers) should be scrapped. The minister answered that local accountability is horizontal, that the national government can only request policy and supervisory information, and that he considers the planned abolition of the periodic evaluation premature and wants to keep an active rekenkamer, with consultation planned on dormant audit bodies.
Control over efficient and lawful spending takes place at the local level.
Controle op doelmatige en rechtmatige besteding vindt op lokaal niveau plaats.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de privatisering van het toezicht in de bouw

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked the government about privatising building inspection, including whether private checks on structural safety would be independent, who would be liable, and whether regional inspection services would be a better option. Minister Blok answered that private quality assurance is planned from 2015 with checks and balances, that liability and sanctions will be clarified by mid-2013, and that a national inspection body proposal is still under consideration.
My intention is to make private supervision possible alongside municipal supervision.
Mijn voornemen is om naast het gemeentelijk ook privaat toezicht mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Fokke over de vervuiling van oppervlaktewater door microplastics

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about microplastics and nanomaterials polluting surface water, including measures on cosmetics, research on health effects, filtering, and producer responsibility. The minister answered that the government focuses on source-based action, ongoing research, EU cosmetics rules, and a voluntary packaging agreement, without yet filtering microplastics from water.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for now steers towards a source-based approach.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu stuurt vooralsnog aan op een brongerichte aanpak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over het bericht dat illegaal afval door gemeenten wordt gedumpt

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked the state secretary about reports that municipalities dump or sell electronic waste to illegal circuits abroad, including whether this breaches agreements with Wecycle. The state secretary answered that illegal volumes cannot be quantified, that enforcement and the revised WEEE directive will be used to close the chain, and that 16% of municipalities sell some valuable e-waste outside the Wecycle system, with further steps promised.
If municipalities themselves trade part of their electronic waste, there is no insight into what happens to this waste, because it is not registered.
Indien gemeenten zelf een deel van hun elektronisch afval verhandelen, is er geen zicht op wat er met dit afval gebeurt, omdat het niet geregistreerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over de berichtgeving dat het gebruik van statische verkeersmodellen zou kunnen leiden tot verkeerde beleidskeuzes

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports that static traffic models could lead to wrong policy choices, and whether dynamic models should be used instead. The minister answered that static models underpin environmental measures for road projects and noise/air programmes, that dynamic models are used for traffic management and road design details, and that static models are more accurate for future traffic volumes while dynamic models are more accurate for flow details.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Fokke over “het bericht dat Brabant duizenden boeren niet gaat controleren op vergunning”

MPs Jacobi and Fokke asked the State Secretary whether Noord-Brabant can refuse to enforce the Nature Conservation Act against thousands of farmers lacking permits, and whether the province should be held to its enforcement duty. The State Secretary said he is aware of the long-running 'interimmers' problem, that the PAS can help, and that he is working with the provinces on a solution, without committing to a specific enforcement action.
Within the framework of the PAS, I am working with the provinces on a solution.
Ik werk in het kader van de PAS samen met de provincies aan een oplossing.

m: Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat regelt dat de minister zorgdraagt voor het optuigen en in stand houden van een landelijk aanbodsysteem voor alle door toegelaten instellingen voor verhuur aang

Amendment requiring the minister to set up and maintain a national rental offer system listing all social-landlord rental homes below the liberalisation threshold, with rules set by general administrative order.
Our Minister shall ensure a national offer system in which at least all rental dwellings offered by approved institutions are listed
Onze Minister draagt zorg voor een landelijk aanbodsysteem waarin ten minste alle door de toegelaten instellingen te huur aangeboden woonruimten

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 21 dat regelt dat de opgebouwde inschrijfduur als woningzoekende voor een sociale huurwoning bij een corporatie (of samenwerkingsv
Lets municipal housing ordinances and housing corporations let applicants carry registration duration across municipalities and regions, and lets municipalities give local residents a priority bonus.
This amendment provides that accumulated registration duration as a housing seeker for a social rental home with a housing corporation can always be carried over
Dit amendement regelt dat de opgebouwde inschrijfduur als woningzoekende voor een sociale huurwoning bij een corporatie (of samenwerkingsverband van corporaties) altijd kan worden meegenomen

Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat o.a. een bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen maximumbedrag regelt voor de bemiddelingsvergoeding voor het huren van huurwoningen onder de libera
Caps the intermediary fee housing associations may charge tenants for below-liberalisation-threshold rentals, sets the cap by general administrative order (AMvB), and bans annual registration fees.
to compensate administrative costs, charge at most an amount set by general administrative order
ter compensatie van de gemaakte administratiekosten ten hoogste een bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vastgesteld bedrag in rekening
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 18 dat regelt dat bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de door een verhuurder

Amends the Housing Act and Housing Act provisions so that ministerial rules on information about rental dwellings below the liberalisation limit must go through public consultation and be sent to parliament before adoption.
At the same time as publication, the draft is submitted to both Houses of the States General.
Gelijktijdig met de bekendmaking wordt het ontwerp aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal overgelegd.
Motie van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over benoemen van de endogene effecten voor de schatkist
Asks the government to name the endogenous effects on the Treasury explicitly in the explanatory memoranda of bills.
in the explanatory memorandum to bills to name the endogenous effects for the Treasury from now on
in de memorie van toelichting bij wetsvoorstellen de endogene effecten voor de schatkist voortaan te benoemen
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen over verplichte adviesaanvraag door de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst
Amendment makes the minister's advice request to provincial executive or plusregio board mandatory instead of optional when assessing municipal housing/subsidiary options.
This amendment aims to ensure that the Minister of Housing and Central Government Affairs does not ask for advice on a non-binding basis.
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd dat de Minister van Wonen en Rijksdienst niet vrijblijvend advies vraagt.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat het mogelijk maakt om in ernstige gevallen direct een bestuurlijke boete op te leggen
Allows administrative fines to be imposed directly, without a prior warning, in serious cases involving threats to liveability, health or safety.
if: a. the offender has committed the same or a comparable offence less than two years before, or b. the offence involves a threat to liveability or a danger to health or safety.

indien: a. de overtreder minder dan twee jaar voorafgaande aan die overtreding eenzelfde of een vergelijkbare overtreding heeft begaan, of b. de overtreding gepaard gaat met een bedreiging van de leefbaarheid of een gevaar voor de gezondheid of veiligheid.

Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat regelt dat de opgebouwde inschrijfduur als woningzoekende voor een sociale huurwoning bij een corporatie (of samenwerkingsverband van corporaties) altijd kan w
Amendment lets housing corporations and municipal housing ordinances carry over waiting-list registration duration across municipalities and regions for social rental housing.
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over een plan van aanpak voor de problematiek van onderhoud en beheer in aandachtswijken
Asks the government to present to the House within a year an analysis and action plan on maintenance and management problems in disadvantaged neighbourhoods' owner-occupied housing.
within one year to present to the House an analysis of and action plan for this problem
binnen een jaar een analyse van en een plan van aanpak voor deze problematiek aan de Kamer voor te leggen

Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat regelt dat bij een algemene maatregel van bestuur regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de door een verhuurder te verstrekken informatie over een door hem a
Lets an general administrative order (AMvB) set rules on information landlords must publish about affordable rental housing, with a consultation and draft-submission procedure.
by or pursuant to a general administrative order it is determined which data a recognised housing association must publish at least
bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur bepaald welke gegevens een toegelaten instelling ten minste bekend maakt
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen over het schrappen van de aanvullende maatregel die het mogelijk maakt de OZB-heffing te verlagen
Deletes an unused municipal provision allowing lower property tax (OZB) levies, as a bureaucracy-reducing measure.
This amendment deletes the additional measure that allows lowering the OZB property tax levy.
Met dit amendement wordt de aanvullende maatregel die het mogelijk maakt de OZB-heffing te verlagen, geschrapt.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen dat regelt dat de huidige verleningsmogelijkheid ten aanzien van een gebiedsaanwijzing wordt gehandhaafd
Amendment deletes the article allowing extension of an area designation beyond eight years, so that the existing single extension remains and no further extensions are possible.
With this bill the extension of an area designation is expanded to a maximum of four times four years.
Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt de verlenging van een gebiedsaanwijzing uitgebreid naar maximaal vier maal vier jaar.
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over een bredere werking van een uitspraak van de huurcommissie bij onzelfstandige woonruimte
Asks the government to study how a rental committee ruling on a case in non-self-contained housing can be applied more broadly to other tenants in the same building.
a ruling of the rent committee on a case concerning non-self-contained housing can be used more actively
een uitspraak van de huurcommissie over een casus bij onzelfstandige woonruimte actiever ingezet kan worden
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen over het schrappen van de drempel van € 36,- voor het voorleggen van een geschil aan de Huurcommissie
Keeps the option for tenants to bring disputes under €36 per year to the Huurcommissie by deleting the proposed threshold.
By removing the option to bring such disputes to the Huurcommissie, tenants will be left with the sub-district court as their only route
Door het schrappen van de mogelijkheid om geschillen in dit soort situaties aan de Huurcommissie voor te leggen zullen huurders als enige rechtsgang de kantonrechter overhouden
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over een verbod op all-in huurcontracten
Asks the government to ban all-in rental contracts as soon as possible and submit a bill to that effect.
requests the government to ban all-in rental contracts as soon as possible and submit a bill to the House to that effect
verzoekt de regering om, all-in huurcontracten op zo kort mogelijke termijn te verbieden en een wetsvoorstel daartoe aan de Tweede Kamer voor te leggen
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over een analyse van de bestaande kostenstructuur van de Nederlandse elektriciteits- en gasnetwerken
Asks the government to commission within a year an analysis of the cost structure of Dutch electricity and gas networks and to involve the House in the assignment.
requests the government to have an analysis carried out within a year and to involve the House in the research assignment
verzoekt de regering om, binnen een jaar een analyse als bedoeld te laten uitvoeren en de Kamer te betrekken bij de onderzoeksopdracht
Motie van het lid De Rouwe c.s. over ondersteunen van de uitwerking van de Toekomstagenda voor Snelfietsroutes
Asks the government to support, together with local authorities, the elaboration of a future agenda for fast cycle routes so cycling measures can be part of the Beter Benutten programme.
requests the government, together with the responsible decentralised authorities, to support the elaboration of the Future Agenda for Fast Cycle Routes
verzoekt de regering, samen met de verantwoordelijke decentrale overheden de uitwerking van de Toekomstagenda Snelfietsroutes te ondersteunen
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over toewijzen van goedkope huurwoningen aan de primaire doelgroep
Motion asking the government to give priority allocation of affordable rental homes to the primary target group and to adjust the core stock norm accordingly.
requests the government to promote that affordable rental homes are allocated with priority to households from the primary target group
verzoekt de regering, te bevorderen dat huurwoningen in de categorieën goedkoop en betaalbaar bij voorrang worden toegewezen aan huishou dens uit de primaire doelgroep
Amendement van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen waarin wordt gezorgd dat de leidingwaterbelasting meer bijdraagt aan waterbesparing.
Amends the water tax so that households pay nothing on the first 50 cubic metres per connection, with higher rates on higher consumption to encourage water saving.
With this amendment it is ensured that the water supply tax contributes more to water saving.
Met dit amendement wordt gezorgd dat de leidingwaterbelasting meer bijdraagt aan waterbesparing.
Motie van de leden Agnes Mulder en Paulus Jansen over het inrichten van een leerproces voor energiecoöperaties
Asks the government to set up a learning process for energy cooperatives and to report regularly to the House on the obstacles they raise, such as administrative burden.
and the ministry analyses these and regularly reports to the House on them
en het ministerie deze analyseert en de Kamer hierover regelmatig rapporteert
Motie van de leden Paulus Jansen en Agnes Mulder over de rol van EBN in het versnellen van de benutting van het geothermisch potentieel
Asks the government to explore what role the state-owned company EBN could play in speeding up geothermal energy use.
requests the government to explore what role EBN can play in accelerating the use of the geothermal potential of the Dutch subsurface
verzoekt de regering om, te verkennen welke rol EBN kan spelen in het versnellen van de benutting van het geothermisch potentieel van de Nederlandse ondergrond
Motie van de leden Paulus Jansen en Agnes Mulder over versterking van het draagvlak bijomwonenden van wind-op-land-projecten
Asks the government to present a proposal within six months to strengthen residents' legal protection and fairer sharing of burdens near wind-on-land projects.
believes that support among residents can be strengthened through good legal protection and a legally guaranteed fairer distribution of benefits and burdens
van mening dat het draagvlak onder omwonenden versterkt kan worden door goede rechtsbescherming en een wettelijk geborgde eerlijker verdeling van lusten en lasten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het toepassen van de heffingsvermindering op het ombouwen van kantoren naar onzelfstandige wooneenheden
Extends the energy-investment tax reduction to converting offices into non-independent dwellings such as student rooms.
This amendment encourages converting offices into non-independent dwelling units, including student rooms, by making the tax reduction applicable.
Met dit amendement wordt het ombouwen van kantoren naar onzelfstandige wooneenheden, waaronder studentenkamers, gestimuleerd door de heffingsvermindering hierop van toepassing te laten zijn.
Motie van het lid Paulus Jansen over alleen liberaliseren als er geen gegadigde is om de woning te huren
Asks the government to ensure through the Housing Act that housing associations may liberalise or sell vacated social rental homes only after confirming no eligible applicant wants them.
can only liberalise or sell after it has been established that no housing seeker from the target group wishes to rent it
slechts kunnen liberaliseren of verkopen nadat is vastgesteld dat er geen woningzoekende uit de doelgroep is die deze woning wil huren
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen over het toepassen van de heffingsvermindering op het ombouwen van kantoren naar onzelfstandige wooneenheden
Amendment extends the energy-investment tax reduction to conversions of offices into non-self-contained dwellings such as student rooms.
'rental dwellings' is replaced by: rental dwellings or non-self-contained living space.
wordt «huurwoningen» vervangen door: huurwoningen of onzelfstandige woonruimten.
Motie Paulus Jansen over de beleidseffectiviteit van financiële arrangementen voor het wonen
Asks the government to report fully in the 2013 annual report on the policy effectiveness of housing financial arrangements such as mortgage interest relief.
requests the government to report fully on the policy effectiveness of financial arrangements for housing in the 2013 annual report
verzoekt de regering, bij het jaarverslag 2013 integraal te rapporteren over de beleidseffectiviteit van financiële arrangementen voor het wonen
Motie Paulus Jansen over een onderzoek naar structurele effecten op leegstand
Asks the government to research structural causes of vacancy in offices, shops and business buildings and report to parliament within six months.
Requests the government to conduct research into structural effects on vacancy of offices, shops and businesses and report to the House within six months.
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek te doen naar structurele effecten op leegstand van kantoren, winkels en bedrijven en hierover binnen zes maanden aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 13 over nadere invulling van 'eisen' als bedoeld in artikel 11 van de Gaswet

As I wrote to the House last December in a letter on the organisation of supervision of housing corporations, I will in principle honour all CFV requests to use sanction powers.

Zoals ik de Kamer december jl. in een brief over de inrichting van het toezicht op corporaties heb geschreven, zal ik in beginsel alle verzoeken van het CFV tot het inzetten van sanctiebevoegdheden honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Tongeren, Paulus Jansen, Agnes Mulder en Ouwehand over het verstrekken van jodiumpillen in verband met het beperken van effecten van een nucleaire ramp

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, CDA and PvdD asked the Minister of Health whether Dutch households should receive iodine tablets in advance of a nuclear accident, given the Tsjernobyl and Fukushima experience with central storage. The minister said she is considering door-to-door distribution for some zones, will consult regional partners and the ministries involved, and admitted she does not know how long distribution takes or how many people could be reached.

In the coming months I want to work out, in consultation with the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice and the relevant regional partners, a proposal for effective and efficient distribution of iodine tablets.

De komende maanden wil ik in overleg met de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie en de betrokken regionale partners een voorstel uitwerken voor een effectieve en efficiënte distributie van jodiumtabletten.
