Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over ultrasone kattenverjagers

The MP asks whether ultrasonic cat repellers producing 10 kHz-plus tones at 140 dB may be sold and installed in the Netherlands, whether permits or limits apply, and whether the government will set maximum noise limits or ban them. The government replies that sale and installation are not prohibited or permit-required beyond municipal nuisance rules, that the devices fall under the Warenwetbesluit electronische producten, that NVWA measurements show no health risk under normal use, and that no new limits or ban will be set.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de oplossing van de EMV-knelpunten bij hoogspanningsnetten (Elektrisch Magnetisch Veld)

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the costs of undergrounding high-voltage lines and buying out homes under them can be socialised through network tariffs, and why the minister's position squares with a European Commission reply deferring to the national regulator. The minister answers that the position is unchanged, that the regulator ACM sets tariffs and shares the analysis, that the Commission's reply does not alter the view, and that the cost split with municipalities and the state will not be revised.
There is no difference between the European Commission's answer and my earlier answer during the debate.
Er zit geen licht tussen het antwoord van de Europese Commissie en mijn eerdere antwoord tijdens het debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de controle op kwartsstofemissies op bouwplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked how the Inspectorate SZW checks compliance with the quartz dust exposure limit on construction sites, including inspection frequency, filter and vacuum rules, and the value of real-time dust monitoring. The minister describes about 2,000 yearly site inspections with attention to hazardous substances, a six-week 2013 inspection campaign with 441 checks and 23 fines, reliance on general performance-based rules rather than equipment specifications, and rejects portable fine-dust meters as unsuited for quartz exposure assessment.

In doing so, the Inspectorate SZW checks, based on a visual inspection, whether the nature, extent and duration of quartz dust exposure has been assessed and whether the appropriate measures have been taken on the basis of that assessment.

Daarbij controleert de Inspectie SZW op basis van een visuele inspectie of de aard, mate en duur van de blootstelling aan kwartsstof is beoordeeld en of op basis van die beoordeling de juiste maatregelen zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Smaling over de fusie van woningcorporaties Ymere en De Woningbouw (Weesp)

MPs Jansen and Smaling asked the minister whether the merger of Ymere and De Woningbouw (Weesp) followed the 'nee-tenzij' principle, what alternatives and public-value tests were used, and whether merger benefits are monitored. The minister answered that the merger was approved on the basis of the 2002 merger criteria, that no separate public-value test or alternatives study is required, that monitoring of benefits is primarily the corporation's responsibility, and that he will strengthen merger rules through new legislation.
I also intend, through the Revision Act for approved housing institutions, to require that it be demonstrated that a merger is preferable to other forms of cooperation.

Ik ben bovendien voornemens via de Herzieningswet toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting te regelen dat aannemelijk gemaakt moet worden dat een fusie te prefereren is boven andere vormen van samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de rechtsbescherming van erfpachters

An SP MP asks the ministers whether they will change the law so leaseholders (erfpachters) can compel a reluctant ground lessor to amend contracts marked 'code rood', rather than having to sue, and whether they will act on NVB suggestions such as statutory protection, court review and AFM supervision. The minister maintains that the leaseholder must go to court, but says consultation with stakeholders on the evaluation of the banking guideline and possible steps will take place shortly.

This does not alter the fact that, as also indicated in the earlier answer of 7 February 2014, consultation with relevant parties will take place shortly to jointly consider which steps are conceivable based on the experiences gained.

Dit laat onverlet dat, zoals ook aangegeven in eerdergenoemde beantwoording van 7 februari 2014, op korte termijn overleg zal plaatsvinden met betrokken partijen om aan de hand van de opgedane ervaringen met elkaar te bezien welke stappen denkbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidreducerend asfalt

Two SP MPs asked the minister about quieter road surfaces: whether savings would fund noise relief for households above noise limits, whether wet-road noise and aging effects are modelled, and the design and reporting of trial programmes. The minister answered that the new PERS surface is still in early development with cost-effectiveness under study until 2018, that noise models use annual averages without a wet-road correction judged not to underestimate exposure, and that results will be reported to parliament then.
Cost-effectiveness is one of the topics in the research now started.
Kosteneffectiviteit is een van de onderwerpen in het nu gestarte onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over grote tariefsverhogingen voor de gebonden klanten bij stadsverwarmingsnetten

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about sharp district heating tariff increases for bound customers from 1 January 2014, whether the Warmtewet allows extra connection charges, whether the ACM can test reasonableness, and whether excessive increases can be reversed. Minister Kamp answers that the tariffs follow the NMDA principle and a price cap, that rising bills are the result of the new system, that the ACM can handle complaints, and that the ministry will not add a separate reasonableness test but will monitor costs.
I therefore do not intend to introduce a form of tariff review other than the maximum price based on the NMDA principle.
Ik ben dus niet voornemens een andere vorm van toetsing op de tarieven in te voeren dan de maximumprijs gebaseerd op het NMDA-principe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de bedreiging van complexen monumentale arbeiderswoningen door de verhuurdersheffing

An SP MP asked whether the rental levy (verhuurdersheffing) threatens non-profit landlords of monumental social-rental housing, and whether the government will exempt them or evaluate the levy's impact. The minister answered that the levy is general, sees no grounds for distinguishing these landlords, notes rent increases and harmonisation are available, and promised a fundamental evaluation by early 2016.
Both in the debate in the Senate and in the House of Representatives I indicated that I would report on the effects of the rental levy.
Zowel in het debat in de Eerste als in de Tweede Kamer heb ik aangegeven verslag te doen van de effecten van de verhuurderheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de toepassing van de Warmtewet bij complexen met blokverwarming

MP Paulus Jansen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the application of the Warmtewet to apartment complexes with block heating, including whether the law is clear on 17 points, whether guidance will be improved, whether ACM has the expertise and has tested tariffs, and whether heat efficiency can be linked to the Energy Agreement. The minister answered that the terms in the article are outdated, that the law protects consumers regardless of heat source, that ACM handles complaints (three pending), that a heat vision will follow, and that efficiency is not a goal of the law.
I will send the vision to the House of Representatives around the summer.
Ik zal de visie rond de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over het project «modernisering zuiveringsheffing

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked about industrial firms leaving public wastewater treatment, the scope and composition of the 'modernisering zuiveringsheffing' project, and monitoring and transparency of private treatment plants. Minister Schultz answered most questions on substance, citing ongoing study by Royal Haskoning DHV, while declining to change self-regulation or the household cost allocation, which she said falls outside the project.
The research is being carried out on behalf of IenM by Royal Haskoning DHV.
Het onderzoek wordt in opdracht van IenM uitgevoerd door Royal Haskoning DHV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vastrecht bij productie- en leveringsbedrijven van energie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether fixed energy-supply charges are reasonable, whether they differ across providers, and whether their rise is justified given lower costs for billing and customer service. The minister answered that ACM supervises tariffs as a whole under a benchmark model it does not publish in detail, that fixed charges vary between providers, that providers may choose which costs to put under the fixed charge, and that fixed charges make up only about 6% of an average household bill.

ACM does not provide detailed information about this assessment model and the criteria it uses, because a public model would allow a maximum tariff to be derived that could act as a market reference price.
Over dit beoordelingsmodel en de criteria die daarin worden gebruikt verstrekt ACM geen gedetailleerde informatie, omdat uit een openbaar beoordelingsmodel een maximumtarief is af te leiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over munitiestortplaats Engelsmanplaat (Waddenzee)

Two MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a WWII munitions dump near the Engelsmanplaat in the Wadden Sea, including whether it is monitored and who is responsible. The government answered that the dump lies under about 10 metres of sand, is covered by regular Rijkswaterstaat bed and water-quality surveys, and that the Ministry of Defence's EOD handles explosives clearance.
Rijkswaterstaat includes this area in the regular six-yearly depth measurements of the Wadden Sea region.
Rijkswaterstaat neemt dit gebied in het kader van de reguliere 6-jaarlijkse dieptemetingen van het Waddenzeegebied mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir over de bediening van station Utrecht Lunetten

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why NS sprinter stops at Utrecht Lunetten are halved from December 2013 and whether alternatives were explored. The Secretary of State answered that ProRail's stricter planning norms, after the Amsterdam Singelgracht collision, force the cut for westbound trains until infrastructure is adapted by end 2015, that alternatives were explored with operators, and that he urged ProRail and NS to reduce the hindrance.
I have urged ProRail and NS to jointly inform travellers as well as possible and in good time about travel options.
Ik heb er bij ProRail en NS op aangedrongen om samen de reizigers zo goed mogelijk en tijdig te informeren over de reismogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vastrecht bij de productie- en leverings-bedrijven van energie

Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why energy suppliers charge fixed monthly fees (vastrecht) that cover overhead, whether these fees have risen faster than energy prices and mislead consumers, whether the ACM supervises them, and whether suppliers should instead recover overhead through the variable price. The minister replied that fixed charges are a legitimate element of a free market, that the ACM monitors total tariffs and sees no problem, that he will ask the ACM for a fixed-charge overview, and that he sees no need for further study or a mandate to shift overhead into variable prices.
I see no problem in the way fixed charges are billed.
Ik zie geen probleem in de wijze waarop vastrecht in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de externe en interne veiligheid van windturbines

An MP asked the government about the safety of wind turbines after the storm of 28 October 2013 and a fatal accident at Ooltgensplaat, including damage overviews, applicable safety and occupational health rules, and inspection practice. The minister answered that no national damage overview exists, that existing Arbo and Warenwet rules apply, that the Inspectie SZW is investigating the Ooltgensplaat accident and may adjust rules, and that inspections occur only in response to signals.
The Inspectie SZW investigation will determine whether the applicable provisions of the Working Conditions Act and the Consumer Goods Act have been adequately complied with.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW zal uitwijzen of de van toepassing zijnde voorschriften van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet en Warenwet adequaat zijn nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over een lagere watertemperatuur bij drinkwaterinstallaties, in relatie tot energiebesparing bij gebouwverwarming en warmtapwaterbereiding

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked whether warm tap water may be set at 50 degrees where certified copper-silver ionisation systems are installed, and whether lower temperatures could enable energy savings from waste heat and solar heat. The minister answered that such lower temperatures are permitted only via pilots under expert supervision and strict legal restrictions, and that the potential savings are limited to specific situations.

If the results are satisfactory, agreement can be given from a public health perspective to lowering the hot tap water temperature and/or flushing frequency at all locations where the system concerned is installed.

Indien de resultaten bevredigend zijn, kan uit oogpunt van de volksgezondheid akkoord worden gegaan met verlaging van de warm tapwatertemperatuur en/of spoelfrequentie op alle locaties waar het betreffende systeem is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sluiting van spoorwegovergangen tussen station Heemstede-Aerdenhout en Hillegom met een aanmerkelijk recreatief belang

MPs Dik-Faber and Paulus Jansen asked whether the level crossings at Laantje van Alverna and Laantje van Leyduin, which have recreational value, may be closed, and why ProRail's procedure and risk analysis were not followed. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the crossings are public and recreational, stated that a closure agreement with the right-holders for Laantje van Alverna has been reached, and said no decision has yet been taken on Laantje van Leyduin.
However, the policy is equally aimed at preventing that a change in the traffic function of existing crossings worsens crossing safety.
Het beleid is er echter evenzeer op gericht om te voorkomen dat door een wijziging van de verkeersfunctie van bestaande overwegen de overwegveiligheid verslechtert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over woningcorporaties die nog steeds met anti-kraakcontracten werken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether housing corporation Woonstad's use of anti-squatting (anti-kraak) occupancy agreements for residents of a block in Rotterdam conflicts with a parliamentary motion requiring only temporary contracts under the Leegstandwet, and asked how many corporations use such agreements and whether the minister would end the practice. The minister replied that Woonstad is extending tenancies where legally possible before demolition, that the practice cannot in all cases be avoided according to Aedes, and that he will not take measures to definitively end anti-kraak contracts, while committing to report on the scope of temporary letting as the motion requested.
I am not aware of this information.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het fonds voor duurzame energie, gekoppeld aan de levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele

The SP MP Paulus Jansen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the EUR 100 million additional innovation investments by Essent and Delta, the SET sustainable energy fund, and how parliament can oversee compliance with the Borssele nuclear plant covenant. The minister answered that most approved projects are in progress, the 2014 deadline will be extended by five years, project details are confidential, and biennial reporting to parliament will follow.
Individual projects are not reported on due to commercial confidentiality.
Over individuele projecten wordt vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet gerapporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Unbundling Act (Wet onafhankelijk netbeheer) has delivered its benefits, whether the government will commission an independent evaluation, and about investment, employment and monitoring of integrated grid operators. The minister declined to assess the Act's effects while the Supreme Court appeal on the Court of Appeal's ruling is pending, and gave limited data on investment, quality and employment while noting that ACM has no complaints about cross-subsidy.
I do not consider it prudent to make further statements about the Won at this time.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig om op dit moment verdere uitspraken te doen over de Won.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vragen van inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging door verhuurders met minder dan 10 woningen

An SP MP asked whether landlords with fewer than 10 homes, exempt from the landlord levy, may request income-dependent rent increases and whether this is consistent with the law's purpose. The minister answered that all regulated landlords may propose such increases regardless of size, and that the government sees no reason to change the rules.
All landlords who rent out regulated homes may propose an income-dependent rent increase to the tenants of those homes.
Alle verhuurders die woningen gereguleerd verhuren mogen aan de huurders van die woningen een inkomensafhankelijke huurverhoging voorstellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, De Rouwe en Hoogland inzake het meenemen van de fiets in de Fyra en de Thalys

Three MPs asked why bicycles cannot be carried on the Fyra trains between Rotterdam/Breda and Den Haag/Brussel and on the Thalys, despite suitable space, and how this fits EU rail passenger rules. The state secretary explained that high-speed line safety management excludes loose bicycle transport, that folding or dismantled bikes are allowed as hand luggage, and that adjustments to the safety system are being examined.
For the Intercity to Brussels and the domestic connections on the high-speed line, it is currently being examined whether there is a solution to allow loose bicycle transport.
Voor de Intercity naar Brussel en de binnenlandse verbindingen over de hogesnelheidslijn wordt momenteel onderzocht of er een oplossing is om los vervoer van fietsen mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de positionering van het toezicht op woningcorporaties in het licht van het WRR-advies “Toezien op publieke belangen”

The MP asks how the minister will apply the WRR advice on supervision to the housing corporation sector, whether bureaucratic cost reduction and a fit-and-proper test should be left to corporations, and how the supervisor's style, instruments, personnel and budget will be set. The minister answers that the Woningwet revision will strengthen supervision and that a fit-and-proper test will be anchored in public law, but defers detailed choices on supervisory style, personnel and budget to later, promising to keep parliament informed.
I consider it too early to go into detail now on how the new supervisor will operate and how its personnel policy will take shape.
Ik acht het nog te vroeg om nu al in detail in te gaan op de wijze waarop de nieuwe toezichthouder zal gaan opereren en hoe het personeelsbeleid vorm gaat krijgen.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over herrie van politiehelicopters(ingezonden 5 juli 2013).

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the legal rules for deploying police helicopters and whether night-time and urban use causing noise nuisance should be restricted to acute safety risks, quieter equipment, or flight instructions. The government replied that legal rules exist under the Police Act and aviation law, that deployments are tested for proportionality, subsidiarity and priority including nuisance, and that deployment is limited to lifesaving, complex arrests and high-impact crime, without committing to new restrictions.
Deployments are tested against the requirements of proportionality, subsidiarity and priority.
De inzetten worden getoetst aan de eisen van proportionaliteit, subsidiariteit en prioriteit.
Vragen van het lid PaulusJansen (SP) aan de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over de huurprijzen van studentenkamers (ingezonden 22 juli 2013).

An SP MP asked the housing minister about a Savills-based report showing rising and very high rents for student rooms, including whether the rent protection for rooms is meaningful. The minister said no reliable research confirms the figures, declined to state a per-square-metre price, and pointed to the existing rent-review route and the national student housing action plan.
Due to the lack of valid and reliable research on rents for student rooms and their development (see also answer 2), there is no insight into the level and development of the price per square metre.

Vanwege het ontbreken van valide en betrouwbaar onderzoek over huurprijzen voor studentenkamers en de ontwikkeling daarvan (zie ook antwoord 2), is er geen inzicht in de hoogte en ontwikkeling van de vierkante meterprijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de schadeafhandeling na aardbevingen ten gevolge van gaswinning

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the slow handling of damage claims after the Groningen earthquakes caused by gas extraction, including the share of claims assessed, agreed deadlines with NAM, and counter-expertise requests. The minister reports that about 35% of claims had completed assessment reports by early August 2013, explains the capacity problems, states an aim of assessment within three months without firm guarantees, and gives the counter-expertise figures.

I have had the damage settlement process reviewed by the Technical Committee on Soil Movement (Tcbb), and I have also appointed an independent Ombudsman where citizens can take their complaints and concerns.

aan uw Kamer heb aangegeven, heb ik het proces van schadeafhandeling laten toetsen door de Technische Commissie Bodembeweging (Tcbb) en daarnaast heb ik een afhankelijke Raadsman ingesteld, waar burgers terecht kunnen met hun klachten en zorgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting bij waarborgfondsen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether corporate tax now applies to former tax-exempt guarantee funds, when it started, whether any minister was consulted, the state's backstop exposure, and the effects on housing corporations' investment and VAT. The State Secretary declined to give fund-specific tax positions citing article 67 AWR, stated no change in the tax authority's position occurred, and said the requested effect studies were not carried out and would add nothing.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) does not allow me to provide information on the tax positions of individual guarantee funds.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) staat mij niet toe informatie te verstrekken over de belastingposities van individuele waarborgfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de mogelijke verkoop van NUON door Vattenfall

The MP asks whether the government sees NUON as strategically important for energy supply and the Energy Agreement, and whether it will examine a state stake in or full takeover of NUON. The minister answers that NUON is an important supplier, that the government will not take a stake because the market is liberalised and supervised by the ACM, and that Vattenfall's search for an investment partner is a normal market matter.
State participation in Nuon is not an issue.
Deelname van het Rijk in Nuon is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over extreme stookkosten in het Hilwiscomplex in Amsterdam

An MP asks the minister about extreme heating costs for tenants of the Hilwiscomplex in Amsterdam, including whether tenants can contest the costs, whether they can force installation of efficient boilers, and whether the rules on tenant-installed facilities should change. The minister answers that the Huurcommissie and courts can review costs, that tenants can enforce energy-saving measures via civil law, that existing rules already provide compensation, and that he will not reintroduce the withdrawn bill.
For rent-regulated dwellings, tenants can have the advance payment and the settlement of service costs reviewed by the Huurcommissie.
Bij huurwoningen met een gereguleerde huurprijs kunnen huurders het voorschot op en de afrekening van de servicekosten door de huurcommissie laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over onderwijs in conflictlanden

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the lack of schooling for children in conflict countries, the low share of emergency aid going to education, and Dutch contributions to education in conflict settings. Minister Ploumen answered that education is part of broader aid, outlined Dutch programmes (PBEA, Balochistan, GPE, NICHE) and said the BIV budget does not target education as such.
As a result, it is not possible to determine precisely what percentage of Dutch humanitarian aid goes to education.
Daardoor is echter niet goed te bepalen welk percentage van de Nederlandse humanitaire hulp naar onderwijs gaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over het opschorten van toeslagen en hypotheekrenteaftrek

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked why childcare and other allowances were withheld without prior notice during an investigation of entitlement, how many people were affected, and how the burden of proof and reimbursement timing were handled. State Secretary Weekers answered that a processing error blocked payments to 1411 allowance recipients and 518 tax refunds, which were then paid late, with about 750 cases paid twice, and described the balie and letter procedure for verifying entitlement.
Immediately after the error was discovered, the allowances and income tax refunds were paid after all (by the first week of July at the latest).
Direct nadat de fout is ontdekt zijn de toeslagen en de terugbetalingen inkomstenbelasting alsnog uitbetaald (uiterlijk in de eerste week van juli).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over asbestsanering in Emmen

MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked the government about asbestos remediation at the Visserhoek flat in Emmen, including whether the housing corporation, contractor, inspection body and municipality acted improperly. The state secretary answered that certified firms did the work, that no legal violation was found by the Inspectie SZW, that municipal supervision lies with the provinces, and that the wider sector is responsible for safe work.
Interadministrative supervision of municipalities is vested in the provinces under the Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht.
Het interbestuurlijk toezicht op gemeenten is middels de Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht neergelegd bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, Hoogland en De Rouwe over aanleg en beheer van wandel- en fietsroutes

MPs asked about the state of national walking and cycling route networks, their financing after central funding ended, obstruction by waterboards and infrastructure, and planning protection. The government replied that responsibility for these networks now rests with the regions, that it will not intervene, and that it will not add new reporting obligations.
With the signing of the Nature Governance Agreement, care for the national route networks is the responsibility of the regions (mainly provinces, municipalities and recreation boards).
Met de ondertekening van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur is de zorg voor de Landelijke Routenetwerken de verantwoordelijkheid van de regio (met name provincies, gemeenten en recreatieschappen).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de gevolgen van de auto van de zaak voor het autogebruik

MPs Bashir and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers whether they endorse Van Ommeren's analysis that the company car tax regime causes large economic losses through extra car travel, parking and vehicle choice. State Secretary Weekers rejected the analysis and its conclusions, arguing the evidence for the claimed effects is weak and that existing tax burdens and employer incentives already address these issues.
No, I endorse neither the main lines of the analysis nor all of the conclusions.
Nee, ik onderschrijf noch de hoofdlijnen van de analyse noch alle conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over particuliere erfpacht

An MP asks the ministers of Housing and Justice about private leasehold (particuliere erfpacht): how many homes have been refused mortgages under the bank guideline, whether the guideline should be made generally binding, and what has been done on advertisement transparency. The minister says no precise figures are held, rejects a general binding declaration or an Erfpacht Act, and points to existing contract-law protections and voluntary measures.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de fiscale regeling voor hypotheekrenteaftrek

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether homeowners who already enjoyed mortgage interest deduction on a previous home can only get deduction on a new loan if its term is shortened, and how the rules work in such cases. The State Secretary explained the transitional and new rules, said the shortened-term outcome is undesirable, and announced a policy decision allowing a 360-month repayment period with the deduction period shortened by the earlier period.
Pending legislation, I will shortly approve in a policy decision that in cases like this one, the new home loan may be repaid over 360 months.
Vooruitlopend op wetgeving zal ik op korte termijn in een beleidsbesluit goedkeuren dat in gevallen als het onderhavige, de nieuwe eigenwoningschuld in 360 maanden mag worden afgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Monasch over de naleving van de Woningwet en de Wet op het overleg

MPs Jansen and Monasch asked whether a housing corporation may restrict the statutory right of tenants' organisations to make binding nominations for supervisory board seats, the board size and tenure rules, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that corporations cannot deviate from the mandatory two binding nominations, that the supervisory board may refuse a nominee who does not fit the profile, and that the Herzieningswet will entrench tenant rights, but that no ministerial intervention is currently warranted, only a call on the parties to act.
The corporation cannot include deviating provisions on this point in its statutes, because otherwise the minister for Housing and Government Service would not approve the amendment to the statutes.
De corporatie kan geen afwijkende bepalingen op dit punt opnemen in de statuten, omdat anders door de minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienstgeen goedkeuring voor de statutenwijziging wordt verleend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de mogelijke verkoop van URENCO

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands intends to sell its URENCO shares, whether the promised legal and financial investigation is complete, and how public interests such as non-proliferation and safety would be safeguarded after a sale. The minister confirmed the intention to sell in response to the UK and German private shareholders wishing to exit, said the public interests must be effectively secured first, and that the exact arrangements are still under discussion with the UK, Germany and the German shareholders.
The cabinet has – as a result of the wish of the United Kingdom and the German shareholders E.on and RWE to sell their URENCO shares – the intention to also divest the Dutch shares.

Het kabinet heeft – als gevolg van de wens van het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de Duitse aandeelhouders E.on en RWE om de aandelen in URENCO te verkopen – het voornemen om ook de Nederlandse aandelen te vervreemden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Paulus Jansen over een belastingaanslag over wateronttrekking ten behoeve van een installatie voor warmte-koudeopslag

MPs Van Tongeren and Paulus Jansen asked whether a heat-cold storage (WKO) installation that extracts and reinjects groundwater was liable for groundwater tax under the Wbm, and why nine-year-old residents in Etten-Leur received an assessment. The State Secretary answered that the exemption required a permit, closed-loop reinjection into the same aquifer, and compliance with permit conditions, that the tax was abolished from 1 January 2012, and that he had no indication the inspector misinterpreted the law, citing tax confidentiality for concrete cases.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation, I cannot provide information on concrete cases.
In verband met de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik over concrete gevallen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het vaststellen van de borgings- en investeringsruimte voor woningcorporaties door WSW en CFV

An SP MP asked the minister for Housing whether delayed decisions by the WSW guarantee fund on housing corporations' guarantee and investment room, due to capacity shortages and the Hoekstra advisory work, would block corporation investments and the 6% VAT maintenance rate. The minister answered that the 2013 guarantee volume is known, the WSW has set up a process to give corporations timely clarity on 2014 volumes, and corporations can make optimal use of the VAT reduction.
As the answers show, the 2013 guarantee volume is already known, and the WSW has organised the process so that the 2014 guarantee volume will also be known in time.
Zoals uit de antwoorden blijkt is het borgingsvolume 2013 al bekend en is door het WSW het proces zo ingericht, dat ook tijdig het borgingsvolume voor 2014 bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over gebreken bij het verstrekken van inkomensgegevens door de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asked the ministers about a glitch on 11 April 2013 in the Tax Authority system that gave landlords income data for income-dependent rent increases, plus remedies, error rates, damages claims and administrative burden. The minister answered that the glitch was fixed within a day, that landlords were advised to re-request data, that five landlords have made liability claims, and that some figures cannot be provided for privacy or data reasons while a fuller update will follow after the summer recess.
For reasons of privacy, only the information necessary for this purpose is generated.
Om redenen van privacy wordt alleen de hiervoor noodzakelijke informatie gegenereerd.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het liberaliseren van huurwoningen uit het gereguleerde segment

An SP MP asked minister Blok about liberalising about one million regulated rental homes, their composition, what counts as high quality, where households with children and disabled people would live, and what the 'iron stock' of family and accessible homes should be. The minister answered that about 72% are family homes and 23% single-storey homes, that corporations decide which homes to liberalise, that no fixed occupancy norm beyond the Bouwbesluit applies, and that WoON2012 shows sufficient family and accessible rental stock.
It is up to the housing corporation to make targeted choices here, also with regard to local and/or regional housing demand.
Het is aan de corporatie om hierin gerichte keuzes te maken, ook met het oog op de lokale en/of regionale woningvraag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de hardheidsclausule voor chronisch zieken en gehandicapten bij de inkomensafhankelijke huurverhogingen

An SP MP asks why the promised hardship clause for chronically ill and disabled tenants against income-dependent rent increases was not yet clarified, when rent notices were due within three weeks, and on what date the ministerial regulation would be published. The minister replies that the regulation was sent to parliament on 25 April 2013, published on 29 April and in force from 1 May, defines the eligible group, places costs on tenants and landlords, and relies on public information to make the objection route known.
I sent the regulation to your House on 25 April 2013.
Ik heb uw Kamer de regeling op 25 april 2013 toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de onderhoudsstop van de kerncentrale Borssele

An SP MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the timing of the maintenance outage at the Borssele nuclear plant, whether the whole reactor vessel is inspected given its age, the inspection technique used, and whether the outage is long enough for a full scan. The minister answered that the outage runs from 12 April to about 17 May 2013, that the vessel is inspected ultrasonically under an expanded programme, and that the regulator will extend the inspection if the results warrant it.
Should the outcomes of the measurements give reason for it, the investigation will be extended.
Mochten de uitkomsten van de metingen daartoe aanleiding geven wordt het onderzoek uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over kredietverstrekking aan en bankgaranties voor bouwbedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Housing about bank collateral demands and guarantees for construction firms after a reported credit stop by ING threatened a bankruptcy. The minister answered that DNB lacks firm-specific collateral data, that collateral rules follow from capital requirements, and that disputes are left to contracting parties.
There is no specific insight into whether construction firms are asked for more or less collateral than other firms.
Er is geen specifiek inzicht in de mate waarin van bouwbedrijven meer of minder onderpand dan van andere bedrijven wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar woningcorporatie Woonbron

An SP MP asks the minister for Housing about a planned investigation into the financial problems at housing corporation Woonbron, including delays, the unprofitable SS Rotterdam project, and whether the regulator should have acted on suspected disguised subsidies. The minister answers that Woonbron will be asked to investigate recoverable damage after the ship is sold, that the regulator detected no disguised subsidy, and that the regulator's oversight of group affiliations is limited to financial exposure.
I have asked Woonbron to carry out such an investigation as soon as the SS Rotterdam has been sold.
Ik heb Woonbron verzocht een dergelijk onderzoek te laten verrichten, zodra de ss Rotterdam verkocht is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het realiteitsgehalte van het bestuursakkoord IPO/Rijk over 6.000 megawatt wind op land

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether the provincial site realty check for 6,000 MW onshore wind had been completed, what the provinces' guarantee in the 2013 administrative accord means, and what happens if sites are annulled by courts. Minister Kamp answered that the Bosch en Van Rijn report was finished, found the IPO bid fell short, and that extra agreements now require provinces to guarantee 6,000 MW with monitoring but no legal sanctions.
The report was completed on 22 March 2013. You will find the report attached to the answer.
Het rapport is op 22 maart 2013 afgerond. U treft het rapport als bijlage bij de beantwoording aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over de stijgende kosten van een aansluitovereenkomst brandbeveiligingsinstallaties

Two SP MPs asked why the fee for a fire alarm connection agreement in Noord-Holland Noord rose sharply and whether businesses are unfairly burdened as the regional safety board compensates lost income. The minister replied that the safety board, as the responsible authority, chose the tariff increase and that the matter is a local responsibility, while offering to take no action beyond noting the board's role.
The decision to compensate the shortfall from falling OMS subscriber numbers by raising the OMS tariff from 1 January 2013 was taken by the daily board of the safety region.

Het besluit om het tekort door de daling in de aantallen OMS-abonnees te compenseren door een verhoging van het OMS-tarief per 1 januari 2013 is genomen door het dagelijks bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de effecten van het woningmarktakkoord voor de noordelijke woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the housing minister whether he accepts that the housing-market agreement would cut northern housing corporations' investment capacity by 52% for 2013-2018, versus 14% under the Rutte II coalition agreement, and how he will prevent a dramatic drop. The minister disputes the model's assumed rent-setting basis, points to ABF research showing a manageable temporary mismatch between rent revenue and the levy, and says no dramatic investment drop need occur.
The recalculations of the Housing Agreement's arrangements show that for the corporations in the northern provinces there need not be a dramatic drop in investment levels.

Uit de doorrekeningen van de afspraken uit het Woonakkoord blijkt dat voor de corporaties in de Noordelijke provincies geldt dat er geen sprake hoeft te zijn van een dramatische terugval in het investeringsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het over de nieuwe financieringsconstructe voor koopwoningen uit het woonakkoord

An SP MP asked the minister about the new two-part mortgage (annuity loan plus a second loan financing part of the repayments) under the housing accord, covering notary costs, bank interest, tax treatment, risks on forced sale, cooperative ownership and rental alternatives. The minister answered that the government gives advance clarity on tax consequences but does not intervene in bank product design, that risk suitability is left to lenders and the AFM, and that the government sees no case for cooperative or rental-based reform.
In line with the answer to question 2, it is not appropriate to seek contact with banks or other financial institutions to establish whether there is interest in offering a second loan.
In lijn met het antwoord op vraag 2 ligt het niet in de rede contact te zoeken met banken of andere financiële instellingen om na te gaan in hoeverre er interesse bestaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Smits en Paulus Jansen inzake het bericht dat het aantal lesuren techniek op 40% van de scholen daalt

MPs Smits and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary for Education whether the reported decline in technology lesson hours at 40% of schools is confirmed, and what causes and actions follow. The state secretary said the department has no data on technology lesson hours, that schools have freedom in timetabling, and pointed to the Techniekpact, primary-school initiatives and new vmbo programmes, rejecting making technology a mandatory subject.
So I do not know whether the number of technology lesson hours is actually declining.
Ik weet dus niet of het aantal lesuren techniek daadwerkelijk daalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak over de aankoop door de Rijksgebouwendienst van een kantoorpand in Den Haag

SP MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Raak asked why the Rijksgebouwendienst bought an office building in The Hague near the Eurojust site, questioning the fit with the vacant-office convenant and whether vacant state property could have been used, and asked for an overview of state-owned offices. The minister confirmed the purchase for €7.9 million as part of arrangements for a possible future Eurojust expansion, said it does not conflict with the convenant, and promised an overview plus a forthcoming joint plan with the municipality.

With the purchase of the building, effect is given to the agreements between the Dutch State and Eurojust to make a possible future expansion of Eurojust feasible in the immediate vicinity of the new building.

Met de aankoop van het pand wordt invulling gegeven aan de afspraken tussen de Nederlandse Staat en Eurojust om een mogelijke uitbreiding van Eurojust in de toekomst mogelijk te maken in de directe nabijheid van de nieuwbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over energielabels en energiebesparing

An MP asked the minister about energy label issuance, compliance with the EU EPBD directive, verification of label obligations, the rental sector energy savings covenant, and energy use in government buildings. The minister reported 33% of homes had a label at end-2012, admitted the label obligation at sale/rental is not checked, said the bill was rejected and a new proposal is planned, and promised further steps and research.
At present, the obligation to provide an energy label when renting or selling a home in 2012 is not checked.
Op dit moment wordt de verplichting om een energielabel te overleggen bij de verhuur c.q. de verkoop van een woning in 2012 niet gecontroleerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over geluidsoverlast van goederentreinen bij Borne

An SP MP asked the state secretary about noise from freight trains near Borne, including measurement discrepancies, publication of operator names, horn signals and the reliability of the noise register. The state secretary said the variation is real and that source measures are needed, but declined to publish operator names, denied the horn practice, and deferred conclusions on the discrepancies until a full-year measurement report.
A measurement period of only 4 months is in my view insufficient to base conclusions on; I am awaiting the definitive report.
Een meetperiode van slechts 4 maanden acht ik onvoldoende om conclusies op te baseren, ik wacht daarvoor de definitieve rapportage af.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over het verruimen van de overgangsperiode voor het omzetten van een bestaande aflossingsvrije hypotheek in een (bank)spaarhypotheek tot 1 april 2013

An SP MP asked how large the fiscal costs would be in 2013 and later if all homeowners with interest-only mortgages switched to savings mortgages before 1 April 2013, and what the basis and financing of the extended transition period was. The minister, on behalf of the state secretary of Finance, answered that the budgetary loss is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long run, assuming owners who chose interest-only mortgages deliberately chose not to save and few would now switch.
The budgetary loss resulting from the introduction of this transitional arrangement is expected to be nil in 2013 and in the long term.
De budgettaire derving als gevolg van de introductie van deze overgangsregeling, zal in 2013 en op lange termijn naar verwachting nihil zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidsoverlast langs de HSL-Zuid bij Breda

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether she endorsed a student report finding that noise standards along the HSL-Zuid near Breda are exceeded at several locations and that noise screens underperform. The state secretary rejected the conclusions as based on measurements not meeting Dutch rules and wrong legal assumptions, but committed to honour the tracébesluit noise limits and to decide on additional measures after pending TNO measurements and pilot effect studies.
Yes, I will of course keep my commitment.
Ja, ik zal mijn toezegging vanzelfsprekend nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de overstapcampagne van ConsuWijzer

An MP asked whether the ConsuWijzer 'switch energy supplier' campaign should encourage consumers to also compare the sustainability of energy supply, and whether the campaign would promote switching to green energy. The minister replied that ConsuWijzer is run by independent regulators who set their own campaigns, that no direct intervention is needed, and that the overstapcoach offers a practical switching guide while the EnergieWijzer lets consumers compare suppliers on service, contract types and green supply, leaving the weight given to sustainability to consumers.
I consider that a good thing, and direct intervention by me is therefore not appropriate.
Dat vind ik een goede zaak en directe interventie van mij acht ik dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de  frequentiestabiliteit in relatie tot een groeiend aandeel duurzame elektriciteit

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether existing European and national agreements on grid frequency stability remain adequate as renewable generation grows, and what strategies could address frequency swings, plus questions on coal versus gas dispatch and cost-effectiveness. The minister answered that existing arrangements are currently adequate, that frequency deviations are increasingly frequent but not yet endangering supply, and that the problem is being addressed through the European ENTSO-E network code process and monitoring by TenneT.
TenneT also indicates that the existing agreements with the other system operators in Europe for managing frequency stability are currently adequate.
TenneT geeft tevens aan dat de bestaande afspraken voor het beheren van de frequentiestabiliteit met de andere systeem netbeheerders in Europa op dit moment toereikend zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sloop van woningen in de Van der Pekbuurt in Amsterdam door woningcorporatie Ymere

MPs Karabulut and Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a housing corporation may demolish homes in the Van der Pek neighbourhood under the revised Building Decree, which requires only a notification, and whether demolition should halt while heritage protection as a townscape is being initiated. The minister answered that the demolition notification and permit concern nuisance and safety only, that protection of townscapes is the municipality's task, and that the cultural-historical concerns are being raised in consultation with the municipality and the corporation.
It is primarily the task of the municipality of Amsterdam to carefully weigh and protect the heritage values in Amsterdam.
Het is primair de taak van de gemeente Amsterdam om de erfgoedwaarden in Amsterdam zorgvuldig af te wegen en te beschermen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over de leegstand van woningen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about reported vacancy of 77,000 social rental homes and 110,000 private rental homes and what action would be taken. The Minister found the 3% social rental vacancy acceptable, attributed it mainly to normal turnover and market reasons, could not provide a breakdown or regional data, and saw no reason for action.
As indicated in answer 2, the vast majority of vacancy at housing corporations is not related to their policy but is caused by regular turnover vacancy and vacancy for market reasons.

Zoals bij vraag 2 aangegeven is het overgrote deel van de leegstand bij woningcorporaties niet gerelateerd aan het door hen gevoerde beleid, maar wordt deze veroorzaakt door reguliere mutatieleegstand en door leegstand om marktredenen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over bezoldiging van corporatiebestuurders en de algemene bedrijfslasten van woningcorporaties

Two SP MPs asked the minister about executive pay at housing corporations, the 2012 press-reported pay research, and a central public register of board and supervisory roles. The minister said pay disclosure is left to the sector code, a uniform reporting duty will follow under the WNT, nevenfuncties will be disclosed in annual reports, and no binding pay cap exists yet.
When the WNT is introduced a transitional regime will apply, through which remuneration will gradually be reduced to the applicable norms.
Bij invoering van de WNT gaat een overgangsrecht gelden, waarmee de beloningen geleidelijk naar de toepasselijke normen zullen worden teruggebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar de rechtsbescherming van woonbootbewoners

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about who will carry out the independent study on improving legal protection for houseboat residents, the study's research questions, whether residents should sit on the steering committee, and whether the study should be awaited before a pending rent-review procedure. The minister said the tender is not yet concluded and the client will be announced later, described the research questions and steering committee composition, declined to add a resident representative, and said the study will not judge the pending liggeld procedure.
I will inform you of who will carry out the study once the tender is concluded.
Ik zal u na afronding van de aanbesteding informeren wie het onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over gratis draadloos internet in de trein

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether NS would end free wifi on trains in 2013, whether past agreements with the state covered it, whether the minister would include it in a new concession, and whether a national standard is needed. The minister replied that the current contract ends in 2013 and NS aims to keep free wifi depending on the new contract, that a 15 million euro subsidy covered it, that the minister will consider it in the new concession without guaranteeing it, and that a national standard is not his responsibility.
I propose to make an integrated assessment once the picture is complete.
Ik stel me voor om als het beeld compleet is een integrale afweging te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over een incident met een lekkende wagon op station Oss

An SP MP asked the minister about a train carrying hazardous goods that caused a leak and disruption at Oss station, including its route, frequency of such incidents, false alarms, liability for damage, and whether procedures and preventive inspections should be tightened. The minister said the operator may choose its route, reported 35 leaks and four station evacuations since early 2011, stated liability rests with the infrastructure manager who can recover costs from the operator, and announced an ILT thematic inspection action while seeing no need to change reporting procedures.
No registration is kept of cases of false alarms.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van gevallen van loos alarm.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked whether the newly created RLI advisory council, which replaces the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, has adequate external safety expertise, whether former AGS members are included, and what budget and concrete plans exist. The minister answered that one member with external safety expertise was appointed, that no former AGS member was appointed formally but all will be invited as associated members, and that concrete programming is left to the next cabinet.
Because of the start of the Rli and the caretaker status of the cabinet, it was decided to leave the making of concrete agreements on programming for the coming years to the new cabinet.
Vanwege de start van de Rli en de demissionaire status van het kabinet is besloten om het maken van concrete afspraken over de programmering in de komende jaren over te laten aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked the minister what the three knowledge platforms (relEVant, the Kennisplatform Externe Veiligheid and the specialists' forum) did last year to replace the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, how often the Strategisch Kennisplatform met, and how the government justifies its claim that strategic knowledge cooperation is adequately safeguarded. The minister listed activities of relEVant and DORA, noted the SKP met in early 2011, and argued cooperation is sufficiently ensured given existing universities and institutes.
All things considered, I believe that cooperation in the area of strategic knowledge is sufficiently guaranteed.
Alles bij elkaar genomen, meen ik dat de samenwerking op het gebied van strategische kennis voldoende gewaarborgd is.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de toepassing van PUR-schuim bij de isolatie van begane grondvloeren

MPs Paulus Jansen and Ulenbelt asked about health complaints from PUR foam insulation under ground-floor slabs, inspection oversight, municipal building control, and isocyanate risks. The minister answered that inspectorates have no view of complaint scale, that private certification (BRL 1332) is considered sufficient without extra public checks, and that no evidence yet shows unacceptable risks, though further fire-safety research will be reported later.
To supplement this with random public inspection, I see no reason.
Voor aanvulling daarvan met steekproefsgewijze publieke controle zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over brandpreventie door middel van slimme gasmeters

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether a smart gas meter concept for gas leak detection and automatic shut-off, nominated for a fire safety innovation prize, could add fire safety, support rollout of smart meters, face legal barriers, and warrant a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the concept may contribute to fire safety, that building and gas law do not hinder it, that a cost-benefit analysis is not appropriate since the idea is at an early stage, and that network operators are willing to examine feasibility with the developer.
A cost-benefit analysis is not something I consider appropriate.
Een kosten batenanalyse acht ik niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over standaardisatie van software rond het Omgevingsloket

An SP MP asked the minister whether a single national database for enforcement data under environmental and spatial planning law, as proposed by the municipality of Delft, could cut ICT costs, improve transparency and be investigated further. The minister said the proposal will be considered alongside alternatives and reported on in early 2013, without committing to a statutory registry.
Alongside a central database, I will investigate alternatives, in line with the capabilities of the subnational governments and efficient in terms of management and maintenance.
Naast een centrale database zal ik alternatieven onderzoeken, aansluitend bij de mogelijkheden van de medeoverheden en efficiënt in termen van beheer en onderhoud.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de meldingsplicht voor asbestsanering

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether asbestos removal firms must make four separate notifications before work starts, whether the Arbeidsinspectie portal could auto-forward them, and why the Bouwbesluit notification should not be dropped as duplicative. State Secretary Atsma replied that there is no Wet milieubeheer notification, that two notification moments apply (four weeks before for the municipality, two days before for inspectorates and certifiers), that the portal forwards automatically, and that the Bouwbesluit notification will be kept.
There is no notification under the Wet milieubeheer, but before asbestos removal in buildings, a notification/communication must be made at two moments.
Er is geen melding op grond van de Wet milieubeheer, maar voorafgaand aan een asbestsanering in gebouwen, moet op twee momenten een melding/mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over een lijst van 200 gebouwen waarin op grote schaal spuitasbest is verwerkt

An MP asked the state secretary about a 1997 Labour Inspectorate report finding sprayed asbestos in 200 buildings, and whether the follow-up measures were carried out and whether a list of current buildings with public functions could be provided. The state secretary answered that the measures were implemented by 2001, that asbestos policy now places responsibility on owners, and that no inventory exists so the requested list cannot be provided, though schools suspected of asbestos can be viewed online.
No inventory of asbestos in buildings outside demolition situations has been carried out, so the requested list cannot be provided.
Er is niet overgegaan tot (al dan niet verplichte) inventarisatie van asbest in gebouwen in niet-sloopsituaties zodat de gevraagde lijst niet kan worden overgelegd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over Van Gansewinkel en private equity

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the financial situation of Van Gansewinkel Group under private equity ownership, whether he had been misled about its equity, its waste-processing quality, layoffs and whether he would intervene. The state secretary answered that the company says its finances are stable, found no grounds to say he was misled, relies on existing waste law and the national waste plan rather than ownership, and sees no need to mediate, while offering to talk with the company.
In light of this information, I cannot conclude that the company misled me earlier.
Gelet op deze informatie kan ik niet de conclusie trekken dat ik eerder door het bedrijf ben misleid.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de reële en politieke planning voor de Omgevingswet

An SP MP asks the minister why she does not accept the civil servant's view that the political timetable for the Omgevingswet is not realistic and that 2018 is a more plausible start date, and whether she knew of this when informing parliament on 9 March 2012. The minister answers that the timetable remains ambitious but feasible, that the entry-into-force date is not yet fixed pending the Invoeringswet and implementing rules, and that she informed parliament as fully as possible at the time.
I am then, as Minister, responsible for informing parliament fully and correctly, both orally and in writing.
Ik ben vervolgens als Minister verantwoordelijk om het parlement volledig en juist te informeren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en van Bommel over de zaak Van Bilderbeek

MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister whether she endorses the account in the book 'De Olievlek' about the Van Bilderbeek case in Colombia, and what the government did to assist the brothers humanitarian, diplomatically and legally, why the passport took so long, and for an update on actions since 2008. The minister declined to comment on the book beyond matters within her own remit, detailed consular, diplomatic and legal steps, explained the passport refusal under past policy and the court-ordered issuance in January 2011, and gave an update.
I can only give a judgment on matters that concern me.
Ik kan slechts een oordeel geven over zaken die mij regarderen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Jasper van Dijk, Peters over een volgende aanslag op het rijksmonument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop

Three MPs (Jansen, Van Dijk and Peters) asked whether the foundation Meru had again applied for demolition of the national monument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop, whether the municipality of Roerdalen had enforced repair, and whether the instruments were adequate. The state secretary confirmed the new permit application and said the municipality has used enforcement (an order under penalty, upheld by the Raad van State, with a deadline of 21 September 2012), that the minister has no power to force repair, and that no change in procedures is needed.
I have no legal means to enforce restoration.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om herstel af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de politieke en reële planning voor de Omgegevingswet

An SP MP asked the minister whether she agreed that the political timetable for the Omgevingswet (environment act) was not the realistic one, and whether she had known of the civil servant's realistic planning before informing parliament. The minister denied the conclusion, said no distinction exists between political and realistic planning, and refused to send a separate list of other legislative projects with diverging timetables.
There is no distinction between political and realistic planning, so I cannot answer the question.
Er bestaat geen onderscheid tussen politieke en reële planning, waardoor ik niet aan de vraag kan voldoen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Paulus Jansen over de fiscale behandeling van waterwoningen

MPs Bashir and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Supreme Court ruling on floating houses (waterwoningen) affects transfer tax, mortgage interest relief, the eigenwoningforfait, municipal property tax and box 3 wealth tax, with worked examples, numbers and a plan to remove the unequal treatment. The State Secretary answered that floating homes classed as movable goods fall outside transfer tax and box 3 while the ruling leaves the owner-occupier rules intact, that the number and revenue effect are highly uncertain (a few hundred homes, a few million euros a year), and that he will examine options to remove the difference, reporting by the Belastingplan 2013.
I am not prepared to accept this difference in advance.
Ik ben niet bereid dit verschil op voorhand te accepteren.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de veroordeling van twee directeuren van Eternit in Italië

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice whether he knew of the Italian conviction of two Eternit directors for asbestos deaths, how many deaths in the Netherlands are known, and whether a criminal investigation would follow in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed the conviction, said he has no data on deaths but referred to a letter and an asbestos victims institute report, and said the Public Prosecution Service decides on investigations and has no case known against Eternit.
The Public Prosecution Service determines in which cases there is reason to start a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie bepaalt in welke gevallen er aanleiding is een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over energiebesparing door innovatieve automatische zonwering

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a TNO report on energy savings from automated exterior blinds (HR-zonwering) was accepted, whether such blinds are included in the energy label calculation and the Energie Investerings Aftrek, and how innovation could be promoted. The government agreed with the report, said blinds are already in the calculation for non-residential buildings but not yet for homes, and explained the two routes to EIA for non-residential buildings, while declining to pick specific technical innovation and pointing to general energy-quality incentives.
For non-residential buildings, HR blinds are already included in the standard calculation method and software for the EPC and energy label, for homes not yet, but I will promote this.
Voor utiliteitsgebouwen is HR-zonwering al opgenomen in de standaardberekeningsmethode en -software voor de EPC en het energielabel, voor woningen nog niet, maar ik zal dit bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over Besluit uitvoering Crisis en herstelwet

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether the Almere exemption in the Crisis and Recovery Act implementing decree (art. 6e) applies only to new build and how it affects existing homes, resale and renovation. The minister answered that the exemption covers only listed new-build rules, existing homes must meet existing-building rules, and renovations must reach the acquired-rights level and the existing-building standards.
The articles containing the existing-building requirements are not mentioned in the decree and are therefore excluded from the experiment.
De artikelen waarin de voorschriften voor bestaande bouw zijn opgenomen worden niet genoemd in het besluit en zijn derhalve uitgesloten van het experiment.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het bedrijf Odfjell

An MP asked the government about benzene emission peaks at Odfjell, the status of a criminal investigation into incident reporting, the action plan, and protection of whistleblowers. The government answered that the emission source and criminal investigation scope are for the relevant bodies, that enforcement pressure is being applied through joint inspections, and that no legal obligation exists to protect whistleblowers.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to determine the scope of the criminal investigation.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om de reikwijdte van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de naleving van de Regeling afsluiten elektriciteit en gas van kleinverbruikers

An SP MP asked the energy minister whether network operators and suppliers must report disconnection figures, why Liander's disconnection trend differs from Enexis and Stedin, whether new suppliers disconnect faster for non-payment, and whether a quick dispute procedure exists for small consumers facing disconnection. The minister answered that reporting is not mandatory, explained the differences are hard to attribute, saw no evidence new suppliers act differently, and said no fast dispute procedure exists but a smart-meter flow limit could be considered.
No, network operators and suppliers are not obliged to report figures on disconnections or end of supply.
Nee, netbeheerders en leveranciers zijn niet verplicht om over aantallen afsluitingen, dan wel beëindiging van levering te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over malafide verhuurmakelaars

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they support a private certification mark for rental brokers, whether it should be made mandatory, and whether a national licensing requirement for rental brokers would help sanction malpractice. The minister supports voluntary quality measures but sees no reason to make a certificate mandatory, and rejects reinstating a state licensing requirement as it would conflict with the policy of a compact government; rental owners remain responsible for their own tenant selection and can hold brokers liable.
However, I see no reason to make a certificate mandatory, so that the certificate or one of the certificates becomes a establishment requirement for brokers.
Ik zie echter geen reden voor het verplicht stellen van een keurmerk, zodat het keurmerk of een van de keurmerken een vestigingsverplichting wordt voor makelaars.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken landbouw en Innovatie over het beheer van slimme meters (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister about who is responsible for smart meter data after a move, who supervises that party, what sanctions apply, how privacy oversight works, sample sizes, EDSN's role, and the status of an information code. The minister answered that the meter operator is responsible, that the Cbp (privacy) and NMa (energy regulator) share oversight and can impose sanctions, that the NMa monitors the rollout, and that the information code is planned for April 2013.
The Cbp supervises compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act.
Het Cbp houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Stort van Troost (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the Stort van Troost contaminated landfill in Dordrecht, including support for the municipality against Shell, when contamination spread became unacceptable, access to monitoring reports, and why remediation was delayed. The state secretary replies that soil remediation is fully decentralised to the municipality, which receives a budget and legal support funding, that monitoring reports are public, and that the Polder Stededijk redevelopment has stalled due to lost ecological funding.
Implementation of soil remediation policy is fully decentralised and in this matter the municipality of Dordrecht is the competent authority.
De uitvoering van het bodemsaneringsbeleid is volledig gedecentraliseerd en in deze kwestie is de gemeente Dordrecht bevoegd gezag.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over import van nieuwe auto’s die niet aan de emissienormen voldoen (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

MP Paulus Jansen asked whether Volkswagen importer Pon was importing new T2 camper vans as used vehicles to avoid EU emission standards, and whether this loophole should be closed. State Secretary Atsma denied the importer was involved, said the vehicle appears to meet Euro 4 rather than Euro 5, and explained that EU rules prevent member states from refusing registration of vehicles already approved elsewhere in the EU.
Registration in the Netherlands of a vehicle previously registered in another EU member state cannot be prevented.
Registratie in Nederland van een voertuig dat eerder een registratie heeft verkregen in een andere lidstaat van de EU kan niet worden tegengehouden
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over transport van uraniumhexafluoride over de weg (ingezonden 28 november 2011).

An SP MP asked why six trailers of uranium hexafluoride travelled unaccompanied over the A73 on 18 November 2011, and whether the licence, route, notification, compliance checks and police escort rules were respected. The minister answered that the transport followed the licence with notification given, an alternative route agreed with police and the Kernfysische Dienst, that spot checks show generally good compliance, and that IAEA rules did not require police escort for this material.
In fact it concerned a transport of three lorries carrying six cylinders loaded with uranium hexafluoride.
Het betrof overigens een transport van drie vrachtwagens met zes cilinders beladen met uranium hexafluoride.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het beperken van magnetische velden rond bestaande hoogspanningstracés (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether phase-rotation (fasedraaiing) to reduce magnetic fields around existing high-voltage lines, as trialled by Stedin, could be applied more widely at low cost and whether the minister would consult grid operators. The minister confirmed the technique is applicable in principle, gave cost figures, but saw no reason to require grid operators to apply it, while promising to report later in the year on buy-out options for residents close to lines.
At this moment I see no reason to apply the phase-rotation technique and to prescribe it to grid operators.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om de techniek van fasedraaiing toe te passen en dit netbeheerders voor te schrijven.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris Financiën over de saldering van energiebelasting bij teruglevering van duurzaam opgewekte elektriciteit (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Finance about uncertainty over netting of energy tax for sustainably generated electricity fed back above 5,000 kWh per year, the cross-reference to a repealed article in the Energy Tax Act, the correct interpretation, control mechanisms and timing. The secretary answered that the law is clear, that the reference error will be corrected via the Fiscale verzamelwet 2011, that netting is limited by the tax on consumed electricity, and that the Tax Administration checks suppliers' declarations.
If this bill is enacted and enters into force, the incorrect reference will be corrected.
Als dit wetsvoorstel tot wet wordt verheven en in werking treedt, wordt de verkeerde verwijzing gecorrigeerd.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over grondstoffen voor de productie van biobrandstof (ingezonden 27 s

MP Paulus Jansen asked the state secretaries about the Task Force Sustainable Palm Oil's initiatives, whether Neste Oil's biofuel refinery uses 400,000 tonnes of palm oil, the RSPO complaint against supplier IOI, whether the refinery receives state financial support enabling conditions, and how the 2015 sustainability target is ensured. The government answered that the Task Force has taken several voluntary steps, that Neste Oil's palm oil share cannot be determined in advance, that IOI's certification is suspended only for new plantations, that no subsidy went to the refinery, and that binding enforcement is limited to statutory criteria for energy use while private parties are held to voluntary commitments.
The share of palm oil at Neste Oil Netherlands therefore cannot be estimated in advance.
Het aandeel palmolie bij Nesté Oil Nederland kan daarom niet op voorhand worden ingeschat.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het opzeggen van pachtcontract door Staatsbosbeheer (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether Staatsbosbeheer's termination of the lease of farmers Evers over Icelandic horses was proportionate, whether mediation was pursued, and whether individual circumstances were considered. The state secretary answered that horse-keeping breached the lease and zoning plan, that termination was a last resort confirmed by the court, and that Staatsbosbeheer had sought alternatives, but the lessee ended talks.
Staatsbosbeheer proceeded carefully in this regard. The lease judge also examined this point.
