Staatsbosbeheer is daarbij zorgvuldig te werk gegaan. Dit is iets waar overigens ook de pachtrechter naar heeft gekeken.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over controle op de veiligheid van sprinkler- en brandmeldinstallaties (ingezonden 5 september 2011).

MP Paulus Jansen asked whether installers may choose who inspects fire alarm and sprinkler systems, how often fire services check certificates, and whether independent oversight is adequate. Minister Donner answered that owners choose inspectors under the new Bouwbesluit 2012, that fire services check certificates during routine inspections, and that current oversight is adequate though CCV rules are being revised.
It is up to the building owner/user to decide who carries out this inspection, and not the installer or maintenance company.
Het is aan de gebouweigenaar / gebruiker om te bepalen wie deze inspectie uitvoert en niet aan de installateur of het onderhoudsbedrijf.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de asbestbesmetting op twee scholen in Purmerend (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about an asbestos contamination at two Purmerend schools, including whether the removal complied with rules, whether the clearance certificate was rightly issued, and whether the inspectorates would map the whole process. The state secretary confirmed the closures, said the company was certified but declined further comment due to a criminal investigation, noted no authority inspected during removal, and saw no reason for additional inquiry while the criminal probe runs.
I currently see no reason for additional investigation since a criminal investigation is underway.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding tot aanvullend onderzoek aangezien er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aansprakelijkheid van Eternit voor kosten van asbestsanering (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the Arnhem appeal court ruling holding Eternit liable for asbestos exposure harm, and whether the state should sue Eternit to recover asbestos removal costs. The secretary confirms the ruling, describes state compensation schemes and recovery efforts, rejects total asbestos removal from buildings as disproportionate, reports failed voluntary talks with Eternit, and says he will further examine legal options in light of the ruling.
In light of this ruling, I will conduct further research.
In het licht van deze uitspraak zal ik nader onderzoek doen.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bouwleges (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

MPs Jansen and Van Raak asked the minister about building permit fees (bouwleges) and whether municipalities use the VNG transparency model, and whether fees are checked against the maximum cost-recovery criterion. The minister answered that only 38 of 200 surveyed municipalities use the VNG model, that a monitor by Deloitte is underway with results due in June 2012, and that fee levels and any cost-recovery test are for municipalities and ultimately the courts.
I am not currently commissioning any research into the fee rates.
Ik laat op dit moment geen onderzoek uitvoeren naar de legestarieven.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de juridische procedure van asbe

An SP MP asks why asbestos victims applying under the two compensation schemes (TAS for employment-related, TNS for non-employment-related exposure) face different appeal routes and double court fees, and asks for a shorter procedure and a longer application deadline. The state secretary explains the routes follow from different legal bases, promises to examine ways to reduce rejections on both applications and to consider legislative change if needed, and declines to extend the application deadline because only the victim can apply.
I share the view that a single legal route for both schemes would be more efficient and cost-saving.
Ik deel de mening dat één rechtsgang voor beide regelingen efficiënter en kostenbesparender zou zijn.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gasnetwerk (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MPs Gesthuizen and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice about the risks of old cast-iron gas mains, including the OVV chairman's claim that the advice had not been acted on, where risks are greatest, how far network operators are moving, and the status of the Gasunie transmission network. The minister answers that the advice has been followed through legal changes, SodM supervision agreements and completed risk inventories, that replacement is risk-based over decades, and that the Telegraaf map concerns regional networks rather than the Gasunie transmission network.
However, I do not agree with his claim that insufficient action has been taken on the Safety Board's recommendations.
Ik ben het echter niet eens met zijn stelling dat er onvoldoende is gedaan met de adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over veiligheid van liften (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Social Affairs about lift safety, including whether maintenance firms may choose the inspector, the independence of certified inspection bodies flagged by the Labour Inspectorate, and whether the SNEL safety norm for existing lifts should be made mandatory. The state secretary replies that inspectors must be independent and under supervision of the Labour Inspectorate and accreditation body, that the Inspectorate's independence finding is still provisional with a final view expected in late 2011, and that no mandatory SNEL implementation is planned because the case for it is not yet convincing.
After processing the responses, the Labour Inspectorate will give a definitive judgement.
Na verwerking van de reacties zal de Arbeidsinspectie een definitief oordeel geven.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Karabulut en Paulus Jansen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het woningaanbod voor specifieke doelgroepen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about housing supply for vulnerable groups, including homeless people, youth leaving youth care, ex-psychiatric patients, ex-prisoners, families living in anti-squat arrangements or campsites, and forced evictions by housing associations. Minister Donner answered that most data are unavailable, cited partial CorpoData figures, rejected stricter reporting requirements for associations, declined further research on campsite living, and said municipalities can use urgency declarations to prioritise these groups.
I am not in favour of an accountability obligation at this detailed level.
Ik ben geen voorstander van verantwoordingsplicht op dit gedetailleerde niveau.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verwerking van brandbaar afval uit Napels (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about incineration of combustible waste from Naples in Dutch plants, including whether it displaces Dutch waste, volumes, prices, AVR-Van Gansewinkel's finances and controls on the waste stream. The state secretary replied that no notification had yet been filed, that the flexible import ceiling could block new imports, and that the Inspectorate checks transports by sampling, judging the risk from Naples waste as small.
Setting rates for processing waste from abroad is a matter for the processing companies themselves.
Tariefstelling voor verwerking van afval uit het buitenland is een zaak van de verwerkingsbedrijven zelf.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over het verlagen van de nettarieven voor Gasunie door de NMa (ingezonden 3 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the NMa's proposed retroactive cut to Gasunie's gas network tariffs, Gasunie's likely appeal, the Finance ministry's support for Gasunie, who benefits from refunds, and the write-down on the German BEB acquisition. The minister answered in detail, explaining the NMa's timeline and the Finance ministry's shareholder position, but stating that the NMa, not the minister, is responsible for the tariff parameters following a court ruling that the earlier policy rule was unlawful.
It is therefore the responsibility of the NMa, and not of the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, to make the said assessment.
Het is dus de verantwoordelijkheid van de NMa, en niet van de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, om de genoemde afweging te maken.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Jacobi (PvdA) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de emissies van de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie OMRIN te Harlingen (ingezonden 27 mei 2011)

MPs Jansen, Jacobi and Samsom asked whether the OMRIN waste incinerator in Harlingen exceeds its permitted emission levels, what the limits on downtime and enforcement framework are, and what action the government will take. The State Secretary replied that the provincial authority enforces the permit and Besluit verbranden afvalstoffen, that the 60-hour annual downtime cap has reportedly not been exceeded, and that no additional measures are needed.
According to the province, this maximum has not been exceeded since commissioning.
Volgens de provincie is dit maximum sinds de ingebruikname niet overschreden.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bouwtoezicht in Almere (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether Almere may skip parts of Bouwbesluit checks for private commissioned homes, after a local alderman announced reduced testing, and whether the ministry was informed. The minister answers that gemeenten may vary testing intensity but may not omit checks entirely, that the VROM-Inspectie will examine Almere's practice, and that the minister will report on reducing regulatory burden this autumn.
However, completely refraining from supervising compliance is not possible.
Geheel afzien van toezicht op de naleving is echter niet mogelijk.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de energiebelasting op aardgas ten behoeve van gasmotoren in schepen (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why natural gas for CNG engines in vehicles is exempt from energy tax while the same gas for vessels is not, and whether this omission would be corrected. The state secretary replied that CNG filling stations pay a fixed energy tax rate, that vessels fall under the degressive band tariff with no exemption or refund, and that the government will examine adjusting the rules and plans to raise the fixed rate to 0.16 per m3.
This natural gas is therefore not exempt from energy tax.
Dit aardgas is dus niet vrijgesteld van EB.
Vragen van het lid PaulusJansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat kleinverbruikers teveel betalen voor de meterhuur (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether households overpay about 180 million euros a year for gas and electricity meter rental, whether the meter rates were agreed in anticipation of smart meters, how long overcharging may continue, and whether the surplus is reserved for smart meter rollout. The minister denied endorsing the overpayment claim, explained the 2010 meter tariff regulation and NMa monitoring, and said surpluses will be netted against later costs though grid operators may use the money in the meantime.
This regulation ensures that the consumer does not have to pay more than the costs of metering and a reasonable return for the grid operator.
Deze regeling zorgt ervoor dat de consument niet meer dan de kosten voor het meten en een redelijk rendement voor de netbeheerder hoeft te betalen.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over onterechte verlaging van de huurtoeslag bij overlijden partner (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Finance whether surviving partners are wrongly losing rent allowance after a partner's death, and whether they are automatically or actively informed about the 10% rule. The State Secretary confirms the situation affects about 16,000 households, explains the conditions of the 10% rule, and commits to examining abolition of the income-tracing and 10% rules in the 2012 tax plan and instructing the tax authority to stop income tracing in such cases.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to refrain from tracing income upon death in situations where a surviving partner remains.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ingestorte galerijen in Leeuwarden (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the construction system and balcony detailing of the collapsed Antillenflat in Leeuwarden are used elsewhere, and whether a rapid investigation into similar risks would be done. The minister said there was too little information yet, would wait for the owners' association investigation, then check with the VROM-Inspectie and inform owners and municipalities, with an update expected in September 2011.
Since there is currently still insufficient information known about the Antillenflat, I cannot answer this question.
Aangezien op dit moment nog onvoldoende informatie over de Antillenflat bekend is, kan ik geen antwoord geven op deze vraag.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over hoge kosten voor bemiddeling/administratie in de particuliere huursector (ingezonden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about whether courts deem high brokerage and administration fees charged to tenants in the private rental market reasonable, whether internet listing fees are acceptable, and whether sanctions and a fee cap are needed. The minister answered that such brokerage costs are generally not chargeable to tenants under Article 7:417, that unlawful advertising is an unfair commercial practice enforceable by the Consumer Authority, and that a fee cap would wrongly imply such costs are permissible, so he refused one.
As set out under 1–2, this is in principle not about the reasonableness test of Article 264 of Book 7 of the Civil Code, but charging brokerage costs is not permitted at all.

Zoals onder 1–2 uiteengezet, gaat het hier in beginsel niet om de redelijkheidstoets van artikel 264 van Boek 7 BW, maar is het in rekening brengen van bemiddelingskosten in het geheel niet geoorloofd.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris Infrastructuur en Milieu over proefboringen naar schaliegas en het fracken van de ondergrond ten b

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure & Environment about permits for shale gas test drilling and fracking, including which authority is competent, chemical disclosure, environmental impact assessment, safety distances, financial liability and a Brabant Water concern about drinking water. The minister answered in detail that permits and oversight by SodM and municipalities exist under current law, that the chemicals are a trade secret visible to the regulator, and that no national criteria or law change is planned.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), De Boer (VVD), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kwaliteitsborging van energielabels

MPs asked the minister of Interior about quality assurance of energy labels, including how many were deregistered in 2010, whether spot checks by certifying bodies are legally regulated, whether certifying bodies may check firms they certified, and how many labels failed checks. The minister answered that certifying bodies found 582 deviations among 4,365 checked labels, leading to suspensions or withdrawals, that the market-based system is adequately safeguarded, and that the VROM-Inspectie's findings are not directly comparable.
I will continue to closely monitor the work of the Certifying Institutions and have them report to me regularly on their findings.
Ik zal de werkzaamheden van de Certificerende Instellingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en mij regelmatig laten rapporteren over hun bevindingen.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitvoering van de tijdelijke subsidieregeling voor maatwerkadviezen voor woningen (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An SP MP asks the Interior Minister whether the temporary subsidy scheme for tailored home energy advice was legally allowed to be delegated to third parties, why intermediaries received preferential treatment, and whether the scheme was tendered. The minister answers that Agentschap NL, not third parties, administered the subsidy, that intermediaries were allowed to submit collective applications to simplify administration without harming individual applications, and that the budget went fully to owner-occupiers.
The subsidy was granted by Agentschap NL and was therefore not outsourced to third parties.
De subsidie is verstrekt door Agentschap NL en is dus niet uitbesteed aan derden.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de veiligheid van dijken (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a wave-overtopping test on the Strijenham sea dike in Tholen, whether the results would be released, whether the dike construction met specifications, and what would be done to ensure dikes meet safety norms. The state secretary said results were expected in June 2011, the dike section had passed the recent legal assessment, and remedial projects would finish by 2015.
No, the results of the research are expected to become available in June 2011.
Nee, naar verwachting komen de resultaten van het onderzoek in juni 2011 beschikbaar.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brand in het havengebied Amst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and ministers about the handling of the February 2011 fire at the Amsterdam port chemical complex, including emergency response, communication, reporting of hazardous substances, emissions, enforcement history, and liability costs. The government answered that the response and coordination went well, that no health risks were measured, that enforcement and inspections are ongoing or completed, and that no major societal costs beyond emergency deployment are known.
Unfortunately it proved impossible to answer the questions before the committee meeting on external safety because relevant information had to be requested from third parties.
Helaas bleek het niet mogelijk vóór het AO externe veiligheid de vragen te beantwoorden omdat relevante informatie bij derden moest worden opgevraagd.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financien over wanpraktijken bij het verlengen van hypotheken (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MPs Jansen and Irrgang (SP) asked the Finance Minister about high mortgage rates on renewal, the deadline for renewal offers, and whether banks may charge existing customers more than new ones. The minister answered that the NMa is studying the mortgage market in two stages, that the first quick scan signals serious problems, that pricing is for lenders to decide, and that he is consulting parties and the AFM on possible follow-up.
The NMa is currently examining competition in the mortgage market in more depth in a second study.
Momenteel onderzoekt de NMa in een tweede onderzoek meer diepgaand de concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de financiële schade voor waterschap Brabantse Delta vanwege de brand bij Chemie-Pack (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether it is fair that waterschap Brabantse Delta bears the financial costs of the Chemie-Pack fire clean-up, which could raise local water board levies by 40%. The state secretary said investigations are ongoing, that water boards may recover costs from polluters and levy them on the area, and that if recovery fails and levies rise extremely, compensation options would be explored with the relevant ministers.
This must be the aim. If that does not succeed, there is reason for further consultation.
Dit moet de inzet zijn. Als dat niet lukt, is er reden voor nader overleg.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verkoop van het Woningbedrijf Oirschot aan woningcorporatie Laurentius (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the sale of the Oirschot municipal housing company to housing corporation Laurentius adequately protected tenants and served housing purposes rather than maximum profit, and asked him to intervene before the council decides. The minister replied that the municipality followed a careful procedure with housing interests weighing heavily, and that as the council decides independently he saw no need to take a position before the council vote.
For the council of a municipality to take a decision on a proposal from the mayor and aldermen, it can in general decide independently, without a prior view from a minister being necessary.

Voor het nemen van een besluit op een voorstel van een college van burgemeester en wethouders kan de raad van een gemeente in zijn algemeenheid zelfstandig een beslissing nemen, zonder dat daarbij een voorafgaande opvatting van een bewindspersoon noodzakelijk is.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over extra risico voor doven en slechthorenden bij de brand van Chemie-Pack in Moerdijk.

An MP asks ministers whether deaf and hard-of-hearing residents faced extra risk during the Chemie-Pack fire in Moerdijk because they were alerted later, and why the NL-Alert cell broadcast system was not introduced as promised in 2010. The minister says the survey does not allow firm conclusions about greater risk, that NL-Alert is technically ready but needs until 2011 for regional rollout, and that a gateway review will be reported by mid-May.
I expect to be able to inform you about this by mid-May.
Ik verwacht u hier medio mei over te kunnen informeren.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de brand bij Chemie-Pack (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary and interior minister about the Chemie-Pack fire in Moerdijk, covering the scope of the Safety Board investigation, past supervision and sanctions, whether the company fell under the Brzo hazardous substances regime, compliance with PGS 15 storage rules, the delayed public information on chemicals, and firewater containment. The state secretary answered that the Safety Board's focus was still to be set, that the company was supervised annually as required and a joint inspection report would follow by 25 February 2011, and that the remaining questions would be covered by the ongoing investigations.
The investigation by the VI, IVW and AI will address whether adequate facilities for firewater containment were present.
Het onderzoek van de VI, IVW en AI zal ingaan op de vraag of er afdoende voorzieningen aanwezig waren voor bluswateropvang.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA), Van Bochove (CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Steenrijk e

MPs asked the minister for Interior Affairs to respond to criticism in the Steenrijk en Straatarm report of Maastricht housing corporation Servatius's sales plan, and to explain when the central housing fund and ministry were informed of Servatius's financial problems and why a formal instruction took six months. The minister rejected the report's criticism as one-sided, said the fund raised concerns once in 2009, and explained the 2008 delay by noting the ministry was not formally notified and checked legal robustness before issuing a pre-announced instruction.
The former ministry of VROM received no signals in June 2008 about the financial problems surrounding Servatius's campus project.
Het toenmalige ministerie van VROM heeft in juni 2008 geen signalen ontvangen over de financiële problematiek rond het campusproject van woningcorporatie Servatius.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over thermische verwerking van asbest (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked whether thermal treatment of asbestos is preferable to landfilling and what steps the government has taken to stimulate it, and whether the landfill standard tightening is tied to sufficient treatment capacity. State Secretary Atsma answered that landfilling remains the minimum standard, that the government is willing to support denaturation via fiscal schemes and higher landfill tax, but that industry must decide on building plants, and that the LAP conditions for a landfill ban apply.
However, industry itself must weigh the options and actually proceed to build an installation.
Het bedrijfsleven moet echter zelf de afweging maken en daadwerkelijk overgaan tot de bouw van een installatie.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut, Jansen (beiden SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de fusie van de woningcorporaties Com-wonen

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations Com-wonen and PWS may take on obligations before a merger is approved, whether the recruitment of three directors for a not-yet-existing corporation fits overhead reduction goals, and how to avoid evasive answers on announced mergers. The Minister said pre-merger commitments are allowed but must not present the merger as a fait accompli, that he will address the corporations on their advertisements, that the merger test remains in force, and that overhead is assessed under the professionalism and efficiency criterion.
I will address Com-wonen and PWS on this.
Ik zal Com.wonen en PWS hier op aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de benoeming van een interim-bestuurder bij ProRail (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

MP Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the appointment of a supervisory board member as interim director of ProRail, its maximum term, pay, the appointing authority, compliance with the Tabaksblat Code, the selection profile and the timing of a permanent successor. The minister confirmed the interim appointment for a fixed term until a permanent successor is found, a full-time salary of 188,000 euro within the Balkenende norm, appointment by the sole shareholder, and a search underway for a permanent president-director to be presented shortly.
The appointment is for a fixed term, namely until a permanent successor to Mr Klerk is appointed.
De benoeming is voor bepaalde tijd, namelijk tot het moment dat er een definitieve opvolger van de heer Klerk wordt aangesteld.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over een kostendekkende premie voor de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG) (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

An SP MP asks the ministers of Interior and Finance whether the NHG risk premium should rise to cover costs, how supervision of the WEW works, whether premiums should differ by price segment, and whether a stress test will be run. The minister answers that supervision is exercised by the WEW supervisory board and the Interior ministry, that the WEW may disregard DNB advice, that higher-segment risks are lower so no higher premium is warranted, and that a national risk analysis and a Commissie Risicoregelingen review will cover the NHG.
The WEW can therefore disregard the advice of De Nederlandsche Bank.
Het WEW kan de adviezen van de Nederlandsche Bank dan ook naast zich neerleggen.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Neppérus (VVD), Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66), Ouwehand (PvdD) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de st

MPs from several parties asked whether asbestos, pesticides and herbicides from the Stichting Machinale Landbouw have polluted the Wageningen area in Suriname, whether Dutch responsibility and cancer mortality are involved, and whether Dutch assistance is available. The minister answered that no recent research exists, that Suriname's authorities are investigating and planning awareness activities, and that the Netherlands will consider assistance if Suriname requests it.

Due to the lack of research data, the Surinamese authorities cannot determine the extent to which the operations of Stichting Machinale Landbouw have affected negative developments in the living environment of Wageningen and surroundings.

Vanwege het ontbreken van onderzoeksdata is door de Surinaamse autoriteiten niet vast te stellen in hoeverre de bedrijfsvoering van Stichting Machinale Landbouw van invloed is op negatieve ontwikkelingen in de leefomgeving van Wageningen en omstreken.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kolenbroei (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about coal heating (kolenbroei) causing odour nuisance near Zaanstad and whether rules prevent it. The state secretary answered that no general rules exist beyond the general duty of care, that permits contain monitoring requirements, and that the inspectorate will ask competent authorities to add emergency procedures where missing.
The VROM Inspectorate will inform the competent authorities and ask them to add requirements where necessary, as is customary with the DCMR.
De VROM-Inspectie zal de bevoegde gezagen informeren en hen verzoeken om zonodig voorschriften toe te voegen zoals bij de DCMR gebruikelijk is.
Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP) en Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het blenden van stookolie (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs Jansen and Van Tongeren asked the minister whether ships are still mixing hazardous chemical waste into bunker fuel, what law applies, what penalties exist, how reporting duties and enforcement are arranged, and what priority enforcement has been given since the 2008 North Refinery case. The state secretary confirmed the reported practice is suspected but its scale is unknown (research planned for 2011), described the existing legal framework, penalties, reporting duties and inspection capacity (about 1.75 FTE), and declined to say more about the North Refinery criminal investigation while it is ongoing.
Hiernaar zal in 2011 onderzoek worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Veiligheid en Justitie over het onervaren personeel bij de Schipholbrand en de brandveiligheidsmaatregelen in justitiële inrichtingen (ingezonden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about inexperienced staff and fire-safety measures at the Schiphol detention centre before and after the 2005 Schiphol fire, including staff surveys, maintenance complaints, training, outsourcing and spending. The state secretary answered that staff concerns led to a survey but the fire halted follow-up, that all executive staff now take fire-safety training, that outsourcing is for flexibility and budget figures were given, and declined to answer questions 9 to 12 in time for the budget debate.
Unfortunately this has not proven possible, but of course this matter can also receive attention in the general consultation with your House on 8 December.
Tot mijn spijt is dit niet mogelijk gebleken, maar uiteraard kan ook in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 8 december aanstaande aandacht worden besteed aan deze materie.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de omgewaaide hoogspanningsmasten tussen Doetinchem en Ulft (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked whether the pylons toppled at Vethuizen met the new European standard, what share of Dutch pylons comply, and what replacement would cost. The minister answered that KEMA found the masts met the standards of their time and the new norm's design specifications, that extreme winds exceeded design limits, and that no replacement program exists beyond regular inspection.
The investigation showed that the toppling of the masts was caused by extreme weather conditions in which wind speeds reached between 150 and 200 km/h.
Het onderzoek heeft aangetoond dat het omwaaien van de masten is veroorzaakt door extreme weersomstandigheden waarbij windsnelheden zijn bereikt tussen de 150 en 200 km/u.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inzameling en hergebruik van kunststof afval (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether he agrees that half of collected plastic waste ends in incinerators, how collected plastic flows through recycling, whether producers can be required to add markers, and whether he will address barriers to post-sorting installations. The state secretary largely referred to earlier answers, said markers would only make sense at EU level and could harm Dutch competitiveness, and promised a review of pre- and post-sorting due early 2011 without committing to new post-sorting plants.
The study will be ready early 2011 and will then be sent to the House.
Het onderzoek is begin 2011 gereed en zal daarna aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de Schipholtunnel (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Transport about the prolonged repair of the Schiphol tunnel after a train incident, the cause and damage, shortages of repair materials, the timetable impact and rail disruption statistics. The minister answers that repairs are completed, cause is still under investigation by several bodies, responsibility for reserve materials lies contractually with contractors, and that exact train cancellation figures are hard to give.
It is difficult to indicate how many trains were cancelled as a result of repairs following accidents.
Het is lastig aan te geven hoeveel treinen er zijn uitgevallen ten gevolge van reparaties na ongelukken.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over voorkruipen bij het aanvragen van gemeentelijke vergunningen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Delfzijl municipality's acceptance of payment from a company to speed up permit handling was lawful and equitable, and whether it risked a wider trend. The Minister answered that the EUR 45,000 contributed by the initiator funds preparatory research for a zoning plan revision, not faster permit processing, so no measures were deemed necessary.
No payment is made for faster processing of permit procedures, according to the municipality.
Er wordt niet betaald voor een snellere afhandeling van vergunningprocedures, aldus de gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het verbeterplan van het bedrijf Thermphos in Vlissingen (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asks whether Thermphos's improvement plan to cut dioxin and cadmium emissions is adequate, whether health, agricultural and nature damage is being assessed, and by when the company will comply with legal requirements and whether the 2015 deadline is acceptable. The state secretary replies that the plan is still being finalised under the province of Zeeland, that RIVM studies are nearly complete, that the Labour Inspectorate has tightened oversight, and that the province expects a timely and effective approach, deferring key timing to the provincial licensing process.
Thermphos is drawing up, under the direction of the province of Zeeland, a plan setting out the measures it will take to improve the environmental and safety situation.
Thermphos maakt, onder regie van de provincie Zeeland, een plan waarin ze vastlegt welke maatregelen ze treft ter verbetering van de situatie op het gebied van milieu en veiligheid.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het conflict tussen de staatssecretaris en de provincie Flevoland aangaande de

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about his decision to drop the Oostvaarderswold nature link and sell state nature land, including the lack of consultation, impact assessment, land figures, costs and the effects on large grazers. The state secretary confirmed the decision follows the coalition agreement, admitted no impact assessment was done, gave land and cost figures, and said further consultation and an EHS review will follow, with a grazers advisory report due 1 November 2010.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over het werkelijke brandstofverbruik van vermeend schone en zuinige auto’s (ingezonden 9 septem

MP Jansen (SP) asked ministers about the gap between official test fuel consumption and real-world consumption of supposedly clean cars, the actions taken, the timeline for a more realistic test, EU competence, CO2 targets and fiscal incentives. The minister answered that the test is EU-harmonised and cannot be changed unilaterally, that a new test is expected around 2015, that the government acknowledges the test needs revising, and that the discrepancy does not affect air quality targets.
The Netherlands cannot deviate from this unilaterally.
Nederland kan daar niet eenzijdig van afwijken.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de mogelijke overname van Crucell door Johnson & Johnson (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister whether the planned takeover of Leiden biotech firm Crucell by Johnson & Johnson is desirable, whether the state or universities hold shares or received proceeds, what subsidies Crucell received, and how to prevent knowledge and patents leaving the Netherlands. The minister called the takeover a good development, said the government holds no shares and sees no reason for state participation, reported EUR 11.6 million in subsidies for 2003-2009 while withholding WBSO tax details as confidential, and said no knowledge drain is occurring since Crucell will become Johnson & Johnson's vaccine centre.
The government holds no shares in Crucell.
De overheid heeft geen aandelen in Crucell.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, aanvullende vraag over de mogelijke overname van Crucell door Johnson & Johnson (ingezonden 22 september 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the reported 11.9 million euro payout to Crucell's CEO upon takeover by Johnson & Johnson could compromise company interests, and whether this conflicts with the Tang/Irrgang amendment. The minister replied that assessing whether personal financial interest harms company interests is not for her, noting that commissioners and shareholders also judge this and that takeover legislation must be respected.
It is not for me to assess whether, due to a personal financial interest, the company's interest is jeopardised.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of door een persoonlijk financieel belang het bedrijfsbelang in het gedrang komt.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het rapport «Convenant Benchmarking Energie-efficiency»: resultaten en vrijstelling

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Housing about a CE Delft report finding that energy-efficiency gains under the Benchmarking covenant lagged behind expectations and that energy-tax exemptions were poorly targeted. The minister partly agrees with the findings, argues firms did not breach their commitments, notes the covenant was replaced by the 2009 ETS agreement, and declines to commit to the report's recommendations pending a new cabinet.
I see no reason in the research, which concerns a covenant that was replaced by new agreements in October 2009, to change government policy on this point.
Ik zie in het onderzoek, dat ziet op een convenant dat inmiddels in oktober 2009 is vervangen door nieuwe afspraken, geen aanleiding om het regeringsbeleid op dit punt te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de vergunningplicht voor zonnecollectoren en zonnepanelen (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

An MP asked the housing minister whether municipalities must set welstand criteria for solar panels, whether a notification duty or free automatic permit could replace the permit requirement, and why panels not attached to buildings always need a permit, among other technical questions. The minister replied that no specific welstand criteria are required, a permit remains needed for facade panels for preventive review, the permit-free rules will be adjusted so feeding energy to third parties no longer triggers the permit requirement, and free-standing panels stay permit-dependent.
Solar panels and collectors on building roofs should, in my view, be placeable without a permit as far as possible.
Zonnepanelen en -collectoren op daken van gebouwen zouden naar mijn mening zoveel mogelijk zonder vergunning geplaatst moeten kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over imidacloprid en thiacloprid in relatie tot bijensterfte. (ingezonden 2 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asks the agriculture minister whether she agrees with toxicologist Tennekes that imidacloprid and thiacloprid break down slowly and harm bees even at minimal doses, and whether the authorisation of Merit Turf should be revoked pending the bee-death research. The minister replies that the new study shows no simple dose-effect relation but that EU field studies found no long-term harm, so no measures are planned, and that the Ctgb is assessing an objection and will inform the House.
I will inform you about the handling of the objection.
Ik zal u informeren over de afhandeling van het bezwaarschrift.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel (CDA), Jansen (SP), Neppérus (VVD) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het waterkrachtproject Borgharen (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Borgharen hydropower project on the Maas, its SDE subsidy eligibility, permit progress and whether the 1 November 2010 SDE deadline could be extended. The minister said the project fits the SDE hydropower criteria, that permits were lagging, and that she is willing to move the hydropower deadline to 31 December 2010 if more time is needed.
I am willing to move the closing date for the hydropower category from 1 November 2010 to 31 December 2010, if it is established that more time is needed to obtain the permits.

Daarom ben ik bereid om de sluitingsdatum voor de categorie waterkracht te verschuiven van 1 november 2010 naar 31 december 2010, indien vast komt te staan dat meer tijd nodig is om de vergunningen rond te krijgen.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de emissie-eisen voor tweewielers (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

MP Jansen asks ministers about the rising popularity of scooters, their contribution to air pollution, and the much weaker emission standards for mopeds and motorcycles compared with cars, and whether stricter standards and tax differentiation should be pursued. The minister answers that moped contributions to national pollutants are small, that she ambitions to raise moped emission standards to car levels and supports faster EU tightening, but that tax differentiation is not feasible and no moped tax will be proposed.
It is my ambition to raise the emission requirements for two-wheeled motor vehicles to the current level of standards for passenger cars.
Het is mijn ambitie om de eisen aan de uitstoot van tweewielige motorvoertuigen op te trekken tot het huidige niveau van de normen voor personenauto's.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over activiteiten van Nederlandse drinkwaterbedrijven in China (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether Dutch public drinking water companies' foreign commercial activities in China are permissible, whether the government holds data on their size, and how compliance with the 1% foreign-turnover guideline is monitored. The minister answered that the companies' annual reports already disclose foreign activities, that public shareholders are primarily responsible for oversight, and that the 1% limit actually concerns the share of turnover spent on WASH-related foreign activities rather than all commercial turnover.

The public shareholders are primarily responsible for the drinking water companies and can, with the mentioned and any additional information from the companies, keep track of the foreign activities and compliance with the policy letter.

De publieke aandeelhouders zijn de eerst verantwoordelijken voor de drinkwaterbedrijven en kunnen met de genoemde en eventuele aanvullende informatie vanuit de drinkwaterbedrijven zicht houden op de buitenlandse activiteiten en de naleving van de beleidsbrief.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Justitie over antikraakovereenkomsten en leegstand in de sociale huursector (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether housing corporation Woonbelang is letting vacant social rental homes under anti-squatting use agreements with high fees, potentially evading the Leegstandwet, and asked about monitoring and targets. The minister said the arrangements are in principle rental agreements subject to mandatory tenancy law and that courts must decide, that vacancy data is not monitored for this purpose, and that such arrangements are a matter between the parties and municipalities.
To what extent this circumvents rental legislation is, as already mentioned, for the judge to assess.
In hoeverre daarmee de huurwetgeving wordt ontdoken, is, zoals hiervoor al is vermeld, ter beoordeling aan de rechter.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over visserij in de Voordelta (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why intensive fishing (mussel seed and cockle fishing, beam trawling) in the Voordelta Natura 2000 area, possibly in the seabed protection zone near rest areas, is compatible with a 20,000 ha nature reserve compensating for Maasvlakte 2. The Minister replied that the fishing is licensed or exempt under the management plan, that no displacement or increase has occurred, that no unlicensed fishing was found, and that beam trawling above 260 hp outside the protection zone is not yet licensed, with an appropriate assessment under way.
An appropriate assessment is currently being drawn up, in consultation with the fishing sector and nature organisations, for the existing beam trawl fishery in the Voordelta.
Momenteel wordt in overleg met de visserijsector en natuurorganisaties een passende beoordeling opgesteld voor de bestaande boomkorvisserij in de Voordelta.

Vragen van de leden Jansen en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de massale ontduiking van de CAO in de taxibranche (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

SP MPs Jansen and Ulenbelt asked the ministers of Transport and Social Affairs about widespread non-compliance with the collective labour agreement in the taxi sector, including fraud with social premiums, its causes, and possible enforcement. The minister replied that the Sociaal Fonds Taxi is responsible for the data, that inspectorates received no prior signals, that social partners agreed a 15% cap on agency staff, and that SFT imposes back-payments with a 10% penalty, while declining a retrospective study and pointing to social partners and existing enforcement for further action.
A study as referred to I consider neither possible nor necessary.
Een onderzoek zoals bedoeld acht ik niet mogelijk en ook niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het mestbeleid (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister whether the manure policy, including low-emission application, is harmful: whether micro-organisms survive longer when injected, whether surface spreading emits similar ammonia, whether low-emission spreading really cut ammonia, and whether the animal health service advises surface spreading. The minister answers that there is no known research on micro-organism survival, a pilot on surface spreading is running until 2012, the PBL evaluation shows strong ammonia reduction, and the policy will not change.
I am aware of the views of the VBBM on this subject.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de opvattingen van de VBBM over dit onderwerp.
Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Justitie over huren in de particuliere sector (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

MPs Jansen and Van Bochove asked whether it is acceptable that Vesteda charges new tenants much lower rents than sitting tenants for identical liberalised-sector flats, and whether courts can lower rents there. The minister confirms the rent gap and its implication of falling market value, states that rent adjustment is left to contract and that courts may adjust rents for unforeseen circumstances, including extreme value loss.
In this way the tenant can put to the court the question whether there is reason to adjust the tenancy agreement on grounds of unforeseen circumstances (art. 6:258 BW).
Zo kan de huurder de vraag voorleggen aan de rechter of er reden is voor aanpassing van de huurovereenkomst op grond van onvoorziene omstandigheden (art. 6:258 BW).
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over camera’s langs de wegen (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport about reports of drivers braking for new roadside cameras, whether cameras cause accidents or traffic jams, which bodies may place cameras and what they record, whether competing firms duplicate cameras, and what criteria prevent a proliferation of cameras. The Minister answered that no evidence links cameras to accidents or jams, that cameras are placed sparingly under stated purposes with some personal-data safeguards and CBP notifications, and that a joint national camera system is being pursued.
VenW will make efforts toward a single joint camera system for various purposes for public parties.
Daarnaast zal VenW zich inspannen voor één gezamenlijk camerasysteem voor diverse doeleinden voor de publieke partijen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over een spoorwegongeval bij Maarheeze (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister of Transport about the causes of a train-lorry collision at a level crossing in Maarheeze, the independence and publication of investigations, whether the crossing had been recently rebuilt to legal standards, the permit procedure for exceptional transport, camera surveillance, and technical or grade-separation measures. The minister said the inspectorate's investigation points to the lorry driver failing to clear the crossing in time, with final results expected in December 2010, reports are public, the rebuild and permit procedure are under review, and no intensification of crossing-safety measures is currently warranted.

The Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management (IVW) concludes from on-site investigation that the collision between a train and a lorry at a level crossing in Maarheeze on 22 July 2010 could have occurred because the lorry driver did not clear the crossing in time.

De Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) concludeert op grond van onderzoek ter plaatse dat de aanrijding tussen een trein en een vrachtwagen op een overweg bij Maarheeze op 22 juli 2010 heeft kunnen plaatsvinden doordat de bestuurder van de vrachtwagen de overweg niet tijdig heeft vrijgemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het plan om gasolie op te slaan in Twentse zoutholtes (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked ministers whether the reported plan to store gas oil in Twente salt caverns is factually correct, whether such storage has precedent abroad, whether groundwater is monitored, whether it is legally possible in the Netherlands and whether any permit applications exist. The minister confirmed the facts, described precedent in the US and Germany, said no groundwater monitoring is done abroad, explained the Mijnbouwwet permit and consent framework, and confirmed one permit application by AkzoNobel.
Yes. Oil storage in salt cavities is in principle possible.
Ja. Olieopslag in zoutholtes is in beginsel mogelijk.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over mogelijke fraude en omkoping bij het uitdelen

An SP MP asked the ministers of VROM, Interior and Justice whether a royal honour awarded via the VROM ministry, allegedly obtained through fraud and bribery, warranted investigation, and how long and how many honours were linked to the retired chief of cabinet. The government replied that the honour followed standard advisory procedure, the Public Prosecution Service sees no basis for a criminal investigation, and the related alleged offences are time-barred, so no systematic review is planned.
Based on the information currently available, the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to initiate a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie ziet op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie geen aanleiding tot het instellen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de perceptiekosten en administratieve lasten van de integrale vennootschapsbelasting en wijkenheffing (ingezonden 25

An MP asked the Finance and Housing ministers whether the government had measured the actual administrative burden on housing corporations from the integrated corporate tax and the neighbourhood levy, and whether a claimed €40 million and €8 million annual burden was acceptable. The minister answered that no ex-post measurement was done, that the burden is expected mainly in 2008–2009 and varies per corporation, and that the Tax Administration has taken steps to limit it, with no new study planned.
No ex-post calculation has been made of the effects of introducing the integrated corporate tax liability for housing corporations on staffing and administrative burden.

Er is niet op basis van nacalculatie nagegaan wat de effecten zijn van de invoering van de integrale belastingplicht voor de vennootschapsbelasting (VPB) bij woningcorporaties op de formatie en de administratieve last.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over de buitenlandse activiteiten van de NS (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asks ministers of Transport and Finance about NS's foreign activities, including limits set by the state shareholder, the share of foreign revenue and staff, financial exposure through subsidiaries, transparency to parliament, and the Deutsche Bahn lawsuit. The ministers answer that foreign activities are limited by agreed conditions, about 15% of revenue is foreign, liability is ring-fenced, and they will examine whether the strategy still fits and inform parliament.

If, despite the above answers to questions 3 and 4, your House has concerns about the effects of the international activities on continuity in the Dutch home market, both ministers are of course willing to inform your House about this.

Indien er ondanks bovenstaande antwoorden op vragen 3 en 4 zorgen bestaan vanuit uw Kamer over de effecten van de internationale activiteiten op de continuïteit op de Nederlandse thuismarkt zijn beide ministers vanzelfsprekend bereid om uw Kamer hierover te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat slimme meters eenvoudig te hacken zijn (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether smart meters can be hacked, what safeguards exist, how customers are legally protected if meters are manipulated, and whether the mandatory rollout is acceptable given these risks. The minister answered that hacking cannot be ruled out entirely, listed technical and procedural safeguards and planned rules, and said customers remain able to claim against the network operator or the hacker and can refuse a smart meter.

Before the rollout of the smart meter starts, a general administrative order will be established under the market model bill (31 374) setting further requirements for the metering equipment, including its security.

Voorafgaand aan de start van de uitrol van de slimme meter zal op grond van het wetsvoorstel marktmodel (31 374) een algemene maatregel van bestuur worden vastgesteld waarin nadere eisen worden gesteld aan de meetinrichting.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verhalen van schade toegebracht in het verkeer in landen buiten de Europese Unie (EU) (ingezonden 9 april 2010)

An SP MP asked the ministers of Transport and Foreign Affairs whether insurers should have representatives in non-EU countries popular with Dutch drivers to make recovering damages easier, and whether they would arrange this with insurers. The minister answered that EU law provides a basis for such arrangements, but no equivalent exists for non-EER countries where Dutch authority has no regulatory power, so insurers' cooperation is limited and private insurance is the main option.
The latter is all the more difficult because the situations you raise concern insurers not established in a member state, over which the Dutch government has no regulatory competence whatsoever.

Dat laatste is des te moeilijker omdat het in de door u aangesneden situaties om niet in een lidstaat gevestigde verzekeraars gaat waarover de Nederlandse overheid geen enkele regelgevende bevoegdheid heeft.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bromfietsrijbewijs (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport about first experiences with the moped practical exam, its costs, driving school availability, the CBR fee of 95 euro, and effects on moped use. The minister reported 541 candidates in March 2010 with an 84% pass rate, said it was too early to answer the cost and instruction questions, promised an evaluation with results in March 2011 and a road-safety evaluation by 2013, and said the fee is cost-covering and subject to ministerial approval.
I currently think it is still too early to make statements about the aspects of the moped practical exam you mention.
Ik vind het momenteel nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over de door u genoemde aspecten van het bromfietspraktijkexamen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de enorme vertragingen voor luchtvaartpassagiers door de aswolk (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked the transport minister how Regulation 261/2004 applies to passengers stranded by the Icelandic volcanic ash closures, what airlines must compensate, and whether passenger rights were respected. The minister answered that the ash closure counts as extraordinary circumstances excusing financial compensation but not care and refund duties, that the Inspectorate will assess complaints case by case, and that the total number of affected passengers is unknown.
No complaints have so far been received by the Inspectorate.
Bij de Inspectie zijn tot nu toe nog geen klachten binnengekomen.

m: Amendement van de leden De Boer en Van Bochove over het schrappen van de sanctie voor de koopsector
Removes the sanction provision for the purchase sector from the Housing Act amendment bill.
This amendment deletes the sanction provision for the purchase sector in proposed article 11c, second paragraph, of the Housing Act.
Dit amendement schrapt de sanctiebepaling voor de koopsector, zoals in het voorgestelde artikel 11c, tweede lid, van de Woningwet.

Amendement van de leden De Boer en Van Bochove over de noodzaak voor de eigenaar van een gebouw om te beschikken over een energieprestatiecertificaat berekend aan de hand van het bouwjaar van het gebo

Deems building owners to hold an energy performance certificate based on construction year until a certified certificate is issued, and lets the minister set detailed calculation rules by ministerial regulation.
Detailed rules on calculating energy performance by construction year are given by ministerial regulation
Bij ministeriële regeling worden nadere voorschriften gegeven over het berekenen van de energieprestatie per bouwjaar
Motie van het lid Van Bochove over vereenvoudiging van het stelsel
Asks the government, when amending rent law, to simplify the rent regime so protection fits regional housing markets and tenants' incomes.
requests the government, when amending rent legislation, to examine how the system can be made simpler
verzoekt de regering, bij een nadere aanpassing van de huurwetgeving te bekijken op welke wijze het stelsel eenvoudiger kan worden gemaakt
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove over het vastleggen van het maximum van 5% boveninflatoire huurstijging in de wet
Caps rent increases above inflation at 5 percentage points by law, limiting the minister's ability to set higher percentages.
The rent increase percentage referred to in the first sentence amounts to a maximum of the inflation rate plus 5 percentage points.
Het huurverhogingspercentage, bedoeld in de eerste volzin, bedraagt maximaal het inflatiepercentage plus 5 procentpunt.
Motie Slob c.s. over versterking van het brandpreventiebeleid
Asks the government to explore additional ways to strengthen fire prevention policy and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with relevant parties, to examine what additional options exist to further strengthen fire prevention policy
verzoekt de regering in overleg met betrokken partijen te onderzoeken welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er nog zijn
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove over het ontvlechtingsproces
Amends the fire-service dismantling bill so municipalities have up to one year to decide to dissolve their own fire brigade and until 1 January 2014 to amend the joint arrangement.
The disentangling process must be carried out carefully.
Amendement van de leden Slob en Van Bochove over een evaluatie van het instituut fysieke veiligheid
Requires the Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid to supply information to the minister and obliges the minister to send Parliament an evaluation of the IFV provisions within five years.
Our Minister sends to the States General within five years of the entry into force of articles 66 to 75 a report on the effectiveness and effects of these articles in practice.

Onze Minister zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de artikelen 66 tot en met 75 aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze artikelen in de praktijk.
Motie Verhoeven/Van Bochove over inschrijving van vve's bij de Kamer van Koophandel
Asks the government to investigate ending the mandatory Chamber of Commerce registration for vve's and inform the House.
requests the government to investigate which steps can be taken to end the mandatory registration of vve's with the Chamber of Commerce
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken welke stappen gezet kunnen worden om de verplichte inschrijving voor vve's bij de Kamer van Koophandel te beëindigen
Motie Voortman/Van Bochove over het scheiden van wonen en zorg
Asks the government to allow care-related facilities to be reflected in rent levels so housing corporations are not discouraged from building care housing.
create the possibility to pass on in the rent the facilities necessary from a care perspective
de mogelijkheid te creëren om de voorzieningen die vanuit zorgoogpunt noodzakelijk zijn te verrekenen in de huurprijs
Motie Ortega-Martijn/Van Bochove over een "Early Warning" systeem
Asks the government to examine whether rules must change to allow an early-warning neighbourhood monitoring system in Almere and to offer that municipality experimental space.
requests the government, together with the municipality of Almere, to examine whether regulatory changes are needed to apply such early-warning systems
verzoekt de regering in samenwerking met de gemeente Almere te onderzoeken of aanpassing van regelgeving nodig is voor het toepassen van dergelijke signaleringssystemen
Motie Van Bochove/De Boer over het functioneren van verenigingen van eigenaren
Asks the government to examine how the functioning of owners' associations (verenigingen van eigenaren) and the quality of certified administrators can be improved.
requests the government to examine how the functioning of owners' associations can be optimised
verzoekt de regering te bekijken op welke wijze het functioneren van verenigingen van eigenaren geoptimaliseerd kan worden
Motie Van Bochove/Ortega-Martijn over huurcontracten met een bepaalde duur
Motion asking the government to set up a broad committee to examine fixed-term rental contracts for temporary housing needs.
requests the government to set up a broadly supported committee
verzoekt de regering om een breed gedragen commissie in te stellen
Asks the government to quickly reach a new agreement with the European Commission so that an income limit for elderly, care and disabled housing groups replaces the current EU decision.
requests the government to quickly reach agreements with the European Commission, a new appropriate decision
verzoekt de regering met de Europese Commissie spoedig tot afspraken – een nieuwe passende beschikking – te komen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Bochove ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het uitbreiden van de overgangstermijn
Extends the transition period for applying the new rent valuation system to existing rental homes by one year, from 1 January 2013 to 1 January 2014.
In article IE, '1 January 2013' is replaced each time by: 1 January 2014.
In artikel IE wordt «1 januari 2013» telkens vervangen door: 1 januari 2014.
Motie Van Bochove over huurprijsverhoging na woningverbetering
Motion asks the government to ensure the rent increase formula after home improvements is evaluated and takes account of energy saving.
requests that, in good consultation with the members of the Advisory Council, it ensures the formula is evaluated
verzoekt om in goed overleg met de leden van de Raad van Advies ervoor te zorgen dat de formule wordt geëvalueerd
Motie Van Bochove over energiebesparende maatregelen in monumenten
Asks the government to prepare specific policy for monuments, possibly removing them from the housing valuation system, so energy-saving measures do not make them unrentable.
requests the government to make preparations to be able to pursue specific policy on monuments and, if necessary, to remove them from the housing valuation system
verzoekt de regering om voorbereidingen te treffen om specifiek beleid te kunnen voeren met betrekking tot monumenten en deze desnoods uit het woningwaarderingsstelsel te halen
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove over het verruimen van de mogelijkheden verbouwingen te laten plaatsvinden met het oog op een verlaging van de energielasten
Amendment would let landlords carry out renovations over tenant objections for energy savings by allowing a presumption of reasonableness below 70% tenant consent under conditions.
the proposal referred to in paragraph 2 is presumed reasonable when 70% or more of the tenants have agreed to it
wordt het in lid 2 bedoelde voorstel vermoed redelijk te zijn, wanneer 70% of meer van de huurders daarmee heeft ingestemd
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove over het uitbreiden van de overgangstermijn naar twee-en-een-half jaar
Extends the transition period for applying the new rent valuation system to existing rental homes from 2012 to 2014.
A reasonable transition period of 2.5 years between introducing the new rent valuation system and applying it to existing rental homes
Een redelijke overgangstermijn van 2,5 jaar tussen invoeren van het nieuwe woningwaarderingsstelsel en het toepassen van dit stelsel op bestaande huurwoningen
Motie Ortega-Martijn c.s. over een tijdelijk voorziening voor het omwisselen van de Nederlands-Antilliaanse gulden
Asks the government to arrange a temporary facility so citizens can exchange Netherlands Antillean guilders in the European part of the Netherlands.
requests the government to arrange a temporary facility to make it possible to exchange the Netherlands Antillean guilder in the European part of the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering een tijdelijke voorziening te treffen om omwisselen van de Nederlands-Antilliaanse gulden in het Europees deel van Nederland mogelijk te maken
Motie Brinkman c.s. over het voorkomen van een herhaling van schuldsanering
Motion asking the government to ensure the College financieel toezicht can carry out its controls so that debt rescue of the new Kingdom countries is never needed again.
requests the government to do everything possible so that the College financieel toezicht can carry out its control work to such an extent
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te stellen, zodat het College financieel toezicht haar controlewerkzaamheden dermate kan uitvoeren
Motie Van Bochove/Monasch over behandeling van de herziene Woningwet in dit parlementaire jaar
Asks the government to ensure the revised Housing Act can be debated and adopted by parliament in the current session, with the bill sent by March 2011.
requests the government to ensure that in the current parliamentary year the legislature can discuss and adopt the revised Housing Act
verzoekt de regering om ervoor te zorgen dat in het huidige parlementaire jaar de wetgever de herziene Woningwet kan bespreken en kan aannemen
Motie Van Bochove c.s. over het alsnog verstrekken van koopsubsidie
Asks the government to provide funds so that a group of buyers who applied for a purchase subsidy between 30 March and 13 April 2010 receive it after all.
requests the government to make funds available to still grant a purchase subsidie to this group
verzoekt de regering middelen beschikbaar te stellen om alsnog een koopsubsidie te verstrekken aan deze groep
Motie Leerdam c.s. over nauwlettend volgen van het prijsniveau op de BES-eilanden tijdens de invoering van de dollar
Asks the government to closely monitor price levels on the BES islands during the dollar introduction, with a double-pricing obligation, and to report to the Chamber by 1 March 2011.
requests the government to closely monitor the price level on the BES islands during this period and to send the Chamber a report on it by 1 March 2011
verzoekt de regering het prijsniveau op de BES-eilanden gedurende deze periode nauwlettend te volgen en de Kamer hierover voor 1 maart 2011 een rapportage te sturen

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Depla c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 tot het invoegen van de bepaling dat geen meerjarige onderhoudscontracten mogen worden gesloten zolang niet tweederde deel van de a
Amendment barring new homeowners' associations from signing maintenance contracts longer than one year until two-thirds of apartments are transferred.
the homeowners' association will not enter maintenance agreements with a term longer than one year
gaat de vereniging van eigenaars geen overeenkomsten voor onderhoud aan met een langere looptijd dan een jaar
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het zenden van afschrift van het onderhoudsplan aan  burgemeester en wethouders
Requires the owners' association to send the municipality a copy of its maintenance plan within four weeks so the authority can check it is carried out.
The owners' association sends a copy of the maintenance plan to the competent authority within four weeks of drawing it up.
De vereniging van eigenaars zendt binnen vier weken na het opstellen van het onderhoudsplan, bedoeld in het eerste lid, een afschrift van het plan aan het bevoegd gezag.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over het betrekken van elektronische communiciatiemiddelen bij vergaderingen van de vereniging van eigenaars

Amends the Civil Code for owners' associations so that electronic communication and voting rules apply to apartment owners' associations, letting their house rules set voting eligibility and electronic use conditions.
The amendment restores this evident omission and provides that the owners' association can communicate with its members electronically.
Het amendement herstelt deze klaarblijkelijke omissie en regelt dat de Vereniging van Eigenaars via het elektronisch verkeer met hun leden kan communiceren.
Amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over voldoende bijdragen aan het reservefonds voor het uitvoeren van het onderhoudsplan
Requires owners' associations to fund their maintenance reserve adequately and send the maintenance plan and contributions to the mayor and aldermen, who could then use sanctions.
The owners' association sends a copy of the maintenance plan and the agreed contributions to the reserve fund to the mayor and aldermen.
De vereniging van eigenaars zendt afschrift van het onderhoudsplan en van de overeengekomen bijdragen aan het reservefonds aan burgemeester en wethouders.
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove c.s. over het opnemen in het onderhoudsplan van een schatting van de benodigde jaarlijkse reservering na afloop van het onderhoudsplan
Requires maintenance plans for owners' associations to include an estimate of the annual reserve needed for large costs beyond the plan period.
an estimate of the annual reserve needed for costs other than ordinary annual costs after the period covered by the maintenance plan
een schatting van de benodigde jaarlijkse reservering voor andere dan de gewone jaarlijkse kosten na de periode waarop het onderhoudsplan betrekking heeft
Amendement van het lid Depla c.s. tot het invoegen van de bepaling dat geen meerjarige onderhoudscontracten mogen worden gesloten zolang niet het tweederde deel van de appartementen is verkocht
Bars owners' associations of apartments from concluding maintenance contracts longer than one year until two-thirds of the apartments are sold.
As long as two-thirds of the apartment rights have not yet been sold, the owners' association will not conclude maintenance agreements with a term longer than one year.
Zolang het tweederde deel van de appartementsrechten nog niet is verkocht, gaat de vereniging van eigenaars geen overeenkomsten voor onderhoud aan met een langere looptijd dan een jaar.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Remkes c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het vooralsnog buiten toepassing laten van de bepalingen rondom de gemeenschappelijke voorziening politie

Amendment keeps certain police-cooperation provisions for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom inapplicable for now, requires ministerial assessment after four and two years against objective criteria, and asks for parliamentary involvement in that decision.
Parliamentary involvement in that decision-making is desirable and necessary.
Parlementaire medebetrokkenheid bij die besluitvorming is wenselijk en nodig.
