Motie Leerdam c.s. over een regeling zoals bedoeld in artikel 38 van het Statuut

Asks the government to arrange with Curaçao and Sint Maarten a regulation under the Statute ensuring they keep financial norms, report annual accounts and provide information, and to reinstate financial supervision if norms are breached, informing the Chamber beforehand.
requests the Council of Ministers of the Realm also to promote that, if it is established that Curaçao or Sint Maarten culpably no longer meets the norms
verzoekt de rijksministerraad tevens te bevorderen dat, als wordt vastgesteld dat het land Curaçao of Sint-Maarten verwijtbaar niet meer voldoet aan de normen
Motie Leerdam c.s. over aanpassing van de AMvRB
Asks the government to amend the AMvRB on Curaçao and Sint Maarten so it can be extended repeatedly and so that parliament gets a prior voorhang procedure on any decision to end or extend it.
the House is informed in advance of any decision to end or extend this AMvRB through a voorhang procedure
de Kamer voorafgaand gekend wordt in ieder besluit tot beëindiging of verlenging van deze AMvRB via een voorhangprocedure
Motie Leerdam c.s. over een secretariaat van het Koninkrijk
Asks the government to decide by 2010, in consultation with overseas partners, whether to create a Kingdom secretariat.
requests the government to decide in 2010, in close consultation with the overseas partners, whether or not to establish a Kingdom secretariat
verzoekt de regering om nog in 2010 in nauwe afstemming met de overzeese partners een besluit te nemen over het al dan niet in het leven roepen van een secretariaat van het Koninkrijk
Motie Van Bochove en Leerdam over het voorleggen van de voordracht voor het Koninklijk Besluit aan de Staten-Generaal, de Staten van Curaçao en de Staten van Sint-Maarten

Asks the government not to submit the royal decree proposal for repealing the Rijkswet financieel toezicht until four weeks after the draft is laid before the Staten-Generaal and the Curaçao and Sint Maarten legislatures.
requests the government not to submit the proposal for the royal decree, referred to in article 35 of the law, until four weeks after the draft has been laid before the Staten-Generaal
verzoekt de regering de voordracht voor het Koninklijk Besluit, bedoeld in artikel 35 van de wet, niet eerder te doen dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp is overgelegd aan de Staten-Generaal
Motie Van Bochove over een visie op de toekomst van het Koninkrijk
Motion asking the government to present to the House by 1 January 2011 a vision on the future of the Kingdom with proposals to modernise the Statute.
requests the government to inform the House by 1 January 2011 of the vision on the future of the Kingdom
verzoekt de regering de Kamer voor 1 januari 2011 in kennis te stellen van de visie op de toekomst van het Koninkrijk
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Bochove ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het gelijktrekken van de mogelijkheden op de BES eilanden bij beroep in cassatie
Allows cassation appeals to the Hoge Raad in tax cases from the BES islands, brought by the taxpayer or the Minister of Finance, aligning them with the Netherlands.
In tax matters concerning the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, the Hoge Raad takes cognizance of a cassation appeal.
De Hoge Raad neemt in belastingzaken met betrekking tot de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba kennis van een beroep in cassatie
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Bochove ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het gelijk trekken van de mogelijkheden bij beroep in cassatie.
Amendment extending the right to appeal in cassation to the Supreme Court for tax cases in the Caribbean Netherlands, aligning it with the Netherlands.
The Supreme Court takes cognizance of appeals in cassation in tax matters for the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba
De Hoge Raad neemt in belastingzaken met betrekking tot de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba kennis van een beroep in cassatie
Amendement van het lid Remkes c.s. over een latere inwerkingtreding van de bepalingen rondom de gemeenschappelijke voorziening politie

Amends the police bill so that the articles on the joint police facility enter into force later by royal decree, with a waiting period and parliamentary involvement, and a temporary general measure is used meanwhile.
Parliamentary involvement in that decision-making is desirable and necessary.
Parlementaire medebetrokkenheid bij die besluitvorming is wenselijk en nodig.
Amendement van het lid Van Bochove over het gelijktrekken van de cassatiemogelijkheden voor de BES en Nederland met betrekking tot belastingzaken
Lets the Hoge Raad hear cassation appeals in tax cases for the BES islands, including appeals by the taxpayer and the minister, aligning these with the Netherlands.
The Supreme Court hears cassation appeals in tax cases concerning the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.

qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bochove over het besluit van de voorzitter van de Staten van Curaçao om de openbare vergaderingen van de Staten van Curaçao voor onbepaalde tijd te schorsen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the Curaçao Staten chair's indefinite suspension of plenary sessions, reportedly until after elections, complies with the Staten's wishes and the rules, and what it means for democracy and Kingdom relations. The minister confirmed no plenary sessions had been held, said the suspension conflicts with the Staten's Rules of Procedure and has no basis in other ordinances, called it a worrying democratic situation, but said the matter is primarily for Curaçao to resolve and the Netherlands is waiting.
Suspending Staten sessions indefinitely is contrary to the Staten of Curaçao's Rules of Procedure and, as far as I can determine, has no basis in any other national ordinance.

Het voor onbepaalde tijd opschorten van Statenvergaderingen is in strijd met het Reglement van Orde van de Staten van Curaçao en vindt, voor zover ik kan nagaan, ook geen basis in enige andere landsverordening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Bochove over het bericht dat het aantal mensen met een betalingsachterstand op de hypotheek de afgelopen vier jaar verdubbeld is

Two CDA MPs asked the government about the doubling of mortgage payment arrears, whether homeowners can rent out part of their home given bank consent and tenancy protection, whether students will face delays finding rooms, and whether a quick short-lease option could be introduced. The minister confirmed the arrears figure, explained that banks must be asked for consent and that the hospitality rule and the tax room-rental exemption already apply, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, without proposing new legislation.
In view of the above, I am of the opinion that measures are already in place, both on tenancy protection and tax legislation, that facilitate the renting of rooms.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat al voorzien is in maatregelen zowel qua huurbescherming als qua belastingwetgeving die het verhuren van kamers faciliteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Monasch over de ontwikkeling van Lelystad

MPs Van Bochove and Monasch asked about the development of Lelystad, including the Lelystadtafel commitments, fragmented housing ownership from the Centrada sale obligations, and the lack of private renovation funds. The minister responded that the municipality received funds and an extra annual contribution, that responsibility for the sales lies with the corporation and owners, and that a round-table with relevant parties will be organised to seek solutions.
It is important that with fragmented ownership the approach to corporation and private homes is aligned.
Het is belangrijk dat bij versnipperd bezit de aanpak van de woningen van corporaties en particulieren wordt afgestemd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over brandpreventie door middel van slimme gasmeters

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether a smart gas meter concept for gas leak detection and automatic shut-off, nominated for a fire safety innovation prize, could add fire safety, support rollout of smart meters, face legal barriers, and warrant a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the concept may contribute to fire safety, that building and gas law do not hinder it, that a cost-benefit analysis is not appropriate since the idea is at an early stage, and that network operators are willing to examine feasibility with the developer.
A cost-benefit analysis is not something I consider appropriate.
Een kosten batenanalyse acht ik niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove over de afdeling Bevolking, Burgerlijke Stand en Verkiezingen (BBSV) op Curaçao

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the Curaçao civil registry and passport office (BBSV), including security of passport issuance, a sharp rent increase for a new building, and arrears owed to the Dutch state. The minister said the Governor remains responsible, that a new location must meet security requirements before mandated issuance can move, and that the Governor will press Curaçao for payment without committing to interest or further action.
The Governor is responsible for correct passport issuance in Curaçao, even when it happens under mandate.
De Gouverneur is verantwoordelijk voor een juiste paspoortuitgifte in Curaçao, ook als dat gebeurt in mandaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about inheritance tax problems for heirs who cannot sell an inherited house and lack liquid funds to pay. The government answered that about 528 deferral requests were received in early 2012, that deferrals are granted case by case under existing policy, that no new rules are planned, and it referred heirs to notaries for advice on accepting an inheritance with benefit of inventory.
It is therefore not necessary to take further measures and make it possible, as the questioners propose, to grant up to two years of deferral (on top of the standard year).
Het is derhalve niet nodig om nadere maatregelen te treffen en het mogelijk te maken, zoals vraagstellers voorstellen, om maximaal twee jaar uitstel (bovenop het standaard jaar) voor te schrijven.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove over lessen uit het faillissement van de Redema Groep

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about lessons from the Redema Groep bankruptcy for owners' associations (VvE), including whether funds can be recovered and whether a national public-law body should be created. The minister answered that accounts in the name of the VvE are outside the bankruptcy, that pooled 'inzake' accounts fall into the estate so members may recover only part, that a national body is not the most obvious solution, and that a study on VvE functioning will report in Q2 2012.
Nevertheless, I will ask VvE-belang among others to pay renewed attention to this in their communications in the coming period.
Ik zal desalniettemin onder meer VvE-belang vragen hier de komende tijd in hun communicatie- uitingen nogmaals aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over Besluit uitvoering Crisis en herstelwet

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether the Almere exemption in the Crisis and Recovery Act implementing decree (art. 6e) applies only to new build and how it affects existing homes, resale and renovation. The minister answered that the exemption covers only listed new-build rules, existing homes must meet existing-building rules, and renovations must reach the acquired-rights level and the existing-building standards.
The articles containing the existing-building requirements are not mentioned in the decree and are therefore excluded from the experiment.
De artikelen waarin de voorschriften voor bestaande bouw zijn opgenomen worden niet genoemd in het besluit en zijn derhalve uitgesloten van het experiment.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de erfbelasting over een niet verkochte woning (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bochove asked whether heirs struggle to pay inheritance tax when an unsold house is the main asset, and whether payment deferral should be temporarily extended. The state secretary replied that the Tax Administration reports no such problems, points to its generous deferral practice, and sees no reason to widen the deferral rule.

In response to your question whether I am aware of signals from practice that many taxpayers have problems paying inheritance tax when the estate consists of a house that cannot be sold quickly enough, I can inform you, based on information from the Tax Administration, that such problems do not exist at all.

1 Antwoord 1 Naar aanleiding van uw vraag of mij uit de praktijk signalen bekend zijn dat veel belastingplichtigen problemen hebben om de erfbelasting te betalen als de nalatenschap uit een woning bestaat en deze woning niet snel genoeg verkocht kan worden, nu de verkooptijd is opgelopen tot 23 maanden, kan ik u op grond van informatie van de Belastingdienst meedelen dat bedoelde problemen hoegenaamd niet bestaan.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over borgbaarheid maatschappelijk vastgoed (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether housing corporations can finance community care points (zorgsteunpunten) and whether WSW guarantees can cover premises housing GPs and therapists, given the WSW's stance that these fall outside the DAEB category. The government answered that the WSW talks concluded GPs and therapists are not DAEB-eligible, while encouraging corporations to build shared care facilities and noting limits on state aid for GP premises.
The conversation with the WSW has been concluded, with the indication that GPs and therapists are not classified in the DAEB category.
Het gesprek met het WSW is afgerond, waarbij is aangegeven, dat huisartsen en therapeuten niet tot de daeb-categorie worden gerekend.

Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het toepassen van de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MP Van Bochove asks how the squatting and vacancy law (Wet kraken en leegstand) is applied, including why many Gelderland municipalities have not adopted a vacancy ordinance, whether police may address squatters, and whether the absence of an ordinance blocks prosecutorial eviction. The government answers that municipalities choose their own instruments, that police may address squatters but criminal eviction requires an order from the public prosecutor, and that the Openbaar Ministerie does not depend on a municipal ordinance.
The Public Prosecution Service does not depend on a vacancy ordinance nor on notifications from a municipality to act against squatting.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is niet afhankelijk van een leegstandsverordening noch van meldingen van een gemeente om op te treden tegen kraken.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onjuiste waardebepaling van verhuurde panden in box 3 en de Successiewet, waardoor mensen extreem hoge belasting dien

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 switch to WOZ-based valuation of rented homes for box 3 and inheritance tax is causing extreme tax burdens, and proposed remedies such as a counter-evidence rule and municipal consultation. The State Secretary largely rejected the proposals, defending the WOZ valuation and existing appeal routes, while pointing to rent-cap and valuation adjustments and a few narrow changes for leased homes and service flats.
A counter-evidence arrangement was, when the mandatory use of the WOZ value was introduced and several times since, rejected with reasons.
Een tegenbewijsregeling is bij invoering van het verplicht gebruik van de WOZ-waarde en ook al enkele keren daarna, beargumenteerd afgewezen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brandweer Gelderland-Zuid (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the Gelderland-Zuid fire service ending its diving rescue task from 1 July 2011, and whether people in the water are left to drown and whether the police take over. The minister answers that the region has chosen grip and surface rescue units instead, that this is a regional responsibility, that the police only handle body recovery under a regional agreement, and sees no need for further steps.
It is up to the municipalities or the safety regions to make a choice in this.
Het is aan de gemeenten dan wel de veiligheidsregio's om hierin een keuze te maken.

Vragen van de leden Verburg en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een klacht betreffende het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (ingezonden 7 j

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a National Ombudsman finding that a chalet owner in a holiday park lacked the right to choose his energy supplier, and whether a law change would follow quickly. The minister answered that a bill implementing the third energy package extends supplier choice to recreational networks after a three-year transition, and that talks between the network owner and grid operator Enexis on a takeover were ongoing without agreement yet.
To bring about change, the third package bill includes a provision creating a basis for rules by general administrative order on valuing a network when it is transferred.

Om hierin verandering te brengen, is in het wetsvoorstel voor het derde pakket o.a. een bepaling opgenomen die een grondslag biedt om bij Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur voorschriften op te nemen over de waardebepaling van een net bij overdracht.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ligplaatsen van woonboten (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Van Bochove (CDA) asks the Minister of Interior whether answers on mooring rights for houseboats are adequate, given a June 2011 radio report on buyers of mooring plots and claimed gaps in private-law protection for residents. The minister rejects these objections, stating that private-law remedies (reasonableness and fairness, unfair terms rules) apply and that tenancy protection for houseboat moorings would undermine public-law flexibility.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die opvatting deel ik niet.

Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de opname van de Noordoostpolder (NOP) in de voorl

MPs Koopmans and Van Bochove asked why the Noordoostpolder was nominated for UNESCO's tentative World Heritage list despite the municipal council voting against it, and whether it would be removed and when. The state secretary answered that the council's decision shows insufficient support, so the Noordoostpolder will not be placed on the revised tentative list, and explained the earlier municipal request and advisory commission history.
Following the council's decision, I note that there is insufficient support for placing the Noordoostpolder on the tentative list.
Naar aanleiding van het besluit van de gemeenteraad constateer ik dat er onvoldoende draagvlak is voor plaatsing van de Noordoostpolder op de voorlopige lijst.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over verloting van woningen (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dudok Wonen's lottery giving 50 applicants a home at 50% discount, and whether a 'Kopen naar wens' scheme, needed legal approval and was a proper way to help starters. The minister answered that the scheme is a split purchase with erfpacht rather than a discount, requires no ministerial permission, and that the lottery is a fair way to allocate scarce homes, and that Dudok currently complies with the rules.
No legal permission is needed for such a lottery.
Voor een dergelijke verloting is geen wettelijke toestemming nodig.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Maastrichtse woningcorporatie Servatius (ingezonden 28

Opposition and coalition MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the WSW guarantee fund could cover liquidity shortfalls at Maastricht housing corporation Servatius, including the Campus Calatrava losses, and why a sanitation route via CFV was not used. The minister answered that WSW guarantees under category 6 were permitted, that the financing plan was approved by the appointed supervisor and the CFV/WSW, and that the planned sale of 1,850 homes was acceptable and that no formal council decision was needed.
It has been agreed with the backstoppers (the State and municipalities) that in all cases where the WSW considers guarantees under category 6, consultation with the backstoppers takes place first.
Met de achtervangers (Rijk en gemeenten) is afgesproken dat in alle gevallen dat het WSW borging onder categorie 6 overweegt, eerst overleg plaatsvindt met de achtervangers.

Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Krakers zitten klussers dwars» (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asks whether the Wet Kraken en Leegstand can protect renovators in Arnhem's Sint Marten district from squatters, what the local safety triangle has done, and why the problem persisted. The minister says the local triangle is handling it, criminal eviction has been announced for five properties, civil proceedings are under way, and no comparable cases are known elsewhere.
The approach to this specific situation is the responsibility of the local safety triangle.
De aanpak van deze concrete situatie is aan de lokale driehoek.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), De Boer (VVD), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kwaliteitsborging van energielabels

MPs asked the minister of Interior about quality assurance of energy labels, including how many were deregistered in 2010, whether spot checks by certifying bodies are legally regulated, whether certifying bodies may check firms they certified, and how many labels failed checks. The minister answered that certifying bodies found 582 deviations among 4,365 checked labels, leading to suspensions or withdrawals, that the market-based system is adequately safeguarded, and that the VROM-Inspectie's findings are not directly comparable.
I will continue to closely monitor the work of the Certifying Institutions and have them report to me regularly on their findings.
Ik zal de werkzaamheden van de Certificerende Instellingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en mij regelmatig laten rapporteren over hun bevindingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Nationale Hypotheekgarantie en Coöperatieve Flatexploitatie Verenigingen (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks whether NHG mortgage guarantees are unavailable for CFV cooperative flat memberships, whether banks are withdrawing finance for small CFV units, and whether the minister will act to extend NHG to CFV memberships. The minister confirms the exclusion, explains that CFV membership is a usage right with joint liability and no choice of lender, says banks' decisions are their own, and declines to intervene.
I can agree with the WEW's considerations not to stand surety for a CFV membership.
Ik kan mij vinden in de afwegingen van het WEW om niet borg te staan voor een lidmaatschap van een CFV.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Eisen woningen student te streng» (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

MP Van Bochove asked the minister whether national or municipal building requirements or the temporary nature of sites make student housing unprofitable, and whether temporary site issues and the Wro exemption will be addressed. The minister said ministry talks with student housing umbrella Kences are ongoing, a knelpuntenbrief will follow in June, and the temporary deviation period from zoning plans will be extended.
In line with my commitment in the General Consultation of 8 March 2011 on student and elderly housing, I will send your House a bottleneck letter on student housing in June.
Conform mijn toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg van 8 maart 2011 over studenten- en ouderenhuisvesting zal ik uw Kamer in juni een knelpuntenbrief met betrekking tot studentenhuisvesting sturen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Vreewijk in Rotterdam (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether legal rules obstruct residents of Vreewijk from establishing their own housing association, and whether a pending merger between Com.wonen and PWS should be conditioned on or delayed for their wishes. The Minister confirmed awareness, said no legal rules block the plan beyond owner cooperation and standard requirements, and refused to attach extra conditions to or suspend the merger, offering only to discuss options with the parties.

I will not attach the additional condition to the proposed merger between Com.wonen and Patrimoniums Woningstichting in Delfshaven that the residents of Vreewijk garden village can see their wish realised.

Aan de voorgenomen fusie tussen Com.wonen en Patrimoniums Woningstichting te Delfshaven zal ik niet de extra voorwaarde verbinden dat de bewoners van tuindorp Vreewijk hun wens gerealiseerd kunnen zien.
Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Financiën over de aanscherping normen hypothecaire kredietverlening (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MPs Blanksma-van den Heuvel and Van Bochove asked the Finance Minister about the tightened mortgage lending norms, including the new LTV norm, the AFM findings on overlending, and the NVB proposal and its economic effects. The minister answered that the LTV norm caps loans at 104% of market value plus transfer tax with at most 50% interest-only, that the AFM report is public, and referred the economic-effects questions to attached answers.
Question 4: Can you confirm that the letter also states that the NVB proposal is a good interpretation of the open norm for responsible mortgage lending?
Vraag 4 Kunt u bevestigen dat in de brief tevens staat dat het voorstel van de NVB een goede invulling vormt van de open norm voor verantwoorde hypothecaire kredietverstrekking?

Vragen van de leden De Boer (VVD), Van Bochove (CDA) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de belangenafwijking van een kraakpand (ingezo

Three MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Interior about a court ruling that refused eviction of a squatted building and whether a balancing of interests must now be made, and how property rights will be protected. The minister answers that the Squatting and Vacancy Act already protects property, cites recent rulings and a pending cassation appeal, and sees no reason yet for additional measures.
Pending the outcome of this cassation procedure, there is for me no reason to take additional measures to protect property rights.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van deze cassatieprocedure bestaat er voor mij geen aanleiding aanvullende maatregelen te nemen ter bescherming van het eigendomsrecht.

Vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de ministers Infrastructuur en Milieu, en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het Heerenveense model bij vergunningaanvragen (ingezonden 7 januari 2

Two CDA MPs asked whether the Heerenveen model, which skips checking parts of building applications on the applicant's self-declaration, is blocked by the online permit portal, and how it fits the Dekker committee's advice. The minister answered that the portal does not block the model, that Heerenveen's outdated form is being retired, and that the model fits the Dekker philosophy though quality assurance remains a weak point.
The Heerenveen model essentially consists of omitting the assessment of a number of aspects of the Building Decree 2003.
Het Heerenveense Model bestaat in essentie uit het achterwege laten van de beoordeling van een aantal aspecten uit het Bouwbesluit 2003.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA), Van Bochove (CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Steenrijk e

MPs asked the minister for Interior Affairs to respond to criticism in the Steenrijk en Straatarm report of Maastricht housing corporation Servatius's sales plan, and to explain when the central housing fund and ministry were informed of Servatius's financial problems and why a formal instruction took six months. The minister rejected the report's criticism as one-sided, said the fund raised concerns once in 2009, and explained the 2008 delay by noting the ministry was not formally notified and checked legal robustness before issuing a pre-announced instruction.
The former ministry of VROM received no signals in June 2008 about the financial problems surrounding Servatius's campus project.
Het toenmalige ministerie van VROM heeft in juni 2008 geen signalen ontvangen over de financiële problematiek rond het campusproject van woningcorporatie Servatius.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut, Jansen (beiden SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de fusie van de woningcorporaties Com-wonen

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and CDA asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations Com-wonen and PWS may take on obligations before a merger is approved, whether the recruitment of three directors for a not-yet-existing corporation fits overhead reduction goals, and how to avoid evasive answers on announced mergers. The Minister said pre-merger commitments are allowed but must not present the merger as a fait accompli, that he will address the corporations on their advertisements, that the merger test remains in force, and that overhead is assessed under the professionalism and efficiency criterion.
I will address Com-wonen and PWS on this.
Ik zal Com.wonen en PWS hier op aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het 55+ complex De Prinsenhof te Rotterdam (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister about the planned sale of the 55+ housing complex De Prinsenhof in Rotterdam owned by a housing corporation, and whether residents' views would be considered. The minister confirmed the sale intent, said residents can stay or relocate, noted ministerial approval is needed only for sale to a market party, and promised to inform the House of any decision.
When the sale is submitted to me, I will inform the House of my decision.
Wanneer de verkoop aan mij wordt voorgelegd zal ik de Kamer over mijn beslissing informeren.

Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Knops (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over aflossingsvrije hypotheken (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether Rabobank's halt to fully interest-only mortgages in shrinking regions such as Groningen breaches equal treatment and encourages shrinkage, and whether they would seek agreements with banks. The minister replied that Rabobank denies any policy to stop interest-only loans, that advice depends on the client's personal situation, and that the postcode rule in the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering prohibits discrimination on area grounds.
Under the Mortgage Lending Code, the mere fact that the mortgaged home is located in a particular postcode area cannot be grounds to reject the application.
Het enkele feit dat de hypothecair te verbinden woning is gelegen in een bepaald postcodegebied kan volgens de Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financiering geen grond zijn om de aanvraag af te wijzen.
Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP) en Van Bochove (CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Justitie over huren in de particuliere sector (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

MPs Jansen and Van Bochove asked whether it is acceptable that Vesteda charges new tenants much lower rents than sitting tenants for identical liberalised-sector flats, and whether courts can lower rents there. The minister confirms the rent gap and its implication of falling market value, states that rent adjustment is left to contract and that courts may adjust rents for unforeseen circumstances, including extreme value loss.
In this way the tenant can put to the court the question whether there is reason to adjust the tenancy agreement on grounds of unforeseen circumstances (art. 6:258 BW).
Zo kan de huurder de vraag voorleggen aan de rechter of er reden is voor aanpassing van de huurovereenkomst op grond van onvoorziene omstandigheden (art. 6:258 BW).

Vragen van de leden Vietsch, Ten Hoopen en Van Bochove (allen CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezon

CDA MPs asked ministers whether Utrecht's refusal to enforce the new squatting ban and the Public Prosecution Service's reluctance to prosecute squatters were acceptable, and how enforcement would be ensured. The minister replied that prosecution is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service under the opportunity principle and available capacity, that enforcement will proceed from 1 October with priority given to cases involving owner obstruction, nuisance or damage, and that there is no reason to think the ban will not be enforced.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Spies en Jager (allen CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de aangescherpte energieprestatienorm (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about the status of the Northern Netherlands energy agreement and the draft experiment decree allowing a tighter energy performance norm (EPC 0.5) for new homes, and whether preconditions such as market and municipal support were met. The minister answered that the Council of State raised no objections, that the decree is notified to the European Commission, that some market parties still seek clarity on calculation methods, and that the decree will enter into force on 1 October 2010 with informing parliament at publication.
I intend to inform your House upon publication of the decree.
Ik ben voornemens om uw kamer te informeren bij de publicatie van het besluit.

requests the government, together with affected municipalities, to develop supporting policy to compensate job losses

Asks the Presidium to prepare a change to the Standing Orders requiring support of at least fifty members for urgent and general consultation meetings.
requests the Presidium to prepare an amendment to the Standing Orders requiring the support of at least fifty members for urgent and general consultation meetings

Asks the Presidium (the Tweede Kamer's own governing board) to refrain from tendering reprography and cleaning maintenance services.

Asks the Presidium to propose a standing annual parliamentary research agenda, including ex post implementation studies, to strengthen the House's information position against the government.
which helps strengthen its information and knowledge position relative to the government
die haar informatie- en kennispositie ten opzichte van de regering helpt versterken
Motie Brinkman c.s. over afvaardigen van één fractielid voor een buitenlandse reis
Asks the Presidium to change rules so every parliamentary group may send at least one member on foreign trips, with existing distribution rules applying thereafter.
requests the Presidium to amend the rules accordingly, so that as a first principle all factions may send one faction member

Motie Halsema c.s. over opnemen van PM-post personele noden van Kamerleden, fracties en Kamer
Asks the Presidium to add a provisional budget item for the personnel support needs of MPs, parliamentary groups and the House while a study is pending.
requests the Presidium, pending the outcome of this study, to include a provisional item in the budget
verzoekt het Presidium daartoe in afwachting van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek, een PM-post op te nemen op de begroting
Motie Anker c.s. over de parlementaire hoffelijkheidstroffee
Asks the Presidium to take charge of the parliamentary courtesy trophy and its regulations and oversee its annual award.
