Sets the reduction factor for emission allowances at 1.0 with an annual reduction of 0.0578 instead of the original path.
The reduction factor is 1.0. At the start of each calendar year the reduction factor is lowered by 0.0578.
De reductiefactor bedraagt 1,0. Bij aanvang van ieder kalenderjaar wordt de reductiefactor verlaagd met 0,0578.
Amendement van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het laten verlopen van alle uit het Nationaal Groeifonds vloeiende gelden via de andere begrotingen.
Requires all Nationaal Groeifonds money to flow through other departmental budgets so that the House gets budget approval over every project via supplementary budgets.
This ensures that the House in all cases, and not only when the fund managers find it substantively appropriate, has a firmly anchored budgetary right.
Zo wordt geborgd dat de Kamer in alle gevallen, en niet enkel als de fondsbeheerders dit inhoudelijk passend vinden, een gedegen verankerd budgetrecht heeft.
Amendement van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het laten verlopen van alle uit het Nationaal Groeifonds vloeiende gelden via de andere begrotingen.
Amendment requiring all Growth Fund expenditures to also be recorded in departmental budgets so parliament gets budget right over each project.
The expenditures listed therein are always also included as expenditures and receipts in the relevant departmental budgets.
De daarin vermelde uitgaven worden steeds tevens als uitgaven en ontvangsten opgenomen in de betrokken departementale begrotingen.
Amendement van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over ophoging met een vlakke heffing van € 10 per ton kooldioxide-equivalent
Adds a flat levy of 10 euro per tonne CO2-equivalent on industrial installations, indexed yearly, to shift the burden of the energy transition away from SMEs.
is increased by 10 euro per tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent of the annual industrial emissions
wordt vermeerderd met € 10 per ton kooldioxide-equivalent van de industriële jaarvracht
Amendement van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de reductiefactor bepalen op 1,0 en een jaarlijkse verlaging
Sets the emissions-allowance reduction factor at 1.0 with an annual reduction of 0.0578, tightening the CO2 levy's dispensation rights for industry.
The reduction factor is 1.0. At the start of each calendar year the reduction factor is lowered by 0.0578.
De reductiefactor bedraagt 1,0. Bij aanvang van ieder kalenderjaar wordt de reductiefactor verlaagd met 0,0578.
Amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. over het vervallen van de BIK
Strikes the articles introducing the BIK investment allowance from the Belastingplan 2021, reversing a tax measure and redirecting the revenue to cover abolishing the rental levy.
Amendement van het lid Alkaya c.s. t.v.v. nr. 7 over verhoging van de vennootschapsbelasting
Raises the corporate income tax rate from 25% to 30% for taxable profits above the stated thresholds.
The proposed change raises the corporate tax rate from 25% to 30% for taxable amounts above the stated thresholds in 2021 and 2022.

Door de voorgestelde wijziging wordt het tarief voor de vennootschapsbelasting bij een belastbaar bedrag of een belastbaar Nederlands bedrag van in 2021 meer dan € 245.000 of van in 2022 meer dan € 395.000 verhoogd van 25% naar 30%.
Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over aandacht van de Raad van State voor artikel 3.1 Comptabiliteitswet in zijn advisering
Expresses the wish that the Raad van State explicitly assess in its advice on bills how the obligations of Article 3.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet are met.
expresses as its wish that the Council of State explicitly pays attention, when advising on bills, to how the obligations under Article 3.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet are given effect

spreekt als haar wens uit dat de Raad van State bij zijn advisering over wetsvoorstellen expliciet aandacht besteedt aan de wijze waarop invulling is gegeven aan de verplichtingen uit artikel 3.1 Comptabiliteitswet
Motie van het lid Bruins c.s. over volgende regeerakkoorden doorrekenen vanuit het bredewelvaartsperspectief
Motion asking that future coalition agreements be costed from a broader well-being perspective rather than only economic growth.
resolves to have a future coalition agreement costed from a broad well-being perspective
neemt zich voor een volgend regeerakkoord te laten doorrekenen vanuit een bredewelvaartsperspectief
Motie van het lid Snels over grote bedrijven verplichten om commerciële winst in Nederland te rapporteren
Asks the government to examine how large companies could be required to report their commercial profit in the Netherlands and report in early 2021.
requests the government to examine how this should be shaped in a law amendment
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe dat in een wetswijziging moet worden vormgegeven
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Snels c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over een versnelling van besluitvorming door dossiervorming

Amendment to the Awir adding a rule that a request under one benefit scheme is presumed to cover all compensation schemes and that later requests get a reduced decision period with a minimum of eight weeks.

If a request for the hardship scheme, safety-net provision or compensation scheme is followed by another request under these schemes, the decision period for the later request is reduced by the time already elapsed.

Indien een verzoek tot toepassing van de hardheidsregeling, de vangnetbepaling of de compensatieregeling wordt gevolgd door een ander verzoek tot toepassing van een van deze regelingen, wordt de beslistermijn inzake laatstgenoemd verzoek verminderd
Motie van de leden Snels en Leijten over in het verantwoordingsonderzoek speciale aandacht besteden aan de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen

Asks the presidium to invite the Algemene Rekenkamer to give special attention in its next accountability audit to the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen, reporting on Verantwoordingsdag and possibly an interim report in autumn.
to consider giving special attention in the accountability audit next year to the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen
in overweging te geven in het verantwoordingsonderzoek komend jaar speciale aandacht te besteden aan de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen
Amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. over een O/GS-tegemoetkoming
Adds a compensation scheme for parents wrongly labelled as intentional or grossly negligent in childcare benefit debts, with the tax authority keeping the burden of proof.
The burden of proof for the qualification as intent or gross negligence lies and remains with the Tax Authority/Benefits
De bewijslast voor de kwalificatie als opzet of grove schuld ligt en blijft liggen bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen
Amendement van het lid Snels over het verkorten van de beslistermijn
Shortens the initial decision period for hardship allowance decisions from six to three months, with a single extension of up to three months.
The initial decision period of six months is shortened to three months under this amendment.
De initiële beslistermijn van zes maanden wordt op grond van dit amendement ingekort tot een termijn van drie maanden.
Amendement van het lid Snels over de bewijslast
Amends the burden of proof for the hardship allowance so that it suffices that payment of costs is plausible by any means, not only shown by the parent.
If it has become plausible in another way which costs were paid, the hardship allowance may also be applied.
Indien op andere wijze aannemelijk is geworden welke kosten zijn betaald, kan de hardheidstegemoetkoming eveneens worden toegepast.
Motie van het lid Alkaya c.s. over ervoor zorgen dat het bedrijfsleven de geleden schade draagt
Asks the government to ensure businesses bear the damage of the credit-insurance crisis measure for supplier credits and to inform the Chamber how this will be organised.
asks the government to ensure that businesses bear the damage suffered from the crisis measure of reinsurance of supplier credits
verzoekt de regering, er zorg voor te dragen dat het bedrijfsleven de geleden schade van de crisismaatregel herverzekering leverancierskredieten zal dragen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Snels en Stoffer tvv nr. 27 over een differentiëring en verdubbeling van de tarieven voor passagiers
Doubles the flight passenger tax and introduces higher rates for non-economy classes and business travel.
This amendment doubles the flight tax rate for passengers
Dit amendement verdubbelt het tarief van de vliegbelasting voor passagiers
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Snels en Stoffer tvv nr. 11 over een differentiëring en verdubbeling van de tarieven voor passagiers
Doubles the passenger aviation tax rates and introduces a higher rate for passengers not in the lowest travel class, with a delayed start date for the differentiated tax.
This amendment doubles the aviation tax rate for passengers, in line with variant 4c calculated by the cabinet.
Dit amendement verdubbelt het tarief van de vliegbelasting voor passagiers, in lijn met variant 4c die door het kabinet is doorberekend.
Motie van het lid Snels over alles doen wat nodig is om de negatieve economische effecten van het coronavirus voor de eurozone te bestrijden
Asks the minister to tell the Eurogroup that no economic instrument should be ruled out in fighting the coronavirus effects on the eurozone.
requests the Minister to convey in the Eurogroup that everything necessary must be done
verzoekt de Minister, om in de eurogroep uit te dragen dat alles gedaan zal moeten worden wat nodig is
Motie van het lid Snels over in de gaten houden dat het bedrijfsleven de kosten van de crisis niet onnodig afwentelt op de meest kwetsbare werknemers
Asks the cabinet to call business to account and monitor that firms do not unnecessarily pass crisis costs onto the most vulnerable workers.
requests the cabinet to hold business to account on this and to monitor in the coming period that business does not unnecessarily pass the costs of the crisis onto the most vulnerable workers

verzoekt het kabinet, het bedrijfsleven daarop aan te spreken en de komende tijd in de gaten te houden dat het bedrijfsleven de kosten van de crisis niet onnodig afwentelt op de meest kwetsbare werknemers
Amendement van het lid Snels over een verdubbeling van de tarieven voor de vracht
Amendment doubling the aviation tax rates for freight transport, in line with a costed cabinet variant.

The rate of the first bracket of the wage and income tax is lowered by 0.14 percentage points to 8.76% in 2018.
Het tarief van de eerste schijf van de loon- en inkomstenbelasting wordt met 0,14%-punt verlaagd naar 8,76% in 2018.
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over investeringen in de Belastingdienst
Asks the cabinet to study which Belastingdienst units could yield more tax revenue and less fraud from investment, and to inform the House of the results.
requests the cabinet to examine which parts of the Belastingdienst investments could lead to more tax revenue and to inform the House of the outcomes
verzoekt het kabinet, te onderzoeken bij welke onderdelen van de Belastingdienst investeringen kunnen leiden tot meer belastingopbrengsten en de Kamer over de uitkomsten te informeren
Motie van de leden Van Raan en Snels over beter beprijzen van milieuschade
Asks the government to study the PBL advice on green tax shifting and present a step plan on applying it in the 2019 tax plan.
requests the government to examine the advice in the PBL report on green tax shifting
verzoekt de regering, om de adviezen in het rapport Fiscale vergroening: Belastingverschuiving van het PBL te onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Snels c.s. over respecteren van de beslagvrije voet
Asks the government to respect the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet) in all forms of debt collection, even before it is explicitly protected by statute.
requests the government, even as long as the legal protection is not explicitly enshrined in law, to respect the subsistence allowance in every form of collection
verzoekt de regering om, ook zolang de wettelijke bescherming niet expliciet wettelijk is vastgelegd, de beslagvrije voet bij elke vorm van invordering te respecteren
Motie van het lid Azarkan c.s. over evaluatie van de Innovatiebox
Asks the government to evaluate the Innovation Box in 2020 instead of 2022.
requests the government to evaluate the Innovation Box in 2020 rather than 2022
verzoekt de regering om, de Innovatiebox niet in 2022, maar in 2020 al te evalueren
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over digitale diensten betrekken in de belastingheffing
Motion asking the government to examine how the tax system can be adapted so that digital services contribute fairly to tax.
to examine how the tax system can be adapted so that digital services are also fairly included in taxation
te onderzoeken hoe het belastingstelsel aangepast kan worden, zodat ook digitale diensten op een redelijke wijze in de belastingheffing worden betrokken
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over de vergroeningsopgave
Asks the cabinet to make transparent how much citizens and businesses contribute to the greening effort and what it means for energy bills.
requests the cabinet to make transparent how many citizens and businesses contribute to the greening effort
verzoekt het kabinet, inzichtelijk te maken hoeveel burgers en bedrijven bijdragen aan de vergroeningsopgave
Motie van het lid Snels over het eigen huis als vermogen
Motion asks the cabinet to explore treating the owner-occupied home as wealth rather than income in tax law.
requests the cabinet to also carry out an exploration of revising the tax treatment of the owner-occupied home
verzoekt het kabinet, in dit kader of apart ook een verkenning uit te voeren naar herziening van de fiscale behandeling van het eigen huis
Motie van de leden Snels en Dijkgraaf over het beperken van de aflossingsverplichting
Asks the government to study limiting the mandatory 100% repayment requirement for mortgage interest deduction to a residual debt of around 30%.
requests the government to investigate the possibilities and consequences of limiting the repayment obligation
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheden en gevolgen te onderzoeken van het beperken van de aflossingsverplichting
Motie van het lid Snels over monitoren van onvoorziene gevolgen
Asks the government to monitor unforeseen negative income effects of abolishing the wet-Hillen and to compensate them in the next tax plan if found.
requests the government to closely monitor whether unforeseen and undesirable consequences arise from the abolition of the wet-Hillen
verzoekt de regering, nauwlettend te monitoren of er onvoorziene en onwenselijke consequenties van de effecten van de afschaffing van de wet-Hillen ontstaan
Amendement van het lid Snels over tijdelijke verhoging energietarieven alleen vierde en vijfde schijf
Changes the temporary energy-tax rate increases so that the extra revenue is raised only through the fourth bracket for gas and electricity.
This amendment provides that the temporary increase is instead fully recovered through an increase in the fourth bracket rate on natural gas.
Dit amendement regelt dat de tijdelijke verhoging echter geheel wordt opgehaald door middel van een verhoging van het tarief in de vierde schijf op aardgas.
Amendement van het lid Snels C.S. over het aanpassen van de schijven in de inkomstenbelasting
Changes income tax bracket rates and the third bracket endpoint for 2018.
The rate of the first bracket of wage and income tax is lowered by 0.14 percentage points to 8.76% in 2018.
Het tarief van de eerste schijf van de loon- en inkomstenbelasting wordt met 0,14%-punt verlaagd naar 8,76% in 2018.
Amendement van het lid Snels over het uitbreiden van de lijst van geneesmiddelen
Narrows the reduced VAT rate for medicines and medical aids and removes some exemptions, raising revenue.
The tightening of the definition of medicine yields a budgetary revenue of €42 million.
De aanscherping van de definitie van geneesmiddel heeft een budgettaire opbrengst van € 42 miljoen euro.
Amendement van het lid Snels over het vervallen van het vereenvoudigd derdenbeslag
Deletes the provisions allowing creditors to levy simplified third-party garnishment on all types of claims.
With this amendment, the proposed possibility for the recipient to levy simplified third-party garnishment on all types of claims is dropped.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat de in het wetsvoorstel voorgestelde mogelijkheid voor de ontvanger om vereenvoudigd derdenbeslag te leggen op alle soorten vorderingen, vervalt.
Amendement van het lid over vervallen schorsende werking verzet alleen bij verzet 2 weken voor aflopen termijn

Removes the automatic suspension of tax enforcement under a payment order when an objection is filed, except where the summons is served at least two weeks before the scheduled forced sale, so suspension stays in place in other cases.
The objection suspends enforcement of the payment order insofar as it is contested by the objection, if the summons is served at least 2 weeks before the set date of forced sale.

Het verzet schorst de tenuitvoerlegging van het dwangbevel voor zover deze door het verzet wordt bestreden indien de verzetsdagvaarding uiterlijk 2 weken voor de door de deurwaarder vastgestelde datum van executoriale verkoop
Amendement van het lid Snels over geen uitbreiding van de inhoudingsvrijstelling voor situaties waarin de inhoudingsplichtige niet een houdstercoöperatie is
Limits the extension of the dividend withholding tax exemption to cases where the withholding entity is a houdstercoöperatie, excluding capital companies.
established and the withholding agent is a holding cooperative
gevestigd en de inhoudingsplichtige een houdstercoöperatie is
Motie van het lid Snels c.s. over een effectieve maatregel bij het vaststellen van niet-deugdelijke wettelijke controles
Asks the government with the AFM to explore requiring a different partner or firm to redo audits found deficient.
requests the government, in consultation with the AFM, to examine whether an effective measure could be that after deficient statutory audits a subsequent audit must be done by another partner

verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de AFM te onderzoeken of een effectieve maatregel kan zijn dat bij het vaststellen van niet-deugdelijke wettelijke controles opgelegd kan worden dat een volgende controle door een andere partner
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over de impasse doorbreken door voorstellen voor het verdienmodel uit te werken
Asks the government to break the impasse on audit quality by drafting proposals that fundamentally change the business model of accountancy firms, including separating audit from advisory work.
requests the government to break this impasse and develop proposals that fundamentally change the business model
verzoekt de regering, deze impasse te doorbreken en voorstellen uit te werken die het verdienmodel fundamenteel veranderen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het rapport van Reclaim Finance met de titel ‘Banks fuelling expansion of oil-and-gas Arctic extraction’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about a Reclaim Finance report showing Dutch banks and investors still fund oil and gas firms active in the Arctic, and whether the government would act on it. Minister Knapen answered that the government opposes Arctic oil and gas exploitation, expects financial institutions to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and will raise the issue in EU and Arctic Council channels, but could not provide an overview of investments or policies and deferred several points.
The cabinet does not have such an overview.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de cv/bv-structuur

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the cv/bv structure, including the Commission's state aid concerns, the 2005 hybrid-entity decision IFZ2005/546M, and whether the government informed the European Commission or the Chamber. The government answered that it had no contact with the Commission on state aid for the structure, that the state aid risks were limited, that the Commission had not found unlawful aid, and that the revenue involved cannot be traced.
It cannot be determined which money flows are related to the cv/bv structure.
Het is niet te achterhalen welke geldstromen aan de cv/bv-structuur gerelateerd zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het onterecht terugvorderen van toeslagen van zelfstandigen

MP Snels asked about the wrongful clawback of allowances from self-employed people caused by the Bbz loan-to-gift rule, the delayed fix, and the limited 2014–2016 compensation scheme. The State Secretary replied that the problem stemmed from a legal interaction rather than administrative error, that the compensation scheme reached only 1,169 claimants, and that whether to extend compensation to pre-2014 cases is still under review, with promised letters on documents and advice.
Currently, following a question from MP Omtzigt, all written documents on the leenbijstand from 2006 onward are being reviewed.
Momenteel wordt, naar aanleiding van een vraag van het lid Omtzigt, gekeken naar alle schriftelijke documenten over de leenbijstand vanaf het jaar 2006.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether joining Austria's push for a coalition to shape any revision of the Stability and Growth Pact conflicts with the caretaker government's position that substantive stances should be left to the next cabinet, and whether blocs forming between northern and southern member states are undesirable. The minister confirmed the letter from Austria, said the caretaker cabinet stands by its earlier position but that it will still engage in the debate on sound public finances, and that cooperation with other member states should not be ruled out.
The caretaker cabinet stands behind the content of the parliamentary letter 'Broad reflection on the Stability and Growth Pact (SGP)'.
Het demissionaire kabinet staat achter de inhoud van de Kamerbrief «Brede bespiegeling inzake het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact (SGP)»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over belastingontwijking door Pfizer

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Pfizer through a Dutch-US cv-bv hybrid mismatch structure, its persistence despite ATAD II, state aid rules, possible subsidies for Pfizer's R&D, and further measures. The State Secretary replied that ATAD II removed the tax advantage of the cv-bv structure, that new such structures have largely ceased, that impact will be monitored with a report in 2024, that Dutch treaty policy blocks the dividend-withholding gap for the US, and that Pfizer was not found as a subsidy recipient, citing tax confidentiality for fiscal details.
Under the fiscal confidentiality obligation laid down in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over publieke country-by-country-reporting

Member Snels asked whether Member States, including France, proposed weakening the EU public country-by-country tax reporting directive (opt-outs for six years, no CBC reporting on profits outside the EU, and dropping intra-group versus external transaction reporting). The Minister replied that the trilogue has concluded, that the contested points were either already in the negotiating mandate or are not in the text, that the Netherlands was not involved in the position paper, and that the final text will be presented to the Council for approval.
I cannot go into France's position concretely, because of the confidentiality of deliberations in the Council.
Op de positie van Frankrijk kan ik overigens niet concreet ingaan, vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen in de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en van der Lee over duurzaamheidsrisico’s van staatsobligaties

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked the Finance and other ministers about the climate and sustainability risks of sovereign bonds, transparency on those risks, and how Nederland compares internationally on green recovery spending. The government answered that it supports transparency and integrating climate risks into IMF and World Bank debt analyses, that no current sovereign debt runs past 2060 and climate risks do not yet directly affect Dutch creditworthiness, and that it will raise climate risks more proactively with investors.
The Agency will therefore also proactively address climate risks and how the Netherlands tackles them in future presentations to prospective investors.
Het Agentschap zal daarom ook in de toekomst proactief in de presentaties voor beoogde investeerders aandacht besteden aan klimaatrisico’s en de wijze waarop Nederland deze risico’s adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Snels, Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over de noodzaak om zo snel als mogelijk financiële instellingen verplichten over klimaatrisico’s te rapporteren

MPs asked the Finance Minister about speeding up mandatory climate-risk reporting by financial institutions, including the TCFD framework, its alignment with the EU's proposed revision of the non-financial reporting directive, and the timing of EU and IFRS standards. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU-level harmonisation over a national patchwork, and that it will assess the Commission proposal via a BNC-fiche and pursue international convergence rather than launch national legislation now.
The cabinet wants to work towards a swift and prompt completion of the European process and its implementation in our national laws and regulations.
Het kabinet wil zich inzetten voor een voortvarende en spoedige afronding van het Europese traject en implementatie daarvan in onze nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over nieuwe fouten met de uitkering van toeslagen

Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors in child-related allowance payments to migrant workers who are wrongly treated as single parents because their partner lives abroad, including delays, repayments and whether the Belastingdienst acts on evidence. The government acknowledged the structural difficulty in verifying foreign partner data, described the verwantschapsquery, the stopknop for refugees and new partner-submission forms, and said improvement proposals are expected this year, while declining to give figures on affected migrant workers.
It is not known how many migrant workers have reported that they wrongly received the single-parent supplement.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel arbeidsmigranten hebben aangeven dat zij onterecht een alo-kop hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Paternotte, Snels en Westerveld ver de financiële middelen voor toegangstesten

MPs Sneller, Paternotte, Snels and Westerveld asked the Health Minister about the roughly 925 million euro for access testing, its legal basis, the outsourcing to a private foundation, board pay, and whether funds were committed before parliamentary authorisation. The minister answered that spending is phased with go/no-go decisions, that funds were committed before formal authorisation under Comptabiliteitswet article 2.27, and that contract texts were shared with parliament, while offering to seek Auditdienst Rijk advice.
Your House was informed of the funds for phase 0 through the fourth supplementary budget of VWS on 12 March.
Uw Kamer is door middel de vierde incidentele begroting van VWS op 12 maart geïnformeerd over de middelen voor fase 0.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Bromet over de schuldbekentenis van de Rabobank

GroenLinks MPs Snels and Bromet asked ministers how banks financing intensive agriculture share responsibility for unsustainable farming, for insufficient disclosure of transition risks, and for blocking farmers' green transition, following a Zembla broadcast. The ministers answered that all agricultural chain parties share responsibility, that banks must consider foreseeable risks, that they call on financiers to act, and that new public instruments such as an investment fund and working-capital scheme are being developed.
I call on Rabobank, and also on the other financial institutions active in the agri-sector, to explicitly take on their role in financing the transition to more sustainable agriculture.

Ik roep de Rabobank, en ook de andere financiële instellingen die actief zijn in de agrosector, op om hun rol in de financiering van de omschakeling naar een duurzamere landbouw nadrukkelijk op zich te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over "hedge funds en vermogensbeheerders die NOW steun ontvangen"

An MP asked whether hedge funds and asset managers receive NOW wage-subsidy support, whether bonuses to non-board traders are paid with public money, and whether support should be restricted or clawed back. The minister replied that eligibility is sector-neutral, no separate register of such firms exists, the bonus ban covers only management and board, and no clawback or new restrictions are planned beyond existing rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het bericht 'Oeganda loopt €21 miljoen mis door Nederland (en dat is het topje van de ijsberg)'

MPs Snels and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the government about a Volkskrant report that Uganda loses tax revenue through Dutch structures, including dividend exemption under the Netherlands-Uganda treaty and the adequacy of anti-abuse rules. The Secretary of State answered all 12 questions substantively, defending the treaty's purpose, citing confidentiality limits for individual taxpayers, and committing to add anti-abuse provisions to the Uganda treaty and new conditional withholding taxes.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot comment on the situation of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de situatie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Snels over belastingontwijking ten koste van ontwikkelingslanden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether developing countries lose money to tax avoidance via the Netherlands, citing a ActionAid estimate of 1.8 billion euros a year, and asked about policy goals, coherence, and specific recommendations. The government disputes the estimate's basis, says it has no reliable measure of avoidance, and describes existing and planned anti-avoidance measures while rejecting several recommendations such as broader withholding taxes and a UN tax body.
The government itself does not make estimates of lost tax revenue in other countries.
Het kabinet maakt zelf geen schattingen van misgelopen belastinginkomsten in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de vernietigde dossiers

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about the destruction of roughly 9,000 Toeslagen appeal files, including whether the destruction violated retention rules, whether Wob requests were answered incompletely, and whether all related correspondence could be shared. The State Secretary confirmed about 7,087 files were destroyed in 2020, stated that the 2014 destruction did not meet the seven-year retention period, said an independent inspectorate is investigating, and declined to release the individual case files while promising to attempt reconstruction and to share the internal notes on the destruction.
The relevant appeal files contain information about individual procedures of benefit recipients, and moreover these files contain private information about citizens.
De betreffende beroepsdossiers bevatten informatie over individuele procedures van toeslaggerechtigden, bovendien bevatten deze dossiers privéinformatie van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Snels en Bruins over de maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

MPs Sneller, Snels and Bruins asked how the COVID-19 export credit insurance (ekv) relaxation measures were designed, including their composition of the Rijkscommissie, links to debt relief, green transition, and fossil-fuel financing, and whether France's approach should be followed. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered substantively on most points, stating the measures are temporary, open to all sectors, additional to the private market, and that the government will pursue greening of ekv internationally without committing to a fossil-fuel phase-out scenario.
The cabinet will study with interest the French report focusing on scenarios for a full stop of ekv coverage for fossil-fuel-related projects.

Het kabinet zal het Franse rapport dat zich concentreert op scenario's voor volledige stopzetting van dekkingsmogelijkheden vanuit de ekv voor fossiel-gerelateerde projecten met belangstelling bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht “Kabinet schuift vanwege corona ook CO2-heffing industrie voor zich uit”

GreenLeft MPs asked why a press report said the government was postponing the industry CO2 levy due to COVID-19, whether the 2022 start date still held, and why climate plans were leaked to the press rather than shared with parliament. The State Secretary replied that the levy is still planned for 1 January 2021 as agreed in the Climate Agreement, that the bill goes to parliament with Budget Day, and that the Urgenda package was already sent to parliament.
The bill will be presented to your House as part of the 2021 tax package on Budget Day.
Het wetsvoorstel zal als onderdeel van het belastingplanpakket 2021 met Prinsjesdag worden aangeboden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg, Özütok en Snels over de opschorting van het Wob-verzoek van Pieter Klein

MPs from D66, GroenLinks asked the Health Minister why he suspended a Wob freedom-of-information request from journalist Pieter Klein on coronavirus matters and whether this undermines oversight and press freedom. The minister answered that the request was suspended for force majeure due to crisis work, that only coronavirus-related Wob requests are paused with a plan to resume by 1 June, and that alternative channels and appeal routes remain open.
Only in a very exceptional situation can an administrative body invoke force majeure to suspend the decision period for Wob requests.
Uitsluitend in geval van een zeer uitzonderlijke situatie kan een bestuursorgaan met een beroep op overmacht de beslistermijn voor Wob-verzoeken opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de inzet van het ESM en Eurobonds

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether the ESM should be deployed and whether eurobonds should be issued to counter turbulence in Italian and Spanish government bond markets during the COVID-19 crisis. The minister answered that the ESM is available on request under strict conditionality, that joint eurozone debt issuance is undesirable, and that the Eurogroup will meet more often with the Commission and other finance ministers, with information to parliament through regular channels.
Your House will be informed about this through regular channels.
Uw Kamer zal hierover via reguliere kanalen worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de daadwerkelijke inkomensongelijkheid in Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about actual income inequality in the Netherlands, including a critique of the official income statistics, wealth inequality, regressivity of taxes and whether the government will change how inequality is measured. The minister partly disputes the article's assumptions, defends CBS conventions, says wealth inequality is not a policy target, and declines to change the measurement method.
I am aware of the article. I agree that wealth is distributed more unequally than income.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel. Ik onderschrijf dat vermogens ongelijker verdeeld zijn dan inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Diks over de over recente berichtgeving omtrent het Marginal da Corimba-project in Angola

MPs Snels and Diks asked about press reports on the Marginal da Corimba project in Angola, including Atradius export credit insurance due diligence, forced evictions, the Dutch embassy's knowledge, trust office supervision and Dutch anti-bribery enforcement. The state secretary answered that the state's involvement in the evictions could not be established, that due diligence did not include commercial pricing, and that the government would evaluate CSR policy and enforcement measures, with some questions referred to later reports.
Based on its own investigation, the Dutch state has not been found to be directly involved, via Atradius DSB, in the alleged human rights violations in June 2013 in Luanda.
Op basis van eigen onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de Nederlandse staat via Atradius DSB rechtstreeks betrokken is bij de vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen in juni 2013 in Luanda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over de bedreiging van de publieke taak van woningcorporaties

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the housing minister whether falling net cash flow at housing associations threatens their public task, citing unrealised property value gains, weak new building, the ATAD1 tax effects and the call to move dead capital to social housing. The minister confirmed most premises, said the lower cash flow is substantial but financial ratios remain sufficient, blamed the cause only partly on factors outside associations' control, and pointed to pending studies and a stronger binding nature for local performance agreements.
I will consult with VNG and Aedes on how this starting point can concretely take shape.
Ik ga in overleg met VNG en Aedes bezien hoe dit uitgangspunt concreet vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over miljonairs tegen belastingontwijking en voor hogere belastingen

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about a petition by wealthy individuals calling for higher taxes on the very rich and action against tax avoidance, and whether the cabinet supports it. The government answered that it combats tax avoidance as a priority and taxes high incomes more heavily, but sees no need for further tax increases on the very rich in the Dutch context, and gave detailed answers on tax avoidance, wealth inequality and box 2.
The cabinet considers it important that everyone in the Netherlands benefits from economic growth.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat iedereen in Nederland profiteert van de economische groei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over scholen die in de clinch liggen met de Belastingdienst over zonnedaken

GroenLinks MPs asked why schools must charge VAT on electricity fed back to the grid and whether they could be exempted, citing a 2018 motion and the Urgenda ruling. The Secretary of State answered that the new small-business scheme from 2020 lets schools opt out of VAT on feed-in, that a blanket exemption is not possible under EU VAT rules, and that no mandatory rollout of solar panels on school roofs is planned.
An exemption for feed-in to the grid by all schools is not possible.
Een vrijstelling voor de netleveringen door alle scholen is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de UN Climate Action Summit van 23 september

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government knows banks and insurers invest heavily in shale gas and plastics, whether it will press for action at the UN Climate Action Summit, and whether it will pressure financial institutions to restrict such financing. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to national climate policy, the ban on new shale gas exploration permits, plastics programmes, and the Platform for Sustainable Finance, but made no commitment to restrict financing directly.

It is a good thing when insurers, banks and other financial institutions are open about the environmental and climate effects of their investments, so that their customers can make an informed choice.

Het is een goede zaak wanneer verzekeraars, banken en andere financiële instellingen open zijn over de milieu en klimaateffecten van hun investeringen, zodat hun klanten een gefundeerde keuze kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de effectieve belastingdruk van grote bedrijven in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the CBS finding that the effective corporate tax burden of large firms fell from 22.7% to 17.1% despite an unchanged nominal rate, and whether this is explainable to taxpayers. The State Secretary answered that loss offsetting and other differences between commercial profit and taxable amount explain the gap, and that the government awaits a further CBS publication and the advisory committee's report before drawing conclusions.
The cabinet is therefore waiting for the further CBS publication and the advice of the Advisory Committee on the taxation of multinationals.
Het kabinet wacht daarom op de nadere publicatie van het CBS en het advies van de Adviescommissie belastingheffing van multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de nieuwe interne regels van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB) voor het uitlenen van geld aan energieprojecten

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked whether the government would oppose the EIB's revised Energy Lending Policy, specifically the loopholes for gas plants with 'credible' low-carbon gas plans and a one-year extension for gas infrastructure projects, and whether it would push for a firm emissions limit before the 15 October 2019 Board meeting. The Minister answers that the Netherlands supports a firmer policy, prefers the original emissions limit definition, and will push for phasing out fossil fuel financing and for an ambitious outcome, while noting the decision is still under negotiation.
The Netherlands is strongly committed to this in the negotiations and will work to bring other countries along to a clear and ambitious policy.
Nederland maakt zich hier in de onderhandelingen hard voor en zet zich in om andere landen mee te krijgen voor een beleid dat helder en ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Snels over de ‘Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers how Netherlands has used its shareholding in the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to push human rights and environmental standards, complaints mechanisms, transparency and oversight. The minister answered that the Netherlands has pushed for these standards and transparency within the bank's board, that the complaints and disclosure rules have gaps the government will raise in the upcoming framework review, and promised to report annually to parliament.

I propose to share a report with the House of Representatives annually after the meeting of the bank's highest governing body, the Board of Governors, to inform the House of the most important developments at the AIIB.
Ik stel voor om jaarlijks na de bijeenkomst van het hoogste bestuursorgaan, de Board of Governors , van de AIIB een verslag met de Tweede Kamer te delen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het bericht ‘Uber created $ 6.1 billion Dutch weapon to avoid paying taxes’

Green Left MP Snels asked the State Secretary for Finance about reports that Uber used Dutch structures to shelter intellectual property from tax, whether Netherlands is seen as tax-friendly, how IP valuation and amortisation work, and how the Tax Authority supervises transfer pricing. The State Secretary denied the Netherlands is a tax-friendly alternative, said quantitative data on IP transfers is unavailable, outlined the arm's-length and amortisation rules, and described tightened ruling practice and transfer-pricing audit approaches while refusing to create new amortisation limits.
Information on transfers of intellectual property to the Netherlands from countries on the Dutch list of low-tax jurisdictions is not available because it does not appear from the tax returns.

2 Informatie over verplaatsingen van intellectueel eigendom naar Nederland vanuit landen die zijn opgenomen op de Nederlandse lijst met laagbelastende jurisdicties 3 is niet voorhanden omdat dit niet uit de aangiften naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Snels over het bericht dat het kabinet €2 miljard per jaar kan besparen op diabeteszorg (voor type 2) door betere, meer duurzame en goedkopere diabeteszorg

Greens MPs Ellemeet and Snels asked whether the government would pursue lifestyle medicine and demedicalisation to cut type 2 diabetes costs, and how this fits budget rules and prevention commitments. The minister responded that lifestyle interventions can help but their savings are not yet proven, pointed to a ZonMw research programme of 1 million euro, said GLI is in the basic package and expects further steps via the Preventieakkoord, and promised an inventory with stakeholders by year end.
I want to work with relevant field parties to inventory why certain lifestyle interventions (e.g. interventions for diabetes) are not getting off the ground or are not being scaled up.
Ik wil samen met betrokken veldpartijen inventariseren waarom bepaalde leefstijlinterventies (bijv. interventies bij diabetes) niet van de grond komen of niet worden opgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het bericht dat  KLM medeoprichter is van een maatschappij die vluchten tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil verzorgen

MPs Kröger and Snels asked whether the government knows KLM co-founded Air Antwerp, a Antwerp-London flight venture, and how this fits KLM's talks on phasing out short flights. The minister confirms awareness, says the Antwerp-London route falls outside the Dutch phase-out process, and promises to urge the sector to favour rail on short routes.
The fact that KLM holds a minority interest in the new airline Air Antwerp, which wants to (re)open the Antwerp-London route, does not detract from the above process.

Het feit dat de KLM een minderheidsbelang heeft in de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Air Antwerp – die de route tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil (her)openen – doet geen afbreuk aan het bovengenoemde proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de arresten van het Hof van Justitie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance how the 26 February 2019 CJEU Danish judgments on abuse of EU tax directives affect Dutch conduit companies, dividend withholding exemptions, substance requirements, tax rulings and state aid. The State Secretary answers all 25 questions at length, largely affirming the CJEU's abuse criteria, accepting that substance rules may need revision, committing to review rulings and to a future withholding tax on interest and royalties, while declining to confirm several positions and deferring some matters to national courts.
The cabinet is studying these judgments thoroughly, but already establishes that the national power to combat abuse is certainly not unlimited.
Het kabinet bestudeert deze arresten grondig, maar stelt in ieder geval nu al vast dat de nationale bevoegdheid om misbruik te bestrijden zeker niet onbegrensd is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Snels over ouders die met de staatssecretaris in gesprek gaan over de problemen in het kader van CAF-11 (Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators 11), waarover de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Snels asked the State Secretary of Finance, in written questions, about the childcare benefit (CAF-11) problems, the individual talks with affected parents, whether parents can bring an advisor, whether talk reports will be shared, and safeguards such as full file access, representation and time to consider offers. The State Secretary answered that parents may bring someone, that talk notes will not be shared given their personal nature but a summary will be provided, and that parents get file access and may be represented, while the advisory commission was asked to advise on time to consider offers and confidentiality clauses.
Given the personal nature of the conversations, I do not consider it appropriate to share the verbatim notes with your House.
Gezien het persoonlijke karakter van de gesprekken vind ik het niet gepast om de woordelijke notities met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht ‘Open letter on climate-related financial risks’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the finance and economic affairs ministers how they respond to a central bank open letter with four recommendations on climate-related financial risks, and whether the government will engage with the NGFS and open up climate data. The minister answers that the recommendations are valuable and largely in line with government policy, citing DNB stress tests, the Klimaatakkoord, and EU and international initiatives, while stating that the NGFS is a central bank network in which ministers are not directly involved.
I therefore strongly advocate, together with DNB and the AFM, at European and international level for integrating climate risks into banks' risk management and supervision.
Ik maak mij dan ook – samen met DNB en de AFM – in Europees en internationaal verband hard voor het integreren van klimaatrisico’s in het risicobeheer van banken, alsmede in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Snels over de totstandkoming van de bizar lage raming van de kosten voor verlaagde bijtelling in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord

MPs Omtzigt and Snels asked whether the Finance Ministry checked the low cost estimate for the reduced company car tax addition (bijtelling) for electric cars in the draft Climate Agreement, and how a realistic estimate could be made. The state secretary answered that the figures come from the CARbonTAX model and are plausible, that behavioural effects explain the low 2030 cost, and that annual monitoring and a 2023 evaluation of car taxation are planned.

The cabinet considers it essential to monitor annually so that timely adjustments can be made if signals of overstimulation, unbalanced distribution of burdens, or too limited room for manoeuvre for the Dutch motorist appear.

Het kabinet acht het van essentieel belang om jaarlijks te monitoren zodat tijdig kan worden bijgestuurd bij signalen van overstimulering, onevenwichtige lastenverdeling en een te beperkt handelingsperspectief voor de Nederlandse automobilist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over het Eerlijk Pensioenlabel

MPs Smeulders and Snels asked ministers about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ranking of Dutch pension funds' sustainability policies, including the methodology, the poor grades, lagging disclosure, follow-up under the IMVB convenant, and whether climate reporting should be mandatory. The government defended the pension funds' own responsibility, pointed to the IMVB convenant and existing reporting duties, declined to assess the study's methodology, and said the sector would be given time to improve before any further regulation.
It is not for the government to assess the methodology of the research, nor to assess the outcomes of the research or come up with alternative grades.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de methodologie van het onderzoek te beoordelen, noch om de uitkomsten van het onderzoek te beoordelen of met alternatieve rapportcijfers te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels, Sneller, Bruins en Nijboer over de ING-witwasaffaire

Four MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his ministry suggested wording to DNB on its letter about the ING money-laundering case, whether it steered answers, and how ministerial responsibility for DNB is exercised. The minister answered that his officials only asked clarifying questions, that DNB decides its own wording, that he holds only system responsibility for DNB, and that he was first informed of the case on 31 August 2018.
DNB is independent in carrying out the tasks assigned to it as an independent administrative body: it judges individual cases autonomously and is not subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

DNB is onafhankelijk in de uitvoering van de taken die haar als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zijn opgedragen: zij oordeelt zelfstandig over individuele gevallen en is niet ondergeschikt aan de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Snels en Nijboer over ING als huisbankier van de Staat

MPs Bruins, Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister when he learned of legal options to terminate state contracts with ING after the money-laundering settlement, why the September letter did not explain them, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered that legal options were mapped from September 2018, advice was finalised in late September, the Chamber received the analysis in earlier answers, and a further letter on additional exclusion and termination grounds was sent with this answer.

Simultaneously with answering these questions, I am informing your Chamber by letter about the possibilities of including additional exclusion grounds in new tender procedures for payment services and about additional termination grounds in contracts.

Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze vragen informeer ik uw Kamer per brief over de mogelijkheden voor het opnemen van aanvullende uitsluitingsgronden bij nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedures betalingsverkeer en over aanvullende opzeggingsgronden in overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de zwarte en grijze lijst van belastingparadijzen

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the EU blacklist and greylist of tax havens, including the Oxfam Novib report, which countries were proposed for listing, Switzerland and EU member states' compliance, and whether the government would vote for the proposal. The State Secretary answered that the Council conclusions of 12 March 2019 contain the lists, that ten countries were added to the blacklist, that the government supports the conclusions as a significant step, and that monitoring will continue.
That is why I consider it important to find a balance between informing properly on the one hand, and doing justice to the nature and possible sensitivity of the decision-making on the other.
Daarom acht ik het van belang om een balans te vinden tussen het goed informeren enerzijds, en recht te doen aan de aard en mogelijke gevoeligheid van de besluitvorming anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het recente onderzoek ‘Taxing Aviation Fuels in the EU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about a CE Delft study on taxing aviation fuel in the EU, including legal obstacles, revenue estimates, CO2 effects and synthetic kerosene. The State Secretary answered that Chicago Convention and EU energy tax rules constrain a kerosene tax, estimated revenue of roughly 500-750 million euro, and said effects on demand depend on many factors requiring further study.
At the international conference on CO2 pricing and flight taxes that I am organising on 20 and 21 June, a kerosene tax will also be discussed.
Tijdens de internationale conferentie over CO 2 -beprijzing en vliegbelastingen die ik organiseer op 20 en 21 juni a.s. zal ook over een kerosinebelasting worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over Nederland als fiscaal doorsluisland en het nieuwe rulingbeleid

MP Snels asks whether the Netherlands functions as a conduit state for profit flows to tax havens, how a conditional withholding tax and economic nexus test would work, and whether rulings should be published in full. The State Secretary answers that conditional withholding tax and nexus requirements are being introduced, that publishing summaries of rulings is preferred over full anonymised publication, and that enforcement and EU-level measures are being pursued.
I am therefore also working on many legislative amendments to tackle tax avoidance.
Ik ben daarom tevens bezig met vele wetswijzigingen om belastingontwijking aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked why the cabinet's estimate of a 108 euro rise in household energy bills differs from the CBS figure of 334 euro, and whether the cabinet will correct its distributional and purchasing-power estimates using CPB findings. The minister attributes most of the gap to market price assumptions and differing energy-use assumptions, says current inflation data give no reason to doubt the purchasing-power figures, and promises a CPB analysis of the Klimaatakkoord income effects and to improve information with PBL, CBS and others.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a clear view of how energy costs affect different households.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om goed zicht te houden hoe de energielasten neerslaan bij verschillende huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Alkaya, Snels en Bruins over het bericht dat banken financiering van fossiele energie niet hebben teruggebracht

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks and insurers still invest far more in fossil energy than in renewables, and about the transparency and comparability of financial institutions' climate investments. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to DNB monitoring, the sector's climate commitment within the Klimaatakkoord, and EU sustainability disclosure work, without committing to new mandatory reporting rules.
At the request of a motion by MPs Snels and Sneller, I have asked DNB to continue monitoring the Dutch financial sector's exposures to CO2-intensive sectors.
Ik heb DNB, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Snels en Sneller 3 , gevraagd de uitzettingen van de Nederlandse financiële sector op CO 2 -intensieve sectoren te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de impact van belastingverdragen

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance about an ActionAid report claiming that Dutch tax treaties cause developing countries to lose large amounts of withholding tax on dividends and interest, and proposes fairer treaty negotiation, transparency and a UN model minimum. The government rejects the report's mechanical method and conclusions, says it will keep pushing for fair allocation of taxing rights, and promises to return on treaty assessment tools and explore data on inflows.
Just like the authors of the technical report, I do not have the micro data that would be needed to answer this question.
Net zo min als de opstellers van het technische rapport beschik ik over de micro data die nodig zouden zijn om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Nijboer over de grootste belastingfraude in de Europese geschiedenis

MPs Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about the CumEx dividend tax fraud, including prosecutions, bank involvement, the Belastingdienst's systems and whether Dutch dividend stripping continues. The government answered that it cannot judge the Dutch share or the scale abroad, referred to an ongoing OM investigation, said the Belastingdienst does not systematically track fines, and outlined limits on enforcement due to the heavy burden of proof, with a commitment to inventory dividend stripping practices.
As the cover letter shows, situations of dividend stripping also occur in the Netherlands.
Zoals blijkt uit de aanbiedingsbrief doen zich in Nederland ook situaties van dividendstripping voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister whether ING, the state's house bank, remained eligible in tender procedures after a recent OM transaction under article 74 of the Criminal Code, and whether this should affect future tenders. The minister answered that the transaction is not a final conviction, so no mandatory exclusion ground applies, ING may still bid, and stricter anti-money-laundering criteria will be considered in upcoming tenders, including the credit card contract and a planned reassessment before any 2020 extension.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister how ING's admission of structural anti-money-laundering violations fits with its role as the state's house bank, whether it meets the sustainability criteria, whether contracts can be terminated, and whether evaluation moments exist. The minister replied that the tenders were carefully drafted, ING still meets the criteria, the contract allows termination for specified breaches, and periodic review occurs, while stating a transaction under the Criminal Code offers no basis for terminating the contract.
The requirements and wishes in the tender were at the time carefully and adequately formulated.
De eisen en wensen in de aanbesteding zijn destijds zorgvuldig en adequaat geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de ongevallenverzekering voor Deliveroo bezorgers

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Deliveroo's free accident insurance for couriers signals employer status and disguised self-employment, whether the Tax Authority will enforce, and whether clarity is needed to prevent a race to the bottom. The minister answered that employer status is for courts to decide case by case, that tax confidentiality bars comments on individuals, that the government will tackle disguised self-employment through new rules, and that enforcement against the most serious bad-faith cases continues, with a broader scope from 1 July 2018.
No statements can be made about individual taxpayers under article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen kunnen op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘IT-controleurs: te weinig investeringen in cyberbeveiliging’

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked whether accountant reports give enough attention to cybersecurity and ICT, whether rules exist requiring accountants to check companies' cybersecurity measures, and whether supervision should assess effectiveness. The state secretary agreed cybersecurity matters, pointed to existing audit-related rules and the NIS Directive, and said the government prefers to leave organisations free to choose their own instruments.
I want to give organisations further room for now to choose for themselves the right instruments to make their business cybersecure.
Ik wil organisaties verder vooralsnog de ruimte geven om zelf de juiste instrumenten te kiezen om hun bedrijf cybersecure te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

Green-Left MP Snels asks the State Secretary of Finance to answer earlier questions one by one about abolishing the dividend tax, its employment effects at Unilever, who benefits, and whether foreign treasuries gain most. The State Secretary largely defers to a forthcoming bill, argues the measure is part of a fiscal package for the investment climate, and says the net revenue mostly flows to foreign investors and governments, which cannot be quantified precisely.
It is therefore my preference in such situations to refer to the forthcoming bill, so as to keep the risk of incomplete and/or incorrect answers as small as possible.
Het heeft daarom mijn voorkeur om in dergelijke situaties te verwijzen naar het aankomende wetsvoorstel, om zo het risico op onvolledige en/of foutieve antwoorden zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het afschaffen van de dividendbelasting

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Ministry about the employment and investment effects of abolishing the dividend tax, the Unilever headquarters move, and internal civil-service and CPB analyses questioning the policy. State Secretary Snel answered that the government cannot quantify employment effects, sees the dividend tax abolition as part of a broader fiscal package for the investment climate, and disputed several analyses, while not providing quantified beneficiary breakdowns.
The cabinet has no direct insight into Unilever's personnel policy.
Het kabinet heeft geen direct zicht op het personeelsbeleid van Unilever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het informeren van de Kamer

The MP asks the Prime Minister why he answered the earlier questions generally and whether the Chamber should be informed before the media about plans and reports, and whether ministers have a media strategy. The Prime Minister answers that the Chamber may rely on receiving relevant information before the media, that existing working agreements with the Chamber's clerk were reconfirmed, and that these agreements already set out how and when the Chamber is informed, without committing to new measures.
The Chamber could and can, as a starting point, rely on receiving relevant information before the media report on it, insofar as the cabinet controls this.
De Kamer mocht en mag er als uitgangspunt op vertrouwen dat zij – voor zover het kabinet dat in de hand heeft – de beschikking krijgt over relevante informatie voordat media daarover berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de zwarte en grijze lijst van belastingparadijzen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance why Bahrain, the Marshall Islands and Saint Lucia were not explicitly flagged for removal from the EU blacklist of tax havens, and about transparency of the Code of Conduct Group's procedures, commitment letters, sanctions and the Dutch response. The State Secretary answered that the EU list procedures are confidential but Dutch pressure led to publication of list changes after Coreper, that 35 jurisdictions have consented to publishing their commitment letters, and that Dutch measures (withholding taxes, CFC rules) will target listed or low-tax jurisdictions.
The formal procedures of the Code of Conduct Group state that the work of the Code of Conduct Group is confidential.
De formele procedures van de Gedragscodegroep stellen dat het werk van de Gedragscodegroep vertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het informeren van de Kamer

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he stands by his earlier statement that parliament must be informed before the media, and how he assesses two recent cases where journalists received information about the tax rulings report and the Petten nuclear waste funding before parliament. The Prime Minister answered yes to the first question and, on the rest, only restated the general principle that parliament should be informed as quickly as reasonably possible under article 68 of the Constitution, without addressing the specific cases or committing to any measure.
This includes that the government informs the chambers as quickly as reasonably possible about relevant matters.
Daarbij hoort dat de regering de Kamers zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk informeert over relevante zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het bericht 'mining taxes’ van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a SOMO report alleging that Rio Tinto-linked Dutch and Luxembourg conduit companies avoided large taxes in Mongolia and Canada, and asked about treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse rules, withholding taxes and conduit companies. The government answered that no treaty negotiations with Mongolia are ongoing, committed to BEPS-compliant anti-abuse provisions and to excluding conduit companies from investment-treaty protection, and said it would pursue treaty abuse firmly.
The cabinet considers it desirable that only investors carrying out substantial business activities in the Netherlands can use Dutch investment agreements.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk dat enkel investeerders die substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten in Nederland verrichten, gebruik kunnen maken van Nederlandse investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het verslag van de Ecofinraad van 23 januari 2018

MP Snels asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Ecofin agenda item on delisting eight jurisdictions from the EU tax blacklist, why commitments by Panama and others were accepted despite being vague, and whether the minister would press for more transparency. The State Secretary admitted the item was added as an A-item late and that Parliament should have been informed via an agenda supplement, promised to flag expected listing changes in future agendas, defended the adequacy of the commitments, and said that secret assessment details cannot be shared but some correspondence was published and further transparency pleas were made.
It would have been better if Parliament had been informed through a supplement to the annotated agenda of this change to the agenda.
Het was beter geweest als uw Kamer door middel van een aanvulling op de geannoteerde agenda op de hoogte was gebracht van deze wijziging van de agenda
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het belastingverdrag Nederland Malawi

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked whether the government will ratify the 2015 Netherlands-Malawi tax treaty without reopening it, whether Malawi's requested changes are being negotiated, and whether anti-abuse provisions are adequate given an ActionAid report on treaty abuse costing Malawi USD 27.5 million. The State Secretary answered that Malawi's requested changes were not taken up, that ratification should proceed with a later amending protocol, that main purpose tests exist, and that the MLI can bring the treaty in line with BEPS.
The cabinet therefore proposed to Malawi that, as is customary, ratification of the tax treaty be completed and that negotiations on an amending protocol follow.

Derhalve heeft het kabinet in zijn reactie aan Malawi voorgesteld om, zoals gebruikelijk is, de ratificatie van het belastingverdrag af te ronden en daarnaast te gaan onderhandelen over een wijzigingsprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het stellen van hogere kapitaaleisen aan leningen voor fossiele investeringen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether higher capital requirements should apply to loans for fossil investments and whether a green supporting factor should be resisted. The minister answered that capital rules serve prudential purposes and should not be used to steer investment, that other policy options are more effective, and that the government will not push for higher capital requirements on fossil lending.
No, capital requirements serve a prudential purpose and should not be used for other policy objectives.
Nee, kapitaaleisen dienen een prudentieel doel en moeten niet ingezet worden voor andere beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het schaduwbancaire stelsel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about the repo market and shadow banking: its role in the 2008 crisis, its size, its regulation, the failure of banks, and the FTT. The minister answers that the market has been made more transparent under SFTR, that international work continues, that bank failure frameworks exist, and that the Netherlands opposes an FTT.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het feit dat de EU steeds meer ‘vuile’ kolenstroom importeert

Two GreenLeft MPs asked whether the EU's growing net import of coal-generated electricity should be curbed by a carbon border levy, and whether the Netherlands will champion one. The government responded that it is positively curious about a Commission-planned carbon border adjustment mechanism, pending a proposal in 2021, but gave no firm timeline, design, or commitment to lead.
The willingness to take a leading role on a CBAM will depend on the further development of the Dutch position.
De bereidheid een voortrekkersrol ten aanzien van een CBAM te vervullen, zal afhangen van de verdere uitwerking van de Nederlandse positie.

m: Motie van de leden Van Nispen en Palmen over een landelijk dekkend netwerk voor mensen met sociaal-juridische problematiek
Asks the government to propose how a nationwide network of low-threshold legal-social help points, building on the Huis van het Recht, could be established, with a timeline.
Motie van de leden Palmen en Van Nispen over een brief over de stand van zaken rond de aanbevelingen van de commissie-Silvis
Asks the government to send parliament a letter on implementing the Silvis commission's recommendations on reducing dependence on one law firm, and to hire more in-house lawyers and use other firms.
requests the government to send the House a letter on the state of implementation of the Silvis commission's recommendations
verzoekt de regering om aan de Kamer een brief te sturen met daarin de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van de commissie-Silvis
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de Nationaal Rapporteur Verslavingen toegang verlenen tot dezelfde data als de Kansspelautoriteit zodat deze onderzoek kan doen naar gokgedrag en gokverslaving
Asks the government to give the National Rapporteur on Addiction access to the same gambling data the Gambling Authority holds, to enable research on gambling behaviour.
requests the government to grant the National Rapporteur on Addiction access to the same data as the Gambling Authority
verzoekt de regering de Nationaal Rapporteur Verslavingen toegang te verlenen tot dezelfde data als de Kansspelautoriteit
Motie van het lid Palmen over met de resterende middelen van de envelop Groepen in de knel de aanmanings- en incassokosten bij boetes verlagen
Asks the government to use remaining funds to lower reminder and collection costs on traffic fines, which burden vulnerable people.
requests the government to include this in the Spring Memorandum and cover it within remaining funds
verzoekt de regering om dit te betrekken bij de Voorjaarsnota en dit te dekken binnen de resterende middelen
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over samen met gemeenten de vinger aan de pols houden ten aanzien van de kinderarmoededoelstelling
Asks the government, with municipalities, to monitor the child poverty target closely and inform the House in time if it is at risk.
requests the government, together with municipalities, to keep a close watch on the child poverty target, and to inform the House in time if it is at risk
verzoekt de regering samen met gemeenten de vinger aan de pols te houden ten aanzien van de kinderarmoededoelstelling, en de Kamer tijdig te informeren als deze in gevaar dreigt te komen
Motie van het lid Palmen c.s. over een onderzoek naar een algemene grondslag voor gegevensdeling in het belang van de burger om de actieve toekenning van inkomensrechten verder vorm te geven
Asks the government to study a general legal basis for government data sharing to actively grant income entitlements, which would widen the state's access to citizens' data.
