requests the government to investigate which general legal basis, such as article 20 of the Constitution in conjunction with article 2:1 of the General Administrative Law Act, could be used as a GDPR basis for data sharing

verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken welke algemene grondslag, zoals artikel 20 van de Grondwet juncto artikel 2:1 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht, als AVG-grondslag gebruikt kan worden voor gegevensdeling
Motie van het lid Palmen over de Kamer vooraf informeren over een voornemen om uitgaven te doen die een bepaalde omvang overschrijden en niet in de begroting zijn opgenomen
Asks the presidium to inform the Chamber in advance of planned unbudgeted spending above a set threshold.
requests the presidium to inform the House of Representatives in advance of the intention to make expenditure exceeding a certain, to be determined, amount that is not included in the budget

verzoekt het presidium om de Tweede Kamer vooraf te informeren over het voornemen om uitgaven te doen die een bepaalde, nader vast te stellen, omvang overschrijden en niet in de begroting zijn opgenomen
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over de aanbevelingen van de parlementaire enquêtecommissie Fraudebeleid en Dienstverlening met voorrang, voortvarend en concreet uitwerken
Asks the presidium or the Werkwijze committee to implement the parliamentary enquiry's recommendations on Parliament's own role and working methods, with priority, this calendar year.
to elaborate the PEFD recommendations with priority, expeditiously and concretely
de aanbevelingen van de PEFD met voorrang, voortvarend en concreet uit te werken
Motie van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Palmen over voldoende aandacht voor brede kennis en vaardigheden over de democratische rechtsstaat in het opleidingsaanbod voor ambtenaren
Asks the government to examine broadening civil servants' training so that knowledge of the democratic rule of law receives attention alongside professional skills.
requests the government to examine how the training offer for civil servants can be broadened
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe het opleidingsaanbod voor ambtenaren kan worden verbreed
Motie van het lid Van Oostenbruggen c.s. over aandacht voor het EU-perspectief op de waarborging van de democratische rechtsstaat in het onderzoek van de Staatscommissie rechtsstaat
Asks the government to ensure the Staatscommissie rechtsstaat research explicitly considers the EU perspective on protecting the democratic rule of law and citizens' rights.
requests the government to explicitly devote attention in the Staatscommissie rechtsstaat study to the EU perspective on safeguarding the democratic rule of law
verzoekt de regering om in het onderzoek van de Staatscommissie rechtsstaat expliciet aandacht te besteden aan het EU-perspectief op de waarborging van de democratische rechtsstaat
Motie van het lid Palmen over een wezenlijke sanctiebepaling indien overheidsinstanties niet voldoen aan de wettelijke eisen voor archiefbeheer
Asks the government to propose a substantive sanction provision that the Information and Heritage Inspectorate can impose on government bodies that repeatedly fail archive management requirements.
a substantive sanction provision that the Information and Heritage Inspectorate can determine and impose if government bodies fail to meet archive management requirements after repeated pressure.

een wezenlijke sanctiebepaling, die door de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed kan worden bepaald en opgelegd indien na herhaaldelijk aandringen via de huidige methodes overheidsinstanties niet voldoen aan de wettelijke eisen voor archiefbeheer
Motie van het lid Palmen over de mogelijkheid verkennen om een chatapplicatie te ontwikkelen voor ministers en ambtenaren voor zakelijk gebruik
Motion asking the government to explore a dedicated secure chat application for ministers and officials for business communication, to aid archiving and security.
requests the government to carry out an exploration of developing a chat application along French lines
verzoekt de regering een verkenning uit te voeren naar de mogelijkheid om naar Frans model een chatapplicatie te ontwikkelen
Motie van het lid Palmen over binnen vier weken een volwaardig archief van de chatberichten van de minister-president opleveren
Asks the government to deliver within four weeks a complete, searchable archive of the Prime Minister's chat messages, approved by the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage.
requests the government to deliver within four weeks a full archive of the Prime Minister with approval by the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage
verzoekt de regering om binnen vier weken een volwaardig archief van de Minister-President op te leveren met accordering door de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Eijk over schijnzelfstandigheid bij de UHT

MPs Aartsen and Van Eijk (VVD) asked whether the UHT childcare benefits recovery body stopped working with self-employed contractors from 1 April 2025, why it withdrew its offer to pay fines for intermediaries, and how it assesses bogus self-employment under the Deliveroo criteria. The government answered that UHT still uses self-employed workers where legally possible, applies an internal risk framework, withdrew the fine-compensation offer after tax-compliance concerns, and sees no legal-certainty problem.
As you know, your House asked the government to implement as well as possible the motion of 1 October 2024 by MP Boon (PVV).
Zoals bekend heeft uw Kamer de regering gevraagd om zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de Kamermotie van 1 oktober 2024
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over het artikel 'Rechter wijst meer dan ?500.000 toe aan gedupeerde vader in toeslagenaffaire'

Three NSC MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling awarding over 500,000 euros to a victim of the childcare benefits scandal, and about the handling of supplementary damages claims, appeals, lawsuits and payouts. The State Secretary answered in detail with figures on claims, decisions, appeals, pending cases and penalty payments, while noting the Van Dam advisory commission's findings are still awaited and the ruling is under study.
The cabinet has made agreements with municipalities, OTB and IPW for referring parents for urgent assistance.
Het kabinet heeft afspraken gemaakt met gemeenten, OTB en IPW voor het aandragen van ouders voor urgentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Van Nispen over het schenden van het verschoningsrecht door het OM

MPs Palmen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's breach of legal professional privilege in the Castor case, the settlement with Stibbe and an asset manager, the role of the landsadvocaat, and a disciplinary ruling on the landsadvocaat. The minister answered that the OM acknowledged a procedural error, that the Supreme Court filled a legal gap, that a new OM directive and a chain project are underway, and defended the landsadvocaat's good faith while answering most questions substantively.
The OM acknowledges that this constitutes a procedural irregularity.
Het OM erkent dat hier sprake is van een vormverzuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over het artikel 'Overheid verzaakt plicht om transparant te zijn: ’U wilt die informatie zeker niet meer hè?’'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether ministries breach the statutory Woo deadlines for freedom-of-information requests, why, and whether journalists are asked to withdraw requests as outdated. The minister confirms that all ministries miss the deadlines, attributes this to structural causes, defends contacting requesters as permissible, and announces measures, an evaluation brought forward and a dashboard.
In this context, I consider it permissible and desirable to contact Woo requesters about their requests.
In dit kader acht ik het toegestaan en wenselijk om over Woo-verzoeken in contact te treden met Woo-verzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Omtzigt en Palmen over het artikel ‘Landsadvocaat krijgt waarschuwing voor rol in fraudezaak’

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a disciplinary warning given to the state's chief lawyer (landsadvocaat) from Pels Rijcken over handling privileged emails in the fraud case, and about integrity safeguards in the state's contract with the firm. The Minister answered that the warning was the lightest sanction, that he did not believe the lawyer acted contrary to his duties, that the emails should have been removed promptly, and that the issue would be raised in administrative consultations with the firm.
I regret that these emails were not removed from the file directly when it became clear that they concerned information covered by legal privilege.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat deze e-mails niet direct uit het dossier zijn verwijderd toen duidelijk werd dat het verschoningsgerechtigde informatie betrof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Palmen, Ceder en White n.a.v. Beleidsreactie ACOI-rapport over de openbaarheid van de Bijlmervliegramp-stukken en het feit dat openbaarheid jaren op zich laat wachten door vertra

MPs Jansen, Palmen, Ceder and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Bijlmer air disaster archive remains largely closed years after the 2023 motion and why the government is commissioning external studies before acting on the ACOI recommendations. The minister defends the sequencing as driven by scarce expertise and procedure, outlines timelines and planned studies, and says access to the audio material was delayed by equipment and digitisation needs.
The aim is to have the study on recommendation 4 completed in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is het onderzoek naar aanbeveling 4 in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de conceptenrichtlijn

MPs Palmen and Six Dijkstra asked the Interior Minister whether earlier answers on draft documents under the Woo transparency law were correct, including a nota showing a ministry applied a blanket draft-exclusion policy. The minister acknowledges the 2022 Woo instruction was too strict, leading to routine refusal of drafts, that it was revised in July 2024, and that a study of Woo implementation costs will start, but denies the Chamber was deliberately misinformed.

As previously stated in the letter to the House of 12 February 2024, the Woo instruction appeared stricter than intended, so that in practice drafts were refused more often than they should have been.
Zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 12 februari 2024 oogde de Woo-instructie strakker dan bedoeld, waardoor in de praktijk concepten vaker werden geweigerd dan zou moeten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over "het hanteren van een te lage beslagvrije voet voor ouderen bij de verrekening van schulden"

An MP asked why the SVB keeps applying a beslagvrije voet to AOW recipients that the Centrale Raad van Beroep and a district court found too low, and whether the government will raise it. The state secretary answers that the SVB now uses two calculation methods, that no specific increase for AOW recipients is justified by the new research, and that the rules will not be changed for this group, though the government will reconsider the wider system.
In the reconsideration requested by the CRvB, I therefore conclude that nothing will be changed in the Regulation on this point.
In de door de CRvB gevraagde heroverweging kom ik dan ook tot de conclusie op dit punt in de Regeling niets te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Palmen over de artikelen 'Zeventig plekken in Limburg erbij voor woonwagenbewoners, maar die zijn er lang niet allemaal blij mee: ‘Lijkt op chantage'' en 'Rechter oordeelt dat G

MPs Zeedijk and Palmen asked the minister about press reports on new caravan pitches in Limburg and a court ruling that The Hague discriminates against caravan dwellers, and about antiziganism, the value of caravan camps, federal monitoring and a standplaatsenbeleid vision with municipalities. The minister answered that antiziganism and structural obstacles slow pitch creation, that the government is monitoring development and supporting municipalities, and that a 2018 policy framework was delivered in response to the Ombudsman.
The stigma must therefore be combated, because discrimination is not permitted.
Het stigma dient dan ook bestreden te worden, omdat discriminatie niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi en Palmen over mankementen in het huidige boetesysteem in Nederland

MPs Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi and Palmen asked the Justice Minister about problems in the Dutch traffic fine system, including imprisonment for unpaid fines (gijzeling), debt, child welfare effects, insurance fines, proportionality of escalating reminders, and the possibility of income-dependent fines. The Minister answered that gijzeling is subject to judicial review and that payment arrangements exist, but declined to adopt income-based fines, a 30% reduction, or a maximum of 150 euro, citing costs and burden on the criminal justice chain, while promising a WODC evaluation and a ministry study on escalation.
We cannot entirely rule out that children were placed out of home at the time because their parent was imprisoned for non-payment.
Wij kunnen niet geheel uitsluiten dat kinderen destijds uit huis zijn geplaatst doordat hun ouder werd gegijzeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Palmen  over antisemitisme

MPs Omtzigt and Palmen asked the Justice Minister for a list of all antisemitic incidents over four weeks, the concrete actions taken and the number of people fined, arrested or prosecuted, and for answers within a week. The minister gave partial counts from anti-discrimination bodies and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, said a full case-level overview would be disproportionate to produce now, and referred the request for incident overviews to CIDI.
The full overview requested, with the manner of follow-up, requires case-level research.
Het door u gevraagde volledige overzicht met de wijze van opvolging vergt onderzoek op zaaksniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Palmen over een sociaal veilige werkomgeving voor Rijksambtenaren

MPs Chakor and Palmen asked about a FNV manifesto and report alleging bullying, harassment and weak accountability for misconduct at the Ministry of VWS, including whether managers are sidelined and whistleblowers protected. The Minister says the ministry takes the signals seriously, cites a 2022/2023 staff survey, a new survey started in March 2024, whistleblower protections and rijksbrede initiatives, while rejecting claims of a cover-up culture.
A new staff survey (started 11 March 2024), specifically on social safety and conduct, will hopefully give a sharper and more complete picture of the problems and direction for additional actions.

Een nieuw uit te voeren medewerkersonderzoek (gestart op 11 maart 2024), specifiek gericht op het thema sociale veiligheid en omgangsvormen, geeft hopelijk een scherper en completer beeld van de problemen en richting voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen en Omtzigt over een advies van de landsadvocaat

MPs Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen and Omtzigt asked why the landsadvocaat's advice on the childcare benefits affair was released late, what changed between two versions of the letter, and how the 'Heidi' logging system worked, when it breached GDPR and how it linked to the Fraud Signalling Facility. The State Secretaries answered that the version was not final, explained Heidi's purpose and its suspension in 2017 and December 2023, and promised a further letter within three weeks on wider Tax Authority use of Heidi.
Your House will be informed within 3 weeks at the latest about how other parts of the Tax and Customs Administration used Heidi, for what purposes and which data were processed.
Uw Kamer wordt uiterlijk over 3 weken geïnformeerd over hoe andere onderdelen van de Belastingdienst gebruik hebben gemaakt van Heidi, voor welke doeleinde en welke gegevens hierbij verwerkt werden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de SGO-instructie dat conceptdocumenten categorisch niet verstrekt moeten worden

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether a secretaries-general meeting instruction categorically withholds draft documents from parliament and Woo requesters, and whether that is lawful under the Constitution and the Woo. The State Secretary denied categorical withholding, said drafts require a case-by-case assessment of relevant factual information, and promised to clarify the instructions.
Blanket refusal of drafts without this test is not permitted, and that is also not what was agreed in the SGO.
Integrale weigering van concepten zonder deze toets is niet toegestaan en dat is ook niet zo gewisseld in het SGO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Idsinga over het artikel 'Aantal huishoudens met schulden door toeslagen in vijf jaar verdubbeld'

Two MPs asked the government about a news report that the number of households with problematic debts from childcare and other benefit allowances (toeslagen) doubled in five years, and about the causes, support for affected households, and the future of the allowance system. The State Secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the pause in toeslag debt collection during COVID and to rising allowance payments, outlined support measures and the upcoming final report on the future of the system, and declined to give a firm timetable for quick fixes.
The cabinet has announced that from 2025 the 27-year age limit for first-degree blood relatives in the allowance partnership will be abolished.
Het kabinet heeft aangekondigd om per 2025 de 27-jaarsgrens voor eerstegraadsbloedverwanten in het toeslagpartnerschap af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Palmen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether political leadership was fully informed and gave green light before an Iranian sabotage operation reported by Volkskrant, and whether the legal powers exist for digital sabotage. The minister declined to discuss operations or the information given to the Prime Minister, citing secrecy, and pointed to parliamentary oversight via the CIVD and the CTIVD and to the legal basis for disruption measures.
Because of the mentioned duty of secrecy, the information provided to the Prime Minister cannot be addressed in public.
Vanwege de genoemde plicht tot geheimhouding kan in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op de informatievoorziening aan de Minister-President.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over de opvolging van de aanbevelingen bij het rapport “De archivering van chatberichten bij het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken”

An MP asks the Prime Minister about follow-up to the inspectorate's report on archiving chat messages at the Prime Minister's ministry, including the ministry's placement under enhanced supervision, the new document management system, and whether the Prime Minister's chats are archived systematically and searchably. The government answers that the ministry is under enhanced supervision and that chats are now stored in the document system, but largely defers to the national approach, leaves key questions on systematic and verifiable archiving without a concrete timeline, and points to pending legislation and ongoing market research.
As I reported in my response to the Inspectorate's report, I have not deleted any chat messages since the end of May 2022, and they are retained for safekeeping and archiving.
Zoals ik heb gemeld in deze reactie op het Inspectierapport verwijder ik sinds eind mei 2022 geen chatberichten meer en worden deze bewaard ten behoeve van veiligstelling en archivering.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de hersteloperatie

Ergin (DENK) asks the State Secretary for Finance how she reconciles her claim that nobody can say no one has been helped with thousands of childcare-benefit victims still waiting, struggling mentally or in poverty, and why the recovery operation repeats past failures and fails ex-partners, relatives and victims abroad. The State Secretary answers that nearly all parents received compensation and that remaining gaps are being addressed through new damage routes, a mental-health hub, a government-VNG agreement extending broad support and a budget extension, while largely rejecting the charge of repeating past patterns.
In the recovery operation the parent's story is leading and the starting point for compensation is generosity.
In de hersteloperatie is het verhaal van de ouder leidend en is het uitgangspunt voor compensatie ruimhartigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceulemans over personen die ten onrechte als gedupeerde zijn aangemerkt en gecompenseerd in het kader van de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how many people were wrongly classed as victims and compensated in the childcare benefits scandal, whether recovery of compensation will occur, and what the status is of the Auditdienst Rijk investigation. The State Secretary answered that the audit examines only the completeness and correctness of the mailing records, that compensation will not be reclaimed except in cases of evident fraud, and that the findings will be sent to Parliament with his response once the investigation is completed, without giving a figure for the number or cost of wrongful compensation.
Once the investigation is completed, I will send the Chamber the investigation report, including my response.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond zal ik de Kamer het onderzoeksrapport, inclusief mijn reactie, doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jimmy Dijk over de voortgangsrapportage Hertsteloperatie Toeslagen

MP Jimmy Dijk asked why the government rejects a legal basis for sharing data between UHT and DUO to map student debts of children affected by the childcare benefits scandal, and why alternative methods, including a CBS study, were not pursued. The State Secretary refused the data sharing as disproportionate since no generic debt-relief scheme will be introduced, pointed to the existing children's scheme and DUO facilities, and said no further exploration of alternatives is opportune.

Data sharing between UHT and DUO would only provide insight into the amount and number of student loans of affected young people, not into whether those loans are the result of the childcare benefits scandal.
Gegevensdeling tussen UHT en DUO zou uitsluitend inzicht geven in de hoogte en de aantallen studieleningen van getroffen jongeren, niet over of die leningen het gevolg zijn van de toeslagenaffaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Door angst voor schijnzelfstandigheid worden wachtlijsten bij UWV nog langer'

VVD MPs asked why UWV is ending contracts with self-employed occupational physicians over fear of sham self-employment, whether this reflects tax enforcement, and how it fits motions to avoid categorical exclusion of freelancers. The government answers that UWV no longer hires physicians as freelancers due to sham-self-employment risk, that the Tax Authority enforces risk-based and has lifted its moratorium with a soft landing, and that freelancers still work at UWV in some domains.
The Tax Authority cannot, under its duty of confidentiality, answer whether enforcement has taken place against occupational physicians working on UWV assignments.
De Belastingdienst kan op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht niet beantwoorden of van handhaving sprake is bij verzekeringsartsen die in opdracht van UWV werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de Hersteloperatie Kindertoeslagen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about two court rulings (Rotterdam 2024, Midden-Nederland 2025) that found the Dienst Toeslagen must assess compensation for all years on a parent's file, whether telephone applications are still accepted, and how the government will avoid unnecessary litigation against victims of the childcare benefits scandal. The State Secretary accepted the rulings, said no appeal was lodged, confirmed telephone applications are no longer accepted because the deadline has passed but were confirmed in writing when they were, and stated the aim is generous compensation and avoiding litigation against parents.
The Dienst Toeslagen partly for this reason chose not to lodge an appeal in the two mentioned court cases.
Dienst Toeslagen heeft mede hierom ervoor gekozen om geen hoger beroep in te stellen in de twee genoemde rechtszaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het rapport 'Rechtsbescherming in het geding – Onderzoek informatieverstrekking aan de rechter, deel 2'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretaries of Finance about the Inspectorate IBTD report finding a 'win the case' culture at the Tax Administration, structural shortcomings in information provision to courts, a poorly ordered information management, and whether a monitoring team for appeals and safeguards at the UHT are needed. The government rejects generalising five cases to a structural failure, points to improvement measures and a forthcoming analysis and status letter, and says the appeal monitoring team was judged not to add value.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Haage over het bericht ‘Bij de hulporganisatie voor toeslagenouders heerst een onveilig werkklimaat’

MPs Dijk and Haage asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report of an unsafe work climate at the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT), including shouting, discrimination, unwanted advances, and derogatory remarks about affected parents. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems as unacceptable, described the Berenschot investigation and follow-up measures such as team sessions and workshops, but declined to extend the investigation to other UHT locations.
I deeply regret that in some situations there may have been hurtful talk about the childcare benefits affair and/or the parents concerned.
Ik betreur het zeer dat in enkele situaties mogelijk op een kwetsende wijze is gesproken over de toeslagenaffaire en/of de betreffende ouders.
Antwoord op vragen aan van het lid Teunissen over de uitvoer van honden door het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Customs records exports of live animals, including dogs, by destination and exporter, and how many dogs were exported to Israel and whether the Ministry of Defence exported dogs since October 2023. The government answered that Customs holds export declarations but dogs fall under a general animal code, reported 4,435 dogs exported worldwide in 2024 (93 to Israel), found no Defence dog exports, and declined to give exporter or recipient details citing privacy rules.
Due to privacy regulations, Customs unfortunately cannot provide data concerning the exporter or recipient.
Vanwege privacy voorschriften kan de Douane u helaas geen gegevens verstrekken die zien op de exporteur of ontvanger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over DUO-schulden van getroffen kinderen

An SP MP asked how many children recognised as affected by the childcare benefits scandal currently have or have had DUO student debt, their average and total debt, the cost of automatic write-off, and how much maatwerk compensation they received. The State Secretary replied that no data exist because the Wet Hersteloperatie Toeslagen gives no basis for sharing data on affected children, that the cabinet will not create a separate debt scheme, and that a write-off would be complex and maatwerk use by this group is not tracked.
Data on any DUO debts of this specific target group are therefore not available.
Gegevens van eventuele schulden bij DUO van deze specifieke doelgroep zijn daarom niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk en Haage over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland ECLI:NL:RBGEL:2024:7601 en het bericht op LinkedIn van 16 januari 2024

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Gelderland court ruling that a toeslagen victim is entitled to free legal aid for broad support, and why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand appealed. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad filed a pro forma appeal to clarify the legal question, and argued that gemeentelijke brede ondersteuning falls under the normal Wrb income criteria.

On appeal, the question is whether there is an entitlement to free legal aid, regardless of income or assets, under the Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

In hoger beroep staat ter discussie of er aanspraak bestaat op kosteloze rechtsbijstand, ongeacht inkomen of vermogen, op grond van de Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het interview in de Volkskrant van 22 januari 2025

MP Dijk (SP) asks the State Secretary of Finance to explain and reflect on interview remarks about possible misuse of the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation and a 'real versus unreal victims' framing, and whether changing the law on penalty payments would prolong procedures. The State Secretary stands by her remarks, says she did not use the 'real and unreal victims' framing, commits to sending the underlying documents on possible legal changes, and says the recovery operation's objective is to speed up and improve it.

qa: This item is a list of dozens of written parliamentary questions from various MPs that the government has declared lapsed, because they were answered otherwise or are no longer considered opportune to answer. Since no substantive questions are answered, the government gives no answers on the merits.
The questions below are to be considered lapsed.
Onderstaande vragen dienen als vervallen te worden beschouwd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Hennis-Plasschaert en Verheijen over het veiligheidsrisico van Chinese telecomproducenten

Three VVD MPs asked the government whether Chinese telecom producers pose a security risk to Dutch critical infrastructure, what steps will be taken to map such risks, and whether KPN and others will be questioned. The minister answers that vulnerabilities are a conceivable risk but there is no direct evidence of espionage use, that intelligence services remain alert and will warn relevant parties if concrete indications emerge, and that the matter will be raised actively with companies.
For the time being there is a conceivable risk, but there are no direct indications that these vulnerabilities are actually being used for espionage purposes.
Vooralsnog is hier sprake van een voorstelbaar risico, maar zijn er geen directe aanwijzingen dat deze kwetsbaarheden daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt voor spionagedoeleinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een mogelijke preventieve aanval op Iran

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers whether the Netherlands had been approached about, or assisted in, preparations for a possible preventive attack on Iran, and whether legal advice existed on its legality. Minister Timmermans answered that the Netherlands had not been approached or assisted, that the British internal legal advice is not known to him, and that internal legal advice on pre-emptive action remains confidential.
Internally, written advice has been given on international legal questions concerning possible pre-emptive or preventive action.
Intern is schriftelijk geadviseerd over volkenrechtelijke vragen met betrekking tot mogelijk preëmptief of preventief optreden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over Eritrese praktijken

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked about Eritrean consulate practices of taxing diaspora Dutch nationals with threats of withheld services, and whether international law and UN Security Council resolution 1907 were breached. The minister says extraterritorial taxation is not itself contrary to the Vienna Conventions, extortion is unacceptable and existing law suffices, that no further investigation of the arms embargo question is needed now, and that complaints depend on victims filing reports, with anonymity only conditionally possible.
Once a report has been filed, the police under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service will investigate it.
Zodra er aangifte is gedaan zal de politie onder leiding van het OM daar onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over WOTS-verzoeken uit Panama

MP Marcouch asked whether Dutch prisoners in Panama seeking transfer under the WOTS are routinely refused, on what grounds, and whether agreements with Panama exist. The minister answers that requests are assessed individually, that transfer requires roots in the Netherlands and at least four months of remaining sentence, that all six 2012 and one 2011 Panama requests were refused for insufficient remaining sentence, and that Panama is bound only by the Council of Europe transfer convention, with no further agreements needed.
All requests made from Panama in 2011, namely one, and so far in 2012, namely six, were rejected by the Netherlands because the remaining sentence was insufficient.
Alle aanvragen die in 2011, te weten één, en tot op heden in 2012, te weten zes, vanuit Panama zijn gedaan zijn door Nederland afgewezen omdat er een onvoldoende strafrestant was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de toegang van de VS tot data in de cloud

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether the US access to cloud-stored data of Dutch users, including protected data, is a problem and whether the government will advise against cloud use and consult US and EU counterparts. The state secretary replied that the risk is known, that responsibility lies primarily with data controllers, that no advice against cloud use is needed, and that the issue is being raised in EU negotiations on the data protection regulation.
I consider this an undesirable situation. This problem is known within the European Union, and the proposal for a General Data Protection Regulation seeks to offer a solution.
Ik acht dit een onwenselijke situatie. Dit probleem is bij de Europese Unie bekend, en het voorstel voor een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming poogt daarvoor een oplossing aan te reiken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse targeted killings

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the legality of US targeted drone killings in Pakistan, Yemen and Somalia, including signature strikes, attacks on rescuers and funerals, and UN recommendations. The minister said international humanitarian law may apply in an armed conflict with Al Qaida, that the legal framework is clear enough, that internal legal advice was received, and that she would not press US allies for a moratorium.
Regarding specific attacks in the countries concerned, I do not have the factual information needed to give a responsible judgement on their legality.
Ten aanzien van specifieke aanvallen in betreffende landen beschik ik niet over de feitelijke informatie die nodig zou zijn om een verantwoord oordeel te kunnen geven over de rechtmatigheid ervan.
qn: Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van Amerikaanse drone aanvallen voor de burgerbevolking van Pakistan

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths and harms from US drone strikes in Pakistan, citing a Stanford/NYU report, and whether the US should compensate, be more transparent, or halt strikes. The minister answered that the US acknowledges some civilian deaths but gives no figures, that Dutch data on civilian deaths cannot be verified, that compensation and proportionality are matters for the US, and that no moratorium will be pursued, though more US transparency is welcomed.
I am in favour of greater openness about such strikes.
Ik ben voorstander van meer openheid over dergelijke aanvallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de ontvoering van de Nederlandse fotojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two British nationals linked to the kidnapping of Dutch photojournalist Jeroen Oerlemans, Turkish intelligence's role in his release, and whether the government evaluated the case. The minister confirmed cooperation with British police, declined to discuss the arrestees' involvement because the British investigation is ongoing, denied receiving any Turkish confidentiality request, and said the case was reviewed without any policy change.
Since the arrests took place at the request of the British authorities and the investigation there is still ongoing, I cannot give any information on this.
Aangezien de aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden op verzoek van de Britse autoriteiten en het onderzoek aldaar nog loopt kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over een Amerikaanse waarschuwing voor Chinese telecombedrijven

SP MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked whether the Netherlands would act on a US warning that Chinese telecom firms Huawei and ZTE pose a security risk and may pass information to China, and what Dutch authorities do about it. The government replied that the public part of the US report gives no reason to change its stance, that the non-public part has not yet been received, that Huawei and ZTE are active in the Netherlands, that no Chinese espionage via this equipment has been established, and that no further US cooperation is currently needed.
We do not yet have access to the non-public part of the report and therefore cannot yet assess the conclusions from it, or their underpinning.
Wij hebben op dit moment nog niet de beschikking over het niet-openbare gedeelte van het rapport en kunnen de conclusies daaruit – en de onderbouwing daarvan – dus nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de zaak van de heer Van Bilderbeek

An SP MP asked whether the 2009 confidential lawyer's report on the Colombian trial of Mr Van Bilderbeek would be made available to him and to parliament. The minister answered that the report was refused under the Wob, but in exceptional circumstances it was sent to Mr Van Bilderbeek and made available confidentially to MPs without precedent.
By way of a very exceptional measure, I am prepared to provide the report of the trusted lawyer to Mr Van Bilderbeek
Bij wijze van hoge uitzondering ben ik bereid het rapport van de vertrouwensadvocaat aan de heer Van Bilderbeek te verstrekken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het rapport “Trading Away Peace: How Europe helps sustain illegal Israeli settlements”

An MP asked the foreign minister for a response to a report claiming EU policy helps sustain Israeli settlements, whether he supports correct labelling of settlement products, and the Dutch position on twelve recommendations. The minister replied that the report and its recommendations are being studied, that settlement products must not receive EU tariff preference, that EU labelling rules should be correctly enforced, and that concrete steps will be communicated later.
As soon as it is clear which steps the Netherlands can take, we will inform your House of Representatives about this.
Zodra duidelijk is welke stappen Nederland kan nemen, zullen wij uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de Commissie voorstelt om Albanië de status van kandidaat-lid te verlenen

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the European Commission's recommendation to grant Albania EU candidate status is misguided, whether pre-accession aid would be wasted, and whether Albania, described as Islamic and corrupt, should be barred from accession. The minister answered that Albania has had an accession perspective since 1999, that pre-accession aid is unrelated to candidate status, and that accession is possible if all strict conditions are met.
If these countries meet all the strict conditions of the enlargement process, they can eventually accede to the EU.
Indien deze landen voldoen aan alle strenge voorwaarden van het uitbreidingsproces, dan kunnen zij op termijn toetreden tot de EU.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de Amerikaanse oproep om de Syrische oppositie te hervormen

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister whether the government, like the US, no longer considers the Syrian National Council worthy of Dutch support, and how it views reports of jihadist strength among rebels. The minister answers that the SNC has reorganised into a more inclusive coalition that he welcomes, acknowledges that the growing number of jihadist fighters is worrying, and pledges continued support for a credible alternative to the Syrian regime.
The Netherlands will, with its allies and through its contacts in opposition circles, provide the necessary support to build a credible alternative to the Syrian regime.
Nederland zal met haar bondgenoten en via haar contacten in oppositiekringen de nodige ondersteuning bieden om een geloofwaardig alternatief voor het Syrische regime op te bouwen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over het bewind in Egypte onder president Morsi

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about press freedom, police violence and an anti-Semitic prayer under President Morsi in Egypt, and whether economic cooperation and arms export resumption were premature given rights concerns. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the Netherlands will urge Egypt on rights and offer rule-of-law support, rejected the hateful rhetoric, and said economic cooperation uses existing instruments and the arms export permits were addressed in a letter of 8 October.
The Netherlands is willing to support Egypt, when asked, in strengthening the rule of law and improving public administration.
Nederland is bereid Egypte desgevraagd te ondersteunen bij versterking van de rechtsstaat en verbetering van openbaar bestuur.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een mogelijk waarnemerschap van Taiwan bij de UNFCCC

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether Taiwan's bid for observer status at the UNFCCC (Doha, 2012) should be supported given Taiwan's high CO2 emissions. The minister answered yes to the factual questions, but said support for Taiwan's observer request cannot be given under the one-China policy, while practical cooperation remains possible.
However, a request from Taiwan for admission as an observer state cannot be supported on the basis of the one-China policy.
Een verzoek van Taiwan tot toelating als waarnemerstaat kan echter niet worden gesteund op grond van het één-China beleid

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over berichten dat volgens een VN ‘Group of Experts’ Rwanda en Oeganda directe militaire steun geven aan guerillastrijders in Congo en over de mensenrechtensitua

MPs Voordewind and Van Dijk asked about a UN Group of Experts finding that Rwanda and Uganda directly arm M23 rebels in Congo, about human rights in Congo and Rwanda, and whether Dutch aid to Rwanda's justice sector should end. The minister said the leaked report cannot yet be fully assessed, that Dutch aid remains suspended without linkage to the Amnesty findings, and that Rwanda's Security Council seat will sharpen scrutiny of its compliance with norms.
Since we have not been able to see the full final report, it is not yet possible to reach a considered judgment on the report or to consider new measures.

Aangezien wij geen kennis hebben kunnen nemen van het volledige eindrapport, is het op dit moment nog niet mogelijk om tot een afgewogen oordeel over het rapport te komen of om nieuwe maatregelen te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat leden van Al Shabaab terugkeren uit Somalië naar onder andere Kenia

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder asked about reports that Al Shabaab fighters are returning from Somalia to Kenya and elsewhere, including whether Dutch nationals are involved and whether Kenyan police corruption hampers counter-terrorism. The minister answered that exact numbers are unknown, cooperation is opportunistic rather than structural, Dutch nationals cannot be excluded, and Dutch support for police training and reform continues.
I do not have exact figures or detailed information on the spread.
Ik beschik niet over exacte aantallen of gedetailleerde informatie over de verspreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Jan Vos en Schouw over geweld in de Braziliaanse sojateelt

MPs Van Gerven, Jan Vos and Schouw asked the government about violence against indigenous peoples and smallholders linked to Brazilian soy farming, and what Dutch action, embassy contact, bank financing and investigation follow-up exists. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy raises indigenous rights with Brazil and supports CIMI, that the Dutch soy sustainability initiatives are supported, that the embassy has no knowledge of a river-dredging study, and that one Dutch bank has a code of conduct and it will report on prosecutor investigations involving Dutch financiers.
Yes, insofar as this concerns Dutch banks and financiers.
Ja, voor zover dit Nederlandse banken en financiers betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de positie van minderheden in Egypte

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Immigration about the treatment of Coptic Christians and other minorities in Egypt, including forced displacement from Sinai, blasphemy prosecutions, unfair military trials, the Maspero investigation and arms exports. The minister answered that the government is pressing Egypt on religious freedom and rule of law, has reviewed internal flight alternatives case by case, and has kept the arms export policy unchanged, without committing to new concrete steps.
The Netherlands urges Egypt to comply with its international obligations, including guaranteeing freedom of expression and freedom of religion or belief.
Nederland spoort Egypte aan tot het naleven van zijn internationale verplichtingen, waaronder het garanderen van vrijheid van meningsuiting en vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanvallen vanuit Syrië op Turkije

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister whether NATO-made ammunition was used in the deadly Syrian attack on Turkey, whether the Syrian regime was responsible for all cross-border attacks, and whether a de facto buffer zone had arisen. Minister Timmermans answered that details on the munitions and origin were not yet available, that the government lacks full insight into the border situation, and that there is no buffer zone.
Further information is currently not available.
Nadere informatie is op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over de aanslag op Denis Mukwege in Congo

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the government would condemn the attack on Congolese gynaecologist and rights defender Denis Mukwege, visit him through the ambassador, and act against attacks on rights defenders in Congo. The minister answered that the attack was condemned, Mukwege and his family were moved to safety at EU expense, and the Netherlands will keep pressing Congolese authorities for better protection.
The Netherlands will continue, together with EU partners, to press the Congolese authorities for better protection of human rights defenders such as Dr Mukwege.
Nederland zal samen met EU-partners bij de Congolese autoriteiten blijven aandringen op betere bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers als Dr Mukwege.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Inbreuken op de mensenrechten in Turkije en een economische regeringsmissie

De Roon (PVV) asks the foreign minister about the conviction of 330 Turkish officers, press freedom and jailed journalists, Erdogan's push for an international ban on Islam defamation, Turkish anti-hate legislation, Islamisation, and an economic mission to Turkey despite its FATF blacklisting. Minister Timmermans answers that Turkey's rule of law, press freedom and minority protections need improvement, that Nederland rejects equating Islam defamation with crimes against humanity, and that the mission fits the ongoing political dialogue with Turkey.
Freedom of expression and press and media freedom need to be better anchored in Turkey.
De vrijheid van meningsuiting en pers- en mediavrijheid dienen beter verankerd te worden in Turkije.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en De Roon over de bloedige onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of lethal force against Papuan demonstrators in Indonesia, whether the government would condemn it, summon the ambassador, support a free press there, and send independent observers. The minister said the 23 October clashes in Manokwari are still under investigation, denied that repression is structural, noted limits on foreign journalists' access, and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights through bilateral contacts and the EU dialogue, but rejected observers and sanctions-style steps.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the human rights situation in Papua and West Papua in bilateral contacts and through the EU human rights dialogue.
Nederland zal in bilaterale contacten en via de EU-mensenrechten dialoog aandacht blijven vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Papua en West-Papua.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Turkije het hoogste aantal journalisten opgesloten heeft

The MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows that Turkey holds the most journalists in prison, how he assesses the Committee to Protect Journalists' findings, whether the EU Commission will be asked to explicitly judge press freedom, whether Article 301 is used to convict them, and whether the topic is raised bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness, said the EU progress report already expresses concern about press freedom, reported that no journalist is currently jailed under Article 301, and said the issue was raised at bilateral meetings in March and April 2012.
This topic deserves and receives my continued attention.
Dit onderwerp verdient en krijgt mijn voortdurende aandacht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Hongerstaking Koerdische gevangenen Turkije

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about a mass hunger strike by about 700 Kurdish prisoners in Turkey, including reports of beatings, isolation, denial of medical access, and whether Kurdish-language defence and education demands are justified. The minister acknowledged the strike, cited the EU Commission's report on uneven prison conditions, relayed Turkish government denials and a ministerial prison visit, supported improving Kurdish minority rights through Turkey's constitutional reform, and promised continued bilateral and EU attention without committing to contacting the Turkish counterpart directly.
The Netherlands will continue to pay attention to the position of the Kurds both bilaterally and together with the European Commission.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als samen met de Europese Commissie aandacht aan de positie van de Koerden blijven besteden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht 'EU-commissaris: EU verder uitbreiden’

An MP asked the foreign minister about EU enlargement, including concerns that Western Balkan accession could bring organised crime to the Netherlands and about press freedom in Turkey. The minister replied that enlargement is not an end in itself, that the Western Balkan states must meet strict conditions with rule-of-law chapters opened first and closed last, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey.
These chapters are only closed once it can be irrefutably established that these countries have built a positive track record on the said subjects.
Deze hoofdstukken worden pas gesloten nadat onomstotelijk kan worden vastgesteld dat deze landen een positief track record hebben opgebouwd op de genoemde onderwerpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over het VN-mensenrechtenexamen (Universal Periodic Review)

An MP asked the foreign minister why civil society was not consulted in time on the UPR human rights review, whether human rights education and the Optional Protocol to the ICESCR will be adopted, and whether an action plan and publicity for the UPR will follow. The minister answered that NGOs were consulted twice and submitted shadow reports, that the recommendations are a government responsibility, that the action plan is being studied, and that human rights education is covered indirectly in the curriculum while the Optional Protocol is delayed pending case law.
Because the decision whether to accept recommendations is a government responsibility, these organisations were not consulted when preparing the government's response to the recommendations.

Omdat de afweging om aanbevelingen wel of niet aan te nemen een verantwoordelijkheid van de regering is, zijn bij de voorbereiding van de kabinetsreactie op de gedane aanbevelingen deze organisaties niet geconsulteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebrek aan toezicht op de naleving van EU sancties tegen Iran

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister why EU Iran sanctions compliance by member states is not supervised, whether Egypt blends Iranian oil, and how Turkey and Switzerland undermine the sanctions, among other questions. Minister Rosenthal answered that enforcement is a national responsibility, that Dutch supervision is assigned to several ministries and agencies, and that the government raises the matter with third countries and within the EU.
Implementation of sanctions, including granting licences and exemptions, enforcement, and communication with third parties about sanctions policy, is a national matter.
Uitvoering van sancties, inclusief het verlenen van vergunningen en ontheffingen, handhaving, en de communicatie met derden over het sanctiebeleid, is een nationale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper Van Dijk over de Navo oefening Steadfast Noon

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the NATO exercise Steadfast Noon, in which the Netherlands participates at Büchel air base, rehearses procedures for deploying tactical nuclear weapons, and whether Dutch participation conflicts with nuclear disarmament policy. The government declined to give details of the exercise citing international agreements, and argued that NATO remains a nuclear alliance while pursuing a world free of nuclear weapons step by step.
Based on international agreements, no statements are made on this matter.
Op basis van internationale afspraken worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over meldingen van misstanden

Van Raak (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether reports of suspected misconduct were assessed for criminal conduct under the BIOS protocol, and whether the facts were established before concluding that reports did not warrant labelling as a misstand. Minister Rosenthal answered that assessment follows a BZ protocol derived from the BIOS guideline, which always includes a check for criminal conduct, and referred to question 1 for question 2.
The assessment took place in line with the BIOS protocol.
Beoordeling heeft plaatsgevonden in lijn met het protocol van BIOS.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht “het weigeren van de toegang tot India van twee begeleiders van het Dendron college uit Horst”

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he was aware that two supervisors of a Horst school were refused entry to India despite valid visas, and whether he would ask the Indian ambassador to explain and correct this. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Indian embassy was willing to explain the refusal to the supervisors, and noted that under international law states have sovereign authority over entry to their territory.
Under international law, states have the sovereign right to grant or deny foreigners access to their territory.
Volgens internationaal recht hebben landen het soevereine recht vreemdelingen al dan niet toegang tot hun grondgebied te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over herziening van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would follow Canada in suspending diplomatic relations with Iran, citing Iran's support for terrorist groups, nuclear programme, Israel rhetoric and human rights record. The minister answered that the government shares concerns and keeps diplomacy and sanctions as the main tools, a communication channel open, and that suspending relations is not the moment to speculate about, though it does not rule options out.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Het kabinet acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vraag van het lid Servaes over het handelsakkoord van de Europese Unie met Colombia en Peru

The MP Servaes asks whether the EU-Colombia-Peru trade agreement contains binding human and trade union rights obligations and enforceable monitoring and sanction mechanisms, and whether the minister will discuss these with the EU trade commissioner. The state secretary replies that the agreement includes a human rights clause and a sustainability chapter with binding ILO-based obligations, a monitoring and dispute settlement mechanism, and suspension possibility as a last resort, and that the agreement has been signed and will be sent to parliament for ratification.
The trade agreement, and therefore every individual provision, is legally binding on the parties that ratify the treaty.
Het handelsakkoord en dus ook iedere individuele bepaling is juridisch bindend voor de partijen die het verdrag ratificeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over herziening van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Iran

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the Netherlands should follow Canada in suspending diplomatic relations with Iran over its nuclear programme, human rights record, support for Syria and Hezbollah. The minister replied that the Netherlands shares concern, keeps a communication channel open, and applies pressure via diplomacy and sanctions, declining to rule out other options.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Het kabinet acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de hulpverlening door Nederlandse diplomaten aan Nederlanders in nood in het buitenland

An MP asked the foreign minister about complaints over how Dutch diplomats treat Dutch nationals in distress abroad, the number and handling of such complaints since 2011, safeguards for humane treatment, and whether mystery guests are used. The minister reported 1305 complaints in 2011 (mostly visa-related, and only 48 on assistance to Dutch nationals), said consular services are reviewed periodically with a client-satisfaction measure planned for 2013, and said the use of mystery guests is being considered.
The use of mystery guests is being considered.
De inzet van «mystery guests» wordt overwogen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de heer Wishnudath Datadin met de Nederlandse nationaliteit in Dubai door twee agenten uit het vliegtuig is meegenomen en dat zijn familie sindsdien niets meer van he

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister whether the government knew that a Dutch national was taken off a flight in Dubai by police and whether the consulate would seek information about his whereabouts and condition. The minister answered that the consulate contacted local authorities, that the man was not arrested, and that his whereabouts were known and communicated to the family.
Mr Datadin has not been arrested.
De heer Datadin is niet gearresteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over aanhoudend geweld bij mijnen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked the government about ongoing violence at Lonmin mines in South Africa, whether the IFC should pressure Lonmin, whether transparency of payments should be mandated, and whether conflict minerals should be restricted. The minister answered that the South African investigation should not be prejudged, pointed to existing OECD guidelines, EITI and Voluntary Principles, said Lonmin cannot be obliged to disclose payments, and noted that EU negotiations on payment reporting are ongoing.
It is better not to anticipate the outcomes of this investigation.
Het is beter niet vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over de reactie van de VN-mensenrechtenraad naar aanleiding van de film "Innocence of Muslims"

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about UN human rights responses to the film 'Innocence of Muslims', arguing that the UN High Commissioner and the European Parliament President should defend free expression rather than condemn the film. The minister replies that courts, not international officials, should judge the film, that free expression must be central, and that the issue was raised with the High Commissioner but no new EU statement is planned.
At this moment a new EU statement is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is een nieuwe EU-verklaring niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een mogelijke bemiddelende rol in de zaak Assange

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands could mediate in the Assange extradition impasse, including whether Sweden refuses to question Assange in the UK or guarantee against US extradition. The minister confirmed there is no formal charge, explained Swedish law offers no pre-extradition guarantee, and declined any Dutch role, citing trust in the legal process between the UK and Sweden.
No, this concerns a case between the United Kingdom and Sweden.
Nee, dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Zweden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over de Gay Pride in Belgrado

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Serbia's ban on the Belgrade Gay Pride and counter-demonstration, and whether progress had been made on protecting sexual minorities. The minister regretted the cancellation, noted low public acceptance, said the Netherlands would press Serbia and that minority rights are weighed in EU accession decisions.

I will ensure in the Council of Ministers of the European Union that the protection and promotion of minority rights are weighed in decision-making on Serbia's further steps in the EU accession process.

Ik zie er in de Raad van Ministers van de Europese Unie op toe dat de bescherming en bevordering van de rechten van minderheden worden meegewogen in de besluitvorming over verdere stappen van Servië in het EU-toetredingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de abortusboot

MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the Women on Waves abortion boat's planned visit to Morocco, where abortion is illegal, risks prosecution, whether the government had contact with Morocco, what permits the foundation holds, its past activities and whether it receives subsidy. The minister answered that the trip is a private initiative, that Morocco regards it as an NGO matter, that the Dutch Waz permit requires a temporary permit and IGZ review for the mobile clinic which the foundation has not requested, and that it receives no ministry subsidy.
However, WoW has not applied for the temporary permit.
WoW heeft de tijdelijke vergunning echter niet aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over de uitgezette Libiër A.F.

MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Immigration about the 2004 expulsion of Libyan Abu Farsan to Sudan, his alleged rendition to Libya, the role of the CIA and MI6, and whether an independent Dutch investigation will be held following Human Rights Watch's findings. The government's answer, sent confidentially to MPs, was delivered by Minister Leers on behalf of both ministers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ormel over het bericht dat de Congolese politicus Diomi Ndongala is ontvoerd en sindsdien spoorloos is

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction and disappearance of Congolese opposition politician Diomi Ndongala and what the government would do to clarify his fate. The minister replied that no further information was available, that the Dutch embassy is in contact with the UN human rights bureau and has asked Congolese authorities for an explanation, and that there is insufficient reliable information to draw conclusions.
I currently have no further information about the situation in which Mr Diomi Ndongala finds himself.
Ik heb op dit moment geen nadere informatie over de situatie waarin de heer Diomi Ndongala zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over mogelijke Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij 'rendition' naar Libië

MP El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Security and Justice and Immigration about alleged Dutch involvement in unlawful rendition of detainees to Libya, including the handling of asylum claimant Abu Farsan, and whether independent investigation would be conducted. Minister Leers answers on behalf of the ministers, but the text provided is cut off before the substantive answers appear, so the responsiveness and commitments cannot be confirmed.
I hereby provide you confidentially with the answers, on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice, to the written questions
Hierbij bied ik u vertrouwelijk de antwoorden*), mede namens de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, aan op de schriftelijke vragen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez over de militaire presentie in Zuid-Libanon van de terroristische organisatie Hezobollah

MPs Kortenoeven and Hernandez asked the foreign minister whether Hezbollah's military buildup in South Lebanon, its role in the Lebanese government, and the limits of UNIFIL under resolution 1701 breach the EU association agreement and Lebanon's responsibilities. The minister answered that Hezbollah is dominant but not sole ruler in the south, that the Lebanese army has deployed there since 2006, that the Netherlands backs EU listing of Hezbollah, and that the government is responsible for weapons control, answering questions 3 and 4 jointly.
The Netherlands, as is well known, advocates listing Hezbollah on the EU list of terrorist organisations and explicitly avoids contacts with Hezbollah-affiliated politicians.
Nederland pleit zoals bekend voor opname van Hezbollah op de EU-lijst van terroristische organisatie en gaat contacten met Hezbollah-gelieerde politici nadrukkelijk uit de weg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over opschorting training van Afghaanse rekruten

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the suspension of training for new Afghan recruits and about rising 'green on blue' and 'green on green' attacks, and whether the Dutch police training mission in Kunduz should be ended early. Minister Hillen answered that the suspension concerns Afghan Local Police trained by US forces, not the Dutch-trained police in Kunduz, that vetting procedures are followed there, and that the government sees no reason to end the mission early.
The cabinet sees no reason to consider early termination or adjustment of the integrated police training mission in Kunduz.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding de vervroegde beëindiging of aanpassing van de geïntegreerde politietrainingsmissie in Kunduz te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de verplaatsing naar Caïro van het hoofdkantoor van de terreurorganisatie Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hamas's headquarters had moved from Damascus to Cairo, and whether Egypt hosting Hamas breaches the EU-Egypt association agreement, and asked for EU pressure to reverse it. The minister replied that according to Egyptian authorities the headquarters had not moved, that Hamas was only considering opening a representation in an Arab capital, and referred back to that answer for the remaining questions.
I refer to the answer to question 1.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in Bahrein

An MP asked the foreign minister about human rights abuses in Bahrain, including UN review recommendations, convicted opposition members, torture reported by a national commission, and tear gas use. The minister said Bahrain accepted most UN recommendations but not ratifying the Rome Statute, that the Netherlands monitors the cases and supports the commission's findings, and that a special UN Human Rights Council session lacks sufficient support.

The Netherlands closely follows developments concerning the convicted human rights defenders in Bahrain and endeavours to point the Bahraini authorities to the need for a transparent and fair legal process.

Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen inzake de veroordeelde mensenrechtenverdedigers in Bahrein op de voet en spant zich in om de Bahreinse autoriteiten te wijzen op de noodzaak van een transparante en eerlijke rechtsgang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de celstraffen van drie Vietnamese bloggers

MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the prison sentences of three Vietnamese bloggers, whether other members of the Club for Free Journalists face similar risks, and whether the government will raise the case bilaterally and at EU level. The minister said the sentences conflict with international free-expression obligations, knows of no similar cases, and that the EU High Representative and the Netherlands have urged Vietnam to respect free expression and release the bloggers.
Bilaterally and within the EU I press for respect for freedom of expression and in particular internet freedom in Vietnam.
Bilateraal en in EU-verband dring ik aan op het respecteren van de vrijheid van meningsuiting en in het bijzonder internetvrijheid in Vietnam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ormel en Knops over de uitspraken van de Amerikaanse president Obama over eventueel militair ingrijpen in Syrië

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about President Obama's statements on possible military intervention in Syria if chemical weapons are used, and about the risk to the region, the position of Christians, and Turkey's proposal for a buffer zone. The minister confirmed awareness, called the chemical weapons situation worrying, said the Netherlands supports international involvement, and declined a buffer zone for now as lacking a legal basis.
The cabinet, like partners such as the US and UK, sees the Turkish proposal as an extreme measure that is currently not on the agenda.
Het kabinet, evenals partners als de VS en het VK, ziet het Turkse voorstel als een uiterst middel dat momenteel niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ferrier over schending van het wapenembargo en sanctieregime door de Rwandese regering

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the foreign minister whether the government considers the UN Group of Experts' findings that Rwanda violated the DRC arms embargo by supporting the M23 rebels to be serious, how it weighs Rwanda's denial, and what consequences and steps follow for development relations and donor pressure. The minister answered that the findings are worrying, that Rwanda's response and the final report will be weighed, that bilateral sectoral budget support has been suspended and multilateral budget support postponed, and that the Netherlands continues consultations with international partners.
The Netherlands has put on hold the decision on granting bilateral sectoral budget support to the Rwandan government.
Nederland heeft de beslissing over het verlenen van bilaterale sectorale begrotingssteun aan de Rwandese overheid aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over uitlatingen van scheidende Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kigali

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the outgoing ambassador to Rwanda was right to say the Netherlands had not suspended aid and that Rwanda's rebuttal of the UN experts' report was satisfactory, and about the consequences for Congo and Uganda. The minister confirmed the remarks were made to the press without judging Rwanda's reply, said Dutch sectoral budget aid remains on hold pending the final UN Group of Experts report, and that no EU partner or the US has lifted measures yet.
The Netherlands has put on hold the decision on granting bilateral sectoral budget support to the Rwandan government.
Nederland heeft de beslissing over het verlenen van bilaterale sectorale begrotingssteun aan de Rwandese overheid aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over schending door Eritrea van het VN wapenembargo

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the government about Eritrea's reported 2% diaspora tax funding its military in apparent breach of the UN arms embargo, and whether such practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister said the tax is not judged to breach the embargo, that police and prosecutors depend on victim complaints, that the Eritrean chargé was summoned, and that the issue is raised in EU fora.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de 'diaspora-belasting' voor Eritrese Nederlanders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Eritrean government forces Eritrean-Dutch citizens to pay a 2% diaspora tax, whether the funds finance al-Shabaab, and what action would be taken. The minister confirmed the tax is collected via Eritrean embassies and consulates, that police and prosecutors act on complaints, that the UN Monitoring Group found no evidence of Eritrean support to al-Shabaab, and that the Eritrean chargé d'affaires was summoned.
To establish whether offences such as extortion are at issue, the police and the Public Prosecution Service depend largely on reports and complaints from victims.

Voor het vaststellen of misdrijven als afpersing en soortgelijke delicten aan de orde zijn, zijn politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door de slachtoffers.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de praktijken van het consulaat van Eritrea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Eritrean consulate in The Hague extorts Eritrean Dutch nationals through a 2% income levy, whether refusers are threatened or denied consular services, and what the government will do, including possible expulsion of the consul or closure. The minister answered that the levy itself is not illegal in the Netherlands, that police and prosecutors will investigate any reported extortion or intimidation, that protest would be lodged if abuses are confirmed, and that sanctions would be considered if criminal conduct is found, while declining to pre-empt those steps.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over het bericht dat energiebedrijven nog steeds niet openbaar maken of ze bloedkolen gebruiken

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether Dutch energy companies disclose whether they use coal linked to human rights abuses, including coal from Drummond mines in Colombia, and what the coal dialogue has achieved. The state secretary answered that self-regulation via the coal dialogue is preferred, that energy companies proposed only aggregated disclosure of mines citing commercial sensitivity, and listed interim dialogue results with the dialogue expected to run to end 2012.
Information on the specific suppliers of coal to energy companies is, according to the latter, commercially sensitive.
Informatie over de specifieke leveranciers van steenkolen aan energiebedrijven is, volgens laatstgenoemden, commercieel gevoelig.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het Eritrese consulaat Eritrese Nederlanders afperst

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether the Eritrean consulate extorts Eritrean Dutch nationals through a 2% levy and threats, whether it obstructs integration and civil society in Amersfoort, and whether Dutch firms trade with Eritrea. The minister answered that the levy and festival fundraising are not illegal in themselves, that criminal conduct would be investigated on the basis of complaints, that the government will raise the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and that no data exist on Dutch trade with Eritrea.
To establish whether offences such as extortion are at issue, the police and the public prosecution service depend to a large extent on reports and complaints from the victims.

Voor het vaststellen of misdrijven als afpersing en soortgelijke delicten aan de orde zijn, zijn politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door de slachtoffers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gedwongen uithuwelijking van een Nederlands meisje in Somalië

An MP asked ministers whether they were aware of the case of a Dutch girl forced into marriage in Somalia and abandoned there, how the embassy handled her case, and whether a Forced Marriage Unit like the British one should be set up in the Netherlands.
