The government answered that embassy assistance is limited by foreign legal systems, declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, and said an analysis of options, including the British model, will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
In view of the protection of the privacy and safety of S., we cannot go into the individual case.
In verband met de bescherming van de privacy en veiligheid van S. kunnen wij niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Bommel over het martelen van een Molukse demonstrant

MPs Voordewind and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that Moluccan prisoner Johan Teterissa was beaten, denied medical care, moved without notice and held despite peaceful protest. The minister said the mistreatment reports are not confirmed by independent sources, that the government raised past abuse with Indonesia, and that it raises prisoner treatment and sentences bilaterally and within the EU, without committing to a specific request for release.
I raise both bilaterally and within the EU the treatment of prisoners and the heavy sentences imposed on persons who peacefully express their political views, including Mr Teterissa.

Ik vraag zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband aandacht voor de behandeling van gevangenen en de hoge straffen die zijn opgelegd aan personen die op geweldloze wijze hun politieke opvatting ventileren, onder wie de heer Teterissa.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over financiering van Nigeriaanse veiligheidstroepen door Shell

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the government will hold Shell to account for funding Nigerian security forces linked to alleged human rights abuses and whether this conflicts with the Voluntary Principles, which the Netherlands chairs. The minister answered that the government raises these issues with Shell regularly, that Shell says it applies the Voluntary Principles, and that the government presses Nigeria to endorse them, while transparency reporting is left to participants themselves.
For the implementation of the VPs and communication about it with stakeholders, the participants in the VPs, including Shell, are themselves responsible.
Voor de invulling van de VP’s en de communicatie daarover met belanghebbenden zijn de deelnemers aan de VP’s, waaronder Shell, zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de betrekkingen met de Islamitische Republiek Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister how she assessed Canada's severing of diplomatic relations with Iran, whether this related to Iran's support for the Syrian regime and incitement against Israel, and whether the Netherlands would revise its own relations with Iran. The minister said the government noted Canada's decision and understood it as a response to Iranian threats, but that keeping a diplomatic channel open with Iran was important, so the Netherlands would not revise relations.
No. The government considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Nee. De regering acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over meldingen van misstanden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether written reports of suspected misconduct and possible criminal acts by ministry officials in 2008-2010 were received, whether they were classed as suspected misconduct under the integrity rules, and whether they were investigated independently. The minister confirmed reports were received, that 13 officials and 31 local staff were disciplined, that the content did not warrant classing them as suspected misconduct, and that investigations applied hearing both sides and inspection of relevant documents.
If the outcome of the investigation gives cause for disciplinary follow-up, the legal-status framework for employment forms the starting point.
Als de uitkomst van het onderzoek aanleiding geeft tot een disciplinair vervolg dan vormen de rechtspositionele kaders daarvoor het uitgangspunt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

GroenLinks MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands should admit Syrian refugees given the strain on Turkey and neighbouring countries, and whether he would press EU partners on this. The minister replied that refugee relief should remain in the region, that the Netherlands has offered extra support to host countries, and that the refugee issue was raised at the Gymnich meeting, without committing to admitting refugees.
Refugee reception should take place in the region.
Opvang van vluchtelingen dient in de regio te gebeuren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Ormel over het ‘volledig schrappen van financiering van het Institut Néerlandais’

MPs Van der Werf and Ormel asked why the subsidy to the Institut Néerlandais in Paris was fully ended from 2015 after earlier announcing a cut, and about the loss of its partnerships, its role hosting scholars, and its heritage value. The minister replied that the Custodia foundation rejected cost-reduction proposals, so the subsidy will not be renewed after the current period, with a new, cheaper cultural model planned for France.
Thereupon I have decided not to extend the subsidy after the end of the current subsidy period.
Daarop heb ik besloten de subsidie na afloop van de huidige subsidie periode niet te verlengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Pechtold over ‘Subsidiestop van het Institut Néerlandais’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister why the subsidy to the Institut Néerlandais in Paris would be stopped, whether its closure was justified, and whether the decision should wait for a new cabinet. The minister answered that the subsidy ends on 1 January 2015 because shared overhead and rent could not be reduced and a modernised model is needed, and refused to postpone the decision.
For that reason I have decided to end the subsidy to the IN as of 1 January 2015.
Om die reden heb ik besloten de subsidie aan het IN per 1 januari 2015 te beëindigen.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over het bericht dat het Eritrese consulaat in Den Haag Eritrese Nederlanders afperst

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister how the government responds to reports that the Eritrean consulate in The Hague extorts a 2% diaspora tax from Eritreans in the Netherlands, what it knew and did, and whether it will raise the issue with Eritrea and allies. Minister Rosenthal answered that extortion is unacceptable, that the tax itself is not illegal in the Netherlands, that prosecution depends on victims filing complaints, that the Eritrean chargé was summoned on 16 August, and that the matter is being raised within the EU.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de toegenomen spanningen tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

An ChristenUnie MP asked the foreign minister about rising tensions between Armenia and Azerbaijan, including Azerbaijan's pardon and hero status for convicted murderer Ramil Safarov, and what Dutch and EU steps were taken. The minister answered that the events harm regional stability, that the EU and Netherlands call for restraint, and that the OSCE Minsk Group is the proper forum, with the EU supporting confidence-building measures.
The government has urged Azerbaijan at the highest level to show restraint in the conflict with Armenia over Nagorno-Karabakh.
De regering heeft in Azerbeidzjan op het hoogste niveau aangedrongen op terughoudendheid in het conflict met Armenië over Nagorno Karabach.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een 11-jarig meisje met Down Syndroom vanwege schending van de blasfemiewet in Pakistan

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of an 11-year-old girl with Down syndrome under Pakistan's blasphemy law, and whether the Netherlands would seek her release, press Pakistan to repeal or reform the law, and continue funding a legal aid NGO. The minister answered that the girl was released on bail, Pakistan's government ordered an inquiry and an imam was arrested, the Netherlands raised concern discreetly with the EU and via quiet diplomacy, and the embassy already funds a legal aid project for 2011–2013.
For security reasons, the Netherlands, like the EU and the Pakistani government, acts very discreetly in such cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen handelt Nederland evenals de EU, en ook de Pakistaanse overheid, zeer discreet in dergelijke zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over het slopen van sloppenwijken voor de Olympische Spelen in Rio de Janeiro

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked whether the displacement of about 8,000 people for the Rio Olympics is acceptable and whether the government will raise it internationally, and what has been done on the NGO/sports-body conduct code motions and FIFA/IOC responsibility. The minister answered that the number cannot be verified, housing is offered, no international raising is planned for now, an EU expert group will report by end 2012, and that FIFA/IOC cannot be held responsible for host governments' choices.
An exact number cannot be determined.
Een exact aantal valt niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over de Gay Pride in Belgrado

MP El Fassed asked the Foreign Minister whether the Belgrade Gay Pride, banned at short notice in 2011 over security concerns, would be protected in 2012, whether the Dutch government would press Serbia, and whether Serbia's decision should affect EU accession talks. The minister replied that the ambassador has conveyed the message to Serbian authorities, that the government has raised it with Serbian ministers, and that Serbia's treatment of minorities is part of the EU Copenhagen criteria, with the Commission's progress report addressing the LGBT situation.
The Dutch ambassador in Belgrade has conveyed this message to the Serbian authorities in recent weeks.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Belgrado heeft deze boodschap in de afgelopen weken overgebracht aan de Servische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Nederlandse investeringen in leveranciers aan het Syrische regime

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch financial institutions investing in firms supplying monitoring technology to the Syrian regime breach EU sanctions and what the government will do. The government answered that there is no indication of violation by the named firms, so no concrete measures are planned, while describing existing enforcement and supervision of sanctions.
There are no indications that the institutions named in the Profundo research have violated this regulation; there is therefore no direct reason for concrete government measures.

Er zijn geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat de in het onderzoek van Profundo genoemde instellingen deze verordening hebben overtreden; er is daarom geen directe aanleiding voor concrete maatregelen door de overheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez over het bewapeningsprogramma van Turkije

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about press reports on Turkey's ballistic missile programme and whether it conflicts with NATO's collective approach, and whether the government will raise it at the next NATO defence ministerial. The minister answered that Turkey has announced intentions for a missile interceptor and satellite capability, no formal decisions have been taken, such capabilities are also of NATO interest, and there is no reason to see it as a signal of drifting from transatlantic cooperation, so he sees no reason to raise the issue at NATO.
No formal decisions have yet been taken on this.
Hierover zijn nog geen formele besluiten genomen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

MP De Roon asks whether the Dutch shipping sector's use of armed private security guards aboard vessels, absent a legal basis, is acceptable, and whether the government will guarantee affordable, flexible naval protection or legislate for certified private guards. The minister answers that the government prioritises naval Vessel Protection Detachments, will keep monitoring level-playing-field effects and may consider further measures, while stating that the current demand for VPDs is below capacity and that Defence does not compete commercially with private firms.
The cabinet will examine whether, and if so which, additional measures, such as a further reduction of the shipowners' contribution, are needed.
Het kabinet zal bezien of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen, zoals een verdere verlaging van de bijdrage van de reders, nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Nederlandse hulp bij tankdeal met Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked whether the government granted an export licence for a Leopard 2 tank used in Saudi Arabian trials, whether it was a lease, whether parliament was informed, and whether arms-export criteria were applied. The Defence Minister answered that the tank remains Defence property on loan to KMW, that no sale or export occurred so no licence or criteria test was needed, and that parliament was not separately informed.
There is no agreement with Saudi Arabia that would have to be tested in any way.
Er is geen sprake van een overeenkomst met Saoedi-Arabië die op enigerlei wijze zou moeten worden getoetst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over berichten dat Indonesië mogelijk van Duitsland Leopard-tanks wil kopen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia may buy surplus German Leopard tanks, and why negotiations were not halted after a parliamentary motion, and whether a parliamentary rejection counts as a denial notification to EU states. The government answered that it considers the sale possible within export policy, that it ended negotiations after a parliamentary majority opposed the deal, and that a parliamentary rejection is not itself a denial notification since only negative licence decisions under the EU criteria are notified.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “over de campagne tegen huwelijksdwang”

An MP asked ministers whether the state adequately protects women facing forced marriage, marital captivity and abandonment, including criminal law, consular aid, registration, and whether a UK-style Forced Marriage Unit should be set up. The government answered that existing criminal provisions, civil-court routes, Steunpunt Huiselijk Geweld and embassy help suffice for now, that data registration will be assessed in 2013, and that an analysis including a possible unit will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
To offer more effective help in cases of abandonment and forced marriage, the cabinet is currently making an analysis of the problem and of possible solutions.
Om slagvaardiger hulp te bieden bij gevallen van achterlating en huwelijksdwang maakt het kabinet op dit moment een analyse van de problematiek en welke oplossingen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanslag in de Sinaï bij de grensovergang Rafah

An MP asked the foreign minister about Egyptian Brotherhood claims that Mossad was behind the August 2012 Sinai attack near the Rafah crossing, the position of President Morsi, the Sinai security situation, and pipeline attacks. The minister answered that the Brotherhood's claims rest on Israeli travel warnings, that Egyptian authorities blame terrorist elements, that Sinai security has deteriorated with military intensified, and that the latest pipeline attack was on 22 July 2012.
The security situation in Sinai has deteriorated over the past year.
De veiligheidssituatie in de Sinaï is het afgelopen jaar verslechterd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de Jordaanvallei

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about an Oxfam Novib report on how Israeli settlement policy and movement restrictions in the Jordan Valley harm Palestinian livelihoods, and whether the government will press Israel to halt settlement construction and demolitions. The minister confirms awareness of the report, attributes the valley's socio-economic lag partly to Israeli security restrictions and partly to other factors, calls settlements illegal under international law, and says the Netherlands has urged Israel to stop settlement construction in EU and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands advocates this both within the EU and bilaterally.
Nederland draagt – in EU-verband en bilateraal – dit uit.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de nieuwe oproep van de president van de Islamitische Republiek Iran tot vernietiging van de Joodse staat Israël alsmede over mogelijk subversieve activiteiten van Iraanse amb

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Ahmadinejad's renewed call for Israel's destruction, whether it constitutes incitement to genocide, and possible subversive activity by Iranian embassies. The minister condemned the remarks as unacceptable, said prosecution at the ICC is not possible since Iran has not ratified the Statute, and said the Netherlands and EU have repeatedly rejected such statements and will not attend such speeches.
The recent statements attributed to President Ahmadinejad are reprehensible and completely unacceptable.
De recente, aan president Ahmadinejad toegeschreven uitlatingen zijn verwerpelijk en volstrekt onacceptabel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een dodelijke aanval door piraten op een schip bij Nigeria

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly pirate attack on a ship off Nigeria that resulted in four kidnappings, and how such an attack could happen despite navy protection. The government said it has no information on the Nigerian navy's role, does not see a need for Dutch naval protection of merchant ships, and points to industry self-protection measures.
Regarding the circumstances and how it happened, the Nigerian authorities have so far made no statements.
Over de toedracht en de omstandigheden hebben de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten tot dusver geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de beslissing van de EU om de Israëlische stad Modiin uit te sluiten van het EU Associatieakkoord

MP De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU's exclusion of Modiin from the EU-Israel Association Agreement was counterproductive and a breach of contract, and whether the government would oppose it. Minister Rosenthal answered that the agreement does not cover settlement products beyond the Green Line, that there is no breach, and that the Netherlands does not support trade sanctions as a tool in the Middle East peace process.
Products from the settlements fall outside the territorial scope of the agreement.
Producten uit de nederzettingen vallen buiten de territoriale werkingssfeer van het akkoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de opdracht van opperste leider Khamenei om aanslagen te plegen op Westerse doelen

The MP asks whether reports that Supreme Leader Khamenei ordered terror attacks on Western targets should be treated as a declaration of war, how the government responded, and whether Iranian embassy staff in The Hague should be cut to a minimum with others expelled. The minister answers that no such order has been established, that the government will raise the matter in EU context if the reports are confirmed, and that the Vienna Convention leaves staff composition largely to the sending state.
It has not been established that such an order was actually given by Ayatollah Khamenei.
Er is niet vastgesteld dat een dergelijke opdracht daadwerkelijk door Ayatollah Khamenei is gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink over eerherstel voor drie mariniers

Two PvdA MPs asked whether three marines convicted in 1948 for refusing to burn a kampong should receive full rehabilitation and be held up as examples of integrity. The minister replied that the courts found the burning militarily necessary, that no facts justify revising that judgment, that the marines were pardoned and partly restored, and that judging them by today's standards would not be careful.
However, I do not consider it prudent to reassess the conduct of these marines against today's standards and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het echter niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van deze mariniers te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over de behandeling van mensen in Nederlandse en Nederlands-Indische overheidsdienst die indertijd hebben geweigerd mee te doen aan de politionele acties

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked ministers about rehabilitation and treatment of Dutch and Dutch East Indies civil servants and military personnel who refused to take part in the police actions, including how many were punished and whether they will be rehabilitated. The government answered that the numbers of refusers among civil servants and colonial staff are unknown, declined to discuss an individual case, and said it will not reassess past individual conduct against today's norms.

Recognising that the period in question is now viewed in a different light, I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against today's norms and with present-day knowledge.

In het besef dat de desbetreffende periode nu in een ander licht wordt gezien, acht ik het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Afghaanse politie-eenheid loopt over naar de Taliban”

MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports that an Afghan police unit defected to the Taliban, including numbers, weapons, training links and prevention measures. The government answered that the facts are unclear, eleven Afghan Uniformed Police officers reportedly defected with small arms, it cannot confirm NATO training, gives no explanation, and describes intake and mentoring measures to limit future defections.
It is unclear exactly what happened in Farah province (southwest Afghanistan).
Het is onduidelijk wat zich precies heeft afgespeeld in de provincie Farah (Zuidwest-Afghanistan).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over de aardbeving in Iran

Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it knew of the Iran earthquake's consequences and whether Iran had requested international aid, and whether the Netherlands would offer relief. Minister Rosenthal confirmed awareness, expressed condolences, offered humanitarian aid if Iran requested it, and noted that no such request had been made to the Red Cross or the UN.
I have offered him humanitarian aid should Iran request it.
Ik heb hem humanitaire hulp toegezegd zo Iran daarom zou verzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de constitutionele wijzigingen in Egypte

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the dismissal of Egypt's military leaders signals an end to military rule, what the links are to the Sinai border attack, and what role Egypt's parliament plays while it remains dissolved. The minister answered that the military transition ended with Morsi's inauguration, the two leaders were retired to advisory roles, no instability is expected, the Shura council is not involved, and the EU has urged an inclusive solution to the parliamentary crisis.
Tantawi and Anan, the number one and two of the SCAF, were retired by President Morsi as of 11 August and appointed as advisers to the President.
Tantawi en Anan, de nummers één en twee van de SCAF, zijn per 11 augustus jl. door president Morsi gepensioneerd; en benoemd tot adviseur van de President.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over de asielverlening van de heer Assange

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about Ecuador's asylum grant to Julian Assange, UK threats to enter the embassy, and whether the Netherlands would press the UK to let him leave. The minister confirmed the facts, noted UK extradition obligations to Sweden and that the matter is between the UK and Ecuador, and declined to take further steps.
This concerns a matter between the United Kingdom and Ecuador.
Dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Ecuador.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over politieke gevangenen in Sudan

MP El Fassed asked the Foreign Minister about political detainees in Sudan, including Green Party chair Fathi Albeheri, arrested after peaceful protests, and alleged torture, asking for pressure on Sudan and EU action. The minister answered that several protesters, including Albeheri, were released on 17 August 2012, that the Netherlands is concerned and has urged Sudan to respect human rights bilaterally and multilaterally, and that the EU High Representative has already acted.
The Netherlands, together with international partners, closely follows developments in Sudan and urges the Sudanese authorities to respect human rights in the country.
Nederland volgt samen met internationale partners de ontwikkelingen in Sudan nauwlettend en dringt er bij de Sudanese autoriteiten op aan de mensenrechten in het land te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over het hardhandige optreden van de Zimbabwaanse politie tegen LGBTI (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Intersex) activisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and rough treatment of GALZ LGBTI activists by Zimbabwean police, whether their safety is at risk, and whether Zimbabwe's authorities will be pressed on constitutional and international human rights obligations. The minister answered that the ambassy is in regular contact with GALZ, supports them via lawyers and a counseling unit, and that the EU and the Netherlands have voiced concern and urged Zimbabwe to respect its human rights obligations.
At Dutch urging, the EU expressed serious concern about the situation to the Zimbabwean government shortly after the incident.
Mede op Nederlands aandringen heeft de EU kort na het incident haar ernstige zorgen over de situatie uitgesproken tegenover de Zimbabwaanse overheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de veroordeling van de hoofdredacteur van de Egyptische krant Al-Dostor

An MP asked the foreign minister about the prosecution of the editor-in-chief of the Egyptian newspaper Al-Dostor for insulting the president, and whether Egypt's media laws comply with its human rights obligations and whether the Netherlands would press for reform. The minister said the Netherlands seeks press freedom reforms in bilateral and EU contacts, noted a presidential decree limiting pre-trial detention of journalists and announced plans to revise media law, and said the embassy would monitor the trial.
The Netherlands will follow whether and how the announced amendments are implemented.
Nederland zal volgen of en hoe de aangekondigde aanpassingen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van de behandeling van alle verblijfsaanvragen door Iraanse vreemdelingen

MPs asked whether the IND had stopped processing residence applications from Iranian students and nationals, and whether this amounted to discrimination. The minister answered that applications are decided, but students in restricted fields need a ministry exemption under UN resolution 1737 and EU regulation 267/2012, and that some applications for work were temporarily held before resuming processing.
It is a misunderstanding that the IND does not process applications from Iranian students.
Het is een misverstand dat de IND geen aanvragen van Iraanse studenten in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over het gevaar van de islamitische Libanese terreurorganisatie Hezbollah voor de veiligheid in Europa

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior whether the US assessment that Hezbollah may strike in Europe is endorsed, and why Hezbollah is not fully listed on the EU terrorist list. The minister answered that Hezbollah is a terrorist organisation, that Dutch services see no current heightened threat, and that the Netherlands has long favoured full EU listing and will raise the matter again in the EU.
The Netherlands advocates full listing of Hezbollah on the EU terrorism list.
Nederland pleit voor integrale plaatsing van Hezbollah op de EU-terrorismelijst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over straffeloosheid van sleutelfiguren in de Somalische piraterij

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Somali and Puntland authorities shield Somali piracy kingpins, why the UK blocked UN Security Council sanctions on pirate leaders, and the status of a regional anti-piracy prosecution centre. The minister found the reports worrying, said Somali authorities must respond to the UN Monitoring Group findings, noted international debate on whether sanctions would criminalise ransom payments, and reported that the RAPPICC centre is being set up with a Dutch commitment of EUR 300,000 and two experts, expected to be operational in early 2013.
I find these reports worrying. The Somali authorities must provide an account and explanation of the findings of the UN Monitoring Group.
Ik vind deze berichten zorgwekkend. De Somalische autoriteiten moeten tekst en uitleg geven over de bevindingen van de UN Monitoring Group.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over inperking van vrijheid van meningsuiting door verschillende landen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on freedom of expression abroad, including the arrests in Belarus and Morocco and the Pussy Riot trial in Russia. The minister listed Dutch efforts on internet freedom and religious freedom, condemned the Belarus detentions, and said the EU and Dutch officials had raised concerns with Russia and Morocco.
I strongly condemn the intimidation, arrest and detention of journalists, human rights activists and other Belarusian citizens who exercise their universal rights, including Anton Suryapin.

Ik veroordeel de intimidatie, arrestatie en detentie van journalisten, mensenrechtenactivisten en andere Wit-Russische burgers die gebruik maken van hun universele rechten, waaronder Anton Suryapin, ten stelligste.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over overstromingen op de Molukken

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would help relieve the suffering of flood victims in the Moluccas, either by supporting private fundraising or by providing emergency aid with local and Indonesian authorities. The State Secretary answered that the Jakarta embassy found Indonesia did not need international support, as the national disaster agency said sufficient Indonesian resources were available and the situation was improving.
Contact with the Indonesian authorities has shown that there is no need for support from the international community.
Uit contact met de Indonesische autoriteiten is gebleken dat er geen behoefte is aan ondersteuning door de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over straffeloosheid bij moorden op Somalische journalisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Somali transitional government should launch an independent investigation into recent murders of journalists, whether Amnesty's call for an independent inquiry will be raised with Somali authorities, and whether Somalia's human rights obligations will be pressed bilaterally and through the EU and UN. The minister agreed on the need for investigation and to press Somalia on its obligations, noting that independent investigation remains difficult until security improves, and that the Netherlands presses for it in line with a parliamentary motion.
In light of the Hachchi motion (22 831, no. 71), the Netherlands presses for this.
Mede in het licht van de motie Hachchi ( 22 831, nr. 71 ) dringt Nederland hierop aan.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Timmermans over naheffing door de Duitse fiscus aan Nederlandse oud-dwangarbeiders

Two PvdA MPs asked why elderly Dutch former forced labourers received back-tax demands from the German tax authority on their German state pensions despite a stated exemption, and asked for clear Dutch-language guidance and relief. The state secretary answered that an exemption exists but requires formal recognition as 'Verfolgte', that Germany agreed to a bilateral arrangement for those who can show their pension stems from forced labour, and that Dutch-language information is available and being sent with tax forms.
He then promised to resolve this problem efficiently and without bureaucracy by also granting exemption, within bilateral consultation, to forced labourers who formally fall outside the exemption.
Hij heeft mij toen toegezegd deze problematiek op efficiënte en onbureaucratische wijze te willen oplossen door in het kader van bilateraal overleg ook vrijstelling te verlenen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over over de veroordeling van de band Pussy Riot door de Russische rechterInperking van vrijheid van meningsuiting door verschillende landen

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the sentencing of Pussy Riot members was politically motivated and whether the EU should condemn it and intensify the human rights dialogue with Russia. The minister said she shares international concern about the proportionality of the sentence, endorsed the EU High Representative's statement, and said the existing EU-Russia human rights dialogue will continue with concerns raised.
I share the broad international concern about the disproportion between the limited gravity of the offence and the length of pre-trial detention, the prosecution's demand and the final sentence.
Ik deel de brede internationale zorgen over de verhouding tussen enerzijds de beperkte zwaarte van het vergrijp, en anderzijds de lengte van het voorarrest, de strafeis en de uiteindelijke straf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over rapport van de Israëlische nederzettingencommissie

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli settlement commission report that deemed settlements legal, questioning its conflict with ICJ and UN positions and asking for diplomatic pressure. The minister replied that the government has consistently stated the Dutch position against settlements, that it will not anticipate an Israeli cabinet decision, and that the Dutch position has been conveyed in contacts with Israel.
I do not wish to anticipate a possible decision by the Israeli cabinet.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op een mogelijk besluit van het Israëlische kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de situatie rond de Syrische stad Aleppo

An MP asked the foreign minister about the escalating fighting around Aleppo, Kofi Annan's appeal, and what the EU and the Netherlands could do to bring about a ceasefire and pressure Russia and China. The minister answered that the Netherlands favours a political solution, raises the crisis bilaterally with Russia and China, supports the UN General Assembly resolution, backs the opposition and has contributed 7 million euro in humanitarian aid.
The Netherlands remains in favour of a political solution for Syria.
Nederland blijft voorstander van een politieke oplossing voor Syrië.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over Rechtshulpverzoeken door Spanje inzake de Gürtel-corruptiezaak

Parliamentarian Timmermans asked whether the Netherlands has for three years refused to provide Antillean bank account information to Spanish prosecutors in the Gürtel corruption case, and why, given Spanish requests. The minister answered that the Netherlands has assisted the 2008 Spanish request, that additional information was needed and received in 2010, that a FIOD investigation ran until late 2011 and a court permission procedure is pending, and that any remaining evidence in Curaçao is for Curaçao's own authorities to handle.
That investigation lasted until the end of 2011, after which the permission procedure was started at the court, which has not yet reached a final decision.
Dit onderzoek heeft tot eind 2011 geduurd waarna de verlofprocedure bij de rechtbank is gestart welke nog niet tot een eindbeschikking is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over goudwinning op het eiland Romang in de Molukken

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether gold mining by PT Gemala Borneo Utama on Romang polluted drinking water and destroyed crops, whether 418 protesters were arrested, and whether the ambassador would be asked for clarification. The minister confirmed the local conflict and the allegations but had no independent information, said 27 arrested residents were released after processing, and saw no reason to approach the Indonesian ambassador.
I do not have information from other sources that supports or contradicts this accusation.
Ik beschik niet over informatie uit andere bronnen die deze beschuldiging ondersteunt of weerspreekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Iraanse gewetensgevangene Kabudvand

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether detained Iranian journalist Kabudvand is a prisoner of conscience, whether his health has deteriorated and lacks adequate medical care, and whether the Netherlands will back an NGO call for his release and inform Iran. The minister answered that sources conflict on the reason for his arrest, his current health cannot be verified, and the Netherlands raises fair trial and treaty compliance bilaterally and through the EU without committing to a specific individual demand.

The Netherlands presses Iranian authorities bilaterally and multilaterally (for example through statements by EU High Representative Ashton) to uphold a fair and transparent legal process and to respect international treaties Iran has signed.

Nederland dringt bilateraal en multilateraal (bijvoorbeeld via verklaringen van EU Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton) bij de Iraanse autoriteiten aan op het handhaven van een eerlijke en transparante rechtsgang en het eerbiedigen van internationale verdragen die Iran heeft ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over arrestaties van dissidenten door het Cubaanse regime bij de begrafenis van Oswaldo Paya

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Cuba detained at least ten dissidents attending Oswaldo Paya's funeral, whether the government protested, and about suspicions of foul play in his death and the risk to dissidents. The minister confirmed at least thirty were briefly detained without charge, said the embassy monitors the situation and Dutch efforts run through EU-Cuba dialogue, and said only that rumours of a second car exist, with appropriate EU measures possible if developments worsen.
At least thirty dissidents were arrested at Oswaldo Payá's funeral on 24 July and released after a few hours without charge.
Er zijn bij de begrafenis van Oswaldo Payá op 24 juli jl. ten minste dertig dissidenten aangehouden en na enkele uren zonder aanklacht vrijgelaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht 'Surinamers 'belegeren' Nederlandse ambassade'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a large backlog in visa processing at the Dutch embassy in Paramaribo, and whether capacity was insufficient despite the known summer peak. The minister denied any backlog, stating complete applications are handled within five working days, and pointed to extra equipment and staff added for June to August.
There is no backlog. Every visa application, provided it is complete and in order when submitted by the applicant, is processed within five working days.
Er is geen achterstand. Iedere visumaanvraag, mits compleet en in orde door de indiener aangeleverd, wordt binnen vijf werkdagen afgehandeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El-Fassed over het aftreden van VN gezant Kofi Annan en de situatie in Syrië

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about Kofi Annan's resignation as UN envoy for Syria, the Security Council deadlock, the legal classification of the Syrian conflict and whether Switzerland should convene the Geneva Convention parties. The minister answered that Netherlands prioritises ending the violence and respect for humanitarian law, agrees the conflict is non-international, and reported that Switzerland declined to convene a meeting of the parties.
The Netherlands sounded out Switzerland, the depositary of the Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols, on whether it was willing to convene a meeting of the states parties.
Nederland heeft bij Zwitserland, de depositaris van de Geneefse Conventies en Aanvullende Protocollen, gepolst of er bereidheid bestaat om een vergadering van verdragspartijen bijeen te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over de vrijlating van de fotograaf Jeroen Oerlemans

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the release of photographer Jeroen Oerlemans, including the ministry's and KLPD's role, the basis for the minister's public statement, whether media statements affected the release, and lessons learned. The minister declined to share details on the operation for security reasons, said the statement was based on available sources, denied receiving a request for secrecy, and said the case will be evaluated.
Because of the vulnerability and risks in kidnapping cases, no statements can be made about this, including with a view to the future.
Vanwege de kwetsbaarheid en risico’s bij ontvoeringszaken kunnen hierover, ook met het oog op de toekomst, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het systematisch onbestraft blijven van VN'ers na verkrachtingen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that UN peacekeepers in Congo, among others, are almost never prosecuted after raping minors, and what the UN and the Netherlands have done about it. The minister answered that the UN has a zero-tolerance policy with internal reporting and investigation mechanisms, that the trend in reported cases is declining, that the Netherlands has pushed for conduct rules and a training course, and that the UN reports publicly each year.
The UN pursues a zero-tolerance policy towards personnel who commit serious misconduct.
De VN voert een beleid van zero tolerance jegens personeel dat zich schuldig maakt aan ernstige misdragingen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over misleidende berichtgeving met betrekking tot het label Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether products from Western Sahara sold in Dutch supermarkets under a 'Morocco' label are misleading, and whether this breaches EU consumer rules and contributes to occupation. The minister said the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive does not apply because the food labelling directive governs, that misleading origin labelling is prohibited, and that the EU-Morocco agreement covers only Moroccan territory, so Western Sahara products cannot claim preferences.
Under the Labelling of Foodstuffs Decree it is not permitted to place misleading information, including on the origin or provenance of a product, on the label.
Op basis van het Warenwetbesluit Etikettering van levensmiddelen is het niet toegestaan om misleidende informatie, onder meer over de oorsprong of herkomst van een product, op het etiket te plaatsen.

Antwoord vragen Peters over het juridische advies van de Externe Volkenrechtelijke Adviseur (EVA) inzake het risico dat bedrijven of instellingen in nederzettingen bij samenwerkingsactiviteiten betrokken raken die uit de

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether the government would share the EVA legal advice on the risk that companies or institutions in settlements become involved in cooperation stemming from intensified Netherlands-Israel relations, and why earlier answers did not mention it. The minister confirmed the advice existed and was known, but declined to share its content or conclusion, citing the agreed EVA reporting arrangements, and said the policy reflects a broad assessment including international law.
In my view the underlying advice does not fall within the category of advice for which it was promised that the House would be informed of its conclusion.
Onderliggend advies valt naar mijn oordeel niet onder de categorie van adviezen waarvan is toegezegd dat de Kamer geïnformeerd zal worden over de conclusie ervan.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over Tweede Kamervragen over Jordaanse wetgeving die toestaat dat een verkrachter met zijn slachtoffer mag trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press Jordan, given international rules, to reform Article 308 of its penal code, which lets rapists escape prosecution by marrying their victims. The minister acknowledged rights concerns, said international pressure is important, and said the issue will be raised in bilateral consultations and in EU forums.
I will raise this issue within the EU; the Human Rights Subcommittee under the EU Association Agreement with Jordan and the relevant EU Council working groups offer opportunities to do so.

Ik zal deze problematiek in EU verband aan de orde stellen; het Subcomité Mensenrechten in het kader van het EU Associatieakkoord met Jordanië en de relevante EU-raadswerkgroepen bieden daartoe mogelijkheden.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over terroristische aanslag op Israëlische toeristen in Bulgarije

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the bombing of Israeli tourists in Bulgaria was condemned as terrorism and whether the UN Secretary-General, High Commissioner and Human Rights Council failed in their duty, and whether Dutch participation in the Council should end. The minister confirmed strong condemnation, noted UN condemnation, expressed concern about disproportionate criticism of Israel in the Council, and said the Netherlands would stay engaged to balance its work.
No, the Netherlands actively works for more balance in the work of the Human Rights Council.
Nee, Nederland zet zich actief in voor meer balans in het werk van de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de weigering van de EU om Hezbollah als terroristische organisatie aan te merken

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the EU refuses to list Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, whether EU representatives should negotiate with it, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that EU member states lack consensus, that the Netherlands already treats Hezbollah as terrorist and has no contacts with it, that Dutch policy has not changed, and that the Netherlands will keep raising its position in EU fora.
I cannot make any further concrete public statements about this cooperation.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen verdere, concrete mededelingen doen over deze samenwerking.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven en Hernandez over de weigering van de EU om Hezbollah te plaatsen op de lijst van terroristische organisaties

MPs Kortenoeven and Hernandez asked the Foreign Minister why the EU refuses to list Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, whether the Netherlands still considers it one, and whether the EU Association Agreement with Lebanon should be suspended while Hezbollah is in government. The minister answered that the Netherlands regards Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation and will keep raising this in the EU, but opposes suspending the Association Agreement, and described efforts on UNSC resolution 1701 and Syrian chemical weapons.
The Netherlands considers Hezbollah a terrorist organisation.
Nederland beschouwt Hezbollah als een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over foto’s over executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked whether photos showing Dutch soldiers near executed Indonesians implicate Dutch forces, and whether archives and a new research programme on the 1945-1949 Indonesian war should be commissioned. The minister answered that the photos do not establish responsibility, that the institutes hold similar images already in the public domain, and that independent research is for the institutes, not the cabinet.
On the basis of the photographs it cannot be concluded that these soldiers are responsible for the deaths of the victims shown.
Op basis van de foto's kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat deze militairen verantwoordelijk zijn voor de dood van de slachtoffers op de foto.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Hilkens over steenkolenmijnen op de UNESCO-werelderfgoedlijst

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked whether the government would consult Limburg authorities to nominate remaining Limburg coal-mining heritage for the UNESCO World Heritage List, after three Walloon mines were listed. The state secretary replied that the independent commission's advice, adopted in 2011, did not include Limburg mining heritage, so no consultation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to now enter into discussions with authorities in Limburg about a World Heritage nomination of parts of the mining region.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding nu in gesprek te gaan met overheden in Limburg over een werelderfgoednominatie van delen van de mijnstreek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de aanpak van kindersekstoerisme

MP Dibi asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about child sex tourism, including a Limburg suspect in Ghana who was released on bail and can travel freely, and whether Dutch enforcement lacks effectiveness. State Secretary Teeven answered that no separate offence exists, that cases are not registered separately, that the suspect was not pursued for lack of hard evidence, and that a follow-up campaign and a crime analysis are planned.
Child sex tourism is therefore not registered separately in the Public Prosecution Service systems, so it cannot be stated how many cases ended in a conviction.
Kindersekstoerisme wordt derhalve niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd in de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie, zodat niet aan te geven is hoeveel zaken in een veroordeling zijn geëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitlevering van een Nederlandse hacker David S. aan de Verenigde Staten door Roemenië

MP Van Bommel asked ministers how Dutch authorities were involved in the US investigation of Dutch hacker David S., who was arrested in Romania and extradition-bound to the US, and why he was not arrested in the Netherlands. Teeven answered that Dutch authorities received US information but took no investigative action, were not informed of the arrest in advance, received only a pending US mutual legal assistance request, and cannot discuss details of the Romanian extradition proceedings.
I cannot go into the further content of that request, because doing so could harm an ongoing foreign criminal investigation.
Op de verdere inhoud van dat verzoek kan ik niet ingaan, omdat daardoor een lopend buitenlands opsporingsonderzoek zou kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Eijsink over het besluit van Canada zich terug te trekken uit het AWACS-programma

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Canada's withdrawal from the NATO AWACS programme, its reasons, the effect on the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands would reconsider its own participation. The minister answered that Canada cited a strategic defence review and budget cuts, that no other partners are known to be considering withdrawal, that financial consequences are still under discussion, and that ending Dutch participation is not on the agenda.
Ending the Dutch participation in the AWACS programme is not on the agenda.
Beëindiging van de Nederlandse deelneming in het AWACS-programma is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Heijnen en Taverne over problemen bij het stemmen in het buitenland

MPs Timmermans, Heijnen and Taverne asked whether Dutch citizens abroad calling the DUTCHHELP line were given incorrect information, including that they could vote online, and why election information was not on all Dutch missions' websites and at counters. The minister answered that no online voting was mentioned, only registration (which can partly be done online), that election links were provided on embassy and consulate sites, and that posts promoted registration and displayed the website at counters.
No. There is no mention of casting a vote via the internet; however, information is provided on how and where one can register.
Neen. Er wordt niet gesproken over het uitbrengen van de stem via internet; wel wordt informatie verstrekt over hoe en waar men zich kan registreren.
Antwoord vragen Sterk en Hachchi over Nederlands-Pakistaanse vrouw die in huwelijkse gevangenschap in Pakistan verkeert

MPs Sterk and Hachchi asked about a Dutch-Pakistani woman held in a forced marriage in Pakistan, what the embassy had done, and whether the government would act on religious divorce and women's rights. The minister said he could not comment on the individual case for privacy reasons, that the embassy assists consular cases on request, and that he would raise the issue in EU settings.
To protect the identity of the person concerned, I cannot make a substantive statement about the case.
Ter bescherming van de identiteit van betrokkene, kan ik over de zaak geen inhoudelijke uitspraak doen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over 'vernieling van EU-projecten in de bezette Palestijnse Gebieden'

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about Israeli destruction of EU- and Dutch-funded development projects in the occupied Palestinian territories, including whether a full 2001-2011 damage overview would be provided and whether compensation had been obtained. The minister answered that only current-project damage is listed, that a complete record of handed-over projects is not kept, that compensation has not been obtained, and that Dutch interests in preventing destruction are pursued through bilateral and EU channels.

It is not possible to provide a complete overview of damage to completed projects for the following reasons: the Dutch government does not keep a register of damage inflicted on projects already handed over.

Het is niet mogelijk om een volledig overzicht te geven van schade aan de afgeronde projecten om de volgende redenen: – De Nederlandse regering houdt geen register bij van schade berokkend aan reeds overgedragen projecten;
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Harbers over het bericht dat het Oekraïense parlement uitingen van homoseksualiteit wil verbieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign minister about a Ukrainian bill banning expressions and information about homosexuality, and what the Netherlands and EU could do in response. The minister said the bill was off the 6 July agenda, that the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and with the EU, that the bill violates international human rights obligations, and that LGBT rights are part of EU association and visa conditions.
Within the existing financial and programmatic frameworks, the embassy provides support to LGBT organisations and activities.
De ambassade verleent binnen de bestaande financiële en programmatische kaders ondersteuning aan LHBT-organisaties en -activiteiten.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Timmermans over het feit dat bezwaarschriften voor aanvragen van visa voor Nederland in veel gevallen in een andere taal dan het Nederlands dienen te worden geformuleerd

MPs Van Dam and Timmermans asked whether Schengen partners handle Dutch visa applications on Nederland's behalf so that appeals must be filed with another country, possibly in its language, and how that burdens Dutch citizens. The minister confirmed the arrangements and language requirements, but pointed to new applications or Dutch posts as alternatives and made no commitment to change the rules.
In those cases, an appeal against the refusal of the Schengen visa must be lodged with the Schengen country concerned.
In die gevallen dient een beroep tegen de weigering van het Schengenvisum bij het betreffende Schengenland te worden ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Lange over de mogelijke steun van Rwanda aan de rebellen in de Democratische Republiek van Congo (DRC)

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Rwanda is supporting Congolese rebels and war crimes suspect Bosco Ntaganda, and what the government has done about it. The minister confirmed the reports are troubling, said Rwanda must answer the UN findings, and listed diplomatic demarches through the Great Lakes contact group, the EU and the Kigali embassy.
Reports of support from Rwanda to mutinying soldiers in the DRC and to Bosco Ntaganda are disturbing.
De berichten over steun vanuit Rwanda aan muitende soldaten in de DRC en aan Bosco Ntaganda zijn verontrustend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de mogelijke executie van vijf Iraanse Ahwazi Arabieren

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest bilaterally and in the EU over the possible execution of five Ahwazi Arabs held without fair trial, and whether it would back tougher EU sanctions. The minister replied that four of the five had already been executed, that Nederland and the EU have protested and urged abolition of the death penalty, and that additional EU sanctions on Iranian human rights violators and internet monitoring exports were adopted in March.
In response to the report you cite, I have advocated an appropriate response among my EU colleagues to the concerning situation of the Ahwazi community in general and this case in particular.

Mede in reactie op het door u aangehaalde bericht heb ik bij mijn EU collega's een passende reactie op de zorgelijke situatie van de Ahwazi gemeenschap in het algemeen en deze zaak in het bijzonder bepleit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'de blokkade van Gaza'

An MP asked the government whether it shares the view of fifty development, human rights and peace organisations that Israel's Gaza blockade must be lifted, whether it considers the blockade a collective punishment contrary to the Geneva Conventions, and whether it has raised the issue with Israel and will press for its lifting. The minister answered that the Dutch position is unchanged and backs free movement via regular crossings subject to Israeli security interests, regards the measures as security measures under the Fourth Geneva Convention, reports raising the issue with Israel and funding a container scanner, and notes Dutch and EU calls for unconditional opening of the crossings.
The government regards the measures taken regarding access to Gaza as a security measure based on the Fourth Geneva Convention.
De regering beschouwt de getroffen maatregelen rond de toegang tot Gaza als een veiligheidsmaatregel die is gebaseerd op de Vierde Geneefse Conventie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Afzetting president Paraguay

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the removal of President Lugo of Paraguay was a coup and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification from Paraguay's ambassador. The minister answered that the constitution allows congressional removal, that the Supreme Court and electoral body found it constitutional, and that no reason currently exists to request clarification, while the EU is analysing events with the OAS.
At this moment there is no reason to ask the Paraguayan ambassador for clarification.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om de Paraguyaanse ambassadeur om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over het besluit van de Oegandese regering om 38 Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) te verbieden omdat deze homoseksualiteit promoten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether she knows of Uganda's call to ban 38 NGOs for allegedly promoting homosexuality, which NGOs are affected, whether Dutch NGOs are affected, and whether she will raise this with Ugandan authorities as a breach of human rights obligations. The minister answered that the Ugandan NGO Council has said it will not act on the minister's call, and that the position of homosexuals is a recurring item in bilateral and EU political dialogue with Uganda, without committing to a new specific step.
The Ugandan NGO Council, which is responsible for registering NGOs, has however indicated that it does not intend to take action following that call.
De Oegandese NGO-Raad, die belast is met de registratie van NGO's, heeft echter te kennen gegeven niet van plan te zijn naar aanleiding van die oproep actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Dijkhoff over het verbieden van Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) in Oeganda

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether Uganda's banning of 38 NGOs for allegedly promoting homosexuality was acceptable and whether development aid of about 6 million euro per year should be suspended. The minister replied that the NGO Council has said it will not act on the minister's call, so suspension is not currently at issue, and described Dutch efforts on the LGBT situation through political dialogue and funding of human rights organisations.
For now, given what was stated in the answer to question 2, this is not an issue.
Vooralsnog is dit gelet op het gestelde in antwoord op vraag 2 niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over Nederlanders in het buitenland die op 12 september 2012 willen stemmen

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked whether Dutch citizens abroad can register and vote in the 12 September 2012 election, given registration backlogs, staffing, and slow postal delivery of ballots. Minister Donner replied that registration is running normally at about 30,000 requests with roughly 2% rejected, that 36 temporary staff are handling it with capacity expandable if needed, and that ballots will be sent once candidate lists are final, with embassy drop-off points and proxy voting as fallbacks.
If necessary, capacity will be expanded.
Indien nodig zal de capaciteit worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over Shell’s gebrekkige rapportage over olielekkages in Nigeria en compensatie daarvan

MPs Dikkers, De Lange and Smeets asked the government about Shell's inaccurate reporting of oil spills in Nigeria, independent investigation, cleanup and compensation. The minister answered that the Bodo spill is under litigation and a NCP complaint is pending, that Nigerian law assigns spill investigations to joint teams, and that the Netherlands supports dialogue and oversight initiatives while Shell has accepted responsibility for the Bodo cleanup.
The extent of the pollution and the amount of compensation are the subject of a civil case.
De omvang van de vervuiling en de hoogte van de schadeloosstelling zijn onderwerp van een civiel proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over nieuwe anti-christelijke maatregelen in Indonesië

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses news reports of church closures and attacks on Christians in Indonesia, including Aceh's sharia, and what concrete steps the government has taken to protect them. The minister expressed concern, denied that a jihad targets Christians, said Aceh remains subject to national law, and listed diplomatic raising of the issue, the human rights ambassador's visit and support for interfaith programmes.
The Netherlands regularly raises attention to the position of religious minorities in Indonesia.
Nederland vraagt regelmatig aandacht voor de positie van religieuze minderheden in Indonesië.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over honderden opgepakte Tibetanen

The SP MP Van Bommel asked whether hundreds of Tibetans were detained in and around Lhasa after self-immolations, whether tourists and others were expelled, and whether China labelled the self-immolators terrorists, and whether the minister would press China on the detainees. The minister replied that reliable first-hand information is impossible to obtain because Tibetan areas are not freely accessible, that the EU has repeatedly demanded access and raised the issue in dialogue, that no Dutch nationals are known to have been expelled, and that the Netherlands follows the case closely and raises human rights obligations with China.
It is impossible to obtain reliable first-hand information, because various Tibetan areas are not freely accessible to foreign journalists and diplomats.
Het is onmogelijk uit eerste hand betrouwbare informatie te verkrijgen, omdat verschillende Tibetaanse gebieden niet vrij toegankelijk zijn voor buitenlandse journalisten en diplomaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 'de situatie van kinderen in Gaza'

An MP asked the foreign minister about the situation of children in Gaza, including a report on water contamination and the impact of the blockade, and whether the Netherlands should press Israel and the Palestinian Authority on children's rights. The minister answered that the Netherlands and the EU call for open border crossings, that children's rights can be raised in EU human rights dialogues, and that concrete economic support such as a container scanner was agreed.
Treaty parties can hold each other to account for their obligations under the convention.
Verdragspartijen kunnen elkaar aanspreken op de verplichtingen onder het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel inzake Nederlandse oorlogsmisdaden op Zuid-Celebes

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about alleged Dutch war crimes in South Sulawesi in 1946-47 (summary executions, knowledge at top levels, the 1954 decision not to prosecute, and release of the Van Rij/Stam report). The government answered that over 3,000 people died in the actions, that political and military leadership were informed from December 1946, that the 1954 non-prosecution decision was based on the information available, that the facts are now time-barred, and that the report has been deposited for Chamber inspection with personal data caveats.
The report is deposited at the Tweede Kamer registry for the Chamber's inspection, though it should be noted that the report may contain names of still-living persons whose private life is protected.

Tegen deze achtergrond wordt het rapport ter kennisname door de Kamer ter griffie van de Tweede Kamer neergelegd, waarbij moet worden aangetekend dat in het rapport namen van nog levende personen kunnen voorkomen waarvan de persoonlijke levenssfeer beschermd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht “Directeur Wereldomroep krijgt miljoen euro bij vertrek”

An MP asked ministers about reports that the Wereldomroep director would receive about one million euro in severance on departure, and whether such payments are permissible in the public sector. The ministers answered that the Raad van Toezicht sets the severance under the Wereldomroep's contractual and sector frameworks, that the director's pay would be assessed critically using the kantonrechter formula, and that the WNT caps severance at 75,000 euro once in force.
I have urged the RvT to critically assess the severance payment once it becomes relevant.
Ik heb er bij de RvT op aangedrongen om de ontslagvergoeding kritisch te beoordelen zodra deze aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Export van censuur technologie

MP El Fassed asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether Western firms still export censorship technology to countries that violate human rights, whether a list of such firms exists, and what the government is doing on free news gathering, a list of repressive states, and arms trade treaty regulation of dual-use items. Minister Rosenthal replied that it cannot be established whether such exports occur, no company list exists or is desirable, the EU dual-use regulation proposal is expected late 2012, and Dutch efforts to include such goods in the arms trade treaty have found no support.
It is not possible to establish whether companies from European countries and the United States export censorship technology to countries where human rights are violated.
Het is niet mogelijk vast te stellen of bedrijven uit Europese landen en de Verenigde Staten censuurtechnologie exporteren naar landen waar mensenrechten worden geschonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'de Palestijnse gevangene Mahmoud al-Sarsak'

An MP asked the foreign minister about Palestinian prisoner Mahmoud al-Sarsak, held under Israel's administrative detention law, and whether the government would press Israel on the law and his release. The minister replied that al-Sarsak ended his hunger strike and is due for release on 10 July, that administrative detention is permitted in exceptional cases with international safeguards, and that the cabinet opposes long detention without prospect of trial.
The cabinet is opposed to prolonged detention of prisoners without prospect of trial.
Het kabinet is tegen langdurig detineren van gevangenen zonder uitzicht op proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de onrechtmatige huiszoeken tegen Megaupload

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether Dutch police and justice cooperated with a US request in the Megaupload case after a New Zealand court ruled the search warrants unlawful for lack of specificity, and whether an independent judicial review will be arranged. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no role in US-to-New Zealand requests, that the incoming request was tested against treaty and Dutch law and carried out under an investigating judge, and that all incoming requests are checked before execution with the same safeguards as domestic investigations.
The Netherlands has no role in legal assistance requests that the American authorities address to the New Zealand authorities.
Nederland heeft geen tussenkomst bij rechtshulpverzoeken die de Amerikaanse autoriteiten richten tot de Nieuw-Zeelandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over wapenhandel naar ontwikkelingslanden

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about arms trade to developing countries, including whether the Oxfam-reported aid and military spending trends are accurate and why a development criterion is absent from the ATT preparation letter. The minister answered that the OECD-DAC could not confirm the Oxfam calculations, that the Netherlands applies a socio-economic development criterion to relevant export licences and supports one in a future treaty, and that it advocates such a criterion in EU and UN settings.
The Netherlands works within the EU for uniform application of criterion 8 of the EU Common Position.
Nederland spant zich in EU-verband in voor uniforme toepassing van criterium 8 van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over internetcensuur door de Palestijnse autoriteit

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Authority internet censorship, the arrests of a journalist and two bloggers, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister said President Abbas ordered unblocking of websites, one journalist was released on bail, and the government sees no reason to halt cooperation, relying on dialogue and support for civil society.
The Dutch Representative in Ramallah conveyed the Dutch concerns about arrests and interrogations of journalists to the Palestinian Authority.
De Nederlandse Vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah heeft de Nederlandse zorgen over arrestaties en ondervragingen van journalisten aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit overgebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het nieuwe detentieregime in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Afghanistan, under US pressure, is adopting a detention regime allowing indefinite administrative detention similar to Bagram, and how this fits international and Afghan law. The minister answered that details of the new regime are not yet known to the government, that a Joint Monitoring Board will oversee compliance, and that the Dutch embassy will continue to press for detention in line with international law.
Concrete details about this regime are not currently known to the government.
Concrete details over dit regime zijn de regering op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported surge in US arms and ammunition imports by Greece in February 2012 amid its social crisis, and whether this threatens political stability and whether the government will raise it abroad. The minister answered that the purchases appear to be by the Greek government, that no structural import increase is evident given defence budget cuts, that there is no reason to think weapons will fall into the wrong hands, and that the government sees no reason to raise arms supply with the US or in EU/UN forums.
The government sees no reason to raise arms supply.
De regering ziet geen reden om wapenlevering aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over een mogelijke Duitse boycot van het EK voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about a possible German boycott of Euro 2012 over the situation of Ukrainian opposition figures, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit by not sending a political delegation. The minister said concerns about the rule of law and Timoshenko's treatment prompted a conditional stance, that Minister Schippers attended the Netherlands-Denmark match after improvements in Timoshenko's detention, and that the government raised the issue with Ukraine at EU level.
The cabinet previously indicated that if Ms Timoshenko's situation did not sufficiently improve, the Netherlands would not send a political-level delegation to Ukraine.
Door het kabinet is eerder aangegeven dat als de situatie van mevrouw Timosjenko niet voldoende zou verbeteren, Nederland niet op politiek niveau naar Oekraïne zou gaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de door het Koeweits parlement aangenomen doodstraf voor blasfemie

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he views Kuwait's parliament adopting a death penalty for blasphemy and whether the Netherlands will protest, press for release of those detained, coordinate sanctions, and cut ties with OIC states. The minister answered that the Emir had sent the bill back to parliament, that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and is raising the matter with the EU, and that it opposes stripping UN membership or minimising relations with those states.
The embassy is following this issue closely and it is being discussed at EU level at the Dutch request.
De ambassade volgt deze kwestie op de voet en deze wordt op Nederlands verzoek in EU-verband besproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over homofobie in Oekraïne

An MP asked the foreign minister about the cancelled Kyiv Pride parade, police protection, alleged gag orders and assaults on participants, and whether EU visa-liberalisation commitments on anti-discrimination are breached by Ukrainian draft laws. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities did not adequately guarantee a peaceful march, that Dutch and EU partners raised the draft laws with Ukraine, and that adopting comprehensive anti-discrimination legislation is a necessary condition for visa liberalisation.
I consider the actions of the Ukrainian authorities inadequate to guarantee a peaceful course of the demonstration.
Ik acht het handelen van de Oekraïense autoriteiten ontoereikend om een vreedzaam verloop van de manifestatie te garanderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over de vernieuwing van de licentie van Shell in Nigeria

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they accept the renewal of Shell's Nigerian licence despite pollution from oil spills, what the Dutch government thinks of Shell Netherlands' remarks on polluted water, and whether they have discussed compensation for local residents with Shell. The government answered that licence renewals are a matter between Nigeria and the companies, that it has intensive contact with Shell on MVO and the Niger Delta, and that it facilitates a dialogue on pollution there.
Renewal of licences is a matter between the Nigerian government and companies with which the Nigerian government wishes to do business.
Verlenging van licenties is een zaak tussen de Nigeriaanse overheid en bedrijven waar de Nigeriaanse overheid zaken mee wenst te doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over het strafproces tegen de Turkse musicus Fazil Say

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Turkish musician Fazil Say for allegedly insulting Islam on Twitter, and whether this signals an attack on free expression in Turkey, including whether the ambassador should be summoned and whether an observer should attend the trial. The minister answered that Say is charged under Article 216.3 of the Turkish penal code, that Dutch concerns about free expression and press freedom in Turkey are raised with the Turkish government, and that the Netherlands is following the case and will consider observer attendance in consultation with EU partners.
Dutch concerns about this are discussed in contacts with the Turkish government.
Nederlandse zorgen hierover worden in contacten met de Turkse regering besproken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Kortenoeven over vrij internet bij de ambassades in landen waar internetcensuur geldt

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Dutch embassies in censored countries are themselves subject to internet censorship and whether opening embassy Wi-Fi to the public could help. The minister replied that embassies use the ministry's secure internal network, that opening Wi-Fi is not possible for security reasons, and that the government will explore EU cooperation to give human rights defenders uncensored access.
I will raise in the EU context whether cooperation is possible in countries with internet censorship so that human rights defenders can use uncensored internet connections.
