Ik zal in EU-verband aan de orde stellen of in landen met internetcensuur kan worden samengewerkt om mensenrechtenverdedigers gebruik te laten maken van ongecensureerde internetverbindingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Lange en Timmermans over het bericht dat het gehele Noorden van Mali in handen is van extremisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that extremist groups control northern Mali, asking about threats to security, Dutch and EU responses, a contact group, ECOWAS progress, humanitarian aid and food security. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs multilateral, ECOWAS-led efforts, supports regional anti-crime programmes and humanitarian funding, and will assess any request to join an international Mali group.
The Netherlands favours an approach within a multilateral framework.
Nederland is voorstander van een aanpak in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over de uitspraak van de Turkse premier Erdogan dat abortus moord is

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister how the government reacted to Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remarks calling abortion murder, and whether the minister would raise this during the royal visit to Turkey. The minister replied that Dutch law permits abortion under conditions reflecting a fundamentally different view, and that women's rights are regularly raised with Turkey, including in EU conclusions, without committing to a specific statement on the visit.
The importance of women's rights is regularly a point of attention in discussions with the Turkish government, including within the framework of the European Commission's progress reports.
Het belang van vrouwenrechten is regelmatig punt van aandacht in gesprekken met de Turkse regering, ook in het kader van de voortgangsrapportages van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Wapentransport naar Syrië

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister about reports of a Russian arms shipment to Syria, UN arms embargo enforcement, and the role of carriers and sanctions law. The minister could not confirm the shipment, said EU and UN embargoes are generally well observed, described EU measures and Dutch sanctions law covering Dutch nationals and firms abroad, and referred to a separate letter.

In EU matters the Netherlands asks for attention to the role of carriers and transporters in complying with arms embargoes, and has called on EU partners to stress this in their contacts with carriers.

Nederland vraagt in EU-verband aandacht voor de rol van transporteurs en vervoerders in de naleving van wapenembargo's en EU partners opgeroepen om in hun contacten met vervoerders dit te benadrukken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over het opnemen van verzekeringen voor wapentransporten in de sancties tegen Syrië

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked whether insurance for arms shipments to Syria is covered by EU sanctions, whether this should be tightened like the Iran oil-insurance ban, how enforcement works, and whether financial sectors are aware of the rules. The minister answered that EU sanctions ban insuring arms cargo bound for Syria, that Dutch customs (POSS) enforces this and will remind businesses, that at least one ship apparently turned back after insurance was withdrawn, but that many insurers still cover arms cargo and enforcement by insurers is limited.
Given the importance of this matter, these services will again actively bring the information on the sanctions against Syria to the attention of Dutch business.
Gezien het belang van deze materie zullen genoemde diensten de informatie over de sancties tegen Syrië nogmaals actief onder de aandacht van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Qatar als een van de grootste grootaandeelhouders in Shell

An MP from the PVV asked the government about reports that Qatar had become a major shareholder in Shell, including the size of its stake, any other Dutch energy holdings, other Islamic investors, and the government's view of a Sunni dictatorship gaining influence. The minister said Shell does not disclose stakes below 3%, Qatar holds no known other Dutch energy stakes, the annual report does not show other investors, and that the government welcomes foreign investment within existing law.
The size of the stake has not been disclosed by Shell.
De grootte van het aandeel is door Shell niet bekendgemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Schaart over de levering van een SIGMA korvet aan Indonesië

Two VVD MPs asked about the sale of a SIGMA corvette by Damen Schelde Naval Shipbuilding to Indonesia, including contract value, jobs, prior deliveries and whether EU arms export criteria were applied. The government confirmed a contract of about $220 million for one corvette with an option on more, said a positive preliminary assessment against the EU criteria was made, and provided an overview of export licences for Indonesia.
In an exploratory phase, a so-called sondage, a positive opinion was given based on assessment against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position.
In een verkennende fase, een zogenaamde sondage, is een positief advies gegeven aan de hand van de beoordeling van de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans over een 14-jarig Marokkaans meisje dat gedwongen werd haar verkrachter te trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it would press Morocco, bilaterally and within the EU, to reform article 475 of its penal code after a 14-year-old girl was forced to marry her rapist, and what concrete steps it would take. The minister answered that the issue is raised through the UN Universal Periodic Review and the EU-Morocco neighbourhood dialogue, that a bilateral working group is not the right forum, and that Morocco's national debate on the article has not yet started.
That is why I have had this case raised in Morocco's review under the UN Human Rights Council's Universal Periodic Review.
Daarom heb ik deze zaak aan de orde laten stellen in het landen-examen van Marokko in het kader van de Universal Periodic Review van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over mogelijke uitlevering Paul Watson aan Costa Rica

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the German arrest of Paul Watson for possible extradition to Costa Rica, the absence of a Netherlands-Costa Rica extradition treaty, Costa Rica's human rights record, and whether the Netherlands would urge Germany not to extradite him. The minister answered that the decision lies solely with the German Justice Minister, that the Netherlands has no extradition treaty with Costa Rica, and that Costa Rica's legal system gives no cause for concern.
It is not for me to intervene in that decision, because responsibility lies exclusively with the German Minister.
Het is niet aan mij om in die beslissing te treden, omdat de verantwoordelijkheid hier uitsluitend ligt bij de Duitse Minister.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold en Ten Broeke over de uitzending op de Azerbeidzjaanse staatstelevisie AzTV over het alternatieve songfestival op 26 mei

MPs Pechtold and Ten Broeke asked whether the minister was aware of an Azerbaijani state TV broadcast discrediting Dutch NGOs such as IKV Pax Christi over an alternative song festival, and what the government would do about media pressure on critical NGOs. The minister acknowledged the broadcast, said there was no evidence it harmed the NGOs or their partners, noted the ambassador had raised the issue, and said the matter would be raised with the Azerbaijani foreign minister.
However, I have no indication that this one-off broadcast will hinder the work of the Dutch organisations concerned.
Ik beschik echter niet over aanwijzingen dat deze eenmalige uitzending het werk van de betreffende Nederlandse organisaties zal bemoeilijken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over rechtszaken tegen het klooster Mor Gabriël

An MP asked the foreign minister about lawsuits against the Mor Gabriel monastery, including frequent postponements and whether EU embassies attend hearings. The minister confirmed the cases are ongoing, said procedural postponements are common in Turkey, and explained that embassies attend substantive hearings on a rotating basis.
Yes, I am aware of the postponement of the court case.
Ja, ik heb kennis van genomen de verdaging van de rechtszaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over benoeming van Mugabe tot ambassadeur van toerisme door de Wereld Toerisme Organisatie (UNWTO)

An MP asked whether the UN World Tourism Organization had appointed Zimbabwe's President Mugabe as a tourism ambassador and what Dutch and EU steps would follow if so. The minister replied that UNWTO denies any such appointment and that the UNWTO has no Ambassadors Programme, so the follow-up questions were not applicable.
No, UNWTO denies such an appointment. UNWTO has no 'Ambassadors Programme'.
Nee, UNWTO weerspreekt een dergelijke benoeming 1 . UNWTO heeft geen «Ambassadors Programme».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de dreigende executie van vier homoseksuelen in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the threatened execution of four men in Iran over alleged homosexual conduct, whether the sentence rests on rape rather than consensual same-sex acts, whether appeal is possible, and whether the Iranian ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed the reports, said HRANA cites a rape conviction with the defendants claiming consent, noted appeal to the Supreme Court may be possible, and stated the EU position against the death penalty will be raised at the next EU statement.
I will make efforts to raise attention to this case as well in the next EU statement.
Ik zal mij inspannen om bij de volgende EU verklaring ook voor deze zaak aandacht te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'het Nederlandse standpunt ten aanzien van de invoer van producten uit nederzettingen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever'

Labour MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands pressed for changes to EU Council conclusions on imports from West Bank settlements and whether it would ban such imports. The minister declined to disclose the proposed changes, said customs checks are applied correctly, and stated the Netherlands opposes trade sanctions as a tool in the peace process.
Regarding the various proposals, the cabinet, as usual, makes no announcement.
Over de verschillende voorstellen doet het kabinet – zoals gebruikelijk – geen mededeling.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over benoeming van Mugabe tot ambassadeur van toerisme door de Wereld Toerisme Organisatie (UNWTO)

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Robert Mugabe was appointed tourism ambassador by the UN World Tourism Organization and, if so, whether the Netherlands should boycott the assembly and stop its contribution. The minister answered that the reports are incorrect, UNWTO denies any such appointment, and stopping the contribution is not an option.
The report is incorrect. UNWTO denies such an appointment.
Het bericht is onjuist. UNWTO weerspreekt een dergelijke benoeming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de destructie door Israël van door de EU gefinancierde ontwikkelingsprojecten in de bezette Palestijnse Gebieden

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli destruction of EU- and Dutch-funded development projects in the occupied Palestinian territories, including damage totals, Dutch protests and compensation, and a threatened solar energy project. The government answered that it raised liability for the damage with Israeli authorities, that about EUR 65,000 damage hit one Dutch-funded project, that no compensation has been received, and that talks with COGAT have not yet produced a settlement.
This consultation has not yet led to a damage settlement.
Dit overleg heeft nog niet geleid tot een schaderegeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ferrier over het bericht dat de Indiase overheid 77 buitenlandse NGO's op een ‘watchlist’ heeft geplaatst

Ferrier (CDA) asked the government about reports that India placed 77 foreign NGOs on a watchlist and required detailed disclosure of their activities under the FCRA. Minister Rosenthal answered that the FCRA was tightened in 2010 to counter misuse of foreign funds, that the EU delegation reports difficulties for some NGOs, and that human rights concerns will be raised bilaterally and in the EU-India dialogue.
Both in bilateral contacts and during the upcoming EU-India human rights dialogue, attention will be given to this issue.
Zowel in bilaterale contacten als tijdens de aanstaande EU-India mensenrechtendialoog wordt aan deze kwestie aandacht gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ferrier over de conferentie ‘The Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum’

An MP asks whether the government knows of and endorses a private investment forum on Sudan, whether Sudanese regime members and Dutch officials attended, and how it fits the Ferrier motion on conditions for aid to Sudan. The minister says no Sudanese government members took part, two foreign ministry officials and one agriculture ministry official joined part of the programme, and the government continues to press for humanitarian access and compliance with UN resolution 2046.
Members of the Sudanese government did not take part in the Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum.
Aan het «Sudanese Dutch Private Investment Forum» is niet deelgenomen door leden van de Sudanese regering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de arrestatie van de Sudanese journalist Faisal Mohammed Salih

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention of Sudanese journalist Faisal Mohammed Salih, whom he says is held as a prisoner of conscience at risk of torture, and whether other journalists face similar treatment. The minister confirmed the arrest appears linked to a critical interview, said at least 11 related arrests occurred in April and May, and said the Netherlands and EU partners are raising the case and calling for his immediate release.
The Netherlands, together with EU partners, is working on this case.
Nederland zet zich, samen met EU-partners in voor deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen Ormel, Voordewind en Ten Broeke over 'een Palestijnse Christen'

MPs Ormel, Voordewind and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Christian Daoud Nassar, who cancelled a Dutch visit, and about a long-running land and legal dispute with Israeli authorities over the family farm. The minister confirmed the cancellation, disputed that the family was described as illegal residents, outlined the land registration dispute and court process, and said there was no reason for the Netherlands to intervene.
Based on the available information, I currently see no reason for the Netherlands to get involved in this matter.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor Nederland om zich te mengen in deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang over het artikel ‘Hoe Arend Jan linkse taboes slecht – in zijn eentje’

An SP MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether a former foreign minister had agreed with a VVD MP to attack a colleague minister on development aid, whether the economic affairs minister is defending the development budget at the Catshuis talks, and whether a former MP's claims about cooperation were true. The minister answered that no such arrangement existed, declined to address the Catshuis talks beyond noting a parliamentary exchange had taken place, and said the practice described is consistent with good, transparent parliamentary conduct.
No, as explained in the answer to question 3.
Nee, zoals toegelicht bij beantwoording vraag 3.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het tegenhouden van reizigers naar Israël

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Israel asking European airlines to deny boarding to activists travelling to Bethlehem, the identification of travellers, criteria used, and Israeli security staff at airports. The minister answered that states may refuse entry, that criteria and lists are not public and not held by the Dutch government, that El Al staff have licensed additional security tasks at Schiphol, and that the Dutch government does not track refusals based on foreign rules.
Due to the heightened threat against Israeli flights, El Al employees have been designated to carry out additional security tasks on top of the regular security process.

In verband met de verhoogde dreiging gericht tegen Israëlische vluchten, zijn er medewerkers van El Al aangewezen om aanvullende beveiligingstaken uit te voeren, bovenop het reguliere beveiligingsproces.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het legaliseren van buitenposten door Israël

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's decision to legalise three West Bank outposts conflicts with international law and the peace process, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it. Minister Rosenthal answered that settlements are illegal under international law and an obstacle to peace regardless of Israeli status, that the step is unilateral and unhelpful, and that the Netherlands has conveyed its position to Israel and the EU condemned the move.
Settlements are illegal under international law and an obstacle to peace.
Nederzettingen zijn illegaal onder internationaal recht en een obstakel voor vrede.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over mogelijke gesprekken tussen Hamas en enkele EU-lidstaten waaronder Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands or the EU had talked with Hamas, and how this fits with Parliament's motions forbidding contact. The minister answered that contacts remain conditional on Hamas accepting the Quartet principles, that Hamas has not yet done so, and that the government implements the motions.
The government fully implements Chamber motions that make contacts with Hamas conditional on Hamas accepting the Quartet principles.
De regering geeft onverkort uitvoering aan Kamermoties die contacten met Hamas afhankelijk stellen van aanvaarding door Hamas van de Kwartetbeginselen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over groeiend antisemitisme in Hongarije

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that a Hungarian town cultural committee tried to bar Jewish actor Jozsef Szekhelyi and that the committee was described as making antisemitic remarks, and whether the government would act and place antisemitism on the EU agenda. The minister said Hungarian authorities are investigating, no ban was imposed, he condemns such remarks if confirmed, and the Netherlands combats antisemitism through international bodies.
If the statements were indeed made as reported in the media, I strongly condemn them.
Mochten de uitspraken inderdaad gedaan zijn zoals in de media is bericht, dan veroordeel ik die ten zeerste.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Schouw over vermeende uitspraken van de Albanese staatssecretaris van Defensie

Two D66 MPs asked whether an Albanian deputy defence minister really called for the Dutch ambassador to be declared persona non grata over LGBT advocacy, and what the government would do. The minister confirmed the statements, said they do not reflect the Albanian government's position, and said the EU and Dutch embassy have condemned them and will continue supporting LGBT emancipation.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to ask the Albanian authorities for clarification on these specific statements.
Ik acht het derhalve niet nodig om de Albanese autoriteiten over deze specifieke uitspraken om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het Turkse NAVO-lidmaatschap

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Turkey's blocking of NATO-Israel partnership projects is unacceptable, whether some allies oppose closer cooperation with Israel, whether Turkey sabotages Active Endeavour, and whether the answers will precede the 15 May debate. The minister confirmed the press report, said Turkey has blocked a limited number of projects involving Israel, that Netherlands and allies urged a quick resolution, and that Israel's offer to expand Active Endeavour is under consideration.
Several NATO allies, including the Netherlands, have expressed regret that this bilateral dispute affects NATO matters and have underlined the principle of non-discrimination toward partners.

Verschillende NAVO-bondgenoten, waaronder Nederland, hebben aangegeven te betreuren dat dit bilaterale geschilpunt gevolgen heeft voor NAVO-aangelegenheden en hebben het principe van non-discriminatie ten aanzien van partners onderstreept.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over wapentransport naar Egypte met een Nederlands schip

MP El Fassed asked the ministers whether a Dutch-flagged ship was carrying a military cargo from the US to Egypt, and about Egypt's human rights record, arms export risks, and whether the carrier can be held to account. The government answered that the cargo's destination was not confirmed and not Egypt, that transporting military goods requires no licence, that no action against the shipowner is planned, and that the Wet Strategische Diensten deliberately excludes mere transport services.
No steps against the owner of the chartered ship are being considered because the facts give no cause for them and there is no legal basis on which steps could be taken.

Antwoord 6 Er worden geen stappen tegen de eigenaar van het gecharterde schip overwogen omdat de feiten hier geen aanleiding toe geven (zie antwoord op vraag 2) en omdat er geen juridische grond is op basis waarvan stappen gezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de plezierjacht op beschermde dieren door hoogwaardigheidsbekleders

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would object to King Juan Carlos's elephant hunting, ban trophy hunting offers and gifts to officials, and bar Dutch royals from hunting protected species. The state secretary replied that trophy hunting is legal and may fund conservation, declined to disclose royal hunting or trophy details citing privacy, and saw no need for a ban on hunting-trip advertising.
Providing information on participation in hunting and the presence of hunting trophies in palaces and homes is incompatible with protecting the privacy of the Royal House.

Verstrekking van gegevens over deelname aan de jacht en aanwezigheid van jachttrofeën in paleizen en woningen is niet verenigbaar met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van het Koninklijk Huis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over situatie van Khader Adnan en administratieve detentie van Palestijnen door Israël

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the hunger strike and administrative detention of Khader Adnan, the treatment of Palestinian administrative detainees, due process, torture allegations and Israel's detention of Palestinian MPs and minors. The minister answered that Adnan ended his hunger strike and was released, that the EU and the Netherlands raise detention safeguards and the prohibition of torture in dialogue with Israel, and that Israel is bound by its treaty obligations, while declining to pass judgement on contested reports.
The Netherlands conducts a human rights dialogue with Israel, bilaterally and through the EU, including on compliance with international humanitarian law and human rights treaty obligations.

Nederland voert bilateraal en via de EU een mensenrechtendialoog met Israël, onder meer over de naleving van internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het humanitair oorlogsrecht en mensenrechtenverdragen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over het conflict tussen de Nederlandse dierenbeschermer Edwin Wiek en de Thaise overheid over de handel in uit het wild gevangen babyolifanten voor de toeristenindustrie

Hazekamp (PvdD) asked the ministers whether the Thai government and its park officials were complicit in poaching baby elephants for tourism and in harassing Dutch animal welfare activist Edwin Wiek's shelter, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns. The minister answered that the matter is under investigation by Traffic, that Thailand is responsible for CITES enforcement, and that the Netherlands would raise concerns with Thailand if official involvement is established, but could not rule out that seized animals fall prey to traders.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de arrestatie van de Chinese activiste Ni Yulan en haar echtgenoot Dong Jiqin

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention and sentencing of Chinese activist Ni Yulan and her husband, and whether the Netherlands would protest, investigate the proceedings, and keep raising human rights with China. The minister expressed concern about the sentences and lack of transparency, said the Netherlands had protested via the EU and bilaterally, declined to intervene in Chinese legal proceedings, and committed to continued raising of human rights.
I do not wish to interfere in the Chinese judicial process.
Ik wil niet treden in de Chinese rechtsgang.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over het bericht dat de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp, Ni Yulan, en haar echtgenoot, Dong Jiqin, zijn veroordeeld tot celstraffen

Pechtold (D66) asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the two-year-plus prison sentences given to human rights advocate Ni Yulan and her husband in China, whether the EU had formally requested her release, and whether the Netherlands would press for her case. The minister answered that the Netherlands and EU expressed concern and disappointment, raised the case in the EU-China summit and with the Chinese ambassador, and that no formal EU release request had been made, while the Human Rights Tulip prize had been handed to her relatives.
After the ruling of Tuesday 10 April and the statement of the EU delegation, the EU has not made a formal request to the Chinese authorities to release Ni Yulan.
Na de uitspraak van dinsdag 10 april jl. en de verklaring van de EU-delegatie is er door de EU geen formeel verzoek ingediend bij de Chinese autoriteiten om Ni Yulan vrij te laten.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en van Bommel over de zaak Van Bilderbeek

MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister whether she endorses the account in the book 'De Olievlek' about the Van Bilderbeek case in Colombia, and what the government did to assist the brothers humanitarian, diplomatically and legally, why the passport took so long, and for an update on actions since 2008. The minister declined to comment on the book beyond matters within her own remit, detailed consular, diplomatic and legal steps, explained the passport refusal under past policy and the court-ordered issuance in January 2011, and gave an update.
I can only give a judgment on matters that concern me.
Ik kan slechts een oordeel geven over zaken die mij regarderen.

Antwoord vragen Peters en El Fassed over de gebrekkige medewerking van de NAVO bij het onderzoek van de rapporteur van de Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa naar de omgekomen bootvluchtelingen uit Libië

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers why NATO failed to cooperate fully with the Council of Europe rapporteur investigating the deaths of 63 boat migrants from Libya, and why no rescue was offered after a distress alert. The ministers replied that NATO cooperated to the extent possible, that some information lies with member states, that NATO did not command the sea area, and that the alert was a search request rather than a distress call, so NATO bore no rescue obligation.
Part of the requested information can only be provided by member states. It concerns a national competence.
Een deel van de gevraagde informatie kan alleen door lidstaten worden aangeleverd. Het betreft een nationale bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over de invoering van de sharia in Timboektoe

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he deplores the imposition of sharia on Timbuktu by Tuareg groups, whether sharia applies elsewhere in Mali, whether Ansar Dine has links to AQIM, and whether the government will explicitly condemn sharia in Mali internationally. The minister answered that the situation is unstable and worrying, that independent confirmation of sharia elsewhere in Mali cannot be given, that contacts between Ansar Dine and AQIM exist, and that developments are followed with concern internationally without an explicit condemnation.
Independent confirmation of the introduction of sharia in parts of Mali cannot be given.
Onafhankelijke bevestiging van invoering van de sharia in delen van Mali kan niet worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over 27 hongerstakers in gevangenissen in Marokko

An MP asked the foreign minister about 27 hunger strikers held in Moroccan prisons, who claim unfair trials, torture and inhumane treatment, and whether an investigation and raising the matter with Morocco is warranted. The minister answered that the situation is a concern, that Morocco's National Human Rights Council has opened an inquiry and that prison directors were instructed to respect human rights, and that the matter will be discussed in the EU-Morocco human rights dialogue.
In the human rights dialogue the EU conducts with Morocco under the European Neighbourhood Policy, the progress of investigation and action will be discussed.
In de mensenrechtendialoog die door de EU met Marokko wordt gevoerd in het kader van het Europese Nabuurschapsbeleid, zal de voortgang van onderzoek en actie worden besproken.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over het bericht dat de Sudanese president Bashir zegt dat in Sudan de geest van de jihad is opgeleefd

MP Driessen (PVV) asked the foreign minister whether she shares concern over Sudanese president Bashir's claim that the spirit of jihad has revived in Sudan and his talk of 'liberating' South Sudan, and whether Sudan's attacks on the South are part of jihad. Minister Rosenthal answered that the statement is an example of escalatory language and that the recent violence stems from unresolved issues of the Comprehensive Peace Agreement, without addressing the jihad framing directly.
The statement in question is an example of escalatory language.
De desbetreffende uitspraak is een voorbeeld van escalerend taalgebruik.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk en Van Bommel over de verkoop van tanks aan Indonesië

SP MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the cabinet approved a 200 million euro tank sale to Indonesia and an Egypt defence deal, how these fit human rights concerns and earlier parliamentary motions, and whether the minister misled parliament on timing. The ministers answered that a cabinet discussion took place with follow-up agreements referred to an earlier letter, no decision had been taken on Egypt, the Indonesia question was addressed in that letter, and they denied the allegations of strategic delay and ignored advice.
Given the cabinet's current caretaker status, we wish to weigh these matters with the utmost care before presenting them to your House.
Mede gezien de huidige demissionaire status van het kabinet willen wij deze aangelegenheden met de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wegen, alvorens ze aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Fritsma over het bericht dat Roemenen en Bulgaren vaker betrokken zijn bij mensenhandel

MPs Elissen and Fritsma asked whether the rising share of Romanians and Bulgarians in human trafficking cases warrants 100% border checks on their nationals and a firm stance on Schengen accession. The minister answered that border controls are already applied, that the KMar pilot has been scaled up nationally, and that the Netherlands will judge Schengen accession only after the July 2012 CVM report.
The cabinet's position on the Schengen accession of Bulgaria and Romania is known.
Het standpunt van het kabinet inzake de Schengentoetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenie is bekend.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe en Ferrier over het voornemen van verschillende universiteiten om talenstudies op te laten gaan in brede studies

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares concern that several universities plan to fold language degrees (e.g. Frisian, French, Portuguese) into broad bachelor programmes, and whether standalone full-time language study should be preserved for national and international interests. The State Secretary acknowledged language importance, said profiling may mean some small programmes disappear or are merged or restructured, and that broad bachelors can still offer languages, while institutions must align plans with the Implementation Plan for Humanities.
I share the view that languages are of great importance from a national cultural perspective and for the Dutch economy and exports.
Ik deel de mening dat talen van groot belang zijn vanuit nationaal cultureel belang en voor de Nederlandse economie en de export.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over inperking van internetvrijheid in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Iran would shut down popular email services and internet access were accurate, and whether the Netherlands could still support internet freedom in Iran. The minister said EU embassies could not verify Iranian intentions, but that the government has earmarked 1 million euros for emergency internet technology and support for Iran, with further funds from the Human Rights Fund.
It is therefore impossible at this time to establish what the intentions and capabilities of the Iranian authorities are.
Het is daardoor onmogelijk om op dit moment vast te stellen wat de intenties en mogelijkheden van de Iraanse autoriteiten zijn.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over de samenstelling van het grondwetscomité in Egypte

MP Ormel asked the foreign minister about the composition of Egypt's constitutional committee, which Coptic and moderate parties withdrew from or boycotted, and about how the Netherlands will safeguard minority and women's rights. The minister says the Administrative Court has declared the committee unconstitutional and activities are paused, and describes bilateral and EU advocacy and funding for women's organisations, with no answer on whether the EU's election monitoring request has been granted.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Egyptian authorities to admit independent (international) election observers.
Nederland zal bij de Egyptische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op toelating van onafhankelijke (internationale) verkiezingswaarnemers.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Karabulut over de mishandeling van Koerdische kinderen in Turkse gevangenissen

Two SP MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of sexual abuse and beatings of Kurdish juveniles in the Pozanti detention centre in Turkey, and about related oversight and Dutch influence. The minister answered that the Turkish justice ministry has investigated, closed the youth wing, transferred detainees, and is preparing criminal measures, while stating that Dutch and EU pressure on Turkey continues through accession channels.
I will continue to follow this situation closely, also within the framework of the EU accession process.
Ik zal deze situatie, ook in het kader van het EU -toetredingsproces, met aandacht blijven volgen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de detentie van Afghaanse vrouwen

An MP asks the foreign minister about the detention of Afghan women and girls who flee domestic violence or forced marriage, and whether the government will press Afghan authorities to implement the elimination-of-violence law nationwide and adopt the new family law. The minister says the Netherlands raises women's rights and the HRW findings in bilateral and multilateral contacts, but cannot name concrete improvements and only commits to continue raising these issues.
Yes. The subject of women's rights is explicitly raised.
Ja. Het onderwerp vrouwenrechten wordt nadrukkelijk aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het verbod van LGBTI (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Intersex) demonstraties in Moldavië

Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister about the ban on LGBTI demonstrations in Moldova and whether the government will press Moldovan authorities on constitutional rights, pending anti-discrimination legislation and their human rights obligations. Minister Rosenthal replies that the EU and bilateral channels have condemned the ban, that Moldova's foreign minister pledged adoption of anti-discrimination law, and that the matter will be raised at the EU-Moldova human rights dialogue and UPR follow-up.
Both bilaterally and within the EU, the Moldovan authorities are being called to account on this.
Zowel in bilateraal als in EU-verband worden de Moldavische autoriteiten hierop aangesproken.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over de zelfmoord van het 16-jarige Marokkaanse meisje Amina Filali

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Foreign Affairs about the suicide of a 16-year-old Moroccan girl forced into marriage with her rapist under Article 475 of Morocco's penal code, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco on it. The minister of Foreign Affairs acknowledged the article's effect on women's rights, said the Moroccan government will address the issue itself and that EU human rights dialogue will cover progress, and declined to commit to a working-group meeting.
Because the Moroccan government has indicated it will address this issue itself, it is now mainly up to the Moroccan government and society to study the legal context and revise the legislation.

Omdat de Marokkaanse regering heeft aangegeven deze kwestie zelf te zullen aanpakken, is het nu vooral aan de Marokkaanse regering en de Marokkaanse samenleving om de juridische context te bestuderen en de wetgeving te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven, Bosma en Wilders over de Turkse reactie op het in het Rijksmuseum exposeren van een ‘anti-Turkse spotprent’

PVV MPs asked the government about Turkish media criticism of a 1683 anti-Turkish caricature exhibited at the Rijksmuseum, whether Turkish authorities had contacted the Dutch government, and whether the museum's explanatory text was a form of capitulation. The minister answered that the Turkish embassy raised concern via the foreign ministry, that the museum is responsible for its own captions, and that the government does not share the characterization of the museum's conduct.
As for any Turkish contacts with the Rijksmuseum, I refer you to the director of the Rijksmuseum.
Voor wat betreft eventuele Turkse contacten met het Rijksmuseum, verwijs ik u naar de directeur van het Rijksmuseum.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether she would respond to the Saudi Grand Mufti's call to destroy all churches on the Arabian Peninsula, including bilateral or EU-level challenge over Saudi Arabia's religious freedom obligations. The minister deplored the remarks, said they were raised with the GCC at EU level, noted the Mufti has no formal political role, and said human rights including religious freedom are regularly discussed with Saudi authorities.
Antwoord vragen Peters, Pechtold en Timmermans over intensivering van de bilaterale relatie met Israël

MPs Peters, Pechtold and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the Netanyahu visit, the planned intensification of Dutch-Israeli relations, the expected bilateral cooperation agreement and its transparency, and whether settlement-based firms could benefit. The minister answered that the visit was routine, a first Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council is set for 7 June 2012 with a non-binding founding document to be shared after the meeting, and that consular services to settlement firms are refused without legal advice being needed.
The cabinet first wants to reach agreement with Israel on the content of the document.
Het kabinet wil eerst overeenstemming bereiken met Israël over de inhoud van het document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van vijf Papua’s in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of five Papuans in Indonesia for a peaceful independence declaration, including the fairness of the trial, alleged police violence, deaths at the demonstration, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia and reconsider tank sales. The minister answered that the appeal is pending, that Indonesian and NGO inquiries confirmed three deaths but left circumstances unclear, that some disciplinary sanctions were imposed, and that a motion on tank sales is under consideration.
I am awaiting the appeal ruling.
Ik wacht de uitspraak in hoger beroep af.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de steun van de Liberiaanse president aan anti-homowetgeving

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Liberian President Ellen Johnson Sirleaf's reported support for anti-homosexuality bills, and whether the government would engage the Liberian authorities and the AU on international human rights obligations. The minister said the reported statements contradict the president's earlier public commitments, that the Dutch policy on LGBTI rights will be conveyed in regular contacts and EU channels, and that the EU is in contact with a Liberian activist.
The Netherlands rejects discrimination and actively advocates for the rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex (LGBTI) persons.
Nederland wijst discriminatie af en komt actief op voor de rechten van lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, transgender en intersex (LHBTI) personen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over de positie van Assyrische christenen in Irak

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven) asked the Foreign Minister about the position of Assyrian Christians in Iraq, including a human rights report on their exodus, Dutch support for UNDP projects in Nineveh, police deployment there, and the status of the Zakho attacks investigation. The minister described the UNDP projects and said he would raise concerns about church attacks and police in Nineveh with Iraqi authorities, while noting that some arrests were made and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
I will discuss this shortly with the Iraqi authorities and specifically ask for attention to the deployment of police in Nineveh.
Ik bespreek dit op korte termijn met de Iraakse autoriteiten en vraag daarbij specifiek aandacht voor de inzet van de politie in Nineveh.
Antwoord vragen Ormel en Ten Broeke over de veroordeling van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs Ormel and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of five Papuan men for declaring Papuan independence at a congress, and about Indonesia's continued harsh sentencing of peaceful demonstrators, the transfer of prisoners, and the slow implementation of the Special Autonomy Law. The minister confirmed the convictions as attempted treason, noted that an appeal was filed and awaited, stated Dutch concern has been raised bilaterally and in the EU, acknowledged slow autonomy implementation as a cause of protests, and described UP4B office openings and possible Dutch support for programmes in Papua.
I am awaiting the appeal ruling.
Ik wacht de uitspraak in hoger beroep af.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen.

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns the Saudi grand mufti's call to destroy all churches on the Arabian Peninsula, whether it endangers Christians, and whether the EU and UN will respond. The minister said she regrets the remarks, knows of no attacks following them, noted EU concerns were raised with the GCC, and stated the mufti has no formal political role and that human rights including religious minorities are regularly discussed with Saudi authorities.
The grand mufti has no formal role in political decision-making in Saudi Arabia, so his remark does not reflect the policy of the Saudi authorities.
De grootmoefti heeft geen formele rol in de politieke besluitvorming in Saudi-Arabië, zijn opmerking weerspiegelt dan ook niet het beleid van de Saudische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de situatie omtrent de Oekraïense oppositieleider Avakov

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister about the prosecution of Ukrainian opposition figure Arsen Avakov, including Interpol's role, and whether the Netherlands and EU would press Ukraine on politically motivated prosecutions and criminal provisions. Minister Rosenthal answered that the Netherlands lacks insight into the Interpol-related arrest, that the EU and Netherlands have repeatedly raised rule-of-law concerns with Ukraine, and that she raised the matter with the Ukrainian foreign minister.
I have no insight into the procedure that resulted in Mr Avakov's arrest by the Italian authorities.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de procedure die heeft geresulteerd in de aanhouding van de heer Avakov door de Italiaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen.

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about a reported call by Saudi Arabia's grand mufti to destroy all churches in the region, including the influence of the cleric, Saudi authorities' reaction and what the government would do. The minister deplored such statements, said the mufti has no formal political role, raised concerns through the EU with the GCC, and noted that human rights are discussed regularly with Saudi authorities, without committing to new steps beyond that.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over 'de invoer van producten uit nederzettingen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever'

MP Van Bommel asked ministers about imports of products from West Bank settlements under the EU-Israel Association Agreement, including labelling, preferential-origin controls, a blacklist of firms, and enforcement. Minister Rosenthal answered that such misuse is very rare, that origin checks are conducted with the Commission moving toward publishing a settlement postcode list, that blacklisting is for the Commission, and that no import ban exists in line with the international position.

Partly at the urging of the European Parliament, the European Commission is currently considering publishing this list with the aim of preventing settlement products from using the tariff preferences.

Mede op aandringen van het EP overweegt de Europese Commissie (EC) momenteel openbaarmaking van deze lijst met als doel om te voorkomen dat nederzettingenproducten gebruik maken van de tariefpreferenties.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Bontes over de VN-mensenrechtenraad

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister why the UN Human Rights Council adopted a report praising Qaddafi's Libya despite global criticism, why EU members on the Council agreed, and whether those states would be challenged. The minister replied that the report only records the Council's discussion of Libya's 2010 review, that Netherlands asked critical questions, and that adopting the report does not mean endorsing every statement in it.
Agreeing to the report therefore certainly does not automatically mean agreeing with everything other UN member states have put forward.
Instemming met het verslag betekent dus zeker niet per definitie instemming met al hetgeen door andere VN-lidstaten naar voren is gebracht.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de mensenrechtensituatie in Cuba

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report on routine short-term detentions and harassment of critics in Cuba, and whether the Netherlands will protest bilaterally and in the EU and support tougher EU sanctions. The minister acknowledges the report, says the Netherlands opposes these restrictions and presses for release of political prisoners via the EU-Cuba dialogue, and says sanctions would be considered if necessary.
The Netherlands presses for the unconditional release of all political prisoners, an end to arbitrary short detentions and improvement of the human rights situation in general.
Nederland dringt aan op de onvoorwaardelijke vrijlating van alle politieke gevangenen, beëindiging van arbitraire korte detenties en verbetering van de situatie van de mensenrechten in het algemeen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the minister of Foreign Affairs whether the UN Human Rights Council's adoption of several resolutions critical of Israel, and a fact-finding mission, was disproportionate compared with its one resolution on Syria, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the number and character of the Israel resolutions were disproportionate, said the Netherlands argues for proportionality and has raised the concern within the EU and the UN, and answered all questions.
I consider the number of Israel resolutions and their character to be disproportionate.
Ik acht het aantal Israël-resoluties en het karakter ervan disproportioneel.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat een kerk in Koeweit mogelijk voor Goede Vrijdag gesloten wordt

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether a Kuwaiti evangelical church would close before Good Friday following a Saudi fatwa, and whether the government would protest or summon Kuwait's ambassador. The minister answered that the church is not closing and services will proceed, saw no reason to summon the ambassador, and noted no change in Kuwaiti policy toward churches.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Van Gerven over marteling en mishandeling in Israëlische detentiecentra

MPs Van Bommel and Van Gerven asked the government about a report alleging torture and ill-treatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres with medical staff involvement, and whether the government would press Israel for independent investigation and accountability. The minister said the government cannot assess the report's findings, leaves judgement and investigation to Israeli authorities and the UN Committee against Torture, and noted Israel's Health Ministry had set up a review commission.
The cabinet does not have the information that would make it possible to form a judgement on the content of the report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de informatie die het mogelijk maakt een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud van het rapport.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over Aanvallen Japanse walvisvaarders op bemanning Sea Sheperd

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about Japanese whalers' alleged violent attacks on Sea Shepherd crew near Antarctica, including water cannons, grappling hooks and bamboo poles, and asked why no prosecution had been launched. The minister said the Netherlands is in contact with both sides and will assess whether independent investigation is needed, but declined to judge the specific incidents, pointing to the absence of a judicial procedure and to the lack of complaints filed.
On the basis of the available information I am not in a position to make a substantive judgment on this specific situation.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie ben ik niet in staat om een inhoudelijk oordeel te vellen over deze specifieke situatie.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over de actie 'plant een olijfboom'

MP Ten Broeke asked the foreign minister about a Dutch-supported olive-tree planting action in the Palestinian territories, including whether the land was privately owned and whether Norway's and Israel's handling of the incident should be raised. The minister confirmed the facts of the statements, declined to rule on land ownership as a local legal matter, said owners should be able to act without outside disruption, and said the matter is primarily for Norway.
This concerns a legal question that must be interpreted under local applicable law. It is not for the Netherlands to rule on it.
Het betreft een juridische kwestie die naar lokaal geldend recht dient te worden geïnterpreteerd. Het is niet aan Nederland daarover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ormel en Voordewind over 'de sluiting van een christelijke kerk door de Palestijnse Autoriteit'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority intends to force the First Baptist Church in Bethlehem to close, and what the background is. The minister answered that the PA says it has no plan to close the church, that the church issued marriage and birth certificates without authorisation and was asked to stop or meet legal requirements, and that Christians enjoy religious freedom in the Palestinian territories.
As previously indicated, there is no intention to close the Baptist congregation in Bethlehem.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven is er geen voornemen de Baptistengemeente in Bethlehem te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Peters over voltrekking van de doodstraf door India

An MP asks the foreign minister about India's plan to lift its death penalty moratorium and execute Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana, and about Sikh concerns of discrimination. The minister answers that the execution has been postponed pending a new clemency request, that religious minorities face some discrimination but no anti-Sikh violence like in the 1980s and 1990s, and that the EU has made a demarche to India opposing the death penalty.
After the Indian intention to execute Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana became known, the Netherlands pressed within the EU for a demarche against it with the Indian authorities.
Nadat het Indiase voornemen om Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana te executeren bekend werd, heeft Nederland zich in EU-verband hardgemaakt voor een demarche hiertegen bij de Indiase autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ormel en Çörüz over de recente aankondiging van executie van Balwant Singh Rajoana in India

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the announced execution of Balwant Singh Rajoana in India, the legal process, India's refusal to support a UN moratorium on the death penalty, pending clemency petitions, and EU steps. The minister said the case has had little criticism, that a de facto moratorium exists but India opposes UN resolutions, and that the EU will make a demarche in Delhi calling for the moratorium to be kept.
The EU will carry out a demarche with the Indian authorities in Delhi in the short term and raise its principled objections to the death penalty.
De EU voert op korte termijn bij de Indiase autoriteiten in Delhi een demarche uit en stelt de principiële bezwaren tegen de doodstraf aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Peters over geweld door kolonisten en Palestijnen op de Westbank

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about settler violence against Palestinians on the West Bank, including OCHA and Yesh Din findings on weak prosecution, the Netanyahu measures announced in December 2011, the EU note on enforcement, and incident statistics. The minister answers that the Israeli authorities should first respond, that the government will inform parliament on the measures, that it agrees with the report's findings, and gives OCHA incident figures while noting no comparable data exist for Palestinian violence.
The cabinet is of the view that it is primarily up to the Israeli authorities to respond to this.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het in eerste instantie aan de Israëlische autoriteiten is daarop te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Magnitsky case, including whether Russian documents are authentic, whether a US-style visa ban exists, and when the Netherlands will impose a visa ban as the House requested. The minister answered that the Russian criminal case is ongoing, that there is no categorical US visa ban but visas can be refused for human rights abuses, that the list of persons refused entry is confidential, and that further EU steps will be considered after the Russian proceedings.
Information on who is or is not registered in the Schengen Information System for refusal is confidential.
De informatie met betrekking tot wie al dan niet in het Schengen Informatie Systeem ter weigering staan geregistreerd, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over gevangenisstraffen voor dissidenten in Iran

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether reported prison sentences for Iranian dissidents Ali Shakouri-Rad (4 years) and Abdolfattah Soltani (18 years) signal growing repression, and whether the EU should intensify pressure, including harder options against Iranian leaders. The minister confirmed increasing repression, reported that the Netherlands pushed for additional EU sanctions, and noted that the EU adopted an expanded list of human rights violators and an export ban on internet monitoring technology on 23 March.
The Iranian regime is exercising increasing repression against the opposition, dissidents and human rights activists.
Het Iraanse regime oefent toenemende repressie uit tegenover de oppositie, dissidenten en mensenrechtenactivisten.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, Arib en Marcouch over ongeregeldheden in Noord-Marokko

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about arrests of demonstrators in northern Morocco, including a Dutch-Moroccan man detained for photographing a demonstration, and about Morocco's democratic and human rights reforms. The minister said protesters were detained, that the government should allow peaceful demonstrations, that the man is now free but still faces trial, and that further steps depend on the court outcome.
It is important that the new government shows it takes the modernisation process seriously and allows peaceful demonstrations.
Het is belangrijk dat de nieuwe regering aantoont het moderniseringsproces serieus te nemen en vreedzame demonstraties toestaat.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over schokkende beelden van dierenmishandeling op een Brits veebedrijf

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch meat from a UK factory-farm abuse case could be stopped at the border, whether Dutch consumers can be protected, and what enforcement safeguards exist. The state secretary replied that closing borders on welfare grounds is not possible under EU law, that enforcement is shared with member states and the NVWA does risk-based inspections, and promised to push for better EU enforcement without committing to a specific step.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dat kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de opgepakte Nederlander van Marokkaanse afkomst in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Morocco of a Dutch national of Moroccan descent, Yuba Zalen, whether he was tortured and whether protests in the Rif were suppressed harshly. The minister answered that Zalen was arrested for photographing a demonstration, received consular assistance from an honorary consul and was released pending trial, and described the protests and police response as involving tear gas and water cannons without condemning the conduct.
Mr Zalen has been released pending the court hearing.
De heer Zalen is in vrijheid gesteld in afwachting van de rechtszitting.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de situatie van Bradley Manning

El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the foreign minister whether she knew of UN torture rapporteur Méndez's findings that Bradley Manning was cruelly and inhumanly treated, whether this violates the Convention against Torture, and whether she would raise concerns with the US. Minister Rosenthal said the rapporteur did not conclude torture in Manning's case, that pretrial detention should not be punitive, and that she sees no reason for bilateral action since US compliance is reviewed within the UN framework.
I therefore see no reason in this specific case for bilateral action by the Netherlands towards the US.
Ik zie daarom in dit specifieke geval geen aanleiding voor bilaterale actie van Nederland richting de VS.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de toekenning van een prijs van het Prins Claus Fonds 2011 aan Tsering Woeser

An MP asks the foreign minister about Tibetan writer Tsering Woeser, who was reportedly barred by Chinese authorities from collecting a Prins Claus Fonds prize at the Dutch embassy in Beijing, and whether the government will raise it at the EU level and in human rights dialogue. The minister replies that China denies house arrest and only asked her not to attend, that the prize and money were transferred, and that the government will raise the case in the EU-China human rights dialogue.
I will argue that her case is raised when individual cases are addressed in that framework.
Ik zal bepleiten dat haar zaak wordt meegenomen wanneer in dat kader individuele gevallen aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de actie van Invisible Children op YouTube en Twitter

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the Invisible Children Kony 2012 campaign, its independence and funding, and whether government should inform users of NGO status on social media and promote social media for human rights. The minister acknowledges the campaign's attention value, says NGOs themselves must communicate their status and independence, and states the government supports internet freedom projects but declines a dedicated letter beyond existing policy reporting.
It is up to NGOs themselves to communicate about their status and independence to users of social media.
Het is aan NGO's zelf om over hun status en onafhankelijkheid te communiceren met gebruikers van sociale media.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de verkiezingen van 6 mei aanstaande in Armenië

An MP asked the minister about EU and Dutch efforts to promote fair elections in Armenia, including funding, electoral law reform and media freedom. The minister answered that the EU, OSCE and UNDP run programmes on elections, that the Netherlands supports civil society observation and funds one long-term and four short-term OSCE observers, and that electoral law was recently revised with OSCE and Venice Commission recommendations.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke en Ormel over het bericht dat de Afghaanse president Karzai het standpunt van de Ulema Council steunt dat vrouwen niet mogen mixen met mannen op school of tijdens het werk

MPs Ten Broeke and Ormel asked whether President Karzai endorsed the Ulema Council's ruling that women may not mix with men at school or work, and what the Netherlands and the international community are doing to protect women's position in Afghanistan from Taliban influence. The minister confirms Karzai called the statement consistent with Islamic law but reaffirmed support for constitutional women's rights, notes shared concern, and describes Dutch support for women's organisations, programmes and diplomatic raising of the issue.
The Netherlands shares the concerns of MP Fawzia Koofi.
Nederland deelt de zorgen van parlementslid Fawzia Koofi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Palestijnse ophitsing ten aanzien van de Joden

An SGP MP asked the foreign minister how the government judges a Palestinian mufti's public call to kill Jews and whether it will sanction the Palestinian Authority or limit its funding. The minister condemned the statements, said they violate the Roadmap and the ICCPR, and declined sanctions for now, instead urging the PA to act and reviving trilateral talks.
Punishing the PA will not contribute to restarting the peace talks at this time.
Bestraffing van de PA zal op dit moment niet bijdragen aan de herstart van de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de verdediging van de Palestijnse haatmoefti door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority defended a mufti whose speech incited violence, and whether Dutch funding should be cut. The minister condemned the mufti's words, said there was no evidence the PA defended them, and refused to cut funding, citing the priority of restarting peace talks and a commitment to trilateral talks against incitement.
Punishing the PA will not contribute to restarting the peace talks at this time.
Bestraffing van de PA zal op dit moment niet bijdragen aan de herstart van de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de bevindingen van het boek Deception

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the book 'Deception' documenting Palestinian Authority incitement and glorification of terrorism, and whether Dutch aid should be conditioned on tackling it. The minister acknowledged the statements as unacceptable but argued the PA cannot be held responsible for every media statement, referred the matter to revived trilateral talks and EU channels, and rejected monthly conditional aid payments as counterproductive to peace talks.
In all its contacts with the PA, the government points to the need to counter incitement and glorification of violence.
Het kabinet wijst in al zijn contacten met de PA op de noodzaak haatzaaien en geweldverheerlijking tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over de organisatie Palestinian Media Watch

MPs El Fassed asked the foreign minister about Palestinian Media Watch, its director's past ties to Central Fund of Israel, alleged funding by a foundation linked to a wanted person, and whether the government has an accurate picture of incitement in Israel and the Palestinian territories. The minister confirmed awareness of the outsourcing report, said the director was active there until 2010, gave limited information on the funding and Cherney matter, and stated the cabinet relies on its own observation and diplomatic reporting.
I have no further information about the relationship between Cherney and Palestinian Media Watch.
Ik heb geen nadere informatie over de relatie tussen Cherney en Palestinian Media Watch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over ophef, verontwaardiging en onzekerheid binnen het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken n.a.v. de casus-Haspels en zijn persoonlijke facebook pagina

An MP asked the foreign minister about internal unrest at the foreign ministry over her public criticism of officials, including a case involving an ambassador's personal Facebook page, and asked whether the works council's letter and the secretary-general's replies would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that social media use is governed by the civil servants' freedom-of-expression rules with the usual criteria, that a staff meeting was held on 5 March, and that the internal response follows those lines with no real difference between online and offline expression, without sending the internal letters to parliament.
Are you willing to send the secretary-general's replies to the works council's letter to the House?
Bent u bereid de antwoorden van de secretaris-generaal op de brief van de Ondernemingsraad naar de Kamer te sturen
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de toekenning van een prijs van het Prins Claus Fonds aan Tsering Woeser

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Tibetan writer Tsering Woeser was placed under house arrest, preventing her from collecting a Prins Claus Fund award, and whether the government would press China to lift it. The minister confirmed she had asked not to attend the dinner, noted China denies house arrest, and said the award stands and the money was transferred, without committing to press Beijing.
The obstruction of Ms Woeser's attendance changes nothing about the fact that she was awarded the prize by the jury of the Prins Claus Fund.
De belemmering van aanwezigheid van mevrouw Woeser verandert niets aan het feit dat haar de prijs is toegekend door de jury van het Prins Claus Fonds.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de toespraak van de minister van buitenlandse zaken voor de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the 'receptor approach' is official Dutch human rights policy, as stated in a UN Human Rights Council speech, and why the promised letter to parliament explaining it was not sent earlier. The minister answers that the approach is being explored in a pilot as requested by parliament, that the letter has been sent, and that the speech is consistent with prior exchanges with parliament.
Implementation of the receptor approach is currently being explored in a pilot, as requested in the Van der Staaij et al. motion.
Uitvoering van de receptorbenadering wordt op dit moment verkend in een pilot zoals in de motie Van der Staaij c.s. verzocht.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de berichtgeving dat Bahrein het bezoek van VN onderzoeker Juan Mendez wil uitstellen

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Bahrain wants to postpone the visit of UN investigator Juan Mendez, whether NGOs face visa restrictions, and whether the government will raise this with Bahrain or at the EU Gymnich meeting. The minister confirmed awareness, said states must grant the UN Special Rapporteur on torture access, and said the Netherlands raises this, including NGO restrictions, in the UN Human Rights Council.
The Netherlands raises this, as well as the restrictions on NGOs, in the UN Human Rights Council.
Nederland stelt dit, net als de restricties voor NGO’s, aan de orde in de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven over Chinese overheidsmaatregelen tegen mensenrechtenverdedigers

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Chinese police preventing Tsering Woeser from receiving the Prins Claus Prize and to her house arrest, whether she can be invited to the Netherlands, how these measures are assessed, and whether Dutch diplomats visited or attended the trial of Ni Yulan. The minister says the government deplored the events and asked Chinese authorities for an explanation, that Woeser cannot travel as she has no passport, that the Tibetan issue is raised in EU-China dialogue, and that Ni Yulan's trial was monitored but the embassy was denied access to the courtroom.
I regret the course of events and have asked the Chinese authorities for a text and explanation.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken en heb de Chinese autoriteiten om tekst en uitleg gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over Europese wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of claims that France and Germany pressed Greece to spend EU aid on arms contracts and tied aid to submarine-type purchases. The minister confirmed awareness of both claims and said they gave him no reason to revise his earlier answers.
The statement by Mr Cohen Bendit and the anonymous remarks from a former Papandreou aide give me no reason to revise these answers.
De verklaring van de heer Cohen Bendit en de anonieme uitspraken van een medewerker van voormalig premier Papandreou geven mij geen aanleiding deze antwoorden ter herzien.
Antwoord vragen Helder en De Roon over het bericht ‘Ruim helft diplomaten betaalt boetes niet’

MPs Helder and De Roon asked whether foreign diplomats fail to pay over half of traffic fines and what the government does about it. The minister confirmed non-payment rates, explained that diplomatic immunity limits enforcement, and described diplomatic pressure and a planned annual reminder operation with CJIB and RDW.
That is not really possible for the period mentioned.
Dat is voor de genoemde periode niet goed mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Kortenoeven en Bontes over kandidaturen van Pakistan en Venezuela voor de VN Mensenrechtenraad

Three PVV MPs asked whether Pakistan and Venezuela are the only candidates for vacant UN Human Rights Council seats, whether their poor human rights records should bar them, and what the government will do to block them. The minister replied that other candidates exist under clean-slate arrangements, that human rights records weigh heavily but Netherlands does not state voting preferences, and that election of these two countries is unlikely to be prevented.
However, the Netherlands does not make statements about voting preferences in elections for UN bodies.
Nederland doet echter geen uitspraken over stemvoorkeuren bij verkiezingen voor VN-organen.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Jasper Van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij mogelijke bombardementsmissies op land in Somalië

MPs Irrgang and Van Dijk asked whether the Netherlands was involved in contingency plans for beach bombardment missions against pirate and insurgent camps in Somalia, and whether this would exceed the mandate. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not involved in any such plans, that piracy and terrorism were conflated in the press, and that Atalanta's mandate rests on UN resolutions; they promised to inform parliament once EU decisions on action with effect on land are completed.
As soon as the decision-making in EU context on action from the sea, with effect on land, is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het mandaat van de EU-operatie Atalanta

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU anti-piracy operation Atalanta, including reports of a more robust approach, UK Apache plans and the mandate under UN resolution 1816. The ministers answered that there is no objection to extending the operating area, that the EU decision on land-effect action is still pending and will be reported to parliament by letter.
Once the decision-making at EU level on action from the sea with effect on land is completed, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra de besluitvorming in EU-verband over optreden, vanaf zee, met effect op land voltooid is, wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over Kameroense wetgeving die mensen vastzet op verdenking van homoseksualiteit

An MP asked the foreign minister about Cameroonian law that detains people on suspicion of homosexuality, whether it breaches Cameroon's international human rights obligations, and whether the government will raise this with Cameroon bilaterally and through the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, said such a law breaches Cameroon's human rights obligations, and said the Netherlands has raised the issue in the EU, which issued a demarche, and will keep pressing it.
The Netherlands will continue to press within the EU for LHBT rights to be put on the agenda in relations with the Cameroonian government.
Nederland zal binnen de EU blijven aandringen op het agenderen van LHBT rechten in de relaties met de Kameroense regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen naar aanleiding van een nieuwsbericht over digitale spionage van China en Rusland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about digital espionage by China and Russia against travellers and businesses, including device tampering, government protective measures and the risks posed. The minister answered that the risk is real, listed espionage methods and existing AIVD/MIVD advisory, awareness and information-security measures, while withholding country-specific details as classified.
I cannot provide further information on which countries engage in espionage, as this concerns the knowledge level and sources of the AIVD and MIVD.
