Nadere informatie over landen die zich schuldig maken aan spionage kan ik niet verstrekken aangezien dat raakt aan het kennisniveau en de bronnen van de AIVD en de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albayrak over het artikel 'Boycot Roemenië en Polen gevreesd'

The MP Albayrak asks the Foreign Minister about fears of a boycott of Dutch goods by Romania and Poland linked to the Dutch refusal to allow free movement of workers for Romania, and whether the government shares concerns about export harm. The minister says the government is aware of the concerns, sees no evidence of negative export effects, and leaves the call by two MEPs to them, noting a boycott would violate EU internal market rules.
There are no indications that Dutch policy actually has negative consequences for Dutch exports.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat het Nederlands beleid daadwerkelijk negatieve gevolgen heeft voor de Nederlandse export.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over een nieuwe internationale aanpak van de problematiek in Somalië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported UK consideration of air strikes against pirates and Al Shabaab in Somalia, and about Dutch representation and position at the London conference. The minister answered that the Netherlands was represented, argued for an integrated (non-military-only) approach, announced funding for a stability fund and an anti-piracy centre, and said the UK had not asked for the Dutch position on military action.
On behalf of the government, the minister argued for an integrated approach to the problems in Somalia.
Namens de regering heeft de minister gepleit voor een geïntegreerde aanpak van de problematiek in Somalië.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over het bericht dat gruwelijke wraakacties worden uitgevoerd op Irakese homoseksuelen

Deputy Schouw (D66) asked the ministers of Immigration and Foreign Affairs about reports of violent reprisals against Iraqi homosexuals, whether this contradicts the 'social taboo' characterisation in the country report, and whether a moratorium or upgraded protection for Iraqi LGBT asylum seekers would follow. Minister Leers answered that the attacks also target 'Emo' youth, that the policy for Iraqi homosexuals has been changed to treat them as a vulnerable group, that a new country report is due around August 2012, and that he sees no need for a separate report or moratorium.
I have asked my colleague at Foreign Affairs to keep me informed if significant developments occur in the meantime.
Ik heb mijn ambtgenoot van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd mij op de hoogte te houden als zich in de tussentijd belangwekkende ontwikkelingen voordoen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel en Peters over het ILO rapport 'Burried in Bricks' en de betrokkenheid van NAVO/ISAF bij dwangarbeid in steenbakkerijen

MPs Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel and Peters asked the government about the ILO report 'Buried in Bricks' on bonded child and adult labour in Afghan brick kilns and whether NATO/ISAF supply chains use such bricks. The government answered that it shares the aim of ending child labour, that NATO/ISAF can not fully trace brick supply lines, and that NATO agreed four concrete follow-up steps while Afghanistan bears primary responsibility.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Libische opstandelingen

MP Van Bommel asked whether the Canadian ship HMCS Charlottetown, under NATO command, was ordered to let a vessel carrying arms to Libyan rebels pass, and whether the government knew of arms deliveries to rebels and acted against them. The government answered that NATO judged the transfer within Libya not to breach the arms embargo, that it does not consider the ship's conduct contrary to Dutch policy, and that interpreting UN resolutions is for each member state to decide.
The government shares this view and does not consider the conduct of the Canadian ship to be contrary to Dutch policy.
De regering deelt deze opvatting en acht het optreden van het Canadese schip niet strijdig met het Nederlandse beleid.
Antwoord vragen Bosman over het artikel ‘Emissie op Sint Maarten succesvol’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about a reported Sint Maarten port bond issue, whether Dutch oversight or CFT played a role, and whether Curaçao's planned loan would require Dutch purchase. The minister answered that the port is a private company outside the Rijkswet Financieel Toezicht, so neither Dutch government nor CFT had a role, and that the Curaçao road fund is not a budget fund so the Dutch standing facility cannot be used.
The port is a private-law company and therefore does not fall under the provisions of the Rijkswet financieel toezicht.
De haven is een privaatrechtelijke onderneming en valt hierdoor niet onder de bepalingen van de Rijkswet financieel toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over kinderarbeid en de positie van Dalits in India

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about whether the EU-India trade agreement's sustainability chapter had been agreed, child labour and Dalit rights in India, an ITUC report on labour rights, and human rights follow-up such as torture reports. Minister Rosenthal answered that the trade negotiations were not concluded before the February summit, that India has relevant laws but implementation is weak, and that Dalit rights and torture are on the EU-India human rights dialogue agenda, though most answers restate existing policy.
It has not proven possible to conclude the negotiations on the EU-India free trade agreement before the EU-India Summit of 10 February.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om de onderhandelingen over het EU-India vrijhandelsverdrag voor de EU-India Top van afgelopen 10 februari af te ronden.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de voortgang van de oorlog in Afghanistan

SP MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a US officer's critical article on the Afghan war, including whether insurgents control most land beyond ISAF bases and whether Afghan security forces make non-fire pacts with insurgents. The minister answered that the article reflects limited observations, that the security transition is on plan, that the government disagrees the Taliban controls territory, and that such pacts are only isolated incidents, with a fuller picture to come in a forthcoming progress letter.
In the forthcoming progress letter you will be informed further about the current security situation.
In de komende stand-van-zakenbrief wordt u nader geïnformeerd over de actuele veiligheidssituatie.

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about the Koran burning at Bagram, the riots in Kunduz, police conduct, the suspension of Dutch mission activities, and President Karzai's reaction. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, described police action as effective, and reported that Dutch training activities resumed from late February and early March 2012.
A joint Afghan-ISAF investigation into the precise background of the burning is ongoing.
Een gezamenlijk Afghaans-ISAF onderzoek naar de precieze achtergrond van de verbranding is gaande
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitzending “KRO reporter internationaal”

An SP MP asked three ministers about a KRO broadcast on Dutch private security contractors operating abroad, including the absence of registration of firearms incidents, screening of personnel, and liability for offences. The government replied that Dutch firms operating only abroad fall under the law of the host country, that MFA-contracted guards are screened by the AIVD and meet strict criteria, and that liability depends on the facts and host-country criminal law.
The principle that for security activities the law of the country of deployment, not of origin, applies, I consider logical and correct.
Het uitgangspunt dat voor het uitvoeren van beveiligingswerkzaamheden niet de wetgeving van het land van herkomst maar die van het land van inzet leidend is acht ik logisch en juist.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het voorliggend wetsvoorstel in Sint Petersburg dat het recht op vrije meningsuiting van LGBT'ers enorm zal inperken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the St Petersburg bill restricting LGBT expression violates human rights and Russia's Council of Europe commitments, and whether Russia will be challenged bilaterally and through the EU and Council of Europe. The minister agreed the bill restricts LGBT rights, called it contrary to Russian federal law and ECHR/ICCPR obligations, and reported EU demarches and personal concerns raised with Lavrov, while noting Russia's view that the law protects minors.
This regional legislation is in conflict with Russian national legislation and with Russia's international obligations.
Deze regionale wetgeving is in strijd met Russische nationale wetgeving en met de internationale verplichtingen van Rusland
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over de verwoesting door de overheid van de provincie Punjab (Pakistan) van gebouwen van de Lahore Charitable Organization

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Pakistani Lahore authorities' demolition of four Lahore Charitable Organization buildings, including housing and a chapel, and about the situation of minorities. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the demolition, said it likely had financial motives, raised the matter bilaterally, and said the Netherlands will press Pakistan with EU partners for change, without committing to report back on the specific reasons.
The Netherlands has requested an explanation from the Pakistani authorities about this incident at the bilateral level.
Nederland heeft op bilateraal niveau uitleg gevraagd aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten over dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over het bericht ‘Londen boos op Europese Hof na uitspraak over radicale Aboe Katada’

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about the European Court of Human Rights ruling blocking the deportation of Abu Qatada to Jordan, including how many similar suspects are in the Netherlands and how Europe can avoid becoming a safe haven for extremists. The minister answered that only a very small number of such persons are in the Netherlands, explained the Court's reasoning (diplomatic assurances sufficient on Article 3, but a flagrant denial of justice risk under Article 6), and said the government will keep exploring options such as removal to third countries.
An exact number is not given in cases like these because of the nature of the files.
Een exact aantal wordt in gevallen als deze niet gegeven in verband met de aard van de dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans over de staking van de olieproductie in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about the South Sudan oil production shutdown, alleged Sudanese seizure of oil, Dutch and EU roles in the negotiations, and the humanitarian situation. The minister answered that both states should revise unilateral steps and resume talks under the AU panel, that the Netherlands plays a supporting role, that the EU's role is supportive, and that the Netherlands will monitor the humanitarian situation.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over de steenkolendialoog

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the government about the stalled coal dialogue, supply-chain transparency for coal origin, and whether Nuon's commercial interests justify withholding it. The government replied that the dialogue is progressing, that origin disclosure is commercially sensitive and an imperfect indicator, and that it will invite parties to be transparent without itself publishing results.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation will, from its observer position, call on the parties involved to be transparent about the progress of the dialogue and the results achieved when the occasion arises.

Het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, zal vanuit zijn waarnemerspositie, de betrokken partijen oproepen bij gelegenheid zelf transparant te zijn over het verloop van de dialoog en de bereikte resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de rechtszaak tegen Erwin Vermeulen in Japan

The MP asks whether the minister misled the press about family visit options for Erwin Vermeulen, detained in Japan, and about his treatment and detention conditions, and asks whether the government will raise the case with Japan. The minister answers that the family was correctly informed, that detention conditions met Japanese rules, that the government expressed concern and urged Japan to allow family contact, but that it refrained from judging the case while it was before the courts.
In my view correct information has been provided.
Er is naar mijn oordeel correcte informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt over de Magnitsky-zaak

MPs Çörüz and Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the Magnitsky case, including what was raised with Lavrov, the posthumous prosecution, a visa ban on 60 officials, and further pressure on Russia. The minister answered that he pressed for a swift, objective investigation, questioned the posthumous proceedings, and noted the US and UK had no visa ban, deferring any EU steps until the Russian investigation concludes.
I pressed for the swift completion of an objective and comprehensive investigation into the death of Sergei Magnitsky.
Ik heb aangedrongen op een spoedige afronding van een objectief en alomvattend onderzoek naar de dood van Sergei Magnitsky.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de mogelijke arrestaties van honderden Tibetanen door de Chinese autoriteiten

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of hundreds of Tibetans arrested by Chinese authorities while travelling to India, and whether detention and political re-education camps are involved. The minister said the events cannot currently be verified due to restricted access to Tibet, promised the human rights ambassador will try to visit Tibet, and referred to ongoing EU efforts to raise access and the situation with Chinese authorities.
It is not currently possible to establish what exactly happened.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk na te gaan wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Timmermans over een inval van Syrische troepen bij een NGO

MPs Pechtold and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister how the government would respond to a Syrian raid on an NGO that reportedly detained human rights defenders, and whether it would raise the incident at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister replied that the government was deeply concerned, that EU High Representative Ashton had already issued a statement calling for release, and that the EU Council had discussed Syria on 27 February.
Expressing our concerns through the EU is the most effective approach in this case.
Het uiten van onze zorgen via de EU is in dit geval het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over het uitblijven van een reactie op uitlatingen van de heer Rick Santorum

An MP asked the foreign minister why the Dutch embassy in Washington did not publicly rebut US candidate Santorum's false claims about forced euthanasia of the elderly in the Netherlands, and whether the ambassador would be instructed to respond publicly. The minister answered that the embassy had provided facts to Santorum's campaign team and to US media, and that Santorum's claims do not match Dutch practice and law.
The embassy provided facts to Mr Santorum's campaign team that refuted the statements he used.
De ambassade heeft feiten verstrekt aan het campagneteam van de heer Santorum waar de door hem gebezigde uitspraken werden weerlegd.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over de Amerikaanse actie tegen Megaupload en de arrestatie van een Nederlander

MPs El Fassed and Dibi (GroenLinks) asked about the US shutdown of Megaupload, the arrest of a Dutch national, Dutch cooperation via mutual legal assistance requests, and the seizure of Dutch servers. The minister said Dutch cooperation rested on existing treaties, that the servers were seized at US request under a pending foreign investigation, and declined to disclose further details.
I cannot provide further information on the background of the seizure or the content of the servers, because this concerns an ongoing foreign investigation.
Over de achtergronden van de inbeslagname en over de inhoud van de servers kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen omdat het hier een lopend (buitenlands) onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en De Lange over het bericht dat Zuid- Sudan afstevent op een hongersnood

MPs Timmermans and De Lange asked whether the government knows of WFP/FAO reports that South Sudan is heading toward famine, whether Dutch food aid is requested and how it will be funded, whether it will support cash transfers, helicopter support, and a role in preventing famine. The state secretary confirmed the reports, outlined a EUR 4 million contribution via the UN humanitarian fund plus multi-agency contributions, said FAO will assess cash transfers, and said no formal helicopter request was received while transport capacity is adequate.
The Netherlands plans to contribute EUR 4 million to this humanitarian action plan.
Nederland is van plan EUR 4 miljoen bij te dragen aan dit humanitaire actieplan.
Antwoord vragen  El Fassed over Amerikaanse belemmeringen op internetvrijheid

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the US pressured European countries, including the Netherlands, into passing online piracy laws such as SOPA, and how the government assessed SOPA. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not approached, that pressure on other EU states is a bilateral matter, and that the SOPA assessment was given in a separate letter from the economics minister.
The Netherlands has not been approached or pressured by the US to pass legislation.
Nederland is niet benaderd of onder druk gezet door de VS om wetgeving door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het bericht “Opstandige regio roert zich weer’

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about reports of violence against Tibetan protesters in Draggo, arrests, monasteries under siege, labelling of self-immolators as terrorists, dialogue with the Tibetan government in exile, and Han Chinese settlement in Tibet. Minister Rosenthal said the facts cannot be verified because the area is closed to EU representatives and journalists, and that the EU is preparing a demarche calling for dialogue and access.
It is not possible to establish precisely what happened.
Het is niet mogelijk precies na te gaan wat er is gebeurd.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over beschietingen van kinderen bij de grens met de Gazastrook

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about reported shootings of children near the Gaza border and Israel's restrictions on building materials for Gaza. The minister condemned violence against children, said Israel has legitimate security needs and must act within international law, and said Dutch concerns are shared with Israel.
On the basis of the available information I cannot assess whether these Israeli military actions, as described in the question, were specifically directed against children.
Ik kan op basis van de beschikbare informatie niet beoordelen of deze Israëlische militaire acties zoals in de vraag gesteld zich specifiek tegen kinderen richtten.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Hachchi over uitspraken HRW over Nederlands mensenrechtenbeleid

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister to respond to Human Rights Watch criticism that the Netherlands has become inconsistent on human rights, including toward friendly countries such as Israel, and to explain the government's position on appointing an EU Special Representative for Human Rights. The minister rejected the criticism, said friendly countries are also addressed on rights issues (with examples to follow in the 2011 human rights report), and stated the government is in principle opposed to such an EU special representative, pending internal EU discussions.
As promised to the House, I will include examples of this in the 2011 human rights report.
Zoals toegezegd aan de Kamer zal ik in de mensenrechtenrapportage 2011 daarvan voorbeelden opnemen.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier over de positie van vrouwen en het aanpakken van discriminatie in Egypte na de verkiezingen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how she assesses the position of women and discrimination in Egypt after the elections, given that the two largest parties do not clearly endorse these values. The minister answers that the parties' stated positions remain to be tested in practice, that women's representation is under 2 percent of parliament, and that the Netherlands funds and raises women's rights with Egyptian authorities.
The Dutch government will also assess the new Egyptian government on its actions regarding women's rights.
De Nederlandse regering zal de nieuwe Egyptische regering ook wat betreft vrouwenrechten beoordelen op haar daden.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over Amerikaanse National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether the US NDAA section 1021 on indefinite detention shifts power from courts to the executive and endangers Dutch residents, and whether it undermines Western criticism of rights violations elsewhere. The minister answered that it is premature to judge the law's effects, that the EU will raise concerns with the US, and that the US remains bound by international human rights and humanitarian law.

A number of provisions in the NDAA referred to by the ACLU, in particular those on detention of terrorism suspects and the possible geographic and temporal extension of the applicability of international humanitarian law, are not consistent with the Dutch and EU view of international law.

Een aantal bepalingen in de NDAA waaraan de ACLU refereert, met name die over de detentie van terrorismeverdachten en de mogelijke geografische en temporele oprekking van de toepasselijkheid van het humanitair oorlogsrecht, strookt niet met de Nederlandse en EU opvatting over het internationaal recht.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, De Lange en Marcouch over een anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

MPs Timmermans, De Lange and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether she knows the anti-homosexuality bill providing for the death penalty has been reintroduced in Uganda's parliament, whether she considers it a human rights violation, and how she will increase pressure on Uganda. The minister confirmed the bill violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations, said the Netherlands has repeatedly raised this bilaterally and multilaterally, and noted the Ugandan prime minister distanced himself from the proposal in a written statement.
The Netherlands has repeatedly pointed out to the Ugandan authorities, both bilaterally and multilaterally, that such a law violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations in this area.

Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk in zowel bi- als multilateraal verband de Oegandese autoriteiten erop gewezen dat een dergelijke wet in strijd is met de mensenrechten en de Oegandese internationale verplichtingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de Mensenrechtentulp

An MP asked the foreign minister whether she had pressured the independent jury over the human rights award, contacted Chinese authorities, moved the award ceremony, and apologised to China. The minister denied influencing the jury, said she had only asked Chinese authorities about blocking the laureate's daughter's trip and had not apologised, and declined to discuss cabinet deliberations.
I do not make statements about deliberations in the Council of Ministers.
Over beraadslagingen in de ministerraad doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over het bericht dat Nederland een EU-verklaring over Israël aanpaste

MP Pechtold asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands had intervened to remove references to an EU diplomatic report and to soften critical language on Israel in an EU Council statement. The minister denied that Dutch positions were pressed to avoid criticism of Israel, said the final text reflects EU consensus, and called the Dutch input constructive.
The Netherlands and many other EU member states made suggestions for the drafting of the Council conclusions.
Nederland en veel andere EU-lidstaten hebben suggesties gedaan voor de redactie van de Raadsconclusies
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Finance whether Greece will buy costly, unnecessary weapons during its bailout, whether the Dutch government issued export licences and lobbied for German arms sales, and whether Greek defence spending is excessive. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets have fallen since 2007, that the Dutch licence concerns frigate radar components for a Greek shipbuilding programme unrelated to the Die Zeit report, and that Greek procurement is a matter for Greece, declining to confirm several reported claims.
It is for the Greek government to shape its security policy and to set the priorities for its armed forces, and therefore also for its investments.
Het is aan de Griekse regering om haar veiligheidsbeleid vorm te geven, alsook de prioriteiten vast te stellen voor de strijdkrachten en daarmee ook in het doen van investeringen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over gebrek aan openheid over mogelijke tankdeal met Indonesië

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia was kept in the dark about a possible Dutch Leopard tank sale, how the government would implement the parliamentary motion on arms sales to Indonesia, and whether Indonesian parliamentarians had visited the Netherlands. The government answered that confidential talks with interested countries are ongoing, that any agreement would be reported to parliament, that Indonesia was informed of the motion, and that no catalogue or export-country list exists, with overview information provided in the annual MPO.
Should an agreement be reached with one of those countries, it will of course be reported to the House in accordance with the Van den Doel et al. motion.
Mocht het met een van die landen tot een overeenkomst komen, dan zal die uiteraard in overeenstemming met de motie-Van den Doel c.s.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de positie van Nederland op de 'scorecard' van The European Council on Foreign Relations

An MP asks the foreign minister about the Netherlands' poor ranking in the ECFR 2012 scorecard, its weaker standing versus Sweden and Denmark, its retreat on multilateral issues, its alleged obstruction of EU positions on the Middle East, and how it will restore its international position. The minister disputes the methodology, reframes the criticised positions as principled, and rejects the criticism while stating that Dutch interests remain central.
I do not share your negative assessment.
Ik deel uw negatieve oordeel niet.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over het rapport “Kosovo and Serbia: A Little Goodwill Could Go a Long Way”

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the ICG report on Kosovo and Serbia, including whether Serbia's EU candidacy should be conditioned on Kosovo participating in regional meetings without UN chaperoning, on border agreement implementation and on clearing roads to Kosovo. The minister says no additional conditions have been set beyond the December 2011 European Council conclusions, that Serbia's candidacy was not discussed at the PSC, that the Netherlands can support candidate status once those conclusions are met, and that comments on recommendations addressed to third parties are not for the government.
No additional conditions have been set for Serbia to obtain candidate membership.
Er zijn geen aanvullende voorwaarden aan Servië gesteld om het kandidaat-lidmaatschap te verkrijgen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het bericht dat Nederland ingrijpt bij kritische EU-tekst over Israël

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he intervened to keep a reference to a sensitive EU diplomatic report on Israel out of EU conclusions, and why. The minister confirms Dutch input shaped the text toward a balanced formulation supporting direct talks, says non-public reports are not usually cited, and denies colleagues objected.
The discussions on Council conclusions are confidential.
De besprekingen over Raadsconclusies zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind over de mogelijke samenwerking tussen de Taliban en het Afghaanse leger

An MP asked the foreign minister whether a confidential NATO report shows Taliban cooperation with the Afghan army and Pakistani intelligence support for the Taliban, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledged the report but declined to discuss its contents under NATO rules, said cooperation with the Taliban is not on the table until preconditions are met, and said there is no evidence of Taliban infiltration of the Afghan security services it works with.
Under NATO regulations, the government makes no statements about the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een geheim NAVO rapport over samenwerking tussen Taliban en de Afghaanse politie

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about a reported secret NATO report on Taliban cooperation with Afghan police, including questions on Taliban popular support, Kunduz transition and Pakistan's ISI. The minister declined to comment on the content of classified NATO documents, stated the transition is on schedule, and gave substantive but general answers on the other points.
In line with NATO regulations, the government does not make statements about the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de samenwerking tussen Afghaanse politiemensen en militairen met de Taliban

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the foreign minister about reports that Afghan police and soldiers cooperate with the Taliban in Kunduz, including NATO document claims and possible ISI ties. The government declined to discuss the confidential NATO document, denied rising Taliban influence in Kunduz and any infiltration of Dutch-trained units, and stressed Pakistan's importance.
In line with NATO regulations, the government makes no statements on the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Europese wapenexport naar ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked about incomplete EU arms export reporting for 2010, late submission by some member states, and whether licence refusals under criteria 2, 3 and 8 are adequately documented. The minister answered that several states do not register or pass on actual export values, the deadline was exceeded by some states, the common position sets no reporting deadline, and the Netherlands favours greater transparency in the EU.
The government cannot verify whether the value of actual exports to the Middle East and North Africa in 2010 was greater or smaller than 8.3 billion euro.
De regering kan niet nagaan of de waarde van de daadwerkelijke export naar het Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika in 2010 groter of kleiner dan 8,3 miljard euro was.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over beperking van bewegingsvrijheid van buitenlanders in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about raids on democracy NGOs in Egypt, the travel bans on foreign NGO staff, the prosecutions of 43 staff, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister said freedom of association is essential, aligned with EU High Representative Ashton's calls, said no Dutch nationals or Dutch-funded organisations were known to be affected, and that Nederland asked the EU Special Representative to raise the issue with Egypt.
The Netherlands asked the EU Special Representative for the southern Mediterranean, Bernardino León, to raise this issue forcefully with the Egyptian authorities during his visit to Egypt.

Nederland heeft EU Speciaal Vertegenwoordiger voor het zuidelijke Middellandse Zeegebied, Bernardino León, gevraagd deze kwestie tijdens zijn bezoek aan Egypte krachtig aan de orde te stellen bij de Egyptische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Pretoria

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch ambassador in Pretoria, who had 'liked' a Facebook page opposing a government supported by the PVV, should be disqualified and what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed the ambassador should have refrained from publicly expressing such a political view, that he has been addressed on it, and that he has since unliked the page.
Mr Haspels has been addressed on this and has in the meantime unliked the relevant Facebook page.
De heer Haspels is hierop aangesproken en heeft de betreffende Facebook-pagina inmiddels «ge-unliked».
Antwoord vragen Ormel over het plaatsen van Boko Haram op de lijst van terroristische organisaties van de EU

The MP asks the Foreign Minister for analysis of rising violence by Boko Haram against Christians in Nigeria, the death toll of the holiday attacks, the flight of Christians and reprisals against Muslims, whether the Netherlands will push for listing Boko Haram as a terrorist organisation in the EU, and what diplomatic action has been taken. The minister gives a substantive answer on the group, casualty figures, displacement, says the Netherlands will consider and raise EU listing, and reports condemnations and diplomatic steps.
The Dutch government is of the view that adding Boko Haram to the list of terrorist organisations should be considered and will raise this within the EU.
De Nederlandse regering is van mening dat toevoegen van Boko Haram aan de lijst van terroristische organisaties moet worden overwogen en zal dit binnen de EU aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over een brochure betaald door het Duitse ministerie van Justitie

PVV MPs Wilders and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether it is appropriate that a German justice ministry-funded brochure links Wilders' ideas to German neo-Nazi violence, and whether the government will distance itself and summon the German ambassador. The minister answered that the brochure does not make that claim, only factual references to Wilders' visit and a Facebook announcement, that the government distances itself from any reading implying he operates outside the rule of law, and that it will not summon the ambassador but has raised the matter directly with the German ministry.
No, there are direct contacts with the German Ministry of Justice on this subject in which the Dutch position described above has been stated.
Nee, er zijn directe contacten met het Duitse ministerie van Justitie over dit onderwerp waarin de boven beschreven Nederlandse positie is gemarkeerd.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over oriënterende gesprekken die Shell voert in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked whether Shell is exploring activities in South Sudan, including a possible pipeline to Ethiopia, and how the government ensures responsible conduct. The minister confirmed a general exploratory visit notified in advance to the ministry and embassy, said Shell has no pipeline plans, and pointed to OECD guidelines and Shell's assurances on transparency.
Shell has informed that it has no plans to construct a pipeline from South Sudan to Ethiopia.
Shell heeft laten weten dat het geen voornemens heeft om een pijpleiding van Zuid-Sudan naar Ethiopië aan te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over het Turkse raketprogramma

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Turkey is developing long-range ballistic missiles, whether this breaches NATO philosophy or the non-proliferation treaty, and whether the minister will raise it at NATO. The minister replied that nothing is known to him about a Turkish missile programme, declined to engage with the NATO and non-proliferation questions on that basis, and answered the timing question affirmatively.
I have no knowledge of this and have also been unable to obtain any confirmation of it.
Mij is daarover niets bekend en evenmin heb ik daar enige vorm van bevestiging van kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over recente ontwikkelingen in Jemen

An MP asks the foreign minister about the immunity granted to former Yemeni president Saleh under the transition deal, whether he still exerts influence, and whether sanctions or pressure remain possible. The minister confirms the immunity is part of the November transition agreement, acknowledges signals of Saleh's continued influence, but says there is no information he is using capital for political gain and that sanctions are not currently appropriate.
Immunity for President Saleh is part of the transition agreement concluded in November between President Saleh and the opposition parties.
Immuniteit voor president Saleh maakt deel uit van het transitieakkoord dat in november tussen president Saleh en de oppositiepartijen werd gesloten.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de dochter van Mensenrechtentulpwinnares Ni Yulan

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention of Ni Yulan's daughter at Beijing airport while travelling to receive the Human Rights Tulip, and whether the ambassador would be summoned and what steps the government would take. The minister confirmed the detention and release, said China regards it as a domestic matter, reported that the embassy has requested explanation, and said he would speak at the ceremony.
I immediately asked the Chinese Ambassador in The Hague and in Beijing for an explanation of this situation.
Ik heb onmiddellijk bij de Chinese Ambassadeur in Den Haag en in Peking om tekst en uitleg gevraagd over deze situatie.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het protest tegen mijnbouw in Mali

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about a protest tour against a planned uranium mine in Mali, the impact of mining on local food security and water, and whether the government supports local participation and technical assistance. The state secretary acknowledged the report, stated that mining impacts depend on location and that environmental controls need improvement, pointed to Mali's EIA requirements, EITI membership and several capacity-building programmes.
It would go too far to answer this question positively in general terms.
Het zou te ver strekken om deze vraag in algemene zin positief te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Kortenoeven over de boycot van Iraanse olie

MPs De Roon and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about Greek objections to an EU boycott of Iranian oil, possible compensation arrangements, costs, Turkey's exemption request and the Halkbank position. The minister replied that EU talks on compensating supply and modalities are ongoing, that a ban is not expected to cause direct extra costs but may briefly raise oil prices, that Turkey is not covered by an EU ban, and that EU sanctions apply to Halkbank's European branches.
At this moment, discussions are taking place at EU level about a ban on the import of Iranian oil into the EU.
Op dit moment wordt in EU-verband gesproken over een verbod op de import van Iraanse olie in de EU.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven over de vriendschappelijke betrekkingen tussen het islamistische regime Erdogan en de islamitische terreurorganisatie Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's engagement with Hamas and whether the government would condemn it and reconsider celebrating 400 years of Dutch-Turkish relations. The minister replied that Turkey's contacts are monitored and raised with Ankara, that EU conditions for contact with Hamas apply, and that the bilateral relationship is important and will be celebrated.

The government follows the contacts between Turkey and Hamas and raises with Turkey that, through contacts with a terrorist organisation, it crosses the red lines of the EU's common foreign and security policy.

De regering volgt de contacten tussen Turkije en Hamas en spreekt Turkije aan dat het door contacten met een terroristische organisatie de rode lijnen van het gemeenschappelijk buitenlands en veiligheidsbeleid van de EU overschrijdt.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de grondwetswijziging in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether it shares concerns that Hungary's Orbán government laws (media, electoral system, judiciary, constitution) breach democratic principles and fundamental rights, and whether it will raise this at EU level or start an Article 7 procedure. The government answered that it shares concerns, that the Commission is investigating, and that it sees no reason yet for an Article 7 procedure.
Like the European Commission and many of our European colleagues, we are concerned about various legislative changes the Orbán government has initiated over the past year.
Wij zijn, net als de Europese Commissie en veel van onze Europese collega’s, bezorgd over verschillende wetswijzigingen die de regering-Órban het afgelopen jaar heeft geïnitieerd.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over invallen bij mensenrechtenorganisaties in Egypte

MP De Roon asked whether the Egyptian government's raids on human rights NGOs were brutal and whether Dutch funds to Egypt should be frozen. Minister Rosenthal expressed serious concern about the raids, noted the EU High Representative had also raised concern, and said bilateral development aid is being phased out while the remaining funds, channelled through NGOs supporting the transition, should not be frozen.
Freedom of assembly and freedom of expression are essential in a democratic constitutional state.
Vrijheid van samenscholing en vrijheid van meningsuiting zijn essentieel in een democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven en Wilders over Nederlands-Iraanse relaties

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked why the Dutch ambassador to Iran was recalled and then sent back, and whether Iran's conduct justified a different stance. Minister Rosenthal answered that the recall was a joint protest against the storming of the British embassy, that dialogue requires a diplomatic presence, and that the government condemns Iran's threats and keeps tightening EU sanctions.
In the view of the countries involved, it is important to keep the channel of dialogue with the Iranian authorities open.
Het is naar het oordeel van de betrokken landen van belang om het gesprekskanaal met de Iraanse autoriteiten open te houden.

qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het bericht dat er jaarlijks ongeveer voor 1 miljard euro faillissementsfraude wordt gepleegd

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked ministers whether they recognise the estimate of about 1 billion euro yearly losses from bankruptcy fraud, whether the 2.5% detection rate is adequate, and what has been done since the last committee debate. Minister Opstelten answered that about 700 million euro of the 4 billion euro in bankruptcy debts stems from fraud, that the FIOD handles about 40 complex cases a year, and referred to a letter of 27 November 2012 for the measures taken.
For that reason I am of the view that the detection rate must go up further and work on this is under way.
Mede daarom ben ik van mening dat de pakkans verder omhoog moet en wordt daar ook volop aan gewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Ulenbelt over aanstaande facturen van de product- en bedrijfschappen

MPs Verhoeven and Ulenbelt asked whether the government knows that product and trade boards are already sending invoices for 2013, when the abolition of the boards will take effect, whether boards should waive levies if they hold reserves, and when the last invoices will be sent. The minister answers that the boards will be abolished as agreed in the coalition agreement, public tasks will move to the ministry from 2014, a legislative process will start, and levies may still be needed until abolition because reserves may not cover long-term obligations.
Until the moment of abolition, the boards constitute administrative bodies with their own board, responsibility and the power to impose levies.
Tot het moment van opheffing vormen de schappen bestuurslichamen met een eigen bestuur, verantwoordelijkheid en de bevoegdheid om heffingen op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Hennis-Plasschaert en Verheijen over het veiligheidsrisico van Chinese telecomproducenten

Three VVD MPs asked the government whether Chinese telecom producers pose a security risk to Dutch critical infrastructure, what steps will be taken to map such risks, and whether KPN and others will be questioned. The minister answers that vulnerabilities are a conceivable risk but there is no direct evidence of espionage use, that intelligence services remain alert and will warn relevant parties if concrete indications emerge, and that the matter will be raised actively with companies.
For the time being there is a conceivable risk, but there are no direct indications that these vulnerabilities are actually being used for espionage purposes.
Vooralsnog is hier sprake van een voorstelbaar risico, maar zijn er geen directe aanwijzingen dat deze kwetsbaarheden daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt voor spionagedoeleinden.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Recourt over identiteitsfraude door slecht bewaarde paspoortkopieën

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked about identity fraud risks from copies of passports that self-employed contractors must give each client and clients must keep for seven years. The minister replied that the retention duty is legally required, that the government lacks data on fraud involving such copies, suggested contractors write purpose and date on copies, and said the VAR web module will not change the identification requirement.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will start a campaign at the end of this year to point people to this option.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties start eind dit jaar een campagne om mensen op deze mogelijkheid te wijzen.
qn: Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van cookies door de NPO

Two SP MPs asked whether agreements with the ministry oblige the NPO to obtain consent for cookies on its websites and to explain which functions require them, and whether cookie data is shared with third parties. The state secretary replied that the NPO uses functional, analytic, advertising and social media cookies, that consent is sought except for functional cookies, that data is anonymised and not passed to third parties, and that some social media trackers are controlled by those providers.
As promised at the Telecommunications General Consultation of 21 November, it is currently being examined whether, and under what conditions, analytic cookies can be regarded as necessary cookies.

Zoals bij het Algemeen Overleg Telecommunicatie van 21 november jongstleden is toegezegd wordt momenteel onderzocht of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden, analytische cookies kunnen worden beschouwd als noodzakelijk cookies
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over het gebruik van cookies op de websites van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

An MP asked whether the public broadcaster NPO may block users who refuse tracking cookies and whether it should offer an analytics-only cookie option. The state secretary answered that NPO uses only analytics cookies itself, that the Ster's advertising and social media cookies are placed by third parties, that the NPO must comply with the Telecommunications Act, and declined to require an analytics-only option or talks with NPO.
No, I believe the NPO must comply with the law and properly inform users about the use of cookies.
Nee, ik vind dat de NPO zich aan de wet moet houden en de gebruikers goed moet informeren over het gebruik van cookies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over een Amerikaanse waarschuwing voor Chinese telecombedrijven

SP MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked whether the Netherlands would act on a US warning that Chinese telecom firms Huawei and ZTE pose a security risk and may pass information to China, and what Dutch authorities do about it. The government replied that the public part of the US report gives no reason to change its stance, that the non-public part has not yet been received, that Huawei and ZTE are active in the Netherlands, that no Chinese espionage via this equipment has been established, and that no further US cooperation is currently needed.
We do not yet have access to the non-public part of the report and therefore cannot yet assess the conclusions from it, or their underpinning.
Wij hebben op dit moment nog niet de beschikking over het niet-openbare gedeelte van het rapport en kunnen de conclusies daaruit – en de onderbouwing daarvan – dus nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dam en Monasch over de aanbesteding van elektrische bussen in Friesland

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why Friesland awarded an electric bus tender to Chinese firm BYD rather than a Dutch producer, and whether Chinese state aid made the award unfair. The minister replied that the tender followed EU rules on price and quality, that state aid to BYD was not excessive, and that the province could not legally be ordered to cancel the award, while promising to push for a stronger EU procurement and trade policy towards China.
It is up to a contracting authority to determine whether such a case arises.
Het is aan een aanbestedende dienst om te bepalen of zo'n geval zich voordoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Hijum over de gebrekkige concurrentie op de hypotheekmarkt

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about weak competition on the mortgage market, including whether the 2008 state-aid price-leadership ban on ING was a missed chance and how mortgage margins compare to claims by the Vereniging Eigen Huis. The minister says the ban was a Commission condition that was not freely negotiable, that it is now being ended as part of the ING restructuring, and that the government will keep monitoring the market with the NMa and announces transparency and single-tier rate measures.
I cannot therefore endorse the finding that there would have been a missed opportunity.
De constatering dat er sprake zou zijn van een gemiste kans kan ik dan ook niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jan Vos naar aanleiding van het openblijven van de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asks the minister about the draft decision extending the operating life of the Borssele nuclear plant, including whether the convention's safety-ranking requirement still applies, how it will be verified, the reactor-vessel crack investigation timing, and the stress test and inspection options. The minister answers that the convention requirement remains, measurements will occur at the spring 2013 shutdown before the extension starts, the 10-year safety review is separate, stress test findings do not affect the permit, and the regulator can impose further requirements.
The investigation therefore takes place before the extended operating period starts on 1 January 2014.
Het onderzoek vindt dus plaats voordat de periode van verlengde bedrijfsduur op 1 januari 2014 ingaat.
Antwoord vragen Nijboer en Vos over de hoge additionele kosten bij het gebruik van een creditcard voor betalingen en specifiek voor boekingen bij vliegtuigmaatschappijen

MPs Nijboer and Vos asked about high credit-card surcharges on payments, especially airline bookings, and whether UK-style rules should apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the EU consumer rights directive caps surcharges at actual costs, including for passenger transport, that a Dutch implementing bill is expected soon, and that the Payment Services Directive revision will be pursued, while consumer-authority enforcement on hidden fees is noted.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de tarieven voor bluswater

An MP asked the minister about the sharply higher fire-water connection tariffs charged by Oasen to businesses in eastern South Holland, whether this constitutes abuse of market power, and what businesses can do. The minister replied that drinkwater rules do not apply to fire water, so companies set these tariffs freely, but the competition law ban on abuse of dominance applies, that the NMa is independently competent to investigate, and that businesses may use alternatives or complain to the NMa or municipalities.
I have informed the NMa of recent developments regarding Oasen's fire-water tariffs.
Ik heb de NMa op de hoogte gebracht van de recente ontwikkelingen aangaande de bluswatertarieven van Oasen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over de frequentieveiling van 4G-internet

An MP from the CDA asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the pace of 4G rollout in the Netherlands, the EU Digital Agenda Commissioner's call for faster rollout, and what the government can do to ensure constant network quality. The minister agreed Europe should speed up, argued the Dutch rollout is at an early stage like elsewhere, pointed to flexible licences, extra spectrum and rollout obligations, and said the market should deliver and that network quality is covered by the new Telecommunicatiewet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de overstapcampagne van ConsuWijzer

An MP asked whether the ConsuWijzer 'switch energy supplier' campaign should encourage consumers to also compare the sustainability of energy supply, and whether the campaign would promote switching to green energy. The minister replied that ConsuWijzer is run by independent regulators who set their own campaigns, that no direct intervention is needed, and that the overstapcoach offers a practical switching guide while the EnergieWijzer lets consumers compare suppliers on service, contract types and green supply, leaving the weight given to sustainability to consumers.
I consider that a good thing, and direct intervention by me is therefore not appropriate.
Dat vind ik een goede zaak en directe interventie van mij acht ik dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leegte over het netto vermogen van windmolens

An MP asked the minister whether wind turbines' net effective capacity is far below the assumed 23 percent and whether the minister will commission independent research into grid integration losses. The minister answered that onshore turbines average about 2,200 full-load hours (roughly 25 percent capacity factor), that integration effects reduce fuel savings by at most 2 to 3 percent, that the CBS-based critique is methodologically flawed, and that no new study is warranted.
In light of the above observations, I consider the outcomes of the analysis presented by Mr le Pair insufficient grounds for new research into the integration losses of sustainable energy.

In het licht van bovengenoemde observaties acht ik de uitkomsten van de door de heer le Pair gepresenteerde analyse onvoldoende aanleiding om een nieuw onderzoek naar de inpassingsverliezen van duurzame energie te doen.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Leegte over het rendement van windmolens naar aanleiding van een bericht in De Telegraaf over uitlatingen van hoogleraar Richard Tol

An MP asks the minister whether a professor's claim that wind energy has negative returns and should not be subsidised is accurate, and questions the role of backup capacity, economies of scale and technological progress. The minister disputes the negative-return claim, explains the SDE+ subsidy basis and rejects ending wind subsidies, while acknowledging offshore costs remain high.
This cabinet has explicitly chosen not to subsidise specific sustainable energy technologies, but to direct support towards the most cost-efficient techniques.
Dit kabinet heeft er nadrukkelijk voor gekozen om geen specifieke duurzame energie technologieën te subsidiëren, maar de ondersteuning te richten op de meest kostenefficiënte technieken.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over aardgasinkomsten en een staatsfonds

Two MPs asked whether the minister knew of a press report on a sovereign fund from gas revenues, what share of Groningen gas proceeds goes to Shell and ExxonMobil and whether the MOR agreement could be terminated, and how the government followed up a 2008 letter on studying the optimal design of wealth preservation. The minister replied that the MOR profit split gives the state about 90% of proceeds at current prices so no change is planned, and that the 13th Studiegroep Begrotingsruimte advised on the FES feeding mechanism, which the cabinet has frozen with the related bill withdrawn.
I therefore see no reason to terminate this agreement or change it.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze overeenkomst op te zeggen dan wel te veranderen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Albert Heijn een betalingskorting oplegt aan haar leveranciers

An MP asked the ministers whether Albert Heijn's imposed two-point payment discount on suppliers is lawful, what role the government sees for itself in curbing abuse of purchasing power, and whether the NMa should supervise purchasing power preventively. The minister replied that the relationship is private law between firms, that Albert Heijn suspended the discount, that the ministry is facilitating a code of fair trading practices, and that studies on enforcement of the abuse-of-dominance ban and on existing law are forthcoming.
However, I also note that in practice it is difficult to demonstrate abuse of an economic dominant position.
Ik constateer echter ook dat het in de praktijk lastig is om misbruik van een economische machtspositie aan te tonen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Koppejan over het bericht ‘stortvloed van klachten over het bedrijf zakelijke telefonie voortduurt’

MPs Omtzigt and Koppejan asked the minister whether complaints about the business telephony firm Zakelijke Telefonie continue, how many complaints were filed, and what action would be taken against spam, misleading switching, and inadequate switching procedures. The minister replied that OPTA received 148 complaints and the fraud reporting point 110, that OPTA independently decides on investigations, and that the government will explore legal measures and possible expanded OPTA powers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over een studie naar de olieprijs door IMF

An MP asked the minister about a 2012 IMF study forecasting a doubling of the oil price by 2021, its effects on the Dutch economy, and whether it undermines CPB and government energy policy. The minister replied that the model is promising but unproven, the Dutch economy would lose about 0.15 percentage points of growth per year, existing energy policy remains valid, and no new research will be commissioned.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat NWO1) promotiestudenten financiert die voor Shell in India gaan werken

An MP asked whether NWO funding for PhD positions that largely go to Indian students who will then work for Shell is a good use of scarce research money. The government replied that Shell pays the PhD salaries, that NWO's contribution goes to open research programmes within the top-sector policy, and that no revision of NWO allocation criteria is needed.
Revising the criteria for the distribution of the NWO budget is not on the table.
Herziening van criteria voor verdeling van NWO-budget is niet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «NMa moet kortingseis Albert Heijn bekijken» (ingezonden 14 september 2012).

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that Albert Heijn demanded discounts from suppliers, the status of a motion on sustainability initiatives and fair trade practices, and whether suppliers may be asked to help grow Albert Heijn's market power. The minister answered that the supplier relationship is private law and parties must resolve disputes themselves, that the competition authority NMa may act only on abuse of a dominant position, and that the government is pursuing wider producer-organisation rules at EU level.
The relationship between Albert Heijn and its suppliers is a private-law matter concerning individual companies.
De relatie van Albert Heijn en haar leveranciers is een privaatrechtelijke en betreft een aangelegenheid tussen individuele ondernemingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over mogelijke capaciteitsheffing energieleveranciers

An MP asked the minister about the price effects of renewable subsidies, the risk of future electricity capacity shortages, and whether a capacity fee for power producers is needed. The minister answered that capacity is ample, rejected a capacity fee and TenneT building plants, and promised to raise capacity mechanisms at EU level.
I consider a capacity remuneration to ensure sufficient back-up capacity for electricity production in the Netherlands unnecessary and undesirable.
Ik acht een capaciteitsvergoeding om te verzekeren dat er voldoende back-up capaciteit van elektriciteitsproductie aanwezig is in Nederland onnodig en niet wenselijk.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de groeiende verschillen in de kredietverlening tussen grootbedrijf en midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB)

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs about the growing interest-rate gap between large firms and SMEs and what the government will do to support SME credit and innovation financing. The minister replies that credit has broadly held up, attributes the gap to market risk factors and supervisory rules, and points to existing schemes such as the BMKB and the Innovatiefonds MKB+ while promising a new financing monitor.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments in credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Plasterk over strengere eisen aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf bij het verstrekken van kredieten

MPs Mei Li Vos and Plasterk asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance why SME credit is riskier and more expensive than large-firm credit, whether banks will tighten lending criteria, and what alternative financing and Innovation Fund instruments exist. The minister replied that SME rates reflect structural risk and transaction costs, that credit has broadly held up, and outlined existing and planned financing instruments, while declining to assign BNG a direct SME lending role and leaving the transformation of the Innovation Fund into a national investment bank to a future cabinet.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments regarding credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de  frequentiestabiliteit in relatie tot een groeiend aandeel duurzame elektriciteit

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether existing European and national agreements on grid frequency stability remain adequate as renewable generation grows, and what strategies could address frequency swings, plus questions on coal versus gas dispatch and cost-effectiveness. The minister answered that existing arrangements are currently adequate, that frequency deviations are increasingly frequent but not yet endangering supply, and that the problem is being addressed through the European ENTSO-E network code process and monitoring by TenneT.
TenneT also indicates that the existing agreements with the other system operators in Europe for managing frequency stability are currently adequate.
TenneT geeft tevens aan dat de bestaande afspraken voor het beheren van de frequentiestabiliteit met de andere systeem netbeheerders in Europa op dit moment toereikend zijn.
Antwoord vragen Vos over het bericht dat Duitsland 300 miljard euro verdient met duurzame producten en diensten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Germany earns large sums from green technology and whether the Netherlands should seek a fully renewable energy supply by 2050. The minister agreed that investment brings benefits, described the two-track energy and innovation policy, declined to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on the revenue side, and said the energy supply should be CO2-neutral by 2050 while keeping fossil fuels, emissions trading and all energy options open.
I therefore see no reason at this time to ask the Algemene Energieraad for advice on this.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding de Algemene Energieraad om advies te vragen hierover.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bemmel over een mogelijke nieuwe veiling van telecomfrequenties

An MP asked the minister whether unused 400 MHz and 1500 MHz telecom bands could be auctioned to new mobile entrants under FRAND conditions. The minister answered that the bands are largely unsuitable or still under EU-level study, that a possible auction would depend on market conditions, and that access obligations can only be imposed by the regulator OPTA on operators with significant market power.
I am also currently examining whether this residual space is suitable for applications that have come under pressure in recent years.
Tevens onderzoek ik momenteel of deze restruimte geschikt is voor toepassingen die in de afgelopen jaren onder druk zijn komen te staan
Antwoord vragen Slob over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-Rail

MP Slob asked ministers whether the 2012 auction of mobile frequencies would cause interference with GSM-R railway communications, including its frequency, costs, safeguards and whether licence conditions protect rail safety. The ministers acknowledge interference at several sites, describe filters, a new 'adequate protection' licence condition, ongoing studies of signal-strength ceilings and cost questions, and state that no irreversible steps have been taken before the auction starts on 31 October 2012.

On 18 April 2012 I informed your House that the start of the application procedure for potential auction participants from 16 April 2012 is not an irreversible step regarding the resolution of the possible interference problems.

Op 18 april 2012 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat de start van de aanvraagprocedure voor potentiële deelnemers aan de veiling vanaf 16 april 2012 geen onomkeerbare stap is met betrekking tot het oplossen van de mogelijke interferentieproblemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de NS die in een brief aan haar leveranciers te kennen heeft gegeven dat ze 3 maanden moeten gaan wachten op hun geld

An MP asks the ministers whether NS, the state-owned railway company, may impose 90-day payment terms with a 4% discount on its suppliers, and how SMEs can resist and what the government will do. The ministers reply that NS withdrew the letter and keeps the 30-day norm, that the state as shareholder will not intervene, and that the late-payment directive does not apply to NS but 30 days remains the norm.
NS has now withdrawn this letter.
NS heeft deze brief inmiddels ingetrokken
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het polsen van Australië over het weren van een Nederlandse megatrawler uit hun wateren

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether the Dutch government contacted Australia about the megatrawler Margiris, whether it misinformed parliament, and how it plans to address EU overcapacity. The minister replied that the government only asked Australia for information on new legislation affecting a Dutch investment, denied misinforming parliament, and rejected the claim that Dutch fleet overcapacity harms stocks.
For the cabinet there was no reason to intervene in early July.
Voor het kabinet was er geen reden om begin juli te interveniëren.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over onduidelijke garantiebepalingen

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about unclear statutory guarantee rules and whether consumers know their rights, given reports that they pay unnecessarily for repairs. The minister answered that consumer information via ConsuWijzer and enforcement by the Consumentenautoriteit exist, that Dutch law uses an open non-conformity period rather than a fixed guarantee term, and that he will seek more clarity together with the social partners.
I consider it important that clarity is created on this which is broadly supported.
Ik vind het van belang dat hier duidelijkheid over wordt geschapen die breed wordt gedragen.
Antwoord vragen Koopmans betreffende het TKI onderzoek naar grondontsmetting

An MP asked the state secretary about the TKI research agenda on soil disinfection, import phytosanitary barriers, and nitrate manure rules hindering wet soil disinfection for export bulbs and lilies. The government answered that phytosanitary requirements are not generally rising, that it has strengthened market-access capacity, that the manure rules create timing barriers, and that EL&I cannot reallocate TKI budgets but can request attention to the research.
EL&I cannot release budgets from TKIs.
EL&I kan geen budgetten van TKI's vrijmaken.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over "administratieve rompslomp voor parttime zzp'ers"

MP Hamer asked whether part-time self-employed workers struggle to obtain a VAR WUO declaration from the Tax Authority, causing them to lose assignments, and whether government will help solve this and send a letter by 1 October 2012. The state secretary answered that the VAR assessment applies uniform criteria to all applicants, that part-timers less often qualify as entrepreneurs under existing case law, and that a web module will be introduced to make the qualification process more transparent, with no change to the legal definition planned.

I am of the view that a web module can provide clarity to the client and contractor about the classification of their working relationship and the associated rights and obligations, so that both parties know where they stand.

Ik ben van mening dat een webmodule duidelijkheid kan bieden aan opdrachtgever en opdrachtnemer over de kwalificatie van hun arbeidsrelatie en de bijbehorende rechten en plichten zodat beide partijen weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord vragen Jan Vos en De Vries inzake de situatie bij Thermphos

Two PvdA MPs asked the economy minister about the Thermphos situation in Zeeland, including job losses, an anti-dumping case against Kazakh phosphorus, green investment support and help finding an investor. The minister answered that the Commission's anti-dumping decision is due by 16 March 2013, that several state instruments could support investments, and that the ministry is working with the province to help find investors.
I am actively involved in this file and therefore in consultation with the company, the Province of Zeeland and other parties to see where I can help, within my means, with a possible restart.
Ik ben actief betrokken in dit dossier en daarom in overleg met het bedrijf, Provincie Zeeland en andere partijen om te zien waar ik – binnen mijn mogelijkheden – kan helpen in een evtuele doorstart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het behoud van e-mailadressen

MP El Fassed asks the minister to address forced email address changes by ISPs (Wanadoo/Orange/Online), including keeping old addresses, forwarding mail after switching providers, and not reissuing addresses for ten years. The minister agrees that changes are inconvenient and will consult the sector on temporary free forwarding, but rejects a legal portability regime and sees no evidence that reissue limits reduce identity fraud.
I will therefore consult with the sector to see whether the sector is willing to make agreements on temporarily forwarding email messages free of charge.
Ik zal dan ook met de sector in overleg treden om te kijken of de sector bereid is afspraken te maken over het (tijdelijk) kosteloos doorsturen van e-mailberichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over netneutraliteit en de EU-inzet voor de World Conference on International Telecommunications

An MP asked the minister whether Commissioner Kroes effectively supports the ETNO proposal for paid prioritisation ('tolweg') on the internet and whether the EU position for the WCIT undermines net neutrality. The minister said the EU position has not yet been decided, that he had previously criticised the ETNO proposal, and that he will not support proposals that undermine net neutrality in the WCIT.
On behalf of the Netherlands, I will in any case not allow room for proposals that undermine net neutrality, as recently enshrined in law here.
Namens Nederland zal ik in ieder geval geen ruimte bieden aan voorstellen die de netneutraliteit, zoals hier onlangs wettelijk vastgelegd, aantasten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Verzekeraar wil luxe afkickresorts niet vergoeden’

An MP asked ministers whether the Jellinek Curaçao addiction retreat, subsidised with €600,000 under the Dutch Antilles programme, is too expensive, serves only wealthy patients, transferred expertise to local staff, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister replied that local Curaçaos can apply on the same terms, the subsidy's job-creation and expertise goals were largely met, and no conditions on treating local addicts were attached to the subsidy.
No conditions were attached to the PSNA subsidy regarding the treatment of local addicts.
Vanuit de PSNA-subsidie zijn geen voorwaarden gesteld met betrekking tot het behandelen van lokale verslaafden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers aangaande aardschokken in Noord-Groningen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked whether recent earthquakes in Groningen are known, whether they have occurred for years, whether the burden of proof for gas-extraction damage should be reversed, and whether residents will be informed. The minister confirmed the quakes and recurrence, defended the existing claims procedure via NAM and the independent Tcbb as effective, and offered information on causes and damage handling.
I therefore see no reason to amend the procedure.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de procedure aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland hun aandeel in URENCO zouden willen verkopen

An MP asked the minister whether the UK government and German utilities E.On and RWE intend to sell their stakes in Urenco and how non-proliferation and security interests would be protected. The minister answered that the UK is considering a sale but has not decided, that E.On and RWE have not publicly commented, and that public interests will be safeguarded in any ownership change.
For the Netherlands, but also for Germany and the United Kingdom, it is paramount that these public interests remain well safeguarded.
Voor Nederland, maar ook voor Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, staat voorop dat deze publieke belangen goed geborgd blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de enorme stijging van de elektriciteitsprijzen op Bonaire

MP Van Gent asked the ministers about a reported 50 percent electricity price rise on Bonaire after an arbitration ruling in the WEB-Ecopower dispute, its causes, renewable energy investment and whether the increase will be blocked. The minister confirmed the arbitration obligations, said the prices were not adjusted since 2010, that a tariff decision lies with the Bonaire public body, and that the government plans legal rules requiring efficient, cost-covering tariffs with supervision and is discussing temporary limits on the increase.
The Public Body of Bonaire is responsible for deciding on the level of the new tariffs.
Het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is verantwoordelijk om over de hoogte van de nieuwe tarieven een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte over het bericht ‘Desastreuze stroomprijs Bonaire’?

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether WEB on Bonaire had deliberately underpaid Ecopower for electricity, whether the island government shares responsibility, and how tariffs, transparency and cross-subsidies work. Minister Verhagen answered that the dispute was settled via arbitration, that the island executive council sets tariffs and has not adjusted them since July 2010, and that an audit and a new tariff proposal are pending.
Under the Electricity Concessions BES Act, the island executive council is authorised to set tariffs for the supply of electricity.
Het bestuurscollege is op grond van de wet Elektriciteitsconcessies BES bevoegd om de tarieven voor de levering van elektriciteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over de ontwikkelingen in de stroomprijs op Bonaire

An MP asked the government how electricity prices on Bonaire have developed, whether the arbitration ruling between WEB and Ecopower will raise prices for residents, and what options exist for competition and decentralised renewable generation. The minister answered that tariffs have been frozen since 2010, that a new regulatory framework is being prepared with the Ministry of Infrastructure, and that the minister of EL&I holds political and legal responsibility for energy supply in the Caribbean Netherlands, with some powers delegated to the local government.
In the Electricity Concessions BES Act, part of the powers over energy supply has been delegated to the local government.
