In de wet elektriciteitsconcessies BES is een deel van de bevoegdheden betreffende de energievoorziening gedelegeerd aan het lokale bestuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over Douwe Egberts en de aanbesteding voor warme dranken- en vendingautomaten

An MP asked the government about the award of a hot drinks and vending machine tender for the Ministry of Defence and FMH to Douwe Egberts, including how fair-trade and living-wage criteria fit EU case law, how they are enforced, and whether the listing coincided with the company's stock market debut. The government answered that the tender followed EU-compliant special performance conditions, set out three living-wage compliance regimes with Douwe Egberts under regime 1, and stated the award was objective and unrelated to the listing.
The award was based on the most economically advantageous tender and is entirely separate from the stock market listing.
De gunning is op basis van de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving geweest en staat geheel los van de beursnotering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de grote zorgen bij de kleine binnenvaart

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious concerns in the small inland shipping sector, including fears for vessels under 1000 tonnes, bottom tariffs, crisis measures and the modal shift target. The minister responded that market parties bear primary responsibility, that regulatory changes depend on the Central Commission for Rhine Navigation, that a Transition Committee is implementing structural recommendations, and that no short-term crisis measures are feasible.
I sent this report to the House on 16 November 2011, together with my response.
Ik heb dit rapport op 16 november 2011 samen met mijn zienswijze naar de Kamer gestuurd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bestoken van ondernemers met spooknota’s

An SP MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers why fake invoices (spooknota's) causing an estimated 400 million euro in losses to businesses are not clearly criminalised, and how many fraudsters have been convicted. The minister answered that sending such invoices rarely constitutes a criminal offence because the victim usually consented to the contract, that a Criminal Code change is not the right tool, that prevention is the focus, and that the prosecution service cannot separate these cases from broader data.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over compensatie van passagiers met grote vertraging door vliegtuigmaatschappijen

An MP asks the government why airlines still inform passengers poorly about compensation for long delays, and whether they should be forced to act, adopt a uniform claims procedure, and revive the aviation complaints committee. The State Secretary replies that inspection finds compliance on information provision generally good, that the main problem is the Sturgeon ruling on delay compensation pending European Court clarification which blocks sanctions, and declines new national rules or a revived complaints committee while pointing to existing inspectorate complaint handling.
Pending the legal clarity that only the European Court can give, or an amendment of the Regulation, the inspectorate currently cannot impose sanctions for violating the Sturgeon ruling.

In afwachting van de juridische duidelijkheid die alleen gegeven kan worden door het Europese Hof, of door aanpassing van de Verordening, kan de inspectie momenteel geen sancties opleggen voor overtreding van het Sturgeon-arrest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hamer inzake het verlies van 400 arbeidsplaatsen bij DSM

An MP asked ministers whether DSM's planned loss of 400 Dutch jobs, after receiving part-time unemployment support, was justified and whether EU globalisation funds would be used if forced dismissals occur. The minister answered that the decision is DSM's responsibility, that no collective dismissal notice has been filed, and that the EGF could be considered only if the 500-dismissal threshold is met.
This decision is the responsibility of DSM.
Deze beslissing is de verantwoordelijkheid van DSM.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de geplande aanleg van het agrologistieke bedrijventerrein Nieuw-Reijerwaard bij Ridderkerk

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked why the province of Zuid-Holland omitted air quality from the MER for the Nieuw-Reijerwaard logistics business park, questioning its demand, location and irreversible steps. The minister answered that the province is the competent authority under a decentralised budget, that air quality is covered by the NSL monitoring tool, and that the Rijk backed the project as an alternative location, with the provincial inpassingsplan due for adoption in spring 2013.
The province of Zuid-Holland is therefore also the competent authority for determining the scope and level of detail of the MER to be drawn up.
De provincie Zuid-Holland is daarmee ook het bevoegde gezag voor het vaststellen van de reikwijdte en het detailniveau van het op te stellen MER.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Werf en De Rouwe over het artikel “Plannen voor stroom uit aardwarmte” uit het Nederlands Dagblad van 30 juni 2012

CDA MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about press reports on two geothermal exploration permit applications covering about 19% of the Dutch land area, submitted by one company, and how the procedure, concurrent applications and state revenue work. The minister answered in detail on the procedure, the areas, the legal discretion to limit permit size and depth, the three concurrent applications received, and that the government earns no fees from the applications.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het convenant ‘Uitvoering Havenvisie 2030’

An MP asked whether the Blankenburg tunnel is named as a required accessibility action in the Port Vision 2030 covenant the minister signed, and whether signing it is appropriate given the project is controversial. The minister replied that the tunnel is not named in the covenant, that the Rijk keeps the right to take differing positions on individual action points, and refused to withdraw the signature.
I will comply with that and will of course form my own judgement on it.
Ik zal daaraan voldoen en mij daar natuurlijk ook een oordeel over vormen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over een lek in de Belgische kerncentrale Tihange 1

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about a long-running leak of radioactive water at the Belgian Tihange 1 reactor, the regulator's knowledge of it, and calls for closure, transparency, joint investigation and emergency zoning. The minister replied that the leak is in an inner wall of a spent-fuel pool without threat to people or environment, that Belgium is responsible for the reactor, that Dutch monitoring finds no anomalies, and that a Limburg protection zone and decentral iodine pill storage will be arranged.
Nuclear safety is primarily a national responsibility, and the information provided to me by the Belgian regulator gives me no indication that cross-border risks arise from the leak in Tihange 1.

Nucleaire veiligheid is primair een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en de aan mij door de Belgische toezichthouder geleverde informatie geeft mij geen indicatie dat er grensoverschrijdende risico´s aan de orde zouden zijn als gevolg van het lek in Tihange 1.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over de financiering van de onderzoeksreactor Pallas

An MP asked the minister about media reports on radioactive waste problems and leaking drums at the Petten reactor, and on the funding of its cleanup. The minister denied any leakage, stated that corroded packages were reported to parliament, outlined planned measures to remove the waste to COVRA, and declined further independent research, citing existing expert review and enhanced supervision.
I already asked the Nuclear Physics Service at the beginning of this year to carry out extra supervision of the activities at the Petten research location.
Ik heb de Kernfysische Dienst begin dit jaar al verzocht extra toezicht te houden op de activiteiten op de onderzoekslocatie Petten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in de media over een mogelijk defect in de kerncentrale Doel 3

The MP Van Tongeren asks the minister about reports that nuclear plant Doel 3 in Belgium was shut down over possible reactor vessel defects, including information exchange with Belgium and the safety of Borssele. The minister answers that Doel 3 is offline pending inspections, that Borssele poses no safety concern, and that nuclear safety in Belgium is a Belgian national responsibility, relying on the Belgian regulator FANC.
Nuclear safety is primarily a national responsibility.
Nucleaire veiligheid is primair een nationale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over identiteitsfraude

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked about identity fraud in which a criminal opened a PostNL business mail-forwarding account in a victim's name and redirected post, including private mail. The state secretary said attempts are rare (under 0.03%), PostNL has taken measures, the police investigation found no suspect, and the matter is being looked into, but declined to give details on the specific case.
In the interest of the investigation and with a view to possible future fraud attempts, no further information can be given about specific cases.
In het belang van het onderzoek en met het oog op eventuele toekomstige fraudepogingen kan over specifieke zaken geen verdere mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de nieuwe sluis bij IJmuiden

MP Kuiken asked why the replacement of the Noordersluis at IJmuiden should be brought forward ten years, what economic justification exists, and whether Amsterdam can credibly pursue intercontinental container handling without harming Rotterdam. The minister answers that the early investment is a regional wish with costs borne by the region under a 2009 covenant, that a cost-benefit analysis supports it in two of three growth scenarios, and that container growth in Amsterdam is expected to be complementary to Rotterdam.
Given the agreed cost distribution, the MIRT projects up to 2020 therefore suffer no hindrance from the earlier construction of a new sea lock at IJmuiden.
Gezien de overeengekomen kostenverdeling ondervinden de MIRT-projecten tot 2020 dus geen enkele hinder van de eerdere aanleg van een nieuwe zeesluis in IJmuiden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf betreffende problemen bij MEP-vergisters

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about financial problems at MEP biogas digesters, including whether the subsidy terms favour newer SDE+ projects and whether early investors should be compensated. The minister denied that the MEP is systematically less favourable, rejected retroactive changes and extra subsidies on state-aid grounds, but announced several measures such as extended lifetime subsidies and broader permitted biomass streams.
I do not change the rules of the game midway through the competition.
Ik verander niet gedurende de wedstrijd de spelregels.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'de blokkade van Gaza'

An MP asked the government whether it shares the view of fifty development, human rights and peace organisations that Israel's Gaza blockade must be lifted, whether it considers the blockade a collective punishment contrary to the Geneva Conventions, and whether it has raised the issue with Israel and will press for its lifting. The minister answered that the Dutch position is unchanged and backs free movement via regular crossings subject to Israeli security interests, regards the measures as security measures under the Fourth Geneva Convention, reports raising the issue with Israel and funding a container scanner, and notes Dutch and EU calls for unconditional opening of the crossings.
The government regards the measures taken regarding access to Gaza as a security measure based on the Fourth Geneva Convention.
De regering beschouwt de getroffen maatregelen rond de toegang tot Gaza als een veiligheidsmaatregel die is gebaseerd op de Vierde Geneefse Conventie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over netneutraliteit

An SGP MP asked ministers about the Dutch net neutrality law, including criticism from EU Commissioner Kroes and OPTA, and whether the ban on ideologically motivated internet filtering by providers conflicts with the constitution and ECHR. The minister rejects these criticisms, defends the law as protecting freedom of expression and consumer choice, and declines an OPTA review for now because the law has not yet taken effect.
I do not see the value of such a study at this moment, because the law has just been adopted by the States General.
Ik zie het nut van zo’n onderzoek op dit moment niet in, omdat de wet net door de Staten-Generaal is aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de OPTA-kritiek op netneutraliteit in Nederland

An MP asked the minister whether he had seen OPTA's criticism of Dutch net neutrality law and whether his views had changed. The minister said his view is unchanged, defended the statutory net neutrality rule as a safeguard against market incentives, and said OPTA will enforce it.
My view has not changed. I continue to stand behind the Dutch regulation on net neutrality.
Mijn mening is niet gewijzigd. Ik blijf achter de Nederlandse regelgeving over netneutraliteit staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de plannen van Europese telco’s om de netneutraliteit te schaden

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch government would oppose an ETNO proposal to introduce sending-party-pays interconnection charges for internet data, which would threaten net neutrality. The minister said the proposal is preliminary and raises concerns about barriers to services and monopoly-like bottleneck pricing, will discuss it within the EU, and firmly distances the government from it.
Based on my current understanding of what the ETNO proposal entails, I firmly distance myself from it.
Op basis van mijn huidig beeld wat het voorstel van ETNO inhoudt, neem ik daar krachtig afstand van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over het voorstel van Europese telecombedrijven om online dienstverleners mee te laten betalen aan de kosten voor internetverkeer

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether an ETNO proposal to make online service providers pay for internet traffic would undermine net neutrality and enable blocking, and whether the government would push for legal net neutrality protection at EU level. The minister answered that the proposal conflicts with Dutch net neutrality law, that it could reduce competition and innovation, and that the Netherlands intends to distance itself from the proposal and has raised net neutrality with the Commissioner and at the Telecom Council.
Based on my current understanding of what the ETNO proposal entails, the Dutch position is to distance itself from the proposal.
Op basis van mijn huidig beeld wat het voorstel van ETNO inhoudt, is de Nederlandse inzet om afstand te nemen van het voorstel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over verkoop van goederen via een webwinkel op een perceel met bestemming "bedrijfslocatie"

An MP asks ministers whether municipal zoning rules that treat webshops like physical retail, and a court ruling allowing municipalities to exclude webshops from certain zones, create uncertainty and economic harm, and whether national rules should be updated. The state secretary answers that there is no national rule on webshop locations, that zoning is a municipal and provincial matter, and that no national steps are planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further steps at national level here.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om van rijkswege hier nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het onvoldoende versleuteld opslaan van wachtwoorden

An MP asked the minister for Economic Affairs about the LinkedIn password breach, its responsibility, whether specific rules for password storage exist, and whether talks with large companies are possible. The minister said LinkedIn bears primary responsibility, that the government will not take over that responsibility, that no specific password storage rules exist under the data protection law, and that the issue will be revisited under a parliamentary motion and awareness campaigns will be updated.
Given the question about the responsibility of business, I expect my successor in the next cabinet to address this issue further as part of implementing the Gesthuizen/Verhoeven motion.

Mede gezien de vraagstelling over de verantwoordelijkheid van het bedrijfsleven, verwacht ik dat mijn opvolger in het volgende kabinet nader op deze problematiek zal ingaan als onderdeel van de uitvoering van de motie Gesthuizen/Verhoeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat banken de geldkraan voor veelbelovende bedrijven dichtdraaien

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether banks are blocking credit to promising technology firms, whether the December agreements with banks are being kept, and what will be done about financing obstacles. The minister says financing is a priority, points to existing schemes (Innovatiefonds MKB+, innovation contracts, OKD, information campaigns) and rejects extending the willekeurige afschrijving tax measure on budgetary grounds.
The cabinet is in principle in favour of measures that stimulate investment by businesses.
Het kabinet is in principe voorstander van maatregelen die investeringen door het bedrijfsleven stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over brandpreventie door middel van slimme gasmeters

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether a smart gas meter concept for gas leak detection and automatic shut-off, nominated for a fire safety innovation prize, could add fire safety, support rollout of smart meters, face legal barriers, and warrant a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the concept may contribute to fire safety, that building and gas law do not hinder it, that a cost-benefit analysis is not appropriate since the idea is at an early stage, and that network operators are willing to examine feasibility with the developer.
A cost-benefit analysis is not something I consider appropriate.
Een kosten batenanalyse acht ik niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bemmel over het bericht dat in een uitgelekt EU-rapport korte metten wordt gemaakt met subsidies op zonne- en windenergie

An MP asked the minister whether he agreed with a leaked EU report calling for an immediate end to subsidies for solar and wind energy, and whether citizens should avoid energy-bill increases and VAT reductions on solar panels. The minister answered that renewable energy still needs temporary stimulation, that the new SDE+ levy is meant to make citizens' contributions visible, and that there is currently no VAT reduction on solar panels, only an agreed subsidy scheme.
In line with the usual procedure, your House will receive a BNC fiche setting out the Dutch position on the communication.
Conform de gebruikelijke procedure zal uw Kamer een BNC-fiche ontvangen, waarin het Nederlandse standpunt ten aanzien van de mededeling wordt gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ontvangst van radio in delen van Noord-Holland

An MP asked how the power increase of the Lopik transmitter would be verified and whether alternative measures such as relay transmitters in Noord-Holland would be used. The minister answered that transmitter power was restored to pre-fire levels on 11 April 2012, that a further increase for Radio 4 is blocked by Belgian objections, and that no adequate alternatives exist yet.
The power of all transmitters at Lopik was increased on 11 April 2012 to the level before the fire.
Het vermogen van alle zenders op Lopik is per 11 april 2012 verhoogd tot het vermogen van voor de brand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Qatar als een van de grootste grootaandeelhouders in Shell

An MP from the PVV asked the government about reports that Qatar had become a major shareholder in Shell, including the size of its stake, any other Dutch energy holdings, other Islamic investors, and the government's view of a Sunni dictatorship gaining influence. The minister said Shell does not disclose stakes below 3%, Qatar holds no known other Dutch energy stakes, the annual report does not show other investors, and that the government welcomes foreign investment within existing law.
The size of the stake has not been disclosed by Shell.
De grootte van het aandeel is door Shell niet bekendgemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “NMa heeft andere prioriteiten dan muziekauteurs”

MP Peters asked ministers whether the NMa's refusal, on priority grounds, to investigate a complaint by Stichting Platform Makers about NPO conduct was acceptable, whether the minister would talk with the NMa, whether competition law is applied evenhandedly in culture, and when a copyright contracts bill would be submitted. The minister answered that the NMa is an independent body setting its own priorities, that appeal remedies exist, that competition law applies to creators, and that the bill would be submitted shortly.
It is therefore up to the NMa to set its own priorities.
Het is dan ook aan de NMa om haar prioriteiten vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Schaart over de levering van een SIGMA korvet aan Indonesië

Two VVD MPs asked about the sale of a SIGMA corvette by Damen Schelde Naval Shipbuilding to Indonesia, including contract value, jobs, prior deliveries and whether EU arms export criteria were applied. The government confirmed a contract of about $220 million for one corvette with an option on more, said a positive preliminary assessment against the EU criteria was made, and provided an overview of export licences for Indonesia.
In an exploratory phase, a so-called sondage, a positive opinion was given based on assessment against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position.
In een verkennende fase, een zogenaamde sondage, is een positief advies gegeven aan de hand van de beoordeling van de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over olieboringen in het Noordpoolgebied

MP Ouwehand asked the Dutch government whether it shares concerns about Shell's planned Arctic exploratory drilling, the risk of an unstoppable oil spill, and whether it will oppose or urge against the drilling. Minister Verhagen answered that the US authority is the competent regulator, that he sees no reason to doubt its decision, and that he will not call on other states or Shell to stop, while promising only to keep encouraging Shell toward responsible business.
It is not for me but for the permitting authority – in this case the US government – to weigh whether activities may be allowed.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de vergunningverlener – in dit geval de Amerikaanse overheid – om de afweging te maken of activiteiten toegelaten kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken over compensatie aan passagiers bij vertraging luchtvaart

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked whether airlines that refuse compensation for delays over three hours, cancellations or overbooking act unlawfully under EU Regulation 261/2004 and the Sturgeon ruling, and whether the state will enforce it. The state secretary answers that the Sturgeon ruling is binding, that the inspectorate enforces it but has paused new sanctions pending test cases and preliminary questions to the European Court, and that complaints are normally handled within six months.
For failing to comply with the Sturgeon ruling, the inspectorate has imposed a penalty order on each of four Dutch airlines.
Voor het niet naleven van het Sturgeon-arrest heeft de inspectie vier Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen elk een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en De Mos naar aanleiding van het bericht «Impacts of wind farms on land surface temperature»

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether, given a study finding local warming effects of wind farms, the policy and the SDE+ subsidy should be changed, and whether onshore wind should still be considered sustainable. The minister answered no to each, arguing the effects are small and local and that onshore wind is cheap and needed for EU renewable targets.
The article at the centre of these questions also gives no reason for this.
Ook het in deze vragen centraal staande artikel vormt daartoe geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over het ‘Bel-me-niet register’

An MP asked the minister whether the exemption allowing companies to call existing customers registered on the Bel-me-niet register could be removed, or a separate objection category added, after a TROS survey showed most registrants find such calls annoying, and whether market research should fall under the same rules as the Telecommunications Act. The minister rejected removing the exemption as disproportionate, relying instead on the right of objection per call, promised better consumer information and to examine a time limit for former customers, and declined to integrate the self-regulatory MOA research filter into the register.
My assessment is that dropping the exemption for warm contacts or adding a separate category to the Bel-me-niet register does not meet the proportionality requirement.
Mijn inschatting is dat het laten vervallen van de uitzondering voor warme contacten of het opnemen van een aparte categorie in het Bel-me-niet register niet aan de proportionaliteitseis voldoet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çelik inzake de financiële verliezen die het Wellant College voor zijn rekening neemt voor het IPC Groene Ruimte B.V.

An MP asked the ministers whether the Wellant College's 2010 losses at its subsidiary IPC Groene Ruimte B.V. were acceptable, and whether the sector's disclosure rules allow such losses to remain hidden. The minister said the Inspectorate's basic arrangement gives no cause for further investigation, that the 2011 figures are not yet due, that the rules on timing and public-private separation were followed, and that the 0.6 million loss was charged to a private reserve.
A negative deviation from the projected result, as occurred at IPC Groene Ruimte B.V., is in itself no reason for me to conduct further investigation.
Een afwijking in negatieve zin van het geprosnosticeerd resultaat zoals bij IPC Groene Ruimte B.V. het geval was, is op zich geen aanleiding voor mij om hier nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koppejan over het bericht ‘Kans op doorstart Zalco bijna verkeken’

MP Koppejan asked the minister whether Zeeland Seaports refused to allow splitting the Zalco erfpacht, delaying a partial takeover that could save part of 600 jobs, and whether the minister would intervene on the grid connection and speed up the process. The minister denied the refusal as reported, said the erfpacht split and new environmental permits must be arranged among parties with the province's cooperation, and said parties aim for a decision by mid-June.
From contacts with the parties involved it has become clear to me that the information in the article is not correct.
Uit contacten met betrokken partijen is mij gebleken dat de informatie in het artikel niet correct is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over Van Gansewinkel en private equity

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the financial situation of Van Gansewinkel Group under private equity ownership, whether he had been misled about its equity, its waste-processing quality, layoffs and whether he would intervene. The state secretary answered that the company says its finances are stable, found no grounds to say he was misled, relies on existing waste law and the national waste plan rather than ownership, and sees no need to mediate, while offering to talk with the company.
In light of this information, I cannot conclude that the company misled me earlier.
Gelet op deze informatie kan ik niet de conclusie trekken dat ik eerder door het bedrijf ben misleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hazekamp over CO2-opslag onder de zeebodem

An MP asked the minister about reported plans by RWE/Essent to store CO2 under the seabed in depleted gas fields, the government's role, EU or government funding, Wadden Sea environmental risks, and coal-plant policy. The minister denied knowledge of a concrete plan, said environmental assessments would be required for any project near Natura 2000 areas, and defended coal plants as supply-secure while pointing to a coal tax in the coalition agreement.
I am not aware of any concrete plan for storing CO2 from the RWE/Essent coal plant under the seabed.
Er is mij geen concreet voornemen voor de opslag van CO 2 uit de kolencentrale van RWE/Essent onder de zeebodem bekend.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over vermeende kartelafspraken

MP Kuiken asked the government about alleged cartel arrangements among oil companies on petrol prices, including a German investigation, whether it extends to the Netherlands, signs of cartel formation in Dutch fuel sales, and steps to lower pump prices. The minister said the German probe is limited to Germany, that NMa has no findings of cartel conduct in the Dutch market but will not comment on ongoing probes, that pricing patterns are for the NMa to assess, and listed tax and crude price factors and a planned tender-information measure.
It is for the NMa to assess whether patterns or conduct in the market point to possible cartel arrangements between the oil companies.
Het is aan de NMa om te beoordelen of patronen of gedragingen in de markt duiden op mogelijke kartelafspraken tussen de oliemaatschappijen.
Antwoord vragen Leegte over het artikel ”Industrie wordt gestraft voor goed milieugedrag

MP Leegte asked the state secretary and minister whether they knew a Telegraaf article claiming industry is penalised for good environmental behaviour under the EU emissions trading system, and how clean industry leaders would be protected from competition-distorting measures. The government replied that the free-allocation rules from 2013 use benchmarks based on the 10% most efficient firms, so clean firms benefit, and that the cited company is not disadvantaged, though it acknowledged its free allowances will not cover all emissions.

The allocation method for free allowances for the trading period starting in 2013 has been improved compared with previous periods, precisely to ensure that clean industry leaders do not suffer unnecessary harm.

De toewijzingssystematiek van gratis rechten voor de handelsperiode die start in 2013 is verbeterd ten opzichte van de voorgaande handelsperioden, juist om er zorg voor te dragen dat schone industrieleiders geen onnodige schade ondervinden.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang over het artikel ‘Hoe Arend Jan linkse taboes slecht – in zijn eentje’

An SP MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether a former foreign minister had agreed with a VVD MP to attack a colleague minister on development aid, whether the economic affairs minister is defending the development budget at the Catshuis talks, and whether a former MP's claims about cooperation were true. The minister answered that no such arrangement existed, declined to address the Catshuis talks beyond noting a parliamentary exchange had taken place, and said the practice described is consistent with good, transparent parliamentary conduct.
No, as explained in the answer to question 3.
Nee, zoals toegelicht bij beantwoording vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over de onduidelijkheid tussen de vitaliteitsparagraaf in het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma en die paragraaf in het Stabiliteitsprogramma

MPs Vermeij and Hamer asked why the vitality package's mobility bonuses appear in the National Reform Programme but are cut back in the Stability Programme, and which work bonuses are ended. Minister Kamp answered that the programmes were aligned as far as possible, that the mobility budget is frozen rather than abolished, and that the work bonuses for workers and employers are ended as part of the budget agreement.
The final version of the National Reform Programme submitted to your House on 27 April was aligned as far as possible with the commitments in the Stability Programme.
De definitieve versie van het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma dat op 27 april aan uw Kamer is aangeboden, is zo veel mogelijk afgestemd op de afspraken uit het Stabiliteitsprogramma.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf over het bericht "TenneT moet grondverbruik vergoeden"

MP Van der Werf asked ministers whether TenneT refuses to negotiate annual compensation for permanent cable easements affecting landowners and farmers, and whether this could stall grid construction. The minister replied that negotiations between LTO, FPG and TenneT are ongoing and a private matter, while the Belemmeringenwet Privaatrecht and expropriation-like powers (gedoogplicht) remain available if no agreement is reached.
I regard those negotiations as a matter between LTO, FPG and TenneT.
Die onderhandelingen beschouw ik als een zaak tussen LTO, FPG en TenneT.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de oproep van de NMa aan ziekenhuizen om grote inkoopcombinaties te vormen

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the NMa's call on hospitals to form large purchasing alliances conflicts with their amendment against unnecessary clustering of public tenders, and whether the advice is one-sided. The minister replied that the NMa's recommendation does not require merging tenders, is not in conflict with the amendment or current procurement rules for academic hospitals, and has not created confusion, so no action against the NMA is planned.

I am of the view that the NMa's call for more purchasing alliances does not conflict with the amendment Verhoeven/Gesthuizen, adopted by the House of Representatives, on unnecessary clustering of public contracts.

Ik ben van mening dat de oproep van de NMa om meer inkoopcombinaties te vormen niet haaks staat op het onlangs door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen amendement Verhoeven/Gesthuizen over het onnodig clusteren van overheidsopdrachten.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (NMa) pleit voor een apart invoedingstarief voor decentrale energieopwekking

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the NMa's call for a separate feed-in tariff for decentralised generators means political decisions were taken, what the effects are on completed projects, level playing field and SDE+ subsidies, and how the smart grid test gardens reduce grid costs. The minister answered that the policy review on a producer tariff is not yet finished, will be completed before summer and will cover a general producer tariff rather than one for decentralised producers only, and that the NMa will study grid cost savings from decentralised feed-in by year end.
The policy review into the effects of introducing a producer tariff has not yet been completed.
De beleidsmatige beschouwing naar de effecten van de invoering van een producententarief is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het concept VNG-model algemene inkoopvoorwaarden voor de levering van diensten

An MP asked the minister about the VNG model general purchasing conditions for services, including liability, intellectual property transfer and proportionality under the government's Proportionality Guide. The minister answered that the model is optional and can be deviated from, that the proportionality guide will be designated as a guideline with the new procurement act, and that deviations must be motivated.
The Proportionality Guide will be designated as a guideline by general administrative order when the proposed new Procurement Act enters into force.
De Gids proportionaliteit zal bij inwerkingtreding van het voorstel voor een nieuwe Aanbestedingswet bij AMvB worden aangewezen als richtsnoer.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de kosten van hotelkamers

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether online booking sites' strict rate parity conditions push up hotel room prices, and whether the Consumer Authority has the capacity to investigate. The minister replies that hotels remain free to set prices, that booking-site fees buy a service consumers may value, that competition and consumer-protection authorities already supervise the market, and that consumer information is available, without committing to new action.
It is up to the market itself to determine the price of hotel rooms.
Het is aan de markt zelf om de prijs van hotelkamers te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het verzuimen van de zorgplicht door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

The MP Bouwmeester asked the ministers whether low-cost airlines Ryanair and Vueling unlawfully refuse care to passengers delayed by strikes and whether a dedicated airline complaints committee should be reinstated. State Secretary Atsma answered that EU Regulation 261/2004 requires care, that the pending Court of Justice case (McDonagh/Ryanair) will decide the matter, that the inspectorate (ILT) enforces the rules and handles complaints, and that reinstating a complaints committee is primarily for private parties to decide.
The inspectorate does establish infringement of the Regulation, so passengers can, if they wish, start civil proceedings on the basis of that decision.
De inspectie stelt wel overtreding van de Verordening vast, zodat passagiers met dat besluit desgewenst een civiele procedure kunnen starten.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf over het bericht de gasmeter liegt straks niet meer

An MP asked whether the planned change in gas metering (administrative temperature correction) will end improper gas profits by 1 January 2013, whether that date will be met, and whether energy companies cooperate. The minister answered that the NMa is following the statutory procedure with a draft decision and final adoption expected mid-2012, that the entry into force will likely be later than 1 January 2013, and that companies are reportedly cooperating constructively.
The NMa then aims to introduce the measures as quickly as possible.
De NMA streeft er vervolgens naar de maatregelen zo snel mogelijk in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over lange reistijd bij low budget vliegmaatschappijen

Two MPs asked whether low-cost airlines misleadingly advertise airports as central to the capital while the transport from those airports is long and costly, and whether this breaches consumer protection and creates unfair competition. The minister says the Consumentenautoriteit and courts can judge misleading advertising under Dutch civil code rules and the travel industry code, and that the Consumentenautoriteit has sufficient powers and means to act.
I leave the judgement on whether these specific cases involve misleading or unfair commercial practices to the supervisory authority and the courts.
Ik laat het oordeel of er in deze concrete gevallen sprake is van misleiding of een oneerlijke handelspraktijk over aan de toezichthouder en de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Koopmans en Koppejan over de inhuur van flexibele arbeidskrachten via de aanbestedingskalender

MPs Van Hijum, Koopmans and Koppejan (CDA) asked why central government spends over 45 million euro on temporary agency staff during spending cuts, whether this undoes departmental downsizing targets, and about the tender's lot structure, CAO application, SME access and an overview of framework contracts. The minister answered that the 10% external-hire norm applies, that agency staff are used for peaks and temporary tasks rather than replacing permanent staff, that the CAO Rijk does not apply to them but the inlenersbeloning does, and listed current framework contracts and their durations.
For years the House of Representatives has been informed about the scale of external hiring of personnel by central government, including temporary agency workers.
Sedert jaren wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de omvang van de externe inhuur van personeel bij het Rijk, waaronder uitzendkrachten.

An MP asked the minister whether Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sales of business address data exposing self-employed people's home addresses are lawful, and whether an opt-in should be introduced. The minister answered that home addresses are not sold as such, that business addresses are public for legal certainty, that the Non Mailing Indicator is being expanded, and that the new Ondernemerspleinen will not displace private activity.
It may however be that the business address of the company coincides with the home address of the entrepreneur.
Wel kan het zijn dat het zakelijk adres van de onderneming samenvalt met het woonadres van de ondernemer.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het gratis toegankelijk maken van informatie uit basisregistraties ten behoeve van opsporing

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether police and prosecutors are hampered by paying per query for Chamber of Commerce and cadastral register data, and whether free access should be restored as the Emergo report recommends. The government replied that budget financing since 1 January 2012 removed invoicing for police and prosecution, that free use of basic registers is the aim by 2015, and that a decision on the end-state is expected at the end of 2012.
The cabinet aims to remove as far as possible the financial barriers to using basic registers, not only within government but also outside it, and to increase their use.

Het kabinet streeft ernaar dat de financiële drempels voor het gebruik van basisregistraties, niet alleen binnen de overheid maar ook daarbuiten, zo veel mogelijk verdwijnen en dat het gebruik ervan toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het bericht dat kantoren vaak energiezuiniger kunnen

MP Dikkers asked whether energy-efficient offices waste energy through misuse, whether the government will engage owners and users, and whether the same problem affects government buildings and what savings are possible. The government answered that the Jones Lang LaSalle study rests on a small sample and does not separate building energy from plug-load, so it gives little basis for conclusions, while the Rijksgebouwendienst has already started a programme to improve climate installation use in government buildings.

The Rijksgebouwendienst already found some years ago that too much energy is structurally consumed due to insufficient attention to the proper functioning of climate installations, including through incorrect use.

Door de Rijksgebouwendienst is reeds enkele jaren geleden geconstateerd dat er structureel te veel energie wordt verbruikt door onvoldoende aandacht aan de goede werking van klimaatinstallaties, onder andere door onjuist gebruik daarvan.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de raffinaderij op Aruba

An SP MP asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Aruba refinery, Aruba's efforts to keep it open, and Dutch support for that effort. The government answered that Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy, that the Netherlands supports it through diplomacy, trade missions and a 2011 cooperation protocol, and that further support was pledged.
As a country within the Kingdom, Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy.
Als land binnen het Koninkrijk is Aruba primair verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen economisch beleid.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over de relatie tussen uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Kroes en de aandelenemissie van Ziggo

MP Van Dam asks the minister whether Commissioner Kroes's reported remarks about blocking Dutch cable-opening amendments may have affected the Ziggo share issue, and questions Ziggo's profits, executive pay and consumer prices. The minister says Kroes personally confirmed she made no such remark, refuses to judge profits, pay or investment decisions, and sees no reason to request EU investigations or to raise the matter with Kroes.
No, answers to these questions are not called for.
Neen, antwoorden op deze vragen zijn niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Mos over kernafvalopslag COVRA in Zeeland

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about COVRA's radioactive waste processing and storage facilities in Zeeland, including whether Dutch facilities could be shared with other countries to reduce costs. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that Dutch policy requires all domestic radioactive waste to go to COVRA, and said that cross-border cooperation under the EU directive is possible but not currently on the agenda.
Possible cooperation is, however, not currently on the agenda.
Eventuele samenwerking is nu echter niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over het opslaan van adresbestanden door Twitter

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether Twitter's storage of users' full address books breaches privacy and the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the assessment and any enforcement belong to the independent CBP and OPTA, which do not comment on ongoing investigations, and the government itself takes no action.
The judgement on whether there is a breach of the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens in this case, and any enforcement measures, is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Het oordeel of er in casu sprake is van een schending van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, en het eventueel inzetten van handhavende maatregelen, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt en Koppejan over het bericht ‘OPTA waarschuwt ondernemers voor ongewilde telefonie overstap’

MPs Koppejan and Omtzigt asked the minister about OPTA complaints over unwanted telephony switches by business customers, and about the sector's practices and remedies. The minister answered that a tightened switching procedure with fines now exists, that complaints have not fallen, and that KPN has started summary proceedings against ZakelijkeTelefonie.nl while a structural approach may follow if problems persist.
I will monitor developments and if the problems have not substantially diminished in the short term, a more structural approach is desirable.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen volgen en mochten de problemen op korte termijn niet substantieel zijn verminderd dan is een meer structurele aanpak wenselijk.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het gebruik van chemicaliën bij gaswinning in de omgeving van Wijk & Aalburg en Brakel

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the twelve chemicals used in 2008 fracking at Wijk en Aalburg and Brakel, their REACH registration, disclosure, SodM oversight and NPN's planned new drilling. The minister answered that SodM was informed via the work programme, that information on composition was released after a supplier reclassified it, that SodM monitors by risk without on-site inspection during fracking, and that a new chemical registry and an independent study are planned.
Antwoord vragen Schaart over het ruimtevaartbeleid, en de gevolgen van bezuinigingen voor de positie van de ESA-vestiging te Noordwijk

MP Schaart (VVD) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that ESTEC, ESA's research centre in Noordwijk, might leave the Netherlands, the economic value of space activity, Dutch ESA contributions, and long-term funding certainty. The minister answered that space is part of the top-sector policy, outlined Dutch contributions and multiplier effects, promised a policy letter before summer, and said ESA member states will clarify their funding at the November 2012 ministerial conference.
Yes, it is my intention to send Parliament a policy letter on space policy before this summer, including the priorities the cabinet chooses for this policy area in the coming years.
Ja, het is mijn voornemen om voor deze zomer een beleidsbrief over het ruimtevaartbeleid aan uw Kamer aan te bieden
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het bericht dat Shell Chinees schaliegas gaat zoeken en produceren

An MP asked whether Shell's agreement with CNPC on Chinese shale gas includes rules on water, chemicals and working conditions, and whether the minister will press Shell for enforceable terms or oppose shale gas extraction. The minister replied that he has no insight into private contracts and no power to set rules outside Dutch territory, pointed to Shell's public commitments and operating principles, and said he cannot yet say whether shale gas can be developed safely pending a Dutch risk study.
I have no insight into agreements that companies conclude with each other, so also not into the arrangements made between Shell and China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC).
Ik heb geen inzicht in overeenkomsten die bedrijven met elkaar sluiten, dus ook niet in de afspraken die gemaakt zijn tussen Shell en China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC).
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de verkoop van namaak Uggs op de Nederlandse markt (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about large-scale online sale of counterfeit UGG boots, its representativeness, Chinese cooperation, economic damage, enforcement measures, Marktplaats's role, animal-welfare concerns about fur, and labour conditions. The government answers that customs intercepts counterfeit goods at the border, cooperates with China and Marktplaats's notice-and-takedown programme, and that counterfeits are a large and growing problem, but declines to take specific extra measures on fur or labour conditions.
No, for action against infringement of intellectual property rights it makes no difference how the articles in question were manufactured.
Nee, voor het optreden tegen inbreuk op intellectueeleigendomsrechten maakt het geen verschil hoe de desbetreffende artikelen zijn vervaardigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van bont van wasbeerhondjes in nep-Uggs (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether counterfeit Uggs made with raccoon dog fur were on the Dutch market and whether measures would be taken against them. The minister could not confirm the scale, pointed to customs seizures and brand-owner tools, and said no additional measures were planned because enforcement does not distinguish by fur type.
I do not intend to take other measures to combat counterfeiting.
Ik ben niet voornemens om andere maatregelen ter bestrijding van namaak te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Plasterk over consumentenvertrouwen en consumptie

MPs Albayrak and Plasterk asked why Dutch consumer confidence fell and why Dutch consumer spending diverged from Germany's after EU consumer spending stalled in Q4 2011. Minister Verhagen attributed the decline to stock prices, unemployment, inflation and housing prices, said the divergence reflects Germany's stronger recovery, and stressed the government's efforts to preserve confidence in public finances.
The cabinet is therefore working hard to safeguard confidence in the sustainability of public finances.
Het kabinet werkt daarom hard om het vertrouwen in de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handelsmissie naar Japan en de mogelijkheid om daar de situatie van de in Japsn gevangengenomen Erwin Vermeulen te bespreken

An MP asks the Economics minister whether the trade mission to Japan would raise the detention of Dutch citizen Erwin Vermeulen, and about market access for agri-food exports, whaling, dolphin hunting and trade figures. The minister answers that the government will not interfere in Japan's legal process, that the case was resolved with his acquittal on 22 February, and that market access and non-tariff barriers were discussed along with trade and investment figures.
The Netherlands does not interfere in Japan's legal process.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang van Japan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handelsmissie naar Japan

An MP asked the minister whether the Japan trade mission discussed the Dutch bill on the nationality of sea vessels in order to withdraw Sea Shepherd's Dutch registration, and why this was raised during a trade mission. The minister answered that the bill was briefly mentioned at Japan's request, that the Dutch position against whaling was stated, and that the court case of a Dutch citizen was left to the Japanese judiciary.
I emphasised that discussion of the legislation in the House of Representatives depends on the House agenda.
Ik heb benadrukt dat het bespreken van de wetgeving in de Tweede Kamer afhankelijk is van de kameragenda.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen bittorrent-verkeer blokkeert

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked whether the University of Groningen's computing centre, by blocking BitTorrent traffic for students without a court order, acts as an internet access provider bound by the proposed Telecommunications Act article 7.4a and whether such blocking and disconnection of students at rightsholders' request is acceptable. The minister answered that the RUG appears to be an internet access provider under the proposed article 7.4a, that blocking is only allowed in limited exceptions such as a court order, that he knows of no concrete cases of students being disconnected at rightsholders' request, and that the proposed article 7.6a limits disconnection to non-payment, bankruptcy and fraud.
This means that if the new article 7.4a takes effect, the RUG may not hinder or block services or applications when providing internet access to its students.
Dit betekent dat als het nieuwe artikel 7.4a van kracht wordt, de RUG bij het bieden van internettoegang aan haar studenten geen diensten of toepassingen mag belemmeren of blokkeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Bemmel en Tony van Dijck over de storingen bij ING (min ELI)

PVV MPs Van Bemmel and Van Dijck asked whether the government accepts that ING must always be reachable for internet banking, and whether the minister will talk with ING's management about a backup system. Finance Minister De Jager answered that ING has a full shadow backup system, that the outages were a rare combination of human error and technology, and that he sees no reason to discuss it further with ING's management.
In view of the above, I see no reason to exchange further views with ING's management on this.
Gelet op vorenstaande zie ik geen redenen om hier met de directie van ING verder nog over van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans over het salaris van de Floriadedirectie en de vergoedingen van de commissarissen bij de Floriade

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Floriade directorate's pay exceeds the Balkenende norm, how much public subsidy funds it, and whether commissioners' fees (reportedly 4000 euro per meeting) are excessive and publicly financed. The minister answered that the Wopt does not apply to the Floriade company, that the directorate's pay is reportedly below the norm, that no state subsidy is used for directorate salaries, that commissioner fees average 750 euro net per month and are not state-financed, and that the exhibition commissioner's fee is split 50/50 between the ministry and the company.
At my request, the chair of the Supervisory Board informed me that the Floriade directorate's remuneration does not exceed the norm amount.
Op mijn verzoek heeft de voorzitter van de Raad van Commissarissen mij medegedeeld dat de vergoeding van de Floriadedirectie niet boven het normbedrag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over de signaalsterkte van de radio in Noord-Holland (min ELI)

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education, Culture and Science why radio reception in northern Noord-Holland remains poor and when it will improve, and whether other regions have similar problems. The minister said higher transmitter power is being coordinated, with Radio 1-3 ready but Radio 4 still under negotiation with Belgium, and that full restoration depends on rebuilding the Hoogersmilde mast and repairing Lopik by around summer 2012.
Since 2008, Agentschap Telecom, together with the Dutch Public Broadcasting organisation (NPO), has worked on improving reception of national public broadcasters in the area mentioned.
Er is sinds 2008 door Agentschap Telecom, samen met de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO), gewerkt aan verbetering van de ontvangst van landelijk publieke omroepen in het genoemde gebied.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Gesthuizen over sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die slecht beveiligd zijn

Two SP MPs asked whether locks, pumping stations and bridges that can be operated remotely over the internet are insecure, whether other municipalities use the same SCADA systems, why earlier warnings from the NCTb were not acted on, and whether these structures should be manned again. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat-managed structures are largely not internet-connected, that security is continuously monitored, and that she is responsible only for Rijkswaterstaat objects, not for municipalities.

As minister I am responsible for the management of locks, pumping stations and bridges managed by Rijkswaterstaat, and I therefore cannot answer for the municipality of Veere or for other municipalities or authorities.

Als minister ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van sluizen, gemalen en bruggen die door Rijkswaterstaat beheerd worden en ik kan derhalve niet antwoorden voor de gemeente Veere of voor andere gemeenten of overheden.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink naar aanleiding van de perspublicatie ‘DutchAero grijpt naast mammoetorder JSF’

An MP asked the minister about press reports that Dutch Aero would lose a large F-35 engine order, the size of the revenue forecast and investments, job losses, and whether individual firms' figures can be disclosed. The minister says the F136 engine forecast was about 750 million dollars, declines to give company-level forecasts, investments or revenue breakdowns citing commercial confidentiality, and gives partial updates such as 15 jobs and a promise to report on contracts in the next annual report.
The breakdown by individual company of that total revenue expectation, specifically for the F136 engine, I will not disclose because of commercial confidentiality.
De uitsplitsing naar individuele bedrijven van die totale omzetverwachting en specifiek ten aanzien van de F136-motor maak ik vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het rapport van milieudefensie over Biokerosine

An MP asks the ministers about a Milieudefensie report criticising biokerosene, including food security, social sustainability criteria, indirect land-use change, climate neutrality under the ETS, and government support. The state secretary answers that EU sustainability criteria apply, that the government supports indirect land-use change inclusion and advanced biofuels, and describes existing funding and initiatives.
The Netherlands, together with other member states, has repeatedly urged the European Commission to include ILUC at European scale in the sustainability assessment.
Nederland heeft, samen met andere lidstaten, meermaals bij de Europese Commissie erop aangedrongen ILUC op Europese schaal mee te nemen in de duurzaamheidsbeoordeling.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over ontslagen bij uitgeverij Wegener

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they condone the planned loss of 300 to 350 jobs at publisher Wegener, whether regional news provision is important, and how they would support regional news. The ministers said job cuts are a private company decision, acknowledged the importance of news provision, and pointed to regional media centre cooperation and the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Pers as measures.
Although I regret the loss of employment, it is primarily up to Wegener to decide on this.
Hoewel ik het verlies aan werkgelegenheid betreur, is het primair aan Wegener om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans over de staking van de olieproductie in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about the South Sudan oil production shutdown, alleged Sudanese seizure of oil, Dutch and EU roles in the negotiations, and the humanitarian situation. The minister answered that both states should revise unilateral steps and resume talks under the AU panel, that the Netherlands plays a supporting role, that the EU's role is supportive, and that the Netherlands will monitor the humanitarian situation.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over de steenkolendialoog

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the government about the stalled coal dialogue, supply-chain transparency for coal origin, and whether Nuon's commercial interests justify withholding it. The government replied that the dialogue is progressing, that origin disclosure is commercially sensitive and an imperfect indicator, and that it will invite parties to be transparent without itself publishing results.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation will, from its observer position, call on the parties involved to be transparent about the progress of the dialogue and the results achieved when the occasion arises.

Het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, zal vanuit zijn waarnemerspositie, de betrokken partijen oproepen bij gelegenheid zelf transparant te zijn over het verloop van de dialoog en de bereikte resultaten.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Irrgang over afschaffen omstreden Amerikaanse  invoerheffingen en terugbetaling van de geïnde heffingen aan het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about the end of US 'zeroing' anti-dumping duties and why no refund of duties already paid by Dutch exporters was agreed. The state secretary welcomed the deal, said the WTO ruling was prospective only, and noted that the EU tried but failed to secure refunds, leaving affected firms to pursue US courts.
The ruling applies to the future and has no retroactive effect.
De uitspraak geldt voor de toekomst en heeft geen terugwerkende kracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de privacyvoorwaarden van Google

An MP asked the government about Google's revised privacy terms, including whether combining user data across products requires opt-in consent and whether Google's market power leaves users without alternatives. The minister deferred conclusions to the European data protection authorities, explained the legal framework under the Wbp, and said alternatives exist and competition law applies.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the steps taken by the European supervisory authorities before I can inform you about the consequences of Google's new privacy terms.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de stappen van de Europese toezichthouders af alvorens ik u kan informeren over de gevolgen van de nieuwe privacyvoorwaarden van Google.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Van Vliet over de metallurgische industrie

PVV MPs De Mos and Van Vliet asked the ministers whether the government will act to protect the metallurgical industry's level playing field against the EU emissions trading system and the German nuclear phase-out, and urge that the system be scrapped. The minister answers that the Dutch government supports the ETS and only seeks compensation for genuine carbon leakage risk, while the Commission's state-aid guidelines are still pending.
The aim is to maintain a level playing field in Europe and to prevent member states from using state aid to distort European competitive conditions.
Het doel is handhaving van het gelijke speelveld in Europa en daartoe voorkomen dat lidstaten door middel van staatssteun de Europese concurrentieverhoudingen kunnen verstoren.
Antwoord vragem Gesthuizen over het negeren van ‘Bel-me-niet register'

An MP asks the minister why companies ignore the Bel-me-niet telemarketing register, whether OPTA fines deter violations, and what steps will reduce complaints. The minister says complaints are falling, OPTA has imposed 1.2 million euro in fines, no company has been fined repeatedly, and an evaluation will be sent to parliament this spring.
This evaluation will be sent to your House this spring.
Deze evaluatie wordt uw Kamer dit voorjaar toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen Leegte en Dijkhoff betreffende de uitkomst van de Energieraad van 14 februari 2012

Two MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether several small member states oppose the Commission's proposed Projects of Common Interest mechanism under the Connecting Europe Facility for energy, and what the Dutch position is. The minister answered that most member states, large and small, want a greater role for member states in selecting projects, that Dutch policy is unchanged after the February 2012 Energy Council, and that a progress report will come to the June Council.
The large majority of member states, both large and small, want, together with the Netherlands, a greater role for member states in determining projects of common interest and the path leading there.

Het overgrote deel van de lidstaten, zowel groot en klein, wil met Nederland een grotere rol voor de lidstaten bij het vaststellen van de projecten van gemeenschappelijk belang en de weg die daar naartoe leidt.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over energiebesparing door innovatieve automatische zonwering

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a TNO report on energy savings from automated exterior blinds (HR-zonwering) was accepted, whether such blinds are included in the energy label calculation and the Energie Investerings Aftrek, and how innovation could be promoted. The government agreed with the report, said blinds are already in the calculation for non-residential buildings but not yet for homes, and explained the two routes to EIA for non-residential buildings, while declining to pick specific technical innovation and pointing to general energy-quality incentives.
For non-residential buildings, HR blinds are already included in the standard calculation method and software for the EPC and energy label, for homes not yet, but I will promote this.
Voor utiliteitsgebouwen is HR-zonwering al opgenomen in de standaardberekeningsmethode en -software voor de EPC en het energielabel, voor woningen nog niet, maar ik zal dit bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Koppejan over de groei van crowdfunding en regulering/toezicht

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the growth of crowdfunding and whether it is adequately regulated and supervised. The minister replied that consumer protection applies through the Wet op het financieel toezicht with AFM and DNB guidance, that crowdfunding is a useful addition warranting no current regulatory obstacle, and that a further roundtable with supervisors is planned.
As the document also indicates, the supervisory authorities are willing to consult with the initiators of a crowdfunding platform to inform and/or advise them on the applicable laws and regulations.

Zoals in het document ook wordt aangegeven, treden de toezichthouders graag in overleg met de initiatiefnemers van een crowdfunding platform om hen op de hoogte te stellen en/of te adviseren over de toepasselijke wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat Nederland kampt met een nijpend tekort aan hoogopgeleide technici

MP Schouten asked the ministers about reports of a severe shortage of highly educated technicians, the ROA labour market forecast, and whether the social loan system for masters students deters bèta students. The minister acknowledged serious technical labour shortages, outlined joint public-private measures and a Masterplan due to be sent to cabinet, and argued the masters loan burden is limited and unlikely to deter students.
By 2 April at the latest, your House will be informed about the cabinet's ambitions.
Uiterlijk 2 april a.s. wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de ambities van het kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over te hoge prijzen voor hotelkamers

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether online booking intermediaries charge excessive commissions to hotels, whether hotels are free to set prices, and whether consumers can see intermediary fees. The minister answered that commission levels vary and hotels are free to contract, that a legal disclosure duty is undesirable, and that the competition authority has received no formal complaints and sees no reason for further investigation.
I am not aware of the precise content of the contracts between booking sites and hotels.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de precieze inhoud van de contracten tussen boekingssites en hotels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schaart en Lucas over het artikel ‘Slimme dijken op komst’

MPs Schaart and Lucas asked about a newspaper report on 'smart dikes', including whether broadband cable ducts in dikes could be shared with telecom companies at marginal cost and how water boards are encouraged to combine projects. The minister answered that sensor dike technology is still being studied, that a convenant between water boards and cable operators is in preparation, and that she will consider cost-sharing when the moment is right.
A convenant between the Union of Water Boards and the Platform of Network Operators is currently being prepared.
Er wordt op dit moment gewerkt aan een convenant tussen de Unie van Waterschappen en het Platform Netbeheerders
Antwoord vragen Van Bemmel inzake BARD (Offshore windmolenaar)

An MP asked whether the offshore wind developer Bard, reportedly close to bankruptcy, had received any of the planned 4.2 billion euro subsidy and whether it could be reclaimed, and whether offshore wind is financially unfeasible. The minister answered that no subsidy has been paid, since the parks are not yet built and subsidy is paid per actual production, that Bard no longer holds a stake after a takeover, and that offshore wind is not yet among the most cost-efficient options.
Nothing. The subsidy was promised to two limited partnerships, whose shares were held by BARD in May 2010.
Niets. De subsidie is toegezegd aan een tweetal CV's, waarvan in mei 2010 de aandelen in handen waren van BARD.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de naleving van de Regeling afsluiten elektriciteit en gas van kleinverbruikers

An SP MP asked the energy minister whether network operators and suppliers must report disconnection figures, why Liander's disconnection trend differs from Enexis and Stedin, whether new suppliers disconnect faster for non-payment, and whether a quick dispute procedure exists for small consumers facing disconnection. The minister answered that reporting is not mandatory, explained the differences are hard to attribute, saw no evidence new suppliers act differently, and said no fast dispute procedure exists but a smart-meter flow limit could be considered.
No, network operators and suppliers are not obliged to report figures on disconnections or end of supply.
Nee, netbeheerders en leveranciers zijn niet verplicht om over aantallen afsluitingen, dan wel beëindiging van levering te rapporteren.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de uitstapmogelijkheden van het JSF-programma

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Defence and Economic Affairs whether Dutch industry contracts depend on actually buying JSF aircraft, what exit costs and withdrawal conditions apply, and when the government shared these with parliament. Minister Hillen answered that industry has received orders from the development phase, that order allocation depends on US prime contractors and best-value principles, that partial information has been shared confidentially over time, and that Nederland can exit subject to MoU terms with exit costs to be detailed in the 2011 annual report.
It is contained in the Lockheed Martin Letter of Intent that was sent confidentially to the House on 10 October 2006.
Het is opgenomen in de Letter of Intent van Lockheed Martin die op 10 oktober 2006 vertrouwelijk aan de Kamer is gezonden
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf over het bericht "Stichting bepleit platform voor windmolens"

An MP asked the minister about the national coordination regime for large wind projects, including whether the state picks sites without consulting local authorities, how the Groningen N33 wind park is progressing, and whether alternatives are considered. The minister denied that the state decides without consultation, described consultation and public participation steps, said there is no binding Groningen share, and pointed to the forthcoming Rijksstructuurvisie Wind op Land for site clarity.
In the context of preparation, consultation takes place with the municipalities and province(s) concerned.
In het kader van de voorbereiding vindt overleg plaats met de betrokken gemeenten en provincie(s).
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de tabakslobby die meespreekt in Den Haag

An SP MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about contacts between ministry officials and the tobacco industry, including an informal arrangement that industry would first raise issues with the director-general, and whether the ministry follows WHO guidelines limiting industry interaction. The minister answered that such contacts are part of normal stakeholder engagement, that the ministry is transparent about them, and that he disagrees with critics' characterisations of tobacco policy.
I was not aware of this specific arrangement, and that is not necessary because it fits the policy line I indicated in answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Ik was niet op de hoogte van deze specifieke afspraak, en dat hoeft ook niet want hij past in de beleidslijn zoals ik bij vraag 1 heb aangegeven.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een geheime keylogger op 141 miljoen smartphones (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

The MP asks whether Carrier IQ spyware (keylogging, SMS and https interception) is on Dutch smartphones, whether it is sold to third parties, and whether government phones are affected. The minister answers that no evidence of such software on phones sold in the Netherlands was found, that data sales are denied by the company, and that other supervisors could investigate if needed.

Should it turn out that such software is present on smartphones delivered in the Netherlands, it is up to the Data Protection Authority, the Independent Post and Telecommunications Authority or the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there is reason to investigate from their responsibilities.

Mocht toch blijken dat dergelijke programmatuur voorkomt op in Nederland geleverde smartphones, dan ligt het op de weg van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens, de Onafhankelijke Post en Telecommunicatie Autoriteit of het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er vanuit hun verantwoordelijkheden aanleiding is onderzoek te doen

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vermeend programma geïnstalleerd op smartphones dat de gebruiksgegevens van telefoongebruiker (ingezonden 7 decembe

MP Verhoeven asked the minister whether the Carrier IQ software reported on smartphones violates Dutch privacy law, whether its presence on any phone in the Netherlands can be excluded, and whether an investigation will follow. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers given to MP Gesthuizen without addressing the questions on substance.
To answer your questions 2 and 3, I refer to my answers to the parliamentary questions from MP Gesthuizen.
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen 2 en 3 verwijs ik naar mijn antwoorden op de kamervragen van het lid Gesthuizen

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebrek aan Nederlandse ambitie ten aanzien van windenergie op zee (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the lack of Dutch ambition on offshore wind, citing a Volkskrant article and Rabobank and Bloomberg reports, and asked about 2020 project output, the 4 GW gap, cost and subsidy comparisons with other countries, jobs and patents, and industrial policy. The minister responded that the reports' conclusions are broadly consistent with sector views, rejected protectionism, projected about 1 GW of offshore capacity by 2020, said offshore wind has no prominent role in the 2020 renewables approach, and pointed to the topsector policy and a Green Deal with industry.
I have concluded a Green Deal with NWEA on, among other things, innovation and cost reduction.
Ik heb een Green Deal gesloten met NWEA over onder meer innovatie en kostenreductie

Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Dijksma (beiden PvdA), Hachchi (D66) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Defensie over het stopzetten van de ontwikkeling van de F13

MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about the cancellation of the F136 engine development for the Joint Strike Fighter, including the financial commitments of Dutch firms, expected orders, contacts with industry and the US Congress. The government regrets the decision, says the US financed the engine alone, reports about 7 million euro invested by Dutch firms and a revised order estimate of about 750 million dollars, and says it is pursuing a larger role for Dutch industry on the F135 engine.
The answer to questions 13, 14 and 15 addresses the possibly larger role of Dutch industry in producing the remaining engine, the F135 from Pratt & Whitney.
In het antwoord op de vragen 13, 14 en 15 wordt ingegaan op de mogelijk grotere rol van de Nederlandse industrie bij de productie van de overgebleven motor, de F135 van Pratt & Whitney.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken landbouw en Innovatie over het beheer van slimme meters (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister about who is responsible for smart meter data after a move, who supervises that party, what sanctions apply, how privacy oversight works, sample sizes, EDSN's role, and the status of an information code. The minister answered that the meter operator is responsible, that the Cbp (privacy) and NMa (energy regulator) share oversight and can impose sanctions, that the NMa monitors the rollout, and that the information code is planned for April 2013.
