The Cbp supervises compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act.
Het Cbp houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Van Hijum (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichtgeving rondom het failliet van Zalco (ingezonden

MPs Koppejan and Van Hijum asked ministers about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Zalco, its impact on employment and the metal industry, and the unequal European energy cost playing field. The minister answered that the parent company tried to rescue Zalco, that EGF support is being prepared, and that the government is pursuing a North-West European electricity market and contacts with the Commission on German and Belgian measures.
I have therefore asked the European Commission to provide an overview of similar schemes in other countries and of the Commission's position on these schemes.
Ik heb daarom bij de Europese Commissie de vraag neergelegd een overzicht te geven over soortgelijke regelingen in andere landen en de opstelling van de Europese Commissie tegenover deze regelingen.
Vragen van het lid van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de berichtgeving rondom de eventuele verkoop van Helianthos (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

An MP asks the economics minister about the possible sale of Helianthos patents to a Qatari buyer, the risk of losing jobs, lost Dutch value, and whether subsidies can be reclaimed. The minister replies that Nuon is free to sell, an online auction is planned, subsidy conditions will be checked and reclaimed if breached, but he cannot block the transaction.
However, I am closely monitoring whether Helianthos complies with the subsidy conditions and will consider how to reclaim the subsidies if it does not.
Wel houd ik scherp in de gaten of Helianthos aan de subsidievoorwaarden voldoet en zal ik bezien hoe ik de subsidies kan terugvorderen indien dat niet het geval is.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het blokkeren of belemmeren van VOIP door tal van Europese telecomproviders (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether reported widespread blocking of VoIP by European mobile providers conflicts with EU telecom rules, whether DPI use for VoIP detection is a privacy intrusion, whether the minister will press for stricter net neutrality rules and whether providers may block services if content firms refuse to pay. The minister replied that they lack data on other countries, that EU rules only require transparency about restrictions, that the pending Dutch net neutrality bill would forbid blocking and separate tariffing of VoIP, and that the government will raise net neutrality in the Telecom Council.
I do not have factual data on the conduct of European telecom providers regarding VoIP in other countries.
Ik beschik niet over feitelijke gegevens over de handelwijze van Europese telecomproviders met betrekking tot VOIP in andere landen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over energieleveranciers die schuldhulpverleningsinstanties niet i

MPs Spekman and Samsom asked ministers whether energy suppliers fail to notify debt-relief agencies before winter disconnections, whether this breaches the ministerial regulation, and how compliance is enforced. The minister acknowledged the notification rules, said the Energiekamer NMa supervises compliance with sanctions available, and noted a new convenant and voluntary frost-disconnection arrangements are being relied upon.
The Energiekamer NMa supervises compliance with the Electricity and Gas Act and therefore also with the ministerial regulation on disconnection policy.
De Energiekamer NMa houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Elektriciteits- en Gaswet en daarmee ook op de naleving van de ministeriële regeling afsluitbeleid.

Vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het conflict tussen het energiedistributiebedrijf WEB e

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the unresolved payment dispute between utility WEB and supplier Ecopower on Bonaire, including whether binding arbitration had been completed by the agreed 7 November 2011 deadline. The minister replied that talks between the parties continue, the dispute persists, arbitration has not been concluded because the timetable was deliberately set aside, and no party is obstructing a solution.
However, the parties have also agreed between themselves that, with the consent of both, the planned timetable could be deviated from if negotiations toward a solution required it.

Partijen zijn echter ook onderling overeengekomen dat met beider instemming van het voorgenomen tijdsschema zou kunnen worden afgeweken indien onderhandelingen om te komen tot een oplossing dat zou noodzaken.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de afpersing bij telefoonabonnementen (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

The SP MP asks whether the government knows that young adults, often with mild intellectual disabilities, are coerced into taking out expensive phone contracts, and what will be done about it, including prevention in schools, phone company obligations, re-joining the credit registry, and police investigation. The ministers acknowledge the problem but say the scale is unknown, point to ongoing police-telecom cooperation, note the existing information helpdesk and under-18 parental consent rule, say the sector is exploring an extension of Preventel, and state that police do take complaints but often lack investigative leads.
Telephone companies are working with the police to map the scale more precisely and to consider what proportionate and effective measures could reduce or prevent such practices.
Telefoonmaatschappijen werken samen met de politie om de omvang nader in kaart te brengen en te bezien wat mogelijke proportionele en effectieve maatregelen zijn.

Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de financiële gevolgen voor ondernemers van de sloop van winkelcentrum ’t Loon i

An MP asked ministers about the financial damage to shopkeepers from the partial demolition of shopping centre 't Loon in Heerlen, including whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies and what support and short-time working arrangements are available. The government answered that the disaster compensation law does not apply, that Heerlen has set up a compensation scheme up to EUR 50,000 backed by a provincial request, and that 18 short-time working applications are being assessed by UWV.
The Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) has been assessed by the Minister of Security and Justice as not applicable to the situation in Heerlen.
De Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) is door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie beoordeeld als zijnde niet van toepassing op de situatie in Heerlen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een geheime keylogger op 141 miljoen smartphones (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asks ministers whether Carrier IQ spyware installed on millions of smartphones collects keystrokes and SMS data in the Netherlands, whether it is sold to third parties, whether consumers can remove it, whether government phones are affected, and what other privacy-invasive software exists. The government's answer is only an interim notice: the questions cannot be answered within the normal period because the supervisor's investigation results are awaited.
The reason for the delay is that the answers await the results of an investigation by the supervisor.
De reden van uitstel is dat voor de beantwoording gewacht wordt op resultaten van een onderzoek door de toezichthouder.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een vermeend programma geïnstalleerd op smartphones dat de gebruiksgegevens van telefoongebruiker (ingezonden 7 decembe

An MP asked the minister whether Carrier IQ keylogger software reported on smartphones could be ruled out in the Netherlands, what the minister thinks of it, and whether it breaches privacy law. The minister's reply only announces a delay, saying the answers await a regulator's investigation and will follow as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the answers await the results of an investigation by the supervisory authority.
De reden van uitstel is dat voor de beantwoording gewacht wordt op resultaten van een onderzoek door de toezichthouder.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van 3000 plaatsen

MPs Dijksma and Jadnanansing asked whether the figure of 3000 lost postdoc and PhD positions due to innovation policy is accurate and what the government will do to prevent it. The minister disputes the VSNU calculation as incomplete and overstated, argues the real FES cut is about 240 million euros, and promises monitoring with knowledge institutions rather than concrete new measures.
I have agreed with the knowledge institutions that I will closely monitor the developments and involve them in this.
Ik heb met de kennisinstellingen afgesproken dat ik de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet zal monitoren en hen hierbij zal betrekken.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Provincie wil rijkssteun voor tweede kerncentrale Borssele» (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether state money will be put into a possible second nuclear plant at Borssele, given a provincial lobbying push, and about the planned split of Delta and Evides. The minister repeats that no public money will improve the business case for a nuclear plant, that financing is the initiators' responsibility, and that Evides dividends go fully to shareholders, while the Delta-Evides split is planned by end 2013.
As I have frequently stated, I will not deploy public money to improve the business case of a nuclear power plant.
Zoals ik inmiddels veelvuldig heb aangegeven, zal ik geen publiek geld inzetten om de business case van een kerncentrale te verbeteren
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over transport van uraniumhexafluoride over de weg (ingezonden 28 november 2011).

An SP MP asked why six trailers of uranium hexafluoride travelled unaccompanied over the A73 on 18 November 2011, and whether the licence, route, notification, compliance checks and police escort rules were respected. The minister answered that the transport followed the licence with notification given, an alternative route agreed with police and the Kernfysische Dienst, that spot checks show generally good compliance, and that IAEA rules did not require police escort for this material.
In fact it concerned a transport of three lorries carrying six cylinders loaded with uranium hexafluoride.
Het betrof overigens een transport van drie vrachtwagens met zes cilinders beladen met uranium hexafluoride.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de effectiviteit van investeringen in R&D (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

MP Dijkgraaf asks the economy minister how the government evaluates a PhD study finding high GDP multipliers from R&D investment, the lower multiplier of fiscal R&D support, and proposals for an incremental R&D facility and attracting foreign R&D. The minister answers that R&D is central to innovation policy, that existing instruments (Innovatiefonds MKB+, WBSO, innovation contracts, RDA+) are being pursued, and that the government will not yet add an incremental scheme or claim firm returns on investment.
The cabinet aims, with the new business policy, to raise R&D intensity to 2.5% of GDP by 2020.
Het kabinet stelt zich ten doel om met het nieuwe bedrijfslevenbeleid in 2020 de R&D-intensiteit te verhogen naar 2,5% van het BBP.

Vragen van de leden Smeets, Dikkers en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken en aan de staatssecretarissen van Economie Landbouw en Innovatie, en van F

MPs asked whether multinationals such as Shell should be obliged to disclose tax payments and royalties per country and project, and whether Dutch tax policy attracting extractive firms is problematic. The government answered that transparency is supported via international initiatives (EITI, EU and OECD country-by-country reporting work), that it will not address individual companies on their payments, and that Dutch tax treaties are public.
The Netherlands favours transparency and seeks international agreements that apply to all internationally operating companies.
Nederland is voorstander van transparantie en streeft naar internationale afspraken die gelden voor alle internationaal opererende bedrijven.

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «NRG start duizendste productie-cyclus isotopen voor behandeling alvleesklier- en darmkanker» (ingezonde

The MP asks whether the Petten High Flux Reactor, which produces medical isotopes, can be kept running and when it must be replaced, and asks for a letter on the status. The minister confirms the reactor's importance but gives no guarantee against production stoppages, explains the ten-yearly safety evaluation due in 2012, and says talks on a replacement reactor are ongoing without committing to a letter.
Given the ongoing talks, I cannot currently tell the House more than what is stated in the answers to the questions above.
Gelet op de lopende gesprekken kan ik de Kamer op dit moment niet meer melden dan wat in de antwoorden op bovenstaande vragen is weergegeven.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebruik van bont van wasbeerhondjes in nep-Uggs (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that fake UGG boots in the Netherlands use raccoon dog fur, whether they are hard to distinguish from genuine ones, and what measures will be taken. The government replied only with a notice that the answers would be delayed because not all required information had been received yet.
since not all required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is

Vragen van de leden Leegte en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht Zorgen om energievoorziening Saba en Stati

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Interior about the energy supply on Saba and Sint Eustatius after the splitting of utility Gebe, including concrete plans for new companies, cross-subsidies from Sint Maarten, the risk of doubled energy prices, and eligibility for EU Connecting Europe funding. The government replied that SEO research indicates cheaper supply is feasible, that support from the ministry for new companies has been arranged, that regulation is being worked on with results expected in 2012, and that it opposes using the EU facility for these islands.
With the executive councils of Saba and Sint Eustatius it has meanwhile been agreed that they will receive support from my department in forming the intended new companies.
Met de bestuurscolleges van Saba en Sint Eustatius is intussen afgesproken dat zij bij de vorming van de beoogde nieuwe bedrijven ondersteuning krijgen van mijn departement.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het optreden van Prins Maurits in de uitzending van Pauw en Witteman van 11 november 2011 (ingezonden 16 nove

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether Prince Maurits' criticism of government policy in a November 2011 television broadcast was acceptable and what it says about ministerial responsibility. The minister answered that the prince did not criticise government policy, since he spoke before the vote on an amendment, and that ministerial responsibility for royal family members concerns conduct affecting the public interest, which was not at stake.
Prince Maurits did not criticise government policy.
Prins Maurits heeft geen kritiek geuit op het regeringsbeleid.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inval van de NMa bij Veolia in verband met een onderzoek naar verboden prijsafspraken r

An MP asked ministers whether the competition authority NMa's raid on Veolia over suspected illegal price agreements on OV-chipkaart development costs for students implicates other transport firms, what sums were charged and provided, when conclusions are expected, and what sanctions are possible. The government confirmed the raid and the investigation, declined to name other firms or give timing or the investigation's scope, reported the public funds provided to decentralised authorities and NS without isolating development costs, and listed fines, orders under penalty and binding instructions.
To avoid parties being unnecessarily incriminated, and also under case law on this, the NMa does not independently disclose the names of parties under investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat partijen onnodig worden geïncrimineerd en ook op grond van de rechtspraak daarover, brengt de NMa zelfstandig geen namen naar buiten van partijen die onderwerp van onderzoek zijn.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «oprichting RETBuzz gaat niet door (ingezonden 4 novemb

MPs Haverkamp and Monasch asked whether the planned RET-Qbuzz joint venture was blocked by the competition authority NMa and what the government can do given the tender deadline. The minister answers that the NMa issued no decision because the parties withdrew their notification, that the late filing was the parties' own responsibility, and that the tender timing is for the Stadsregio Rotterdam and the companies to decide.
The Stadsregio Rotterdam is responsible for further organising the tender procedure.
De Stadsregio Rotterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de verdere inrichting van de aanbestedingsprocedure.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Wageningen Universiteit (ingezonden 21 ok

An MP asks whether a news item claiming Wageningen University had no evidence on milk's health effects remains online without correction, and why Wageningen falls under a different ministry than other universities. The minister says the publishing decision lies with Wageningen UR and that the university follows the same legal rules as other universities, with the agriculture minister responsible for green education.
It is up to Wageningen UR to decide whether or not to withdraw reporting on this subject from its magazine Resource for students and staff of Wageningen UR.
Het is aan Wageningen UR om te beslissen of zij berichtgeving over dit onderwerp in haar blad Resource voor studenten en medewerkers van Wageningen UR wel of niet intrekt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Atoomrel Greenpeace» (ingez

An MP asks ministers whether Greenpeace activists who dug under rail tracks used for nuclear waste transport should be prosecuted and held liable, and whether Greenpeace should be held responsible. The minister answers that the transport containers are safe, that the judgment on the action is for the courts and the Public Prosecution Service, and that Greenpeace effectively endorsed the action, while the security plans will be evaluated.
I leave the specific judgment in this case to the court.
Het specifieke oordeel laat ik in dit geval aan de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en van Miltenburg (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de slechte ontvangst van Radio 1, Radio 2, Radio 3, Ra

MPs Schaart and van Miltenburg asked why radio stations including Radio 1 and Omroep Drenthe remain poorly received in northern Netherlands after the Hoogersmilde mast collapse, and what the public broadcaster and government are doing about it. The minister answered that a temporary emergency mast and alternative frequencies improve reception but full restoration awaits rebuilding the mast (expected October 2012), and that a 200-metre temporary mast is being planned.
You will be informed separately by letter about the progress and the action plan.
Over de voortgang en het plan van aanpak wordt u afzonderlijk per brief geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Delta twijfelt over Borssele 2» (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether investment in a second nuclear plant is viable, whether public money will be used, what talks have been held with Delta and others, and whether correspondence will be shared. The minister answers that investment is a market matter, no public money will be used to improve the business case, no talks on specific financing were held, and correspondence is not shared as it falls outside the usual permitting procedure.
However, I have held talks at a higher level of abstraction about the progress of the talks between DELTA, RWE and EdF.
Wel heb ik op een hoger abstractieniveau gesprekken gevoerd over de voortgang omtrent de gesprekken tussen DELTA, RWE en EdF.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de economische betrekkingen tussen Nederland en Israel (ingezonden

MPs Peters and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch economic ties with Israel, including settlement businesses, the Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council, and Gaza gas fields. The government restated its policy of discouraging economic relations with businesses in occupied territories, said it does not actively check trade with settlement firms, and declined to see evidence of unlawful Israeli use of Gaza gas.
In general, the government discourages economic relations with businesses in the occupied territories.
In zijn algemeenheid ontmoedigt de regering economische relaties met bedrijven in de bezette gebieden.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het beperken van magnetische velden rond bestaande hoogspanningstracés (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether phase-rotation (fasedraaiing) to reduce magnetic fields around existing high-voltage lines, as trialled by Stedin, could be applied more widely at low cost and whether the minister would consult grid operators. The minister confirmed the technique is applicable in principle, gave cost figures, but saw no reason to require grid operators to apply it, while promising to report later in the year on buy-out options for residents close to lines.
At this moment I see no reason to apply the phase-rotation technique and to prescribe it to grid operators.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om de techniek van fasedraaiing toe te passen en dit netbeheerders voor te schrijven.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het instellen van een keurmerk voor de glazenwassersbranche (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

The MP asks whether the government shares concerns about intimidation and extortion by rogue operators in the window-cleaning sector, how widespread this is, and whether a quality mark should be introduced. The minister agrees the practices are worrying, says no exact figures exist, refers to existing enforcement routes (police, Openbaar Ministerie, FIOD, NMa), and sees no need for further government measures beyond encouraging sector-led initiatives.
I do not have exact figures on how often these occur because they are not always reported to the designated authorities.
Ik beschik niet over exacte cijfers over de mate waarin deze voorkomen omdat hiervan niet altijd melding wordt gemaakt bij de daarvoor aangewezen instanties.

Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over misleidende en agressieve verkoopreisjes voor ouderen (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether elderly people on bus trips are subjected to misleading and aggressive sales demonstrations, including intimidation, blocked doors and refused cancellations, and whether the Consumer Authority and Public Prosecution Service should give this more priority. The ministers answered that the Consumer Authority fined several operators for unfair commercial practices, that the 2008 rules are adequate and enforcement effective, that the operators have ceased activity, and that the Consumer Authority has prioritised such practices.
I therefore have no reason to assume that the legislation and/or the enforcement are not adequate.
Ik heb dan ook geen reden te veronderstellen dat de wetgeving en/of de handhaving niet toereikend zou zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het tracé bij Nieuwe Wetering (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister about the Nieuwe Wetering transmission line route, including the precautionary principle near Schiphol, underground cable lengths, health risks such as fine particulate matter, and the choice of a westerly route. The minister answers that the precautionary principle is applied, the route was chosen as far west as possible, underground cable is limited to 20 km used up near existing housing, and RIVM and health council studies find no aggravated health effects.
As indicated during the debate with your House on 9 June, we do apply the precautionary principle for aviation safety.
Zoals is aangegeven tijdens het debat met uw Kamer op 9 juni jl. passen we het voorzorgsprincipe voor de luchtvaartveiligheid juist wel toe.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht TNT baas krijgt 2,6 miljoen (ingezonden 21 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the 2.6 million euro severance payment to TNT's former CEO is disproportionate, whether it breaches the Tabaksblat code, and whether it should be taxed at 100%. The minister answers that pay is a matter for the company's supervisory board and shareholders, that the code applies on a comply-or-explain basis with the Monitoring Commission reviewing it, and that the existing 30% excessive severance levy already discourages such payments.
The Monitoring Commission is conducting special research this year into the quality of the explanations given for non-application, including regarding provision II.2.8.
De Monitoring Commissie doet dit jaar speciaal onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de gegeven uitleg bij niet-toepassing, onder andere ten aanzien van bepaling II.2.8.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het opslaan van kernafval (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asks the government whether the Belgian research on storing nuclear waste is sound and whether Belgian authorities should be pressed to study deep-layer storage with Brabant and Brabant Water. The minister answers that Belgian research followed correct procedures, that the Belgian government will not be approached, but that information will be shared with the province of Noord-Brabant and a administrative meeting can follow.
In the question hour of 27 September 2011 the state secretary of EL&I promised that I would send the Brabant provincial executive (GS) the available information.
In het vragenuurtje van 27 september 2011 heeft de staatssecretaris van EL&I toegezegd dat ik het Brabantse college van Gedeputeerde Staten (GS) de beschikbare informatie zal toezenden.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico’s op het digitale Klic-systeem

MPs Ziengs and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked whether enforcement under the WION underground utilities law still hits small recreational businesses with no safety risk, whether fines can reach 100,000 euro, and whether these networks should be exempt from the digital KLIC system given the costs. The minister answered that only one recreational operator was registered, which then withdrew after contact; the 100,000 euro is the statutory maximum fine; some exemptions exist but not for third-party supply; and he will review proportionality in the upcoming WION evaluation, with no enforcement in the meantime.
I am therefore willing to look at the proportionality of the current WION relative to recreational businesses.
Ik ben daarom bereid te kijken naar de proportionaliteit van de huidige WION ten opzichte van de recreatieondernemers.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een onvolledige rapportage van Agentschap Telecom over graafschades veroorzaakt bij het aanleggen van glasvezel (ingezond

MP Schaart asks the minister whether reported excavation damage figures for Deventer and Amsterdam are accurate and whether the Agentschap Telecom report on glass-fibre excavation damage is misleading and should be corrected. The minister denies knowing the source of the figures, explains the report is based on mandatory netbeheerder reports with no breakdown by cause, admits the report could have addressed risks more, and says AT has contacted the agency and will act as supervisor.
Following your questions, there has been contact with AT.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen is er contact geweest met AT.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over vermeende privacy-schendingen met cookies door Facebook (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Deputy Verhoeven asked the minister whether Facebook's irremovable cookies collecting privacy-sensitive data breach the Dutch Personal Data Protection Act, and how this relates to the cookie amendment to the Telecommunications Act and the minister's earlier stance favouring self-regulation. The minister answered that the Wbp requires unambiguous consent that can be withdrawn, that assessing compliance is for the Cbp, that OPTA will supervise article 11.7a Tw once in force, and that he opposed the original amendment's stricter wording but never argued for self-regulation replacing legislation.
Whether in the situation described personal data was processed, and whether the Wbp was then complied with, is not for me to assess.
Of in de beschreven situatie sprake was van verwerking van persoonsgegevens, en of in dat geval voldaan is aan de Wbp, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Dijkhoff (beiden VVD) minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de € 9,1 miljard beschikbaar stelt voor met name breedband in buitengebieden (ingezonden 6 o

MPs Schaart and Dijkhoff asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the EU's Connecting Europe Facility would offer EUR 9.1 billion for broadband, including to local governments and utilities, and how many Dutch households lack broadband and whether the Netherlands should claim a share. The minister answered that broadband rollout is primarily a market task with public funding only where markets fail, that about 98% of households can reach 30 Mbps, and that questions on budget shares cannot yet be answered because the proposal is still in early decision-making.
Given the stage of decision-making the Connecting Europe Facility proposal is in, answering these questions is not possible at this time.
Gelet op de fase van besluitvorming waarin het voorstel voor de «Connecting Europe Facility» zich bevindt, is beantwoording van deze vragen nu niet mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de benzineprijs die hoger is dan de olieprijs rechtvaardigt (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

MP Dijksma asked the minister of Economic Affairs why Dutch petrol prices no longer track the oil price, whether they should be 5 to 10 cents lower, and what the government would do to lower them. The minister referred to a government study of the fuel market, said long-run pump prices are explained by oil and the dollar rate while short-run fluctuations pass through unevenly, and attributed the apparent gap to different oil price benchmarks used for European petrol.
This shows that the level of Dutch pump fuel prices is in the long run well explained by the oil price and the dollar exchange rate.
Hieruit blijkt dat de hoogte van Nederlandse brandstofprijzen aan de pomp op de lange termijn goed te verklaren is door de olieprijs en de dollarkoers.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over compensatie voor consumenten voor het uitvallen van Blackberry (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the economics minister whether BlackBerry users have a legal right to compensation for the early-October 2011 outage, how to recover subscription costs and extra charges, and whether collective compensation or a statutory compensation right should be pursued. The minister answers that consumers rely on general Civil Code remedies, that the telecom networks functioned as expected, that a collective action is possible but the parties should first settle, and that he will consult the telecom sector but sees no reason for a special statutory right.
However, I am willing to consult with the telecom sector to explore what options exist for finding solutions to these kinds of problems.
Ik ben evenwel bereid om in overleg te treden met de telecomsector om te bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om tot oplossingen voor dit soort problemen te komen.

Vragen van de leden Smeets, Dikkers en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken en aan de staatssecretarissen van Economie Landbouw en Innovatie, en van F

Three PvdA MPs asked ministers about multinational oil, gas and mining companies using tax havens, including Shell, and about transparency of tax payments per country and project. The government announced the answers would be delayed because of inter-ministerial coordination and promised to send them by 11 November.

On behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the State Secretaries of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and of Finance, I undertake to make every effort to send you the answers no later than 11 November.

Mede namens de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretarissen van Economie Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën zeg ik u toe mij te zullen inspannen u de antwoorden niet later dan 11 november aanstaande toe te zenden.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over schaliegas (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the minister about chemicals for fracking shale gas by Cuadrilla, DSM and Queensland Gas Company, REACH registration, and whether a moratorium should be imposed. The minister answered that drilling programmes are not yet submitted, that REACH compliance will be checked before drilling, and that a moratorium is unnecessary because an enforceable ban on non-authorised chemicals already exists.
Announcing a moratorium is therefore not an issue at this time.
Het afkondigen van een moratorium is nu dan ook niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichtgeving betreffende supercookies (ingezonden 26 augustus 20

Two MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Justice whether self-reinstalling 'supercookies' reported in the press go beyond normal cookies, breach the cookie rules in the telecom decree, and should be banned as computer trespass. The minister replied that the cookie consent rules apply and that OPTA, the regulator, must judge concrete cases, and that whether computer trespass applies depends on the technical facts and is ultimately for a criminal court to decide.
It is up to OPTA, as the regulator, to judge in concrete cases whether this way of using cookies violates article 4.1 of the Decree on universal service and end-user interests.

Het is aan OPTA, als toezichthouder, om in concrete gevallen te oordelen of deze wijze van gebruik van cookies in strijd is met artikel 4.1 van het Besluit universele dienstverlening en eindgebruikersbelangen.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de brand bij de radiotoren bij IJsselstein (ingezonden 26 augu

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs why the findings of investigations into the fire at the IJsselstein radio mast remain undisclosed and whether they should be made public immediately. The minister replied that the cause is not yet definitively established, that the investigations are commissioned by the parties and insurers and are still ongoing, and that he will announce findings publicly once available and will address responsibilities for mast safety in a forthcoming review.
I am of the view that once this is the case, the cause of the fire must also be communicated publicly.
Ik ben van mening dat zodra dit wel het geval is, over de oorzaak van de brand ook in de openbaarheid moet worden gecommuniceerd.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Nederland op de ranglijst van sterkste IT-landen sterk gedaald is naar de 10e plaats wereldwijd (ingezond

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about Dutch fall to 10th place in an IT competitiveness index and its causes, and what will be done about ICT policy. The minister answers that the index is one of many with its own method, that Nederland scores well on other ICT indicators, acknowledges ICT's importance and says ICT is included in all top sectors and a forthcoming implementation agenda.
The ICT sector is an important sector for the cabinet.
De ICT-sector is een belangrijke sector voor het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Haaren vreest boringen schaliegas» (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on local fears over shale gas drilling in Haaren, the safety of trial drilling, differences between US and Dutch practice, how to build public support, and the procedural steps between a trial drilling and an exploitation permit. The minister answered that safety comes first, that Dutch rules are stricter than US practice, that a working group on public support will report in autumn, and that a trial drilling is expected no earlier than early 2012 after further safety decisions.

As I have already done in my letters to you of 8 June 2011 and 20 June 2011, I will, if developments give cause for it, ensure that communication with you and with the other governments takes place in a careful manner.

Zoals ik reeds gedaan heb met mijn brieven aan u van 8 juni 2011 en 20 juni 2011 zal ik, indien de ontwikkelingen daartoe aanleiding geven, er voor zorgen dat de communicatie met u en ook met de andere overheden op zorgvuldige wijze plaatsvindt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de grote gevolgen van schaalvergroting in de supermarktbranche voor kleine

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijkgraaf and Schouten asked the economy minister whether expanded Sunday opening harms small supermarket owners relative to chains and whether it should be reversed. The minister replied that the 2011 tightening of the tourism exemption is expected to help small shops, that Sunday opening is only one factor among several, and that no new measures are planned.
No, as I have already indicated, the expanded Sunday opening is only one of the factors contributing to the declining turnover and number of small supermarkets.
Nee, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven is de ruimere openstelling op zondag slechts één van de factoren die een rol spelen bij de dalende trend van de omzet en aantal van kleine supermarkten.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het berekenen van buitensporig hoge annuleringskosten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Bouwmeester asked the minister whether cancellation fees of €50 by Vliegwinkel.nl plus €50 by the airline on booked tickets are excessive, why they were not clearly disclosed, whether this is a misleading practice, and what remedies travellers have. The minister answered that the fees are permitted if disclosed, that the Consumentenautoriteit and courts decide on unfair practices, and that consumers can turn to the Geschillencommissie Reizen or the civil courts.

The Consumentenautoriteit does not comment on any ongoing investigations, and the judgment whether a specific case involves an unfair commercial practice is reserved for the Consumentenautoriteit and the courts.

De Consumentenautoriteit doet geen uitspraken over eventueel lopende onderzoeken en het oordeel of er in een specifiek geval sprake is van een oneerlijke handelspraktijk is voorbehouden aan de Consumentenautoriteit en de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van Vliet en De Mos (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verouderde gasleidingen die tikkende tijdbommen in de Nederlan

PVV MPs asked whether outdated brittle gas pipes in the Dutch subsoil are ticking time bombs, whether risk assessments and replacement timelines of about thirty years are acceptable, and who is responsible for replacing about 10,000 km of cast iron. The minister answers that responsibility lies with regional grid operators supervised by SodM, that the most vulnerable pipes will be replaced within five years, that new safety rules took effect in 2011, and that most cast iron pipes will be replaced by 2041.
SodM supervises the implementation of the plans.
SodM houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de plannen.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gasnetwerk (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MPs Gesthuizen and Jansen (SP) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice about the risks of old cast-iron gas mains, including the OVV chairman's claim that the advice had not been acted on, where risks are greatest, how far network operators are moving, and the status of the Gasunie transmission network. The minister answers that the advice has been followed through legal changes, SodM supervision agreements and completed risk inventories, that replacement is risk-based over decades, and that the Telegraaf map concerns regional networks rather than the Gasunie transmission network.
However, I do not agree with his claim that insufficient action has been taken on the Safety Board's recommendations.
Ik ben het echter niet eens met zijn stelling dat er onvoldoende is gedaan met de adviezen van de Onderzoeksraad.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Verhagen ziet vergunning kolencentrale alsnog komen» (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether he had studied the Council of State ruling annulling the Eemshaven coal plant permit before saying the plant could proceed, and urged alternatives such as biomass and a rethink of energy policy. The minister replied that the provincial authority decides, that he only expressed confidence that new studies would not block a new permit, that energy policy stays unchanged, and that a meeting with the initiators is not appropriate.
Decisions on whether construction of the coal plant may proceed are taken by the competent authority, in this case the province.
Besluiten over de doorgang van de bouw van kolencentrale zijn genomen door het bevoegd gezag, in dit geval de provincie.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van NUON Helianthos (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the economics minister about NUON's plan to close solar cell firm Helianthos, the loss of innovation and jobs, government subsidies, and whether policy could have prevented it. The minister said the market had not found investors, refused new support, said knowledge would be preserved and subsidy recovery was being examined, and defended market-led policy.
I am currently examining, for the part of the subsidy not yet legally settled, what happens to the knowledge developed.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment voor het deel van de subsidie dat nog niet in rechte vaststaat wat er met de ontwikkelde kennis gebeurt.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het technologisch topinstituut (TTI) water in Leeuwarden (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

An MP asks the minister about support for the Wetsus water technology institute in Leeuwarden, including its market position and financing via regional development money. The minister is positive about the institute, sees water technology as a strong sector, and says funding from the regional Rijks REP is in principle agreed, pending the broader innovation contracts.

In February I indicated during my visit to the TTI that I want to make efforts to deploy part of the Zuiderzeelijn funds for the Spatial Economic Package on my budget (the 'Rijks REP') to continue TTI-Wetsus.

In februari jongstleden heb ik bij mijn bezoek aan het TTI aangegeven dat ik mij wil inspannen om een deel van de Zuiderzeelijnmiddelen voor het Ruimtelijk Economisch Pakket die op mijn begroting staan (het «Rijks REP») voor continuering van het TTI-Wetsus in te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over zijn toespraak «De missie van het rentmeesterschap» (ingezonden 13 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether his 24 August speech on the mission of stewardship signalled a final break with offshore wind subsidies, and whether a top-sector adviser's remark that the EUR 4 billion should never have been spent means he should stop subsidising offshore wind and focus on innovation. The minister denies any final break, says offshore wind may matter later once costs fall, and states that offshore wind is unlikely to compete in the SDE+ scheme in the near term while innovation continues via business policy.
I said the subsidy granted could have been spent in a better way.
Ik heb gezegd dat de verleende subsidie beter op andere wijze had kunnen worden besteed.

Vragen van het lid Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat er iedere week ernstige olie- en gaslekkages in de Noordzee plaatsvinden (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

MP Samsom asked the minister about a report that serious oil and gas leaks occur weekly in the North Sea, and about risks from old platforms, maintenance, inspections and worker protection when reporting incidents. The minister answered that the figures mainly concern the British sector, that Dutch leaks are reported to and recorded by SodM, that oil spills are mostly small and gas releases have declined, that maintenance is adequate, and that workers can report anonymously to SodM.
For the Dutch part of the North Sea, oil and gas leaks must always be reported to SodM under the Mining Decree.
Voor het Nederlandse deel van de Noordzee geldt dat olie- en gaslekkages altijd behoren te worden gemeld aan SodM op grond van het Mijnbouwbesluit.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over olie- en gaslekkages (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of frequent oil and gas leaks in the North Sea, whether leaks should be penalised with platform closure after three incidents, whether Shell is responsible for most leaks, and whether all leak information will be made public. The minister answered that leaks are already reported and sanctioned under existing law, that closing platforms after three leaks is not appropriate, that Shell's share is not known and NAM is not treated differently, and that the statistics are already public via the SodM annual report.
For the Dutch part of the North Sea, oil and gas leaks must always be reported to SodM.
Voor het Nederlandse deel van de Noordzee geldt dat olie- en gaslekkages altijd behoren te worden gemeld aan SodM

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken Innovatie en Landbouw over olie- en gaslekkages vanaf olieplatforms (ingezonden 11 juli 2011

An MP asked the government about oil and gas leaks from North Sea platforms reported by The Guardian, whether the Netherlands is informed, and whether incident reporting and safety standards are adequate. The minister answered that the information was not new, that SodM already receives mandatory leak reports and publishes annual data, that existing industry and international cooperation suffices, and that no new EU reporting rule is needed.
For the Dutch part of the North Sea, oil and gas leaks must always be reported to SodM under the Mining Decree.
Voor het Nederlandse deel van de Noordzee geldt dat olie- en gaslekkages altijd behoren te worden gemeld aan SodM op grond van het Mijnbouwbesluit

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, landbouw en Innovatie over hoge annuleringskosten bij online boeken van reizen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Dijksma asked why distance-selling cooling-off rights do not apply to travel bookings, whether online bookings bind consumers, and whether excessive cancellation or correction fees should be curbed. The minister answered that travel services are excluded from the withdrawal right for cost reasons, that consumers are bound once they accept terms before confirmation, and that existing industry terms and the reasonableness principle suffice, though a Commission proposal is expected in 2012.
Given existing practice in the travel sector and the consumer's options to act against excesses, I see no reason to amend the rules.
Gelet op de bestaande praktijk in de reisbranche en de mogelijkheden voor de consument om tegen excessen op te treden, zie ik geen aanleiding om de regels aan te passen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichtgeving betreffende supercookies (ingezonden 26 augustus 20

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice whether they were aware of reports on 'supercookies' that behave like malware, whether such cookies should fall under computer trespass and be banned, and how their use fits the Universal Service Decree. The government replied only with a notice that the answers require interdepartmental coordination and will follow as soon as possible, so no substantive answers were given.
The reason for the delay is that answering requires the necessary interdepartmental coordination.
De reden van uitstel is dat de beantwoording de nodige interdepartementale afstemming behoeft.

Vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Bonaire zonder stroom» (ingezonden 26 aug

MPs Bosman and Leegte (VVD) asked ministers about a payment dispute between utility WEB and generator Ecopower that left Bonaire without reliable electricity, asking who is responsible, whether people and firms were harmed, and whether supply will be guaranteed. The minister answered that the dispute is private-law based with a mediation and possible binding arbitration by 7 November, that the island government has primary responsibility while the national government has no direct role in generation, and that he will examine whether further regulation can help.
The local government has a primary responsibility for the electricity supply.
Het lokale bestuur heeft een primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor de stroomvoorziening.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over spookfacturen (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about 'ghost invoices' sent to trademark holders by registration fraudsters, whether complaints were received, how such fraudsters reappear after civil proceedings, whether the small print calling the document an offer escapes criminal liability, and whether a Belgian-style criminal provision should be adopted. The government reply only announces a delay due to consultation with other departments and promises an answer as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is consultation with other departments.
De reden van het uitstel is afstemming met andere departementen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht da

MPs asked the government about reports that shop staff in Zoetermeer are pressured into Sunday work, and whether this reflects a wider trend, whether workers can enforce their rights, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate compliance. The minister answered that the Zoetermeer decision meets the legal tourism criteria subject to a pending appeal, that workers can invoke the Working Hours Act and Civil Code before the courts, and that the government will not have the Labour Inspectorate supervise collective agreement provisions.
The judge has the final say in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism provision.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Ombudsman: Rijk te positief over windmolens» (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the government's wind energy website omitted critical reports, why it did so, and whether all research should inform decisions. The minister acknowledged the Ombudsman's finding, said the site was editorially limited to one link, and agreed decisions should rest on all research, noting the site now references several reports.
For the website windenergie.nl, the editorial choice was therefore made to touch on the discussion only briefly and include just one link.
Voor de website windenergie.nl werd daarom de redactionele keuze gemaakt om de discussie slechts kort aan te roeren en daarbij één link op te nemen

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verschillende stekkers en betaalpasjes voor het laden van elektrische voertuigen (ingezonden 1

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the number of charging plugs, charging systems and payment cards for electric vehicles, and whether these would be standardised. The minister said three plug types currently suffice, that type 2 is the intended standard for public charging, and that EU-level standardisation is targeted for end 2011 via CEN-CENELEC.
At public charging points the electricity is currently still free.
Op publieke laadpunten is de stroom momenteel nog gratis.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over het verlagen van de nettarieven voor Gasunie door de NMa (ingezonden 3 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the NMa's proposed retroactive cut to Gasunie's gas network tariffs, Gasunie's likely appeal, the Finance ministry's support for Gasunie, who benefits from refunds, and the write-down on the German BEB acquisition. The minister answered in detail, explaining the NMa's timeline and the Finance ministry's shareholder position, but stating that the NMa, not the minister, is responsible for the tariff parameters following a court ruling that the earlier policy rule was unlawful.
It is therefore the responsibility of the NMa, and not of the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, to make the said assessment.
Het is dus de verantwoordelijkheid van de NMa, en niet van de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, om de genoemde afweging te maken.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Gasunie moet 1,7 miljard afwaarderen» (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Gasunie may have to write down 1.7 billion euros, the impact on the state and consumers, effects on gas network maintenance and green gas, and the Gasrotonde project. The minister confirmed a 900 million euro write-down so far, with a possible further 800 million, explained fiscal and tariff consequences, and gave general answers on network investment and green gas.

If the final decisions do not substantially change from the current draft and the estimated repayment obligation of about 1 billion euros remains, Gasunie will be forced to write off another roughly 800 million euros in 2011.

Indien de definitieve besluiten niet substantieel wijzigen ten opzichte van het huidige ontwerp en de geschatte terugbetalingsverplichting van circa 1 miljard euro in stand blijft, dan zal Gasunie genoodzaakt zijn om nog eens circa € 800 miljoen af te boeken in 2011.

Vragen van het lid Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht: Tuinders boren naar warmte maar stuiten op olie, «boeiend probleem blootgelegd» (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister about geothermal boreholes that encountered small amounts of gas and oil, and whether ownership and compensation rules are clear. The minister answered that four cases are known, that TNO assesses hydrocarbon risk per permit, that a regulatory boundary between geothermal and gas/oil wells is set out, and that operators should agree among themselves, with a separate letter promised on operator competence.
I will inform your House separately about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer separaat berichten.
Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de joint venture tussen Gazprom en RWE (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the government had responded to a possible RWE-Gazprom joint venture giving Gazprom influence over Dutch Essent plants, whether Dutch rules protect against Russian state interference, whether Gazprom must comply with EU unbundling rules, and whether a Gazprom stake in Borssele nuclear plant needs ministerial approval. The minister answered that talks were at an early stage, that existing market rules and a planned screening provision for changes of control apply, that Gazprom must follow EU and national rules within the EU, and that the minister can block a transfer of Borssele shares if public interests are endangered.

Vragen van het lid Van der Werf (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over lekkage in de pijplijn van boorplatform Gannet Alpha van Shell in het Britse deel van de Noordzee (ingezonden 17 aug

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Shell pipeline leak at the Gannet Alpha platform in the UK sector of the North Sea, including why it was reported late, the spill volume, repairs, and whether Dutch pipelines should be inspected. The minister answered that Shell reported to the UK government within four hours, Dutch rules require immediate reporting to SodM, about 218 tonnes spilled with no oil reaching the Dutch shelf, and that SodM will decide on a specific inspection project after the UK investigation.
As long as the investigation is not concluded and the cause of the leak is not known, I cannot yet say whether the Dutch oil pipeline network requires further investigation.
Zolang het onderzoek niet is afgerond en de oorzaak van de lekkage nog niet bekend is, kan ik nog niet zeggen of het Nederlandse oliepijpleidingennet nader onderzoek behoeft.

Vragen van de leden Verburg en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een klacht betreffende het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (ingezonden 7 j

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a National Ombudsman finding that a chalet owner in a holiday park lacked the right to choose his energy supplier, and whether a law change would follow quickly. The minister answered that a bill implementing the third energy package extends supplier choice to recreational networks after a three-year transition, and that talks between the network owner and grid operator Enexis on a takeover were ongoing without agreement yet.
To bring about change, the third package bill includes a provision creating a basis for rules by general administrative order on valuing a network when it is transferred.

Om hierin verandering te brengen, is in het wetsvoorstel voor het derde pakket o.a. een bepaling opgenomen die een grondslag biedt om bij Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur voorschriften op te nemen over de waardebepaling van een net bij overdracht.

Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de problemen met zendmasten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MPs Van Dijk and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about the failures of the Hoogersmilde and Lopik broadcast masts, the fragmented private ownership, the lack of clear responsibility, whether masts should be publicly owned, and an investigation. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that masts are not in principle a public responsibility except for non-duplicable infrastructure, that existing emergency-broadcast arrangements suffice, and that a mediator has been appointed for Lopik.
The investigations into the cause of this serious situation resulting from the fires have not yet been completed.
De onderzoeken naar het ontstaan van deze ernstige situatie als gevolg van de branden zijn nog niet afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de meettarieven (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about revenues and costs of energy meter rental since 2001, the calculation by Greenchoice, the size of a 'savings pot' for smart meters, and whether it should be recovered or tariffs lowered. The minister answered that historical cost data cannot be provided because the market was unregulated until 2008, that the NMa will monitor costs and revenues and account for differences, and that a maximum on the pot and possibly earlier tariff adjustment will be considered.
An overview of revenues and costs related to meter rental since 2001 is not possible.
Een overzicht van opbrengsten en kosten in verband met de meterhuur sinds 2001 is niet mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de onrust bij een hbo-instelling door plannen voor schaalvergroting (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about unrest at a Dutch university of applied sciences over merger and scale-up plans, and whether the ministry will check the plans and their effect on staff and quality. The minister replies that the institution is restructuring itself, that it is already run as one institution, that the ministry has been informed, and that a ministerial role is not yet at issue, with the new fusion review law taking effect on 1 October 2011.
With the entry into force of the fusion review act, the minister will have a formal role in case of a merger between two or more institutions.
Met de inwerkingtreding van de wet fusietoets krijgt de minister een formele rol ingeval van een fusie tussen twee of meer instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over abonnementen voor mobiel internet (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Van Dam (PvdA) asks whether mobile internet price rises by KPN, Vodafone and T-Mobile signal healthy competition, tacit coordination, and whether the government should reserve spectrum for new entrants. Minister Verhagen answers that the market is competitive, that the competition authority NMa can act against cartels but the government will not commission its own investigation, and that spectrum reservation for two entrants of 2x10 MHz is considered balanced.
I do not know how much (unforeseen) investment the mobile providers have made. This data is commercially confidential.
Er is mij niet bekend hoeveel (onvoorziene) investeringen zijn gedaan door de mobiele aanbieders. Deze gegevens zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.

Vragen van het lid Leegte (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het rendementsverlies van elektriciteitscentrales bij inpassing van windenergie (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the windenergy.nl website was corrected after a National Ombudsman complaint about efficiency losses of power plants from wind integration, and how CBS calculates CO2 savings. The minister confirmed the website was amended and links added, said the CO2 effect is at most 2-3 percent, defended the CBS protocol as consistent with EU rules, and saw no policy consequences.
Following a recommendation by the National Ombudsman, extra links were added to the website www.windenergie.nl to research reports.
Naar aanleiding van een aanbeveling van de Nationale ombudsman zijn er op de website www.windenergie.nl extra links toegevoegd naar onderzoeksrapporten

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Blanksma-van den Heuvel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over risico’s voor het bedrijfsleven van stilvallen kredietverlening (ingezonden 11 august

CDA MPs asked the economy minister whether tightening bank credit and the risk of frozen lending to firms in the second half of 2011 is a problem requiring government action, and what the consequences for growth would be. The minister answered that it is too early to judge a significant credit squeeze, that bank acceptance criteria had eased in Q2, and announced an increase of the BMKB guarantee budget from 765 to 1,000 million euro plus a one-year extension of the Garantie Ondernemingsfinanciering instrument.
To further support credit provision, the cabinet will raise the guarantee budget for the BMKB guarantee scheme this year from 765 million to 1 billion euro.
Om de kredietverlening extra te ondersteunen zal het kabinet het garantiebudget voor de borgstellingsregeling BMKB voor dit jaar verhogen van € 765 mln naar € 1 mld.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het WANO-veiligheidsonderzoek in de kerncentrale van Borssele (Ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the Borssele nuclear plant should be closed until safety is fully secured given 15 safety improvement points from a WANO self-assessment, and whether a terrorism or cyberattack scenario is being studied. The minister refused closure, stating the plant meets its licence requirements, and said EU ad hoc working group reports on security would be sent to parliament, though plant-specific security details are confidential.
At European level it was agreed that the interim and final reports will not address the specific security of individual nuclear plants, because it concerns confidential data.
In Europees verband is afgesproken dat de tussen- en eindrapportage niet zullen ingaan op de specifieke beveiliging van individuele kerncentrales, omdat het vertrouwelijke gegevens betreft.

Vragen van de leden Leegte en Lucas (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Windpark slecht voor stabiliteit dijken»

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether reports that a wind farm endangers the stability of Noordoostpolder dikes are accurate, what measures and costs follow, and how the unrest will be handled. The minister declined substantive comment because the matter is pending before the Raad van State, noting that effects on the dikes were assessed and that no construction or operation will occur before the court rules.

Vragen van de leden Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het raadsbesluit om in Zoetermeer 52 koopzondagen toe te staan (ingezonden

Three MPs asked the minister whether Zoetermeer's council decision to allow 52 Sunday shopping days under the tourism exemption of the Shop Opening Hours Act was lawful, given that the exemption should be interpreted strictly, the tourism must be autonomous and substantial, and workers' interests must be weighed. The minister answered that the municipality's assessment is its own responsibility, that an objection and possible appeal are pending before the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal, and that the courts have the final word.
The judge has the last word in assessing whether the municipality of Zoetermeer rightly used the tourism exemption.
De rechter heeft het laatste woord bij de beoordeling van de vraag of de gemeente Zoetermeer terecht gebruik heeft gemaakt van de toerismebepaling.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het blijven gebruiken van Deep Packet Inspection door telecombedrijven (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asked whether continued use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom firms defies the House's wishes, whether the Dutch data protection authority's findings will be published quickly, and when. The minister denied a need for immediate action, said regulators (OPTA, CBP) are investigating and no strafrechtelijk onderzoek will follow, and gave no date for the CBP results.
Pending an investigation, the CBP makes no statements about the content or the procedural course of the investigation.
Hangende een onderzoek doet het CBP geen uitspraken over de inhoud noch over het procedurele verloop van het onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de brandbrief van de Jonge Academie

Two MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science to respond in full to the Young Academy's letter calling cuts to fundamental research short-sighted, and to say what the reported 350 million euro cut would mean for research quality, quantity and training places. The government replied that the topsector approach keeps fundamental research funding at NWO and KNAW, that no 350 million euro cut applies, and that research will be steered more toward economic topsectors and grand challenges while curiosity-driven research remains possible.
Within the framework of the top sectors there is no question of a cut of 350 million euros.
Er is in het kader van de topsectoren geen sprake van een bezuiniging van € 350 miljoen.

Vragen van het lid Leegte (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bewonerscommunicatie rondom de uitkoop van woningen onder de 220 en 380KV-trajecten die door verstedelijkt gebied lopen

An MP asked the minister how residents and municipalities under the 220 and 380 kV power lines in urbanised areas are kept informed about the buyout of homes, and when clarity on dates, criteria and procedures will be given. The minister said a detailed plan with communication to residents will come at the end of the year, that no one will be forced to move, and that the buyout concerns the 380 kV right-of-way zone.
As I have already indicated to the House, I will come with a worked-out plan at the end of the year.
Zoals ik uw Kamer reeds heb aangegeven zal ik eind van het jaar met een uitgewerkt plan komen.
Vragen van de leden Verburg en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over hoogspanningslijnen in de gemeente Zutphen (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the economy minister about high-voltage lines through Zutphen, including the risk of two parallel 150kV lines, the substation noise, whether the lines can go underground, and whether residents will be consulted transparently. The minister said there is no increased risk, that the 150kV lines do not qualify for house buyouts but may be undergrounded subject to criteria and local study due at the end of 2011, and that a plan with resident communication will follow.
To establish whether undergrounding the lines in Zutphen is actually feasible, however, concrete on-site research is needed.
Om na te gaan of dit betekent, dat het ondergronds brengen van de lijnen in Zutphen ook daadwerkelijk realiseerbaar is, is echter concreet onderzoek ter plaatse nodig.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «KPN zet app-heffing door» (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether KPN's planned fee on messaging apps such as Skype and WhatsApp should be stopped, given a parliamentary majority opposed to it. The minister answered that an amendment banning such app fees has become part of the Telecommunicatiewet bill and that he finds additional fees on new services undesirable.
From the moment this law takes effect, KPN simply has to comply with it.
Vanaf het moment dat deze wet van kracht wordt, moet KPN daar gewoon aan voldoen.
Vragen van het lid PaulusJansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat kleinverbruikers teveel betalen voor de meterhuur (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister whether households overpay about 180 million euros a year for gas and electricity meter rental, whether the meter rates were agreed in anticipation of smart meters, how long overcharging may continue, and whether the surplus is reserved for smart meter rollout. The minister denied endorsing the overpayment claim, explained the 2010 meter tariff regulation and NMa monitoring, and said surpluses will be netted against later costs though grid operators may use the money in the meantime.
This regulation ensures that the consumer does not have to pay more than the costs of metering and a reasonable return for the grid operator.
Deze regeling zorgt ervoor dat de consument niet meer dan de kosten voor het meten en een redelijk rendement voor de netbeheerder hoeft te betalen.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over radioactief besmette zeecontainers in de haven van Rotterdam (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

The MP Karabulut asked whether five radioactively contaminated containers from Japan were let through the port of Rotterdam, what the risks to workers and public health are, and whether all containers from the Fukushima area should be checked on arrival. The minister answered that only one container triggered the alarm and was delayed by human error, that a few containers slightly exceeded transport limits with negligible health risk, and that full checks of every container are not proportionate.
Following this incident, Customs tightened its work instruction.
Naar aanleiding van dit incident heeft de Douane toen de werkinstructie aangescherpt.

Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over CO2-vrije stroomopwekking (ingezonden 30 mei

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure & Environment about the chemical looping CO2-capture technology, its prospects for the Netherlands, and how the government will track the EU-funded DemoCLOCK pilot. The minister answered that the technology is promising but early-stage, that Dutch institutions are involved in DemoCLOCK, and that agreements exist to keep the government informed.
The central government has made agreements with the European Commission and the Dutch bodies involved that the government will be kept informed of the state of affairs.
De Rijksoverheid heeft afspraken gemaakt met de Europese Commissie en de betrokken Nederlandse instanties dat het Rijk op de hoogte wordt gehouden van de stand van zaken.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over workshops sociale media georganiseerd door Syntens (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister why Syntens, a publicly funded innovation body, offers free or low-cost social media workshops that commercial parties also provide, and whether this is a government task. The minister defended the workshops as first-line awareness work for SMEs, said Syntens' remit is being reviewed within the planned Ondernemerspleinen concept, and promised a letter to parliament this summer.
This summer I will send a letter to your House elaborating the concept of the Ondernemerspleinen.
Deze zomer zal ik een brief aan uw Kamer sturen, waarin het concept van de Ondernemerspleinen verder uitgewerkt is.

Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bezorgdheid van de branchevereniging Scheepsbouw Nederland over het toenemende protectionisme van concurrerende overhe
