An MP asked the economy minister whether the Dutch shipbuilding sector's concern about foreign protectionism would be addressed by establishing a level playing field, and whether subsidies or guarantees would be used. The minister replied that the Netherlands seeks international level-playing-field agreements, that Dutch subsidy and guarantee schemes exist, and that distortions would be raised with the European Commission.
Demonstrable distortions of the level playing field within Europe are raised by my department with the European Commission.
Aantoonbare verstoringen van het level playing field binnen Europa worden door mijn departement aangekaart bij de Europese Commissie.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over kredietverstrekking (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MP Verburg (CDA) asked whether it is undesirable that banks loosen credit conditions for large firms but not for SMEs, and whether the minister will pressure banks and inform parliament by end June. The minister said credit terms are market-determined and SME differences are explicable, that supervisors (NMa, AFM) rather than the minister would act if no economic rationale exists, and that an expert group's advice, to be sent before end June, will be considered.
Insofar as differences in treatment have an economic explanation, it is not logical to call banks to account for them.
Voor zover verschillen in behandeling een economische verklaring hebben, ligt het niet in de rede de banken daarop aan te spreken.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over omgang van de Kamer van Koophandel (KvK) met persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether it is acceptable that the Chamber of Commerce sells business contact data, which generates unsolicited mailings, and whether it should switch the Non Mailing Indicator from opt-out to opt-in and convert its mandatory levy to a voluntary one. The minister defends the revenue role of address sales, notes the NMI gives no absolute protection, promises a principled review of registry data use, and says the levy will be substantially reduced in a later letter.
I want to make a more principled assessment in the short term of the openness, availability and permitted use of the data in the commercial register.
Daarom wil ik op korte termijn een meer principiële afweging maken in de openbaarheid, beschikbaarheid en het mogen gebruiken van de gegevens in het handelsregister.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de lobby voor de vestiging van een Europees onderzoekscentrum van Heinz in Nederland

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the minister whether the government lobbied Heinz to locate its European research centre in Nijmegen, whether subsidies, permits, deregulation or animal testing were involved. The minister answered that EL&I pitched the Netherlands and gave location information but made no agreements, subsidy promises or regulatory exemptions, that permits are for the municipality, and that no animal tests are registered for Heinz.
The cabinet is working to strengthen the investment climate to be attractive to national and international companies that create employment and innovation.
Het kabinet zet in op versterking van het vestigingsklimaat om aantrekkelijk te zijn voor nationale en internationale bedrijven die zorgen voor werkgelegenheid en innovatie.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over Filantropie (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Omtzigt asked whether the government will sign a convenant (covenant) with the philanthropic sector on 21 June 2011, who represents the sector, and how the promised geefwet (giving law) and parliamentary involvement are secured. Minister Verhagen confirmed the covenant signing, named the sector signatories, and said the covenant is part of a broader Geefwet package with fiscal changes to be included in the Belastingplan 2012 and a letter to parliament.
The Convenant will be signed on 21 June and will be sent to the Chamber as soon as possible.
Het Convenant wordt 21 juni getekend en zal zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Kamer worden toegezonden

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het raadsbesluit om in Zoetermeer 52 koopzondagen toe te staan (inge

Three MPs (ChristenUnie, SGP, SP) asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether Zoetermeer's council may allow 52 Sunday shopping days under the tourism clause of the Shop Opening Hours Act, questioning whether outflow of purchasing power and the local survey support this and whether the decision should be annulled as in Westland. The minister answered that the tourism clause was properly applied, that Zoetermeer demonstrated autonomous substantial tourism and weighed the statutory interests, and that he sees no reason to propose annulment, while noting the objection period had not yet expired.
Incidentally, based on the information I have received, I see no reason to proceed to a proposal for annulment.
Overigens zie ik, op basis van de informatie die ik heb gekregen, geen reden om tot voordracht voor vernietiging over te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Windmolens, als stroombron» (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

The MP asks the minister about a newspaper article claiming wind turbines take as much energy to build as they produce in eighteen months, about gas-fired backup for wind, about provincial wind permitting in protected areas, and about subsidies for the Urk/Noordoostpolder wind park. The minister rejects the energy claim, says backup is largely flexible coal/gas plant operation rather than gas kept running for wind, denies a blanket ban conflicts with provincial policy, and withholds some tax-related subsidy details while attaching a project list.
The authors are welcome for a discussion at the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation with my staff involved in the subject.
De auteurs zijn welkom voor een gesprek in het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie met mijn medewerkers die bij het onderwerp betrokken zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over windenergie (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

The MP asks whether the minister agrees that wind power is too unreliable to supply a significant share of energy, the capacity factors of onshore and offshore wind in the Netherlands, and how many Dutch windmills positively affect the national grid. The minister answers that wind is variable but its average output can be forecast over the long term, cites countries with significant wind shares and KEMA's finding that 12 GW of wind is integrable by 2020, and refers to CBS data for capacity factors.
That does not, however, mean that wind energy cannot provide a reliable and significant amount of renewable energy.
Daarmee is echter niet gezegd dat windenergie geen betrouwbare en significante hoeveelheid duurzame energie kan leveren.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris Infrastructuur en Milieu over proefboringen naar schaliegas en het fracken van de ondergrond ten b

An SP MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure & Environment about permits for shale gas test drilling and fracking, including which authority is competent, chemical disclosure, environmental impact assessment, safety distances, financial liability and a Brabant Water concern about drinking water. The minister answered in detail that permits and oversight by SodM and municipalities exist under current law, that the chemicals are a trade secret visible to the regulator, and that no national criteria or law change is planned.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over Deep Packet Inspection (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

MPs Schaart and Van der Steur asked whether KPN's use of Deep Packet Inspection is lawful, whether it is used by other providers, and whether the government will investigate privacy compliance. The minister answered that DPI is permitted within legal limits, that Vodafone also uses it, that OPTA has started an investigation and the CBP and Public Prosecution Service will decide further steps, and promised to inform parliament of the results.
I attach great importance to it being clear what is happening and what has happened with the use of Deep Packet Inspection, and whether rules have been broken.
Ik hecht er dan ook sterk aan dat duidelijk wordt wat er gebeurt en gebeurd is bij het gebruik van Deep Packet Inspection, en of hierbij de regels overtreden zijn.
Vragen van de leden Verburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over telefooncontracten overzetten zonder toestemming (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Verburg and Omtzigt asked the minister about businesses being switched to another telephone provider without consent, and what remedies exist and what OPTA can do. The minister confirmed complaints, explained the self-regulated COIN reversal procedure, said OPTA lacks powers because contract law falls under the Civil Code, and called for strengthened procedures without committing to legislation.
I have therefore called on the parties involved to strengthen the existing procedures to prevent transfers without adequate expression of intent.
Ik heb de betrokken partijen daarom opgeroepen om de bestaande procedures te versterken om overzettingen zonder adequate wilsuiting te voorkomen

Vragen van de leden Schaart en van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «iPhone maakt elke minuut een foto van je, ook in bed

Two MPs asked the ministers whether consumers should be told in advance about hidden location-tracking features in Apple devices, and whether government use of Apple products should be halted. The government answered that existing consumer information duties apply, declined to advise separately or ban Apple products, and pointed to security measures for sensitive functions.
I do not consider a separate advice on this point necessary.
Ik acht een separaat advies op dit punt niet noodzakelijk.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de werkwijze van de OPTA met betrekking tot abonnementswijzigingen van KPN (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the minister about OPTA's handling of KPN's business subscription changes, including whether customers who declined annual contracts were nonetheless moved to them and why OPTA did not enforce further. The minister answered that KPN states such customers were not moved, that OPTA is independent and the minister will not comment on its decision, and that KPN will allow telephone-only cancellation for business contracts while other cancellation routes remain possible.
OPTA is an independent regulator and makes its own decisions. I do not consider it appropriate for me as minister to give an opinion on OPTA's decisions
OPTA is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder en neemt zelfstandig besluiten. Ik vind het niet passend om als minister een mening te geven over de besluiten van OPTA

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Jusititie over het gebruik van Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether the use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom providers complies with Dutch law, whether it should be investigated as unlawful interception, and whether providers should be barred from differentiating data by use. The government answered that DPI is lawful only under case-by-case legal limits, that OPTA and the Public Prosecution Service are investigating, and that it will implement a net neutrality motion.
The National Public Prosecution Service is currently conducting a preliminary investigation into this matter.
Het Landelijk Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie verricht op dit moment een oriënterend onderzoek naar deze kwestie.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat drie bestuurders van de Hogeschool Van Hall Larenstein kapitalen verdienen voor nog geen drie uurtjes we

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is unacceptable that three board members of Hogeschool Van Hall Larenstein earn large salaries for very few working hours, and whether excess pay can be reclaimed and the supervisory board held to account. The government replied that the three institutions are managed jointly by one board, that pay is set by agreement and by the supervisory board, that the new pay cap applies only at reappointment, and that no further steps are planned while the motion's follow-up is awaited.
I will not take any further steps now because this will only play a role at reappointment.
Ik zal nu geen nadere stappen ondernemen omdat dit pas een rol gaat spelen bij een herbenoeming.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over wettelijke belemmeringen tussen toezichthouders (ingezonden 27 a

SP MPs asked the ministers whether the competition authority NMa is barred by law from sharing information on tax evasion and fraud with other enforcers, how often this occurs, and whether the Competition Act should be changed. The minister answered that legal options for information exchange with other supervisors and the Public Prosecution Service will be widened, with safeguards, via a forthcoming amendment merging NMa, OPTA and the Consumer Authority.
Yes, together with the NMa I have concluded that the legal possibilities for information exchange with other agencies can be widened.
Ja, samen met de NMa ben ik tot de conclusie gekomen dat de wettelijke mogelijkheden voor informatie-uitwisseling met andere instanties kunnen worden verruimd.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over dreigend massaontslag bij KPN (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister about reported mass layoffs at KPN and the high pay of its former and incoming CEOs, and whether this reflects greed harming the economy. The minister says pay and workforce decisions are for KPN's own board and supervisory board under the Dutch corporate governance code, and declines to judge the pay.
Whether pay is justified by performance is first a matter for the supervisory board and then the shareholders to assess.
Of sprake is van een verantwoorde beloning gelet op de geleverde prestaties is in de eerste plaats ter beoordeling van de raad van commissarissen en vervolgens van de aandeelhouders.
Vragen ingediend door het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over multinationals bij kwekersvrijstelling in octrooirecht (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about who wrote the legal analysis on a plant-breeder's exemption in patent law, how its independence was ensured, which firms were consulted, and whether access to ministers was equal for farmers, NGOs and large companies. The minister replied that only ministry lawyers wrote it, no peer review took place, a Plantum opinion did not change the analysis, a consultation with five industry bodies is underway, and that all groups have equal access.
No peer review took place because sufficient expertise on this subject is available within the department.
Er heeft geen peer review plaats gevonden omdat de expertise over dit onderwerp voldoende op het departement beschikbaar is.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over mogelijke toekomstige problemen in de energievoorziening van Bonaire (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister about risks to electricity supply on Bonaire after financial trouble at Ecopower and its parent Econcern, including threats to public facilities and possible price rises. The minister answered that the dispute is civil-law between Ecopower and WEB, that WEB has a supply duty under a concession, that the government has no formal position, and that a regulatory framework is being considered.
The talks between WEB and Ecopower are a civil-law matter in which the government has no formal position at all.
De gesprekken tussen WEB en Ecopower zijn een civielrechtelijke aangelegenheid waarin de overheid geen enkele formele positie heeft.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid van Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over gebruikmaking van bedrijven en hun diensten van gedragsprofilering over internetgebruik

The MP asks whether the government will inform parliament about OPTA's study on unlawful cookie use, whether the problem extends to online data collection generally, whether resale of such data can be excluded without consent, and what the progress is on EU do-not-track and right-to-be-forgotten rules. The minister refers to OPTA's independent study, says data collection is not per se unlawful and resale is not explicitly prohibited, and describes the EU process with a Commission proposal expected by summer.
Yes, the use of cookies is only one of the ways in which user data on the internet can be collected.
Ja, het gebruik van cookies is slechts een van de manieren waarop gegevens van gebruikers op het internet kunnen worden verzameld.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een koopzondagenbesluit van de gemeenteraad van Vlaa

MPs Dijkgraaf, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Vlaardingen's council decision allotting 18 Sunday shopping days, with shopkeepers choosing 12, violates the Winkeltijdenwet, and whether the minister will petition for annulment. The minister answers that the council ordinance is lawful since it delegates 12 days to the mayor and aldermen, that the college's later designation has been ordered brought into line with the law, and that he will await the municipality's reply before deciding on annulment.
I have pointed this out to the municipality and asked it to adjust the designation of the number of Sunday shopping days so that it complies with the Winkeltijdenwet.
Ik heb de gemeente hierop gewezen en verzocht om de aanwijzing van het aantal koopzondagen aan te passen, zodat deze in overeenstemming met de Winkeltijdenwet is.
Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over toestemming voor NedCar om een derde partner te zoeken (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why NedCar has not yet received permission to seek a third partner, and how quickly that permission and the future of the plant can be settled. The Minister says a turn-around study and a Task Force are underway, the approach has been agreed with Mitsubishi, the decision is expected by year end, and he will coordinate with local and provincial authorities and keep Parliament informed.
I expect that the decision-making on the future of NedCar will be concluded by the end of this year.
Ik ga er vanuit dat de besluitvorming over de toekomst van NedCar eind dit jaar wordt afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over windmolens (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether residents of Bramelt, Deventer, were informed of plans for three large wind turbines only through the media, and whether the minister will press the municipality to consult residents; the minister replies the municipality's council decides the location first and residents can object at the zoning-plan stage. The MP also asks for an overview of subsidies for these turbines and their budgets; the minister lists the tax investment deduction (Finance budget) and the SDE/SDE+ production subsidy (Economic Affairs budget).
This proceeds through the zoning-plan procedure, and it is at that stage that consultation with Deventer residents takes place and objections can be lodged.
Dit verloopt via de procedure voor bestemmings-planwijzing en in dát stadium wordt overleg met de bewoners van Deventer gevoerd en kunnen bezwaren worden ingediend.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de productie van windenergie (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether wind power peaks reduce efficiency of gas and coal plants and whether Texas experience applies to the Netherlands, and requests detailed production data and an independent study. The minister answers that efficiency loss is at most 2-3%, that Dutch conditions differ from Texas, and that additional data and a study would not add value.
Detailed operational data other than the data already being registered is not something I consider necessary.
Gedetailleerde praktijkgegevens anders dan data die nu geregistreerd worden, acht ik niet nodig.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Jaarlijkse splijtstofwisselperiode kerncentrale EPZ» (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the Borssele nuclear plant's annual refuelling outage should be combined with an extensive safety review, whether it should stay closed until independent safety checks are done, and whether an independent expert commission should be set up. The minister refuses these requests, saying the plant meets current safety standards and that the planned EU-linked stress test will suffice.
The starting point is that the Borssele nuclear plant is safe, because it currently meets all existing high safety requirements.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de kerncentrale in Borssele veilig is, omdat deze op dit moment voldoet aan alle nu geldende, hoge veiligheidseisen.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het tekort aan technici met een lagere en middelbare opleiding

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a predicted shortage of lower and intermediate-level technicians and the cuts to MBO training for over-30s. The ministers defended the €23 million technology investments, said the 30+ cut reflects private responsibility, and described an alternative financing arrangement with a €130 million box.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de hoogspanningsverbinding Beverwijk–Bleiswijk (ingezonden 2 februa

MPs Haverkamp and Verburg asked why the Beverwijk–Bleiswijk 380 kV line decision was delayed, why the information evening for residents was postponed, and whether the process will be careful and inform parliament. The ministers said a new preliminary decision now covers both eastern and western corridors, that the information evening was postponed until the route choice is known, and that parliament will be informed of the outcome.
As before, we will inform the House of the outcomes of the process.
Zoals eerder ook het geval, zullen wij de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het proces.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de windmolen (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the net energy yield, maintenance costs, environmental friendliness, bird and animal casualties, and break-even point of wind turbines. The minister answered each question with data and sources, noting that net contribution is only slightly lower than gross and that break-even is expected in coastal areas before 2020.
Maintaining back-up capacity itself has no energy requirement and therefore does not lead to efficiency losses.
Het aanhouden van back-upcapaciteit heeft zelf geen energiebehoefte en leidt daarom niet tot efficiëntieverliezen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de vertrekpremie van David Montgomery (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Parliamentary questions from SP MP Gesthuizen ask the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs how they view the €2.7 million extra severance for Mecom's David Montgomery, amid job losses at Wegener, and what powers exist over pay in foreign-owned firms. The minister replies that remuneration and reorganisation are primarily matters for the companies and their shareholders, notes that no large reorganisation is planned at Wegener, points to the Dutch corporate governance code's comply-or-explain principle, and attributes falling newspaper revenue to declining advertising and competition from free online news.
Mecom's shareholders are the designated parties to intervene if they disagree with how Mecom is run.
De aandeelhouders van Mecom zijn de aangewezen partijen om in te grijpen indien zij het niet eens zijn met de gang van zaken bij Mecom.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de kerncentrale van Borssele meermaals ontsnapt zou zijn aan een ramp (ingezonden 31 maart 2

MPs Koppejan and Verburg asked the minister whether past near-accident incidents at the Borssele nuclear plant were classified too low and what has been done since, and how the Chamber is informed about incidents. The minister answered that the 1986-87 incidents would at most be INES level 1, listed the safety upgrades made since, explained that annual reports go to Parliament, and promised to inform the Chamber immediately of level 2 or higher incidents.
I undertake to inform the Chamber immediately, separately from the annual incident reports, if irregularities of level 2 or higher occur.
Ik zeg de Kamer toe om los van de jaarlijkse storingsrapportages de Kamer onmiddellijk te informeren, als er zich onregelmatigheden van niveau 2 en hoger voordoen.

Vragen van het lid El-Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de deelname van Europese bedrijven aan een conferentie in Dubai over aftappen en filteren van telecommunicatie (

An MP asked the minister whether European firms, including Dutch ones, marketed internet and telephone interception and filtering technology at a Dubai conference to security services in repressive states, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that such trade is not formally banned but must be corporately responsible, that he will invite the firms to warn them of misuse and asks them to stop cooperating if misuse is threatened, and that he has no overview of existing contracts.
I will shortly invite the relevant companies to the ministry to point out the possible misuse of filtering technology for anti-democratic and repressive purposes.
Ik zal op korte termijn de desbetreffende bedrijven op het ministerie uitnodigen om hen te wijzen op mogelijk misbruik van filtertechnologie voor anti-democratische en repressieve doeleinden.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over investeringen door bedrijven en personen die gelieerd zijn aan staten (i

MPs Timmermans and Smeets asked ministers whether Dutch supervisors adequately screen investments by foreign state-owned companies and whether the government will map assets of foreign states and leaders, and whether Libya sanctions were delayed by asset searches. The minister rejected claims of inadequate supervision, declined to compile a list of state-owned company assets citing the investment climate and existing rules, and said Libya sanctions were implemented immediately by financial institutions.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch investment climate and of our economic and diplomatic relations abroad to list all assets of foreign state-owned companies.

Het is niet in het belang van het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat en van onze economische en diplomatieke relaties met het buitenland om alle bezittingen van buitenlandse staatsbedrijven op een lijst te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het boetebeleid bij overtredingen van het spamverbod (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

Rep. Verburg (CDA) asked the minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the fine policy for violations of the anti-spam rule and whether fines are sometimes lower than the profit gained, and whether sanctions should be raised. The minister answered that administrative fines are meant to deter and be proportionate, not to strip profits, so no change is planned, and described how OPTA set a EUR 550,000 total fine across three violations.
However, an administrative fine is not intended to compensate damage or to remove the unlawfully obtained advantage.
Een bestuurlijke boete is echter niet bedoeld om schade te compenseren of het onrechtmatig genoten voordeel weg te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over subsidies voor innovatieve technologieën voor de Floriadetentoonstelling 2012 in Venlo (ingezonden 1

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidies for the Floriade 2012 Villa Flora office park were tied to using the most innovative climate technology, and whether an innovative heat exchanger was dropped after impossible conditions and a less innovative supplier was chosen. The minister confirmed the contractor chose another supplier on its own assessment, said the national Unique Opportunities subsidy (EUR 500,000) does not require the most innovative technologies but only an energy performance target, and left the regional subsidies to the region's own responsibility.
As for the subsidies granted by the municipalities and the province, I would note that the region has its own responsibility to deploy the financial resources effectively.

Voor wat betreft de subsidieverlening van de gemeenten en provincie wil ik opmerken dat de regio hierin haar eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft om de financiële middelen op een effectieve manier in te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Albayrak (beiden PvdA) aan de minister-president en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese markt voor diensten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Two Labour MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Economics minister about the government's joint letter with eight other countries urging openness in the EU services market, and about the government's stance on the Services Directive and the country-of-origin principle. The minister confirmed the letter, said the directive is to be fully implemented and evaluated by 2011-2012 with possible amendments, and stated that labour law, minimum wage and working conditions are outside the directive and will not be used to undermine Dutch rules.
The country-of-origin principle is not part of the current Services Directive, which for the cabinet is the starting point for further strengthening the internal services market.
Het land-van-oorsprongbeginsel maakt geen deel uit van de huidige dienstenrichtlijn, die voor het kabinet het uitgangspunt is voor de verdere versterking van de interne markt voor diensten.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over stijgende (grondstof)prijzen (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks whether falling electricity and gas wholesale prices are passed on to consumers, and whether the NMa's view that the energy market does not work sufficiently is shared. The minister answers that competition should pass on price falls, that the NMa's monitor shows widening margins for standard contracts while price passthrough is delayed, that the NMa's safety-net tariff regulation applies, and that the market is improving but still needs work.
It is up to the NMa to monitor competition in the energy market.
Het is aan de NMa om de concurrentie op de energiemarkt te monitoren.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over windmolens (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the 13% drop in wind power output in 2010 despite more turbines, the gas-plant backup needed, and whether alternatives to wind should be pursued given declining wind, lack of local support and EU targets. The minister attributed the drop to low wind (Windex 77), said backup from gas was acceptable for security of supply, rejected the view that alternatives were preferable, and noted the 2020 renewable target requires further wind growth.
I certainly consider it justifiable that electricity consumers use another production source when windmills supply a lower share of electricity production on a low-wind day or in a low-wind year.

Ik acht het zeker te billijken dat de afnemers van elektriciteit een andere productiebron gebruiken als windmolens op een windarme dag of in een windarm jaar een lager aandeel in de elektriciteitsproductie leveren.
Vragen van de leden Verburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over telefooncontracten overzetten zonder toestemming (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about a provider transferring business phone numbers from KPN without customer consent, asking how common this is, what remedies businesses have, what powers OPTA has, and what measures will prevent unauthorised switching. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that answers will take longer than the usual three weeks, with no substantive answers given yet.

I hereby inform you that more time is needed to answer the written questions from MPs Verburg and Omtzigt (both CDA) on transferring telephone contracts without consent, submitted 24 February 2011, than the usual three weeks.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat voor de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Verburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) over telefooncontracten overzetten zonder toestemming, ingezonden 24 februari 2011, kenmerk 2011Z03877 , meer tijd nodig is dan de gebruikelijke drie weken.

Vragen van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het voorkomen van onnodige aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether small local networks without safety risks, such as recreation businesses, should be exempted from mandatory connection to the Klic-online system given high digitisation costs. The minister answered that existing exemptions under the RION already cover such private networks, that a further exemption is unnecessary, and that the ministry will communicate with the RECRON sector association.
Yes, I agree with that. The Kadaster and the Agentschap Telecom are the organisations that have informed me of this.
Ja, daar ben ik het mee eens. Het Kadaster en het Agentschap Telecom zijn de organisaties die mij hierover hebben geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een woordvoerder van de NMA die openlijk twijfelt aan het nut van een onderzoek (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

Van Bemmel (PVV) asks the minister whether an NMA spokesperson's public doubts about a fuel-price investigation are biased and whether the study should be urgent given rising prices. The minister replies that the NMA only confirmed earlier studies found no reason for further enforcement, that the new study is outsourced to an external bureau, and that results will be sent to parliament before 1 June 2011 and shortly after summer.
I will inform your House before 1 June 2011 of the results of the study into the bottlenecks in developing price comparison services.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor 1 juni 2011 informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de knelpunten bij het ontwikkelen van prijsvergelijkingsdiensten
Vragen van de leden Verburg (CDA) en Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de ESA (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

MPs Verburg and Schaart asked the minister about Dutch commitment to ESA, its contribution levels, return calculations and the role of space and aviation in the top-sector policy. The minister answered that contributions will be set at the 2012 Ministerial Conference within budget limits, that Dutch geo-return exceeds 1, and that space can contribute to several top sectors.
The Cabinet will consider the Dutch position ahead of the 2012 Ministerial Conference within the framework of financial possibilities.
Het Kabinet zal de Nederlandse inzet in aanloop naar de Ministeriële Conferentie in 2012 bezien binnen het kader van de financiële mogelijkheden.
Vragen van het lid Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat vakantieparken kosten verzwijgen (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether holiday parks hide costs such as tourist tax and cancellation insurance pre-ticked, and whether the sector should inform consumers better. The minister says existing consumer protection rules (unfair trading practices law, Code Reisaanbiedingen) already cover this, opposes pre-ticked boxes and supports an EU ban on them, and refers the specific case to the Consumentenautoriteit and courts.
I have therefore brought this specific matter to the attention of the Consumer Authority.
Ik heb deze specifieke kwestie dan ook onder de aandacht gebracht van de Consumentenautoriteit.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de «uiterst benarde» positie van consumenten bij faillissementen (ingezonden 16 februari

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether consumers who prepaid for goods from a bankrupt retailer are in a weak position compared with banks, and what measures would rebalance this. The government answered that consumers rank as ordinary creditors with little prospect of recovery, that some retailers partly compensated customers, and that it sees no reason to change preferences, pointing instead to consumer protection tools and third-party deposit schemes.
We see no reason to place private individuals in a position similar to banks, for example by abolishing privileges and preferences in bankruptcy.
Wij zien geen aanleiding om particulieren, bijvoorbeeld door de afschaffing van voorrechten en preferenties in faillissement, in een soortgelijke positie als banken te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over regionale omroepen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MP Verburg (CDA) asked the minister about digitisation policy for regional radio broadcasters, arguing that a proposed frequency allocation would leave seven of thirteen regional broadcasters with inadequate coverage and that this is a problem for emergency communication, and asked what would be done and for an update by 1 May 2011. The minister confirmed receipt of the ROOS letter, said coverage would be addressed in refining the policy and that talks on a possible frequency swap were ongoing, and promised to inform parliament before 1 May.
I expect to be able to provide more clarity in the short term and will inform you of this before 1 May.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn meer duidelijkheid te kunnen geven en zal u hierover voor 1 mei a.s. informeren.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de betrokkenheid van Shell bij gasboring in Karoo Zuid-Afrika (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers about Shell's proposed shale gas exploration in the Karoo, including water and chemical risks, Dutch government involvement or financing, guarantees, parent-company liability and the government's view of the Democratic Alliance's objections. The ministers answered that the Dutch government has no political view on the Princess's statements, that the approval lies with South African authorities under their environmental law, that no Dutch financing or guarantees were given, and that liability questions are for the courts.
It is up to the South African authorities, in the context of licensing, to assess the extent to which the gas drilling method proposed by Shell poses a risk in this area.
Het is aan de Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten om in het kader van de vergunningverlening te beoordelen in hoeverre de door Shell voorgestelde wijze van gasboring een risico vormt in dit gebied.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Shell agenten in Nigeria geweldsinstructies gaf (ingezonden 3 februari 2011)

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers whether the government knew of Shell instructing Nigerian police to use lethal force, under Force Order 237, and what pressure was applied to change it. The ministers said the reports stemmed from leaked US cables, that they did not know whether Shell used its influence, and that the EU-Nigeria dialogue raises the order's revision.
I am not aware whether, and if so how, Shell used its influence to pressure the Nigerian government to amend Force Order 237.
Het is mij niet bekend of, en zo ja, op welke wijze Shell haar invloed heeft gebruikt om druk uit te oefenen op de Nigeriaanse overheid om de «Force order 237» te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over concurrentie op de parkeermarkt (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether municipalities transferring parking management to cooperatives they belong to breaches competition rules, whether they influence pricing, and whether core tasks like tax collection should stay in-house. The minister answers that competition and tendering assessments are for the NMa and civil courts, has no pricing data, and sees no need for national policy since municipalities remain directly accountable.
It is not for me to rule in individual cases on the applicability and compatibility of competition law.
Het is niet aan mij om in individuele gevallen over de toepasselijkheid van en de verenigbaarheid met het mededingingsrecht een uitspraak te doen.
Vragen van het lid Verburg aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de kritiek op het CPB (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asks the economics minister about press reports that the CPB is drifting toward academic research and away from its core macro-economic forecasting, and asks what will be done to restore focus and authority. The minister says macro forecasting remains core work, that there is no reason to doubt quality, that he will raise the concerns with the CPB director, and that existing oversight committees supervise the bureau.
Nevertheless, I will discuss these concerns in a forthcoming meeting with the director of the CPB
Desalniettemin zal ik deze zorgen in een volgend overleg met de directeur van het CPB bespreken
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over de innovatieambities van dit kabinet (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Dijksma (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether the Netherlands is falling behind peer countries in R&D investment and whether the cabinet's cuts to innovation and education are wise given the crisis-era investment packages. The minister answered that public R&D spending is above the EU average but private R&D lags, that the new innovation policy aims at long-term competitiveness rather than more money, and that the crisis measures were appropriate for their time.
To strengthen the knowledge economy, it is not primarily about more money.
Om de kenniseconomie te versterken gaat het niet primair om meer geld.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Nederlandse bedrijfsleven raakt verder achterop met R&D» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the minister of Economic Affairs why Dutch private R&D investment ranks 16th in the OECD, whether Nederland belongs at that position, and what ambition and plans the government has to raise private knowledge investment. The minister acknowledges the ambition for a top-5 knowledge economy, attributes low private R&D to sector structure and weak attraction of foreign R&D, argues output indicators give no cause for pessimism, and refers to the new business policy letter and the National Reform Programme for targets.
For this I refer you to the main lines of the new business policy, described in the letter "Naar de top".
Hiervoor verwijs ik u naar de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe bedrijfslevenbeleid, beschreven in de brief «Naar de top».
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie betreffende een advies inzake hondentraining van Syntens (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether Syntens, a government-funded innovation network, was right to advise a firm to use a dog training session and how this fits its mandate. The minister answers that Syntens only referred the firm to a commercial adviser, which the firm paid for itself, and describes Syntens' funding and role.
Contrary to what was reported, Syntens did not advise holding a session with dogs to better understand the mutual relationships.
In tegenstelling tot wat in de berichtgeving is opgenomen, heeft Syntens niet geadviseerd om een sessie met honden te houden om de onderlinge verhoudingen beter te begrijpen.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het boetebeleid bij overtredingen van het spamverbod (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

MP Verburg (CDA) asks the minister of Economic Affairs about the fine policy for breaches of the anti-spam ban, after a press report on a large OPTA fine for SMS spam, and whether fines are sometimes lower than the gain from the breach. The minister announces that answers will take longer because further consultation with OPTA is needed, so no substantive answers are given yet.
To answer the questions from MP Verburg (CDA) on the fine policy for breaches of the anti-spam ban, submitted 17 January 2011, further consultation with OPTA is needed.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) over het boetebeleid bij overtredingen van het spamverbod, ingezonden 17 januari 2011, is nader overleg met OPTA nodig.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Rijksinpassingsplan Windmolenpark No

MPs Slob and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked why the Noordoostpolder wind park spatial plan was adopted before a meeting with Urk, whether NUON wind plans in eastern Flevoland are being considered together, and whether alternative sites were studied. The minister replied that Urk was consulted repeatedly, seven turbines were dropped in response, the EIA addendum examined alternative locations, and follow-up talks were held.
I have informed your House separately about the outcomes of those talks.
Over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken heb ik uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over misleidende cijfers van Shell over olielekkages in de Nigerdelta (ingezonde

MPs Smeets and Dikkers asked whether Shell's claim that 98% of Niger Delta oil spills are caused by sabotage is misleading, and what the government will do about it. The ministers said they have no evidence for a 50% sabotage figure, have referred the complaint to the OECD National Contact Point, and will press for transparency while an independent UNEP study proceeds.
The NCP is considering how to handle the complaint.
Het NCP beraadt zich over de behandeling van de melding.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een mogelijke kerncentrale in de Eemshaven (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the energy minister whether a nuclear plant planned by Electrabel GDF Suez for Eemshaven was true, whether it could be ruled out, and whether Electrabel had notified the government. The minister confirmed awareness of press reports, said Electrabel only expressed interest after the Maxima plant opening and never notified a concrete plan, and noted that Eemshaven is not a designated nuclear site while promising to inform parliament of any concrete notification.
However, I have not received any notification of the intention to build a nuclear power plant in Eemshaven.
Ik heb echter geen mededeling van het voornemen tot de bouw van een kerncentrale in de Eemshaven ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over buitenlands beleid dat is afgestemd op Shell (ingezonden 25 januari 20

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch foreign policy on Iran sanctions was shaped to protect Shell, whether Shell deserved preferential treatment over other Dutch firms, and whether a Foreign Affairs secondment to Shell created conflicts of interest. The ministers replied that the leaked US cables are the US's responsibility, that the Netherlands backs strict EU sanctions, that the secondment serves sector knowledge, and that government economic diplomacy serves Dutch business as a whole.
Where the interests of Dutch companies are disproportionately affected by this, we will stand up for them.
Wanneer belangen van Nederlandse bedrijven hierdoor onevenredig geraakt worden, zullen wij hiervoor opkomen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over franchisenemers die ten onder gaan aan wurgcontracten waarbij de franchisegever voordeel heeft (ingezonden 14 januari 2

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether franchisees are being induced into onerous contracts under false pretences by franchisors who benefit, and whether a study of the scale of the problem and additional measures are planned. The minister replies that no structural abuses were found in a 2009 EIM study, that the sector should self-regulate, and that he will repeat the research but sees no current need for new government measures.
Of course I am willing to repeat the study that was published in December 2009.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om het onderzoek dat in december 2009 uitkwam te herhalen.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Taverne (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de positie van Apple in de leveringsovereenkomst tussen uitgevers en abonnees (ingezonden 18 januari 2

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether Apple's new demands on publishers' iPad subscriptions were undesirable and whether the competition authority NMa should investigate. The minister said the exact Apple plans and their consequences were still unclear, that no complaints had been filed, and that the NMa was monitoring developments without opening a formal investigation.
If there is abuse of power, the NMa can act against it.
Indien er sprake is van machtsmisbruik, kan de NMa hiertegen optreden.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Annual Growth Survey (ingezonden 18 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would take the European Commission's criticism of the draft National Reform Programme into account and why the Commission omitted the Netherlands from its table of national Europe 2020 targets, and asked for those targets to be added. The minister replied that the criticism is addressed in a joint letter of 4 February 2011 and that national targets for CO2, renewables and early school leavers already exist, while the others are qualitative and will be elaborated in the April reform programme.
In the National Reform Programme of April, the cabinet's ambitions will be further elaborated in policy terms.
In het Nationaal Hervormingsprogramma van april zullen de ambities van het kabinet beleidsmatig nader worden uitgewerkt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de weigering van CanalDigitaal zich aan te sluiten bij een geschillencommissie (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister why CanalDigitaal refuses to join a dispute committee for consumer complaints, given its near-monopoly in areas without cable alternatives, and whether the minister would use his statutory power to require accession. The minister said the market power question belongs to the regulators, that he is negotiating voluntary accession with CanalDigitaal, and that he is considering a mandatory accession obligation for programme service providers if that fails.
I am currently in discussion with CanalDigitaal about joining a dispute committee on a voluntary basis.
Ik ben op dit moment in gesprek met CanalDigitaal over aansluiting bij een geschillencommissie op vrijwillige basis.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanpak van strategische sectoren in de Europese Unie (ingezonden 15 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about EU plans to protect strategic sectors and knowledge from takeover risks, and whether a new EU authority or strategy is needed. The minister replied that existing Dutch and EU tools suffice, that extra screening would add bureaucracy and deter investors, and that no new authority is warranted.
I see no reason to add extra elements to this, for example in the form of additional screening of mergers and takeovers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier extra elementen aan toe te voegen, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van extra toetsing van fusies en overnames.
Vragen van het lid Schaart (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie inzake cybercrime aanvallen op Nederlandse bedrijven (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the economics minister about cyberattacks on Dutch firms, the Netherlands' high rate of ICT incidents in the EU, and planned action. The minister acknowledged the problem, said firms bear primary responsibility, pointed to awareness programmes and an information-sharing knooppunt, and promised to address it in the forthcoming Digitale Agenda and Nationale Cybersecurity Strategie.
In March 2011 the National Cybersecurity Strategy will be sent to the House of Representatives, including policy on tackling cybercrime.
In maart 2011 zal de Nationale Cybersecurity Strategie aan de Tweede Kamer worden toegestuurd met daarin ondermeer het beleid rond de aanpak van cybercrime.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat goede doelen de dupe worden van het Bel-me-niet register (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether he would act on reports that charities lose donation income because of the Bel-me-niet register, and what measures he would take. The minister replied that inventories and a Intomart GfK study found no proven causal link, so no measures are taken for now, but he will examine the effects in the register's evaluation later in 2011 and act if harm is shown.
The inventory does nevertheless signal that charities may be experiencing hindrance from the Bel-me-niet register.
Wel geeft de inventarisatie een signaal af dat Goede Doelen mogelijk hinder ondervinden van het Bel-me-niet register.

Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gedoogbeleid van de gemeente Sint-Oedenrode ten aanzien van de avondwinkelbepaling in de Winkeltijdenwet (ingezonde

An MP asked the minister whether the municipality of Sint-Oedenrode, by allowing two Sunday-open supermarkets against the one-per-15,000-residents limit in the Shop Opening Hours Act, should be held to account and what measures would prevent other municipalities from doing the same. The minister said municipalities must comply with the law, that interested parties can object and appeal (an objection has been filed), and that he has no power to intervene while that procedure is pending.
I therefore have no means to intervene.
Ik heb dan ook geen mogelijkheden om in te grijpen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afrekenbare en controleerbare

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable, checkable targets, baselines and milestones for the government's plan to concentrate business subsidies on top sectors. The minister confirmed the plan but deferred concrete indicators, instruments and budgets to a business policy letter and a mid-2011 update, and pointed to the annual report for accountability.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Six MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, verifiable targets, baselines and interim milestones for improving SME access to government tenders. The minister confirmed the goal but deferred measurable indicators and milestones to a later memorandum, citing measures in the new Procurement Act and an evaluation after four years.
The cabinet will go into this further in the memorandum in response to the report on the bill for the new Procurement Act.
Het kabinet zal hier verder op ingaan bij de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag bij het wetsvoorstel voor de nieuwe Aanbestedingswet.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs for measurable, enforceable targets for 14% renewable energy by 2020, including baselines, interim milestones and how the government will be held accountable. The minister confirmed the 14% target (about 290 PJ), stated no interim targets will be set, deferred a fuller assessment and promised an SDE+ evaluation in 2014 and an annual accountability letter in May.
The cabinet does not set interim targets for the individual years.
Het kabinet hanteert geen tussendoelstelling voor de afzonderlijke jaren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs from several parties asked the minister whether the cabinet aims for 2% annual energy savings until 2020 and requested measurable, verifiable targets, baselines, interim goals, actions and accountability. The minister answered that the cabinet has no separate energy-saving target, that targets are EU climate and renewable goals, and that existing covenants will continue alongside a planned Green Deal, with a letter on the Green Deal promised for February 2011.

As indicated in the answer to question 1, this cabinet has no separate target for energy saving. There will therefore be no baseline measurement, interim targets, measurable indicators or progress reports.

Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven, heeft dit kabinet geen separate doelstelling voor energiebesparing. Van nulmeting, tussendoelen, meetbare indicatoren en voortgangsrapportages zal dan ook geen sprake zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the cabinet aims to cut administrative burden for businesses by 10% by 2012 and 5% yearly thereafter, and how this target would be measured, achieved, verified and accounted for. The minister answered that all seven questions, including the measurability and accountability of the targets, will be addressed separately in a regulatory burden letter to be sent in February 2011.
The question on the accountability and verifiability of cabinet targets regarding administrative burden and regulatory pressure will be answered separately in the Regulatory Burden letter.
De vraag over omtrent de afrekenbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van kabinetsdoelen met betrekking tot administratieve lasten en regeldruk, zal separaat beantwoord worden in de Regeldrukbrief

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

MPs asked the economics minister for measurable targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments and reporting timelines for the government's aim to strengthen links between knowledge, research and innovation policy. The minister confirmed the aim but deferred concrete indicators, targets and budgets to a forthcoming business policy letter and topic-area agendas, with accountability via the annual report.
The House of Representatives will be informed around mid-2011 about the concrete elaboration of business policy, particularly regarding the top sectors.
De Tweede Kamer zal medio 2011 worden geïnformeerd over de concrete uitwerking van het bedrijfslevenbeleid, in het bijzonder met betrekking tot de topgebieden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over Wikileaksberichten over Shell (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

Mr Gesthuizen (SP) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about Wikileaks reports that Shell settled a corruption case in Nigeria, that the Dutch embassy lobbied for Shell against the Petroleum Industry Bill, and that Shell could stop gas flaring in 2011. The ministers answered that the Netherlands promotes transparency, CSR and human rights in Nigeria, disputes the embassy's role only partly by describing meetings rather than phone calls, and say they will keep pressing Shell and Nigeria to end flaring as soon as possible.
This, however, was not a telephone conversation but a meeting.
Dit betrof overigens geen telefoongesprek maar een bijeenkomst.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat rekeningen steeds vaker niet betaald word

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports that household bills are increasingly left unpaid, probing causes, the effect on small firms, household debt stability, and the wage share. The government answered that responsibility lies with debtors and creditors and municipalities, cited research on causes, rejected a link between consumer debt and financial instability, denied a declining labour share, and pointed to municipal debt-relief funding and a pending bill.
Het kabinet zet in op zelfstandigheid.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de berichten dat kleine bedrijven in de autoherstelbranche uit de markt worden gedrukt door de grote jongens en de verz

An SP MP asked the Economics minister about reports that small car-repair firms are being squeezed out by large chains and insurers, and about alleged flaws in the NMa sector scan and SEO critique. The minister replied that insurers and repairers must follow competition law, that the NMa sector scan is independent and not a formal investigation, that no further research is planned after a court upheld it, and that the sector had ample chances to respond.
In view of the above, I therefore do not consider it useful to conduct new or additional research or to examine whether a different research approach would lead to different outcomes.
Gelet op het bovenstaande acht ik het dan ook niet zinvol nieuw of aanvullend onderzoek te doen of te bezien of een andere onderzoeksaanpak tot andere uitkomsten zou leiden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afrekenbare en controleerbare

Six MPs from opposition parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation nine questions about measurable targets, indicators, baselines, milestones and accountability for the cabinet's plan to concentrate business subsidies on focus and mass (top sectors). The minister's reply only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Seven MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie, SGP and PvdD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation to specify measurable, checkable targets for the coalition goal of giving SMEs more chances in government procurement, including baselines, interim targets, instruments and accountability. The minister replied that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Seven MPs from opposition and coalition-adjacent parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation for measurable, verifiable targets for the 14% renewable energy goal for 2020, including baselines, interim targets, instruments, and how and when the government will account for progress. The minister's reply only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Seven MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie, SGP and PvdD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about measurable energy-saving targets, baselines, interim goals, instruments, and how the cabinet will account for progress up to 2020. The minister's reply is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Seven opposition and coalition-adjacent MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the cabinet's target to cut administrative burdens for businesses by 10% in 2012 and 5% annually thereafter is measurable, what indicators and baseline are used, what steps and instruments will be used, and how progress will be reported to parliament. The minister replied only that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline and that answers will follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over afreken

Seven opposition MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation to specify measurable indicators, baselines, interim targets, actions, instruments and accountability arrangements for the coalition goal of strengthening links between knowledge, science, applied research and innovation policy. The minister replied only that the questions could not be answered within the deadline and that answers would follow as soon as possible.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de brief van KPN over de opzegtermijn bij zakelijke contracten (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister about KPN's November letter to business customers that unclearly set a one-year contract default if they did not respond, and about the raised standard notice period; the minister said OPTA supervises compliance with the Telecommunications Act, that enforcement requests are pending, and that SME protection is limited by EU rules, with a Bill to add a passive information duty for SMEs.
OPTA has these enforcement requests under consideration; OPTA's investigation is still ongoing.
OPTA heeft deze handhavingsverzoeken in behandeling; het onderzoek van OPTA loopt nog.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over handel in .nl-domeinnamen (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether SIDN sells lists of domain names in quarantine, how quarantined .nl names are allocated, whether safeguards prevent hijacking, and whether registrar Domainorder.nl's practices are fair and transparent. The minister denied SIDN sells such lists, explained the first-come-first-served allocation and anti-abuse measures, and said the current registration system appears fair and transparent, while leaving the regulation to the self-regulating SIDN.
Based on the current registration practice explained below, I cannot conclude that the current registration is unfair or not transparent.
Op basis van de huidige registratiepraktijk die hieronder toegelicht wordt, kan ik niet concluderen dat de huidige registratie niet eerlijk zou zijn of niet transparant.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Smits (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het gat met betrekking tot BTW-berekening bij zelfstandigen d

MPs Gesthuizen and Smits asked whether a VAT gap exists for self-employed education providers, who must charge the high rate when working directly for clients, and whether workarounds like incorporating are costly. The minister replied that no gap exists: the Europe-compliant register (RKBO) applies a lighter audit to self-employed working via institutions, but direct providers must take the normal audit, after which all their education is VAT-exempt; no new measures were announced.
There is therefore no gap in the procedures, but an intended difference in treatment in the audit for the recognition register.
Er is dus geen sprake van een gat in de procedures, maar van een beoogd verschil in behandeling bij de audit van het erkenningregister.
Vragen van het lid Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Draka (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asked the economy minister whether he knew of a Nexans letter to the European Commission opposing a Chinese bid for Draka, whether Nexans contacted him, how he assessed its arguments, and whether he had contacted the Commission. The minister confirmed knowing of the letter, denied any contact from Nexans or the Commission, rejected the claims of state support and market closure as unrecognisable, and argued that open borders and foreign acquisitions are in the Dutch interest.
I do not recognise the picture that there would be financial support for Xinmao by the Chinese government or an alleged hermetic closure of the Chinese home market.
Ik herken het beeld niet dat er sprake zou zijn van financiële ondersteuning van Xinmao door de Chinese overheid en van een vermeende hermetische afsluiting van de Chinese thuismarkt.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over eventuele Chinese staatssteun bij de verkoop van Draka (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the Economy minister whether Chinese state aid might be involved in the Xinmao bid for Draka, and about the loss of technology, a skewed playing field, and whether foreign takeover rules should be tightened. The minister answered that China Minsheng Banking appears commercial, that the bid is a market matter, that foreign investment brings benefits, and that existing rules sufficiently protect public interests, while promising to monitor the takeover.
I will continue to actively follow the takeover process and keep a close eye on the interests of the Dutch economy, Dutch employees and shareholders.
Ik zal het proces van de overname actief blijven volgen en de belangen van de Nederlandse economie, van de Nederlandse werknemers en van de aandeelhouders scherp in het oog houden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van kleine biologische proefboerderijen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether Wageningen UR is closing small organic experimental farms, whether subsidies fund a 'megastal' (Dairy Valley) at Goutum, and about cows, feed transport, subsidies and whether the farms could be moved to an independent foundation. The minister answered that Wageningen UR manages its own research facilities, that the ministry funds research programmes rather than facilities, that Goutum is a research location and not a megastal, and that operations are for Wageningen UR and DLO to decide, so no independent foundation is planned.
I do not decide on the operational management of Wageningen UR.
Ik ga niet over de bedrijfsvoering van de Wageningen UR.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van kleine biologische proefboerderijen (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the Spelderholt experimental farm, partly financed by EU subsidy, may be closed early and whether the rules are being circumvented by keeping it on paper. The minister answers that the subsidy conditions (maintaining the project until 1 July 2009 and cooperating with publicity until 1 January 2010) have been met, so no repayment or rule evasion is involved.
Wageningen UR has met both conditions.
Aan beide voorwaarden heeft Wageningen UR voldaan.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het feit dat de Europese aanbesteding voor politievoertuigen slechts één

MPs Ziengs and Ten Broeke asked why a European tender for police vehicles drew only one bidder per lot, and whether clustering the contracts was desirable. The minister explained that cost savings motivated the clustering, that a market consultation showed sufficient competition, and that the government will tighten rules on clustering in the new Aanbestedingswet.
The bill for a new Public Procurement Act already contains a number of important elements that improve small businesses' access to tenders.
Het wetsvoorstel voor een nieuwe Aanbestedingswet bevat reeds een aantal belangrijke elementen die de toegang van kleine ondernemers bij aanbestedingen verbetert.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over strengere eisen aan elektrische auto’s (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the economic affairs minister whether new safety requirements for electric cars, including a high-frequency test requirement and a fee of about 725 euro, hinder innovation and are justified, and whether small firms and students could be compensated. The minister answered that the rules are new rather than stricter, were developed after a TNO/KEMA study on high-voltage wiring risks, have caused no accidents, and that the costs are proportionate.
This does not concern stricter requirements but new requirements.
Het gaat hier niet om strengere eisen maar om nieuwe eisen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat rekeningen steeds vaker niet betaald word

SP MPs asked ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that household bills are increasingly left unpaid, probing causes, effects on SMEs and financial stability, wage stagnation, and debt reduction measures. The government only sent an interim notice that the answers would be delayed until at most 15 January 2011, with no substantive answers yet.
The delay lies in the fact that the answers require interdepartmental coordination, which is taking longer than foreseen.
De vertraging is gelegen in het feit dat de antwoorden interdepartementale afstemming behoeven en deze langer dan voorzien in beslag neemt.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het CBS rapport «Critical materials in the Dutch economy» (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the CBS report on critical materials, Chinese export restrictions on rare earths, wider economic effects of shortages, EU coordination, and recycling initiatives. The minister acknowledged concerns, said there is no acute shortage yet, pointed to WTO consultations and EU resource-efficiency work, and described Dutch recycling initiatives.
I am closely monitoring the situation and developments regarding Chinese export restrictions on rare earth metals.
Ik houd de situatie en ontwikkelingen rond de Chinese exportbeperkingen op zeldzame aardmetalen nauwlettend in de gaten.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het betalingsgedrag van de overheid (ingezonden 17 september 2010).
