An MP asked ministers about EU plans to charge 8% extra interest on late payments by public bodies, the current payment performance of central and local government, what the government will do to speed up payments, and whether a faster Dutch timetable is possible. The minister supported the EU directive (30-day terms, ECB rate plus 8%, EUR 40 recovery fee), reported that 81.4% of central government invoices were paid on time, said local payment is a matter of municipal autonomy with VNG being urged to act, and said implementation would proceed promptly.
Especially for smaller claims, a stimulating effect can be expected, both on the debtor to pay and on the creditor not to passively wait after the payment term has expired.

Vooral bij kleinere vorderingen kan daarvan een stimulerend effect worden verwacht, zowel op de debiteur om te betalen als op de crediteur om niet lijdzaam af te wachten na het verstrijken van de betaaltermijn.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat technologiebedrijven uitwijken naar het buitenland (ingezonden 15 november 2010)

Mr Gesthuizen (SP) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about a report that technology firms are relocating abroad, asking for a response, R&D employment figures for key sectors, and measures to prevent high-value activity leaving. The minister said the survey does not establish a rising trend, reported R&D workforce figures for key sectors falling in line with the business sector, and outlined a forthcoming innovation and business policy with a competitiveness agenda.
In 2011 the cabinet will set out the new economic and innovation policy in a business policy memorandum.
In 2011 zal het kabinet het nieuwe economische en innovatiebeleid vastleggen in een nota bedrijfslevenbeleid.

Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat werkgevers gerichte investeringen in innovatie belangrijker vinden dan belastingverlaging voor het bedri

MP Dijksma asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares concern that employers call budget cuts to innovation policy a 'hakken om het hakken', and whether he will discuss with VNO-NCW's Wientjes trading a lower corporate tax cut for smaller innovation cuts. The minister acknowledged the report, said he sees no reason to change the coalition's mix of generic and targeted measures, and promised a broader letter on business policy in early 2011.
However, I see no reason in advance to change the choices regarding the combination of a strengthened innovation policy and a lower corporate tax.
Op voorhand zie ik echter geen aanleiding om de keuzes ten aanzien de combinatie van een versterkt innovatiebeleid en een lagere vennootschapsbelasting te wijzigen.
Vragen van het lid Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Delta stapt uit Solland Solar en boekt fors af» (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether Delta's exit from Solland Solar conflicts with the 2006 Borssele covenant, where Delta, Essent and the state each committed to investing in sustainable energy, and how that money has been spent, and asks what will be done to support the solar sector. The minister replies that the covenant names no specific projects so Delta is free to choose, that the committee assessing additional innovative projects is still working, and that the government will look at supporting solar only within the Green Deal framework without interfering in business decisions.
At this moment it is not yet possible to state what the agreed investments by Delta and Essent/ERH are being spent on, because at this stage this concerns internal company data.
Het is op dit moment nog niet mogelijk aan te geven waaraan de afgesproken investeringen van Delta en Essent/ERH worden besteed, omdat dit in deze fase nog om interne bedrijfsgegevens gaat.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het rapport «Definitieve berging van hoogradioactief en/of langlevend kernaf

An MP asked ministers whether the Boom clay layer is the only Belgian clay suitable for nuclear waste disposal, whether NIRAS should respond to objections and delay decisions, and whether Dutch stakeholders should have been informed of and able to comment on the Belgian waste plan. The minister answered that the plan is only a strategic principle decision without a specific site, that NIRAS need not respond since its concerns are included in ongoing research, that Dutch consultation was not standard practice but cross-border consultation is being arranged, and that participation would be possible in later project phases.
I will not ask NIRAS to respond because NIRAS has already indicated that the main elements of Mr Weyns' arguments have been incorporated into the current research.
Ik zal NIRAS niet verzoeken om een reactie te geven omdat NIRAS al heeft aangegeven dat de belangrijkste elementen van de argumenten van de heer Weyns meegenomen zijn in het huidige onderzoek

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over de hoge hypotheekmarges in Nederland (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from D66 asked the economics and finance ministers about high mortgage margins in the Netherlands, prompted by an NMa quick scan, asking about the cause, the timing of the full study, possible price-fixing, transparency and fiscal treatment. The minister answered that margins are high historically and relative to other countries, that the NMa's second study will examine causes, that no suspicion of price agreements exists, and that the finance minister will consult market parties on transparency.
As I answered to your earlier questions, the NMa will in the second part of its study of the Dutch mortgage market examine in depth the competitive conditions and their developments.

Zoals ik op eerdere van uw vragen heb geantwoord, zal de NMa in het tweede deel van haar onderzoek naar de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt diepgaand ingaan op de concurrentieomstandigheden en de ontwikkelingen daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de omgewaaide hoogspanningsmasten tussen Doetinchem en Ulft (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked whether the pylons toppled at Vethuizen met the new European standard, what share of Dutch pylons comply, and what replacement would cost. The minister answered that KEMA found the masts met the standards of their time and the new norm's design specifications, that extreme winds exceeded design limits, and that no replacement program exists beyond regular inspection.
The investigation showed that the toppling of the masts was caused by extreme weather conditions in which wind speeds reached between 150 and 200 km/h.
Het onderzoek heeft aangetoond dat het omwaaien van de masten is veroorzaakt door extreme weersomstandigheden waarbij windsnelheden zijn bereikt tussen de 150 en 200 km/u.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vrijstelling van Europese aanbestedingen voor Britse elektriciteitsproducenten (ingezo

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about EU procurement exemptions granted to some member states for energy markets, including whether this enables protectionism and how exemptions are reviewed. The minister answered that exemptions require competitive, open markets, that complaints can go to the Commission or the Dutch competition authority, and that a Dutch exemption request for the energy sector is forthcoming.
I expect to submit this request to the European Commission shortly.
Ik verwacht deze aanvraag op korte termijn bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.

Vraag van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het informeren van de Kamer over de aan het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) gevraagde eerste an

An MP asked the ministers whether the first PBL analysis of the coalition agreement's effects on nature, environment and energy would be sent to parliament promptly. The minister replied that the analysis had already been sent on 19 November by the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment.

Are you willing to send the first analysis of the coalition agreement requested by the cabinet from the Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency (PBL), on the effects of the agreement on nature, environment and energy, to the House as quickly as possible?

Vraag 1 Bent u bereid de eerste analyse van het regeerakkoord die door het kabinet aan het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) is gevraagd 1 over de effecten van het akkoord op natuur, milieu en energie, zo snel mogelijk naar de Kamer te sturen?
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Justitie over de berichten dat Wegener «wordt leeggezogen» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

The SP MP asked whether parent company Mecom might hollow out publisher Wegener by outsourcing its ICT activities under shareholder pressure, and what measures the government would take. The minister replied that no evidence of such conduct is known, that Dutch law lets the parent give guidance but Wegener's board remains responsible, that remedies exist via courts, works council and enquiry procedures, and that he sees no reason to contact Mecom's chief executive now.
Under Dutch law a parent company as shareholder may give guidelines and directions to the boards of subsidiaries within the group.
Naar Nederlands recht kan een moedervennootschap als aandeelhouder richtlijnen en aanwijzingen geven aan het bestuur van dochtervennootschappen binnen het concern.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de berichten dat kleine bedrijven in de autoruitherstelbranche uit de markt worden gedrukt door de grote jongens en de

An MP asks the minister for Economic Affairs how the NMa's finding that insurers may steer repair work fits with a price gap of 412 versus 250 euro for windscreen repairs, and whether small repairers are being squeezed out. The minister replies that insurers are free to choose contractors, the NMa found no dominant position or Mededingingswet violation, and exit is part of a functioning market, committing to no new action.
Insurers in principle have the freedom to decide for themselves with which repairers they contract and to which repair businesses they refer policyholders.
Verzekeraars hebben in beginsel de vrijheid om zelf te beslissen met welke schadeherstellers ze contracten sluiten en naar welke schadeherstelbedrijven zij verzekerden doorverwijzen.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het mogelijk stop zetten van medefinanciering door de overheid aan topinstituten (ingezonden 4 november

MPs Hamer and Smeets asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether four pharma/biotech Top Institutes would lose government co-financing after the FES funding ends, and whether this fits with commitments to attract knowledge-intensive activity. The minister confirmed that FES funding was a one-off impulse, that the four institutes receive a total of EUR 350 million over 2006-2014 with some continuing to 2014 and bridge funding for others, and that the life sciences sector will be addressed in a forthcoming business policy note.
It is not the case, moreover, that the funding for the four top institutes stops abruptly.
Het is overigens niet zo dat de financiering voor de vier topinstituten acuut stopt.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat vier technologische topinstituten voor farmacie en biotechnologie dreigen

MP Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether ending FES funding for the Top Institute Pharma will halt public-private pharmaceutical research and jeopardise jobs and universities. The minister answers that FES money was a one-off impulse, that TI Pharma receives a EUR 6 million bridging grant until July 2012, and that future life sciences policy will be set out in a business policy note.
It is now mainly up to the participating parties to valorise promising results from this cooperation and turn them into valuable products.
Het is nu vooral aan de deelnemende partijen om kansrijke resultaten uit deze samenwerking te valoriseren en om te zetten in waardevolle producten.
Vragen lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over bezuinigingen in de farmasector (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

MP Verhoeven (D66) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether the expected end of FES funding for the pharma Top Institute TI Pharma, and cuts to knowledge investment, are consistent with earlier commitments to strengthen innovation and the investment climate, and what concrete measures will keep the Netherlands competitive. The minister replies that FES was a one-off impulse, that existing projects continue with funds moved to departmental budgets, that TI Pharma has bridging finance to July 2012, and that a Bedrijfslevenbeleid note will follow in 2011.
The cabinet will commit across the full breadth to strengthening the knowledge economy.
Het kabinet zal zich over de volle breedte inzetten voor het versterken van de kenniseconomie.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Van Bemmel (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de kritiek van Shell op subsidies voor windmolens (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Van Bemmel asked whether the minister would respond to Shell CEO criticism of subsidies for offshore wind parks, arguing public money is being spent on them. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said offshore wind is currently more expensive per kWh than gas-fired power, called the Financieele Dagblad comparison incomplete, and promised to scrutinise the use of public money and inform the House on subsidy options.
I will inform you shortly about the options for sustainable energy that are eligible for subsidy in this cabinet period.
Ik zal u op korte termijn informeren over de opties voor duurzame energie, die in deze kabinetsperiode in aanmerking komen voor subsidie.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66), Schaart (VVD) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de ontstane onduidelijkheid over het afronden op hele belminuten door telecoma

MPs Verhoeven, Schaart and Braakhuis asked the minister about telecom providers rounding call charges up to whole minutes, and whether EU rules and national consumer choice permit this. The minister answered that EU roaming rules do not cover domestic calls, that member states may regulate billing proportionately, and that KPN and Vodafone pledged more per-second options and transparency by early 2011.
I want to give the market the chance to improve these points. I want the commitments made to be fulfilled early in 2011.
Ik wil de markt de kans geven deze punten te verbeteren. Ik wil dat de gedane toezeggingen begin 2011 ingevuld zijn.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitspraken van de Eurocommissaris over het afronden van belminuten door telecomaanbieders (ingezonden 12 november 201

An MP asks the minister whether EU rules constrain national intervention against telecom operators rounding up call minutes, and whether the telecom law must be amended. The minister says Dutch law does not prohibit such rules, that the Telecommunicatiewet imposes no per-minute billing obligations and gives OPTA no independent power to order them, and that further measures would require lower-level regulation changes.
The Telecommunications Act imposes no obligations on mobile telephony providers regarding billing method and leaves no room for OPTA to independently decide on such obligations.
De Telecommunicatiewet legt geen verplichtingen op aan aanbieders van mobiele telefonie over de afrekenmethode en laat geen ruimte voor OPTA om zelfstandig te besluiten tot dergelijke verplichtingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de plannen van gemeenten en provincies om een tweede kerncentrale in B

An MP asks the ministers whether they support six provinces and municipalities, via Energy Resources Holding, building a second nuclear plant at Borssele, including concerns about unfair competition, public funding, renewable targets, grid overcapacity and nuclear waste. The minister replies that the market decides, that the company must comply with EU competition and state aid rules, that the government supports nuclear for security of supply and CO2 reduction, that no public support is contemplated, and that geological disposal remains the long-term solution.
It is up to the initiator to consider how they want to deploy their funds.
Het is aan de initiatiefnemer om te bezien hoe zij hun middelen willen inzetten.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het niet aanbestedingsplichtig zijn van vertaaldiensten (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether the government will stop contracting out interpreting and translation services, or at least stop tenders that exclude self-employed providers, as requested by the Platform Zelfstandige Ondernemers. The minister declines to ban European tendering of these services in the new procurement law, pointing instead to proportionality rules, limits on clustering and burden-reducing measures to improve SME access.
Including a ban on European tendering of IIB services in the bill is not something I consider desirable.
Het opnemen van een verbod op het Europees aanbesteden van IIB-diensten in het wetsvoorstel vind ik niet wenselijk.

Vragen van het lid Samsom (PvdA) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onderbrengen van kernenergie b

MP Samsom asks whether moving nuclear energy law responsibilities to the Economic Affairs ministry conflicts with international nuclear safety treaties requiring separation of regulator and promoter, and whether the 1999 transfer was made for that reason. The minister answers that the reassignment is consistent with the treaties because the ministry only sets energy framework conditions, that the 1999 transfer was mainly due to reduced nuclear ambitions, and that the IAEA will review the arrangement at its April 2011 conference.
As usual, the House of Representatives will be informed of the IAEA's findings.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal de Tweede Kamer over de bevindingen van het IAEA worden geïnformeerd.
Vragen van de leden Samsom en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijkheden voor gasopslag bij Pieterburen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether EDF could obtain a permit for gas storage near Pieterburen, whether this conflicts with protection of ecological and landscape values, how long permit procedures take, and what economic effects would follow. The minister answered that only an exploration permit has been requested so far, outlined the three permit phases (exploration, extraction, storage) with objection and appeal routes, gave timelines of about two years for drilling and 6 to 12 months per permit, and cited an investment of half a billion euro and ten permanent jobs.
All the above-mentioned permits and the national coordination scheme provide for an objection and appeal phase.
Alle bovengenoemde vergunningen en de rijkscoördinatieregeling voorzien in een bezwaar- en beroepfase.

Vragen van de leden van Nieuwenhuizen en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over mogelijke windfall profits in de energie-intensieve indust

MPs Nieuwenhuizen and Neppérus asked the ministers about a Nera critique of a CE Delft study on whether energy-intensive industry gained windfall profits from free ETS allowances, and whether the government still stands by its position. The minister disagrees with Nera's critique, sees no reason to revise the position that allowance costs were passed through, and says the report does not change the Dutch stance on carbon leakage lists.
I see no reason to revise my position.
Ik zie geen reden om mijn standpunt te herzien.

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese onderhandelingen met betrekking tot aanpassingen in het systeem van emissiehandel (ingezonden 18 oktobe

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the status of EU negotiations on changes to the emissions trading system (third phase), including the Dutch position on allocating allowances for process gases. The government's reply only states that the answers cannot be given within the normal deadline and will follow as soon as possible.
The answers will be sent to you as soon as possible.
De beantwoording zal u zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangeboden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over het bericht dat de Raad van Commissarissen (RvC) van Crucell een persoonlijk

An SP MP asks ministers whether Crucell supervisory board members' share and option rewards, worth over 4.2 million euro in the Johnson & Johnson takeover, compromise their independence, why the company deviated from Code Frijns provision III.7.1, and what measures will be taken. The minister's reply only states that the answers cannot be given within three weeks because interdepartmental coordination is not finished and will follow as soon as possible.
cannot regrettably be answered within the usual three-week period because the interdepartmental coordination has not yet been completed.
kunnen helaas niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn van drie weken worden beantwoord omdat de interdepartementale afstemming nog niet is afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Justitie over de berichten dat Wegener «wordt leeggezogen» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asks the ministers of Economic Affairs and Justice how they will respond to reports that Wegener is being drained by parent company Mecom, including whether they will limit shareholder power and talk to Mecom's management. The minister only sends a holding notice saying the answers cannot be given within three weeks due to interdepartmental coordination and will follow by 11 November.
The parliamentary questions ... cannot unfortunately be answered within the usual period of 3 weeks because interdepartmental coordination has not yet been completed.
De Kamervragen ... kunnen helaas niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn van 3 weken worden beantwoord omdat de interdepartementale afstemming nog niet is afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de EU-toetredingsaanvraag van Servië en de besluitvorming daaromtrent tijdens de Raad van Buitenlandse Zaken op 25 oktober

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Belgian EU presidency would still table Serbia's EU membership application at the 25 October Council, and whether the request for a Commission opinion should be treated as a political point requiring unanimity. The minister confirmed the item is on the agenda, said the Netherlands expects consensus while the Treaty does not specify unanimity, and argued the presidency has not yet decided the voting procedure.
The cabinet considers that any further steps in Serbia's rapprochement with the European Union should be conditional on full cooperation by Serbia with the Yugoslavia tribunal.
Het kabinet meent dat eventuele verdere stappen in de toenadering van Servië tot de Europese Unie in het teken moeten staan van volledige samenwerking door Servië met het Joegoslavië-tribunaal.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister how the government would enforce a proposed freeze of top salaries at development organisation SNV by offsetting them against subsidy, whether other non-MFS development organisations also exceed the salary cap, and whether a salary ceiling would be pressed for publicly funded organisations outside MFS. The minister's reply was a postponement: research into director salaries at over 100 organisations was not yet finished, with data promised to the House by the end of the month.
Unfortunately, the research into director salaries at over 100 organisations engaged in development-related activities is not yet fully completed.
Helaas is het onderzoek naar de directiesalarissen van ruim 100 organisaties die ontwikkelingsgerelateerde activiteiten ontplooien, nog niet geheel afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingshulporganisatie SNV weigert de salarissen van haar directieleden te verlagen (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MP Driessen asked the foreign minister whether he knew of reports that aid organisation SNV refused to cut its directors' salaries, and whether he would publish salary overviews of all subsidised aid organisations and extend any measures to others. The minister replied only that the review of director salaries at over 100 organisations was not yet complete and that the data would be sent to the House by the end of the month.
Unfortunately, the review of director salaries at over 100 organisations engaged in development-related activities is not yet fully completed.
Helaas is het onderzoek naar de directiesalarissen van ruim 100 organisaties die ontwikkelingsgerelateerde activiteiten ontplooien, nog niet geheel afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over martelingen van Sri Lankaanse vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

MP Ormel asks the Foreign Minister about the reported torture of a Sri Lankan domestic worker in Saudi Arabia, the number of known rights violations against Sri Lankan migrants, the status of the Rizana Nafeek case, and whether the government will raise the matter with Saudi authorities. The minister confirms awareness, says the situation of migrant workers is raised in contacts with Saudi Arabia and that no new developments exist in the Nafeek case, and promises to keep raising human rights violations including this case.
I will continue to raise human rights violations, also in Saudi Arabia, including the case of Rizana Nafeek.
Ik zal schending van de mensenrechten aan de orde blijven stellen, ook in Saudi-Arabië, waaronder de zaak van Rizana Nafeek.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over dood Molukse activist (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

The SP MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about the death in custody of Molukan activist Yusuf Sipakoly, alleged torture by the Densus 88 unit, poor health of other political prisoners, and whether political prisoners should be released before the Indonesian president's visit. The minister responds that the circumstances are not known, that the official investigation should clarify them, that Nederland has raised prisoner health and free expression with Indonesian authorities, and declines to answer before the visit date.
The exact circumstances of his death are not known to me.
De exacte omstandigheden van zijn dood zijn mij niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over folteringen in Senegal (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how he reacted to reports of police torture going unpunished in Senegal, whether this should prompt reconsidering budget support, and for answers before a committee meeting. The minister replied that the government is concerned and will raise it in political dialogue, that Senegal denies impunity and says justice followed in all cases, and that the dialogue currently gives enough grounds to keep engaging rather than reconsidering budget support.
The Dutch government is concerned about this report and will raise this concern in the political dialogue with Senegal.
De Nederlandse regering is bezorgd over dit bericht en zal deze zorg in de politieke dialoog met Senegal aan de orde stellen.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door de Palestijnse Autoriteit bekrachtigen van de doodstraf voor de verkoop van grond aan Joden (ingezonden 22 sept

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a report that the Palestinian Authority upheld the death penalty for selling land to Jews, and whether Jordan and the Palestinian territories have restrictive laws on land sales to Jews, Israelis and Christians. The minister answered that no death sentences in the period had involved land sales, that the cited laws do not make such sales a capital offence, that Nederland opposes the death penalty in all cases, and that Jordan repealed its ban on land sales to Israelis in 1995.
The Netherlands opposes the death penalty regardless of the offence and advocates a universal moratorium.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf, ongeacht het delict, en pleit voor het instellen van een universeel moratorium.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Snijder-Hazelhoff (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over Europees landbouwgeld dat naar kernfusie gaat (ingezonden 23 septe

Two VVD MPs asked why unspent EU agricultural money would be redirected to the ITER fusion project, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. The minister answered that the Commission proposal uses a mix of sources, that the Netherlands opposes it as undermining budget discipline and will seek a solution within category 1A instead.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de veroordeling van Israël door de VN Mensenrechtenraad (ingezonden 24 september 2010)

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council is biased against Israel after its condemnation over the Gaza flotilla raid, and whether Israel may reject the findings. The minister answers that the Council is a political body with some objectivity limits, that Israel's own and UN inquiries are still running, and that the government will make its final assessment once all reports are published.
The government intends to make its final assessment once all investigations have been published.
De regering is voornemens haar finale afweging te maken zodra alle onderzoeken zijn gepubliceerd.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verkrachtingen van vredesactivistes door Palestijnen in Judea en Samaria (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether female peace activists in Judea and Samaria are systematically raped or harassed by Palestinians, whether this is concealed, and whether investigation is warranted. The minister answered that combating sexual violence against women is a Dutch policy pillar, that no information on the phenomenon or Dutch victims is known, and that no reason for further investigation is seen.
I have no information about the phenomenon you describe, nor about possible Dutch victims.
Mij is geen informatie bekend over het fenomeen dat u beschrijft, ook niet over mogelijke Nederlandse slachtoffers.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over dreigende raketaanvallen door Hezbollah op Israël (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Hezbollah preparing rocket attacks on Israel, alleged Iranian involvement, UN resolution 1701 compliance, UNIFIL's limited search powers in private homes, and whether the Netherlands would push for disarmament and a broader mandate. The minister said the reports could not be independently verified, outlined the UN framework and UNIFIL's existing mandate, and stated the Netherlands supports the Lebanese government's disarmament efforts without committing to new concrete steps.
Because these reports could not be verified by independent sources, I cannot provide further information on their accuracy or background.
Vanwege het feit dat deze niet verifieerbaar zijn gebleken door onafhankelijke bronnen, kan ik geen nadere informatie verstrekken omtrent de juistheid en achtergronden ervan.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie van Assyrische christenen in het Noorden van Irak (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of unfair trials and abuse by Kurdish authorities against Assyrian Christians and other minorities in northern Iraq, including the torture case of Robert Aowyamlik. The minister said the Netherlands and the EU raise fair trial and anti-torture issues bilaterally and through the EUJUST LEX mission, and will raise the Aowyamlik case if the opportunity arises.
If the opportunity arises, the case of Mr. Aowyamlik will be raised.
Indien de gelegenheid zich voordoet zal de zaak van dhr. Aowyamlik worden opgebracht.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de nettobijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese Unie (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

The SP MP Van Bommel asks whether the Netherlands is among the largest net EU contributors and whether a lower contribution would be compensated by new EU own resources such as European taxes. The minister confirms the Netherlands is among the top three net payers as a share of GNI, that alternative accounting puts it first, and that the government opposes EU taxes, favouring a GNI-based financing.
The cabinet argues that in the EU the strongest member states should bear the heaviest burdens.
Het kabinet pleit ervoor dat in de EU de sterkste lidstaten de zwaarste lasten dragen

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Hulp dekmantel voor terreur» (ingezonden 13 sept

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Interior and Foreign Affairs about the EU terrorist listing of Al-Aqsa, the Dutch decision to withdraw its national sanctions regime, and measures against fundraising for Hamas-linked groups. The government explained the withdrawal for regulatory consistency, noted the court ruling against the EU listing, said the national procedure was adapted in April 2010, and described existing anti-terror-financing measures while declining to report on ongoing investigations.
No statements are made about investigations carried out in this area, in the interest of those investigations.
Over onderzoeken die op dit vlak worden gedaan, worden in het belang van deze onderzoeken geen mededelingen gedaan.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een informatief bericht voor diplomaten over de deelname aan coalitie(-onderhandelingen) door de PVV (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister which embassies received an information note on the coalition formation involving the PVV, and whether further notes or instructions were sent. The minister answered that the note went to embassies in Africa, Asia, the Americas and Europe, that it was the only such note, and that no embassy requested further information before publication of the draft coalition agreement.
The note in question was sent to embassies in Africa (including Cairo), Asia (including Jakarta and Kabul), the Americas (including Washington) and Europe (including Brussels).
Het betreffende bericht is gezonden aan ambassades in Afrika (waaronder Cairo), Azie (waaronder Jakarta en Kaboel), Amerika (waaronder Washington) en Europa (waaronder Brussel).
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitlatingen richting ambassadeur Habibie van Indonesië (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

MP Pechtold asked the Foreign Minister whether he would distance himself from Wilders' remarks toward Indonesian ambassador Habibie and what concrete steps would secure the state visit. The minister said Wilders' statements are his own responsibility and that both governments cooperated closely on the visit preparations.
The statements by Mr Wilders as reported in the Telegraaf are for Mr Wilders' own account.
De uitspraken van de heer Wilders zoals deze in de Telegraaf zijn weergegeven komen voor rekening van de heer Wilders zelf.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «President Indonesië stelt bezoek aan Nederland uit» (ingezonden 6 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether there was consultation before Indonesia's president postponed his state visit, and what the reasons were and whether the visit could still go ahead. The minister confirmed prior consultation and reported the president's letter citing a Dutch court case seeking his arrest, expressing regret but trusting continued good relations.
In light of this, it was decided to postpone the visit.
In dit licht is besloten om het bezoek uit te stellen.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het optreden van de Verenigde Naties in Congo (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister how the Congolese government is held to account for protecting civilians, whether MONUSCO's mandate and the ISSSS strategy are adequate, how Dutch oversight works, and what security-sector reform criteria apply. The minister answered that Nederland raises protection issues bilaterally and multilaterally, that MONUSCO's mandate is robust but not fully used, and that Nederland monitors the ISSSS through its own staff and an independent evaluation.
The Netherlands regularly discusses these issues in bilateral contacts with the Congolese authorities.
Nederland bespreekt deze kwesties regelmatig in de bilaterale contacten met de Congolese autoriteiten
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de kosten van een verblijfsvergunning voor Nederlanders in Turkije (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister why Dutch nationals in Turkey pay much higher residence-permit fees than nationals of other EU states such as Belgium and Germany, and whether Turkey should be pressed to treat EU citizens equally. The minister confirmed the fee differences are based on reciprocity, said the appeal against the Rotterdam court ruling is pending, and said the Netherlands is in talks with Turkish authorities about the fees Turkey levies.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over jaarlijkse verlofreizen van ambassadepersoneel (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the cost of annual home-leave flights for diplomatic staff and families, including business-class tickets outside Europe. The minister confirmed about 3.5 million euro per year, said business class accounts for roughly 90% of leave costs, and estimated economy class would save 25-30%, but noted the arrangement is a secondary employment condition agreed with unions.
Any adjustment of this would therefore require agreement with the trade unions.
Een eventuele bijstelling hiervan vereist daarom overeenstemming met de vakbonden.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de schandelijke uitlatingen van de Indonesische ambassadeur over PVV-leider Geert Wilders en de Nederlandse kiezers die

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the foreign minister whether he would summon the Indonesian ambassador over remarks calling Wilders incompetent and his voters psychologically afflicted, and whether the ambassador spoke for his government. The minister said the ambassador spoke freely but had been told the remarks about PVV voters were unwise, that he retracted them, and that he would not summon him.
However, I did not think it wise of the ambassador to express himself in the terms he used about PVV voters.
Ik vond het evenwel niet verstandig van de ambassadeur zich in de termen zoals hij die heeft gebruikt uit te laten over de kiezers van de PVV.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over problemen met Nederlandse ontwikkelingshulp in Afghanistan (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister about a Dutch aid official's interview alleging that Afghans tell the Taliban that Dutch-funded projects are paid by Islamic donors, and whether aid money disappears through corruption, and asks for an immediate halt to aid except emergency relief. The minister replies that Dutch funds mostly flow through international institutions under strict controls and monitoring, that the population knows the projects are Dutch-funded, and that he sees no reason to stop aid.
The largest part of Dutch money flows through funds managed by international institutions such as the World Bank.
Het grootste deel van het Nederlandse geld loopt via fondsen die beheerd worden door internationale instellingen als de Wereldbank.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het optreden van de Verenigde Naties in Congo (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about UN peacekeepers' response to systematic rape by armed groups in eastern Congo, including sanctions, ICC referral, the UN's failure to react to warnings, communications gaps, and whether Congolese forces can protect civilians. The minister answered that perpetrators should be prosecuted, supports added targeted sanctions, notes existing UN measures and ICC investigations, reports the UN's internal review and reinforcements, and says MONUSCO lacks the capacity to protect all civilians everywhere.
In his report to the Security Council on 7 September, Khare openly admitted that the UN had fallen short in protecting civilians in the area.
In zijn verslaglegging aan de Veiligheidsraad van 7 september jl. gaf Khare ruiterlijk toe dat de VN tekort zijn geschoten bij de bescherming van de burgers in het gebied.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de Europese export van afgekeurde voedi

An MP asked ministers whether the EU exports rejected food and banned chemicals such as DDT to Africa, and how export of non-compliant fish and expired food is controlled. The government answered that DDT export is banned under EU rules (transit possible, WHO-sanctioned malaria use), that prior-consent procedures apply to restricted chemicals, and that non-compliant Dutch fish must be destroyed and the VWA supervises, while offering no new commitments.
No. DDT is a substance listed under the Stockholm Convention on persistent organic pollutants, and European regulation prohibits exporting DDT from Europe.
Nee. DDT is een stof die op de lijst staat van het Verdrag van Stockholm inzake persistente organische verontreinigende stoffen en Europese regelgeving verbiedt het om DDT uit Europa te exporteren.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de weigering door Kenia om de Soedanese president Al-Bashir op te pakken (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

MPs Peters and Irrgang asked why Kenya hosted Sudanese president Al-Bashir despite an ICC arrest warrant, whether the Netherlands pressed Kenya, and whether it will protest when Al-Bashir visits other ICC states. The minister says Nederland and the EU have strongly urged Kenya to comply, summoned Kenyan ambassadors, and will press for a united EU reaction to future visits, but gives no account of Kenya's own reasoning beyond what Kenya stated.
The Netherlands did this on 2 September.
Nederland heeft dit op 2 september jl. gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over de Soedanese president Omar al-Bashir (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers how the government responded when Sudanese president Al-Bashir visited Kenya and Chad despite ICC arrest warrants, and what it will do to ensure compliance with the Rome Statute. The minister answered that the Netherlands pressed for EU statements, demarches and diplomatic protest, instructed its ambassador to avoid an official lunch, and will keep pushing Kenya and the EU for consistent action.
The Netherlands consistently works within the EU to achieve a united and consistent EU policy.
Nederland zet zich in EU-verband voortdurend in om te komen tot een eengezind en consequent EU-beleid.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over ontwikkelingen in Kashmir (ingezonden 8 september 2010).

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about unrest in Kashmir, alleged Indian rights abuses, UN observer interference, dialogue, independent investigation of complaints, Gilgit-Baltistan democracy and Chinese infrastructure involvement. The minister answered that the situation is noted, could not confirm UN interference, that the international community urges dialogue, that India should investigate abuses thoroughly, and that Pakistan's constitutional reforms have not given Gilgit-Baltistan federal representation.
I am aware of the recently increased unrest in Kashmir.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de recent toegenomen onrust in Kasjmir.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de her-islamisering van de Turkse publieke sector (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Turkish constitutional referendum of September 2010 and the Erdogan government's plans signal Islamisation of the Turkish state and whether Turkey should ever join the EU. The minister welcomed the reforms as bringing Turkey closer to EU standards, said the Netherlands will monitor implementation, and restated the government's position that accession depends on Turkey meeting all conditions.
The Netherlands will therefore closely monitor how the Turkish government implements the constitutional amendments.
Nederland zal daarom nauwlettend volgen op welke wijze de Turkse regering uitvoering geeft aan de grondwetswijzigingen.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een werkbezoek van Israëlische burgemeesters (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the government or the VNG objected to a study visit by Israeli mayors from settlements and whether the government legitimises their office. The minister answered that the government does not maintain contacts with settlement authorities, considers the settlements illegal under international law, but does not prevent other organisations such as the VNG from deciding independently on contacts.
However, this does not mean that the government prevents others from maintaining contacts with them.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de regering anderen verhindert om contacten met hen te onderhouden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ormel (CDA) en Nicolaï (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het weigeren van een delegatie burgemeesters uit Israël (ingezonden 21 septemb

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch embassy advised the VNG against receiving Israeli mayors from West Bank settlements, on what international-law grounds, and what the government would do about the diplomatic fallout. The minister denied the embassy issued a formal negative advice, said the government avoids legitimising settlements but does not prevent others from contacting them, and described the VNG as an autonomous body free to decide.
The VNG is free to decide independently with whom it wishes to have contacts.
Het staat de VNG vrij zelfstandig te beslissen met wie het contacten wil aangaan.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de instructie voor diplomaten over deelname aan coalitie(-onderhandelingen) door de PVV (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister whether a leaked NRC memo instructing diplomats on PVV participation in coalition talks was authentic, whether the minister had a role in it, and how it squares with the three negotiators' refusal to clarify the cabinet's status. The minister replied that the memo was an informative message sent to a small group of embassies, not an instruction, that he approved it before sending, and that he would not anticipate the outcome of the ongoing coalition talks.
There is no question of an instruction to the Dutch posts abroad.
Er is geen sprake van een instructie aan de Nederlandse posten in het buitenland.
Vragen van de leden Peters en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Advies over PVV voor diplomaten» (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister whether a report that diplomats had been advised on how to handle the PVV was accurate. The minister answered that there was no instruction to embassies, only an informative message to a small group of posts about the coalition formation process, usable on a passive basis.
There is no question of an instruction to the Dutch posts abroad.
Er is geen sprake van een instructie aan de Nederlandse posten in het buitenland.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de recente massale verkrachtingen van vrouwen in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about mass rapes of women in Walikale, eastern Congo, whether such attacks are unusual, who is responsible, what Dutch-funded aid reaches victims, mining control, MONUC's response and whether further investigation is needed. The minister answered that the scale is exceptional, attributed the attacks to the FDLR and May-May militia on UN findings, described Dutch-funded aid and MONUSCO's limits, and said the UN Secretary-General sent an assistant secretary-general to investigate the response.

Given the seriousness of the situation, the UN Secretary-General sent the head of the UN Department of Peacekeeping Operations, Atul Khare, to the DRC to investigate further how the UN mission in the field responded to the events.

Gezien de ernst van de situatie heeft de secretaris-generaal van de VN het hoofd van het Departement voor Vredesoperaties van de VN, Atul Khare, naar de DRC gestuurd om verder onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de VN-missie in het veld op de gebeurtenissen heeft gereageerd.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de betrokkenheid van Advanta en Bejo Zaden bij kinderarbeid in India (ingezonden 21 j

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked ministers about child labour in Indian vegetable and cotton seed production linked to Dutch firms Advanta and Bejo Zaden, and whether the government would condemn them, act on subsidies, raise the issue bilaterally and in the EU-India trade deal, and investigate the sector. The ministers answered that they expect firms to follow OECD guidelines, that Bejo is taking dialogue and remedial steps and Advanta's Dutch arm does not source from India, and that they see no need for sector-wide agreements or a separate investigation, while committing to raise the issue bilaterally where useful and to pursue human rights provisions in the EU-India agreement.
In our view both companies are using the opportunities they have to contribute to eliminating child labour in their supply chain.
Naar onze mening benutten beide bedrijven de mogelijkheden die zij hebben om bij te dragen aan de uitbanning van kinderarbeid in hun keten.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ontwikkelingshulp door decentrale overheden (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether Dutch municipalities, provinces and water boards spend money on development aid and whether central government will hold them to account for it. The government answered that no systematic data on local development aid spending is kept, pointed to a 2009 VNG survey, and stated that local authorities are autonomous and accountable to their councils, with no plan to intervene.
Neither central government nor national or umbrella organisations systematically keep information on spending on development cooperation by municipalities, provinces and water boards.

Door de rijksoverheid noch door landelijke- of koepelorganisaties wordt op systematische wijze informatie bijgehouden over uitgaven voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking door gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ABN AMRO een cacaodeal mede financiert (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether ABN AMRO co-financed a purchase of 240,000 tonnes of cocoa, and what its effects on cocoa markets and farmers would be. The ministers answered that ABN AMRO acted only as a broker within normal exchange rules, that the purchase does not affect farmers' incomes in the short term, and that speculation falls outside the development policy aimed at structural improvement.
ABN AMRO acted in line with the applicable laws and regulations of the futures market.
ABN AMRO heeft in lijn met de geldende wet- en regelgeving van de termijnmarkt gehandeld.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over beweringen dat Turkije chemische wapens heeft ingezet tegen Koerdische opstandelingen (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey used chemical weapons against Kurdish fighters, including a claimed Hamburg forensic finding and whether autopsy results are kept secret. The minister denied the forensic institute confirmed chemical weapons use, said autopsy reports are available to next of kin, and said there is no reason to believe Turkey possesses or used such weapons, promising to raise doubts under the Chemical Weapons Convention if information emerges.

Should information come to Netherlands' attention that raises doubts about Turkey's compliance with the Chemical Weapons Convention, clarification will be requested in accordance with the treaty's provisions.

Mocht aan Nederland informatie bekend worden die twijfel doet rijzen over naleving van het Chemische wapensverdrag door Turkije dan zal om opheldering worden gevraagd conform de bepalingen van het verdrag.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over het explosief gestegen aantal aanvallen op kerken in Indonesië en het ontbreken van overheidsoptreden daartegen (ingezonden 28 juli 2010

The SGP MP asks the foreign minister about a reported sharp rise in attacks on churches in Indonesia and the government's response, citing criticism from the Setara human rights institute. The minister acknowledges the rising number of incidents, mostly administrative closures and permit refusals linked to local pressure, says the Netherlands raises religious freedom with Indonesia and the EU, but offers no concrete new measures.
You can rest assured that in my contacts with the Indonesian government I will continue to draw attention to the importance of freedom of religion.
U kunt ervan op aan dat ik in mijn contacten met de Indonesische overheid aandacht zal blijven vragen voor het belang van godsdienstvrijheid.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over kanker en kindersterfte in Fallujah (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the government accepts a University of Ulster study linking the 2004 assault on Fallujah to elevated child mortality, birth defects and cancer, and whether it will press the US for disclosure of weapons used and support a ban on depleted uranium weapons. The minister says the study does not establish that depleted uranium causes the health effects, that the government still supports further objective research, and that it sees no reason to change its position or seek a ban.
I see no reason to endorse the conclusions of the Busby et al report.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de conclusies van het rapport van Busby et al te onderschrijven.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanstaande voorstellen van eurocommissaris Lewandowski voor de invoering van Europese belastingen (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the European Commission plans Europe-wide taxes following remarks by Commissioner Lewandowski, and whether the government will stop such proposals. The minister replied that no official Commission proposal exists yet, that taxation is a member-state competence limited by the treaties, and that the Netherlands opposes an EU tax and will keep stating this position.
Taxation is a sovereign competence of the member states of the European Union.
Belastingheffing is een soevereine bevoegdheid van de lidstaten van de Europese Unie.
Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulp aan de ramp in Pakistan (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

An MP from the Labour party asked the Foreign Minister about the UN flood relief appeal for Pakistan, whether more EU and Dutch aid was needed, whether the government would add funds beyond the EUR 1 million already pledged, and whether it consulted NGOs and EU partners. The minister confirmed the UN appeal, announced additional Dutch funding of EUR 2 million via WFP plus EUR 3.6 million via WFP and UNICEF, and described ongoing coordination with NGOs and the EU.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Turkije mogelijk chemische wapens inzet tegen de PKK (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Turkey may have used chemical weapons against PKK fighters, how he assessed Turkey's denial, and whether he would raise the issue with Turkey or at the OPCW, UN, NATO or EU to press for an independent investigation. The minister answered that Turkey confirms it possesses no chemical weapons, that the cited clinic issued a correction saying it did not confirm chemical weapons caused the deaths, and that the Netherlands sees no reason to suspect Turkey and therefore no reason to raise the matter in multilateral bodies.
On the basis of the information in the cited report, the Netherlands sees no reason to suspect Turkey of using or possessing chemical weapons.
Nederland ziet op basis van de informatie in het aangehaalde bericht geen aanleiding om Turkije te verdenken van het gebruik of het bezit van chemische wapens.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over noodhulp aan Pakistan (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

MP Driessen (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether 367 million euro of 2005 earthquake aid to Pakistan reached victims, whether every cent of current flood aid will reach victims, and whether aid controls will be tightened. The minister said the cited funds went to government reconstruction projects that cannot be verified, that flood aid goes via UN, Red Cross and NGOs reporting to the ministry, and that existing controls are sufficient.
The Netherlands cannot verify what happened to donations from other donors and aid organisations.
Nederland kan niet verifiëren wat er met donaties van andere donoren en hulporganisaties gebeurd is.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulp bij de ramp in Pakistan (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister about the use of the UN Central Emergency Response Fund for flood victims in Pakistan, including whether NGOs can access it directly. The minister answered that the fund is legally limited to UN agencies and IOM, that NGOs are involved indirectly through them, and that procedures and evaluation have been strengthened.
The resolution (46/182 of 19 December 1991) establishing the CERF only allows funding of UN organisations and entities (read IOM).
De resolutie (46/182 d.d. 19 december 1991) waarmee het CERF werd opgericht staat alleen financiering van VN-organisaties en entiteiten (lees IOM) toe.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aangekondigde executie door steniging of ophanging van mevrouw Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani onder de verantwoordelijkhe

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how the government judges the legal process and stoning sentence of Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani in Iran, and what it will do to prevent her execution. The minister answered that she appears to have had no fair trial, that the EU and the Netherlands have protested and called for a moratorium, but that Dutch diplomats cannot visit prisoners and the government does not investigate individual cases.
Information about and access to Iranian detainees is only provided to immediate family, so visiting Ms Ashtiani is not possible for foreign diplomats.
Informatie over en toegang tot Iraanse gedetineerden wordt alleen verstrekt aan directe familie en het bezoeken van mevrouw Ashtiani is derhalve niet mogelijk voor buitenlandse diplomaten.

Vragen van de leden Driessen, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat christelijke slachtoffers van de overstromingen in Pakistan met betrekking tot de hulpverlening

Three PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christian flood victims in Pakistan are denied water, food and aid in favour of Muslims. The minister answered that no signals of partiality had been received, that humanitarian principles require aid regardless of religion, and that he trusts these principles are applied in practice.
No signals have been received from humanitarian aid organisations, the Dutch embassy or other parties indicating partiality in humanitarian aid.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen van humanitaire hulporganisaties, van de Nederlandse ambassade of andere betrokkenen die duiden op partijdigheid bij de humanitaire hulpverlening.
Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de voorgenomen steniging van een Iraanse vrouw (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew of the planned stoning of Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani, whether the court documents are public, whether he agrees stoning fits a wider pattern of Iranian rights abuses, and whether the EU would act to prevent it. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Dutch government and EU repeatedly press Iran on the death penalty and have raised the case, and noted the Iranian authorities disagree on the stated charge.
The Dutch government emphasises at every possible opportunity the right of everyone to a fair and transparent trial.
De Nederlandse regering benadrukt bij elke mogelijke gelegenheid het recht van een ieder op een eerlijk en transparant proces.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over noodhulpverlening door een terroristische organisatie in Pakistan (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked whether the government knew of emergency aid in Pakistan channelled through the militant group Jamaat e Dawa, condemned a hateful remark by one of its aid workers, and asked for a guarantee that no Dutch relief reaches such groups. Minister Verhagen confirmed awareness, condemned the remark as contrary to humanitarian principles, and said Dutch aid flows only via established humanitarian organisations (Red Cross, WFP, UNICEF, SHO) that uphold neutrality.
The Dutch government supports the flood victims through the International Red Cross, the World Food Programme, UNICEF and the Cooperating Relief Organisations (SHO).
De Nederlandse regering geeft steun aan de overstromingsslachtoffers via het Internationale Rode Kruis, het Wereldvoedselprogramma, UNICEF en de Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO).

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister how a proposed SNV salary freeze and offset against subsidy would be implemented, whether other non-MFS development organisations pay above the salary cap, and whether a ceiling could be pressed for. The minister replied that a survey of over 100 subsidised organisations is underway, with results to be sent to the House by end of September, and gave no concrete implementation details.
The overview will be sent to the House by the end of September at the latest, listing the names of the organisations and their associated salaries.
De ontvangen gegevens zullen uiterlijk eind september aan de Kamer worden aangeboden in de vorm van een overzicht waarin de naam van de organisaties en de bijbehorende salarissen staan vermeld.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingshulporganisatie SNV weigert de salarissen van haar directieleden te verlagen (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew that aid organisation SNV refuses to cut its directors' salaries, and whether he would publish salary overviews for all subsidised development organisations and extend any measures against SNV to them. The minister answered that a survey of about 100 subsidised organisations is under way, with results to be sent to parliament by the end of September.
The data received will be submitted to the House by the end of September at the latest, in the form of an overview listing the names of the organisations and their corresponding salaries.
De ontvangen gegevens zullen uiterlijk eind september aan de Kamer worden aangeboden in de vorm van een overzicht waarin de naam van de organisaties en de bijbehorende salarissen staan vermeld.
Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie in Iran van de Nederlands-Iraanse Zahra Bahrami (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the arrest in Iran of dual Dutch-Iranian national Zahra Bahrami, her charges, consular access, legal assistance and risk of the death penalty. The minister answered that Iran refuses to recognise her Dutch nationality, denies consular access, and that Dutch diplomats have repeatedly protested and urged a fair trial and access to a lawyer, while pledging to act against any execution.
The Iranian Ministry also indicated that it does not permit the embassy to provide consular assistance.
Het Iraanse Ministerie liet eveneens weten dat het de ambassade niet toestaat consulaire bijstand te verlenen.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse vrouw die sinds eind 2009 gevangen zit in Iran (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister what crimes a Dutch-Iranian woman detained in Iran since late 2009 is suspected of, whether consular access, a fair trial and legal support are being pursued, and whether the EU will press Iran. The minister answered that Iran refuses to confirm charges, trial date or consular access, treats her only as Iranian, and that the Netherlands is pressing for a fair trial and an EU demarche is being prepared.
In practical terms, however, this non-cooperative attitude of the Iranian authorities means that at this moment I have no formal confirmation of the reasons for the arrest of the person concerned
In praktische zin betekent deze non-coöperatieve houding van de Iraanse autoriteiten echter op dit moment dat ik geen formele bevestiging heb van de redenen van de arrestatie van betrokkene
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat er een Nederlandse vrouw vastzit in Iran (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

MP Pechtold asked the Foreign Minister how he would respond to reports that a Dutch-Iranian woman has been held in Iran since late last year on suspicion of state-endangering activities, and what concrete steps he would take. The minister answered that the ministry verified her Dutch nationality only in late July, has sent diplomatic notes and made demarches, but Iran refuses consular access and treats her as Iranian, so no formal charges or trial date have been confirmed.
After establishing the identity and Dutch nationality of the person concerned, the Dutch Embassy in Tehran sent a diplomatic note to the Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Na vaststelling van de identiteit en Nederlandse nationaliteit van betrokkene is door de Nederlandse Ambassade in Teheran een diplomatieke nota aan het Iraanse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gestuurd

Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidie voor een WK-persreis (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

Two SP MPs asked why the NCDO subsidised a De Pers special on Africa during the 2010 World Cup, questioning its journalistic independence, whether columnists and editors were funded, and whether such grants are wasteful. The minister answered that the €44,300 grant covered reporting and editing costs, that the paper disclosed NCDO funding, that the grant met NCDO criteria, and that journalistic grants remain possible under new policy from 2011.
The special sections of the newspaper state that they are made possible by a financial contribution from the NCDO.
Op de speciale secties van de krant is vermeld dat deze mogelijk is dankzij een financiële bijdrage van de NCDO.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over schending van het Venezolaanse luchtruim door een Nederlands vliegtuig (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister whether Venezuela complained about a Dutch aircraft violating its airspace, whether a defence spokesperson dismissed the complaint as nonsense, what the diplomatic response was, which Dutch aircraft operate near Venezuela, and whether US aircraft were involved. The minister answered that the complaint concerned the Maiquetiá flight information region rather than airspace, that the claim was rejected, that dialogue was agreed, and that the helicopter operated partly in international airspace.
Specifically regarding the FIR, technical consultations will be held in the short term to prevent misunderstandings in the future.
Specifiek ten aanzien van de FIR zal op korte termijn technisch overleg worden gevoerd om misverstanden in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aan Haïti toegezegde hulpgelden na de aardbevingen in januari 2010 (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the status of Dutch emergency and reconstruction aid for Haiti after the January 2010 earthquakes, including where the 83 million euro raised through the SHO public campaign stands, and how aid absorption concerns relate to delays. The minister answered that 12 million euro emergency aid has been transferred to SHO, 29.7 million euro for reconstruction will follow from 2011, and that Court of Audit review happens ex post and does not delay spending.
The audit by the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) takes place not in advance but afterwards.
De controle door de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) vindt niet vooraf maar achteraf plaats.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat slechts 2 procent van de toegezegde hulp Haïti heeft bereikt (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked whether only 2 percent of pledged aid to Haiti had reached the country and where Dutch aid funds were, and whether they would be spent properly or returned. Minister Verhagen answered that the 2 percent figure referred to donor disbursements to the World Bank reconstruction fund, that Dutch emergency aid had been transferred to aid organisations which are funding projects, and that reconstruction funds will be disbursed from 2011 under agreed arrangements monitored by the government.
Agreements have been made with the aforementioned aid organisations on the proper use of the pledged aid.
Over de juiste besteding van de toegezegde hulp zijn afspraken gemaakt met de voornoemde hulporganisaties.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de bewapening van lokale milities in Afghanistan (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MPs Van Dam and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about NATO-backed plans to arm local militias in Afghanistan, including risks of renewed tribal violence, whether the arrangement is truly temporary, and who pays. Minister Verhagen answered that the Netherlands was informed and consulted, that the plan was renamed local police under Afghan Interior Ministry command with vetting and a three-week training, and that the US will fund it.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the further formal elaboration of this plan.
Nederland zal de verdere formele uitwerking van dit plan voorts nauwlettend in de gaten blijven houden.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over toegezegde gelden voor Haïti (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether less than 2 percent of the nearly 8 billion euro pledged for Haiti's reconstruction has been paid out, whether only a few countries have fulfilled their pledges, and whether Dutch commitments have been met. The minister replies that about 506 million dollars has been disbursed, that five donors have paid into the World Bank fund, that Dutch relief funds have been transferred to aid organisations and reconstruction funds are earmarked for 2011 onward, and that EU-level figures are not available to him.
I do not have the data of the individual member states.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens van de individuele lidstaten.

Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de militaire opbouw in Zuid-Libanon, van de met Iran samenspannende islamitische terreur- en jihadbeweging Hezbo

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Hezbollah's military buildup in southern Lebanon, alleged arms stockpiles, and whether the arms embargo and UNIFIL had failed under Resolution 1701. The minister answered that concern exists, that UNIFIL has no mandate to verify Hezbollah's capacity, that the embargo did not fail, and that disarmament must be pursued through the Lebanese political process.
The UN has no mandate to verify the exact capacity itself.
De VN heeft geen mandaat om de exacte capaciteit zelf te kunnen verifiëren.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de EU haar hulp aan Afghanistan bevriest (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether he agreed that corruption in Afghanistan is rampant and whether he would suspend aid as the EU reportedly did. The minister acknowledged corruption as a serious problem, cited Karzai's announced anti-corruption measures, and said the EU is not suspending aid but has postponed adopting its 2011-2013 programme until after the Kabul conference.
The European Union is not suspending development aid to Afghanistan.
De Europese Unie schort de ontwikkelingshulp aan Afghanistan niet op.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over EU-hulp aan Afghanistan opgeschort (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU suspension of 600 million euro in Afghan aid, its view on demanding anti-corruption measures before Dutch aid resumes, and whether the peace jirga statement should also require renouncing violence against foreign troops. Minister Verhagen replied that the EU did not suspend aid but postponed the 2011–2013 programme until after the Kabul conference, that Dutch programmes continue with monitoring against corruption, and that renouncing violence against foreign forces is already emphasised in Dutch and EU messaging.
The European Union is not suspending development aid to Afghanistan.
De Europese Unie schort de ontwikkelingshulp aan Afghanistan niet op.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de conferentie over internetvrijheid in Parijs van 8 juli 2010 (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the outcomes of the July 2010 internet freedom expert meeting in Paris, progress on an EU censorship-export code, the EU Global Online Freedom Act motion, the planned follow-up conference, and funding for Iranian and Burmese internet/media freedom. The minister answered that existing initiatives should be used more effectively, that the EU export restriction awaits technical research, that a European GOFA is not feasible, and that funds were granted to the listed projects.
The Netherlands organised with France on 8 July an expert meeting on internet freedom, in preparation for establishing a so-called Leading Group in this area.
