Nederland heeft met Frankrijk op 8 juli een expertbijeenkomst over internetvrijheid georganiseerd, ter voorbereiding op de oprichting van een zogenoemde Leading Group op dit gebied.
Vragen van het lid Ten Broeke aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het EU-onderzoek «Two Apples a day keeps the doctor away» (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether EU funding of the ISAFRUIT apple study (13.79 million euro), which largely confirmed that eating two apples daily lowers cholesterol, was a poor use of money and how it serves European competitiveness and EU credibility. The minister defended the broad project's wider results and competitiveness value, and declined to list EU-funded studies with a promotional aim, saying ISAFRUIT had no promotional purpose.
This is also not the aim of the Framework Programmes for research and technological development.
Dit is ook niet de insteek van de Kaderprogramma's voor onderzoek en technologische ontwikkeling.
Vragen van de leden Driessen en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het intrekken van alle ontwikkelingshulp aan Suriname (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Driessen and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of Bouterse's election as Surinamese president and whether all development aid to Suriname will be halted immediately. The minister confirms he is aware and declines to stop aid, saying the new government will be judged on its actions and existing commitments will be honoured unless circumstances make this impossible.
The Netherlands will continue to pursue a businesslike and engaged relationship with Suriname.
Nederland blijft een zakelijke en betrokken relatie met Suriname nastreven.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders en Driessen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de islamitische jihad tegen christenen in de Islamitische Republiek Pakistan (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

MPs Kortenoeven, Wilders and Driessen asked the foreign minister about killings of Christians in Pakistan, whether the violence is systematic, Pakistan's blasphemy laws, whether Pakistan should sit on the UN Human Rights Council, and whether aid should be halted. The minister denied systematic persecution, described the government's diplomatic efforts and the blasphemy laws, and refused to end development aid.

The Netherlands, in consultation with other EU countries, expressed its concern to the Pakistani government about violence against Christians and other religious minorities after previous incidents and called for the perpetrators to be prosecuted.

Nederland heeft, in samenspraak met andere landen van de EU, na voorgaande incidenten de Pakistaanse overheid zijn zorgen over het geweld tegen christenen en andere religieuze minderheden kenbaar gemaakt en opgeroepen de daders te vervolgen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestatie in Italië van Nederlander van Turks-Koerdische komaf (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Italy of a Dutch national of Turkish-Kurdish origin, whether the Italian authorities gave reasons, whether legal aid was offered, and his political role in Turkey and Europe. The minister answered that Italy acted on an Ankara arrest warrant, that consular rather than legal aid was provided with a consular visit, that the Dutch government does not interfere in foreign legal proceedings, and that Turkish Kurdish rights are raised bilaterally and within the EU.
The Dutch government does not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
De Nederlandse regering treedt niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Van Vliet (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over het Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde Korps (IRGC) (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the role of Iran's Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) in Iran's nuclear programme, whether it should be listed as terrorist, and whether Dutch firms' ties to it should be investigated. The minister said Nederland is concerned about the IRGC, that IRGC elements were included in UN and EU sanctions, and that export transactions to Iran already get extra scrutiny via licensing, without committing to a separate investigation of Dutch business ties.
Where necessary, under the applicable sanctions policy towards Iran, export transactions are already subjected to further examination.
Waar nodig worden, in het kader van het geldende sanctiebeleid jegens Iran, uitvoertransacties reeds onderworpen aan nader onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand (PvdD), El Fassed en Peters (beiden Groen Links) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de rechtmatigheid van het proces t

MPs asked the government how it followed the trial of two Greenpeace activists in Japan, whether it would press Japan on fair process, and why it judged no breach of international treaties, despite UN criticism. The minister replied that the embassy follows the case, that the government does not interfere in another country's internal legal process, and that the UN findings do not justify discrediting the proceedings.
I will raise their situation in the run-up to the next EU human rights dialogue with Japan.
Ik zal hun situatie in de aanloop naar de volgende EU-mensenrechtendialoog met Japan doen op brengen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over de arrestatie van een kopstuk van de radicaal islamitische terreurbeweging Hamas (ingezonden 3 ju

MPs Voordewind and Anker asked ministers whether a Dutch citizen of Palestinian origin, released by Israel after arrest, is a Hamas leader and whether Dutch criminal or residence-law consequences follow. Minister Verhagen declined to discuss this individual case, stating the general rules on revoking Dutch nationality and that the answers could not be given in time.
I cannot provide any information on individual cases such as this one.
Over individuele zaken zoals de onderhavige kan ik geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het lot van politieke gevangenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Foreign and Interior ministers about political prisoners in Indonesia, including Human Rights Watch recommendations, release of non-violent activists, torture, police training and Densus 88. The minister answers that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue, will again urge amendment of the relevant articles, but gives no figures and leaves the US and Australia to decide on training.
The Indonesian authorities do not publish figures on this.
De Indonesische autoriteiten maken geen cijfers hierover bekend.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat jaarlijks een derde van al het ontwikkelingsgeld weglekt (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether a third of global development aid leaks away through inefficiency, how much Dutch aid leaks, whether an investigation will be launched, and whether aid should be stopped except for emergency relief. The minister answers that the figure is not hard, that no investigation is warranted, that the Netherlands will not stop development cooperation, and points to aid results and international efficiency agreements.
Question 3: How much Dutch development money leaks away each year? Are you willing to launch an investigation?
Vraag 3 Hoeveel Nederlands ontwikkelingsgeld lekt jaarlijks weg? Bent u bereid een onderzoek in te stellen?

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Pechtold (D66), Peters (GroenLinks), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Venezolaanse rechter A

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the detention of Venezuelan judge María Lourdes Afiuni, whether it has raised concerns with Venezuela, and whether it will raise the case at EU level. The minister called the detention an infringement on judicial independence, supported the UN call for her release, said the Netherlands will follow the case in UN and EU contexts and will ask the High Representative to raise it with Venezuelan authorities.
I will check whether High Representative Ashton has raised this with the Venezuelan authorities, and advocate that she does.
Ik zal nagaan of Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton dit bij de Venezolaanse autoriteiten heeft aangekaart, en bepleiten dat zij dat doet.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Amerikaans-Israëlische overeenkomsten over Israëls kernwapenambiguïteit (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew of US-Israeli agreements on Israel's nuclear ambiguity, whether Obama's endorsement of Israel's right to determine its own security needs conflicts with the NPT, and how a Middle East nuclear-weapon-free zone conference could succeed. The minister said he knew of the reports but not the agreements' contents, that Israel is not bound by the NPT, and that Netherlands will support regional confidence-building initiatives ahead of the 2012 conference.
I am not aware whether these agreements will be made public, nor am I familiar with their contents.
Mij is niet bekend of deze overeenkomsten openbaar gemaakt zullen worden, evenmin ben ik bekend met de inhoud ervan.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over zijn verschillende antwoorden op de vraag of hij kan aangeven of door corrupte Afghanen ook Nederlandse hulpgelden Afghanistan zijn uitgesmokk

MP Driessen asked Foreign Minister Verhagen why his answers to a question on whether corrupt Afghans smuggled Dutch aid money out of the country differed between two versions. The minister said the first was a mistakenly sent draft, and that there is no evidence Dutch aid was smuggled, citing risk analysis and monitoring of funds managed by international bodies.
A draft version had mistakenly already been sent electronically to the Chamber.
Een conceptversie was abusievelijk reeds elektronisch naar de Kamer verzonden.
Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Marokko een groot aantal christenen heeft uitgezet (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Ormel asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Morocco expelled a large number of Christians, how Morocco responded to Spanish concerns, whether this signals worsening religious freedom, what contact has occurred about reunifying expelled Dutch nationals with children, and the consequences for the children at Village of Hope. The minister confirms the reports, states Morocco cites its national law on proselytism, acknowledges increasing pressure on Christians, reports ongoing humanitarian contacts without a near-term solution, and says no definitive board solution has been found.

I will continue to follow the situation closely and, where necessary, will not fail to raise the importance of respecting freedom of religion and belief in contacts with Morocco and in relevant international fora.

Ik blijf de situatie op de voet volgen, en zal wanneer nodig ook in de toekomst niet nalaten het belang van het respecteren van de vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging in contacten met Marokko en in de relevante internationale fora aan de orde te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Bontes en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Spanje haar zorgen heeft geuit over het uitzetten van christenen uit Marokko (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether about 130 Christians have been expelled from Morocco since March 2010, how many hold Dutch nationality, and whether the government shares Spain's concern and will raise it with Morocco. The minister confirmed roughly 130 expulsions on proselytism grounds (exact number unknown), seven Dutch Christians expelled and two residence permits withdrawn, shared the concern, summoned the Moroccan ambassador on 9 March, and pledged to keep raising religious freedom with Morocco.
On 9 March I summoned the Moroccan ambassador to protest the expulsion of Dutch Christians.
Op 9 maart j.l. heb ik de Marokkaanse ambassadeur nog ontboden om tegen de uitzetting van Nederlandse christenen te protesteren
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over nieuwe gevangenisstraf Israëlische atoomklokkenluider Mordechai Vanunu (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether the government will support Nobel laureate Mairead Maguire's call for release of Israeli nuclear whistleblower Mordechai Vanunu, jailed for three months for speaking to foreign journalists, and whether it considers this a violation of free expression. The minister answers that the Netherlands trusts Israeli legal process, follows the case closely, and sees no reason to press the Israeli government for Vanunu's release.
I see no reason to press the Israeli government for the release of Mr Vanunu.
Ik zie geen reden bij de Israëlische regering aan te dringen op vrijlating van de heer Vanunu.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door Nederland medefinancieren van een moskee op ground zero (ingezonden 21 juli 20

MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether Dutch taxpayer money supports ASMA, the organisation of imam Faisal Abdur Rauf planning a mosque at ground zero, and whether the subsidy should be withdrawn. The minister answered that ASMA is not involved in the ground zero mosque, that it receives MDG3 fund subsidy for a women's empowerment program in Afghanistan, Egypt and Pakistan, and that withdrawal is not being considered.
No, the American Society for Muslim Advancement (ASMA) is not involved in the construction of a mosque at ground zero in the United States.
Nee, de American Society for Muslim Advancement (ASMA) is niet betrokken bij de bouw van een moskee op ground zero in de Verenigde Staten.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, Bontes en De Roon (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aan te scherpen) sanctieregime

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Shell had halted or resumed gasoline sales to Iran, and whether Shell would receive an exemption under tightened EU sanctions. The government said Shell reported no gasoline sales since October 2009 and that a later report was based on an erroneous port inspection, and it declined to discuss individual companies in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Council will not speak about individual companies.
De Raad zal niet over individuele bedrijven spreken.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, De Roon en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aa

PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of a July 2010 letter from 22 US Congress members urging Shell to end its Iran activities and disclose them to US authorities, and whether it will urge Shell to disclose its Iran activities in the Netherlands too. The ministers answered that they know the letter, that it fits efforts for strict Iran sanctions, that Shell must answer it itself, and that Shell must account transparently to its shareholders while the government supervises compliance with EU and UN sanctions.
Shell is bound by the regulations arising from the relevant UN and European sanctions measures against Iran; it is the government's task to monitor compliance with them.
Shell is gebonden aan de regelgeving die voortvloeit uit de relevante VNVR- en Europese sanctiemaatregelen jegens Iran; het is de taak van de overheid toe te zien op naleving daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de beloning van de directeur van het Rode Kruis (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the Red Cross director's pay (about 202,000 euro including social charges and other allowances) exceeds the DG-norm and the Wijffels code, and whether MFS II subsidy should be withheld. The minister said the salary is within the VFI norm, that the total exceeds the DG-norm and VFI norm but not the Balkenende norm, that the reporting needs clarification which he will raise with the Red Cross, and that the Red Cross has committed to meet the DG-norm from 1 January 2011, so no subsidy sanction is planned.
I share the view that the way the organisation reports allowances and costs is insufficiently transparent and needs clarification.
Ik deel de mening dat de wijze waarop de organisatie melding maakt van vergoedingen en kosten onvoldoende transparant is en verduidelijking behoeft.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een salarisverhoging voor Keniaanse parlementsleden (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MPs Van Bommel and Irrgang asked the Foreign Minister whether Kenyan MPs had voted a 25% salary rise, whether this was excessive given Dutch aid to Kenya, and whether Dutch aid would continue. The minister confirmed the decision is not yet implemented, referred to a planned independent salary commission in the draft constitution, and said good governance programmes address accountability and the issue has been raised in EU political dialogue.

Moreover, civil society organisations in Kenya, supported by the Netherlands and other members of the international community, have long argued that setting MPs' salaries and emoluments is best done by an independent and broadly composed commission rather than by the interested parties themselves.

Overigens hebben maatschappelijke organisaties in Kenia, hierin gesteund door Nederland en andere leden van de internationale gemeenschap, al langer bepleit dat de vaststelling van de hoogte van salarissen en emolumenten voor parlementsleden het best gedaan kan worden door een onafhankelijke en breed samengestelde commissie, en niet door de belanghebbenden zelf.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over moslim-oorlog tegen christenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon Indonesia's ambassador, freeze cooperation and the ratification bill with Indonesia, over mosque calls for a war against Christianization and insecurity for Christians. The minister rejected the claim that the Indonesian state tolerates such acts, said he has confidence in EU dialogue on religious freedom, and declined to freeze the agreement.
I do not share your view that the Indonesian government tolerates such actions.
Ik ben niet met u van mening dat de Indonesische overheid dergelijke acties gedoogt.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Keniaanse parlementariërs hun eigen salaris met 25 procent verhoogden en nu 11.000 euro per maand verdienen (ingezonden 5 juli

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch aid to Kenya should be stopped after Kenyan MPs raised their own salaries by 25 percent, and whether the minister agreed the rise was outrageous. The minister called the proposed rise exorbitant, but declined to halt aid for now, citing support for the Kenyan power-sharing accords and noting a planned independent salary commission in the new constitution.
For now I am not willing to halt aid to Kenya.
Ik ben vooralsnog niet bereid de hulp aan Kenia te staken.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsorganisatie SNV weigert het salaris van haar directeur te verlagen (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he would stop SNV's subsidy entirely because its director keeps a 160,000 euro salary, and whether the director and supervisory board chair are motivated by self-enrichment. The minister refused a full stop, opting instead for a subsidy reduction equal to the excess over the DG-norm, and said he has no reason to doubt the director's motives.
As I have previously informed the House, in this case I choose as a measure a reduction in the subsidy to SNV equal to the difference between the director's salary and the DG-norm
Zoals ik de Kamer eerder heb meegedeeld kies ik als maatregel in dit geval voor een korting op de subsidie aan SNV die gelijk is aan het verschil tussen het salaris van de directeur en de DG-norm
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het veroordelen van een advocaat door een Syrische militaire rechtbank (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands could act internationally against Syria's arrest and conviction of critics, including lawyer Haitham al-Maleh, and what would be done about his health and detention conditions. The minister answered that Nether­lands raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, pushed for an EU clause allowing suspension of the Association Agreement, and called for al-Maleh's release.

I have already urged EU High Representative Ashton to issue a statement on behalf of the EU condemning the arrests and convictions of the Syrian human rights defenders and calling for their immediate release.
Ik heb reeds bij EUHV Ashton aangedrongen op een verklaring namens de EU, waarin de arrestaties en veroordelingen van de voornoemde Syrische mensenrechtenverdedigers worden veroordeeld

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat een Zuid-Afrikaanse hulporganisatie mogelijk enkele tonnen Nederlands belastinggeld heeft verduisterd (ingezonden 8 juli 2010)

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that a South African aid organisation may have embezzled several million euros of Dutch aid funds, and why intervention came so late. The minister confirmed irregularities up to about 700,000 euros, said recovery is being pursued through South African courts, and declined to tighten controls, citing existing risk analysis and monitoring.
In case of proven fraud, the funds will be recovered.
Bij bewezen fraude zullen de fondsen worden teruggevorderd.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over de arrestatie van een kopstuk van de radicaal islamitische terreurbeweging Hamas (ingezonden 3 ju

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether a Dutch national of Palestinian origin, released by Israel after arrest, is a Hamas leader, whether he was linked to al-Aqsa and to criminal offences, whether prosecution is considered, and what the consequences for his residence status would be. The ministers replied only that the answers could not be given within the deadline because information had to be gathered, and promised to send them later.
As soon as the necessary information is available, the answer will be sent to you without delay.
Zodra de benodigde informatie beschikbaar is wordt de beantwoording u onverwijld aangeboden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

Six MPs asked the foreign minister how the government would implement SNV's proposal to freeze high director salaries by offsetting them against subsidy, whether other non-MFS development organisations pay salaries above the agreed cap, and whether he will push for a salary ceiling for largely state-funded organisations. The minister's reply is only an interim notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the deadline because compiling comparable salary data for non-MFS organisations will take time.
As soon as the necessary information is available, the answer will be sent to you without delay.
Zodra de benodigde informatie beschikbaar is, wordt de beantwoording u onverwijld aangeboden.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ontwikkelingshulporganisatie SNV weigert de salarissen van haar directieleden te verlagen (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether he knows of reports that development organisation SNV refuses to cut its directors' salaries, and asks for an overview of directors' salaries across subsidised development organisations and whether measures taken against SNV will apply to all such organisations. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the set deadline because compiling comparable salary data will take time, and promises to send the answers once available.
As soon as the necessary information is available, the answer will be sent to you without delay.
Zodra de benodigde informatie beschikbaar is wordt de beantwoording u onverwijld aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanval van Israël op een internationaal hulpkonvooi (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

MP Van Dam asked the foreign minister whether Israel's assault on an aid convoy violated naval warfare law and international law, and whether the Netherlands would push for an EU-Israel Association Council and an independent inquiry. The minister defended the legality question as still under review, backed an impartial inquiry, but declined to convene the Association Council, citing Israel's own investigation and its eased Gaza access policy.
Investigation will have to show whether in this matter the rules of naval warfare law were followed.
Onderzoek zal moeten uitwijzen of in deze kwestie conform de regels van het zeeoorlogsrecht is gehandeld.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de resolutie in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aangaande de veroordeling van de aanval van Israël op een internationaal hulpkonvooi (ingezonden 4 jun

MP Van Dam asked why the Netherlands voted against a UN Human Rights Council resolution condemning Israel's attack on an aid flotilla, and why Belgium, France and the UK abstained. Minister Verhagen confirmed the no vote, explained that the EU amendments were not accepted and that Israel and flag states should investigate first, and declined to judge other member states' positions.
The Netherlands, together with the UN Security Council and the High Representative, is of the view that Israel and, where desired, the flag states must first carry out an investigation.
Nederland was, met de VNVR en de HV, en is van mening dat het éérst aan Israël en desgewenst de vlaggenstaten is om onderzoek uit te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat aankomend EU-voorzitter België nieuwe stappen wil in de toetreding van Turkije (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

PVV MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the foreign minister about Belgium's plan, as incoming EU presidency, to push new steps in Turkey's accession, and whether the government would call for ending talks given Turkey's rhetoric over the Gaza flotilla, and would state that Turkey must never join. The minister replied that progress depends on objective criteria and reform, that Turkey still has not applied the customs union to Cyprus, that the Gaza tensions should be resolved bilaterally, and that the negotiations are open-ended with no guaranteed outcome.
This is separate from the neighbourhood policy that Turkey conducts with Iran and Syria.
Dit staat los van het nabuurschapsbeleid dat Turkije voert met Iran en Syrië.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Israëlische inname van de humanitaire vloot voor Gaza (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MP Peters asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's seizure of the humanitarian flotilla bound for Gaza was lawful under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, San Remo Manual and Fourth Geneva Convention. The minister answered that the naval law of armed conflict applies, that neutral vessels may be inspected, and that the inspection of the cargo was intended, while not addressing the questions on blockade-breaking and humanitarian access in full detail.
Under the law of naval warfare, belligerent parties are entitled to examine neutral vessels to establish whether they are indeed neutral.
Onder het zeeoorlogsrecht zijn strijdende partijen bevoegd neutrale schepen te onderzoeken om vast te stellen of deze inderdaad neutraal zijn.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Zweedse oliemaatschappij Lundin bij mensenrechtenschendingen in Soedan (ingezonden 15 juni

MPs Haverkamp and Ferrier asked the Dutch foreign minister about alleged complicity of Lundin in war crimes in Sudan's Block 5A and whether Lundin, active in the Netherlands, should face consequences. The minister replied that Sweden, Austria and Malaysia must decide on further investigation, that Lundin is only a gas-licence co-holder in the Netherlands, and that Dutch consequences await the Swedish prosecutor's inquiry.
Pending the aforementioned investigation by the Swedish Public Prosecution Service, this is not an issue at this stage.
Hangende het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van het Zweedse Openbaar Ministerie is dit in dit stadium niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Turkse hulporganisatie IHH en de betrokkenheid van Turkije hierbij (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's labelling of Turkish aid group IHH as terrorist was justified, what its ties to the Turkish government and Hamas are, and whether the Netherlands would demand explanation from Turkey and raise the matter in the EU. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no evidence warranting listing IHH, that IHH is independent of the Turkish state, and that the Netherlands called for an impartial inquiry, with the EU and bilateral channels used to improve Israel-Turkey relations.
The Dutch government urged on the day of the incident a swift, independent and impartial investigation in line with international standards
De Nederlandse regering heeft op de dag van het incident aangedrongen op een spoedig, onafhankelijk en onpartijdig onderzoek, conform internationale standaarden
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het lot van Koerdische kinderen in gevangenissen in Turkije (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's anti-terror law still applies to children despite a promised exemption, and urged faster reform and EU attention to Kurdish minors' treatment. The minister confirmed the law still applies, said Turkey is expected to prioritise amending it, and stated the Netherlands will keep raising Kurdish minority rights bilaterally and via the EU.
Improving the social, economic, cultural and political rights of the Kurdish minority in Turkey is an important priority for the Dutch government.
Verbetering van de sociale, economische, culturele en politieke rechten van de Koerdische minderheid in Turkije is voor de Nederlandse regering een belangrijke prioriteit.
Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Nederland miljoenen extra aan de Palestijnen geeft (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

MP Driessen (PVV) asked why the Netherlands gives extra funds to Palestinians in a Hamas-controlled region, whether the money could be used for jihad or incitement, and whether Dutch donations to UNRWA should be withdrawn. Minister Verhagen replied that the funds go to UNRWA as humanitarian aid, that UNRWA controls misuse of funds, and that Dutch support will continue because the aid is still needed before a peace agreement.
UNRWA is a reliable and neutral organisation that carefully checks whether the funds provided are not misused.
UNRWA is een betrouwbare en neutrale organisatie die nauwgezet controleert of verstrekte middelen niet worden misbruikt.

Vragen van het lid Driessen (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat gevreesd wordt dat ongeveer 2,5 miljard euro aan hulpgelden voor Afghanistan het land is uitgesmokkeld (ingezonden 30 juni 201

An MP asked the foreign minister whether around 2.5 billion euro of aid for Afghanistan, largely development funds, had been smuggled out via Kabul airport since 2007, whether Dutch aid was among it, and whether he would investigate and stop aid. The minister could not confirm the figure, said no evidence shows Dutch aid was smuggled, noted that most Dutch funds flow through World Bank and UNDP trust funds with audits, and declined to stop aid while pointing to Afghan anti-corruption investigations.
The Netherlands will welcome initiatives in this direction.
Nederland zal initiatieven in deze richting verwelkomen.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GL) aan de minister-president en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de herdenking van het drama in Srebrenica (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would attend the 15th anniversary commemoration of Srebrenica and whether the request was desirable given Dutch historical involvement. The government answered that Defence Minister Van Middelkoop will represent the government at the commemoration, which it considers a clear gesture of continued Dutch commitment.
On behalf of the Dutch government, Defence Minister Eimert van Middelkoop will attend the commemoration in Srebrenica marking the events there 15 years ago.
Namens de Nederlandse regering zal op de bijeenkomst in Srebrenica ter herdenking van de gebeurtenissen aldaar 15 jaar geleden, de Minister van Defensie, de heer Eimert van Middelkoop, aanwezig zijn.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang (SP) en Ten Broeke (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsorganisatie SNV (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

MPs Irrgang and Ten Broeke asked whether a board member's foundation (NOTS) had ties with development organisation SNV, what support SNV gave it, whether this is an undesirable conflict of interest, and whether the 90 million euro subsidy is used for an unclear Washington lobby office. The minister replied that a tri-partite energy collaboration exists, that board member did not take part in SNV decisions on NOTS and no SNV funding flowed, and that the Washington office's necessity cannot yet be judged, promising to press for closure if results show it is not essential.
There is no SNV financing of the board member's foundation; the board member did not take part in any SNV decision-making about NOTS.
Van financiering van de stichting van het betrokken lid van de Raad van Toezicht door SNV is geen sprake, het betrokken lid heeft niet deelgenomen aan enige besluitvorming door SNV over NOTS

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de dood van een Nederlandse moslimextremist (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

An MP asked the foreign and interior ministers about a Dutch Muslim extremist reportedly killed in Pakistan, and about radicalisation, jihadist training and foreign funding of radicalisation networks in the Netherlands and Europe. The minister answered that the answers are classified and available only for inspection by Members, placed with the Tweede Kamer's central information point.
The answer to these questions is available for confidential inspection, for Members only, deposited with the Tweede Kamer's central information point.
Het antwoord op deze vragen is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de Leden, gelegd bij net Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verwerpen van de Indonesische speciale autonomie door de bevolking van Papua (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about intimidation of demonstrators in Papua after the population rejected Indonesia's special autonomy, and whether the government would press Indonesia on peaceful dialogue, access for media, humanitarian groups and observers. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects Indonesian sovereignty, works on implementing the 2001 special autonomy law and raises the right to peaceful protest and restrictive access policy in bilateral and EU dialogue, while noting some improvement.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation in Papua and raise it in its contacts with the Indonesian authorities.
Nederland zal de situatie in Papoea nauwgezet blijven volgen en bespreken in de contacten met de Indonesische autoriteiten.

Vragen van de leden Teeven (VVD) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de contacten tussen een ambtenaar van Buitenlandse Zaken en de voortvluchtige C. (wapenhandelaar) (i

MPs Teeven and Van Haersma Buma asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about contacts between a Foreign Affairs official and a fugitive arms dealer wanted by Italy, including whether the official informed his employer. Minister Verhagen answered, but the substantive answers were submitted only for confidential inspection by MPs and not published.
The answer to these questions is available for confidential inspection, for Members only, deposited at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Het antwoord op deze vragen is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de Leden, gelegd bij net Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechtenschendingen in Burundi (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

Irrgang (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of a Human Rights Watch researcher from Burundi, election-related violence, and the withdrawal of opposition presidential candidates, and whether these would weigh on budget support. The minister regretted the expulsion, said Burundi should have engaged in dialogue rather than expelling her, and said the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally, via the EU and in the UN Human Rights Council, with human rights respect one of the conditions for budget support decided after the elections.
At the UN Human Rights Council currently meeting in Geneva, the Netherlands will raise the matter through a national statement.
In de VN-Mensenrechtenraad die momenteel plaatsvindt in Genève, zal Nederland de onderhavige kwestie via een nationale verklaring aankaarten.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Duitse huurlingen in Somalië (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a German firm, Asgaard, signed a five-year contract with a Somali warlord, whether this worsens the civil war, and whether the minister would press Germany to act against such mercenaries. The minister said he only knew of the contract from the media, found such involvement undesirable, and pointed to Germany's statement that the firm must observe EU and German law including the Somalia arms embargo, with the decision on prosecution resting with German authorities.
The content of such a contract is not known to me.
De inhoud van een dergelijk contract is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het stopzetten van programma's van een christelijke niet-gouvernementele organisatie (ngo) in Afghanistan (ingezonden 8 ju

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the suspension of Church World Service programmes in Afghanistan over proselytizing allegations, and whether this reflects wider pressure on Christian organisations. The minister confirmed the temporary suspension by Afghan authorities pending an investigation, said the Netherlands will raise concern and will inform parliament of the outcome, and reported no known general trend of pressure.
Of course I will closely follow the progress of the investigation and inform the House of its outcome once it is made public.
Uiteraard zal ik het verloop van het onderzoek nauwlettend volgen en de Kamer na bekendmaking van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek hierover informeren.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de politieke situatie in Cambodja (ingezonden 9 juni 2010).

Pechtold asks the foreign minister for the government's reaction to the lifting of parliamentary immunity of opposition MPs in Cambodia, the defamation conviction of Mu Sochua, the use of courts against the opposition, and diplomatic steps to protect opposition politicians. The minister calls the immunity lifting worrying, notes concern about the broad defamation offence and the judiciary's independence, and says the Dutch embassy and EU heads of mission have raised the matter with Cambodian authorities.
It is worrying that the parliament controlled by the Cambodian People's Party has once again decided to lift the immunity of a number of parliamentarians.
Het is zorgelijk dat het door de Cambodian People’s Party gecontroleerde parlement wederom heeft besloten om de immuniteit van een aantal parlementariërs op te heffen.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het besluit van de Afghaanse regering om het werk van twee christelijke hulporganisaties te verbieden (ingezonden 9 juni 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister whether the Afghan government's temporary suspension of two Christian aid organisations, over suspected proselytising, conflicts with religious freedom and what the Netherlands will do about it. The minister answered that the suspension is pending an investigation, that Afghan partners may continue, that Afghan law makes conversion punishable, and that the Netherlands and the EU raise religious freedom in their dialogue with Kabul.
In talks with the Afghan authorities, the Netherlands will emphasise the importance of freedom of religion.
Nederland zal in gesprekken met de Afghaanse autoriteiten het belang van godsdienstvrijheid benadrukken.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht van een ritueel geslachte koe voor het WK in Zuid-Afrika (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the foreign minister whether he condemns the ritual slaughter of a cow near a World Cup stadium in Johannesburg, whether he will hold FIFA and the South African ambassador to account, and the minister replied that he rejects the ritual, that FIFA was not involved and that the South African authorities were not involved, so he sees no reason to act. The answers rest on the claim that local chiefs carried out the slaughter, with no commitment to further action.
According to our information, the ritual slaughter was carried out by local tribal chiefs and FIFA was in no way involved in the ritual slaughter.
Volgens onze informatie is de rituele slachting uitgevoerd door lokale stamhoofden en is de FIFA op geen enkele wijze betrokken geweest bij de rituele slachting.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de tender draagvlakactiviteiten op het gebied van internationale samenwerking (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

Ferrier (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the timing, eligibility criteria and next steps of the new subsidy tender for public-support activities in international cooperation, including whether it follows a prior motion. Minister Verhagen confirmed the tender was published on 31 May, said the criteria are set out in the tender document and incorporate the motion's criteria, and expected a selection by summer with a first subsidy round in autumn.
The criteria named in the Voordewind/Ferrier motion have been incorporated in it.
De criteria die zijn benoemd in de motie Voordewind/Ferrier zijn in hierin verwerkt.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Haverkamp (beiden CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bomaanslagen in Mosul op bussen met christelijke studenten (ingezonden

MPs asked the foreign minister about bomb attacks on buses of Christian students in Mosul and how to increase international protection of minorities, including a round-table conference and UN action. The minister confirmed the attack, said protection of minorities is the Iraqi government's responsibility, pointed to existing EU/Dutch human rights and aid efforts, and reported that the UN mission discussed minority protection, without committing to a new conference or UN initiative.
Guaranteeing the safety and human rights of minorities is a matter for the Iraqi government.
De waarborging van de veiligheid en mensenrechten van minderheden is een zaak voor de Irakese regering.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bericht over dwangarbeid voor homo’s in Malawi (ingezonden 21 mei 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the foreign minister whether a same-sex couple sentenced in Malawi to 14 years with hard labour was true, whether the government would raise it with Malawi, and whether it could be raised at the UN. The minister confirmed the facts, reported that the Netherlands and the EU had already voiced concern and that the couple was pardoned and released, and said Netherlands would press for attention to discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation at the UN Human Rights Council.
Netherlands will make efforts so that the EU draws attention to discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation during that session.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inspannen dat de EU gedurende die zitting aandacht vraagt voor discriminatie op basis van seksuele oriëntatie.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over vervolging van homo’s in Malawi (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MPs Nicolaï and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of gay men in Malawi, including a reported 14-year sentence for a male couple, and whether the government and EU had condemned it and whether it affects aid relations. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Netherlands has no bilateral aid relationship with Malawi, noted that the EU ambassadors and the High Representative publicly condemned the case while the Commission's aid is unaffected for now, and described NGO work on HIV/AIDS prevention among vulnerable groups including homosexuals.
The conviction of the homosexual couple has so far had no consequences for the European Commission's aid to Malawi.
De veroordeling van het homostel heeft vooralsnog geen consequenties voor de hulp van de Europese Commissie aan Malawi.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp, Ferrier en Ten Hoopen (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de immer verslechterende situatie in de Indiase deelstaat Manipur (ingezonden 27 mei

CDA MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the deteriorating situation in India's Manipur state, including religious tensions, Dutch economic interests, and the effect on civil society and NGOs. The foreign minister answered that Naga independence demands and an economic blockade cause the unrest, that no Dutch firms or investments are present, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise the matter with Indian authorities if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following this process and will, where necessary, raise the situation in contacts with the Indian authorities.
Nederland en de EU volgen dit proces en zullen zonodig de situatie aan de orde stellen in contacten met de Indiase autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Rwanda, Burundi expel Human Rights Watch workers» (ingezonden 26 mei 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether expelling Human Rights Watch staff from Burundi conflicts with human rights benchmarks for budget support, and about the outlook for fair elections. The minister said only one HRW representative's work permit was withdrawn, that Nederland raised the matter with Burundi and would raise it at the UN Human Rights Council, and that the election process was being closely monitored.
The Netherlands has therefore raised this with the Burundian authorities and will bring the matter up at the 14th session of the UN Human Rights Council in June.
Nederland heeft de Burundese autoriteiten hier dan ook op aangesproken en zal de onderhavige kwestie aankaarten in de 14 e zitting van de VN Mensenrechtenraad die in juni plaatsvindt.
Vragen van de leden Biskop en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over materialen voor de herbouw van een school in Haïti (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

CDA MPs Biskop and Ferrier asked the foreign minister about a container of building materials for a Haiti school that was reportedly blocked at the border, and whether Haiti still only needs cash. The minister replied that the container has now reached Port-au-Prince, that Haiti still has great need for emergency aid, and that the Netherlands funds relief through the UN, the Red Cross and SHO rather than the Haitian government.
This container has now nevertheless reached Port-au-Prince.
Deze container heeft Port-au-Prince inmiddels alsnog bereikt.
Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Israëlische inname van de humanitaire vloot voor Gaza (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Peters and Van Dam asked the foreign minister to answer an unanswered question on Israel's restricted border access for Gaza and whether he would press Israel for free passage of the next aid flotilla. The minister said Israel must open the Gaza crossings and allow normal movement, but declined to demand free sea passage, saying Israel may regulate sea access and urging restraint, while agreeing to answer question 8 by 3 June.
No, I am of the view that Israel has the authority to regulate access to Gaza by sea, to protect legitimate security interests and within the limits of international law.

Nee, ik ben van mening dat Israël de bevoegdheid heeft om de toegang tot Gaza over zee te reguleren, ter bescherming van legitieme veiligheidsbelangen en binnen de grenzen van het internationaal recht.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de plukkers van de tomaten van Ahold (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asked the Foreign and Agriculture ministers about reported forced-labour and poor working conditions among US tomato pickers supplying Ahold, and whether Ahold bears responsibility for suppliers. The government answered that the matter is for Ahold to address and US authorities to enforce, that Dutch imports of these tomatoes are unlikely, and that companies share supply-chain responsibility, which OECD National Contact Points can assess.
The NCP can determine the extent to which a company has (not) taken its supply-chain responsibility.
Het NCP kan bepalen in hoeverre een bedrijf haar ketenverantwoordelijkheid (niet) genomen heeft.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een hulpgoederenkonvooi over zee naar Gaza (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Freedom Flotilla' sailing to Gaza with aid, Israel's announced blockade of it, the earlier Spirit of Humanity incident, and whether the government would press Israel to admit the flotilla. The answer, sent by letter on 1 June 2010, was a reference to a separate letter answering these questions, so the substance is not in this document.
These questions have been answered in a letter dated 1 June 2010.
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 juni 2010
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Israëlische inname van de humanitaire vloot voor Gaza (ingezonden 31 mei 2010).

MP Peters asked the Foreign Minister how the government views Israel's violent seizure of the Gaza aid flotilla that left casualties, whether it condemns the action as disproportionate, how Israel's claimed naval-blockade legal basis holds under international law, whether it will press Israel to end the Gaza blockade and call for an independent inquiry, and what is being done for the two Dutch passengers. The minister said the events shocked him, conveyed that the Netherlands expects Israel to investigate, declined to judge proportionality before facts are known, outlined the laws of naval warfare Israel invokes, supported immediate humanitarian access and reopening of crossings, and said Israel and flag states should investigate first and that the two Dutch detainees receive standard consular assistance.
This investigation will have to be carried out by Israel; the flag states concerned are also competent to conduct an investigation, because it is primarily their rights that are at stake.
Dit onderzoek zal uitgevoerd moeten worden door Israël; ook de betrokken vlaggenstaten zijn bevoegd onderzoek uit te voeren, want het zijn primair hun rechten die in het geding zijn.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het humanitaire «Gaza Freedom Flotilla»-initiatief (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's threatened blockade and possible use of force against the Gaza Freedom Flotilla humanitarian ships, and whether the Netherlands would protect the initiative and press Israel. The minister's answer was given in a letter of 1 June 2010; the text provided contains only the question list and a reference to that letter, so the substance of the government's answers is not visible here.
These questions were answered in a letter of 1 June 2010.
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 juni 2010

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Nicolaï (VVD) en Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over oproep tot boycot van Israël door gesubsidieerde Palestijnse organisatie e

MPs asked the foreign minister whether UNICEF and the Dutch-funded Cordaid, which support the Palestinian youth group Pyalara, should stop funding it after a poster used UNICEF's logo and a hate-style image announcing a programme on a boycott of Israel, and whether the closure of Palestinian TV stations threatens press freedom. The minister answered that UNICEF had cut ties with Pyalara and objected to the poster, that Cordaid and the ministry would monitor such activities without ending funding since no boycott call was found, and that the stations' closures were technical-formal rather than political, with an extended deadline given.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will again urge the co-financing organisations in a separate discussion to carefully assess and monitor activities such as this one.
Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal in een separaat gesprek met de MFO's nogmaals aandringen op een zorgvuldige toetsing en monitoring van activiteiten als onderhavige
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Rwandese beschuldigingen aan het adres van Human Rights Watch (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

The MP asks whether Rwandan accusations of blackmail against Human Rights Watch are justified, whether refusing a work permit threatens HRW's operations, and whether the government will press Rwanda on intolerance of criticism before elections and on resuming general budget support. The minister rejects the blackmail claim, expects HRW to remain welcome, says Nederland and EU partners have raised concerns, and says a decision on budget support will follow a joint review in October 2010.
They invoke the need to prevent at all costs a repetition of the 1994 genocide; preserving stability takes precedence.
Deze beroepen zich op het feit dat men koste wat kost een herhaling van de genocide van 1994 wil voorkomen; behoud van de stabiliteit staat voorop.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over executies van politieke gevangenen in Iran (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether five Kurds were executed in Evin prison on 9 May 2010, what they were charged with, whether their trials met fair-trial standards, whether families and lawyers were informed, and whether the government would seek clarification and protest. The minister confirmed the executions, said a full assessment of fair trial was not possible given closed proceedings, and reported that the ambassador and EU High Representative condemned them and called for a moratorium.
Because of the closed nature of these court cases, it is not possible to give a complete judgment on the extent to which the proceedings meet international standards for a fair trial.

Door het gesloten karakter van genoemde rechtszaken is het niet mogelijk een compleet oordeel te geven over de mate waarin de processen voldoen aan de internationale maatstaven voor een eerlijke procesgang.
Vragen van het lid Schippers (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het ORIO-programma (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister about the ORIO programme, its shift from export-linked ORET, the large share of funds going to consultants, and whether it serves Dutch employment. The minister defends ORIO as targeting concrete infrastructure results, says the consultant share is essential development-phase work, and expects Dutch firms to benefit at tender stage with evaluation in 2012.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over betrokkenheid van vrouwen bij wederopbouw van Haïti (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the role of women in Haiti's post-earthquake reconstruction, including in the donor conference and the Post-Disaster Needs Assessment, should be strengthened in line with UN Resolution 1325. The minister agreed women should be actively involved, said Dutch partners are pressing for this through the UN and EU, and listed concrete steps such as gender-responsive budgeting and a UNDP/UNFPA panel.
Vragen van het lid Nicolaï (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Syrië aan Hezbollah Scudraketten verstrekt (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

MP Nicolaï asked the foreign minister about reports that Syria supplies Scud missiles to Hezbollah and what the consequences would be for the region, the peace process and relations with Syria and the EU. The minister answered that the reports were not verifiable, that such supplies would breach UN resolutions 1559 and 1701, and that the matter would be raised in the UN Security Council and EU if confirmed, without committing to concrete steps.
So far these reports have not been objectively verifiable.
Vooralsnog zijn deze berichten niet objectief verifieerbaar gebleken.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke levering van Scud-raketten door Syrië aan de terroristische Hezbollah-beweging in Libanon (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon the Syrian ambassador, condemn arms deliveries to Hezbollah, and push for sanctions over reported Scud missile transfers. The minister declined to summon the ambassador for lack of grounds on available information, said Nederland raises UN resolution compliance with Syria, and would not anticipate measures before facts are established.
On the basis of the information available to us so far, there is currently no good ground for the Netherlands to summon the Syrian ambassador.
Op grond van de ons tot nog toe beschikbare informatie is er op dit moment voor Nederland geen goede grond om de Syrische ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitnodiging aan een Hamas-minister voor een conferentie in Duitsland (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

Haverkamp (CDA) asked the foreign minister whether a Hamas health minister invited to a German academic conference could obtain an EU visa, and how Palestinian reconciliation and Egyptian mediation stood. Minister Verhagen answered that the official had not applied for a visa, that Netherlands policy on Hamas contacts follows the Quartet principles, and that Germany's role is limited to a Shalit-related request from Israel.
Inquiries show that the Hamas official concerned has not applied for a visa.
Navraag leert dat betrokken Hamas-functionaris geen visum heeft aangevraagd.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Pechtold (D66), Nicolaï (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Iraanse toetreding tot de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN (in

MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would oppose Iran's candidacy for the UN Human Rights Council given its human rights record, and what that would mean for the Council's credibility. The minister replied that Iran withdrew its candidacy and that the Netherlands had actively lobbied against it, and that it will continue to keep notorious rights violators out of the Council.
In the future too, the Netherlands will continue to work unabatedly to keep notorious human rights violators out of the Council.
Ook in de toekomst zal Nederland zich onverminderd blijven inzetten om notoire mensenrechtenschenders buiten de Raad te houden.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het jaarsalaris van de directeur van SNV Nederland (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

MP Irrgang (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the director of SNV Nederland's salary, pension funding, the effectiveness of SNV's advisory work, the disclosure of management salaries, and whether SNV complies with MFS II salary norms. The minister answered that the salary is below the WOPT threshold, the pension top-up allegation is incorrect, the MFS II norm does not apply to SNV's 2006 subsidy, and he has urged SNV to publish salaries of all four directors.
I have advised SNV to consider making the salaries of all four directors public.
Ik heb SNV in overweging gegeven de salarissen van alle vier de directeuren openbaar te maken.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verlies aan geloofwaardigheid van het Kimberley proces inzake diamantenhandel in Zimbabwe (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the Kimberley Process has lost credibility over Zimbabwean diamond trade, including whether Zimbabwe should be suspended if it shows no improvement by June 2010. The minister rejected the claim that the process is a sham, agreed that human rights abuses and military involvement are serious, noted an approved Zimbabwean action plan monitored by a KP observer, and said suspension is an ultimate measure to be decided by the EU at the KP meeting.
The Netherlands is represented within the KP by the EU.
Nederland wordt binnen het KP vertegenwoordigd door de EU.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijheidsbeperking van een Rwandese presidentskandidaat die na 16 jaar in Nederland gewoond te hebben teruggekeerd is naar haar vaderland (i

MP Ferrier asks the Foreign Minister about the detention and conditional release of Rwandan presidential candidate Victoire Ingabire, whether Rwanda's rights record should limit budget support, and whether she holds Dutch nationality. The minister confirms awareness, notes the charges and reporting duty, says the embassy monitors the case, states budget support is sectoral and will be reviewed after the Joint Review, and confirms she is not Dutch.
The embassy in Kigali is closely following this matter and is also in contact with the Rwandan authorities about it.
De ambassade in Kigali volgt deze kwestie op de voet en onderhoudt hierover ook contact met de Rwandese autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld in Oost-Congo en het effect van een mogelijk vertrek van MONUC (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MP Van Dam asks the Foreign Minister about rising violence and rapes in eastern Congo, the Oxfam-cited risks of a MONUC withdrawal, and whether the government will press for mandate renewal and oppose Kabila's push for withdrawal. The minister says the UN Secretary-General sees improved security in the west, so a phased exit may be possible there, but eastern withdrawal requires Congolese capacity; Netherlands favours renewal focused on civilian protection and has raised this bilaterally and in the Great Lakes Contact Group.
The Netherlands considers extension of the MONUC mandate very desirable, mainly with a view to protecting the civilian population in eastern Congo.
Nederland vindt verlenging van het MONUC-mandaat zeer wenselijk, vooral met het oog op de bescherming van de burgerbevolking in Oost-Congo.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de massamoord in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MP Ferrier asks the Foreign Minister about the LRA massacre in eastern Congo, urging faster MONUC investigation and EU technical help, stronger protection of civilians, and linking debt relief to security. The minister confirms the joint MONUC-OHCHR mission and pressure for publication of the interim report, supports the EU envoy's initiative and a MONUC mandate focused on civilian protection, but declines to add protection conditions to the HIPC debt relief process.
The Netherlands is working bilaterally and multilaterally to improve protection of the civilian population in the DRC against the LRA and other armed groups.
Nederland zet zich bilateraal en multilateraal in voor verbetering van de bescherming van de burgerbevolking in de DRC tegen de LRA en andere gewapende groepen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Japan een activist van Sea Shepherd Conservation Society heeft opgepakt (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked whether Japan's arrest of Sea Shepherd activist Peter Bethune (a New Zealand national and former captain of the sunk Ady Gil) and the charges against him were known, and whether the minister would raise his position in upcoming political consultations with Japan. The minister confirmed the facts as reported, said no verdict had been reached, and replied that no consultation date is set and Bethune's case will not be discussed because he is a New Zealand national receiving consular help from New Zealand, though Sea Shepherd's actions and Japanese whaling compliance will be raised.
The position of Mr Bethune will not be discussed.
De positie van de heer Bethune zal niet worden besproken.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken over de Wereldexpo in Shanghai (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

MP Peters asked three ministers whether the cabinet is implementing a parliamentary motion on critical Chinese artists at the Shanghai World Expo, whether Tibetan and Uyghur oppression will be raised, and whether human rights abuses in Expo construction (land expropriation, poor labour conditions) can be excluded for the Dutch pavilion and culture centre. The government answered that the NCAF programmes the culture centre with room for critical artists such as Ai Weiwei, that the Expo site caused forced relocations of about 18,000 households, and that contract rules on labour and safety for the Dutch pavilion are supervised by the commissioner-general.
The NCAF is free to give substance to the content programming.
Het staat de NCAF daarbij vrij om aan de inhoudelijke programmering invulling te geven.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie over het nakomen van eerdere toezeggingen met betrekking tot Haïti (ingezonden 19 maart 2010).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether earlier commitments on Haiti were kept, covering the donor conference, family reunification, monitoring of expedited adoptions and aftercare. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was represented at the conference, that Haitian family reunification cases are prioritised case by case, that aftercare for adopted children is coordinated, and that the Haiti adoption fast-track is an exceptional measure not setting a precedent.
This decision therefore does not set a precedent for other disaster situations should they unfortunately occur in the future.
Dit besluit vormt dan ook geen precedent voor andere rampsituaties indien deze zich onverhoopt in de toekomst zullen voordoen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verheerlijken van een Hamas-topterrorist door de Palestijnse autoriteiten (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

The SGP MP Van der Staaij asks the foreign minister how he judges the Palestinian Authority's naming of a street in Ramallah after Hamas terrorist Yahya Ayash and a square after Dalal Mughrabi, and what measures he will take. The minister replies that naming decisions lie with the Ramallah municipality, that the government rejects them, that the Dutch representative protested to the mayor, and that sanctions are not warranted while the PA continues to renounce terrorism.
The government rejects this decision of the municipal authority, as it contributes to glorifying terror and violence.
De regering verwerpt dit besluit van het gemeentebestuur, aangezien het bijdraagt aan het verheerlijken van terreur en geweld.
Vragen van het lid Blom (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het toepassen van Europese regelgeving met betrekking tot het vrij verkeer van werknemers (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

MP Blom asks the foreign minister whether EU free-movement rules were misapplied in the case of Mr Louw in Sweden, whether he should be compensated, and whether the minister will contact the Swedish minister. The minister answers that a full legal analysis is not possible, that the matter is a Swedish labour-law case for Swedish courts (which may refer questions to the EU Court), and that the Dutch government will not intervene in a civil matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on the correct application of European law in a Swedish national context.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om uitspraken te doen over de juiste toepassing van het Europese recht in een nationale Zweedse context.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Saudi Arabia funds Wahhabist and Salafist spread in the Balkans and whether the relationship should be reconsidered. The minister rejected the claim that Islamic extremism is flourishing there, said the EU addresses extremism through the accession process, and said there was no concrete evidence of Saudi state support for jihadist extremism, so no reason to review the relationship.
There are no concrete indications that the government of Saudi Arabia supports jihadist extremism.
Er zijn geen concrete aanwijzingen dat de regering van Saoedi-Arabië jihadistische extremisme ondersteunt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de raketbeschietingen op Israël vanuit Gaza (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about renewed rocket fire from Gaza into Israel, its causes, international responses, the effectiveness of anti-smuggling measures, and UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon's call on the blockade. The minister answered that the rise is linked to smaller militant groups and Palestinian factional and border tensions, that the EU and partners urge implementation of Resolution 1860, and that the Netherlands participates in a counter-arms-smuggling initiative, while noting the EU has no border-guard mission in Gaza.
The Netherlands participates in a joint action programme within the Gaza Counter Arms Smuggling Initiative (GCASI) to combat arms smuggling into Gaza.
Nederland neemt daartoe deel aan een gemeenschappelijk actieprogramma in het kader van het Gaza Counter Arms smuggling initiative (GCASI)

Vragen van de leden Peters, Vendrik (beiden GroenLinks), Irrgang (SP), Koşer Kaya (D66), Yücel en Waalkens (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het standaard subsidiekader (ingezonden 22 maart 2010).

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the standard subsidy framework for civil society organisations in development cooperation would work, including which existing schemes it absorbs, its 2011 budget, publication of rules, and when organisations can apply. The minister answered that it is a programme-based framework with thematic, country or regional tenders, at least 50 million euros is available in 2011, and rules will be published once thematic priorities are decided.
It is not yet decided which themes, regions or countries will be put out to tender in 2010/2011.
Het staat nu nog niet vast ten aanzien van welke thema’s, regio’s of landen in 2010/2011 getenderd zal worden.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gevangenisstraf voor een Turks-Koerdische politica (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about the cumulative prison sentence of Kurdish politician Leyla Zana in Turkey, including a sentence based on a 2007 Newroz speech, and whether the Netherlands will affirm free speech and send diplomatic representatives to Newroz celebrations. The minister confirms the facts, reaffirms that free expression including political speech is a fundamental right, notes Dutch advocacy with Turkey and the EU, and says the embassy follows the Kurdish issue closely and will raise EU participation at the Heads of Mission meeting.
Freedom of expression is a fundamental right and also includes political statements insofar as they do not incite hatred or violence.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting is een fundamenteel recht en omvat ook politieke uitspraken voor zover deze niet aanzetten tot haat of geweld.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over huidige nucleaire activiteiten van Iran o.a. naar aanleiding van een brief van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken d.d. 24 maart 2010 (ingezon

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about Iran's nuclear and missile activities, the IAEA Additional Protocol, enrichment levels, alleged weaponisation studies, US unilateral sanctions and the reliability of intelligence sources. Minister Verhagen answers that Iran's missile tests are publicly known, that enrichment figures indicate more efficient but fewer centrifuges, that the IAEA holds consistent information on alleged studies, and that he opposes extraterritorial unilateral sanctions while urging sanctions that spare the population.
For the rest, I refer you to the Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services.
Voor het overige verwijs ik u naar de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen en Veiligheidsdiensten.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het artikel «Marinefregat schakelt negen piraten uit» (ingezonden 17 maart 2010).

CDA MPs asked why nine pirates captured by a Dutch frigate were released rather than prosecuted, despite arrangements with Kenya, and about the status of a piracy tribunal and regional transfer agreements. The ministers explained that prosecution failed for lack of evidence and that the EU ordered release, and outlined ongoing efforts with Kenya, UNODC and other states to build prosecution capacity.
Prosecution of the suspects was considered, but this foundered on the lack of evidence.
Er is overwogen de verdachten te berechten, doch dit is gestrand op het ontbreken van bewijs.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat het werk van niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's) in Israël wordt bemoeilijkt door nieuwe wetgeving (ingezonden 11 m

An MP asked the foreign minister whether a proposed Israeli law requiring NGOs receiving foreign donations to register as political organisations and disclose foreign state funding would restrict their freedom and whether the Netherlands would raise it in the EU. The minister said the bill is still early in its process, expressed concern about stigmatisation, fiscal and free-speech effects, said the Netherlands opposes such regulation and will convey its views bilaterally and in the EU, but gave no concrete commitment to raise it at EU level.
The Dutch views on this are therefore conveyed to the Israeli authorities in contacts, both bilaterally and within the EU.
De Nederlandse opvattingen dienaangaande worden daarom ook in contacten met de Israëlische autoriteiten overgebracht, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mogelijkheid tot tijdelijke opvang van voortrekkers op het gebied van mensen

Mr Pechtold (D66) asked the ministers whether Iranian human rights defenders and dissidents could be temporarily admitted to the Netherlands, through visa flexibility, exchange schemes like Libertas, and the EU Shelter City initiative, and whether they should be kept out of asylum procedures. The minister acknowledged the serious human rights situation, said he is willing to examine options for supporting human rights defenders and Shelter Cities, but stated that individual visa assessments within existing law suffice and that asylum applications are not disclosed to Iranian authorities.
I am willing to examine what options the Netherlands has, within the margins of European and national visa policy, to accommodate human rights defenders and offer them a stay here.

Ik ben bereid om te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden Nederland heeft om, binnen de marges van het Europese en nationale visabeleid, mensenrechtenverdedigers tegemoet te komen en hier een verblijf aan te bieden.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie van de mensenrechten in Honduras (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asked the foreign minister about the human rights situation in Honduras under the new Lobo government, the murder of judge Olga Laguna, Dutch embassy support for rights organisations, EU policy, a Human Rights Watch report on killings of transgender people, and rising femicide. Minister Verhagen answered that the situation is precarious, described embassy-funded projects, said the Netherlands takes the HRW recommendations to heart and is monitoring developments, and noted the EU is considering resuming programmes.
The Netherlands takes the recommendations of that report to heart.
Nederland neemt de aanbevelingen van dat rapport ter harte.
Vragen van het lid Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over voedselhulp voor Somalië (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).
