An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether a UN Security Council monitoring report showing that much WFP food aid to Somalia is diverted by corrupt distributors and militants is accurate, whether a Dutch UN official was involved in concealing it, whether KPMG contracting was corrupt, and whether an independent inquiry should be launched. The minister answers that the report's findings still need discussion with the WFP, that a fundamental debate on aid modalities may follow if confirmed, that the UN Ethics Committee handles the official's conduct as an internal UN matter in which he has confidence, and that an independent inquiry could be useful only if investigators get access to primary sources.
The United Nations Ethics Committee, the designated body for investigating the conduct of UN staff, investigated the actions of the UNDP staff member during his posting in Nairobi.

Antwoord 3 en 5 Het United Nations Ethics Committee , het aangewezen orgaan voor onderzoek naar het gedrag van VN-medewerkers, heeft onderzoek gedaan naar het handelen van bedoeld UNDP-staflid tijdens diens plaatsing in Nairobi.
Vragen van de leden Schippers en Nicolaï (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over voedselhulp aan Somalië (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

MPs Schippers and Nicolaï asked the Foreign Minister about a UN report alleging that about half of EUR 357 million in donor food aid to Somalia was misallocated, possibly to armed opposition via wealthy businessmen, and about a lucrative visa trade enabling pirates and rebels to reach Europe. The minister said the findings still need discussion with the WFP and a thorough debate on aid modalities may follow, while stating the Dutch visa policy is strict and that Nederland raised the visa abuse within Schengen and maintains an Immigration Liaison Officer in Nairobi.
In the Schengen framework, the Netherlands has drawn attention to this abuse of visas and its harmful consequences.
Nederland heeft in Schengenverband aandacht gevraagd voor dit misbruik van visa en voor de schadelijke gevolgen hiervan.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een Israëlische universiteit op de Westbank en uitspraken van premier Netanyahu (ingezonden 29 j

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about Israel's plan to upgrade Ariel College to a university in the West Bank and Prime Minister Netanyahu's statements that settlements would remain part of Israel, including whether the government would protest, contact the US envoy Mitchell, raise the matter at EU level and contact Dutch universities. The minister answered that settlement expansion undermines trust, that Nederland repeatedly urges a full settlement freeze in EU and bilateral channels, that the EU and US coordinate, and that no cooperation exists between Dutch universities and the Ariel institutions, while noting that universities are autonomous.
The government considers joint action by the EU and the US in the Middle East peace process to be of the utmost importance.
De regering is van mening dat gemeenschappelijk optrekken van de EU en de VS in het MOVP van het grootste belang is.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over Gemeenschappelijk Visserijbeleid in niet Europese wateren (ingezonden 15 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about EU fisheries partnership agreements with non-EU countries, including payments to countries such as Mauritania and whether they hinder developing countries' self-reliance. The government answers by pointing to the Commission's published overview, arguing the agreements are not a fix for EU overcapacity, admitting mixed effects on developing countries, and committing to a review of the agreements' structure.
The Netherlands agrees with the Commission that the current structure of the EU agreements should be reviewed.
Nederland is het eens met de Commissie dat de huidige structuur van de EU-overeenkomsten tegen het licht moet worden gehouden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de opgepakte dierenactivist in Thailand (ingezonden 24 maart 2010)

MP Thieme asks the Foreign Minister about a Dutch animal activist in Thailand facing a defamation charge brought by a tiger temple abbot, and whether Thailand's free speech and CITES-related illegal tiger trade concerns warrant action. The minister replies that the activist can express views, the matter is for the courts, the embassy is monitoring it, and no grounds currently exist to raise concerns with the Thai government.
At this moment there is no reason to express concern about the course of events.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding zorg kenbaar te maken over de gang van zaken.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Knops (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over cyberaanvallen (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

MPs Haverkamp and Knops asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about a Times report on rising cyberattacks on NATO allies, China's role, weaker European cyber defences, NATO's Article 4 and the Strategic Concept, and progress on a motion for a cyber security strategy. The ministers confirmed the threat is growing, declined to discuss intelligence services' functioning publicly, said NATO information-security standards already ensure interoperability, and referred the motion question to a separate letter.
No public statements are made about the functioning of the security services.
Over het functioneren van veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de stilletjes aangenomen amnestiewet voor oorlogsmisdrijven in Afghanistan (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister about President Karzai quietly enacting an amnesty law covering war crimes in Afghanistan, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it and whether it undermines transitional justice and cooperation with the Karzai government. The minister answers that the law is regrettable, conflicts with international law on serious crimes, hampers transitional justice, and that the Dutch ambassador has raised concerns while dialogue with the Afghan government continues.
Actual application of the amnesty law complicates the process of transitional justice in Afghanistan.
Daadwerkelijke toepassing van de amnestiewet bemoeilijkt het proces van «transitional justice» in Afghanistan.

Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichtgeving dat de Turkse premier Erdogan door Saudi-Arabië wordt beloond voor zijn anti-westerse politiek (ingezonden 16 maart 2010)

An MP asks the foreign minister how he views Saudi Arabia awarding Turkish PM Erdogan a prize for service to Islam, and whether Erdogan's Hamas remarks justify halting Turkey's EU accession talks. The minister says the prize is a routine humanitarian-style award, the Hamas views are not new and do not warrant suspending accession talks, which depend on Turkey meeting all criteria.
This position is not, for me, a reason to halt the current EU accession negotiations.
Dit standpunt is voor mij geen aanleiding de huidige EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen te staken.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over onderdrukking van de oppositie in Cuba (ingezonden 19 maart 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister about the repression of Cuban opposition, including the detention of dissidents, protest arrests and the death of a hunger-striking dissident, and whether Cuba organised counter-demonstrations. The minister says Nederland has no information that the government organised the counter-demonstrations, calls the continued detention of dissidents distressing, says the EU and Netherlands have raised it repeatedly, and commits to keep pressing human rights in the EU dialogue with Cuba.
The Netherlands will continue to press for human rights in general, and these matters in particular, to receive attention in the EU's dialogue with Cuba.
Nederland zal er op blijven aandringen dat mensenrechten in het algemeen en deze zaken in het bijzonder aandacht krijgen in de dialoog van de EU met Cuba.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de nieuwe kieswet en mensenrechtenschendingen in Birma (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the new Burmese electoral law, imposed by the regime, will make the planned elections non-credible, and whether the Netherlands and EU will condemn it, press for Aung San Suu Kyi's release, support a UN human rights resolution citing crimes against humanity, and push for an early Group of Friends meeting. The minister agrees the law reduces electoral credibility, says the Netherlands favours a sharply critical EU statement and repeated calls for release and dialogue, says the EU resolution will reference the UN rapporteur's report, and says the UN Secretary-General will reconvene the Group of Friends on 25 March.
The Netherlands favours a sharply critical EU statement expressing disapproval of the new electoral law and the continuing human rights violations in Burma.
Nederland is voorstander van een scherp-kritische verklaring van de EU waarin afkeuring wordt uitgesproken over de nieuwe kieswet en de de voortdurende mensenrechtensschendingen in Birma.
Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Voordewind (CU) en Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Russische godsdienstwetgeving (ingezonden 8 maart 2010).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about reported Russian legislation that would restrict religious freedom, its status, Dutch protest options, and EU attention to religious minorities in Russia. The minister replied that no official bill has yet been tabled, so he sees no reason to comment on the content, and that religious freedom will be raised in the EU-Russia human rights dialogue if NGO contacts suggest it is needed.
There is not yet an official bill that has been submitted to the Russian parliament.
Er is nog geen officieel wetsontwerp dat aan het Russische parlement is voorgelegd.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Polderman (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over visserijrechten (ingezonden 4 februari 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the development minister about EU fisheries partnership agreements, including payments to Mauritania, whether they are a form of development aid, and what happens to unspent EU development funds. The minister answered that the payments partly fund sustainable fisheries policy and partly are licence fees paid directly by EU vessel owners, that the agreements have not yet sufficiently supported local fisheries, that these payments are not ODA-funded, and that unspent EDF funds roll over to later periods rather than being diverted.
In addition, the partnership agreements must support and strengthen the structural development of local fisheries sectors in the countries concerned.
Daarnaast moeten de partnerschapsovereenkomsten de structurele ontwikkeling van de locale visserijsectoren in betrokken landen ondersteunen en versterken.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Haverkamp (CDA) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van christenen in Marokko (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of 18 Christians at a Bible study in Morocco violates religious freedom, whether the government will raise it with Morocco, whether it sees reason to intensify attention to religious minorities there, and whether there are signs of a tougher policy under the new justice minister. The minister answered yes to the first two, said he protested to the Moroccan ambassador, referred back to an earlier answer on religious freedom in Morocco, and said the situation will be followed closely and that policy on missionary activity is primarily a public order matter for the Interior Ministry.
I will not fail to raise this issue in future contacts with Morocco and in the relevant fora.
Ik zal niet nalaten deze kwestie in toekomstige contacten met Marokko en in de relevante fora aan de orde te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hongerstakingen van Cubaanse dissidenten (ingezonden 8 maart 2010).

MP Ferrier (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the death of Cuban dissident Orlando Zapata after a hunger strike and the growing number of hunger strikes, and what the government will do in EU and UN settings. The minister said the Netherlands regrets the death, urged dissidents to end hunger strikes, raised the human rights situation in EU and UN fora, and said the EU Common Position on Cuba should be kept for now.
The Netherlands called on Cuba to release all political prisoners and to hasten the ratification and implementation of the international covenant on civil and political rights.

Nederland riep Cuba op om alle politieke gevangenen in vrijheid te stellen en haast te maken met de ratificatie en implementatie van het internationaal verdrag inzake burgerrechten en politieke rechten.

Vragen van het lid De Krom (VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het door Frankrijk weigeren van naturalisatie van een man die zijn vrouw dwingt een boerka te dragen (ingezonden 5 f

The MP asks whether France refused naturalisation to a Moroccan man who forces his wife to wear a burqa, on what legal basis, and how this fits international law and whether Dutch law allows similar refusals. The ministers answer that France's decision was individual and based on the applicant's stated views against laïcité and gender equality, that Dutch law allows refusal on comparable grounds under the integration requirement, and that no further action is announced.

Not obtaining the nationality of a country, even if one has lived there long-term and has family members who hold that nationality, is not inhuman or degrading treatment within the meaning of Article 3 ECHR.

Het niet verkrijgen van de nationaliteit van een land, ook als men langdurig in dat land woont en gezinsleden heeft die die nationaliteit wél bezitten, is geen onmenselijke of vernederende behandeling als bedoeld in artikel 3 EVRM.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV), Haverkamp (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de moord op meer dan 500 christenen in Nigeria (ingezonden 10 maart 2010).

MPs from SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister about reported killings of over 500 Christians near Jos, Nigeria, including causes, whether Islamisation or foreign funding is behind the violence, and what the Netherlands and EU can do. The minister answered that causes are complex and not solely religious, that the EU will issue a demarche and raise the issue at the Human Rights Council, and that the Mensenrechtenfonds can support prevention initiatives.
At the Netherlands' instigation, the EU will again make a demarche to the Nigerian authorities to convey serious concern about recent events in Jos.
Mede op instigatie van Nederland zal de EU bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten opnieuw een demarche uitvoeren om grote bezorgdheid over te brengen over de recente gebeurtenissen in Jos

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ontwikkelingen rondom de nucleaire activiteiten van Iran en het meest recente rapport van het IAEA (ingezonden 1 maart 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the latest IAEA report on Iran's nuclear activities, including whether intelligence services confirm it, what NPT articles are violated and what information Iran refuses to provide. The minister replied that Iran has made no progress, that the IAEA cannot confirm the programme is peaceful, that intelligence has been checked and will be briefed to parliament, and that a separate letter on Iran's nuclear programme would follow.
The Parliamentary Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services will receive a briefing from the AIVD and MIVD on Iran on 25 March 2010.
De Commissie voor de Inlichtingen en Veiligheidsdiensten zal op 25 maart 2010 van de AIVD en MIVD een briefing krijgen over Iran.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Iran werkt mogelijk aan kernkop» (ingezonden 23 februari 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares IAEA concerns that Iran may be developing nuclear weapons, whether Iran may ever possess one, and whether he will support sharper sanctions. The minister confirmed the IAEA concerns, said a nuclear military capacity would be unacceptable, and said the Netherlands backs a new UN Security Council resolution with targeted sanctions while keeping dialogue open.
The international community should therefore pursue sharp sanctions and concrete measures in a new UN Security Council resolution.
De internationale gemeenschap dient daarom in te zetten op scherpe sancties en concrete maatregelen in een nieuwe VN Veiligheidsraadsresolutie.

Vragen van het lid Sterk (CDA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Frankrijk het Franse staatsburgerschap heeft ontzegd aan een man die zijn vrouw dwong tot het dragen van een boe

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether France denied citizenship to a man who forced his wife to wear a burqa, whether such refusals are lawful under the European Nationality Convention, and whether the Netherlands should change its nationality law. The government confirmed the French refusal, said nationality rules are a national competence compatible with treaties, and said the Dutch naturalisation rules already allow refusal for lack of integration, so no change is needed.
No. The Dutch Nationality Act contains a norm comparable to the French one.
Neen. De Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap bevat een norm die vergelijkbaar is met de Franse norm.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp , Ferrier (beiden CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking en van Justitie over uitlatingen van Gretta

Four MPs asked ministers of Foreign Affairs, Development Cooperation and Justice about antisemitic statements by Gretta Duisenberg and about subsidies her foundation received via co-financing organisations, including whether subsidised organisations using antisemitic rhetoric should be excluded. The government condemned the remarks, clarified that a 2,500 euro grant came from a co-financed fund rather than the development budget, and said that whether organisations incite hatred is for the criminal courts to decide, with subsidies reclaimed only after a conviction.
If this leads to a conviction, it will also lead to the (partial) withholding or recovery of subsidy funds.
Indien dit leidt tot een veroordeling zal dat ook tot de (gedeeltelijke) inhouding of terugvordering van subsidiegelden leiden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Cqörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het rapport «Understanding Untouchability» in I

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Ćörüz asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the 'Understanding Untouchability' report on caste discrimination in India, asking for EU, bilateral, UN and business-sector action. The minister answered that Dutch human rights policy addresses discrimination based on work and descent, that the issue is raised in EU human rights dialogue and at the UN Human Rights Council, and committed to several concrete steps such as raising the Ambedkar Principles with business missions.
The Netherlands will continue to work to keep this topic on the EU agenda.
Nederland zal zich blijven inzetten dit onderwerp op de EU agenda te houden.
Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gesprekken tussen de VS en Nederland over eventuele terugtrekking van nucleaire wapens (ingezonden 8 maart 2010).

Van Dam (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether exploratory talks with the US about withdrawing US nuclear weapons from European soil are taking place, what the positions are, and whether the Netherlands will push for their removal. The minister answered that no such talks are being held, opposed unilateral steps, and said the Netherlands with four allies is pushing for a NATO debate on nuclear policy.
These talks are not being held.
Vragen van het lid Schippers (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulp aan Mongolië (ingezonden 25 februari 2010).

MP Schippers asked the foreign minister whether he knew of the reported famine and livestock deaths in Mongolia, what structural aid Mongolia receives, and whether emergency aid would be given. Minister Verhagen confirmed awareness, noted a roughly 7.2 million euro yearly environment and water programme, and said a 25,000 euro Red Cross contribution was made with no UN appeal yet launched.
The Netherlands closely follows the humanitarian emergency in Mongolia and has so far contributed 25,000 euro via the Dutch Red Cross from the Silent Disaster Fund.
Nederland volgt de humanitaire noodsituatie in Mongolië nauwgezet en heeft tot nu toe via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis uit het zogenaamde Stille Rampenfonds € 25 000 bijgedragen
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over christenen in Irak (ingezonden 2 maart 2010).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would press Iraq to thoroughly investigate killings of at least eight Christians in Mosul and what measures could protect Iraq's Christian minority, including any EU role. The minister replied that Iraqi authorities must investigate first and that the Netherlands and EU raise minority protection in ongoing human rights dialogue, humanitarian aid, and security-sector support.
It is first and foremost for the Iraqi authorities to investigate these matters.
Het is allereerst aan de Irakese autoriteiten om deze zaken te onderzoeken.

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about an EU delegation's limited mandate and access to Kandhamal, Orissa, the eviction of Christian refugees, the fast-track courts, rehabilitation of victims and Dutch support. The minister answered that the mission went ahead with Indian cooperation and covered a broad mandate, that the government will await the mission report on rehabilitation, and that Dutch support includes a project on access to justice for victims of religious violence.
Yes. I will inform you about that.
Ja. Ik zal u daarover informeren.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het stemadvies van Pakistan om op Pakistaanse kandidaten van de Nederlandse Moslim Partij en de partij Islam Democraten in D

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Pakistani embassy waiting-room leaflets urging votes for Pakistani candidates in The Hague municipal elections constituted improper foreign interference, and whether the Netherlands would retaliate. The minister confirmed such leaflets were found against instructions, said diplomatic missions should refrain from distributing election material, and reported the Pakistani ambassador promised stricter enforcement, while declining to take retaliatory steps.
The ambassador has promised to monitor even more strictly that unauthorised material is kept out of the waiting room of the Pakistani embassy.
De ambassadeur heeft toegezegd er nog strenger op toe te zien dat ongeoorloofd materiaal uit de wachtruimte van de Pakistaanse ambassade wordt geweerd.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de veroordeling van een VN-commissie over het proces tegen twee anti-walvisjachtactivisten in Japan. (ingezonden 19 februari 2010)

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he agrees with a UN Human Rights Council working group that the arrest and trial of two anti-whaling activists in Japan were arbitrary, and whether the Netherlands will convey support for that view to Japan. The minister noted the working group's opinion is authoritative but the Netherlands is not a party, so he draws no conclusions toward Japan, and he said he will raise the matter in human rights consultations and other contacts with Japan.
The Netherlands is however not a party to this case and I therefore see no reason in the ruling to draw conclusions in relation to Japan.
Nederland is echter geen partij in deze zaak en ik zie in de uitspraak dan ook geen aanleiding daaraan conclusies te verbinden in de relatie tot Japan.

An MP asks the minister whether local governments' donations to Haiti, made with public funds, should be overseen by the Algemene Rekenkamer, and questions whether citizens are being pressed to donate. The minister answers that municipalities and provinces decide autonomously and are accountable to elected councils, and that the Algemene Rekenkamer will advise on and audit accountability for aid spending.

The Algemene Rekenkamer will advise the Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the design of the accountability system, so that the use of aid to Haiti is clearly reported.

De Algemene Rekenkamer zal de Samenwerkende Hulporganisaties (SHO) en het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken adviseren over de opzet van de verantwoordingssystematiek, zodat goed inzicht wordt verstrekt in de besteding van de hulp aan Haïti.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een corruptieschandaal bij de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 16 februari 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about a corruption scandal in the Palestinian Authority, whether Dutch or EU funds were involved, and what role the Netherlands would play in addressing it. The minister replied that there are no indications Dutch or EU funds were misused, that controls on aid are strict, and that the Netherlands supports anti-corruption work and raises good governance in its contacts with the Palestinian Authority.
I have no indications that Dutch and/or EU money has been improperly used by the Palestinian Authority.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat Nederlands en/of EU-geld oneigenlijk is gebruikt door de Palestijnse Autoriteit.

MP De Roon asks the foreign minister whether he knows of reports that the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorists by naming streets after them, and whether this makes the PA unfit as a partner. The minister confirms the reports, rejects naming public places after terrorists, and says the PA has been clear against terrorism and that cooperation will continue.
The government will continue with this until the mentioned excesses belong to the past.
De regering zal hiermee doorgaan totdat genoemde uitwassen tot het verleden behoren.

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the foreign minister how the government views Palestinian officials glorifying terrorists, the impact on the peace process, and what pressure and sanctions will be applied. Minister Verhagen answered that the government condemns naming streets after terrorists and remains committed to the two-state solution, pointing to pressure exercised bilaterally and through the EU on both parties.
The government disapproves of naming squares, streets and public buildings after terrorists and regrets the statements cited.
De regering keurt het vernoemen van pleinen, straten en openbare gebouwen naar terroristen af en betreurt de aangehaalde uitlatingen.

MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked whether the government knows of Ugandan politicians' views on homosexuality, whether it will follow Sweden's call to suspend development aid over a bill imposing the death penalty for homosexuality, and how it is pressing Uganda on human rights. The minister confirmed awareness, rejected suspending aid as not on the table, and described diplomatic steps taken, including a letter to his Ugandan counterpart, an EU demarche and continued engagement with local NGOs.
The bill was introduced by a single parliamentary member and is currently under consideration in the Ugandan parliament.
Het wetsvoorstel is ingebracht door één parlementslid en ligt momenteel ter behandeling in het Ugandese parlement.

MPs Omtzigt and Haverkamp asked whether an agreement without restrictions on Belarusian children's recuperation trips to the Netherlands had been reached, and whether the age-14 restriction would be lifted quickly. The minister replied that Belarus removed the remaining obstacles on 28 January and that a presidential decree lifting all restrictions for countries with an agreement means no treaty is needed, so all children can now travel.
The government is pleased that now all children, without distinction, can come to the Netherlands.
De regering is verheugd dat nu alle kinderen, zonder onderscheid, naar Nederland kunnen komen

MPs Van der Ham, Gill'ard and Peters asked whether Uganda's proposed Anti-Homosexuality Bill, which would impose the death penalty and criminalise support for homosexuals, violates human rights and hampers HIV/AIDS prevention, and whether the EU or the Netherlands would make a demarche against it. The minister confirmed the concerns, reported an EU demarche of 3 December, a letter to the Ugandan minister and ongoing embassy contacts, and said the Netherlands would also act unilaterally.
Yes. My letter has been handed over by the Dutch ambassador in Kampala to the Ugandan Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Ja. Mijn brief is door de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kampala aangeboden aan de Ugandese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the killing and abduction of Christians in Mosul, whether it was coordinated and why Iraqi police did not intervene, and how the international community and Dutch police-training missions could better protect religious minorities. The minister confirmed awareness, said the motives were unclear and attacks unclaimed, denied evidence of police negligence, and said the Netherlands raises minority protection with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and in the UN Universal Periodic Review.
I have no information from which it should be concluded that the Iraqi police were negligent in trying to prevent the murder of these four Christians.
Ik beschik niet over informatie waaruit zou moeten worden geconcludeerd dat de Iraakse politie nalatig is geweest bij het trachten te voorkomen van de moord op deze vier christenen.

An MP asks the defence and foreign ministers whether a Dutch military presence in Uruzgan after 2010 is off the table, how the exit and handover to NATO are planned, what diplomatic efforts were made, and what options for future involvement in Afghanistan were considered. The government answers that it will carry out the withdrawal decision, that redeployment planning is underway, that NATO has yet to decide how to fill the lead-nation role, and that options were internal cabinet deliberations to be decided by the next cabinet.

Had this examination led to a decision to deploy military units as referred to in Article 100 of the Constitution, the government would have informed the House of it in accordance with the applicable rules and agreements.

Indien dit onderzoek geleid zou hebben tot een besluit over inzet van eenheden van de krijgsmacht zoals bedoeld in artikel 100 van de Grondwet, zou de regering de Kamer daarover overeenkomstig de geldende regels en afspraken geïnformeerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘(Oud-)topsporters noemen lagere inkomsten ‘ramp voor de clubs’: ‘Bezuinig niet op sport’’

Three MPs asked the minister about press reports that budget cuts threaten sport, including volunteer burden, the CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA proposals, gambling tax differentiation and the health costs of cutting sport. The state secretary answered that sport is valued and that a multi-year strategy and clearer information will follow, but gave no figures on the cuts and no firm commitment on the gambling-tax motion or a sports law.
As indicated in the letter of 2 April 2024, I aim to inform the House further on this before the legislative consultation on the Sport and Exercise budget item for 2025.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief 2 van 2 april 2024 streef ik ernaar uw Kamer hier voor het wetgevingsoverleg over begrotingsonderdeel Sport en Bewegen voor het jaar 2025, nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de gevolgen van budgetplafonds in de ggz

Dobbe (SP) asked the Minister about the effects of insurers' budget caps in mental health care, including administrative burden, patients left unhelped amid long waiting lists, and whether the caps will be abolished. Staatssecretaris Karremans answered that he lacks detailed insight into individual contracts, that caps can improve efficiency, that he does not share the view that fewer patients are helped, and that he will discuss accessibility with the sector without abolishing the caps.
In principle I am not aware of the agreements that individual health insurers and individual care providers make with each other in contracts.
In beginsel ben ik niet op de hoogte van de afspraken die individuele zorgverzekeraars en individuele zorgaanbieders in contracten met elkaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the government how it will respond to reports that residents near heavy industry pay on average 7 percent more in healthcare costs, and what it will do to protect them. The government says health effects of industry are known and points to the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, existing permit and enforcement reforms, and studies by RIVM, but rejects charging polluting firms directly for residents' healthcare costs.
That is therefore an incentive for the cabinet to work on further improving the living environment for residents near industry.
Dat is voor het kabinet dan ook een aansporing om te werken aan het verder verbeteren van de leefomgeving voor omwonenden van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Bushoff over de problemen bij het aanvragen van de financiële ondersteuning voor zorgmedewerkers met post-COVID

MPs Dijk (SP) and Bushoff (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Health about problems healthcare workers with post-COVID face applying for the one-off financial support, including slow DUS-I handling, missed objection deadlines, lost-looking documents and difficulty obtaining medical statements. Minister Agema largely acknowledges the problems and some delays while defending the scheme, saying the second application round is better resourced and that the Regeling was amended to address earlier gaps.
To my regret, the processing period for these objection cases has in many cases been exceeded.
Tot mijn spijt is de behandeltermijn van deze bezwaarzaken in veel gevallen wel overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat het Regionaal Autisme Centrum (RAC) in Helmond en Tilburg stopt met behandeling en het stellen van diagnoses bij 18-plussers

MP Dobbe asks the minister how the government responds to the closure of the Regionaal Autisme Centrum in Helmond and Tilburg for adults, and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The state secretary attributes the closure to staff shortages, points to insurer referral services, says the NZa and regional parties are responsible, and declines to meet regional providers and insurers.
It is for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to assess whether health insurers meet their duty of care.
Het is aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) om te beoordelen of zorgverzekeraars aan hun zorgplicht voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Fysiotherapeuten rennen het vak uit’ en het onderzoek van Fysiovakbond FDV

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that many physiotherapists are leaving first-line care, citing low tariffs, pay gaps, unpaid overtime and holiday pay problems. The Staatssecretaris answered that primary responsibility lies with employers and collective bargaining, that the government will pursue a package of measures and a five-year bundled-payment experiment, and declined to set or ring-fence tariffs.
It is, however, primarily the responsibility of employers to ensure they can attract and retain sufficient staff.
Het is wel primair een verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om ervoor te zorgen dat zij voldoende personeel weten aan te trekken én te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het bericht dat GGZ Friesland het Centrum voor Neuropsychiatrie uiterlijk per 1 juli 2024 sluit

An MP asked the minister about the closure of neuropsychiatry units at GGZ Friesland (CNP) and Altrecht (Vesalius), whether they were unprofitable, whether care capacity and regional spread are adequate, who is responsible, and whether the closures could have been prevented. The state secretary answered that closures had several causes (no continuous demand, no waiting list, portfolio and financial considerations), that patients were placed elsewhere, that responsibility lies with insurers and providers, and that no further investigation is needed, while a regional care-network approach is being developed.
I have no information on the treatment capacity of all clinical and outpatient neuropsychiatry departments in the Netherlands and cannot say whether there are plans to close these departments.

Ik heb geen informatie over de behandelcapaciteit van alle klinische en poliklinische afdelingen van neuropsychiatrie in Nederland en ik kan niet aangeven of er plannen zijn om deze afdelingen te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorginnovaties sneuvelen door financieringsregels'

An MP asks whether effective digital health apps such as Vertigo Training and URinControl should be freely available and how structural implementation barriers are addressed. The minister points to the Digizo.nu programme and IZA agreements for scaling up digital care, says reimbursement issues are assessed case by case, and commits to discussing the signal about advice from Zorgvoorinnoveren with that body.
I do not have the necessary information for that.
Ik beschik niet over de benodigde informatie daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat inspecties signaleren dat criminele netwerken de zorg hebben ontdekt

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers how they will respond to inspection findings that criminal networks have infiltrated healthcare through staffing agencies and fake diplomas, including whether oversight will be improved and whether profit-making in care should be curbed. The minister acknowledges the concern, promises to inform parliament in autumn about follow-up measures, rules out statutory profit caps on legal grounds, and proposes a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn.
Uw Kamer zal hier dit najaar over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan jongeren en volwassenen met eetstoornissen

An MP (Westerveld, GroenLinks-PvdA) asks what concrete steps have been taken since 2021 to improve care for people with eating disorders, including the effects of the 2021 €50m acute youth mental health funding, the status of regional expertise networks and Gezondheidsraad recommendations, and rising waiting times. The state secretary answers that K-EET networks, information tools and funding were developed, that national figures on treatment capacity are not kept, that waiting times rose due to structural shortages and a broad approach is needed, and points to a 2026 subsidy and other initiatives, without quantified targets or new monitoring commitments.
These figures are not kept at national level.
Deze cijfers worden niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de problemen bij Esdégé Reigersdaal

An SP MP asked about staff and relative complaints at the Esdégé Reigersdaal Klaverweide location, the failed mediation, whether the board and supervisory board take responsibility, and whether the IGJ and affected parties were consulted. The Staatssecretaris answered that the board is primarily responsible, that the IGJ is monitoring the situation and the organisation is working on improvement measures, and that individual IGJ cases cannot be disclosed.
The IGJ does not make any statements about the content of the reports or ongoing supervision.
Over de inhoud van de meldingen of lopend toezicht doet de IGJ geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zelfstandig wonen met ADL hulp

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about problems with ADL assistance for people living independently, including staff shortages, poor treatment, and unclear complaint routes. The State Secretary reported about 1,441 clients in 2023, around ten signals, a 6.9% tariff increase, a planned tariff review for 2025, and explained the complaint and oversight procedures (Wkkgz, IGJ, courts) while giving no data on vacancies' future or on 24-hour care gaps beyond general assurances.
I consider it important that ADL assistance is possible 24 hours a day.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er 24 uur per dag ADL assistentie mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat 73% van de zorgverleners aangeeft dat de tijd die ze aan administratie besteden de laatste vijf jaar is toegenomen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she responded to an FNV survey showing 73% of care workers report rising administrative time and to the low perceived follow-up on their complaints, and whether a more fundamental approach to bureaucracy is needed. The minister acknowledged the problem, defended the existing [Ont]Regel de Zorg programme and announced an intensified approach, but declined to commit to meeting the FNV, leaving it to her successor.
I leave it to my successor whether or not to enter into discussion with the FNV about the results of this research.
Ik laat het aan mijn opvolger al dan niet in gesprek te gaan met de FNV over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en van Nispen over de gestegen prijzen van zwemles

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the health minister about rising swimming lesson prices, the number of families supported by the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, funding for poor households and whether the minister will set targets to reduce children without swimming diplomas. The minister answered that the Jeugdfonds supported 20,707 children in 2023, but gave no exact figures for children in poverty, estimated costs of full funding at 3.5 to 10.5 million euro, and declined to commit to a target because swimming diplomas are primarily the parents' responsibility.
Obtaining swimming diplomas for children is primarily a responsibility of the parents.
Het behalen van zwemdiploma's door kinderen is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Vrees voor omvallen van Co-Med in Enschede: wie zouden 9.000 patiënten kunnen overnemen?'

Dutch MP Dijk (SP) asked the minister about the risk of Co-Med GP practices collapsing, leaving about 9,000 patients without a GP, plus related questions on private equity, a motion for a ban and the ministry's contingency plans. The minister said the insurers have terminated Co-Med contracts and offered an alternative, that the IGJ and NZa are monitoring daily, and that the government sees insufficient grounds for a private-equity ban, while promising to send internal documents on Co-Med after the April bankruptcy.
I will send your House the requested internal documents as soon as possible on developments at Co-Med after the bankruptcy on 16 April 2024 of PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam.
Ik zal uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk de gevraagde ambtelijke stukken sturen over ontwikkelingen bij Co-Med na het faillissement op 16 april 2024 van PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het bericht ‘Faillissement dreigt nu ook voor zorg-bv huisartsenketen Co-Med’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the threatened bankruptcy of the GP chain Co-Med, its effect on patient access, and whether private profit conflicts with quality of care and whether merger control should be tightened. The Minister says the insurers have terminated contracts, an alternative offer is in place, the IGJ imposed a penalty order, and the government will broaden the grounds for blocking concentrations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Bushoff en Bikker over het bericht ‘Overheid wilde vooral niet te veel uitgeven aan compensatie ‘zorghelden’ met long covid’

MPs Dijk, Bushoff and Bikker asked whether the government deliberately limited compensation for healthcare workers with long COVID to contain costs, and why the claim process was so burdensome and so few were compensated. The minister answers that the scheme was a gesture of recognition rather than driven by cost or litigation, acknowledges the application process was strict, and announces a reopened application window with a higher amount and wider sick-leave period.
The cost aspect never played a central role in this.
Het kostenaspect heeft hierbij nooit vooropgestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Voor miljarden aan zorgfraude gepleegd, maar pakkans nihil: ’En zorgpremies stijgen steeds meer’

The MP Dobbe asks the minister how the government will tackle healthcare fraud, whether market organisation of care and open-house constructions make fraud easier, and whether budget cuts combined with billions lost to fraud is consistent. The minister answers that fraud will be addressed through the Wbsrz, the Wibz bill and extended licensing, rejects the claim that cuts double-hit care, and says the Wibz bill and a study on open-house models are underway, while rejecting a ban on profit distribution and the claim that abolishing market forces would reduce fraud.
I find it reprehensible that public healthcare funds are being abused and that patients are the victims.
Ik vind het verwerpelijk dat er misbruik wordt gemaakt van publieke zorggelden en dat patiënten daar de dupe van worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het artikel ‘Onderzoek onthult: ziekenhuizen missen menselijke prestaties als oorzaak medische fouten’

An MP asks the minister whether the Inspectorate for Healthcare and Youth (IGJ) should weigh human and organisational performance factors in analyses of medical errors, and whether verbetermaatregelen are sufficiently specific and measurable. The minister replies that the IGJ already attends to human factors and context, pushes for SMART improvement measures and a learning culture, and that the Safety II programme addresses performance variability.
The IGJ asks for SMART (Specific, Measurable, Acceptable, Realistic, Time-bound) improvement measures and tests these in the conversations described earlier.
De IGJ vraagt om SMART (Specifiek, Meetbaar, Acceptabel, Realistisch, Tijdgebonden) verbetermaatregelen en toetst deze tijdens eerder beschreven gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars overstappers belemmeren waardoor de premie onnodig hoog is

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that health insurers hinder switching, keeping premiums unnecessarily high, and about the effects on low-income groups, market oversight and basic-policy complexity. The minister acknowledges the issue, points to NZa information rules and planned exploration of more active notification, says no research into income groups will be commissioned, and notes that investigations by ACM and NZa are independent and confidential.
I will not commission research into the switching behaviour of different income groups.
Ik zal geen onderzoek uitzetten naar het overstapgedrag van verschillende inkomensgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat het budget voor de subsidieregeling Stimulering bouw en onderhoud sportaccommodaties (BOSA) voor dit jaar al bijna op is

An MP asked whether the 2024 budget for the BOSA sports-facility subsidy scheme would run out soon, and whether sports clubs would face higher contributions as a result. The minister confirmed demand far exceeds the €79 million ceiling, raised the ceiling to €111.5 million via a cash shift and a transfer from another scheme, said applications will close on 1 August, and promised to inform parliament on a sustainable future budget in the autumn.
The number of applications and the amounts already granted now exceed the €79 million initially available for the BOSA scheme.
Het aantal aanvragen en de reeds toegekende aanvragen overstijgen inmiddels de € 79 miljoen die aanvankelijk beschikbaar was voor de BOSA-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden sportclubs niet meer kunnen verduurzamen

MPs Van Dijk, Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the minister about reports that hundreds of sports clubs cannot sustainably upgrade their facilities because the BOSA subsidy budget is exhausted, and about whether the budget should be increased. The minister answered that the budget ceiling for 2024 is raised from 79 to 111.5 million euro, that demand still exceeds it, and that the application portal closes on 1 August.
The subsidy ceiling for 2024 is thus raised in total from 79 million euro to 111.5 million euro.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Jos de Blok: ‘VWS en NZa hebben Buurtzorg stelselmatig buitengesloten’'

An SP MP asked the minister whether VWS and the NZa excluded Buurtzorg, why Omaha was not used for home-care funding, and whether client profiles are more burdensome than alternatives. The minister answered each question, saying talks with Buurtzorg will continue, that Omaha was judged unsuitable for funding linkage, and that client profiles are only a supporting tool, with the registration obligation to be dropped per the Joseph-Agema motion.
I will also, when the experiment continues in modified form following the Joseph-Agema motion adopted by your House, contact field parties again, including Buurtzorg.

Ik zal ook bij het vervolg van het experiment, dat gewijzigd zal worden naar aanleiding van de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie Joseph-Agema 3 , weer contact opnemen met veldpartijen, waaronder Buurtzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Deel huisartsen zwicht voor druk ouders en scholen bij voorschrijven ADHD-medicatie’

MPs Tielen and Van Eijk asked about reports that some GPs yield to parent and school pressure to prescribe ADHD medication, and about diagnosis and prescription trends, the ADHD misuse programme, referrals to specialist mental health care, and medical certificates. The minister says the government takes pressure on GPs seriously, points to 'Meer Tijd voor de Patiënt', the Gezonde Focus programme (focused mainly on students) and tables of diagnoses, prescriptions and referrals, but does not commit to new research on referral growth or to studying doctors' pressure around medical certificates.
I cannot provide an overview of the number of referrals to specialist mental health care since 2010 broken down by age group.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven over het aantal doorverwijzingen naar de specialistische ggz sinds 2010 uitgesplitst naar leeftijdsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat het aantal mensen in Nederland met gonorroe flink doorstijgt

MP Paulusma asked the ministers about the rise in gonorrhoea and falling condom use among young people, and about access to STI care, prevention campaigns, municipal funding and sexual health education. The State Secretary answered that the trends are worrying but not yet calling for acute action, that further research and policy decisions on sexual health care are pending for a next cabinet, and that no measures were accelerated.
Decision-making on the system and financing of (supplementary) sexual health care, however, is left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over het stelsel en financiering van de (aanvullende) seksuele gezondheidszorg is echter aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de aanpak van zorgfraude in Tilburg

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the minister how the government responds to reports that Tilburg's fraud enforcement against care providers was arbitrary, whether providers can defend themselves, and whether national bodies should take over care fraud oversight from municipalities. The minister says legal remedies (objection, appeal, ombudsman, civil claims) exist, points to joint measures and pilot projects, and rejects a centralised approach, while noting that excessive profit distribution will be tackled through a bill.
If there is a decision as referred to in the General Administrative Law Act, legal remedies such as objection and (higher) appeal are open within the administrative law framework.
Indien sprake is van een besluit als bedoeld in de Awb, dan staan er binnen de bestuursrechtelijke kaders rechtsmiddelen open zoals bezwaar en (hoger) beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over toezicht op WIC te Balkbrug

The MP asks the Minister how the inspectorate (IGJ) has monitored and improved conditions at the WIC shelter in Balkbrug after a warning that it did not meet safe-care standards, and what happens if no improvement is visible. The Minister says the WIC has been taken over by Elah, the last IGJ visit was on 12 May 2023, the IGJ keeps contact with the provider and will continue to follow whether shortcomings are remedied, without giving concrete new enforcement steps.
The inspectorate has maintained interim contact with WIC to monitor progress on the necessary improvements and the takeover process.
De inspectie heeft tussentijds contact met WIC gehouden om voortgang op de benodigde verbeteringen en het overnameproces te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het optreden van de Atletiekunie na mogelijk seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een atleet

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about how the Atletiekunie handled alleged sexual boundary-crossing behaviour by an athlete, including whether victims feel free to report to the ISR and whether the federation acted within disciplinary rules. The minister answered that the case is pending before the ISR and cannot be commented on, that victims can report through several channels, and that the ISR professionalisation progress will be covered in a letter before summer.
This concerns an ongoing case under investigation by the ISR, and as Minister I can make no statement or judgment about it.
Dit betreft een lopende zaak in onderzoek bij het ISR en daar kan ik als Minister geen mededeling of een uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Hermans over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about a report that at least 172 people died from taking suicide powder Middel X, and about prevention, registration and legal options. The minister says the research shows diverse victims, keeps the current access-limiting code rather than tightening it, and promises further study, a Wtl evaluation and changes to forensic autopsy powers.
I do not intend to further tighten the threshold-raising policy.
Gelet hierop ben ik niet voornemens om het drempelverhogend beleid verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over De toename van geweld in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would respond to NU'91's call for work stoppages after violence against care workers, why safety measures are often missing, what steps she takes, and whether she knows the root causes of rising violence. The minister supports the work stoppage initiative, points to employers' Arbowet duties and a sector-based approach, promotes filing police reports, but says she knows of no research into root causes and will not commission it given the caretaker cabinet.
I am not aware of any research into the underlying causes of aggression in care.
Er is mij geen onderzoek bekend naar de onderliggende oorzaken van agressie in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de subsidieregeling Stimulering bouw en onderhoud van sportaccommodaties (BOSA)

The MP asks for an update on the BOSA sports-facility subsidy scheme (spending, pending applications, remaining budget), whether it is adequate, and whether sports clubs can still get funding to become more sustainable. The minister reports applications of 122.2 million euros against a 79 million budget, raises the 2024 ceiling to 111.5 million via a cash shift and a transfer from DUMAVA, and says new applications will be refused once the ceiling is reached and will not be carried into 2025.
The 2024 subsidy ceiling is thereby raised in total from 79 million euros to 111.5 million euros.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Mohandis over het bericht dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak nog steeds niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit en dit tegenstrijdig is met valpreventie beleid

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Mohandis asked whether stairlifts installed via the Wmo often fail Bouwbesluit safety minimums, whether the ministry's guidance is being used, and whether compliance can be a GALA funding condition, among nine questions. The minister said no signals of widespread non-compliance were received, that enforcement and compliance are municipal responsibilities under the decentralised Wmo and Woningwet, and that the guidance is voluntary and not a GALA condition, while committing to ensure the VNG repromotes the guidance.
Under the Wmo 2015, the municipality (as client and owner) must ensure that the stairlift complies with all regulations, including the Bouwbesluit.
Op grond van de Wmo 2015 moet de gemeente (zijnde opdrachtgever en eigenaar) zich verzekeren dat de traplift voldoet aan alle regelgeving waaronder het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Teunissen over het artikel 'Nederland vormt belangrijke spil in illegale handel bedreigde diersoorten'

MPs Eerdmans and Teunissen asked the ministers how the government responds to a SPOTS/IUCN/Bears in Mind/ELI report that the Netherlands is a hub for illegal trade in endangered species used in traditional Chinese medicine, and what enforcement steps follow. The government answered that one suspect has been arrested by the NVWA investigation service, that enforcement is ongoing, that budgets and capacity are constrained but not quantified, and that it will pursue EU and international coordination while declining to give operational details of ongoing investigations.
In the interest of the investigation, the NVWA-IOD does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
In het belang van de opsporing doet de NVWA-IOD geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de ontstane situatie bij de zorglocatie Abel Tasman in Heerhugowaard

An SP MP asked the health minister about unrest, dismissals and forced transfers of staff at care location Abel Tasman in Heerhugowaard, and its effect on care quality, including why staff worked months without a clustermanager. The minister said the board is responsible, the inspectorate (IGJ) was aware of the problems before the press reports and is monitoring, and the provider reports interim staffing measures and recruitment.
The IGJ cannot make substantive statements about the ongoing supervision.
Over het lopende toezicht kan de IGJ geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Valkenburgse raad bezorgd om sluiting mosaqua

An MP asked the health minister about the possible closure of the Mosaqua swimming pool in Gulpen-Wittem, its regional role, swimming lesson capacity and alternatives for vulnerable groups. The minister said alternatives exist in neighbouring municipalities and that the closure decision is a local responsibility weighing demographic and cost factors.
This is a local responsibility and consideration.
Dit is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid en afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het falende communicatiesysteem voor medische noodhulp in Overijssel

An MP asked the ministers whether the new communication system for emergency medical care in Overijssel, which makes ambulances and trauma helicopters unreachable, is acceptable, how many incidents occurred, and why the decentralised system was chosen and not acted on earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ received only two PTT complaints and no incident reports, that the regional ambulance service chose the app, and that a kwartiermaker is working on the broader missiekritische communicatie problem.
Recently, no reports about PTT have been received by the IGJ.
Recent zijn er geen meldingen bij de IGJ over PTT binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Huisartsenpraktijk in Anna Paulowna al drie weken dicht: 45 meldingen bij inspectie’

An MP asked the minister about the sudden, prolonged closure of a GP practice in Anna Paulowna, the duties of practices toward patients, the insurer's role, and the inspectorate's order to Co-Med, including whether Co-Med should keep taking over practices. The minister answered that continuity of care is paramount, that patients were informed and can use another location, that the NZa and insurer VGZ are monitoring and seeking alternatives, and that a power to temporarily block takeovers will be detailed and sent to parliament soon.
For that reason the IGJ has issued Co-Med a directive.
Om die reden heeft de IGJ Co-Med een aanwijzing gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over een via Nederland verspreide tuberculose-uitbraak bij apen die als proefdier worden gebruikt

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers why parliament was not informed of a tuberculosis outbreak in laboratory macaques imported via the Netherlands, and about the import and export controls on such animals. The minister replied that the risk to public health was negligible, that no enforcement was needed because the importer broke no rules, that the import trade continues because research still needs these animals, and that the answers came late.
Infections with (possible) zoonoses in kept or wild animals are found more often. We do not report every infection to you, only where it may have consequences for public health.

Het komt vaker voor dat er besmettingen met (mogelijke) zoönosen bij gehouden of wilde dieren worden aangetoond. We melden u niet elke besmetting, alleen waar dat mogelijk gevolgen voor de volksgezondheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over de berichten inzake het diabetesmedicijn Ozempic

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the rising off-label prescribing of Ozempic for weight loss, its shortages, IGJ enforcement of advertising and prescribing rules, and whether the Advertising Code Commission can review newspaper promotion. The minister answered that the IGJ enforces the Medicines Act, that promotion of Ozempic for weight loss likely breaches the rules, and that no instruction to the IGJ is needed, while declining to tighten off-label prescribing in general.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to give an instruction on this.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet nodig hierop een aanwijzing te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over gezondheidsrisico’s door het nog tien jaar toelaten van glyfosaat

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the ten-year re-approval of glyphosate ignores possible health risks such as Parkinson's, and whether the precautionary principle should apply. The minister replied that the Zembla broadcast revealed no new facts, that no causal link to Parkinson's is established, that research with RIVM is being pursued, and that EFSA found safe use possible, while the Netherlands abstained in the EU vote.
That is why I am, together with the Minister of LNV, pursuing additional research by the RIVM into a possible link between Parkinson's disease and plant protection products.
Daarom zet ik samen met de Minister van LNV in op aanvullend onderzoek door het RIVM naar een mogelijk verband tussen de ziekte van Parkinson en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het blokkeren van een Twitter account van een arts

An FVD MP asked whether a VWS official emailed Facebook asking it to forward to Twitter a doctor's posts about COVID so the account might be blocked, and whether VWS requested blocking of social media accounts. The government confirmed the email was sent to Facebook and the IGJ, said it only asked Twitter to be alerted to the doctor's statements rather than requesting a block, and that VWS handles reports like any other user and has no power to request account blocks.
The Ministry of VWS has no authority to make a request to block social media accounts.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verzoek te doen tot blokkeren van socialmedia-accounts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ''Zo wil niemand leven', zegt zorgexpert over verwaarloosde Renny'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Renny, a care recipient with complex needs, lives in neglectful conditions despite a 2019 warning, and about possible links to budget cuts in long-term care. The Minister called the situation distressing, said IGJ was informed, a new multidisciplinary meeting was scheduled, and denied any cuts to disability care while acknowledging reversal of certain cuts.
The IGJ makes no further statements about ongoing supervision or reports.
Over lopend toezicht/meldingen doet de IGJ geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht 'Rechter gefrustreerd: klinieken willen verward persoon niet opnemen'

Two SP MPs asked, after a court ruling, how the government will ensure a man with a court-ordered care measure is placed in a secure care facility rather than left homeless, and what is being done about the wider placement problem. The minister answered that a place was found and the man admitted from 29 March 2024, acknowledged that secure specialist places are scarce, and said a work agenda and a letter on the Wzd and forensic care alignment will follow before summer.
As far as we are aware, that information is also not registered.
Voor zover ons bekend wordt die informatie ook niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Renny wordt verwaarloosd in zorginstelling: ‘Onbeschrijflijk lijden’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that a client named Renny was neglected in a care institution, whether this affects other clients, why a 2019 CCE consultation report was not followed up, and whether the IGJ has enough capacity to oversee such cases. The minister answers that the care provider is working on improvement, that the IGJ is informed and prioritises on risk, and declines to give exact numbers of affected clients or of unfollowed reports.
The IGJ makes no further statements about ongoing supervision or reports.
Over lopend toezicht/meldingen doet de IGJ geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'MST en ZGT raken hun patiënten niet kwijt en lopen daardoor miljoenen aan omzet mis'

The SP MP Dijk asked the minister about reports that patients stay too long in hospital because discharge to nursing homes, rehabilitation or home care is blocked, and about related costs and capacity. The minister answered all eleven questions, saying the data on the number of affected patients and net savings is not available, and pointing to care coordination and existing agreements.
I have no insight into the net saving per patient because part of the information needed to calculate it is missing.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de netto besparing per patiënt omdat een deel van de informatie, om dit te berekenen, ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Eijk over het bericht ‘Onveilig sportklimaat en machtsmisbruik bij gewichthefbond’

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports of an unsafe sports climate and abuse of power at the Dutch weightlifting federation, including when NOC*NSF received complaints and started an investigation, whether reporters were contacted about the findings, and when the Commission on an independent integrity centre would be delivered. The minister answered that complaints date from 2020, an independent investigation ran from February 2023 to December 2023, reporters have been kept informed and can contact NOC*NSF, and the Chamber will be informed on the integrity centre before the summer recess.
I expect to inform the Chamber before the summer recess on the progress of preparing legislation for the independent integrity centre.
Ik informeer de Kamer naar verwachting voor het zomerreces over de voortgang van de voorbereiding van wetgeving voor het onafhankelijke integriteitscentrum.
Antwoorde op vragen van het lid Paulusma over mogelijke sluiting van vakken bij de KNVB Bekerfinale
