An MP from D66 asked the government whether closing whole sections of De Kuip at the KNVB Cup final would reduce supporter tickets, and whether the government would engage with the KNVB and supporters' collective on ticket allocation and targeting of collective sanctions. The minister replied that ticket allocation and section closures are the responsibility of the KNVB and the local authorities, not the national government, and pointed to the existing Regiegroep and an update to follow after the 2023-2024 season figures.
Closing sections is the responsibility of the local triangle and the KNVB. The national government has no role in this.
Het sluiten van vakken is de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale driehoek en de KNVB. Hier heeft de Rijksoverheid geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply. The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht over grote verschillen in verslavingszorg

An MP asked the minister about reports of large quality differences in addiction care, patients receiving no care through cherry-picking, and the gap between people with addiction and those receiving treatment. The state secretary acknowledged the signals, pointed to insurers' duty of care and IGJ supervision, and promised a response to the NRV annual report before summer.
As promised in the aforementioned letter, the cabinet will send your House a response to the NRV annual report before the summer recess.
Zoals toegezegd in bovengenoemde brief zal het kabinet uw Kamer voor het zomerreces een reactie op het jaarverslag van de NRV aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten de nieuwe norm voor grotere schoolpleinen niet meenemen in beleid

SP MPs asked whether the government will act on reports that municipalities are not applying the new norm for larger school playgrounds in their policy, and whether they will discuss this with the VNG and school associations or fund larger playgrounds. The minister replied that the norm is a non-binding guideline, that space trade-offs are a municipal responsibility, that the government will discuss it with the VNG and school associations, and that municipal funds are freely spendable.
It is possible that municipalities sometimes get into difficulty in this area and have to make choices.
Het is mogelijk dat gemeenten soms in de knel komen op dit vlak en keuzes moeten maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Welzijn over het artikel ‘Zeker negen gezondheidscentra in conflict met commerciële huisbaas'

MPs Jansen and Welzijn asked the minister about reports that health centres are in conflict with commercial landlords over maintenance costs and rent increases, and whether this threatens access to care. The minister said the lease terms are unknown, that practices are primarily responsible for their own housing, that commercial leasing can be acceptable, and that he will provide an updated housing guidance by end 2024 without committing to structural measures.
The content of the lease in this case is not known to me, so I cannot go into this specific case substantively.
De inhoud van de huurovereenkomst in deze casus is mij niet bekend, dus ik kan niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Recordaantal meldingen van personen met verward gedrag in 2023' en 'Duizenden kwetsbaren wachten op plek beschermd wonen'

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of health and justice about rising reports of people with confused behaviour reaching police and about waiting lists for protected housing, asking whether ggz shortages and funding cuts cause these trends. The minister answered all 14 questions in substance, rejecting a causal link to ggz capacity and maximum waiting times, while acknowledging long waits and listing existing programmes.

I do not have data on how many homeless people who come into contact with the police over confused behaviour are on a waiting list for protected housing or have previously been admitted to a ggz institution.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel mensen die dakloos zijn en in aanraking komen met politie vanwege verward gedrag, op een wachtlijst voor beschermd wonen staan of eerder opgenomen zijn geweest in een ggz-instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het stoppen van basis geestelijke gezondheidszorg door een grote zorgaanbieder

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked the minister how the regional mental health care provider Lentis's decision to stop basic mental health care in Groningen would affect patients and capacity, and why regional bodies were not informed. The minister acknowledged the decision, said Lentis no longer accepts new basic care clients and referred patients elsewhere, and said that oversight of regional capacity is primarily the task of health insurers, not the Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel ‘GGz Breburg wil verder met mentale gezondheidscentra, maar het systeem stokt’

MP Van den Hil asked the Minister of Health about reports that mental health centres' 'verkennend gesprek' (exploratory conversation) model is stalling for lack of funding, and whether IZA transition funds can bridge 2024. The Minister agrees the model is valuable, says 2024 funding runs via an existing facultative performance and a 2025 separate performance is being pursued, notes transition funds cannot cover patient-bound care, and commits to pushing for a solution.
To arrange funding from 2025, I aim to submit a directive to the NZa to both chambers as soon as possible.
Om de bekostiging per 2025 te regelen streef ik ernaar om zo snel mogelijk een aanwijzing aan de NZa voor te hangen bij beide Kamers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode

An FVD MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether it is correct that she cannot say with certainty if a doctor publicly denying that climate change threatens health breaches the KNMG code, how doctors can know this, whether this violates lex certa, and how doctors can still speak freely. The minister replies that the code's core rule allows justified deviation, that doctors must judge this themselves, that the code is self-regulation not binding on disciplinary judges, and that the IGJ acts only when statements pose a public health danger.
Self-regulation does not have the same legal status as legislation or court rulings.
Zelfregulering heeft niet dezelfde juridische status als wetgeving of rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het weigeren openbaar te maken van declaraties zorgbestuurders

An MP asked the health minister whether hospital executives who refuse to make their expense claims public should be compelled by law to account for public funds, and why the NZa does not supervise their claims. The minister said executives should be transparent but relied on industry self-regulation and talks with sector bodies, calling legislation a last resort and stating the Governance Code Zorg has no direct legal basis for enforcement.
I consider a law to regulate this a last resort.
Ik vind een wet om dit te regelen een ultimum remedium.

Antwoord op vragen van het leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Koekkoek over de berichten 'Steeds meer arbeidsmigranten op straat: 'De opvang moet humaner'', 'Een half miljoen arbeidsmigranten: uitbuiting en maatschappelij

MPs from CDA and Volt asked the ministers about media reports on homeless EU labour migrants, including causes, the BRP temporary address registration, the legal-entitlement tool for municipalities, language barriers and WW benefits, and measures against exploitation. The government answered that the numbers are uncertain and being monitored via a new census, that causes are varied and mostly personal, that a legal tool and a short-stay pilot are underway, and that existing measures such as the agency-licensing bill and the labour-market reform are the route forward.
The cabinet recognises the signals that the legal reality regarding the rights of EU citizens is complex.
Het kabinet herkent de signalen dat de juridische werkelijkheid ten aanzien van de rechten van EU-burgers complex is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Palmen over een sociaal veilige werkomgeving voor Rijksambtenaren

MPs Chakor and Palmen asked about a FNV manifesto and report alleging bullying, harassment and weak accountability for misconduct at the Ministry of VWS, including whether managers are sidelined and whistleblowers protected. The Minister says the ministry takes the signals seriously, cites a 2022/2023 staff survey, a new survey started in March 2024, whistleblower protections and rijksbrede initiatives, while rejecting claims of a cover-up culture.
A new staff survey (started 11 March 2024), specifically on social safety and conduct, will hopefully give a sharper and more complete picture of the problems and direction for additional actions.

Een nieuw uit te voeren medewerkersonderzoek (gestart op 11 maart 2024), specifiek gericht op het thema sociale veiligheid en omgangsvormen, geeft hopelijk een scherper en completer beeld van de problemen en richting voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over “Ik bied u mijn oudere handen aan het bed. Maar waarom moet ik dan opnieuw leren rekenen.”

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the health minister about barriers facing older career changers entering care work, including repeated language and maths requirements for mbo training. The minister agreed that entry should be low-threshold, pointed to certificate modules, exemption rules and TAZ programme steps, and promised a progress report before summer.
It is important that entry into care is as low-threshold as possible, while the quality of care is guaranteed.
Het is van belang dat de (zij)instroom in de zorg zo laagdrempelig mogelijk is, waarbij de kwaliteit van zorg gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over de levensgevaarlijke situatie die kan ontstaan bij de sluiting van de geboortezorg in Zoetermeer

An MP asks the health minister about the risks to mothers and babies if the acute obstetric unit at HagaZiekenhuis Zoetermeer closes, including longer travel times, capacity pressure and ambulance strain. The minister replies that no decision has been taken yet, that three studies inform the decision, that the hospital and insurers are responsible, and that the minister has no legal instrument to prevent a closure.
I have no role and no legal instruments to prevent a closure as Minister.
Ik heb als Minister geen rol en geen juridische instrumenten om een sluiting te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over sportverenigingen die alleen met ondersteuning van onder meer betaalde krachten blijven functioneren

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to research showing sports clubs get little support on regulation, sustainability and sports climate, and to NOC*NSF's call for structural paid support for volunteers, and how the Sportakkoord II and Human Capital Agenda address this. The minister answered that support on these themes can ease club practice, listed sport and movement counters, budgets and programmes for volunteer management, and described the Human Capital Agenda's aims, without any commitment to new oversight or powers.
I am of the view that providing support on the mentioned themes can simplify the daily practice of board members.
Ik ben van mening dat het bieden van ondersteuning op de genoemde thema's de dagelijkse praktijk van de bestuurders kan vereenvoudigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen en voorzieningen voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asks the Minister of Health about repair delays for mobility aids, the legal service standards that apply, whether a single desk or a hire pool should be set up, and tax and subsidy arrangements for aids. The Minister says no statutory repair deadlines will be introduced, responsibility lies with insurers, municipalities and care offices, and she will urge those parties to clarify their arrangements.
I will call on these parties to make the arrangements they make more transparent to users of aids.
Ik zal deze partijen oproepen de afspraken die zij maken beter inzichtelijk te maken voor de gebruikers van hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het CBS-rapport inzake aanvullende sterftecijfers

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health whether a CBS report on additional mortality figures supports claims that vaccination raises short-term death risk and that the 2021 COVID death decline was due to natural immunity, and why a new vaccination campaign is planned. The Minister rejected these readings, stating the CBS finds vaccination associated with lower COVID death risk and that no meaningful conclusions can be drawn for early 2021, and referred to an earlier letter for the campaign decision.
I see no reason to doubt this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hieraan te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Diederik van Dijk over patiënten die het Amsterdam UMC aansprakelijk stellen voor schade na gezichtsoperaties

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked the minister about patients holding Amsterdam UMC liable for harm after facial surgeries, including allegations of pressure, incomplete risk information and whether the IGJ should investigate. The minister answered all 13 questions in substance, saying the IGJ sees no reason to investigate, that the care is medically indicated and individually decided, and that the quality standard is being evaluated.
From my position I cannot go into individual files that are before the court.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie niet ingaan op individuele dossiers die zich onder de rechter bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over de brief van Stichting Zeeuwse Zorgschakels aangaande casemanagement dementie die is gestuurd aan alle relaties

An MP asks the minister about a letter from a Zeeland care foundation warning that independent dementia case management may be absorbed into large home-care organisations, raising concerns about independence and loss of shared expertise. The minister answers that independence is guaranteed by the Zorgstandaard Dementie regardless of employer, that shared knowledge should be kept, and commits to commissioning a costing study of dementia case management.
I assume that dementia case management is provided independently in accordance with the Zorgstandaard Dementie 2020.
Ik ga ervan uit dat casemanagement dementie onafhankelijk wordt geleverd conform de Zorgstandaard Dementie 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel ‘Gendersensitieve aanpak nog onvoldoende aanwezig in bestaand beleid, gemeenten en Rijksoverheid aan zet’

Parliamentary questions from MP Paulusma (D66) asked about the application of the gender quality requirement and gender test in policy-making, following a College voor de Rechten van de Mens article. The minister answered that the gender test is not mandatory to report, so its use cannot be tracked, that responsibility lies with individual ministries, and that ZonMw research on gender effects in policy will be delivered in 2024.
The policy compass does not require the gender test to be included in the explanatory memorandum or policy document.
Het beleidskompas verplicht niet tot het opnemen van de gendertoets in de memorie van toelichting of beleidsnota.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Agema over de reactie op de kamerbreed aangenomen motie Eerdmans en Agema over het zo snel mogelijk onderbrengen van psychiatrische patiënten zonder strafblad in een instelling

MPs Eerdmans and Agema asked the health minister how the government responded to a motion to move psychiatric patients without a criminal record out of TBS clinics, and why parliament was not informed earlier. The minister answered that roughly seven people are in a level-4 secure setting without a criminal title, that such placement requires a court-authorised compulsory care order under the Wvggz or Wzd, and that patients keep their legal protections.
Your House is in principle not informed about such individual cases in view of the privacy of all those involved and given the large number of individual cases in which the ministry is involved.
Uw Kamer wordt in principe niet over dergelijke casuïstiek geïnformeerd in verband met de privacy van alle betrokkenen en gelet op het grote aantal individuele gevallen waarbij VWS betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Claassen, Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over het toenemend geweld tegen zorgverleners

PVV MPs asked the health and justice ministers about rising violence against care workers, including reporting of assaults, sentencing, protective equipment costs, a ban on community sentences, mandatory anti-aggression courses and refusing treatment of violent patients. The minister answered at length, citing ongoing consultations, regional meetings and a pending sentencing study, while declining to give several figures or a cost overview.
No, I do not have an overview of this at my disposal.
Nee, ik heb hier geen overzicht van tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Veel agressie tegen artsen op spoedeisende hulp: ‘We willen hulp van de politie én de politiek’'

An MP asks the health minister how the government will tackle rising aggression against hospital emergency staff, including proposals on screening, training, ending treatment relationships, mandatory anti-aggression courses, prison sentences and employer reporting. The minister answers that prevention and reporting policy is primarily the employer's responsibility, lists ongoing measures and motions, and says several points are still under review or to be discussed with other ministers.
I will raise this again at the labour market administrative consultation on 7 March.
Ik zal dit tijdens het bestuurlijk overleg arbeidsmarkt van 7 maart aanstaande (nogmaals) bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en PSV in zee gingen met dubieuze Aziatische gokbedrijven'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Ajax and PSV's sponsorship deals with Asian gambling firms were adequately vetted for money-laundering risks, and about the legal framework, supervision, the planned gambling sponsorship ban and Curaçao's gambling reform. The government answered that football clubs are not gatekeepers under the Wwft, that supervisors' investigations are confidential, that the sponsorship ban applies from 1 July 2025 with no acceleration, and that the Curaçao law is delayed but being monitored.
Whether supervisors are investigating particular cases or entities is supervisory-confidential information.
Of toezichthouders onderzoek doen naar bepaalde casussen of entiteiten is toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Minder vrouwen laten zich testen op baarmoederhalskanker

An MP asks the minister about falling participation in the cervical cancer screening programme and whether the government will act on it, including self-sampling and reminders. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the reasons for non-participation and the steps taken, such as a self-sampling kit, information changes, and research due at year end.
The declining participation as such is a worrying development.
De dalende deelname als zodanig vind ik een zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether a doctor who publicly denies any link between climate change and health problems acts against the KNMG code of conduct, and asks for a simple yes or no. The minister does not give a yes or no, saying the code's rules are not absolute and may be departed from with justification, and that in principle doctors must follow the code including the climate-health link.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, deviation is possible, but such deviation will have to be well justified.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven is afwijking wel mogelijk, maar deze afwijking zal dan goed onderbouwd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Tom Klaassen belandde in een ‘zorgvacuüm’ en stierf terwijl nog overlegd werd wie hem moest helpen'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked about the lack of care for complex psychiatric patients with addiction, the removal of facilities, palliative care as a suggested solution, a confidential mental health report, and funding. The Minister acknowledges gaps in integrated treatment but disputes many claims, points to existing programmes, rejects palliative care as a substitute for shortfalls, and says the NZa will be asked to look at funding again later.
No national data is collected on the local supply of the various types of shelter places and facilities for people with addiction problems.
Over het lokale aanbod van de verschillende soorten opvangplekken en voorzieningen voor mensen met verslavingsproblematiek wordt geen landelijke data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitzending ‘Vape-industrie heeft lak aan overheid’ van De Hofbar op 23 januari jl.

An MP asks the government about flavoured vapes still being sold despite the flavour ban since 1 January 2024, weak NVWA enforcement, banned vape accessories, and a licensing scheme for tobacco outlets. The state secretary rejects claims of no enforcement, describes NVWA checks at producers and retailers, announces stronger enforcement powers and higher fines, and says the licensing question is addressed by the existing plan to reduce outlets by 2032.
I intend to give the NVWA additional enforcement powers so it can enforce more efficiently.
Ik ben van plan de NVWA extra handhavingsbevoegdheden te geven om zo efficiënter te kunnen handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode voor artsen

An MP asked whether a doctor publicly denying climate-health links or the harm of CO2 would breach the KNMG code and face action by the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care (IGJ). The minister answered that the code applies to doctors' statements, that doctors must give correct information but retain freedom of expression, and that the IGJ acts only where statements pose a threat to public health, with discipline a matter for the disciplinary tribunal.
It is not for the IGJ to remove a doctor from the profession. It can initiate a disciplinary procedure, but the judgment on that rests with the disciplinary tribunal for health care.
Het is overigens niet aan de IGJ om een arts uit het beroep te zetten. Zij kan een tuchtprocedure inzetten, echter het oordeel hierover is aan het tuchtcollege voor de gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel ‘Tom Klaassen belandde in een zorgvacuüm en stierf terwijl nog overlegd werd wie hem moest helpen’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a press report that a complex psychiatric patient with addiction was left without care, and about shortages, decentralisation, cuts, Amsterdam regional cooperation, euthanasia proposals and ggz budget use. The minister answered that care options and municipal outreach are being pursued under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, denied knowledge of budget diversion and of unilateral refusal of treatment, and noted that euthanasia is governed by strict legal conditions.
In addition, at the request of the State Secretary of VWS, research is being conducted into the provision of outreach care by municipalities.
Daarnaast wordt op verzoek van de Staatssecretaris van VWS een onderzoek uitgevoerd naar het aanbod van bemoeizorg door gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat Russische sancties zijn overtreden bij voetbaltransfers in binnen- en buitenland en het besluit van het IOC om Russische en Belarussische sporters onder neutra

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports that football transfers involving Russian clubs may have breached sanctions, and about the IOC allowing Russian and Belarusian athletes to compete under a neutral flag. The minister replied that compliance with sanctions is each party's own responsibility, that supervisors investigate suspected breaches, that the government has no indication UEFA or FIFA rules conflict with sanctions, and that it opposes IOC's decision while limiting its own role to informal diplomacy.
In the Netherlands everyone is themselves responsible for complying with sanctions measures.
In Nederland is eenieder zelf verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van sanctiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de tekortkomingen in de geboortezorg voor asielzoekers

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the government about a study showing higher perinatal loss among pregnant asylum seekers, interpreter use, relocation of pregnant women, and communication problems between care providers. The State Secretary replied that the data are already known and regretted, that existing measures and the care chain working group address them, that access to care is adequately arranged, and that relocation of pregnant women is restricted but not fully avoidable.
Yes. Access to maternity care is also well arranged for asylum seekers in the Netherlands.
Ja. De toegang tot de geboortezorg is ook voor asielzoeksters in Nederland goed geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Van der Laan en Sjoerdsma over de rol van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken rondom het WK mannenvoetbal in Qatar

MPs asked whether the Foreign Ministry blocked open criticism of host country Qatar for the 2022 World Cup, kept risks for LGBTIQ+ visitors out of Parliamentary letters, and what has been done for migrant workers. The government denies prioritising trade, says the process was a delicate balancing of interests, and outlines its constructive-critical dialogue, ILO-linked reforms, and planned follow-up.
The official tension could well have been mentioned.
Het ambtelijk spanningsveld had wel genoemd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het toenemend ernstig medicijntekort in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about the worsening national medicine shortage, its causes, patient harm, measures taken, production in the Netherlands, and preferential pricing policy. The minister answered that shortages are multifactorial, outlined measures such as stock obligations, cooperation with insurers and industry, and EU-level action, but gave no guarantee of availability and did not quantify patient harm.
Quantifying any harm is not possible because it can differ per patient and is not recorded.
Het kwantificeren van eventuele schade is niet mogelijk omdat dit per patiënt kan verschillen en niet wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuistop Maastricht declareert: privéchauffeurs en strandyoga in San Diego'

An FVD MP asked the health minister whether hospital board executives' expense claims (private drivers, a retreat in San Diego) are morally acceptable and whether an annual public overview of board declarations should be published. The minister answered that it is up to the supervisory board to judge individual conduct, that the MUMC+ board is reviewing its policy, and that declarations are already public under the Governance Code for hospitals, so no separate annual overview is planned.
It is not within my remit to publish an annual overview of this.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg hier een jaarlijks overzicht over te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark en Joseph over het bericht 'Richard (35) zit zonder strafblad al 12 jaar opgesloten in tbs-kliniek tussen zware criminelen: hij is niet de enige'

MPs Uitermark and Joseph asked about reports that a psychiatric patient without a criminal sentence has been held for 12 years in a tbs clinic, and about shortages of care places. The minister said seven people without a criminal title are in a level-4 setting for treatment reasons, that a plan of action with sector partners is underway to create temporary and permanent places for about sixty people, and that co-placement is in principle undesirable but may be clinically justified.
I cannot go into the case mentioned in the article and therefore cannot give a judgement on the reporting on this point.
Ik kan hier niet ingaan op de in het artikel genoemde casus en daarom ook geen oordeel geven over de berichtgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over de geplande toewijzing van het WK mannenvoetbal in 2034 aan Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked the government about human rights concerns (migrant workers, women, LGBTQI people, press freedom) tied to the planned 2034 men's World Cup award to Saudi Arabia and what the Netherlands would do. The minister acknowledged these concerns, pointed to ongoing human rights dialogue and FIFA requirements in the bid book, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue, but did not commit to a concrete new step regarding the award itself.

The cabinet considers it important that the bid book addresses Saudi Arabia's commitment to the human rights conditions set by FIFA and how it will meet them, and that this commitment is assessed technically.

Het kabinet acht het van belang dat het bidbook ingaat op de inzet van Saoedi-Arabië ten aanzien van de door de FIFA gestelde mensenrechtenvoorwaarden en hoe hieraan te voldoen, en dat deze inzet technisch wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Meer jonge vrouwen op eerste hulp na zelfverwonding of suïcidepoging'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the reported 50 percent rise in young women treated at emergency departments for self-harm or suicide attempts, along with ongoing research, prevention measures, aftercare, and mental health care contracting and insurer waiting lists. The Minister attributed the trend to multiple societal causes, described existing prevention programmes and research, and answered that insurer contracting is improving with an evaluation planned for spring 2024.
Your House will be informed about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: 'Ik voel me een schooier''

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked about a family with a chronically ill child forced to move because municipal refusal to fully fund home adaptations and rising care costs, and about VN-verdrag Handicap compliance. The minister says Wmo 2015 allows adaptations and municipalities weigh alternatives including relocation allowances, declines to change the law, and gives no data on parents' financial problems or on how many use each scheme.
No, as stated in my answer to question 2, home adaptations can be reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 kunnen vanuit de Wmo 2015 woningaanpassingen worden vergoed.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het OM over Fouad L. (verdachte van het doodschieten van drie mensen in Rotterdam op 29 september jl.) ook melding deed bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service reported suspect Fouad L. to the health inspectorate IGJ before a fatal shooting, and what was done with that report. The minister confirmed a March 2023 OM letter and an IGJ investigation that was suspended after the shooting, but declined to share details on privacy and ongoing-investigation grounds and said the IGJ's memo is confidential.
Because of the privacy protection of those involved and the ongoing investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot share information about the report.
Vanwege de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen en het lopende onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie kan ik informatie over de melding niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Moet de spoedeisende hulp in Goes en Terneuzen blijven? Ministerie haalt meningen op'

An MP asked the health minister about public consultation meetings on emergency care in Goes and Terneuzen and whether the emergency departments would close. The minister replied that the meetings feed into a civil-service process on new accessibility norms, that no closure is planned, and that the controversial 45-minute norm decision is left to a next cabinet.
Since the 45-minute norm has been declared controversial by the House, decision-making on a possible alternative to the 45-minute norm is left to a next cabinet.
Aangezien de 45-minutennorm door uw Kamer controversieel verklaard is, wordt besluitvorming over een eventueel alternatief voor de 45-minutennorm aan een volgend kabinet overgelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het weigeren van palliatieve zorg vanwege het bereiken van het budgetplafond

An MP asked whether palliative home care was refused by Zilveren Kruis because a budget ceiling had been reached, and what structural fixes are planned. The minister acknowledges the case, says it was resolved with the insurer, describes ceiling-increase procedures and planned financing reforms, but offers no firm new oversight commitments.
At the end of this year a next letter to the House on palliative care will be sent, again giving the status of the various financing tracks.
Eind dit jaar zal een volgende Kamerbrief palliatieve zorg worden verzonden waarin opnieuw de stand van zaken van de verschillende trajecten rond de bekostiging zal worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de honorering van buurtsportcoaches in Nederland naar aanleiding van diverse wisselingen over dit onderwerp in de Tweede Kamer

An MP asked the minister about the pay and deployment of neighbourhood sports coaches, including use as physical education teachers and whether they should be paid under the teachers' CAO. The minister answered that employment terms depend on local employers, cited revised Brede Regeling rules promoting equal pay and career paths, but declined to send a signal to municipalities and schools on the CAO PO.
Locally, municipalities make decisions about who and what they want the officials funded under the Brede Regeling Combinatiefuncties to be deployed for.
Lokaal maken gemeenten afwegingen voor wie en wat zij de functionarissen die gefinancierd worden uit de Brede Regeling Combinatiefuncties in willen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Grote jeugdzorgorganisatie investeert miljoenen in bedrijven van eigen adviseur, ondanks megaverlies'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a press report on a large youth care organisation investing millions in companies of its own adviser despite heavy losses, and about poor inspection findings at its Zetten secure youth facility, including use of restraint measures, staff shortages, safety and complaints, and governance conflicts of interest. The government answers that it shares concern, that no unlawfulness can be established from the article, that the inspectorate and accountant had no direct reason to intervene, that Zetten is improving under the inspectorate's watch, and points to the Wibz bill to strengthen external oversight of integrity.
The IGJ cannot give information about ongoing supervision.
Over een lopend toezicht kan de IGJ geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Claassen over het niet vergoeden van revalidatietherapie voor een ernstig ziek kind

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why a seriously ill boy's rehabilitation therapy abroad is not reimbursed and why parents must fund it themselves, including through crowdfunding. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because of a pending court dispute, explained the general criteria for basic-insurance coverage, and pointed to SKGZ and court routes for disputes.
As I indicated earlier, I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, kan ik niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Bejaarden met dementie urenlang in hun eigen poep achtergelaten: ‘Onmenselijk hoe mijn moeder is behandeld’'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a newspaper report on residents with dementia left in soiled clothing for hours at care home Kalorama, and about its financial problems, understaffing, use of short-trained temporary staff, and whether staffing norms and care funding should be protected. The Minister said the situation is serious, that the IGJ is closely monitoring Kalorama under a recovery plan overseen by the care office, and that funding is not being cut and remains adequate, while placing primary responsibility on providers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Westerveld over het bericht 'Percentage kinderen zonder zwemdiploma verdubbeld'

MPs Mohandis and Westerveld asked the minister about the doubling of children without swimming diplomas between 2018 and 2022 and what policy is being taken. The minister agreed the trend is undesirable and listed initiatives (Nationaal Plan Zwemveiligheid, Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, teacher and pool support, plans with municipalities expected in autumn), without a single definitive solution.
I expect to be able to inform you in the autumn about the plan at municipal level.
Ik verwacht u in het najaar te kunnen informeren over het plan op gemeenteniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over dreigende sluiting van dagbesteding Antoon & Frans in Megen en de verdere verschraling van dagbestedingslocaties als gevolg van zorgconcurrentie

An SP MP asked the minister about the threatened closure of a day-care location in Megen and the wider thinning of day-care provision due to care competition. The minister responded that the provider Dichterbij decided to close the location because too few clients remained, and that the zorgkantoor, not the government, bears responsibility for sufficient day-care provision.
It is the role of the zorgkantoor to ensure there are sufficient locations for suitable day-care for Wlz clients.
Het is de rol van het zorgkantoor om ervoor te zorgen dat er voldoende locaties zijn voor passende dagbesteding voor Wlz-cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over de afname van het aantal restitutiepolissen

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, the effects on GGZ and district nursing care, contracting transparency and patient protection. The minister answered that the number of restitution policies fell from 25 in 2010 to 4 in 2024, attributed mainly to high declared costs, and defended natura and combination policies while promising improved contracting information via NZa.
The NZa will evaluate the contracting process for 2024.
De NZa zal het contracteerproces voor 2024 evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat het salaris van zorgmedewerkers volgend jaar verder achter gaat lopen

An MP asked the minister whether the widening pay gap between care workers and the rest of the public and private sector is acceptable and what steps will be taken to close it. The minister replied that the studies do not clearly show a widening gap, that a policy weighing is left to a new cabinet, and that no concrete measures are announced.
A policy-based weighing of the outcomes of these studies I leave to a new cabinet.
Een beleidsmatige weging van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken laat ik aan een nieuw kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de noodzaak van ondersteuning voor sportverenigingen en -accommodaties

MP Mohandis asked the minister about support for sports clubs and facilities, including energy-cost relief (TEK, SPUK MEOZ, SPUK NEAS), local funding, greening, and whether support will continue in 2024. The minister answered in detail, citing monitoring by the Mulier Institute, that the energy-cost measures were temporary, no additional swimming-pool aid is planned now, and that a plan with the VSG for regional greening coordination is being prepared.
I have discussed the expected energy-cost problems for 2024 with the VSG but unfortunately see no possibilities at this time to provide additional financial support to the swimming pools.

Ik ben met de VSG in gesprek gegaan over de verwachte problemen bij energiekosten in 2024 maar zie op dit moment helaas geen mogelijkheden om aanvullende financiële ondersteuning te bieden aan de zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de steunmaatregelen om amateurverenigingen voor de hoge energieprijzen te compenseren in 2024 komen te vervallen

An SP MP asked why temporary energy-cost support for amateur sports clubs and public swimming pools ends in 2024 and whether clubs are at risk without it. The minister replied that the support was explicitly temporary (2022–2023), that no alternative plan is planned, that the sector is being monitored, and that a decision on further energy support is for a future cabinet.
Last winter I supported public swimming pools and amateur sports clubs through non-structural specific grants to municipalities.
Afgelopen winter heb ik openbare zwembaden en amateursportverenigingen door middel van niet-structurele specifieke uitkeringen aan gemeenten ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Politie stopt met motoragenten bij wielerkoersen. 'Met deze beslissing trekken ze stekker uit noordelijke wielerwedstrijden'

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the police's decision to stop deploying motorcycle officers at cycling races from 2024 and what will be done to keep races going. The minister acknowledged the reduced police capacity, said deployment is decided locally, and pointed to an Antea Group study on using civilian motorcycle marshals, with a report expected in summer 2024.
The report is expected in the summer of 2024.
Het rapport wordt verwacht in de zomer van 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over beleid voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asked the minister about listening to people with intellectual disabilities, shrinking recreational activities in institutions due to staff shortages and lost funding, and subsidies for outings. The minister answered that consultation rules exist and IGJ oversees them, that outings fall largely outside the ministry's responsibility, and that she will work toward accessible leisure through the National Strategy.
Parties such as the Witte Bedjes Sinterklaas party and the Maak de Droom Waar concert were not organised by my ministry.
Feesten zoals de Witte Bedjes Sinterklaasfeest en het concert van «Maak de Droom Waar» zijn niet door mijn ministerie georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Brink, Krul en Inge van Dijk over het niet doorgaan van amateur wielrenwedstrijden

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers why amateur cycling races are being cancelled because police motorcycle escorts are unavailable, and whether volunteer civilian motorcyclists could be deployed, including via a pilot and changes to traffic rules. The minister answered that a study by Antea Group is underway with results expected in summer 2024, that a temporary experiment would need a legal amendment and AMvB taking about a year, and that changing traffic rules awaits the study's outcome.
I expect the results of the above-mentioned study in the summer of 2024.
De uitkomsten van het bovengenoemde onderzoek verwacht ik in de zomer van 2024.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Gegevens HoNOS+ vragenlijst niet met terugwerkende kracht verwijderd' en de bijbehorende radio-uitzending over dit onderwerp van Argos op zaterdag 25 november jongstl

MP Dijk (SP) asked whether the NZa adequately informed mental health patients about the privacy declaration linked to the HoNOS+ data collection, whether the data should be deleted or the database abandoned, and how patient trust is affected. The minister rejects claims of inadequate information, states the NZa is handling the data with strict safeguards while the bodemprocedure is pending, and says the NZa cannot delete individual patients' data retroactively due to administrative burden.

The NZa states that it is also not possible for it to delete data of individual patients because the NZa has taken very strict organisational and technical measures to prevent the supplied data from being traceable to a natural person.

De NZa geeft aan dat het is daarbij voor haar ook niet mogelijk is om data van afzonderlijke patiënten te verwijderen omdat de NZa, zoals bij vraag 5 aangegeven, zeer strenge organisatorische en technische maatregelen genomen heeft om te voorkomen dat de aangeleverde gegevens te herleiden zijn tot een natuurlijke persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over veiligheid van werknemers in de ggz-zorg

Van Haga asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the safety of mental health (ggz) staff, including agression, underreporting, VFI and BHV training, length of stay, a national reporting point, and keys versus access cards and extra exits. The minister acknowledged the risks but largely placed responsibility on employers under the Arbo law, pointed to existing monitoring and a planned reporting point, and declined a national training or building-standard requirement.
It is up to the employer to weigh whether and where in the building it is safer to work with key cards instead of keys.
Het is ook aan de werkgever om de afweging te maken of en waar in het pand het veiliger is om met sleutelpasjes te werken in plaats van met sleutels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over deproblemen bij de commerciële ggz-instelling Mindler in Zweden

An MP asked the minister about reports of short consultations, workload and private equity at the commercial mental health provider Mindler, and whether profit-making in mental health care should be banned. The minister said short consults driven purely by finance are undesirable but that clinicians set consult length within the quality framework, and that a private equity study due in early 2024 will inform whether further measures are needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het percentage kinderen zonder zwemdiploma is verdubbeld

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the doubling of children without a swimming diploma, the large income gap in swimming skills, and steps to reverse the post-COVID decline and reinstate school swimming. The minister calls the situation worrying and points to municipal and private initiatives, Jeugdfonds support, and a national study on reintroducing school swimming expected in early 2024.
At present I am having research carried out into the total costs and requirements of reintroducing school swimming at national level.
Op dit moment laat ik onderzoeken wat de totale kosten en vereisten zouden zijn voor het herinvoeren van schoolzwemmen op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het Witboek zwembaden voor gemeenten van de FNV

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the minister about the FNV white paper on swimming pools, pool workers' fragmented collective agreements and low pay, school swimming, pool greening, and a national swimming diploma, referring to earlier motions. The minister largely responded by pointing to existing initiatives, pilots, studies, and ongoing talks with stakeholders, committing to inform the Chamber before the next committee meeting.
As previously promised, I will inform you before the WGO Sport 2024 about the (preliminary) outcomes of both studies.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, informeer ik u voorafgaand aan het WGO Sport 2024 over de (voorlopige) uitkomsten van beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen zonder zwemdiploma vooral bij lage inkomens'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how children from lower-income families can be helped to obtain swimming diplomas, and why Dutch children still do not all achieve them. The minister answered that municipal schemes, the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur and school swimming support access, that the backlog is being tackled with the sector, and that parent awareness is being raised through the national swimming safety plan.
I am in continuous discussion with the sector to devise solutions for how the backlogs can be made up.
Ik ben continu in gesprek met de branche om oplossingen te bedenken hoe de achterstanden ingelopen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de vernietiging van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen die zijn ingekocht ten behoeve van het bestrijden van de coronacrisis

MP Van Haga asked the minister about the destruction of COVID-era protective equipment and medical supplies, including a 4 April 2023 transport of 947,800 face masks to a waste processor, and whether Parliament was informed and how costs and procurement were handled. The minister answered that the transports followed a procurement-based sustainable disposal strategy because goods had expired or no longer met standards, provided tender publications and estimated costs, but declined to disclose processing costs and some details as commercially confidential.
The processing costs are part of the agreements with the relevant service provider, and these agreements are commercially confidential.
De verwerkingskosten zijn onderdeel van de overeenkomsten met de betreffende dienstverlener, deze afspraken zijn commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het artikel ‘Steeds meer mensen overlijden na val, vooral ouderen slachtoffer’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the rising number of deaths from falls, mainly among older people, and what is being done about fall prevention, funding, the roles of insurers and innovation. The minister answered that the government supports a national fall-prevention approach, pointed to earmarked municipal funding and insurance-based resources, and described plans for coordination across care domains and technology support.
The cabinet endorses this ambition and is strongly committed to a national fall-prevention approach and associated funding.
Het kabinet onderschrijft deze ambitie en zet stevig in op een landelijke aanpak valpreventie en bijbehorende financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over indiceren bij ouders en kinderen die intensieve kindzorg nodig hebben

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why parents of children needing intensive child care are caught between nurse-led indications, insurers' adjustments, and objections, and whether the treating physician and parents should co-determine care plans. The Minister answers that the child nurse alone holds autonomous indication authority while consulting physicians and parents, that insurers may only check legality and efficiency, and that escalation routes and an action plan exist, but declines to amend the objection procedure or the motion's approach.
I can carry out your motion if I do so in line with the intention of this motion.
Ik kan uw motie uitvoeren als ik dit doe langs de bedoeling van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een kwart van de speeltuinen binnen vijf jaar dreigt te verdwijnen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether they would act on reports that a quarter of playgrounds may close within five years and whether a sports/play norm, a statutory basis for playgrounds, and more support for volunteers were planned. The minister said the data cannot establish the severity, that playground policy is a municipal responsibility, that the government is studying the added value of statutory anchoring, and that it cannot guarantee playgrounds will survive.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Klokkenluiders: De Overloop ging gebukt onder schrikbewind'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about reports that staff at Zorggroep Almere's De Overloop were suspended for misconduct including stolen medication, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) investigated and how staff can be kept out of care. The Minister said he cannot comment on the case, the provider has commissioned its own external investigation and promised to report to the IGJ, and the IGJ acts independently and has not been ordered to investigate.
I cannot make any statements about this from my position.
Ik kan hier vanuit mijn positie geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het artikel ‘Officieel Tour de France Femmes 2024 begint in Rotterdam, drie ritten in Nederland’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why the Tour de France Femmes 2024 stages in the Netherlands cannot receive national subsidy, while earlier men's Grand Tour stages did, and whether the event could be added to the subsidy ladder. The minister answered that since 2021 the subsidy scheme deliberately excludes events whose ownership lies with a commercial party rather than a European or world federation, that the event therefore cannot apply, and that it will not be added to the ladder.
It is therefore not possible for the Tour de Femmes 2024 to apply for a subsidy under this subsidy scheme.
Het is dus niet mogelijk voor de Tour de Femmes 2024 om een subsidie aan te vragen middels deze subsidieregeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het afluisteren van journalisten van De Correspondent bij een gesprek met verdachten van de mondkapjesdeal door het OM en het voor de rechterdagen van Relief Goods Alliance do

An MP asks how the Public Prosecution Service could legally bug a meeting where Correspondent journalists spoke with suspects in the face-mask deal, why the State is suing Relief Goods Alliance without disclosing the summons, and what happened to the recordings. The Minister says the surveillance was a lawful special investigative power on suspects with incidental capture of journalists, that the courts will judge, that the summons is withheld due to ongoing litigation, and that the recordings are part of the criminal file.
Ultimately it is for the court to determine whether the Public Prosecution Service made the right considerations and applied the Directive properly.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te bepalen of het OM de juiste afwegingen heeft gemaakt en de Aanwijzing goed heeft toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over de zorg en ondersteuning van ALS-patiënten

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked about difficulties ALS patients face obtaining Wmo care, aids and home adaptations, the use of an ALS protocol by municipalities, and access to specialised client support. Minister Helder acknowledged problems, said municipalities have discretion and VWS lacks oversight of protocol use, and promised to encourage dialogue with the VNG, while defending the existing GCO target groups and noting municipalities' statutory duty to provide client support.
I have no insight into the extent to which this protocol is actually used by municipalities.
Ik heb geen zicht op de mate waarin dit protocol daadwerkelijk door gemeenten wordt gebruikt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Brink over het bericht dat Europese voetbalclubs sinds het uitbreken van de oorlog in Oekraïne zo’n 40 miljoen euro aan transfer– en huursommen aan hun Russische tegenha

MPs Boswijk and Van den Brink asked whether European football clubs should be barred from paying transfer and loan fees to Russian clubs since the war in Ukraine, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replied that such transactions are not banned under current sanctions, clubs must screen ownership, and the government will not disclose future sanction plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanction measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over het onderzoek vanIederIn

An MP from D66 asked the minister about an IederIn study finding that about one in seven chronically ill people cannot make ends meet due to rising energy costs, and asked what further measures were planned. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing energy allowances, health insurance reimbursements and municipal measures, and said further support would be weighed in the budget process.
I recognise the concerns of this group of vulnerable people.
Ik herken de zorgen van deze groep kwetsbaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat zorg in de stervensfase nog altijd niet goed geregeld is

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a case where a widower kept receiving insurer bills a year after his wife's death, and why end-of-life care remains hard to arrange and reimburse across the Zvw, Wlz, Pgb and Wmo. The minister acknowledged the case, pointed to the NPPZ II programme, NZa work on alternative palliative care funding, and insurer brokerage services, while stating that most end-of-life care goes well.
Arranging and reimbursing end-of-life care goes well in very many cases.
Het regelen en vergoeden van stervenszorg gaat in heel veel gevallen goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over het bericht 'Minder personeel dreigt in ouderenzorg door geldruzie met zorgkantoren'

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that staff cuts threaten elderly care due to tariff disputes with care insurers (zorgkantoren) and a court case. The minister responded that layoffs are undesirable, that the court found the tariffs generally reasonable, and listed measures (WOZO, TAZ, budget increase) to protect staffing and quality, while not committing to a specific new legal change.
In response to the Mohandis motion, I will map the extent to which elderly care organisations are threatening to collectively dismiss staff.
Als reactie op de motie Mohandis ga ik dan ook in kaart brengen in welke mate organisaties in de ouderenzorg personeel collectief dreigen te ontslaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Gert-Jan Jonker ‘s nachts in zijn rolstoel slaapt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care why a wheelchair user was sleeping in his chair at night for lack of home care, and asked about nursing home beds, staffing, and Buurtzorg's model. The Minister acknowledged the situation is unacceptable, pointed to the health insurer's duty of care and a practice team working on a solution, and otherwise gave general policy answers, declining to endorse claims about staffing hours or Buurtzorg's rollout.
This must not happen, which is why I asked the practice team of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to work with him to find a solution so that he is helped to bed every day.

Dit mag niet gebeuren, daarom heb ik het praktijkteam van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport gevraagd samen met hem te kijken naar een oplossing, zodat hij toch elke dag naar bed wordt geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'Drugscrimineel was de baas van zorguitzendbureau dat personeel levert aan Jeugdhulp Friesland'

MP Mohandis asked about a report that a drug criminal headed a care staffing agency supplying Jeugdhulp Friesland, and about oversight of Woodbrookers and fraud prevention. The government answered that the IGJ moved its planned supervision forward, Jeugdhulp Friesland will stop closed youth care in its current form by July 2024, and fraud measures (Bibob, Wbsrz, pilots) and a sector working group on flex staffing are underway.
Such an investigation commissioned by the IGJ is in principle never made public.
Een dergelijk onderzoek in opdracht van de IGJ wordt in beginsel nooit openbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over antwoord op de vragen inzake de uitzending «Het geheim van de spreekkamer» en het artikel «Zorgverzekeraars hebben groot belang bij de data die toezichthouder verzamelt» en Peilin

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care about patients not being informed by providers that their data is shared with the NZa, and about privacy declarations, data-sharing errors, and the link between HoNOs+ data and waiting times. The Minister acknowledges patients should be better informed, explains the NZa's safeguards and the reasons the privacy declaration cannot be split, and commits to answering each question separately.
I expect care providers to inform their clients and patients about the privacy declaration well, fully and neutrally, to always leave the choice entirely to the patient and not to influence it.

Ik verwacht van zorgaanbieders dat zij hun cliënten en patiënten over de privacyverklaring goed, volledig en neutraal informeren, de keuze altijd helemaal bij de patiënt laten en daar geen invloed op uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Financiële situatie voor ouderenzorg onhoudbaar’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about BDO's finding that 238 of 789 analysed elderly care organisations made a loss in 2022, a rise of nearly 40%, and about the cumulative financial pressures, flexible-staff use and waiting lists. The minister confirmed the figures, acknowledged the pressures, noted that two measures will not take effect in 2024 and that the urgency of reform remains, and reported regional waiting-list differences without a causal link to finances.
I see no reason to question BDO's analysis.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de analyse van BDO in twijfel te trekken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de berichten 'Op de ambulance raakten Ben en Mariska besmet met covid, maar slechts één van hen lijkt recht te hebben op vergoeding' en 'FNV: 'Voorwaarden van long covid-regeling

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about press reports that a long-COVID compensation scheme for healthcare workers excludes some deserving cases, such as those who returned to work before relapsing or faced long UWV assessment waits, and about the scheme's strict WIA-based conditions and budget. The minister acknowledged the reports, defended the WIA-based objective criteria as necessary for legal robustness and administrative control, described some simplifications and assistance from DUS-I and UWV, but refused to carry over unused budget to 2024 and offered no broad relaxation of the rules.
When assessing applications, these statutory four weeks are taken into account.
Bij de beoordeling van de aanvragen wordt rekening gehouden met deze wettelijke vier weken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht ‘Weer problemen met leerlingenvervoer in Schiedam: bussen komen soms wel twee uur te laat’

MPs Minhas and Bevers asked about late school transport buses for vulnerable pupils in Schiedam and what the government would do. The minister says responsibility lies with municipalities, that she has written to the VNG asking it to hold municipalities to account, and that she urges Schiedam to act quickly.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport, however, lies with municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt echter bij gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Tielen over de noodzaak om vaardigheden van ziekenhuisprofessionals actueel te houden en de rol van de subsidieregeling Kwaliteitsimpuls personeel ziekenhuiszorg daarin

MPs Paulusma and Tielen asked why no new KIPZ subsidy regulation for 2024 has been published despite the Integraal Zorgakkoord commitment to keep these funds for medical-specialist care, and how the funds and skills-maintenance goal will be secured. The minister says the 2024 extension carries state-aid risks, so the only way to pay out the full 227.5 million euros is an extension that is admittedly unlawful, with a new framework planned for 2025.

The only option I currently see to make the funds available in full in 2024, in line with the IZA agreement, is, given the state-aid risks, to extend the KIPZ subsidy scheme once in a way that is unlawful.

De enige mogelijkheid die ik op dit moment zie om de middelen conform de IZA afspraak in zijn geheel in 2024 beschikbaar te stellen is het, vanwege de risico's op staatssteun, onrechtmatig eenmalig verlengen van de Subsidieregeling KIPZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Atlete Lieke Klaver baalt van 'lullige' regeling over verdiensten: 'Waar heb je het dan voor gedaan?''

An MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a news report on athletes losing or having to repay part of their allowance because of earnings rules, and how the rules might be improved. The minister acknowledges the regulation, says its effects vary by individual, and points to an evaluation and a new topsport strategy expected by end 2024, with no definitive proposal yet.
I look forward with interest to the scenarios for a new provision model.
Ik kijk met belangstelling uit naar de scenario's voor een nieuw voorzieningenmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht Agressie tegen huisartsen steeds heftiger, soms zelfs permanente bewaking nodig'

An MP asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport about rising aggression against GPs, incident figures per sector, prevention measures, use of an amendment earmarking funds for first-line care, the professional secrecy obstacle to filing police reports, and how to increase reporting willingness. The minister said there is no national incident count, that survey data show no clear trend, that VWS supports sector-specific approaches and a first-line study, that professional secrecy does not prevent reporting crimes, and that regional meetings and a podcast or webinar will be organised.
Care organisations themselves record how many incidents occur in their organisation, provided these are reported by their employees.
Zorgorganisaties houden zelf bij hoeveel incidenten er plaats vinden in hun organisatie, mits deze gemeld worden door hun werknemers.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dijk over de uitzending 'Het geheim van de spreekkamer' en het artikel 'Zorgverzekeraars hebben groot belang bij de data die toezichthouder verzamelt'

An MP (Dijk, SP) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the NZa's collection of HoNOS+ patient data for mental health care, including adequacy of advice from the Dutch DPA, patient awareness of privacy statements, and calls for a temporary halt. The Minister answered that the NZa acts within its legal framework and the DPA's December 2022 opinion, that the data collection is under court review, and that patients are informed via a folder and website, but declined to halt the collection or pause it pending a new DPA opinion.
The data collection for care demand typing by the NZa is currently the subject of legal proceedings.
De data-uitvraag voor zorgvraagtypering door de NZa is op dit moment onderwerp van een gerechtelijke procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de toenemende problemen in de ouderenzorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about projected 2024 financial shortfalls in northern elderly care, possible job cuts, the realism of the WOZO programme's effects, the reliance on technology to save staff, and whether enough clustered housing will be built.
