The Minister said providers foresee an exceptional combination of costs, that sector responsibilities are shared, that technology can save labour if organisations reorganise, and cited a target of 80,000 clustered housing units and 40,000 clustered nursing places.
Care providers indicate they expect an exceptional combination of circumstances for 2024, including high sick leave, heavy use of temporary non-employed staff (PNIL) and inflation.

Zorgaanbieders geven aan dat zij voor 2024 een uitzonderlijke samenloop van omstandigheden verwachten, waaronder een hoog ziekteverzuim, hoge inzet van tijdelijk personeel niet in loondienst (PNIL) en inflatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de gemeten oversterfte in juni door het CBS

An SP MP asked why excess deaths in June 2023 were not met with activation of the National Heat Plan and what research and changes would follow. The Minister explained that the heat plan's conditions were not met, that a warning was issued to partners, and committed to an evaluation of the plan once new KNMI climate scenarios are published in October 2023.
I will have an evaluation carried out of the National Heat Plan assessing whether the plan is still adequate given climate change.
Ik zal een evaluatie laten uitvoeren van het Nationaal Hitteplan waarin beoordeeld wordt of het plan nog voldoet gezien de klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over het artikel 'Zorgmedewerker in verkapte loondienst aangepakt: 'Enorm probleem'; 'Bureaus agressief aan het werven''

MPs Van den Hil and Smals asked the Minister for Long-term Care about bogus self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) in healthcare, agency recruitment, a proposed quota and a conduct code for intermediaries, the new professional control law, and collective agreement flexibility. The minister answered that no data exist on involuntary self-employment, that a sector control model and a conduct code are being developed, and that the Wkkgz amendment on staff influence is being implemented.
No figures are available on this specific question.
Over deze specifieke vraag zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht “FNV wil 14,3 procent hoger loon in kraamzorg”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the kraamzorg (maternity care) wage gap contributes to staff shortages, whether the government will support the FNV's 14.3% wage demand, and whether it will take steps to raise wages. The minister answered that a study on the sector's finances and wage development is pending, that collective bargaining is for social partners and the government cannot interfere under international treaties, and that no extra wage room is planned.

No, as stated in the answer to question 4, under international treaties I may not interfere in collective bargaining negotiations and therefore cannot and will not take a position on wage demands in care.

Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 4 mag ik mij op grond van internationale verdragen niet bemoeien met cao-onderhandelingen en kan en wil ik dus geen positie innemen met betrekking tot looneisen in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het schrijnende bericht van een rolstoelgebruiker, zoals beschreven in het artikel ‘Rolstoelgebruiker Annemarie in de kou laten staan door NS: ‘Dit mag niet gebeuren’

An MP asked ministers about a wheelchair user left stranded in the cold by NS after a station lift failed, and whether rules and oversight protect such travellers. The state secretary acknowledged the incident, pointed to existing concession and Bestuursakkoord obligations, and said NS will reflect internally, while maintaining that the existing enforcement tools are sufficient and no new rules are proposed.
I have various steering instruments at my disposal.
Ik heb hiervoor diverse sturingsinstrumenten tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraken inzake de toekomst van de ouderenzorg gedaan in het televisieprogramma Nieuwsuur

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the future of elderly care, clustered housing versus nursing-home places, criteria and costs of Wlz care, and supervision in clustered settings. The Minister answered that more nursing-care places will be needed after 2030, explained the differences in criteria, tariffs and supervision, and gave the building targets and subsidy conditions.
It is currently not registered whether Wlz clients live in a clustered setting.
Er wordt momenteel niet geregistreerd of Wlz-cliënten woonachtig zijn in een geclusterde setting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat de zorgkantoren eerder bezwaar maakten bij het ministerie van VWS over de stapeling van kortingen waar ouderenzorgorganisaties mee te maken krijgen

An MP asked whether care offices had objected to the ministry about stacked cuts hitting elderly care organisations, and whether those cuts were justified. The minister replied that care offices only expressed concerns (no formal objection), denied any cuts over the past five years, pointed to rising spending, and refused to reverse the measures, stating the Wlz budget for 2025 onward is for a future cabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over "pgb-zorgverleners zonder sociaal vangnet”

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) care workers without social safety nets, including family carers, should receive unemployment, sick-pay and disability benefits after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and what would be done. The minister answered that the ruling covers only employment-contract workers under the Rdah, that family carers working on service contracts lack an employment relationship and are excluded, that possible solutions are being explored with a decision expected in autumn, and that extending benefits to the excluded group would cost about 115 million euro structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over het artikel ‘Internationale boksbond gaat olympische status verliezen om Russische invloeden’

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the ministers about the IOC withdrawing recognition of the boxing body IBA over Russian influence, and whether the Netherlands should back World Boxing and cut ties with the IBA. The minister agreed on excluding Russian athletes, officials and trainers, supported the IOC decision, but said it is not yet clear whether World Boxing will gain Olympic recognition and only committed to keeping in contact with NOC*NSF.
It is currently not yet clear whether World Boxing already has prospects of Olympic recognition; that is a matter for the IOC.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of World Boxing al zicht heeft op de Olympische erkenning, daar gaat het IOC over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de verdeling van opleidingsplaatsen over heel Nederland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about the distribution of medical training places across the Netherlands, including funding of trainee doctors outside hospitals, the curriculum, and the allocation of huisarts training places among university medical centres. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to independent bodies, the NZa and the universities as responsible for different parts, and postponed the full answers, with commitments to further study and to inform parliament after the summer.
It is not for the cabinet to take over this direction, but the cabinet does encourage the relevant field parties to develop the content of the care training programmes.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om deze regie over te nemen, maar het kabinet spoort de betrokken veldpartijen wel aan om de inhoud van de zorgopleidingen door te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het artikel “Betaald voetbal predikte loonmatiging tijdens corona, maar spelers kregen meer”.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Eredivisie clubs that received NOW wage subsidies while promising wage restraint had acted improperly, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that loonmatiging was not a NOW condition, that UWV checks eligibility and may reclaim subsidy in case of non-compliance with NOW rules, and that no sector-specific agreements with the KNVB or clubs existed.
Wage restraint was not a condition for the NOW and is therefore not a relevant factor in the determination.
Loonmatiging was geen voorwaarde voor de NOW en is dus geen relevante factor in de vaststelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van MAX vakantieman 3 juli 2023

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers whether travel organisers are transparent about extra costs that people with disabilities face for mobility aids, and how this fits with ANVR conditions and the UN disability convention. The government answered that organisers must disclose costs and suitability for reduced mobility under consumer law, that the ACM supervises this, and that it will raise the position of disabled travellers in EU negotiations on the package travel directive.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Bespuugd, gebeten, uitgescholden. In Drenthe, Groningen en Friesland heeft 80 procent van zorgmedewerkers te maken met geweld op de werkvloer’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about violence against care workers in the northern provinces, including duties on care employers to report incidents to police, training orders for aggressors, the status of a motion on prison sentences, a central reporting point, and whether care workers can terminate treatment agreements with aggressive patients. The minister answered each question, committing to regional meetings, a learning network, a central reporting point under discussion, and further analysis of a sentencing ban, while declining to introduce new statutory duties beyond existing rules.
I have raised the employer filing reports issue at the cabinet committee on the labour market on 31 May.
Ik heb het doen van aangifte door werkgever onder de aandacht gebracht tijdens het BO Arbeidsmarkt van 31 mei jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Helder wil maximumnorm zzp’ers en gedragscode bemiddelingsbureaus'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the share of self-employed workers in care, the costs of agency staffing, private equity influence on staffing agencies, and how to reduce reliance on flex workers. The minister answered that data on false self-employment is unavailable, that a code of conduct for intermediaries is being discussed with industry bodies, and that the question of regulating private equity is left to a next cabinet.
How many of those cases involve false self-employment cannot be derived from CBS data or other sources.
Hoeveel gevallen daarvan schijnzelfstandigheid betreffen is niet uit CBS data of andere bronnen te destilleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend aniossentekort in ziekenhuizen'

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the government about reported shortages of residents-in-training (aniossen) in hospitals, their working hours, employer responsibilities, and the role of physician assistants and nurse specialists. The minister answered that the Capaciteitsorgaan is researching the issue, that intake of PAs and VSs will be expanded from 2025–2026, and that working conditions and employer responsibility are mainly matters between employers and employees, with initiatives under the TAZ programme.

The Capaciteitsorgaan is currently researching the concrete composition of various groups of basic doctors as well as the reasons why basic doctors do or do not progress to certain postgraduate medical training programmes.

Het Capaciteitsorgaan doet op dit moment onderzoek naar de concrete samenstelling van verschillende groepen basisartsen alsmede de redenen voor het wel of niet doorstromen van basisartsen naar bepaalde geneeskundige vervolgopleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Raemakers over het bericht dat de overheveling van de ggz naar Wlz op de lange baan wordt geschoven

MPs Sahla and Raemakers asked the minister why the transfer of mental health care into the Wlz is being postponed, how many clients use the transitional arrangement, and whether it is budget-neutral and on what timeline it will be resolved. The minister answered that about 25,000 clients remain under the transitional rules, that the arrangement does not breach the law, that ending it is still the aim but needs more time for budget-neutral design, and that a concrete timeline will be given later with a report before summer 2024.
On 1 June 2023 there were about 28,500 people with a ggz-living indication under the Wlz.
Op 1 juni 2023 waren er circa 28.500 mensen met een indicatie voor ggz-wonen vanuit de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Nieuwe Wet Zeggenschap nog onbekend onder zorgmedewerkers'

MPs Tielen and Ellemeet asked the health minister why only 11 percent of care workers know about the new Wet Zeggenschap (decision-making rights for care staff) and how awareness, action plans and subsidy use are being monitored. The minister acknowledges the need for awareness, points to communication, sector bodies, subsidies and a planned monitor from September 2023, and says the effects will become clearer after the subsidy projects end.
To be able to see the effect of the legal amendment in practice, I agree that awareness of the amendment is a prerequisite.
Om het effect van de wetswijziging in de praktijk terug te kunnen zien ben ik het met u eens dat bekendheid met de wetwijziging voorwaardelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over het voorstel van de Europese Commissie over long-term care

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the European Commission's proposal on long-term care, including the national coordinator, the stakeholder meeting on quality indicators and next steps. The minister replied that the Netherlands chose a national official contact point rather than a coordinator, that the Chamber was informed via the BNC-fiche and written consultation, and that the focus remains mutual learning with no commitments on outcomes.
The Netherlands did not choose to appoint a national coordinator.
Nederland heeft er niet voor gekozen een nationaal coördinator te benoemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over discriminerende spreekkoren in de stadions

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about discriminatory chants in football stadiums, including the KNVB guideline, enforcement by clubs, ongoing talks, and a technology pilot. The minister answered that the KNVB guideline lets referees stop matches, that from the 2023/24 season homophobic chants aimed at individuals will lead to warnings, stoppages and stadium bans, and that the technology pilot continues and will be scaled up.
The KNVB does not explicitly keep track of how many matches are stopped.
De KNVB houdt niet expliciet bij hoeveel wedstrijden worden stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen bezorgd: Personeelsmarkt ontdekt door private investeerders’

MP Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about reports that private investors are entering the hospital staffing market, asking about private equity's effects, agency costs, and steps to improve staff control. Minister Kuipers answered that private equity's effects on care quality and access are not yet clear, that data on agency costs and private equity payouts are lacking, and that the government will promote staff autonomy via existing programmes and may commission further research.
The Ministry of VWS does not have these figures.
Het Ministerie van VWS beschikt niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'COC meldt 'homohaat tegen kinderen', pand in Eindhoven belaagd'

An MP asked the ministers about reports of anti-LGBTI harassment linked to football supporters, the frequency of discriminatory chants and sanctions, and the KNVB's enforcement of its anti-discrimination rules. The minister gave partial answers: investigations were ongoing, incident data were not recorded in the requested form, and several questions were answered by describing existing policy and planned follow-up action.
At this moment I cannot make any statements about this in connection with ongoing investigation.
Op dit moment kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen in verband met lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de vertraging omtrent de nieuwe bekostiging van wijkverpleging en het in stand houden van de 5-minutenregistratie

An SP MP asks the minister why the 5-minute time registration in district nursing persists despite its formal abolition in 2018, and whether it should be eliminated immediately. The minister answers that a third of providers still use it due to complex ICT systems, that providers must take the final step themselves, and that Vilans support and a possible experiment are available, but gives no firm date for definitive abolition.
To help care providers with this, they can make use of the support offered by Vilans
Om zorgaanbieders hierbij te helpen, kunnen ze gebruik maken van het ondersteuningsaanbod vanuit Vilans
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cliënten ggz stappen boos uit overleg: ‘Plan dataverzameling schendt privacy’'

MPs Dijk and Westerveld asked the minister about MIND leaving the zorgvraagtypering advisory committee and the NZa's plan to collect HoNOS+ data from all ggz patients via opt-out, questioning privacy and consent. The minister replied that the NZa has legal authority to request the data, that patients can object via a privacy declaration, that the NZa will talk with MIND, and that the DSM data will be retained for risk equalisation.
The NZa is legally entitled to request the necessary data.
De NZa is wettelijk gelegitimeerd om de benodigde data op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘De Zonnebloem introduceert nieuw verkeersbord’

An MP asked the minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a campaign by De Zonnebloem for an accessibility road sign and about survey findings that people with disabilities avoid outings and find streets and bridges inaccessible. The minister supports awareness-raising, points to programmes such as Onbeperkt Meedoen, and says that building-code accessibility rules are the responsibility of the Minister of BZK and that municipalities are responsible for local roads, without committing to new rules.
Municipalities are the competent authority for municipal roads and must supervise compliance with these requirements.
Gemeente zijn voor gemeentelijke wegen het bevoegd gezag en moeten toezien op naleving van deze eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over welke huidige minister politiek verantwoordelijk is voor de Mondkapjesdeal

The PVV MP Agema asks which current minister is politically responsible for the Mondkapjesdeal (face-mask deal) that lost EUR 100.8 million, questioning why the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport answers for it when the former minister and the current health minister are the responsible parties. The minister confirms earlier answers, explains she is responsible for the coordination of COVID-19 accountability including the additional PBM procurement investigation, and says the state's lawyer is monitoring claims and reports were passed to the Public Prosecution Service.
In addition, I have passed the reports to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there may be criminal culpable conduct in the transactions examined.
Daarnaast heb ik de rapporten aan het OM overgedragen om te beoordelen of er mogelijk sprake is van strafrechtelijk verwijtbaar handelen in de onderzochte transacties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘’Wanhopige ouders vrezen gedwongen verhuizing gehandicapte zoons’’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that parents fear the forced relocation of two disabled sons by care provider Middin, questioning its compatibility with children's rights and whether financial motives dominate care decisions. The minister said the move was needed because the room housed two clients in a space meant for eleven, that talks with parents continue and a closer Hague location may be found, and that no national figures on such relocations exist, promising to raise the issue with stakeholders.
Nationally no figures are known. I will discuss this topic in consultations with representatives of client organisations, care providers and care offices, and ask them to share any signals with me.

Landelijk zijn geen cijfers bekend. Ik zal dit onderwerp bespreken in overleggen met vertegenwoordigers van cliëntenorganisaties, zorgaanbieders en zorgkantoren en vragen om eventuele signalen met mij te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de uitspraken over de toekomst van de ouderenzorg gedaan in het televisieprogramma Nieuwsuur

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why she claims the sector cannot keep providing care as now, citing administrative burden, staff shortages, sick leave, the shortage of nursing home places and waiting lists, and why she does not act on proposals. The Minister responds by citing demographic and workforce data, the Ontregel programme and subsidies, a commitment to a WOZO programme and a 40,000 extra nursing-care places target by 2030, and rejects accusations of neglect.
I do not have data on overhead at individual institutions.
Over gegevens van de overhead bij individuele instellingen beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat twee Arnhemse zorg-uitzendbureaus strafrechtelijk onderzocht worden wegens valse diploma’s

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that two Arnhem care staffing agencies are under criminal investigation for fake diplomas, and how such diploma fraud could be prevented. The minister called it serious, said care providers remain responsible for checking diplomas and VOG certificates, and pointed to existing tools such as the Wtza, a screening pilot and reporting to the police and the IGJ, without committing to new sanctions.
Care providers are at all times ultimately responsible for delivering good care and for hiring staff with the right qualifications.
Zorgaanbieders zijn te allen tijde eindverantwoordelijk voor het leveren van goede zorg en zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aannemen van personeel met de juiste kwalificaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Werner over toezicht op Persoonsgebonden Budget (PGB)-wooninitiatieven

MPs Westerveld and Werner asked the Minister for Long-term Care about IGJ oversight of PGB-funded housing initiatives after undercover footage revealed abuse at Aurora Borealis, including earlier reports that may not have been recorded. The Minister answered in detail on the handling of reports, inspection timing, staffing cuts, lack of registration of PGB initiatives, and victims' legal aid, stating that the earlier reports could not be found and that the IGJ will hold leadership sessions and expand inspection capacity for 2023–2026.
No explanation has been found for the inability to locate the reports that were allegedly made in November 2020 and June 2022.
Er is geen verklaring gevonden voor het niet terug kunnen vinden van de meldingen die in november 2020 en juni 2022 gedaan zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘Geld in de zorg verdwijnt massaal: Den Haag gaat aan kop’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how she will respond to reports of large-scale misuse of care funds, including the capacity of supervisors over PGB bureaus, the burden of controls, municipal fining powers, tackling criminal networks, fake diplomas and certificates, and a ban on profit distributions in care. The minister answers that the government opposes misuse, explains the supervisory responsibilities of IGJ, NZa, municipalities and the OM, lists existing measures and a forthcoming letter, and rejects a profit ban while preparing an integrity bill that would allow conditions on profit distributions.
It is absolutely undesirable that unscrupulous care providers misuse care funds and take advantage of people in a vulnerable position.
Het is absoluut ongewenst dat malafide zorgaanbieders misbruik maken van zorggelden en hierbij gebruik maken van mensen in een kwetsbare positie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Raemakers over het artikel 'Het gebrek aan zorg voor psychiatrische patiënten met een verslaving drijft ouders tot wanhoop: ‘Wij zijn gevangen in de zorg voor hem’

D66 MPs Kat and Raemakers asked the state secretary and minister about a newspaper report on people with psychiatric problems and addiction who fall between care providers, lose housing and end up in severe cases. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing dual-diagnosis standards, the Integraal zorgakkoord and regional escalation models, says care providers do not record referrals, and promises to pass the Querido pilot to municipalities and to inform itself via the national addiction rapporteur.
Care providers do not keep data on referrals to other care providers, so there is no national picture of how large this group is.
Zorginstanties houden geen gegevens bij over het doorverwijzen naar andere zorginstanties, dus er is geen landelijk beeld hoe groot deze groep is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Werner over het publieksonderzoek van Actiz

Two MPs (Sahla, D66, and Werner, CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about an Actiz survey showing most Dutch people have not arranged for old age, the delayed IBO elderly-care vision, separating housing and care, nursing-home capacity, and funding cuts to building norms. The Minister acknowledged the challenge, pointed to ongoing WOZO programme work, a Zorginstituut study due March 2024, and NZa tariff adjustments, while deferring the IBO report to the Council of Ministers and promising to share it as soon as possible.
In accordance with the applicable procedure, the IBO elderly care study and the cabinet response will first be discussed in the Council of Ministers.
Conform de geldende procedure zal het IBO-ouderenzorg en de kabinetsreactie eerst besproken worden in de Minsterraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het belang van zwemvaardig zijn

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport whether the goal of all children obtaining a swimming diploma by 2025 is still held, how the related motion is being implemented, and about waiting lists, pool closures and access for children with disabilities or low-income families. The minister answers that the ambition holds for children physically able, describes a letter to parliament on implementation and waiting lists, notes thin provision in less urban areas, and reports that no clear negative trend in pool closures is visible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Undercover in Nederland op 23 april 2023

The MP asks the minister about abuse at a care farm shown on Undercover in Nederland, including IGJ inspection frequency, why small care providers are not licensed, whether licensing should be extended, how founders can be kept from re-entering care, and what relatives can do. The minister says inspection is risk-based with no set frequency, a general licensing duty would be an undue burden and not necessarily prevent such cases, background checks and reporting routes exist, and residents were offered victim support and relocated.
There is no guideline for the frequency of visits to care farms.
Er is geen richtlijn voor de frequentie van het bezoeken van zorgboerderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over welke bewindspersoon op dit moment politiek verantwoordelijk is voor de mondkapjesdeal waarbij 100,8 miljoen euro belastinggeld verloren ging

An MP asked which minister is currently politically responsible for the face-mask deal that lost 100.8 million euros, and why the minister responsible is not the one handling the debate on the Deloitte report. The Minister for Long-term Care and Sport answers that she handles accountability coordination for COVID-19 at VWS, including the PBM procurement investigation, while the responsibility question was addressed earlier, and she confirms the report's findings on contacts with the suppliers.
As Minister for Long-term Care and Sport, I am responsible for the process of 'coordination of COVID-19 accountability' at VWS.
Als Minister voor Langdurige Zorg en Sport ben ik verantwoordelijk voor het proces «coördinatie verantwoording COVID-19» bij VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘Wet verhindert stoppen onterechte zorguitkering’

MP Bevers asks whether court rulings that the CIZ can no longer withdraw long-term care entitlements when people are not eligible hamper fraud enforcement, and whether the law should be changed or the CIZ given investigative powers. Minister Helder replies that the CIZ can still withdraw indications for fraud and revise them when care needs change, that a legal clarification is being examined with the CIZ without a decision yet, and that the new cooperation bill only regulates data sharing, not CIZ enforcement powers.
Because of the CRvB rulings, I am in consultation with the CIZ to carefully examine what these rulings mean for the CIZ.
Vanwege de uitspraken van de CRvB ben ik met het CIZ in overleg om zorgvuldig te bekijken wat deze uitspraken betekenen voor het CIZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Ellian over het document ‘Bestuursrecht en verklaring omtrent het gedrag’

MPs Heerema and Ellian asked whether people with a history of sexual intimidation or abuse should be barred from coaching children, and why sport disciplinary rulings are not factored into VOG screening after the sport register was closed. The minister acknowledged the lack of data linkage, said the Ministry of Justice considers disciplinary rulings unsuitable for VOG screening because they fall outside criminal law, and said the sport register closure is under discussion toward a future integrity centre.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, responsible for VOG screening, considers it undesirable to include disciplinary rulings in VOG screening because disciplinary law falls outside criminal law.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, verantwoordelijk voor de VOG screening, acht het niet wenselijk tuchtrechtelijke uitspraken te betrekken bij de VOG screening omdat het tuchtrecht buiten het strafrecht valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ’Binnenlopen met bejaarden’

MP Hijink (SP) asked 18 questions about private equity ownership in care, including too-big-to-fail risks, conflicts of interest, and whether profit distribution should be banned across care. The ministers answered that commercial care providers must follow the same rules, that integrity legislation (Wibz) is in preparation, and that a blanket profit ban is not preferred.
I am not aware of any research that provides insight into the share of the rise in care costs caused by the presence of private equity firms and other investors in care.
Mij is geen onderzoek bekend dat inzicht biedt in het deel van de stijging van de zorgkosten dat wordt veroorzaakt door de aanwezigheid van private equity-bedrijven en andere beleggers in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over het bericht 'OM gaat ‘schokkend’ Hamas-filmpje bij De Kuip onderzoeken, CIDI doet aangifte'

MPs Ellian and Bikker asked about antisemitic chants at the Feyenoord-Ajax match and why stadium police and the club did not intervene immediately. The government condemns the chants, says the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and the club is cooperating, and promises to discuss stricter anti-discrimination measures with the KNVB.
No statements can be made about ongoing or newly initiated investigations.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over lopende of nieuw op te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van der Laan, Mohandis en Bikker over het lekken van cijfers over misbruik in de danswereld

MPs asked the minister why figures from the dance-sector abuse investigation leaked before the victims were informed, and who held the figures. The minister answered that the leak is regretted, that only the ministries of VWS and OCW received the draft conclusions, and that the government will respond after studying the final report due 22 May.
I have not yet responded substantively, but I think it is important to state that my concern is with the victims.
Ik heb nog niet inhoudelijk gereageerd, maar vind het wel belangrijk om aan te geven dat mijn zorg uitgaat naar de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Vrijblijvend kwaliteitskompas is feestje voor zorgaanbieder'

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care why the new quality compass for nursing homes is non-binding, whether it abandons the staffing norm, and whether staff cuts are worsening the nursing-home staff shortage. The Minister replies that all parties support the compass, a deadline of 1 December 2023 is set with an independent chair, the government denies cutting staff and says 10,000 to 12,000 nursing vacancies remain.
The Generic compass 'Working together on quality of life', including measurement instruments, must be ready by 1 December 2023.
Het Generiek kompas «Samen werken aan kwaliteit van bestaan», inclusief meetinstrumenten, moet uiterlijk 1 december 2023 klaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het ‘Nationaal onderzoek toekomstbestendigheid sportclubs’ via de RVVB, Register voor Verenigingsbesturen

An MP asked the minister about the national study on the future resilience of sports clubs by the Register for Association Boards, covering regulatory differences, added rules and burdens, regulatory-burden testing, and local permit treatment. The minister answered that commercial and association sport differ by legal form, that a Sira study on regulatory burden will report before summer, and that local permitting is a local responsibility.
Before the summer, the State Secretary of VWS will send the report to your House.
Voor de zomer zal de Staatssecretaris van VWS het rapport naar uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over spreekkoren bij de halve finale van de KNVB beker

An MP asked the Minister why the Spakenburg-Westerveld cup semi-final was not stopped over homophobic chants, whether clubs have an incentive not to halt matches, and whether discriminatory chants should be tackled regardless of player impact. The Minister called such chants reprehensible, said the rules are set out in the anti-verbal-abuse guideline and clubs are primarily responsible, and said the approach to homophobic chants needs further development with partners.
Together with partners, I want to build on the 'Our football is for everyone' initiative to focus on setting norms for behaviour in stadiums.

Samen met de partners wil ik in het vervolg op «Ons voetbal is van iedereen. Samen zetten we racisme en discriminatie buitenspel» (OVIVI) hier op inzetten en ons richten op het normeren van gedrag in stadions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ''Meer tijd voor de patiënt' betekent voorlopig vooral meer administratie voor de huisarts'

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the extra consultation time for GPs (MTVP) mostly adds administration, whether all GPs can use it from April 2023, regional variation, funding left unused, and the allocation and governance of GP training places and the SBOH foundation. The minister answered that MTVP is available to up to 25% of registered patients per quarter from 1 April 2023 under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, that administrative burden is meant to be minimal, and that training places are set by the minister on Capaciteitsorgaan advice and distributed by training institutes, with the SBOH board governed by its own supervisory board and statutes.
It will need to become clear in the coming period to what extent these agreements are successfully realised and whether regional differences emerge.
Het zal de komende periode duidelijk moeten worden in hoeverre deze afspraken goed tot stand komen en of daar eventueel regionale verschillen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de energieregeling voor openbare zwembaden

An MP asked the minister about closures of several swimming pools and whether they qualify for the public swimming pool energy scheme, which is nearly finalised with applications expected from late May. The minister answered that only De Zeehoek is a public pool eligible, that the others are private and may fall under the TEK scheme, and that heat-network-connected pools are eligible, with a promised further update on SME heat-network cases.
Based on the data known to me, only swimming pool De Zeehoek in Wervershoof is a public swimming pool eligible for the energy scheme for swimming pools.
Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens is alleen zwembad De Zeehoek in Wervershoof een openbaar zwembad dat in aanmerking komt voor de energieregeling voor zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en De Hoop over de negatieve gevolgen van de brede SPUK-regeling voor kleinere gemeenten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether the bundling of sport and health-promotion grants into the SPUK specific grant harms small municipalities, including the Wadden islands, and how it would be fixed. The government replied that over 98% of municipalities receive more money, that three municipalities (two Wadden islands and Rozendaal) would be topped up to their 2022 level, and that the new allocation key is meant to expand sport and health spending.
For these three municipalities, the specific grant will be increased to the level they received in 2022 from the aforementioned programmes.
Daarom zal voor deze drie gemeenten de specifieke uitkering worden opgehoogd tot het niveau dat zij in 2022 kregen uit genoemde programma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat zorginstellingen inkomsten mislopen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether care providers lose income when disabled clients miss day care, whether providers may charge a fee for no-shows, and whether a temporary compensation tariff is possible. The minister replied that no-show costs are already built into tariffs, that providers may agree a contribution to reduce avoidable absence, and that tariffs will be adjusted through the NZa cost study from 2025.
I am not aware how many care institutions are currently facing reduced income because clients attend day care less often.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel zorginstellingen momenteel met verminderde inkomsten te maken hebben, omdat cliënten minder vaak naar hun dagbesteding gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het toezicht op PGB wooninitiatieven

Westerveld asked the minister about IGJ oversight of PGB-funded residential initiatives, the timing of the IGJ's knowledge of abuses at Aurora Borealis, victim support, and the IGJ budget cut. The minister answered that the IGJ was first alerted on 3 October 2022, visited on 14 December, that oversight is shared with care offices, that no national register of PGB residences exists, and that a 5 million euro budget reduction was general and not tied to staff cuts.
There is no registration of PGB-financed residential initiatives.
Er is geen registratie van pgb-gefinancierde wooninitiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de verkrijgbaarheid van plastic rietjes voor medisch gebruik

An MP asked the minister whether the EU single-use plastics ban has made plastic straws for medical use, including 40 cm straws, hard to obtain, and what will be done for people who depend on them. The minister answered that an enforcement waiver keeps straws available via pharmacies, drugstores and wholesalers, that the national decree will be amended to drop the medical-device certification requirement, and that stakeholders will be engaged.
Whether this specifically also applies to 40 cm straws is not known to me.
Of dit specifiek ook geldt voor rietjes van 40cm is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het sluiten van zorglocaties voor mensen die intensieve zorg nodig hebben

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about Pluryn's plan to close two care locations in Horst for residents with intensive care needs, questioning the impact on relocation, social networks, and the financial rationale. The Minister confirmed awareness, explained the closure stems from long-term losses and staffing problems rather than purely financial motives, and said the provider is working with the care office, families and the municipality to find suitable new places, while declining to guarantee residence in Horst and stating no need for new housing-protection research.
I will discuss this topic in consultations with representatives of client organisations, care providers and care offices and ask them to share any signals with me.
Ik zal dit onderwerp bespreken in overleggen met vertegenwoordigers van cliëntenorganisaties, zorgaanbieders en zorgkantoren en vragen om eventuele signalen met mij te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over gedwongen verhuizingen van mensen in zorgwoningen in Horst aan de Maas

An SP MP asked whether forced relocation of 18 residents of Pluryn care homes in Horst aan de Maas is acceptable, whether residents' legal protection is adequate, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the closure is driven by quality and financial sustainability concerns, that Pluryn is consulting residents, families, staff and the municipality, and that the minister sees no role for himself beyond trusting local consultation.
I see no role for myself in this and rely on good consultation on the ground.
Ik zie voor mijzelf geen rol hierin en vertrouw op het goede overleg ter plekke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Westerveld en Van den Hil  over het sluiten van Emergis

MPs Van den Berg, Westerveld and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the closure of the autism clinic at Emergis, the availability of ggz beds and outpatient places, definitions of crucial mental health care, GP practice support staff and the zorgprestatiemodel tariffs. The minister answered that regional overviews and an inventory of crucial ggz are being compiled, that bed-level data per patient group is not available, and that remaining patients will be placed at Emergis or in their own region.
Meanwhile the IZA parties are working to map the match between supply and demand of care in the regional pictures.
Wel werken de IZA-partijen aan het in beeld krijgen van de aansluiting van vraag en aanbod van zorg in de regiobeelden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Mohandis, Werner en Sylvana Simons over het ratificeren van het facultatief protocol bij het VN-verdrag voor rechten van mensen met een beperking

Five MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether she would keep her promise to decide by the end of Q1 2023 on ratifying the optional protocol to the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, and to give clarity within a week. The minister confirmed the commitment, explained that the decision requires broad consultation across the cabinet because the Council of State advised on related protocols, and promised the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023.
My aim is to send you the cabinet decision by mid-May 2023 at the latest.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om u uiterlijk medio mei 2023 het kabinetsbesluit te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘33 gemeenten verlagen tarieven voor pgb ondanks inflatie’

MP Bevers (VVD) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that 33 municipalities are lowering personal budget (pgb) rates despite inflation, including whether rates fall up to 50 percent and how the reductions are justified as 'reasonable rates'. The minister replied that municipalities set pgb rates themselves within legal requirements to provide adequate rates, that she lacks national insight into individual rates and cannot give percentages, and that she is developing a handreiking (guidance) with VNG and Per Saldo to help municipalities calculate adequate rates.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to set adequate rates.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om toereikende tarieven vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Gehandicapte in de knel: hulp aan verstandelijk beperkte met gedragsstoornis te duur’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports of waiting lists and rising VG7 care for people with intellectual disabilities and complex psychiatric or addiction problems, including whether tariffs are too low and why the 2021 analysis led to no increase. The Minister gave figures (133 on the waiting list, 5 urgent), attributed the rise to growing complexity, pointed to KPMG and NZa studies with results due in 2023-2025, and announced a development programme for complex care.
I believe people with complex care needs are entitled to appropriate care and support.
Ik vind dat mensen met een complexe zorgvraag recht hebben op passende zorg en ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘33 gemeenten verlagen tarieven voor pgb ondanks inflatie: ‘Als ik weer moet gaan werken, dan moeten mijn kinderen naar een instelling’

MP Werner (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care about 33 municipalities lowering personal budget (pgb) hourly rates, some to the minimum wage, and about budget holders who fear to complain, along with related questions on rate-setting and a national guideline. The minister answered that municipalities are legally bound to set adequate rates, that informal carers are at least owed the minimum wage, that objection and appeal procedures exist, and that a joint handreiking with VNG and Per Saldo on pgb rate-setting is planned before the Christmas recess.
Municipalities are legally obliged to set adequate rates so that budget holders can purchase appropriate care and support.
Gemeenten zijn wettelijk verplicht om toereikende tarieven vast te stellen, zodat budgethouders passende zorg en ondersteuning kunnen inkopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aangekondigde stakingen bij de ziekenhuizen en het feit dat KPMG aangeeft dat ziekenhuizen in de rode cijfers komen als ze akkoord gaan met de cao-eisen van d

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about planned hospital strikes, a KPMG finding that hospitals would run losses if they accepted union wage demands, and related pay, premium and pharma-profit questions. The minister answered that a new collective agreement had been reached, that the annual overheid bijdrage (ova) is the government's contribution to wage development, that hospitals must negotiate compensation with insurers, and that a study on care-sector pay will be sent to parliament in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform your House of the outcomes.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Werner en Van den Berg over het item in Op1 ‘Administratieve lasten wijkverpleegkundige en huisarts’ d.d. 15 februari 2023

CDA MPs asked the ministers about an Op1 report on administrative burdens for district nurses and GPs caused by insurers now supplying medical aids mainly through national suppliers rather than pharmacies. The minister called the reported situations undesirable, said insurers and V&VN are collecting cases and that the NZa is holding talks, but did not confirm a causal link to the policy change and gave no firm new commitments.
I find the situations mentioned in the broadcast undesirable.
Ik vind de situaties die in de uitzending worden genoemd onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over ’het antwoord dat oud-minister Martin van Rijn verantwoordelijk is voor de mondkapjesdeal waar 100,8 miljoen euro mee verloren ging’

An MP asks whether the current Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport is the constitutional successor responsible for the 100.8 million euro face-mask deal with RGA, whether the former minister cooperated with the Deloitte investigation, and whether the former minister forced renegotiation. The Minister replies that ministerial responsibility follows the policy portfolio (PBM policy lies with the VWS minister), that the former minister did cooperate with interviews and handed over mailboxes, that the legal advice is to await ongoing investigations and prosecution before recovering damages, and that the report does not show the former minister forcing renegotiation, though he did ask an official to contact Van Lienden.
The advice of the state attorney and VWS lawyers is to await the outcomes of the ongoing (further) investigations and the prosecution service's procedures.
Het advies van de landsadvocaat en de juristen van VWS is om de uitkomsten van de lopende (nadere) onderzoeken en de procedures van het OM af te wachten

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten ‘Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters’, ‘Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024’ en ‘D

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government will suspend visas for Russian athletes while Russia wages war in Ukraine, and how many visas were issued. The minister answered that two short-stay visas were granted in July 2022 for sports events, that each application is assessed individually under the Schengen visa code, and that no separate visa policy for Russian athletes exists.
There is no separate visa policy for this category of applicants.
Er is geen sprake van apart visumbeleid voor deze categorie aanvragers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten 'Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters', 'Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024', en '

Two VVD MPs asked the government what role it can play in excluding Russian sports officials and sports-governing bodies, and whether it knows the international boxing federation is dominated by Russian officials, sponsored by Gazprom and allows Russian athletes under their own flag. The minister answered that the government has spoken out with international partners, confirmed awareness of these facts, said the Dutch boxing federation will skip certain IBA events, and stated that Dutch athletes will suffer no disadvantage.
I have, together with my international colleagues, expressed myself on this in several statements to international sport.
Ik heb mij samen met mijn internationale collega’s daar in meerdere statements richting de internationale sport voor uitgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de genderkliniek die homoseksualiteit probeert te genezen

An MP asked the Minister about reports from the UK Tavistock gender clinic, including claims that gender treatment may function as conversion of homosexuality, and whether Dutch gender care faces similar risks. The Minister said the UK situation cannot be compared, the Inspectorate received few signals and none about disguised conversion, and the quality standard for transgender care is under evaluation with results expected end 2023.
Responsibility for the quality of care lies with field parties (care providers, patient associations, etc.).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van zorg ligt bij veldpartijen (zorgverleners, patiëntenverenigingen etc.).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim nadert hoogst gemeten niveau ooit, vooral in de zorg’

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about rising sickness absence in care, its costs, the role of employer good practice, aggression, and the Veerkracht en Zeggenschap subsidy. The minister said costs data are not held, outlined the TAZ programme and employer-focused measures, and promised an update to Parliament before the summer recess.
I do not have figures on the costs of sickness absence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over de kosten van het ziekteverzuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over verscheidene berichten met betrekking tot de GGZ-tarieven

MPs Van den Berg and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports on GGZ (mental health) tariffs, including retroactive NZa review, insurers paying below the maximum tariff, access to severe care, shortage of intramural beds, and ANW on-call duty by self-employed workers. The Minister answered most questions in substance, stating that the NZa will not review 2022-2023 tariffs retroactively, that cost studies are underway for 2024 and 2026, and that regional inventories of crucial mental health care and sector agreements on on-call duty are being pursued.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) does not look retroactively at the tariffs for the years 2022 and 2023.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) kijkt niet met terugwerkende kracht naar de tarieven voor de jaren 2022 en 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over een meldplicht bij stadionverboden

An MP asks whether repeat stadium offenders who already have a stadium ban should routinely also receive a reporting obligation (meldplicht), and why this is not standard practice, plus an update on the digital reporting pilot. The Minister answers that a meldplicht is a mayoral or judicial decision requiring case-by-case proportionality, that routine imposition is neither feasible nor desirable, and that the digital app prototype is still in development with a decision on the next phase expected around summer.
Routinely imposing a reporting obligation is however neither feasible nor desirable and always requires tailored assessment.
Het standaard opleggen van een meldplicht is echter niet haalbaar en niet wenselijk en vereist altijd maatwerk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het verdwijnen van specialistische ggz behandelplekken

An MP asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport about the closure of specialist mental health treatment places and patients stuck on waiting lists, and whether the IGJ should investigate care quality. The minister answered that patients should contact their health insurer for care mediation, that the IGJ saw no reason for further investigation, that a proposal to stop competitive tendering of crucial mental health care is being reviewed, and that workforce programmes are underway.
The IGJ has taken these signals into account in its supervision of how the care providers concerned have fulfilled their duty of care.
De IGJ heeft deze signalen meegenomen in het toezicht naar hoe de betreffende zorgaanbieders de zorgplichten hebben uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Emergis krimpt kliniek verder in afdeling autisme van 16 naar 5 bedden’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a clinic reducing its autism ward from 16 to 5 beds, asking about prevalence, bed capacity, insurer and ministry consultation, outpatient provision and waiting lists. The minister answered that capacity data are not yet available, that a regional inventory of crucial mental health care is underway, and that the IGJ sees no risks to care quality or continuity.
That is not known. This year the demand for crucial mental health care in supra-regional or national context will be mapped per target group.
Dat is niet bekend. Dit jaar wordt de vraag naar cruciale ggz in bovenregionale of landelijke context per doelgroep in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de ‘zorgarrangeur’

MP Van Haga asks the Minister for Long-term Care about the 'zorgarrangeur' (care arranger) scheme, its origins, its authority to grant care, its funding of EUR 8.9 million, its independence and whether it adds bureaucracy. The minister replies that cross-domain cooperation pilots (Ede, Dongen, Hoogeveen) showed benefits for clients and reduced the need for heavier care, that the role uses existing professionals with a mandate, and that the arranger does not replace the CIZ for Wlz indications.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van lid Van Haga over de 43 miljoen die O2 Health aan de Staat moet terugbetalen voor slechte mondkapjes

The MP asked the minister how the health ministry could sign a costly face-mask deal with O2 Health despite its inability to meet delivery and quality terms, who approved it, whether records would be shared, and what happens to the 43 million owed back. The minister answered that the deal was made under crisis pressure, that the 5.1 billion spending is deemed unlawful, that records were shared confidentially and some names withheld for privacy, and that the state is pursuing recovery including seizing assets.
For privacy reasons, the names of the VWS employees involved in this procurement cannot be shared.
Om privacy redenen kunnen de namen van de medewerkers van VWS die bij deze inkoop betrokken waren, niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht Zoekactie naar vermiste Michael

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a missing psychiatric patient held under a court order, including whether the incident was reported as a calamity and how many escapes are reported annually. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing medical confidentiality, said escapes are not in themselves reportable calamities, and noted that providers must have protocols for detained patients who go missing.
Information about a person's health concerns special personal data that cannot simply be shared with third parties.
Informatie over iemands gezondheid betreft bijzondere persoonsgegevens die niet zomaar met derden gedeeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over mantelzorgwoningen

An MP asked the Minister about problems with care homes (mantelzorgwoningen), municipal policy variation, medical certificates and pre-care housing policy. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist, that municipalities have wide policy discretion so no uniform national framework is intended, and that an action agenda on informal care is being prepared with partners including commitments to bundle good examples and an instruction rule in the environmental plan rules.
Municipalities have considerable policy discretion to support citizens tailored to their needs.
Gemeenten hebben een grote beleidsruimte om burgers, op maat, te kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over het bericht ‘Financieel niet rond kunnen komen tijdens opleiding in de zorg’

MPs Agema and Beertema asked whether medical students cannot afford their clinical rotations and whether the stipend of 100 euro per month is adequate. The minister replied that students can access student finance including loans during rotations, that no data exists on dropouts for financial reasons, and that the basic grant is being reintroduced.
No figures are available on the number of medical students who stop their clinical rotations each year for financial reasons.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal Geneeskundestudenten dat jaarlijks stopt met coschappen om financiële redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Acht diplomafraudeurs in zorg voor de rechter, aantal meldingen verdubbeld’

MPs Bevers and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports of diploma fraud in care, the doubling of reports to the IGJ, and how to ensure employers check diplomas and VOGs. The minister answered that care providers bear final responsibility for checks, that the IGJ and DUO are raising awareness, that fraud is prosecuted criminally, and that making DUO extracts mandatory in hiring is not desirable.
It is not possible to find out how many care diplomas have been downloaded from DUO, because that specific information is not kept.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel zorgdiploma's er gedownload zijn bij DUO, omdat die specifieke informatie niet wordt bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Groen licht voor euthanasie, maar Nathalie wil verkrachter eerst nog een keer in de ogen kijken’ en ‘Na loodzwaar traject kreeg ik ‘groen l

Three CDA MPs asked the health minister about press reports of euthanasia requests linked to sexual trauma, asking for data, whether society is failing victims, waiting times and treatment availability for trauma care. The minister answered that no national data on trauma-linked euthanasia requests exists, acknowledged the tragedy, pointed to the national action programme and the Integral Care Agreement, and gave waiting-time and PTSS treatment figures.
No, no data on this is collected at the national level.
Nee, hierover worden op landelijk niveau geen gegevens verzameld.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Slechtzienden blijven thuis door ov-staking: zorgen over actie op verkiezingsdag’

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how far blind and partially sighted voters must travel to vote, how many polling stations are accessible to them, how many voters would be affected by a public transport strike on election day, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that accessibility varies by municipality, that the government urged unions not to strike on election day and asked VNG municipalities to arrange alternative transport, while stating the Kieswet offers no basis for home voting or early voting.
I have urged the VNG municipalities to try to offer alternative transport to voters who need it because of a possible strike.
Ik heb met de VNG gemeenten opgeroepen om te proberen alternatief vervoer aan te bieden voor de kiezers die dat vanwege een mogelijke staking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Ik heb je data nodig, want ik wil weten hoe duur je bent’

MPs Rajkowski and Van den Hil asked, after press reports, about the legal basis for the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit's mandatory one-off collection of patient-level mental health data, who can see the data, why it is needed, and whether patients can access logs. The minister answered that the NZa's powers rest on the Wmg and AVG, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found the collection lawful with conditions, data are stored securely with logging and a non-linkage guarantee, but patients cannot ask the NZa who viewed their data and must ask their provider instead.
It is not always known to clients and patients which data are shared with whom.
Het is niet altijd bekend bij cliënten en patiënten welke gegevens met wie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de subsidie voor de bouw van ouderenwoningen op de plank blijft liggen

An SP MP asked the minister whether she would respond to reports that part of the subsidy for building senior housing is stalled, and how the government would speed up the slow housing-care process. The minister replies that a EUR 312 million scheme for clustered care will open around summer 2023, that regional agreements and an ambassador role are being arranged, and that the target of 290,000 senior homes is set for 2030.
For this scheme, 312 million euros is available.
Voor deze regeling is 312 mln. euro beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over huishoudelijke hulp

An MP asks the minister about shortages and waiting lists for domestic help (huishoudelijke hulp), the failure to meet the six-week decision norm, and what is being done about the shortages and the planned personal contribution. The minister answers that the number of clients rose about 30% to 2021, that no national waiting-list picture exists, that the planned contribution is expected to reduce demand by about 30,000 clients, and that municipalities are responsible for local measures.
There is no national picture of waiting lists for domestic help.
Er bestaat geen landelijk beeld van wachtlijsten voor huishoudelijke hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat GGZ patiënten niet thuis mogen slapen

An MP asked why answers to earlier questions on GGZ patients being unable to sleep at home took so long, why a trial with three nights of home leave was chosen rather than allowing home overnight stays outright, and how this fits with the minister's stated priority of care over financial considerations. The minister explained that the trial was started in April 2020 at the request of provider Yulius and insurer VGZ, that the existing financing already covers night leave, and that the trial ends in April 2023 with the NZa to advise on next steps.
At the end of April 2023 this experiment ends and the NZa will, together with the parties involved, consider which follow-up steps are needed.
Eind april 2023 loopt dit experiment af en zal de NZa samen met betrokken partijen bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat veel ggz patiënten mogelijk geen vergoeding van hun zorg krijgen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the many mental health patients who may not have their care reimbursed because insurers lack contracts with their providers, including the risks to continuity of treatment and patient choice. The Minister reports that about 73% of offered GGZ institution contracts were signed by early 2023, that existing treatments are protected by law, that insurers must inform patients transparently, and that agreements to finalise contracting before 12 November are being worked out.
Health insurers annually make transparent, before 12 November, with whom they have concluded a contract.
Zorgverzekeraars maken jaarlijks voor 12 november transparant met wie zij een contract hebben afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de renseigneringsverplichting

Green Left MP Ellemeet asked why healthcare providers must report payments to third parties (UBD) despite VAT exemptions, why the deadline is 1 February 2023, and whether they should be exempted or consulted on regulatory burden. The State Secretary answered that the obligation is generic and necessary for income-tax pre-filling and checks, that healthcare providers will not be exempted, that the rules are not retroactive, and that case-by-case deadline extensions are available.
No, I do not want to exempt healthcare providers from this obligation.
Nee, ik wil zorgaanbieders niet uitzonderen van deze verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over wie politiek verantwoordelijk was voor de mondkapjesdeal

MP Agema asked which minister was politically responsible for the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, and whether the former minister van Rijn or de Jonge bore that responsibility. The government answered that the minister for Medical Care and Sport (van Rijn) was constitutionally responsible for the procurement, not de Jonge, and that officials bear no political responsibility.
As indicated in the answers to questions 4 and 5, the Minister for MZS was constitutionally responsible for concluding the agreement with RGA.
Zoals aangegeven bij de antwoorden op vraag 4 en 5 was de Minister voor MZS staatsrechtelijk verantwoordelijk voor het sluiten van de overeenkomst met RGA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving over schrijnende situaties bij terminale patiënten

An MP asked the minister about press reports that terminally ill patients lacked incontinence supplies and were left in their own excrement, and whether the shift of medical aid purchasing to insurers and specialist shops caused this. The minister acknowledged the problems are unacceptable, said the scale is unclear, and announced monitoring, NZa talks, and a promised update on palliative care, while rejecting direct legal liability or a link to the Wmg.
I find it self-evidently undesirable that these situations occur at all.
Ik vind het vanzelfsprekend onwenselijk dat deze situaties überhaupt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Smals, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sahla over het bericht ‘Werkgevers niet happig om mensen meer in te zetten, ondanks personeelstekort’

Four MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Long-Term Care about a news report that employers are reluctant to offer more hours despite staff shortages, and about measures to reduce involuntary part-time work. The government answered that it urges employers to talk with staff, points to the Flexible Working Act while saying it cannot oblige employers to offer full-time contracts, and describes ongoing studies and pilots on a multi-hours bonus and combination jobs.
The cabinet cannot, however, oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts or more working hours when employees ask for them, and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten of meer uren werk aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over gemeenten die voor een dilemma staan over de hoge energiekosten van schaatsbanen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about municipalities facing a dilemma between closing ice rinks or paying large sums because of high energy costs, requesting cost overviews, contract expiry dates, monitoring of the motion-Van Dijk/Van der Laan, and support for Thialf. The minister answered in detail on estimated extra energy costs, monitoring letters, municipal support via the Gemeentefonds, Thialf funding of 1 million euro plus talks on sustainability, and a sustainability taskforce action plan.
It is not possible to monitor precisely how the additional adjustment to the Municipal Fund is used by municipalities.
is het niet mogelijk te monitoren hoe de extra bijstelling op het Gemeentefonds precies door gemeenten wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Systeemfout in de financiering is een belangrijke oorzaak van dodelijke ggz-wachtlijsten'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that risk equalisation in the Dutch mental health system makes insurers reluctant to cover severely ill mental health patients, and about options to address it. The minister replied that exceptional high-cost compensation for severe mental health patients was introduced in 2020 and raised to 90% in 2021, that further research is planned, and that alternative models and ex-post equalisation would reduce insurers' efficiency incentives.
As we explain in answer 5, it was chosen to have health insurers bear considerably less risk over the costs of the most expensive mental health patients, as an exception.
Zoals wij in antwoord 5 toelichten, is gekozen om zorgverzekeraars bij uitzondering beduidend minder risico te laten lopen over de kosten van de duurste ggz-patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Radioloog.nu bindt strijd aan met wervingsbureaus vanwege ‘absurd’ hoge marges'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about reported very high margins charged by medical staffing agencies and whether the government will stop them. The minister acknowledges excessive margins, says only a limited share of costs is agency profit, and states talks with agency associations on a code of conduct plus programme actions on flexible labour.
Antwoord op vragen van Werner over het bericht en het rapport van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens ‘Gecoördineerde aanpak nodig om rechtsbescherming van mensen met een beperking te garanderen’

MP Werner (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report calling for a coordinated national action plan to secure legal protection for people with disabilities, and about ratifying the Optional Protocol to the UN disability convention. The minister says the report is welcome and will be discussed with cabinet colleagues, points to existing judiciary measures, defers the national action plan and rights-protection questions to the Minister for Legal Protection, and promises a letter before summer 2023 and a cabinet decision on ratification in Q1 2023.
I will first consult my cabinet colleagues and other stakeholders before coming with a joint response.
Ik ga eerst in gesprek mijn collega’s in het kabinet en andere betrokkenen alvorens ik met een gezamenlijke reactie kom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Groene GGZ

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the Groene GGZ initiative, nature-based care in mental health, and funding for green approaches to ease pressure on specialist mental health care. The minister answered that sustainability measures exist under the Green Deal and subsidies, but that green-care approaches are for care professionals to judge and receive no specific national subsidy, with sector plans and budgets for the Green Deal still to be developed.
It is up to care professionals to judge whether such deployment can be a valuable addition to the current care offer and working practice.
Het is aan de zorgprofessionals om te beoordelen of een dergelijke inzet een waardevolle aanvulling kan zijn op het huidige zorgaanbod en werkpraktijk.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sahla en Werner over het bericht ‘Te groot en vies, in veel gevallen mag de hulphond niet mee, zegt KNGF’

MPs Sahla and Werner asked whether refusals of assistance dogs in shops violate the Constitution and the UN disability convention, and what the minister will do to improve access, recognition and standards. The minister acknowledges reports of refusals, points to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens as a low-threshold, non-binding route with follow-up in most cases, and says a conformity certification scheme and European standards are under study without firm timelines.
For this reason it is important that such incidents can also be brought before the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Om deze reden is het belangrijk dat dergelijke voorvallen ook kunnen worden voorgelegd aan het College van de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het verdwijnen van specialistische GGZ behandelplekken

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asks the minister about the closure and downsizing of specialist mental health beds, the lack of data on high-complexity care, continuity of care for patients from closed clinics, and the NZa's conclusion that the duty of care was not breached. Minister Kuipers responds that the bed numbers are hard to verify, points to Integraal Zorgakkoord agreements on mapping crucial mental health care, reports that IGJ and NZa received few signals about inadequate replacement care, and defends the ambulantisation policy.
It is up to the NZa, in its role as supervisor, to establish whether the duty of care has been met.
Het is aan de NZa in haar rol als toezichthouders om vast te stellen of er aan de zorgplicht is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Thijs Zonneveld: "Alleen een topsporter voor de klas is niet genoeg"’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Sporthelden op School' business case and pilot linking top athletes, sports clubs, municipalities and schools is known, and whether it can inform new pilots and the athlete stipend scheme. The minister confirms awareness, agrees that school-sport links can help vulnerable children, but defers concrete decisions on the pilots to an exploration starting in early 2023 and proposes linking the EUR 200,000 stipend amendment funds to top athletes working in schools in 2023.
I cannot yet say anything about that because we are starting the exploration of the further design of these pilots in early 2023.
Daar kan ik nog geen uitspraken over doen omdat we met de verkenning over de nadere invulling van deze pilots in het begin van 2023 starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de raming en opleiding van Sociaal-Psychiatrisch Verpleegkundigen (SPV)

An MP asked the minister about the lack of structural funding for the sociaal-psychiatrisch verpleegkundige (SPV) training, the number of SPVs needed, why the capacity body does not forecast SPV demand, and whether funding and inclusion in the availability contribution will be pursued. The minister replied that SPV training is not structurally subsidised, that no SPV-specific demand forecast exists, that a one-off vacancy study will be done, and that no new funding or availability-contribution listing is planned because responsibility lies with providers.
I am willing to examine the vacancy rate among sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundigen once, to get a picture of whether there is really a notable shortage.
Ik ben wel bereid om eenmalig de vacaturegraad bij sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundigen te onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Duizenden ouderen hebben acuut verpleeghuisbed nodig, tekort groeit snel’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how the strain on care (acute shortage of nursing home beds, falls leading to hospital and nursing home admission, waiting lists for ouderen) should be understood and what the government will do. The Minister answered that care is under pressure from ageing, labour shortages and changing preferences, outlined waiting-list figures, and said she will consult the four largest Wlz insurers and regions and that funds will flow to regions for integrated home-based care.
Given ageing, labour shortages and older people's changing preferences, which is to keep control over their own lives for as long as possible and live in their own environment, a change is necessary.

Met het oog op de vergrijzing, de krapte op de arbeidsmarkt en de wijzigende voorkeuren van ouderen, die zo lang mogelijk de regie over hun eigen leven willen behouden en willen wonen in hun eigen omgeving, is een verandering noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat van de bijna 22.000 hoogbejaarde wachtenden, 4.734 urgent wachten, wat een stijging van 70% is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the rise in urgent nursing home placement waits, the timing of placements, and the care-intensity profiles of those waiting. The Minister replied that 307 people are urgent and 4,430 active, that most urgent cases are placed within the norm, that the waiting list rose to about 22,000, and that the government will talk with regions about organising home care better, while giving no firm timeline for clearing the list.
I am starting these talks in those places where this problem is greatest.
Ik begin met deze gesprekken op die plaatsen waar dit probleem het grootst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Bewoners Zeist boos over uitbreidingsplannen KNVB: 'Heel bos moet er voor wijken'

An MP asked the minister for Long-term Care and Sport about residents' opposition to the KNVB's plan to expand its Zeist campus onto nature land, and about the role of Staatsbosbeheer, the value of the campus and comparable facilities abroad.
