The minister answered that the expansion is a private KNVB initiative for the KNVB and the province of Utrecht to assess, and that Staatsbosbeheer will not sell the land until the zoning change and nature compensation are approved.
However, it is up to the KNVB itself to weigh what is precisely needed for talent development and the Netherlands' international competitive position in the football world.
Het is echter aan de KNVB zelf om een afweging te maken over wat er precies nodig is voor talentontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van Nederland in de voetbalwereld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over haar reactie op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over het hinderpaalcriterium inzake de Vrije Artsenkeuze en het verlagen van de tarieven met 25–35% door verzekeraars voor ongecontr

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport how she responds to the Supreme Court rulings on the hindrance criterion of free choice of provider, and to insurers cutting reimbursement for non-contracted mental health and home care by 25-35% from 2023, which may create a two-tier system; she asks why citizens are referred to courts and whether the government will stop the cuts before year end. The minister answers that the rulings permit generic discounts in principle but must be assessed case by case against the hindrance criterion, that complaints can go to insurers, the dispute body or courts, and that the cuts are part of the Integraal Zorgakkoord, with the hindrance criterion as a condition.
The hindrance criterion is laid down in law. It is for the dispute body and the court to assess in specific cases whether the insurer's reimbursement conflicts with the hindrance criterion.

Het hinderpaalcriterium ligt besloten in de wet. Het is aan de geschilleninstantie en de rechter om in specifieke gevallen te beoordelen of de vergoeding van de zorgverzekeraar in strijd is met het hinderpaalcriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Het afwegen van eten voor ouderen in zorgcentrum Die Buytenweye in Delft

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care about a Delft care home reportedly rationing residents' food portions to cut waste and costs, and about wider waste and nutrition risks for elderly residents. The Minister says the letter should not have been sent, has been corrected, the home denies it was a cost-cutting measure, and no data exist on care-sector food waste but a study is planned.
After contact with the care institution it became clear that the letter to residents should not have been sent and has since been corrected in a supplementary letter.
Na contact met de zorginstelling is gebleken dat de brief aan bewoners niet verstuurd had moeten worden en intussen ook is gecorrigeerd in een aanvullende brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een opiniestuk waarin wordt gepleit de zorgverzekeraars uit het zorgstelsel te halen

An MP asked the health minister whether they know an op-ed calling for health insurers to be removed from the system, what insurers cost per firm, and how the system would work without them. The minister confirmed awareness, tabled 2021 operating costs per insurer (about 81 euro per insured, 2.6% of care costs, down from earlier years), and argued that the functions insurers perform would still need to be carried out under any alternative model.
Even without the current health insurers, the tasks they perform in the current system must still be carried out.
Ook zonder huidige zorgverzekeraars moeten de taken die zij in het huidige systeem uitvoeren worden vervuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat GGZ patiënten niet thuis mogen slapen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why GGZ patients may not sleep at home on leave even when their treating doctor approves, and whether a legal rule forces insurers to cut budgets. The minister answered that payment depends on overnight stays set by NZa tariff rules rather than a statute, that financially driven refusals are not acceptable, and that an NZa experiment with home sleep leave runs until April 2023 with follow-up to be decided then.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Hijink over Het bericht ‘Inval commerciële verpleeghuizen, ouderen verwaarloosd’

MPs Werner and Hijink asked about reports of police raids on Orpea's commercial care homes, private-equity involvement, profit disclosure to residents, property sale-and-leaseback, and IGJ supervision. The minister answered that providers must follow existing law, that the IGJ enforces care quality, and gave figures on private-equity concentrations and Orpea's growth, while declining to comment on ongoing inspections.
The IGJ does not make statements about whether investigations are ongoing.
De IGJ doet geen mededelingen over al dan niet lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens over het artikel ‘Directeur Thialf uit in brief aan Tweede Kamer ’zeer grote zorgen’ over voortbestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Thialf ice rink's plans to innovate on sustainability and energy costs, and about sustainability support for sports facilities. The minister confirmed awareness, stated support for sports sustainability through the BOSA scheme and other subsidies, and committed to evaluating and continuing the BOSA scheme from 2024 and to exploring financing structures.
I informed your House about this in advance of the committee meeting on sport on 28 November.
Ik heb uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan het WGO sport van 28 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Deloitte-onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

The MP Agema asked the minister about the Deloitte report on the face-mask deal, including which officials were CDA members and their functions. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report but declined to disclose officials' functions and party membership, citing personal data protection and Article 68 of the Constitution.
Given the traceability of the (special) personal data you requested, I therefore cannot share with you either the function or the political party membership of VWS officials.

Gelet op de herleidbaarheid van de door u gevraagde (bijzondere) persoonsgegevens kan ik daarom zowel geen functie alsook geen lidmaatschap van een politieke partij van VWS functionarissen met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het Deloitte-onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether she knew of the Deloitte report on the face mask deal, whether a named civil servant was a CDA member and what function that official held at the ministry. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, explained that names, functions and party membership of officials are withheld under Article 68 of the Constitution and the GDPR, and agreed to answer before the committee debate.
Given the traceability of the (special category) personal data you requested, I therefore cannot share with you either the function or the political party membership of officials.
Gelet op de herleidbaarheid van de door u gevraagde (bijzondere) persoonsgegevens kan ik daarom zowel geen functie alsook geen lidmaatschap van een politieke partij van ambtenaren met u delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer meldingen verwarde personen, maar aanpak moeilijk door privacywet: ‘Je weet niet met wie je te maken hebt.’’

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about rising reports of persons with confused behaviour, data-sharing barriers under privacy law, and whether the national reporting line tracks outcomes. The ministers answered that the national line only forwards callers to regional bodies, that cooperation and data-sharing frameworks are being developed, and that they will keep consulting field partners and the EU on the GDPR.
No, no data is centrally collected on this.
Nee, hierover wordt centraal geen data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over poep spuitende wc's in een ouderenflat in  Hellevoetsluis

An MP asked the minister whether he would hold the housing corporation and municipality to account over sewage backing up into the homes of elderly residents in Hellevoetsluis, and what action he would take. The minister answered that the corporation was responsible for a sewer pipe breach, that it had repaired the breach and taken preventive measures, and that he considers sufficient action has been taken.
The inspection showed a breach in the sewer pipe, for which the corporation was responsible and not the municipality.
Er bleek op basis van de inspectie sprake van een breuk in de rioolleiding, waarvoor de corporatie verantwoordelijk was en niet de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht ‘Minder administratie als oplossing voor personeelstekort’

PVV MP Agema asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether reducing administrative burden is the solution to staff shortages in care, citing Berenschot figures on time spent on administration. The minister agreed reducing unnecessary administrative burden can contribute, outlined the [Ont]Regel de Zorg programme and IZA commitments, but said a broad integrated approach is needed.
Reducing unnecessary administrative burden can make a substantial contribution to reducing the current staff shortages in care.
Het verminderen van onnodige administratieve lasten kan een substantiële bijdrage leveren aan het terugdringen van de huidige personeelstekorten in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla, Belhaj en Kuzu over het artikel 'Racisme duwt medewerkers uit de ouderenzorg'

MPs Sahla, Belhaj and Kuzu asked ministers about a NRC article saying racism pushes care workers out of elderly care, and about the scale of discrimination, its effect on health and sickness absence, and what government and care providers are doing. The ministers answered that discrimination is recognised but insufficiently addressed by employers, cited survey data, described existing Arbo duties and support tools, and announced a national study in 2023 and a progress letter in autumn 2023.
The Ministry of VWS intends to start a nationwide study in 2023 into discrimination and equal opportunities in care, welfare and sport.
Het Ministerie van VWS wil in 2023 een landelijk onderzoek starten naar discriminatie en gelijk kansen in de zorg, welzijn en sport.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Losser testbeleid in ziekenhuizen’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that some hospitals let staff with mild COVID symptoms keep working, and about the reliability of self-tests and the role of care workers and works councils. The minister answered that hospitals may deviate from the RIVM advice under the FMS guideline when care continuity is at risk, that the IGJ can ask boards to justify such decisions, and that the DB advises relaxing testing for care staff.
If there are signals that employers are not acting in line with the guideline, care workers can report this to the IGJ.
Indien er signalen zijn dat werkgevers niet handelen conform de leidraad, dan kunnen zorgmedewerkers een melding doen bij de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over kleinschalige zorg voor ouderen

An MP (Sahla, D66) asked the minister about reports on small-scale care for older people, the gap between home care and nursing-home care, and the role of specialist elderly-care physicians. The minister acknowledged the access problems, pointed to planned sector agreements on general medical care and a pending NZa tariff advice, and said no extra powers for the IGJ or NZa are needed.
To better align the care supply within small-scale housing initiatives with clients' care needs, it is not necessary to grant the IGJ and NZa additional powers.
Om het zorgaanbod binnen kleinschalige wooninitiatieven beter te laten aansluiten op de zorgvraag van cliënten is het niet nodig om extra bevoegdheden toe te kennen aan de IGJ en NZa.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over terhandstellingskosten

MPs Westerveld and Ellemeet asked whether pharmacy dispensing fees (terhandstellingskosten), which can exceed the cost of small-quantity medicines, can be capped nationally or excluded from the deductible. The minister replied that pharmacy tariffs are free, so no national caps are set, that excluding dispensing fees from the deductible is not desirable, and pointed to existing measures such as the frozen deductible and the capped cost-sharing for medicines.
I do not consider it desirable to exclude dispensing from the deductible, even in the case of repeated dispensing to the same patient.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de terhandstelling uit te zonderen van het eigen risico, ook niet als het gaat om herhaalde terhandstellingen bij dezelfde patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rudmer Heerema over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam tussen de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en de Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond (KNLTB)

MPs Ellian and Heerema asked the ministers about court rulings on the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and its fine on the KNLTB, including whether a European Commission letter criticising the AP's strict reading of 'legitimate interest' was withheld. The minister answered that the matter is pending before the courts and the CJEU, that the Commission letter was not shared with the cabinet and is confidential within court proceedings, and that the cabinet will not intervene in the independent AP.
Assessing which documents are necessary for resolving a dispute is for the judge, not the cabinet.
De beoordeling welke stukken voor de beslechting van een geschil noodzakelijk zijn, is aan de rechter, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Mohandis over ‘De impact van geldstress en schulden op de (mentale) gezondheid van mensen’

MPs Kuiken and Mohandis asked how financial stress and debt affect mental and physical health, whether care pressure on GPs and mental health services will rise, and why a fund for energy debts was chosen over preventive measures. The government acknowledges the health link, points to its broader poverty, debt and mental health policies and a temporary energy price cap, and says a temporary emergency fund for energy debts is being explored.
To prevent this, the possibility of a temporary emergency fund is currently being explored.
Om dit te voorkomen wordt momenteel de mogelijkheid van een tijdelijk noodfonds verkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het tweede OVV-rapport over de Nederlandse aanpak van de coronacrisis

An MP asks the government to explain why COVID-19 measures between September 2020 and July 2021 were presented as scientifically founded despite the OVV's finding that their effects were unclear, and whether information was withheld or communication misleading. The minister denies any deliberate misleading, says effects were monitored and evaluated, defers the full government reaction to the OVV report, and largely refers to a letter of 11 November 2022 without substantive new evidence.
Regarding this subject, I have informed your House in my letter of 11 November 2022.
Met betrekking tot dit onderwerp heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 11 november 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked the government about discriminatory chants at football matches, including why FC Twente did not stop a match over homophobic chants and how often matches are halted. The minister answered that clubs bear primary responsibility, that the rules do not depend on chant duration, that exact figures are not kept, and that he is willing to talk with supporters' groups and plans a follow-up to the OVIVI action plan.
Exact figures are not known and reports are not centrally registered and kept for a longer period.
Exacte cijfers zijn niet bekend en meldingen worden niet centraal geregistreerd en voor langere tijd bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Cliënt heeft GGZ vaak niet nodig'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a newspaper report claiming many GGZ clients do not need mental health care, and about addressing underlying social problems to reduce waiting lists. The minister answered that a broader multidisciplinary approach with the social domain, new mental health centres and a national network of low-threshold support points is planned, while noting monitoring under the Integraal Zorgakkoord and existing initiatives on debt, work and mental health.
As I informed your House in my letter of 21 October, I support an approach in which problems people face are considered multidisciplinarily.
Zoals ik uw Kamer in mijn brief van 21 oktober jongstleden heb bericht 2 , ondersteun ik een werkwijze waarin multidisciplinair wordt gekeken naar problemen die mensen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van In het vizier van De Jager over ouderenmishandeling

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a broadcast on elder abuse in care homes, including a whistleblower dismissed after reporting unresolved abuse and the difficulty of reporting. The minister acknowledged the mistreatment, pointed to prior research, a guidance handreiking and a serious game, and said reporting to the inspectorate is possible though the employer must handle the dismissal.
I have been in contact with Vilente. There appear to be some nuances there. It is up to the organisation to judge the dismissal of this employee.
Ik heb contact gehad met Vilente. Daar blijken enkele nuances. Het is aan de organisatie om een oordeel te geven over het ontslag van deze medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de desastreuze gevolgen van de hoge energieprijzen voor de sport

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the consequences of high energy prices for sports clubs and facilities, including whether prices and access are at risk and what compensation will be provided. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to energy-saving advice, sustainability support, the TEK compensation scheme and the price cap, says the sector shares responsibility, and defers a full answer on the motions to November.
I will inform the House about that in November.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarover in november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens ver het artikel 'Amateurclubs rekenen op taaie winter door hoge gasprijzen: ‘Sommige leden douchen júíst hier'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the impact of high gas and energy prices on sports facilities, especially swimming pools and ice rinks, and what support is available. The minister acknowledged the strong impact, cited a Mulier Institute survey and NOC*NSF estimates (including 200 pools at risk of closure), noted a 378 million euro cost increase for 2022-2023, and pointed to sustainability support and ongoing consultations with operators and municipalities.
That is why I asked operators of sports facilities to calculate the size of the cost increase, from which the figure you cited follows.
Daarom heb ik exploitanten van sportaccommodaties gevraagd om een berekening te maken van de omvang van de lastenstijging, waaruit het door u genoemde getal volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Kops over de dreigende sluiting van 200 zwembaden

PVV MPs Maeijer and Kops asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that 200 public swimming pools face closure due to energy costs, including what the government will do and how sport stays affordable. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the figures cannot be substantiated, pointed to existing energy support schemes and a pending review of sport-sector needs, and promised a further update in November.
These figures cannot be substantiated concretely, but I do share the concerns about the impact of rising energy costs on public swimming pools.
Deze cijfers zijn niet concreet te onderbouwen, maar ik deel wel de zorgen omtrent de impact van de stijgende energiekosten voor openbare zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat ouderen in kleine instellingen soms zonder basiszorg zitten

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that elderly residents of small institutions sometimes lack basic medical care, and about when a structural fix would be ready, why some regions manage this and others do not, what happens meanwhile, and how the specialist's conditions will improve. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a sector project with a planning to be reported to parliament in early 2023, cited IGJ/NZa causes, and listed interim measures and a list of factors affecting the approach.
Your House will be informed in early 2023 about the progress and the planning.
Uw Kamer wordt begin 2023 geïnformeerd over de voortgang en de planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat aanbieders van wijkverpleging miljoenen euro’s verlies lijden en de toegankelijkheid van de zorg in gevaar is

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care whether home-care providers' losses and access problems are caused by the tariff system, what the NZa's role is in enforcing insurers' duty of care, and how care at home can be ensured. The minister answered that contracting is free and the hourly model no longer fits the goals, that insurers expect extra revenue in 2023, that the NZa decides on interventions, and pointed to the WOZO programme.
It is up to the NZa, as independent supervisor, to choose an appropriate intervention.
Het is aan de NZa, als onafhankelijke toezichthouder, om hierbij een passende interventie te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden doden na valincidenten'

An MP asked about reports that fatal fall incidents have doubled in ten years, the timing of a fall-prevention programme plan, how municipal funds for fall prevention will be ensured to go to effective measures, and whether municipalities are preparing. The minister acknowledged the concern, linked the rise to an ageing population, said the programme plan would be sent to the House before Christmas, and described a specific grant and national support being prepared.
The House will be informed about this before Christmas.
De Kamer wordt hierover voor de kerst geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht 'Duizenden doden na valincidenten, Financiering valpreventie ouderen blijft lastig'

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about financing fall prevention for older people after a news report on deaths from falls, and about progress on the related amendment, alternative financing, and timely completion of the care chain approach. The minister confirms the policy priority, lists activities funded from amendment money, notes alternative financing via the Health Impact Bond and future funding from 2023-2024, and says governance and agreements with VNG and ZN are being developed.
I intend to make agreements with the VNG and ZN in the GALA.
Ik ben voornemens om afspraken te maken met de VNG en ZN in het GALA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'VWS blijft dwangsommen betalen voor het niet openbaren Sywert-communicatie'

An MP asked the health minister why the ministry has not yet released internal communication on the Sywert deal despite a court order, why it keeps paying penalty payments, and what grounds it relies on for withholding. The minister answered that chat messages need review for cabinet confidentiality, the selection is incomplete, and the Woo process is capacity-intensive, while committing to transparency and declining to specify the refusal grounds before the Woo decision is taken.
The Ministry of VWS does everything to provide requesters with information as quickly and purposefully as possible, while observing the due-care requirements the Woo sets.
Het Ministerie van VWS doet er alles aan om verzoekers zo snel en zo doelgericht mogelijk van informatie te voorzien met in achtneming van de zorgvuldigheidseisen die de Woo stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de zorgbonus voor pgb-zorgverleners en de tegemoetkoming voor mantelzorgers naar aanleiding van het antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen

An MP asked whether the care bonus for Zvw-pgb care workers over 2020 and 2021 had been arranged, and what the status was. The minister replied that it is not yet arranged, citing privacy and legal-basis obstacles because the SVB lacks visibility of the Zvw-pgb target group, and promised to report in Q1 2023.
This has not yet been arranged.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het buitenspeelbeleid in gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of structural attention to outdoor play in national and municipal policy, the share of municipalities with outdoor-play policy and monitoring, and plans to adopt foreign practice and integrate play space into urban planning. The minister answered that 40 percent of municipalities have specific outdoor-play policy, that a knowledge agenda, data harmonisation and a municipal toolbox are in progress, and that concrete play-space design remains the municipalities' responsibility.
The concrete design of public space in a neighbourhood, however, always requires tailored work and also depends on the population composition; responsibility for this lies with the municipality.
De concrete invulling van de openbare ruimte in een wijk vraagt echter steeds maatwerk en is ook afhankelijk van de bevolkingssamenstelling, de verantwoordelijkheid daarvoor ligt bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sahla over de Verliezen in de wijkverpleging

MPs Paulusma and Sahla ask the minister about financial losses in district nursing (wijkverpleging), the NZa's view that the situation is worrying, contracting by insurers, budget underspending and staff sickness. The minister acknowledges sector pressure, points to IZA agreements including a 600 million euro downward adjustment and extra insurer revenue commitments for 2023, and says some data (tariffs, sector-specific sickness and deficit analysis) is not available yet.
I will closely monitor these agreements made in the IZA.
Ik zal deze afspraken die in het IZA gemaakt zijn nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de oplopende kosten bij verpleeghuizen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about rising costs for nursing homes (energy, food, laundry), whether staff can get inflation-linked pay rises, whether one-off compensation is planned, and what room remains for investment. The minister pointed to an ongoing inventory of energy-cost effects, an early tariff update for 2023 and the government's general support and wage-funding measures, but gave no concrete compensation decision.
On the basis of this inventory, I will assess together with the cabinet whether additional measures are needed to ensure continuity of care.
Op basis van deze inventarisatie beoordeel ik samen met het kabinet of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn om de continuïteit van zorg te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht 'Chronisch zieken hebben weinig baat bij het prijsplafond: ‘Het voelt als een oneerlijke strijd’'

PVV MPs Agema and Kops asked how the government will address chronically ill and disabled people who cannot afford energy bills, including whether the energy price cap can be raised or differentiated for high medical energy use. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said differentiation within a price cap is not feasible, pointed to municipal Bijzondere Bijstand and other measures, and promised to inform parliament on a related motion.

In reply to your questions 5 and 6, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform Parliament about the motion by MP Van der Plas et al. on energy compensation for higher energy costs due to medical causes.
Als antwoord op uw vraag 5 en 6 zal de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) het Parlement informeren over de motie van het Kamerlid Van der Plas c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat vier van de tien zorgmedewerkers de zorg dreigen te verlaten

An SP MP asked ministers about reports that four in ten care workers may leave the sector, the rising costs of voluntary deductibles, pay, autonomy and occupational risk insurance. The minister answered that only 9% plan to leave, cited programmes (TAZ, zeggenschap subsidies, 675 million extra for middle groups) and said pay and deductible choices are individual or for social partners.
The mandatory deductible amounts to 385 euro.
Het verplichte eigen risico bedraagt 385 euro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Westerveld over diverse berichten over het disfunctioneren van het ISR en de negatieve gevolgen voor de sporters/sportsters

MPs Van der Laan and Westerveld asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is failing, harming victims of abuse in sport, including former gymnasts. The minister answers that an independent review of sports disciplinary law is underway with results expected in early 2023, that professionalisation measures and additional subsidy conditions are planned, and that the ministry's powers over sports disciplinary law are limited.
I am willing to inform the House in broad outline about the content of the additional subsidy conditions once they have been sent to the institution with the subsidy award.
Ik ben bereid om de Kamer op hoofdlijnen te informeren over de invulling van de aanvullende subsidievoorwaarden zodra deze in de subsidieverlening aan de instelling zijn verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Engelse voetballer komt uit de kast, nu nog in Nederland’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of openly gay professional male footballers in the Netherlands, low acceptance ratings in football, and the handling of homophobic remarks. The government acknowledged that homophobia does not belong in sport and pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen) but committed to no new concrete action.
Homophobia and negative expressions do not belong in sport and therefore also not in football.
Homofobie en negatieve uitingen horen niet thuis in de sport en dus ook niet in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Werner over kwetsbare ouderen die vaak geen gebruik maken van inkomensvoorzieningen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Ministers for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions and for Long-term Care and Sport about vulnerable older people who often do not claim income support, citing a National Ombudsman report on complexity, distance from government and low trust. Minister Schouten largely agreed with the analysis, estimated roughly 30% potential non-take-up of the AIO (about 20,000 households), announced a data-exchange pilot between SVB and UWV/Tax Authority, and defended current application procedures while saying automatic allocation is complex and only sometimes feasible.
I broadly share the analysis of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de analyse van de Nationale ombudsman in grote lijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Zorgpersoneel met long covid radeloos, vakbonden stellen ultimatum aan kabinet’

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how the government would respond to unions' ultimatum over financial compensation for care workers suffering long COVID who lost jobs or income. The minister replied that the government will seek Council of State advice on a follow-up to a joint exploration and will inform parliament as soon as possible, without committing to a specific payment.

After receiving the advice from the Council of State, the cabinet will decide on the follow-up to the exploration and will inform the House of Representatives about this by letter as soon as possible.
Na ontvangst van de voorlichting van de Raad van State beslist het kabinet over het vervolg op de verkenning en zal uw Kamer daarover zo spoedig mogelijk per brief worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bikker over Het artikel 'Bonden dagen Helder voor rechter om uitblijven longcovidfonds zorg'

MPs Paulusma and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about unions suing over the government's failure to set up a long-COVID fund for healthcare workers, and about the delayed letter promised under their motion. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said a legal review by the Raad van State is needed before deciding on support for this group, and promised an update this autumn.
After receiving the advice, the cabinet will decide on the follow-up to the exploration and will inform your House about this by letter as soon as possible.
Na ontvangst van de voorlichting beslist het kabinet over het vervolg op de verkenning en zal uw Kamer daarover zo spoedig mogelijk per brief informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘ADO Den Haag vindt in Funland nieuwe hoofdpartner jeugdopleiding’ en over het aangekondigde verbod op sponsoring van sportclubs door aanbieders van kansspelen in he

An MP asked whether gambling operators (Hommerson Funland and Sir Winston) sponsoring ADO Den Haag youth kits and shirts breaches the ban on gambling advertising aimed at minors, and asked about the scope and timing of the planned sponsorship ban. The ministers acknowledged that such sponsorship must not target minors and that the Gambling Authority can intervene, but said the planned sponsorship ban covers only online gambling and that a two-year transition period is proposed.
If a licence holder does not comply with these rules, the Gambling Authority (Ksa) as supervisor can intervene.
Indien een vergunninghouder zich niet houdt aan deze regels kan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) als toezichthouder ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over Problemen met tolkenvoorzieningen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about bureaucratic procedures at UWV for interpreter provision for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, the length of request times, limits on extra interpreting hours abroad and daily caps, and the lack of team interpreting for shorter assignments. The minister replied that user and interpreter satisfaction with UWV is largely positive, that the 8-week statutory deadline is met with a 10-day target, that the caps are needed for transparency and sustainability with case-by-case exceptions, and that team interpreting for the living domain is being explored, with ongoing optimisation planned.
For the living domain I am currently exploring the impact of lowering the minimum duration of team interpreting assignments from two hours to assignments longer than one hour.
Ik ben voor het leefdomein op dit moment bezig met het verkennen van de impact van het verlagen van de minimumduur van teamtolkopdrachten van twee uur naar opdrachten die langer dan één uur duren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Ginneken over het bericht 'Toezichthouder verzamelt ongevraagd info over 800.000 ggz-patiënten'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether the NZa (healthcare regulator) may collect patients' mental health data without explicit consent, on what legal basis, and whether privacy principles and the Data Protection Authority were properly addressed. The minister answered that the NZa acts under its statutory powers in the Wmg, that data are pseudonymised and will be destroyed after use, that the reporting obligation was postponed to 1 January 2023, and that no further investigation will be ordered because the NZa decides itself how to gather information.

I will not instruct further research as described in questions 8 and 9, because, as stated in my answer to question 1, the NZa as an independent administrative body makes its own considerations about how it generates information.

Ik zal geen opdracht geven tot nader onderzoek zoals omschreven in vraag 8 en 9, omdat zoals gesteld in mijn antwoord op vraag 1 de NZa als ZBO haar eigen afwegingen maakt over de wijze waarop zij informatie genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht 'Agressie aan de balie leidt tot uitstroom apotheekpersoneel'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that aggression at pharmacy counters is driving pharmacy staff out, and about measures to address aggression against first-line care workers. The minister acknowledged the problem, described ongoing branch-based approaches and talks with professional bodies, and said further measures are being explored without committing to specific new steps.
I consider it important that pharmacists, pharmacy assistants and all other first-line care workers can carry out their work in a good and safe manner.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat apothekers, apothekersassistenten en alle andere zorgverleners in de eerstelijnszorg hun werk op een goede en veilige manier kunnen uitoefenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het nieuws dat de National Health Service (NHS) Tavistock kliniek, de enige genderidentiteitskliniek voor kinderen en jongeren in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, heef

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the government about the closure of the Tavistock gender identity clinic in the UK, how Dutch gender care for minors compares, whether rising referrals occur in the Netherlands, and whether the planned legal change to the gender entry in birth records (Transgenderwet) should be paused. The Minister answered that the Dutch approach is multidisciplinary and not affirmative in the Cass-review sense, that referral numbers rose 183% since 2018 with causes still under study, and that he sees no reason to pause the bill, since a judicial review protects children under sixteen.
I see no reason to pause the handling of bill 35 825.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel 35 825 aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het uitsluiten van de uitvaartbranche van de zorgbonus

The MP asks why funeral sector workers were excluded from the COVID-19 care bonus, whether the ministry will talk with the sector, and why a 2020 letter from a funeral supplier association went unanswered. The minister replies that the subsidy is limited to the care and welfare sector, the funeral sector falls outside it, and extending it is not on the table, while acknowledging correspondence from the sector.
The funeral sector does not fall under this sector and for that reason was not eligible to submit a subsidy application.
De uitvaartbranche valt niet onder de deze sector en kwam om die reden niet in aanmerking om een subsidieaanvraag in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulphonden

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the coverage of assistance dogs under the Zvw and Wmo, the evidence for dogs for mental health conditions such as PTSS, and the costs, regulation and oversight of dog training schools. Minister Helder answered that only blind-guide, signal and ADL dogs are covered by the basic health insurance, that therapy and PTSS dogs lack sufficient proven effectiveness, that municipalities have discretion under the Wmo, and that regulation of trainers relies on private standards and a pending European norm.
The Zorginstituut will then consider whether these results give reason to carry out an assessment within the framework of the 'state of science and practice'.
Het Zorginstituut zal dan bekijken of deze resultaten aanleiding zijn om een beoordeling te doen in het kader van de «stand van de wetenschap en praktijk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over beschikbaarheid van nachtzorg

The MP asks how the government will ensure all regions make agreements on unplannable night-time home care, how it will enforce cooperation and landsdekkendheid, and what the Berenschot evaluation is for. The minister answers that the responsibility lies with regional providers and insurers, that the government monitors implementation and will apply administrative pressure if needed, that Berenschot found freerider behaviour in 13 of 23 regions, and that joint purchasing by insurers adds little and would reduce competition.
I expect parties to make every effort to implement the agreements made, and if implementation lags, I will exert administrative pressure to bring it about.

Ik verwacht van partijen dat zij zich maximaal inspannen om de afspraken die gemaakt zijn te implementeren en zal, indien de implementatie achterblijft, bestuurlijke druk uitoefenen om dat te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Onprofessionele geneeskundestudent moet makkelijker weggestuurd kunnen worden'

Two VVD MPs asked why medical schools cannot more easily expel students who repeatedly behave unprofessionally, and whether the Iudicium Abeundi rules should be changed. The minister answered that the IA is reserved for exceptional cases involving patient safety, that institutions can adapt their rules themselves, and that amending the statute is not desirable.
Amending the statutory provisions is not something I consider desirable.
Aanpassing van de wettelijke bepalingen acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over diplomafraude in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about concrete actions against diploma fraud in care, the number of investigations over ten years, prosecutions, how to stop unqualified staff, and whether DUO diploma extracts could be required. The minister answered that DUO runs a campaign on the Mijn diploma's register, that the IGJ reports rising numbers of notices, that a criminal investigation is ongoing without further detail, and that employers should require DUO extracts, though no binding measure was committed.
There is no nationwide comprehensive registration of the number of investigations into diploma fraud in care over the last ten years.
Er is geen landelijk sluitende registratie over het aantal onderzoeken naar diplomafraude in de zorg over de laatste tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over het bericht 'Fraude met valse diploma’s in zorg neemt toe: cashen over de rug van kwetsbare patiënten'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the inspectorate has enough tools and capacity to combat fraud with fake care diplomas, what consequences and patient-safety effects have occurred, and what is being done about malicious staffing agencies, online sellers and the upcoming integrity law. The minister answered that the inspectorate's powers are limited for sole traders and agencies outside its supervision, that criminal enforcement depends on reports, and that a DUO diploma extract will be required in hiring, while the integrity bill does not cover this fraud.
The intervention options for the IGJ are limited in these cases.
De interventie-mogelijkheden voor de IGJ zijn in deze gevallen beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de sponsordeal van Ajax en Unibet

An MP asked the ministers whether the Ajax-Unibet online gambling sponsorship deal, and the normalisation of gambling it may cause, is acceptable given the planned ban on gambling advertising. The minister answered that sponsorship is currently lawful within the rules, that the ban on role models in gambling ads applies from 30 June 2022, and that sponsorship by online gambling operators will be phased out via amendments to the Besluit Wrvk.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I have no view on individual sponsorship agreements.
Ik heb als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen opvatting over individuele sponsorovereenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Mogelijke corruptie in Zwols Isala-ziekenhuis groter dan gedacht’

MPs Tielen and Van Wijngaarden asked about possible corruption at Isala hospital and the roles of internal and external supervisors, reporting channels, further integrity instruments, and the Court of Audit's view on fraud oversight. The minister explained the existing supervisory framework (supervisory boards, NZa, IGJ, Governance Code Zorg 2022), said she has no overview of whipblower-channel numbers, and pointed to a forthcoming letter on the transformation of medical specialist companies.

I do not have an overview of the number of care providers that have a confidential person as a reporting point for deviant behaviour or integrity concerns, nor of the number of reports that reach the external supervisor via such a reporting point.

Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal zorgaanbieders dat beschikt over een vertrouwenspersoon als meldpunt voor afwijkend gedrag of zorg over integriteit dan wel van het aantal meldingen dat via een meldpunt bij de externe toezichthouder terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over financiële misstanden bij MartiniZorg

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about alleged financial misconduct at MartiniZorg and its parent company, including a dividend of 550,000 euros paid out against a 10,000 euro investment, and about rules on profit distribution, executive pay via dividends, and the planned Wibz bill. The Minister said excessive profit distribution is undesirable, pointed to planned statutory conditions on profit distribution and to supervisors for the specific case, and gave examples of municipal profit caps and an indicative timeline of 1 January 2025 for the bill.
I do not comment on the specific MartiniZorg case, but I can very well understand the question marks surrounding it.
Over de concrete casus van MartiniZorg doe ik geen uitspraak, maar ik kan mij de vraagtekens bij deze casus heel goed voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de lange wachttijden bij de ggz

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about long mental health waiting times, underspending of the budget by insurers, staff shortages at GGZ institutions, regional complex-care tables, transparency of waiting lists, and the promised letter on insurers' duty of care. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to measures and IZA agreements, promised transparency improvements and further talks, and gave a partial answer on some points without addressing budget oversight directly.
I therefore want to make agreements in the context of the Integrated Care Agreement (IZA) with care providers, professionals and health insurers on this point
Ik wil daarom in het kader van het Integraal Zorg Akkoord (IZA) afspraken maken met zorgaanbieders, professionals en zorgverzekeraars op dit punt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de GGZ

An MP asks the minister about mental health care waiting lists, a reported suicide while waiting, the Inspectorate's investigation, the legal care duty, and staff retention. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to planned measures via the Integraal Zorgakkoord and NZa oversight, declines to publish the inspectorate's findings, and says a waiting time alone is not a legal violation.
Due to the confidentiality (including professional secrecy) of the information and the privacy of those involved, the IGJ has informed me it will not publish the content of the investigation.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid (o.a. beroepsgeheim) van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkenen heeft de IGJ mij laten weten niet over de inhoud van het onderzoek te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht dat statushouders en nieuwkomers van buiten de EU het personeelstekort in de hartzorg verkleinen

MPs Van den Hil and Becker asked about reports that refugees and non-EU newcomers are easing health-care staffing shortages, and how to speed up BIG registration and link newcomers with care jobs. The minister answered that the government supports win-win approaches, cites a pilot mentoring project and the TAZ programme, and says no overview of municipal arrangements exists nationally.
An overview of all ongoing agreements between municipalities and care institutions on job placement and work experience places does not exist at national level.
Een overzicht van alle lopende afspraken van gemeenten met zorginstellingen bij de bemiddeling naar werk en/of werkervaringsplekken is er niet op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het traineren van het onderzoek naar de mondkapjesdeal

An MP asks why the health ministry only acted after the investigators' warning, whether it is obstructing the Deloitte probe into the face-mask deal (including withheld and filtered data and the private emails of a former minister), and whether delays endanger the report. The minister denies a deliberate conflict, says the ministry is cooperating and that the first report may slip to September because of extended hearing periods.
The research bureau submitted a formal request to the ministry asking for the CISO report with the investigation results on the ministry's correspondence.

Het onderzoeksbureau heeft bij het Ministerie van VWS een formeel verzoek ingediend waarin het bureau dit rapport met onderzoeksresultaten van de CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) van VWS opvraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemende druk op mantelzorgers en ouderenmishandeling

An MP asked the government about pressure on informal carers, respite care availability, and monitoring and registration of elder abuse. The State Secretary answered that carers' overload is addressed through the upcoming WOZO and carer policy agenda, that a national respite network is not planned in favour of local tailored provision, and that monitoring of informal help is not structurally done and registration is not favoured, while promising talks on earlier detection of abuse.
I will engage with the VNG, the Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis and relevant parties such as MantelzorgNL on the possibilities to identify derailed informal care earlier.
Ik zal met de VNG, het Landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis en betrokken partijen zoals MantelzorgNL in gesprek gaan over de mogelijkheden om ontspoorde mantelzorg eerder in beeld te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Kassa over digitale toegankelijkheid en verdere verantwoordelijkheden rond een toegankelijke samenleving13-6-2022

MP Werner (CDA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast on the digital inaccessibility of government websites and apps, the widening digital divide, enforcement of the 2018 accessibility decision, ministerial responsibility for an accessible society, support for businesses, and whether a government accessibility commissioner should be appointed. The minister acknowledges persistent accessibility problems, describes a step-by-step plan with strengthened supervision and an accessibility facilitator, but declines to appoint a separate commissioner.
To ensure that improvement measures actually lead to better accessibility, not only extra support is offered to government organisations, but supervision of compliance is also strengthened.

Om te waarborgen dat verbetermaatregelen daadwerkelijk leiden tot betere toegankelijkheid wordt niet alleen extra ondersteuning geboden aan overheidsorganisaties, maar ook het toezicht op de naleving versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Zonder DigiD lukt zorgen bijna niet'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the difficulty legal representatives and informal carers face handling government matters online, since DigiD is personal and sharing it is prohibited. The government acknowledges the problem, says it is developing a central service to verify representative authority from court registers, and maintains that DigiD must remain personal for protection reasons.

Under my responsibility, a central solution is now being developed which, after a login request by a representative, queries the necessary source registers and issues a declaration to the service provider concerned.

Onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid wordt nu gewerkt aan een centrale oplossing die, na een inlogverzoek door een vertegenwoordiger, de benodigde bronregisters bevraagt en een verklaring afgeeft aan de dienstverlener in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Formule E-coureurs hopen op race in Eindhoven'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the prospects of a Formula E race in Eindhoven, including contact with the Formula E CEO, the government's role, and the requirements for hosting. The minister replied that the government has no direct contact with the CEO, that the ministry coordinates support across departments via a support letter, and that a concrete plan from the local organiser is still needed.
The priority now is that a concrete plan comes forward, with clarity on the timeline, sound financial justification and involvement of other parties.
Het is nu zaak dat er een concreet plan komt, met daarin duidelijkheid over de planning, een gedegen financiële onderbouwing en betrokkenheid van andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer sterfgevallen door Groningse aardbevingsstress'

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the government about a report linking Groningen earthquake stress to possible deaths, and about actions taken, the link to research, psychological effects on residents and children, and the implementation of a motion on children's wellbeing. The state secretary said he was shocked, committed to ending gas extraction in 2023 or 2024, listed funding for social-emotional support and the Commission for Special Situations, and said the child-wellbeing motion was implemented through a research project and follow-up actions.
I am shocked by these figures and will meet with the researchers in July.
Ik ben geschrokken van deze cijfers en ga in juli met de onderzoekers in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over opmerkingen van buurtsportcoach mevrouw N. Haarman tijdens het rondetafelgesprek ‘bewegingsarmoede’ op 21 februari jl.

An MP asked whether municipalities using neighbourhood sports coaches as physical education teachers, paid under the sports collective agreement rather than the education one, circumvents co-financing duties and should be banned. The minister said the arrangement is undesirable, will discuss it with the municipalities concerned and VSG, and will examine the practice in the upcoming revision of the regulation.
On substance, I find it undesirable if such a construction leads to the neighbourhood sports coach being deployed solely in education.
Inhoudelijk vind ik het onwenselijk als een dergelijke constructie leidt tot enkel de inzet van een buurtsportcoach in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over pilot om zorgexpats aan te trekken als deel van de oplossing tegen de personeelstekorten in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about recruiting specialised foreign nurses and whether the Netherlands should copy schemes in the UK and Ireland, plus shortage forecasts and licensing barriers. The minister answered that foreign recruitment is a last resort, that a review of the BIG licensing process is underway, and that no target figure or accelerated scheme will be set.
I will therefore carry out an exploration into how the process can be improved for care organisations that need foreign care staff.
Ik zal daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar hoe het proces kan worden verbeterd voor zorgorganisaties, die behoefte hebben aan buitenlands zorgpersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontbreken van een nationaal zwemdiploma en garanties voor veiligheid en kwaliteit van het zwemonderwijs

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the absence of a national swimming diploma and safeguards for the safety and quality of swimming lessons, citing a Radar report. The minister acknowledged concern, said the sector currently bears primary responsibility, and said the national swimming safety council is exploring regulation scenarios and that the minister will decide on a national diploma after consultation, while declining to adopt the proposal to reintroduce school swimming.
At present, a high degree of responsibility rests with the sector itself to provide swimming lessons responsibly.
Op dit moment ligt een hoge mate van verantwoordelijkheid bij de branche zelf om op een verantwoorde wijze zwemles te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Wijkverpleging gebruikt nog veel onnodige vijfminutenregistratie'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about reports that a third of home-care providers still use the time-consuming five-minute registration, and what steps would end it. The minister says the practice is unacceptable, that about 8% still use the manual form which will be targeted, and that the government will actively approach remaining providers to support the switch to the alternative standard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Bikker over het PGB

MPs Sahla and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care why small-scale residential initiatives that function as care in kind are no longer structurally eligible for personal budgets (PGB), and how this affects beneficiaries' self-direction. The Minister defends the policy as aimed at budget holders who truly self-direct, says the government will work with care offices on contracting while keeping PGB where self-direction is real, and promises further consultation and a self-direction checklist.
My ambition for the PGB in residential initiatives starts from the perspective of the client.
Mijn ambitie met het pgb in wooninitiatieven start vanuit het perspectief van de cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over verdrinkingen in Nederland

An SP MP asked about the true number of drownings in the Netherlands, CBS reporting methods, a possible repeat of a 2009 traffic-drowning campaign, suicide prevention with Stichting 113, and aftercare for lifeguards facing suicide attempts. The minister explains that CBS counts accidental drownings under the cause-of-death classification while broader reporting is planned, says the 2009 campaign had measurable awareness effects but limited proven impact on drownings, and promises to discuss suicide prevention with Stichting 113 and to raise lifeguard aftercare with open-water supervisors.
With the broader perspective that CBS adopts in future publications, I expect that we will have a complete picture of all drownings in the Netherlands in the future.
Met de bredere blik die het CBS in volgende publicaties hanteert, ga ik ervan uit dat we in de toekomst een compleet beeld hebben van alle verdrinkingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over maatregelen om hersenschade bij diverse sporten te beperken

Written questions from MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) ask the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about head injuries and brain damage in sports, including current injury figures, high-risk sports, protocols, fight-sport rules, a youth heading study, and a ministry working group. The minister answers that head injury data are from 2021 with no current figures, sport-wide protocols do not exist, the ministry funds no research, and the minister will consider asking the Health Council and report in mid-2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over hydroxychloroquine als vroeg-behandeling tegen Covid-19 en de werkwijze van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd

An MP asked the Minister of Health about hydroxychloroquine as early Covid-19 treatment, the IGJ's 2020 ban on off-label prescribing in primary care, and its enforcement. The minister answered that the IGJ only enforces existing law, that the Wob document was of little relevance, and that the ministry bought the drug as a precaution, with one fine and one disciplinary case issued.
The IGJ does not itself create laws and regulations, but supervises on the basis of laws and regulations.
IGJ stelt zelf geen wet- en regelgeving op, maar houdt toezicht op grond van wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de beschikbaarheid van nachtzorg

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the availability of night-time care in Overijssel and elsewhere, whether incontinence care needs are going unmet, how providers can deliver it, and whether financing is adequate. The minister said the affected Overijssel cuts concern Zorgverzekeringswet district nursing, that a Berenschot evaluation found 37% of regions lack adequate arrangements for unplanned night care with a follow-up study underway, that new funding for unplanned night care took effect in 2022, and that insurers' joint purchasing is limited to preferred contracting and follow-up policy.
I consider it important to monitor the availability of unplanned night care because a client must be able to use it in the event of an emergency.
Ik vind het belangrijk om de beschikbaarheid van de ongeplande nachtzorg te monitoren omdat het belangrijk is dat een client in geval van een calamiteit hiervan gebruik kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over personeelstekorten in de wijkverpleging

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about staff shortages in community nursing, including whether insurers meet their duty of care, how the Integraal Zorgakkoord addresses labour market problems, and how administrative burdens can be reduced. The Minister answered that insurers show no structural under-contracting, outlined labour-market and registration-burden measures, and committed to an independent study on harmonising procurement and reporting requirements due in the third quarter of 2022.
I expect to be able to inform the House in the third quarter of this year about the outcomes of the study and the follow-up.
Ik verwacht uw kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en de opvolging daarvan te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Hoe een zorgaanbieder heel makkelijk te veel zorg kan declareren'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a news report on how care providers can easily over-declare care, asking how annual accounts are checked, how often the NZa acted on fraud signals, whether whistleblowing channels exist, whether a municipal escalation model with the Public Prosecution Service exists, and the status of removing the double-intent requirement from the Wmo 2015. The minister answered that the NZa uses annual accounts for risk detection and lists informal and formal interventions over five years, points to NZa and municipal reporting channels, denies a formal escalation model but describes ongoing cooperation with the OM/FP, and expects the Wmo amendment in spring 2023.
I expect to present this bill to your House in spring 2023.
Ik verwacht dit wetsvoorstel in het voorjaar van 2023 aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Recordaantal klachten en vragen over discriminatie in 2021'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a report that discrimination complaints in 2021 were at a record high, mostly concerning disability and chronic illness, and about accessibility, measures under the UN Disability Convention, and the effects of COVID-19. The ministers answered that accessibility remains a matter of awareness, that 88% of respondents complied with rulings, that a 2022 policy approach continues implementation, and that they will continue inclusion efforts and housing and labour market initiatives.
88% of the respondent parties found to be in violation were willing to take measures following a ruling finding a breach of equal treatment legislation.

88% van de in het ongelijk gestelde verwerende partijen waren bereid om maatregelen te treffen naar aanleiding van een uitspraak waarin tot schending van de gelijke behandelingswetgeving werd geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Door uitblijven coronastrategie komt lockdown weer in beeld’

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about a risk of a lockdown from a lack of a corona strategy, the National Care Reserve, sick-leave prevention, workforce efficiency and labour-saving innovation. The minister answered that the reserve is still being developed, that the government will update parliament in summer, and listed existing measures and programmes without giving firm new deadlines or commitments on the substance.
At present the legal, implementation and financial questions of the National Care Reserve (as a public task) are being further worked out.
Op dit moment worden de juridische, de uitvoeringstechnische en de financiële vraagstukken van de Nationale Zorgreserve (als een publieke taak) nader uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over het blokkeren van IC-capaciteit tijdens de coronacrisis

MP Goudzwaard asks whether the health ministry discouraged hospitals from expanding IC capacity during the pandemic, citing disputes over subsidy conditions, legal threats and a possible rejected expansion. The minister denies discouraging expansion, acknowledges disputes with about fourteen hospitals over bed definitions and subsidy terms, and says a corrected bed list was adopted with hospitals given a choice to expand in phase 1, but the answers to the NRC journalist's questions were not available in time.
There was never any advice to cut beds.
Er is nooit geadviseerd bedden te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Laan over spreekkoren bij de voetbalwedstrijd tussen de nationale mannenelftallen van Nederland en Duitsland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Laan asked whether homophobic chants were heard at the Netherlands–Germany football match, why the match was not halted, and how the motion on stopping matches for racist or homophobic chants is being implemented. The minister confirmed the chants, said the organisers acted by sending stewards and the chants stopped quickly, and pointed to the OVIVI plan and KNVB rules as the framework, referring to an earlier letter for details.
Furthermore, I am in discussion with the KNVB to bring chants more to the attention of the professional football organisations.
Voorts ben ik met de KNVB in gesprek om spreekkoren meer onder de aandacht te brengen van de betaald voetbalorganisaties (bvo's).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over papieren rietjes

The MP Agema (PVV) asked the Minister of Health about the safety of paper straws after an NVWA warning, including the risk to children and people with disabilities, and asked whether the plastic straw ban should be reversed. The Minister acknowledged the risk, said manufacturers are responsible for product safety and should find safer alternatives, and declined to reverse the ban.
I have no figures on that.
Ik heb daar geen cijfers over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over misstanden in de turnsport

Two MPs asked the ministers about alleged misconduct in gymnastics and the handling of former gymnasts' disciplinary case by the Instituut Sportrechtspraak, including whether the process was careful and why earlier warnings were not acted on. The minister says the disciplinary commission is independent and cannot be judged by the ministry, but promises a broader evaluation of sports disciplinary law, talks with the former gymnasts and the ISR, and an external study on the line between disciplinary and criminal law.
It is up to the independent disciplinary committee of the ISR to give a substantive judgment and rule on an individual case.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke tuchtcommissie van het ISR om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven en daarmee uitspraak te doen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Wat gaat er mis in de wereld van de huisartsen? Waarom stoppen er zoveel?’

An MP from the SP asked the health minister about the pressure on GPs, psychiatric patients remaining with GPs, administrative burden and training numbers, with 12 questions in total. The minister acknowledged the workload concerns, pointed to the forthcoming Integraal Zorgakkoord, administrative-burden programme and training expansion, and gave no binding new measures beyond promised letters.
I want to make agreements with GPs and other care providers in primary care on reducing workload and maintaining job satisfaction.
Ik wil samen met huisartsen en andere zorgverleners in de eerste lijn afspraken maken over vermindering van de werkdruk en behoud van werkplezier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over geldende richtlijnen inzake persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen (PBM) aan het begin van de coronacrisis en het onderzoek naar Long COVID

An MP asks the Health Minister about RIVM guidance on personal protective equipment at the start of the Covid crisis, the Outbreak Management Team advice, Long Covid care and research, and support for health workers affected. The minister answers that the guidance was an independent RIVM/expert product, that ministry input was only for clarification, lists ongoing Long Covid research, and refers to a planned subsidy scheme and a pending decision on a Long Covid fund.
The RIVM drew up these guidelines from its independent position and on the basis of experts and substantive specialists.
Het RIVM heeft deze uitgangspunten opgesteld vanuit zijn onafhankelijke positie en op basis van de van experts en inhoudelijk deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over zeer forse onregelmatigheden bij de uitkering van de zorgbonus in 2020 en 2021

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister of Long-term Care and Sport and the State Secretary of Finance about serious irregularities in the 2020 and 2021 care bonus, including whether bonuses were paid net as promised and whether a sample finding of tax errors in 35% of cases showed fraud or a subsidy windfall. The minister answered that the errors mainly concern incorrect reporting of tax paid rather than deliberate fraud, that overpaid subsidy will be recovered, that a sample was kept rather than extended to full checks, and that four fraud reports have been filed.
Audited subsidies that contain errors will be set at a lower amount. The excess subsidy paid out will be recovered within the applicable laws and regulations.
Gecontroleerde subsidies die fouten bevatten worden lager vastgesteld. Het teveel uitgekeerde subsidiebedrag wordt binnen de hiervoor geldende wet- en regelgeving teruggevorderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Ambulanceverpleegkundige Laura (39): 'Hij greep me bij mijn nek''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about reports that an ambulance nurse was assaulted, that police initially did not want to take her report, and whether the ELA agreements on violence against public-service workers were followed. The minister says police and prosecutors apply the ELA agreements, that the next evaluation is due in 2024, and that some reporting issues will be discussed with the sector, but declines to comment on the individual case and disputes the claimed doubling of incidents.
As is known, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht dat zorgbestuurders amper gecheckt worden op hun dubieuze verleden

An MP asks why none of the 1,270 new care providers registered in 2022 had a certificate of good conduct (VOG) or integrity check, and whether small care providers can be effectively checked for fraud under the Wtza. The minister replies that the notification duty is risk-based by design, that the application form already asks about management's past, that the overall fraud scale is unknown, and that an evaluation and further measures (Wbsrz, Wibz, a letter before summer) are planned.
The total extent of healthcare fraud in the Netherlands is not known.
De totale omvang van zorgfraude in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Hijink over het artikel 'Zorgbestuurders amper gecheckt op dubieus verleden’

MPs Van den Berg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport whether care directors with criminal records or dubious care histories can still easily start new youth or home-care organisations, and why none of the 1,270 new care businesses reporting in early 2022 were asked for a VOG or subjected to integrity checks. The minister replied that a board ban blocks registration at the Chamber of Commerce, that the licence application asks about board members' past, that the number of new businesses is not alarming, and that the IGJ is still analysing the figures.

The fact that no VOG has yet been requested or integrity investigation started for the Wtza licence only means that, based on the application form and the information sources checked, there has so far been no reason to do so.

Het feit dat bij de Wtza-vergunning nog geen VOG is opgevraagd of integriteitsonderzoek is gestart zegt uitsluitend dat er bij deze zorgaanbieders op basis van het aanvraagformulier en de gecheckte informatiebronnen vooralsnog geen aanleiding is geweest om dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het uitzonderen van sportbeoefening bij mogelijke toekomstige coronamaatregelen

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether sports restrictions remain possible under the sixth extension of the COVID-19 temporary law, whether sport could be designated essential, and how the long-term plan would protect sport. The minister confirmed sports measures stay available, said sport is a priority though not formally essential, and promised a long-term plan and health campaign by June, but did not answer all questions in time.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to provide the answers at this time.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording voor dit moment plaats te laten vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over zorgmedewerkers met post-covid-syndroom die reeds zijn ontslagen of dreigen hun baan te verliezen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport when the support scheme for care workers with post-COVID syndrome will start, whether dismissals are being reported, how employers were urged to hold off, whether UWV can point employers to the scheme, and what retroactive options exist for already-dismissed workers. The minister expects the subsidy scheme to be published by June, confirms reports of recent dismissals, outlines measures to inform employers, and explains that the scheme does not give workers a right to claim and the legal position of workers is unchanged.
I expect to publish the subsidy scheme by June at the latest.
Ik verwacht uiterlijk in juni de subsidieregeling te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Westerveld, Van den Berg en Bikker over de staat van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

Four MPs asked the minister about financial strain, possible closures, staffing shortages and the new mental health care payment model in Dutch GGZ. The minister answered that insurers and providers must resolve continuity and financial problems through contracting, that the NZa is monitoring and was asked to analyse closures, and that a joint working-arrangement process on freelance staffing was started, while leaving much of the detail to the sector.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me about any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Westerveld over de voorgenomen sluitingen van GGZ-instellingen en centra

MPs Kuiken and Westerveld asked about planned closures of mental health clinics, including the KIB in Amsterdam West and bed reductions at Altrecht's Eikenboom, asking about causes, continuity of care and waiting lists. The minister answered that closures stem from staff shortages and business considerations, that insurers and providers bear care responsibility under supervision by NZa and IGJ, and that the NZa has been asked to examine whether there is a common underlying problem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over reclame-uitingen voor ggz-zorg
