An MP asks the Minister of Long-Term Care about GGZ (mental health) advertising by providers such as Mindler, including whether it medicalises complaints, adds to waiting lists, targets young healthy patients, and whether such advertising can be banned. The Minister answers that advertising is permitted unless misleading (supervised by the NZa), GP referral remains required, the Inspectorate has imposed improvement measures and will re-inspect.
I have no insight into whether this specific treatment offer is profitable for Mindler.
Ik heb er geen zicht op of dit specifieke behandelaanbod winstgevend is voor Mindler.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over antwoorden op eerdere vragen over de tegemoetkoming voor turnsporters

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the compensation scheme for former gymnasts who suffered abuse, including the role of the advisory group, the 30-hour training criterion, the scope and funding of the scheme, alternative treatment, and the follow-up to a motion on disciplinary versus criminal law. The minister replies that the scheme was simplified and made more accessible, the advisory group's advice is non-binding, the 30-hour criterion has been dropped, a motion will be included in a broader study, and that he cannot say who qualifies.
I cannot make statements about who is eligible for the compensation.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen wie in aanmerking komt voor de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de voorgenomen sluitingen van GGZ-instellingen en centra

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about planned closures of mental health institutions (PsyQ, I-Psy, Pro Persona's Lunteren centre), their effect on availability of specialist care, waiting lists, and what the government will do. The Minister answered that closures are business-driven, that insurers and the NZa/IGJ bear and monitor continuity-of-care duties, that no national overview of closures exists, and that the NZa will analyse recent closures.
I have asked the NZa to analyse the recent closures and inform me of any common underlying causes.
Ik heb de NZa gevraagd om de recente sluitingen te analyseren en mij te informeren over eventuele gemeenschappelijke achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de zorgbonus voor pgb-zorgverleners en de tegemoetkoming voor mantelzorgers

An MP asked the Minister why self-employed PGB care workers still cannot claim the care bonus for 2020 and 2021, when this will be possible, and about municipal cuts to carers' allowances. The Minister explained privacy and subsidy-law obstacles for the Zvw-PGB group, gave no firm date, and said municipalities have discretion and that the government will work with them on carer support.
If these aspects lead to a positive result, the scheme can be published with my approval and the application window for both bonuses (2020 and 2021) can be opened.

Indien deze aspecten tot een positief resultaat leiden, kan de regeling met mijn akkoord worden gepubliceerd en kan tot openstelling van het aanvraagloket voor beide bonussen (2020 en 2021) worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid den Haan over de nieuwe cao-afspraken voor personeel in de Verpleeg- en Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorg (VVT)

MP Den Haan asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about wage gaps for VVT care staff, the adequacy of OVA indexation, and whether insurers should compensate the gap and whether underspending in community nursing should fund a higher VVT pay rise. The Minister replies that the OVA system works, wage differences are complex to compare, the government provides a 675 million euro boost and the VVT cao offers up to about 6.25 percent, and declines to use underspending or to change insurer obligations, which are for private parties.
Collective labour agreements are concluded at the bargaining table by employers and trade unions.
Cao's worden door werkgevers en vakbonden gesloten aan de cao-tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat Buurtzorg Nederland al haar zorgmedewerkers gaat indelen in een hogere salarisschaal

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the government would follow Buurtzorg in placing all its care staff in a higher salary scale, how many staff Buurtzorg employs, and what starting, mid-career and late-career salaries are for district nurses, nursing assistants, primary school teachers and police officers. The minister answered that salary levels are set by collective bargaining partners rather than by government, gave the requested staffing and shortage figures and salary examples, and noted that the government provides annual funding for pay increases.
Determining the level of salaries in care is ultimately the responsibility of employer and employee representatives in the sector who negotiate at the collective bargaining table.
Het uiteindelijk vaststellen van de hoogte van salarissen in de zorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers- en werknemersvertegenwoordigers in de zorg die aan de cao-tafel onderhandelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Van Nispen over de ontoereikendheid van de aanpak om ontuchtplegers en daders van seksueel geweld in de sport te weren

MPs Van der Laan and Van Nispen asked the minister whether screening tools such as the VOG and the NOC*NSF blacklist adequately keep sex offenders out of sports coaching, and about information-sharing gaps. The minister acknowledged the gap, declined to link disciplinary information to the VOG, said a shared registration system is blocked by the GDPR, and promised further talks and a national action plan without committing to a specific legal change.
I consider linking disciplinary information to the Certificate of Conduct for Natural Persons (VOG) undesirable.
Ik acht het koppelen van tuchtrechtinformatie aan de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag Natuurlijke Personen (VOG) niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over zwembaden die door hoge energieprijzen tot wanhoop gedreven worden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how swimming pools and sports halls facing high energy prices could be kept open and affordable. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to VAT cuts, municipal sports funding for energy costs, and sustainability subsidies, and said a Mulier Institute study is pending.
The Cabinet has proposed several generic measures to mitigate the consequences of this price increase, including lowering the VAT on energy from 21 to 9 percent as of 1 July 2022.
Het Kabinet heeft enkele generieke maatregelen voorgenomen om de gevolgen van deze prijsstijging te dempen waaronder verlaging van de btw op energie van 21 naar 9 procent per 1 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'De Atletiekunie is succesvol, maar zit in nijpende geldnood'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about a newspaper report that the athletics federation (Atletiekunie) is successful but in financial distress, including why NOC*NSF funding has fallen despite results. The minister answered that the budget is closed and allocation is NOC*NSF's responsibility, that total support has not declined, and that sports federations are making prioritisation choices with a broader sector strategy under discussion.
The allocation of available financial resources across promising top sport programmes is the responsibility of NOC*NSF.
De verdeling van de beschikbare financiële middelen over kansrijke topsportprogramma’s is de verantwoordelijkheid van de NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over meldingen dat kleine kinderen bijna zijn gestikt in papieren rietjes

An MP asked the Health Minister whether inspectorates would investigate reports of children nearly choking on paper straws, and whether the environmental benefit outweighs the risk, and whether the ban should be reversed. The minister said the NVWA is investigating, the IGJ has no incident reports and will act on its own risk assessment, and that the plastic straw ban stays because alternatives must meet safety rules.
I support the NVWA's initiative to investigate this further and will keep an eye on whether the supervisor receives signals that additional measures are needed.
Ik steun het initiatief van de NVWA om dit nader te onderzoeken en zal in het oog houden of de toezichthouder signalen krijgt dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Rudmer Heerema over de voorkeur voor de vakleerkracht bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Van Nispen and Rudmer Heerema asked whether all physical education lessons in primary schools should be given by ALO-qualified specialist teachers, including what barriers exist and whether a law change is planned. The minister replied that the current mix of specialist and qualified group teachers should remain, that a full switch is unrealistic given teacher shortages and funding, and that no law change is warranted.
Given the current education labour market, I see no reason to change the law on this point.
Ik zie, gelet op de huidige onderwijsarbeidsmarkt, geen aanleiding om de wet op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Kuzu over het bericht dat de zorg nog niet klaar is om de groeiende groep oudere migranten met dementie op passende wijze zorg te verlenen

MPs Den Haan and Kuzu asked whether healthcare is adequately prepared for older migrants with dementia, citing missed diagnoses, language barriers and lack of culturally adapted tests. The minister answered that GP guidelines already address this, that a study on interpreters is underway with results expected around summer, that culture-specific care guidance exists, and that a letter on culturally sensitive care will follow in autumn 2022.
Given the growing number of people with a migration background who depend on good care, I will send your House a letter on culturally sensitive care in autumn 2022.
Gegeven het toenemend aantal mensen met een migratie-achtergrond dat op goede zorg is aangewezen, zal ik uw Kamer in het najaar 2022 een brief doen toekomen over cultuursensitieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het grote verschil in prognoses voor tekorten aan zorgmedewerkers in de verpleeghuizen tussen november 2020 en nu

Agema (PVV) asks why the projected nursing-home staff shortage fell sharply between the November 2020 forecast (31,700 in 2022) and the January 2022 forecast (17,900), and how the government will maintain care quality while a planned 350 million euro cut equivalent to 6,000 staff is made to the quality framework. The minister attributes the difference to updated data, revised COVID assumptions and a changed methodology, and says the cut is a redesign of the framework toward outcome-based norms with more informal care and technology.
For 2030 a shortage between 54,100 and 70,200 employees was expected.
Voor 2030 werd een tekort tussen de 54.100 en 70.200 werknemers verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het stopzetten van de succesvolle gedragsinterventie “sport en gedrag”

MP Van Nispen asks whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' behavioural intervention, which runs on project funding until end-2022, will be continued and funded structurally, and whether Halt or the Justice Ministry should take it over. The Minister says the intervention is well-regarded but its effects are not yet proven, that funding after 2022 is still under discussion with Halt and the KNVB, and that the justice role of Halt does not cover cases without a police report.
For a decision on funding after 2022 it is therefore still too early.
Voor een besluit over de financiering na 2022 is het daarom nu nog te vroeg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en De Neef over het bericht 'Weer meer incidenten met verwarde personen'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Neef asked about rising police registrations of incidents involving people with confused behaviour (over 100,000 in 2020, 130,184 in 2021) and whether most are care matters rather than police matters, plus what measures and national teams have done, how municipal approaches differ, and whether the Veldhoven model and suggested joint police-care consultations should be adopted. The minister answered that the registration rise is not a clear indicator of growth, outlined ongoing triage pilots and national programmes, and promised to consider the suggestions and inform parliament before summer.

Although I share the concerns about the number of registrations, based on the registration of E33 reports it is not possible to state in general terms what share of these cases actually required care or support.

Hoewel ik de zorgen over het aantal registraties deel, is het op basis van de registratie van E33-meldingen niet mogelijk om in algemene zin aan te geven in welk aandeel van deze gevallen eigenlijk zorg of ondersteuning nodig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de tegemoetkomingsregeling van 5000 euro voor (oud-)gymsporters en het artikel Stringente criteria voor aanvraag tegemoetkoming turnleed

MP Westerveld asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the 5,000 euro compensation scheme for former gymnasts, including its short application window, strict eligibility criteria, the requirement to present their account to a commission, tax and benefit implications, and the lack of a hardship exemption. The Minister largely defends the scheme as based on the Ongelijke leggers report and NOC*NSF advice, while acknowledging burdens, promising monitoring, talks with stakeholders, and a clarification from the tax authority that the payment does not affect benefits.
The progress of the compensation is carefully monitored and in the short term I will discuss this with the parties involved.
Het verloop van de tegemoetkoming wordt zorgvuldig gemonitord en op korte termijn zal ik hierover spreken met de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de laatste stand van zaken van zorgmedewerkers met post-covidsyndroom

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the number of care workers with long COVID entering the WIA disability scheme per month, about agreements with social partners and UWV, and about a bridging arrangement. The minister replied that privacy rules prevent employers from recording the cause of sick leave, that UWV applies the same assessment to all WIA claims, and that a temporary support measure for employers is being offered while research continues.
Under privacy regulations, employers are not permitted to record the reason or cause of sick leave.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving is registratie van de reden of oorzaak van ziekteverzuim door werkgevers niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen voor mensen met een beperking

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about insurance and repair of mobility aids for people with disabilities, long repair waits, administrative burden and whether national rules are uniform. The state secretary answered that gemeenten cover repairs for loaned aids and that casco insurance is not required by law, that repair times and administrative burden are monitored, and that a second monitor is due in autumn 2022.
I have no insight into how much time aid users spend on their administration or how many forms they must fill in; this is not tracked anywhere.
Ik heb geen zicht op hoeveel tijd hulpmiddelengebruikers kwijt zijn aan hun administratie of hoeveel formulieren zij moeten invullen, dit wordt nergens bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het nieuwsitem in Hart van Nederland d.d. 11 februari 2022

An MP asked the minister whether the Ouderenfonds' decision to end the Zilverlijn phone service for lonely elderly, announced only a month in advance, was acceptable and whether the ministry would talk to the fund. The state secretary said the fund made an independent choice in which the ministry plays no role, that alternative phone services remain available, and that the ministry keeps in regular contact with the fund on loneliness initiatives.
Stopping the Zilverlijn and the way it was announced was an independent policy choice by the Ouderenfonds in which VWS played no role.
Het stoppen met de Zilverlijn en de wijze waarop dat bekend is gemaakt is een zelfstandige beleidskeuze geweest van het Ouderenfonds waarin VWS geen rol heeft gespeeld.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Maeijer over de noodoproep van een radeloze moeder

An MP asked whether the minister knows of a desperate mother's emergency appeal about her daughter with an eating disorder, whether the girl should get immediate specialist treatment, why some clinics set BMI floors, and how many young people are waiting. The state secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, pointed to regional responsibility and extra funding and initiatives, and said no central waiting-list overview exists but a regional wait-time analysis is being commissioned with a progress report promised.
For reasons of privacy for the mother and daughter, I cannot go into the individual case in parliamentary questions.
Met het oog op privacy van moeder en dochter kan ik in Kamervragen niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen bij patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Long-term Care ministers about police use of the taser on psychiatric patients, including the LOC's call for a ban, the status of promised independent health-effects research, alternatives and the risks for vulnerable people. The minister says police use there is exceptional and a ban is undesirable, that police cannot count taser use in care settings, that the promised research is more complex than expected and will be reported later, and that no equivalent alternatives are known.
This question cannot be answered. The police do not explicitly register a mental health institution as an 'incident location' in their registration system.
Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De politie registreert niet expliciet een ggz-instelling als «incident locatie» in haar registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Politielint in de gang, lachgas in de tuin: zorghuis werd een ‘horror’ voor moeders'

An MP asked the minister about a report on a care home in Tilburg, the oversight of municipal Wmo care, and whether an independent inquiry was needed. The state secretary acknowledged concerning signals about municipal Wmo oversight, announced follow-up on an oversight study, and declined an independent inquiry because the matter falls to the supervisory bodies.
I do not intend to commission an independent inquiry into Acuut Zorggroep because this is not a task or responsibility of mine.
Ik ben niet van plan om een onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar Acuut Zorggroep omdat dit geen taak of verantwoordelijkheid is van mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Mishandeld en verkracht: is dit nou beschermd wonen?'

MP Kuiken asked the minister about press reports on serious abuse and rape in supported housing (beschermd wonen) at RIBW Brabant, and whether this points to wider problems with municipal oversight. The state secretary acknowledged the reports are concerning, said she knows of no similar cases at other institutions, and noted that municipal oversight of the Wmo2015 is failing in places, leading to a study with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022.
At the same time, I recognise the signals about the functioning of Wmo oversight.
Tegelijkertijd herken ik de signalen over het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afname van de zwemvaardigheid onder kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked why the share of children with swimming diplomas is falling and what the minister will do to reverse it, including whether the pool closures during lockdowns were justified. The minister acknowledges concern, explains that pool closures were a deliberate trade-off favouring swimming lessons only from March 2021, and says the backlog is mainly the sector's responsibility, with a letter on progress promised for spring 2022.
That is why on 8 March 2021 the importance of swimming lessons was weighed more heavily than limiting the number of infections.
Daarom is op 8 maart 2021 het belang van zwemles zwaarder gewogen dan de beperking van het aantal besmettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over het artikel 'Osse hospice Oase voert strijd tegen lagere subsidie: ‘Als direct gevolg corona volkomen onterecht gekort''

MPs Werner and Peters asked the minister about a regional report that Oss hospice Oase received lower palliative care subsidy for 2022 because the 2020 COVID-19 dip in client numbers was included in the calculation. The minister answered that the subsidy formula is based on actual client numbers over three years, that no case-specific adjustment is possible to keep the scheme simple, that 111 organisations gained and 90 lost subsidy, and that a one-off COVID compensation was given while 2021 will be considered for 2023.
Despite the coronavirus pandemic, it has been decided to keep the existing method of the subsidy scheme for subsidy year 2022.
Ondanks de coronapandemie is besloten om voor het subsidiejaar 2022 vast te houden aan de bestaande werkwijze van de subsidieregeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over de positie van klokkenluiders binnen de sport

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about whistleblower protection in sport, noting that the planned whistleblower scheme only applies to organisations with 50 or more employees, which most sports bodies do not reach. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to the Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland as the existing reporting point, and said the positioning of that centre is under discussion and will be considered, without committing to a concrete deadline or new scheme.
I am in consultation with parties about the positioning of the Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland, as also requested in the motion by Van der Laan et al.
Ik ben met partijen in overleg over de positionering van het Centrum Veilige Sport Nederland zoals ook motie Van der Laan c.s. vraagt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een zorgmedewerker die 10.000 pillen achterhield van verpleeghuisbewoners voor wie deze geneesmiddelen noodzakelijk zijn en dat de regering voornemens is het Waar

An MP asked the minister about a care worker who withheld 10,000 pills from nursing home residents and about the government's plan to abolish the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn, a warning register for abusive care workers. The minister replied that abolition was decided by the sector body RegioPlus, that the government supports it, that other instruments such as the vergewisplicht, VOG and BIG register remain, and that a broader analysis of instruments will follow.
Whether or not to abolish the Waarschuwingsregister is not up to me.
Het al dan niet opheffen van het Waarschuwingsregister is niet aan mij.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat een zorgmedewerker die 10.000 pillen achterhield van verpleeghuisbewoners voor wie deze geneesmiddelen noodzakelijk zijn en dat de regering voornemens is het Waar

MP Agema asked the government about a nurse who withheld 10,000 pills from nursing home residents and about the planned closure of the Waarschuwingsregister Zorg en Welzijn, a warning register for care workers. The minister answered that the closure was a decision by RegioPlus, supported by the government, that existing preventive and repressive instruments will be analysed and strengthened, and that the register was abandoned earlier because mandatory participation had legal and practical objections.
I am convinced that precisely the combination of preventive and repressive instruments contributes most strongly to safe care relationships.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat juist de combinatie van inzet van preventieve en repressieve instrumenten, het sterkst bijdraagt aan veilige zorgrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Mantelzorgers en professionals moeten het samen zien te rooien, ‘maar overheid moet dan ook iets bieden’

An MP asked whether a Maastricht hospital's 'Mantelzorgacademie' training patients and carers to perform medical tasks such as IV antibiotics, and whether carers face pressure to take over care, and who bears legal responsibility. The state secretary replied that training is voluntary, case-by-case, supervised by professionals, that carers performing such tasks are not acting professionally under the BIG Act, and that the government will keep working on formal-informal care cooperation.
If someone performs reserved acts non-professionally, the BIG Act does not apply to them.
Als iemand niet beroepsmatig voorbehouden handelingen uitvoert dan is de Wet BIG niet op hem van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over berichten dat geld voor gerichte salarisverhogingen in de zorg niet goed terecht komt

MP Van den Hil asked whether the 675 million euro for targeted care-sector salary increases is reaching the intended workers, how the minister supervises this, and whether she agrees the funds should target specific pay scales. The minister denies receiving such signals, says social partners hold primacy over pay, notes an agreement with employers to narrow middle-scale pay gaps, and agrees the funds are meant for specific pay scales.
I follow the collective agreement developments closely, including on the basis of the agreement made on 27 September with the care employers.
Ik volg de cao-ontwikkelingen op de voet, ook vanuit de afspraak zoals die is gemaakt op 27 september jl. met de zorgwerkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ieder jaar 3 miljard euro zorggeld verdwijnt in de zakken van mensen die mensen leveren die zorg leveren

An SP MP asked the government about a newspaper report that 3 billion euros of care funds yearly go to intermediary, recruitment and staffing agencies, and whether agency margins and wage-cost ratios were excessive. The minister answered that most of this sum pays wages and employer charges of agency staff, that margins are roughly 10 to 20 percent, and listed measures to reduce reliance on intermediaries.
The picture that paying costs for non-employed staff results in an annual profit of 3 billion euros for agencies is in any case incorrect.
Het beeld dat de betaling van kosten voor personeel niet in loondienst voor de bemiddelings- en uitzendbureaus resulteert in een jaarlijkse winst van € 3 miljard, is in ieder geval onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over het bericht dat de Minister van VWS de interne fitnessclub in het Erasmus MC openhield terwijl sportscholen gesloten zijn

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why the internal gym at Erasmus MC stayed open while public gyms were closed under the lockdown, and whether all gyms would reopen. The minister answered that the gym is a closed indoor space for staff, permitted under the rules with group-size and distancing limits, and that gyms were reopened on 14 January.
As for the fitness room at Erasmus MC, it is a closed indoor space.
Voor wat betreft de fitnessruimte in het Erasmus MC is sprake van een besloten binnenruimte.
